en: It is a great way to express your creativity and to bring beauty into your home.

kok: Khorosa dopha ni adong wngwi, chini thani kaisa bokjakmung tongo ah swkrok tei norms je chini hodano kaisa kaham tongna thai bwkhak sakatisama.
en: As a member of society, we have a responsibility to uphold the values and norms that make our community a better place to live.

kok: Khokmani wngkha chaya tamhinba omo bohrokni manwiphan tei manwikhwnwirok kubunrokno sinkwlwkmarok, tei omo kaisa jotto hoda sakao kaisa chaya sekrupma tongwi mano.
en: Stealing is wrong because it deprives others of their property and belongings, and it can have a negative impact on the community as a whole.

kok: Jephuru borok khogo, omo kaisa kirima habar tei poitochaya swnam mano.
en: When people steal, it can create an atmosphere of fear and distrust.

kok: Omo bagwi beparirok bwkhak chalukna tei borokno bohrokni nokrok tei nokganarok bising katijak wansukma bwkha bo omo swnam mano.
en: It can also make it difficult for businesses to operate and for people to feel safe in their homes and neighborhoods.

kok: Jora rwmung bising, khokmani tangsitra swkrok tei hodrwk oroiproi bangma bwkhak dagi mano.
en: In addition, stealing can lead to increased crime rates and social unrest.

kok: Tumungno chwng kaisa dopha swnamna muchungkhe boro jottono katijak wansukmarok tei boromjak wngkhe, hwnkhe chwng jottomanwi khai mansak khaina nangnai khaswbaima tei khokma kasogra.
en: If we want to create a society where everyone feels safe and respected, then we need to do everything we can to discourage and prevent theft.

kok: Chwng chini chwrairokno phwrwngmani bai khlaimano ah tongkwthar nangkukma tei kubunrokno kwrwi borom rwma bagwi, tei samung khaimani bai kwkrak hodarwl tei rangthog tonghalokrok swnamma bwkhak abo borokno haino kisa tangsitra bwkhak philma bwkhak swnamo.
en: We can do this by teaching our children about the importance of honesty and respect for others, and by working to create strong social and economic conditions that make people less likely to turn to crime.

kok: Kaisa hodarwkma simanwi habohrok wngkha, chwng jotto chini bokcho khaina nango chini hoda no kaisa kaham thai swnammaa bwkhak.
en: As a socially sensible citizen, we should all do our part to make our community a better place.

kok: Chwng kaichomjak wngna nango chathaya samung-humung saimanrimani bagwi tei chwng jesaphuru phano kwmamma tawngthwng khoroksaswkno chubana bwkhak je nangwi tongkhe.
en: We should be vigilant about reporting suspicious activity and we should never hesitate to help someone who is in need.

kok: Chwng chini saksakni tongmung no bwkhakuplung bo wngna nango tei wngkubui swnamdi je chwng mungsaphano khaiya twi je kubunrokno tangkiri thepai mano.
en: We should also be mindful of our own behavior and make sure that we are not doing anything that could put others at risk.

kok: Thansa khe samung khaimani bai, chwng kaisa dopha swnam mano boro jottono katijak wansukma tei boromjak mano.
en: By working together, we can create a society where everyone can feel safe and respected.

kok: Chwng omono kaisa thai swnam mano boro jottono thani ah sep tonganw khalimanma bwkhak, tei boro jottono thumlai kaisa kaham thai hayung swnammani bwkhak.
en: We can make it a place where everyone has the opportunity to succeed, and where everyone can contribute to making the world a better place.

kok: Oro wngkha baksa jora rwjak wansukmarok kaisa hodarwkma simanwi habohrok wngjak ah nangkukma sakao:
en: Here are some additional thoughts on the importance of being a socially sensible citizen:

kok: * Hodarwkma simanwi habohrokrok wngkha ah sekrupmao sijak kubunrokni sakao bohrokni samungrok.
en: * Socially sensible citizens are aware of the impact of their actions on others.

kok: Bohrok wansukha bahaikhe bohrokni tongmung ah hoda khobwi nwngarwmarok, tei bohrok saimungrok swnamo je jottoni bagwi manmari khayo.
en: They think about how their behavior affects the community as a whole, and they make choices that benefit everyone.

kok: * Hodarwkma simanwi habohrokrok wngkha kubunrokno chubana bwkhak gosimani.
en: * Socially sensible citizens are willing to help others.

kok: Bohrok bohrokni hoda bising kubuljak manna bwkhak kiriya wngkha tei kaisa pherlaima swnamnani.
en: They are not afraid to get involved in their community and make a difference.

kok: * Hodarwkma simanwi habohrokrok wngkha kubunrokno boromkuplung wngkha.
en: * Socially sensible citizens are respectful of others.

kok: Bohrok jottono borom tei borom rwma bai bebohar khayo, bohrokni bosong khauarya, tpngkwthar, sir, eba hodarangthong tongborom.
en: They treat everyone with dignity and respect, regardless of their race, religion, gender, or socioeconomic status.

kok: * Hodarwkma simanwi habohrokrok wngkha bokjak.
en: * Socially sensible citizens are responsible.

kok: Bohrok bojakmung nao bohrokni samungrokni bagwi tei bohrok wngkha thikejak ah sekrupma karwi bohrok ah hayung saka tongo.
en: They take responsibility for their actions and they are accountable for the impact they have on the world.

kok: Tumungno chwng jotto hodarwkma simanwi habohrokrok chaitoksukma khaikhe, chwng kaisa kaham hayung chini saksakni bagwi tei chini thinangni achaisongrok bagwi swnam mano.
en: If we all strive to be socially sensible citizens, we can create a better world for ourselves and for future generations.

kok: A: Nwng saideman je bolong tanmani wngkha kaisa nokbartwibar swlaijakmani dagimani twmwirok?
en: A: Did you know that deforestation is one of the leading causes of climate change?

kok: B: Ihin', ang siya.
en: B: No, I didn't.

kok: Abo bahai khe samung khai?
en: How does that work?

kok: A: Akon, chwng jephuru buphang rok raphaiyo, chwng haino buphangrokno baikhruptongmani khaiya phiya bohroksaksakno.
en: A: Well, when we cut down trees, we're not just destroying the trees themselves.

kok: Chwng lekhabaiya malamatarok tei buphang-uaphangrok tongma thai bo baikhruptongmani khayo.
en: We're also destroying the habitats of countless animals and plants.

kok: Tei jephuru chwng oh tongma thairok kwmajago, chwng ah manmarrok bo kwmajago je bohrok chwngno swnamtonio.
en: And when we lose these habitats, we also lose the benefits that they provide us.

kok: B: Bahaikhe?
en: B: Like what?

kok: A: Kahamno, phunukmari karwi, buphangrok nokbartwibar no cholirinani chubao.
en: A: Well, for example, trees help to regulate the climate.

kok: Bohrok carbon dioxide bo surupbo ah nokbar ni simi tei oxygen phiyogo.
en: They absorb carbon dioxide from the air and release oxygen.

kok: Bohrok haching kochokma tei twi lomani bo kasogra bwkha chubachu khayo.
en: They also help to prevent soil erosion and flooding.

kok: Tei bohrok chahthai tei malmatarokni bagwi tongthai swnamtonio.
en: And they provide food and shelter for animals.

kok: B: Aswkno bolong hokmani kaisa kwbang chaya sago kwlaimarok tongo.
en: B: So deforestation has a lot of negative effects.

kok: A: Omo hai wngo.
en: A: It does.

kok: Tei omo kaisa kebengmung je omo hamsukya wngwi tongo.
en: And it's a problem that's only getting worse.

kok: Bisi thwgwi, chwng chirasai bolong kanirok kwmjak tongo bolong hokmani bwkhak.
en: Every year, we lose millions of acres of forest to deforestation.

kok: Tei tumungno chwng mwthakna bagwi mungsaswk khaiya khe, ah bwthaih rok swbaimani wngna i.
en: And if we don't do something to stop it, the consequences will be devastating.

kok: B: Tamo chwng omono mwthakna bagwi tamo khainai?
en: B: What can we do to stop it?

kok: A: Arao wngkha kwbangma manwirok chwng khai mano.
en: A: There are a number of things we can do.

kok: Chwng chini bophang wngmanwi sanma khairwi mano.
en: We can reduce our demand for wood products.

kok: Chwng buphanagrok kaimano.
en: We can plant trees.

kok: Chess kaisa chapmung tei tang kwrwng ni thwngmung.
en: Chess is a game of strategy and tactics.

kok: Thwngnairok dalbidal lorimarok wansukna kwrwng wngna nango tei bohrokni batainai rokni lorimarok khathaima wngna nango.
en: Players must be able to think several moves ahead and anticipate their opponent's moves.

kok: Bohrok thwngmung ni naidal rok siniwui narakna nango tei bohrokno samung phwnangma bwkhak bohrokni tangsrai khainani.
en: They must also be able to recognize patterns in the game and exploit them to their advantage.

kok: Naidalrok sinijakmanai kaisa berepkhong yaksrai chess thwngnairokn bagwi.
en: Pattern recognition is a key skill for chess players.

kok: Omo bohrokno kotor mangpili naina rwo tei juda juda bokchorok buohangbwlap sakao bahaikhe khoroksa tei khoroksa bai kwrwnglai bahai khe buchinani.
en: It allows them to see the big picture and understand how the different pieces on the board interact with each other.

kok: Omo bohrokno mari sep manna chubawo tei swkang skrimung sakao, je bohrok kahamkuk khe lorimanirok wngwimanma swnam mano.
en: It also helps them to spot opportunities and threats early on, so that they can make the best possible moves.

kok: Buchimani wngkha teikaisa nangkukmani yaksrai chess thwngnairokni bagwi.
en: Intuition is another important skill for chess players.

kok: Omo borokno dakti chapmungrok tei kokthakjak swnamma bwkhak gosirio, jephuru aro aswk wansukna jora manya jotto wngwi manai saimungrokno twih.
en: It allows them to make decisions quickly and decisively, even when there is not enough time to think through all of the possible options.

kok: Buchimani uramuraam saimanjak twih hamrai wngo, phiya omo swrwngmani twih swrwngjak wngwi mano.
en: Intuition is often developed through experience, but it can also be learned through training.

kok: Kubuino, aro kwbangma juda yaksrairok tongo je chess thwngrokni bagwi nangkukmani, ahaino lekhamani, muituphan, tei bwkharwmani.
en: Of course, there are many other skills that are important for chess players, such as calculation, memory, and concentration.

kok: Haiphano, naidal sinijkamani tei buchimani wngkha kanwi jotto nangnai yaksrairok je jotto chess thwngnairokni oro tongo.
en: However, pattern recognition and intuition are two of the most essential skills that all good chess players have.

kok: Oro wngkha baksa phunukmari bahaikhe naidal sinijakmani tei buchimani chess o phwnangwi mano:
en: Here are some examples of how pattern recognition and intuition can be used in chess:

kok: * Kaisa thwngnai sinijak mano je borokni batainai kaisa chongjak khwih kaihnani chaitogwi tongo.
en: * A player may recognize that their opponent is trying to set up a particular trap.

kok: Khwih no khathaima bai, thwngnairok katiwui mano tei omo tangsrai aji mano.
en: By anticipating the trap, the player can avoid it and gain an advantage.

kok: * Kaisa thwngnai bohrokni batainai no buphangbwlap kaisa digi kebel khe nugwi mano.
en: * A player may see that their opponent is weak on one side of the board.

kok: Oh beljak no samungkhaima bai, thwngnairok thwngmungno kaswkma aji mano.
en: By exploiting this weakness, the player can gain control of the game.

kok: * Kaisa thwngnai kaisa kiryai wansukmani tongwi mano je kaisa khathrjak lormani kaisa kahamuk bwkha swnmam mano.
en: * A player may have a gut feeling that a certain move is the best one to make.

kok: Tumung borok baksa kok sukrubwi saimanya tangwiwi ang omtwi khe wansukma phai, bohrok kubui wngwi mano.
en: Even if they cannot explain why they feel this way, they may be right.

kok: Naidal sinimani tei buchimani wngkha yaksrairok hamkrai bwkhak wngya.
en: Pattern recognition and intuition are not easy skills to develop.

kok: Haiphano, bohrok jeba kaisa ni bagwi nangnai sabo kaham chess thwngnai wngna muchungjago.
en: However, they are essential for anyone who wants to become a good chess player.

kok: Loi khlaimung bai, oh yaksrairok sengsa buchuk hulwi mano, tei kaisa thwngnai thwngmungno jotto kwtal lama twi nugwi mananw.

kok: Bokobomrok:
en: Ingredients:

kok: * Jotto-nangma moida cup 1
en: * 1 cup all-purpose flour

kok: * Badam moida cup 1
en: * 1 cup almond flour

kok: * Pherekjak chini cup 1/2
en: * 1/2 cup granulated sugar

kok: * Chujak heleng somchak chini cup 1/4
en: * 1/4 cup packed light brown sugar

kok: * Baking Powder 1/2 tharukbwsa
en: * 1/2 teaspoon baking powder

kok: * Baking Soda 1/4 tharukbwsa 1/4
en: * 1/4 teaspoon baking soda

kok: * Som 1/4 tharukbwsa
en: * 1/4 teaspoon salt

kok: * Papthaya bothna cup 1/2 (latha 1) , tongkhor tungmari'o.
en: * 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, at room temperature

kok: * 1 toktwi kotor
en: * 1 large egg

kok: * 1 kotor toktwi bokhiri
en: * 1 large egg yolk

kok: * Badam sepjak 1 tharukbwsa
en: * 1 teaspoon almond extract

kok: * Dut cup 1/2
en: * 1/2 cup milk

kok: Phunukmani:
en: Instructions:

kok: 1. 350 degrees F'o (175 degrees C) thapa swkang muthungradi. Tok tei moida 8-inchi kiting kek pan.
en: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease and flour an 8-inch round cake pan.

kok: 2. Majar khurio, moida, pherekjak chini, somchak chini, baking powder, baking soda, tei somno baksakhe sapulwi.
en: 2. In a medium bowl, whisk together the flours, granulated sugar, brown sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.

kok: 3. Kotorma khurio, baksa khai makhon bai toktwino heleng tei lophung-lophung wngyasak sapuldi khlaidi. Toktwi bokhiri tei badam bwtwino sapuldi.
en: 3. In a large bowl, cream together the butter and egg until light and fluffy. Beat in the egg yolk and almond extract.

kok: 4. Remrem khai thumdi kwran bokobomrok kisi bokobomrokni saka rwdi, dutno khobwi. Sapuldi manjubaya sak.
en: 4. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, alternating with the milk. Mix until just combined.

kok: 5. Badamni moidano thapdi baksakhe bakjana wngya sak.
en: 5. Fold in the almond flour until evenly distributed.

kok: Ang uananjak wngkha je ang Lyme bemar kulummanjakma tongwi mano, phiya ang saknainai bwkha thangkha tei bo sakha je abo uanama bwkhak mungsa tongna kwrwi hwnwi.
en: I was worried that I might have contracted Lyme disease, but I went to the doctor and he said that I didn't have anything to worry about.

kok: Bo ano sakha je ah bothrai guri wngkha unngthokma haino ah swkrani khutwi bwkhak wngphimani.
en: He told me that the rash was probably just a reaction to the tick's saliva.

kok: Ang khwnama bwkhak holijakha je ani thani mungsa Lyme bemar kwrwi, phiya ang tabukbo kaisa chikonsa kisa uanajak ah bothrai gurini bagwi.
en: I was relieved to hear that I didn't have Lyme disease, but I was still a little bit concerned about the rash.

kok: Ah saknainai ano sakha je omo bini saksakno thangwi painai, phiya omo kisa hatibarrok nakha omo paihjakma kwmana bwkhak.
en: The doctor told me that it would go away on its own, but it took a few weeks for it to completely disappear.

kok: Ah wngdrop bising, anag ah bothrai guri kwchwng tei kwran tonima bwkhak chaitokkha.
en: In the meantime, I tried to keep the rash clean and dry.

kok: Baksa sakao-ah-bokhok hydrocortisone bithi bwthap ah motokmani holirwna bwkhak chubao.
en: I also applied some over-the-counter hydrocortisone cream to help relieve the itching.

kok: Ah bothrai guri motokma tei naithokya wngkha, phiya omo ano jesa kubun kebengmungrok pherjakya.
en: The rash was itchy and unsightly, but it didn't cause me any other problems.

kok: Ang haino khatung kha je ang thani mungsa Lyme bemar kwrwi.
en: I'm just glad that I didn't have Lyme disease.

kok: Tumungmo nwng kaisa swkra nini sago kwphajak mankha, omo jeswk daitono karina bwkhha omo nangkukma.
en: If you find a tick attached to your body, it's important to remove it as soon as possible.

kok: Nwng ah swkrano khepna bwkhak musna jura bai phwnang mano iko nini bukur gana wngmanma bwkhak tei omo phatar suja sotondi.
en: You can use a pair of tweezers to grasp the tick as close to the skin as possible and pull it straight out.

kok: Ah swkrakno atomsa tasotondi eba tamothordi, iko omo ah khorok baima bwhak tei nini bukur bising torrwkma pher mano.
en: Don't twist or jerk the tick, as this could cause the head to break off and remain in your skin.

kok: Waisa nwng ah swkra swkakkha, ah kholano twi tei sapan bai sudi.
en: Once you've removed the tick, wash the area with soap and water.

kok: Nwng kaisa tropical antibiotic lepamabithi bo phulwi mano solomani kasogra chubama bwkhak.
en: You can also apply a topical antibiotic ointment to help prevent infection.

kok: Omo mwrwkna bwkhak nangkukma Lyme bemar marirokni bagwi kaisa swkra bai warjakma wngjak olo.
en: It's important to watch for signs of Lyme disease after being bitten by a tick.

kok: Oh nukswkangmarirok kulum, khorokmihima, sak hoi hoi, bahan samarok, tei kaisa gwrwngjakma bothrai guri khobwi mano.
en: These symptoms can include fever, headache, fatigue, muscle aches, and a characteristic rash.

kok: Tumungno nwng oh nukswkangmarirok babai jesa hamrwk wngkha, daktino nini saknainai bai malaidi.
en: If you develop any of these symptoms, see your doctor right away.

kok: Lyme bemar wngkha kaisa wansukrak kulum, phiya omo antibiotics bai saknaijakma wngwi mano.
en: Lyme disease is a serious illness, but it can be treated with antibiotics.

kok: Dakti hamyaungmarok tei saknaimung wamsukrak hamthayamarok kasogra bwkhak nangkukma wngkha.
en: Early diagnosis and treatment is important to prevent serious complications.

kok: Tumungno nini thani jesa swngmungrok tongkhe swrakrok eba Lyme bemar bagwi, nini saknainai bai kok sadi.
en: If you have any questions about ticks or Lyme disease, talk to your doctor.

kok: Chwng jottono oro swrwngwi kuchuk kana bagwi phayu, abo khlainani bagwi chwng chini tongkhorno hamya-chaya kwrwi tei borom gwnang maswnamlainai.
en: We are all here to learn and grow, and we need to create a safe and respectful environment in order to do that.

kok: Nini rwngremni borokrok tei phwrwngnairokno borom rwdi, nini sinimung rwphuru bo kaham khe rwdi.
en: Please be respectful of your classmates and instructors, and please use discretion when sharing personal information.

en: This is because wrath is often a secondary emotion, meaning that it is triggered by another emotion, such as fear, sadness, or anxiety.

en: When we are feeling these emotions, we may lash out in anger in order to protect ourselves or to feel a sense of control.

kok: Tumungno chwng amo khlaywi mankha hwnkhe, chwng ah khanangmungni chaya thaimungrokno sakpherwi manu.

kok: Chwng jolimano chorwi tonna bagwi kwbangma manwi khlaywi manu, aborok wngkha:

en: Once we know what triggers our anger, we can start to avoid these situations or to develop coping mechanisms for dealing with them.

kok: * Sak-sakno kwchang-kwchang tonnani swrwngmani.

en: The spider will use its silk to create a web that will support you as you ride.

kok: Kaisa kotorma laipak behng kasamani wngkha kaisa pogwimanya simari.
en: Riding a giant wolf spider is an unforgettable experience.

kok: Omo wngkha kaisa kotor lama simari bwkhak ah blongni saktwikarma, tei gana phainani tei sakbaithang kaisa ah hayungni jottoni slai muani khlaimani malmatarok bai.
en: It is a great way to experience the thrill of the wild, and to get up close and personal with one of the world's most fascinating creatures.

kok: Saknainai: Khulumkha, tei nini phaithakni naijakmano lamsogo.
en: Doctor: Hello, and welcome to your annual checkup.

kok: Nwng tini bahai chongphan tong?
en: How are you feeling today?

kok: Rogi: Ang kahamno chongphan tongo, jotto kokno wansugwi naimani.
en: Patient: I'm feeling pretty good, all things considered.

kok: Ang teibo kisa mwktwrwi ganani manwi phaimani, tei ani chamungrok teibo sakdukni bagwi kaham wngkha.
en: I've been getting a little more sleep lately, and my diet has been pretty healthy.

kok: Saknainai: Abo khwnai khakchangma mankha.
en: Doctor: That's great to hear.

kok: Ang nini mal marino nawui chengnai tabuk.
en: I'm going to start by taking your vital signs.

kok: [Saknainai rogini thwi sepmung nainaikha, pulse, tei tungmani.]
en: [The doctor takes the patient's blood pressure, pulse, and temperature.]

kok: Saknainai: Jottomanwino naimani kaham oro.
en: Doctor: Everything looks good here.

kok: Tabuk, nini chamungni bagwi kok salaigrana.
en: Now, let's talk about your diet.

kok: Nwng bomtwi chahmung cha hainohai salo?
en: What are you eating on a typical day?

kok: Rogi: Ang nangnungya ani phungbaili bagwi khurio cereal chaho, sandwich sajarchahmungni bagwi, tei kwthwng chamung horchahmungni bagwi.
en: Patient: I usually have a bowl of cereal for breakfast, a sandwich for lunch, and a salad for dinner.

kok: Ang bwthaihrok tei mwikhwtwngrok sal kwrwngwi chanani chaitogo.
en: I also try to eat fruits and vegetables throughout the day.

kok: Saknainai: Abo kaisa sakdukni chamung kahai khwnamani.
en: Doctor: That sounds like a healthy diet.

kok: Nwng nangmaswk sakswnamnani manwi da tong?
en: Are you getting enough exercise?

kok: Rogi: Ang hatibarni jotto salromwi mukhisa 30 bwsasukni sakswnamna manna chaitogo.
en: Patient: I try to get at least 30 minutes of exercise most days of the week.

kok: Ang samung bwkhak himmo, tei ang hatibaro waisa eba wainwi basketball thwngo.
en: I walk to work, and I play basketball once or twice a week.

kok: Doctor: Abo belai kahamno. sakswnam belai nangkukmani bokcho sakdukni langma tongdalno twi.
en: Doctor: That's great. Exercise is an important part of a healthy lifestyle.

kok: Rogi: Ang saimano, ang teibo kwsrang wngna chaitokganw.
en: Patient: I know. I'm trying to be more active.

kok: Kaisani bagwi, bohrok wngthangjak bisingni slai chwrairok tabuk teibo haino okrarok bai naikoljakha wngkha.
en: For one, children are now more likely to be supervised by adults than they were in the past.

kok: Omo sakmwchang bokchoni bising ah churibirkhong maphani kasamung bwkhak wngo, kaisa jora mapharokno swbaikhrup sama bwkhak phwnangma je bohrokni chwrairokno langmarokni bising belaino kubulkha.
en: This is due in part to the rise of the helicopter parent, a term used to describe parents who are overly involved in their children's lives.

kok: Churibirkhong mapharok wngkha uramuram nukjakha aswkno borokni chwrairokni saka twih kobonmani, chikonnaikani khaimani bohrokni jotto lorimano, tei bohrokno katirina bwkhak chaitokmani jesa chaya wngma simi.
en: Helicopter parents are often seen as hovering over their children, micromanaging their every move, and trying to protect them from any possible harm.

kok: Oh phuwarjak naikoljakma chwrairokni bagwi kwbangma wngmungrok tubukha.
en: This increased supervision has had a number of consequences for children.

kok: Tei kaisa yago, omo chwrairokno katijakma swnamno.
en: On the one hand, it has made children safer.

kok: Bohrok kisa kahai sakderakha eba siniyarokbai chaya khaima eba akabikarok bai tongo.
en: They are less likely to be injured or harmed by strangers or by accidents.

kok: Tei kaisa yago, omo chwrairokno kisa yohkjak bo swnam tongo.
en: On the other hand, it has also made children less independent.

kok: Bohrok kisa ahaino bohroksaksakno nakani khai nama bwkhak khlaimana tongo eba bohrokni sakni chongmarokno swnamma bwkhak.
en: They are less likely to be able to take care of themselves or to make their own decisions.

kok: Jora rwmung bising naikoljakma phuwarkha, bohrok wngthangjak bisingni slai chwrairokbo teibo ahaino swnamarikha samung-humung bising kubulma tongo.
en: In addition to increased supervision, children are also more likely to be involved in structured activities than they were in the past.

kok: Omo sakmwchang bokchoni bising ah "hukumu tangma," kasamung bwkhak wngo, bomo khakrakokrok ah charairokni nangkukma kaisa dalbidal yakbahrasaklaima samung-humung bising kubulma wngjak.
en: This is due in part to the rise of the "activity culture," which emphasizes the importance of children being involved in a variety of extracurricular activities.

kok: Hukumu tangma wngkha kwbangma kusunchwlwi bai chalukjak tongo, ah tangsamung hatio batailaimung bangmani bising khobmani bai tei ah poito je chwrairok je yakbahrasaklaima samung-humung bising kubulma tongo bohrok teibo khlaimanjak langmani bising wngnai.
en: Activity culture has been driven by a number of factors, including the increasing competitiveness of the job market and the belief that children who are involved in extracurricular activities will be more successful in life.

kok: Ah hukumu tangma kasamung chwrairokni bagwi kwbangma bwthaihrok tongo.
en: The rise of the activity culture has had a number of consequences for children.

kok: Tei kaisa yago, omo chwrairokno teibo seprok rwkha bohrokni yaksrairok tei suargangrok hamkrai bwkhak.
en: On the one hand, it has given children more opportunities to develop their skills and talents.

kok: Tei kaisa yago, omo ah sinmung bwkhak bo thepakha je chwrairokno khlaimanma bwkhak wansukrio.
en: On the other hand, it has also added to the pressure that children feel to succeed.

kok: Chwrairok je kaisa dalbidal yakbahrasaklaima samung-humung bising kubulya tongma kahai wansuk mano bohrok saka sumung khaiya.
en: Children who are not involved in a variety of extracurricular activities may feel like they are not measuring up.

kok: Ah unnarwmarok chwrairokni bagwi je laithangjak bisirokni bising ongkhorma tongo kaisa kuthukuk sekrupma tongkha ah lama sakao je chwngrairok tini torrwma wngkha..
en: The worries about childhood that have emerged in recent years have had a profound impact on the way that children are raised today.

kok: Oh uanarwmarok kwbangma swlaimarok bwkhak twlang tongo ah lama bising je chwrairok naikolma tei samung-humung je bohrok kubulma bising tongo.
en: These worries have led to a number of changes in the way that children are supervised and the activities that they are involved in.

kok: Oh swlaimarok kainwi kaham tei hamya bwthaihrok tongo chwrairokni bagwi.
en: These changes have had both positive and negative consequences for children.

kok: Taklai bisini 1920 o, tei thaibo New York Dholi o .
en: The year is 1920, and the place is New York City.

kok: Flapper ni mol belai khwlaijagwi tongo, tei bwrwi siklirok bohrokni kwtal yoksamung no manwi tongthoklai tonglayo.
en: The flapper era is in full swing, and young women are enjoying their newfound freedom.

kok: Bohrok skirt bara kanlaijak tei khwnai bo babari, cigarettes nunglaijak, tei cocktailrok bo nunglaijak.
en: They are dressing in short skirts and bobbed hair, smoking cigarettes, and drinking cocktails.

kok: Bohrok puilani slai tabok tei chwlarok bai malailaijak.
en: They are also dating more freely than ever before.

kok: Khoroksa flapper ni mung khe Josephin.
en: One such flapper is named Josephine.

kok: Bo belai sikli naithok uktibo gwnang tei khebo khachri.
en: She is a beautiful young woman with a sharp wit and a rebellious streak.

kok: Bo bwsai rutuknarogno samung torjakya, phiya bo kwbangma chwlarok bono nasigo.
en: She is not interested in finding a husband, but she does enjoy the attention of men.

kok: Salsa, Josephin party o puila khoroksa sikla bai malaigrao mung Jack.
en: One day, Josephine is at a party when she meets a young man named Jack.

kok: Bebak Josephin chukyao Jack chugo.
en: Jack is everything that Josephine is not.

kok: Bo belai hukumuno palainai borok, koksama kwchang kwchang, tei jesano phan bwkha khuwi samwung khwlayo.
en: He is conservative, polite, and serious.

kok: Phiya Jack ni thani mungsaswk tongo abono nugwi Josephin ma chajak kha.
en: But there is something about him that Josephine finds attractive.

kok: Jack bai Josephin malaina chenglai kha, tei borok dakti no hamjak bo pailai kha.
en: Jack and Josephine begin dating, and they quickly fall in love.

kok: Bohrok kwnwi bars o mwsawino sal haprwo tei horo khe kok salaiwi no dam pairwlayo.
en: They spend their days dancing at the bars and their nights talking for hours on end.

kok: Josephin waisa phano omo hai wngjakya kho kebono.
en: Josephine has never felt this way about anyone before.

kok: Phiya Josephin ni langmao Jack simi chwla ya.
en: But Jack is not the only man in Josephine's life.

kok: Bo tabokbo halok bowi tongkho boni puilani chwla, Tom bai.
en: She is still friends with her former boyfriend, Tom.

kok: Tom wngkha borok kaham, tei bo Josephin no hamjaksugo.
en: Tom is a good man, and he loves Josephine very much.

kok: Online shopping wngkha ah tangsep manwirok paimani eba samungrok kaisa swbai phalnai ah internet sakao.
en: Online shopping is the process of buying goods or services from a retailer over the Internet.

kok: Omo wngkha juda juda mukumu shopping bising je ah painai ahaino sakno twi kaisa khatinogo ah duna bwthaih no paina bwkhak naina thangya.
en: It is different from traditional shopping in that the consumer does not physically visit a store to purchase the product.

kok: Aboni bade, ah painai duna bwthaih twih browses khayo tei onlinen twi paimarok khayo.
en: Instead, the consumer browses through products and makes purchases online.

kok: Ah painai hwnkhe ah duna bwthaih bohrokni nok ni nikumao manphaiyo.
en: The consumer then receives the product at their home address.

kok: Aro kwbangma manmarirok tongo online shopping khaima bwkhak.
en: There are many benefits to online shopping.

kok: Puila, omo uramuram teibo chajak mukumu shopping ni slai.
en: First, it is often more convenient than traditional shopping.

kok: Painairok bohrokni sakni nogni simi aram khai pai mano, jesa jora phano hor eba sal wngthwng.
en: Consumers can shop from the comfort of their own home, at any time of day or night.

kok: Bohrok morokmarokbo suwui mano juda juda swbai phalnairok simi tei duna bwthaih naikolmungrok poriwui paina swkang.
en: They can also compare prices from different retailers and read reviews of products before making a purchase.

kok: Nwirem, online shopping mukumu shopping ni slai teibo painani phan tongwi mano.
en: Second, online shopping can be more affordable than traditional shopping.

kok: Kwbangma swbai phalnairok khaihmarok tei remsitamungrok bohrokni online duna bwthaihrok sakao yapharo.
en: Many retailers offer discounts and promotions on their online products.

kok: Thamrem, online shopping teibo mukumu shoppingni slai habarjak bayapsong wngwi mano.
en: Third, online shopping can be more environmentally friendly than traditional shopping.

kok: Painairok khatinogo chalugwi thangna nangya, obo emissions khairio.
en: Consumers do not have to drive to the store, which reduces emissions.

kok: Haiaphano, aro baksa kebengjak tongo online shoppingo tongo.
en: However, there are also some drawbacks to online shopping.

kok: Puila, painairok reerok kanna chaitok many eba duna bwthaiih rokno kari amjok manya bohrokno bohrok paina swkang.
en: First, consumers cannot try on clothes or test out products before they buy them.

kok: Omo chajakya bwkhak dagi twlang mano tumungno ah dunaa bwthaih painaini khchongmarok bai malaiya eba chakya hwkhe.
en: This can lead to disappointment if the product does not fit or meet the consumer's expectations.

kok: Nwirem, online shopping mukumu shopping ni slai teibo khapharjak wngwi mano.
en: Second, online shopping can be more risky than traditional shopping.

kok: Consumers kisa naikani wngna nango bohrokni credit card ni sakhlaimung online o thumnani swkang.
en: Consumers need to be careful about providing their credit card information online.

kok: Bolong wngkha kaisa thai kwchangtotok tei kwchangtotok.
en: The forest was a place of peace and tranquility.

kok: Buphangrok kuchuk tei bolaijak khe bachajak, bohrokni bedekrok nokha saka sogwinaikha.
en: The trees stood tall and proud, their branches reaching up to the sky.

kok: Bwlairok nokbar bai srosro wngo, tei tokrok bohrokni rwchapmung rwchapbo.
en: The leaves rustled in the wind, and the birds sang their songs.

kok: Omo wngkha mohai thai boro khoroksaswk yoknai bagwi phaimano dagachopa tei dosidopra sal brumbrum langmao.
en: It was a place where one could come to escape the hustle and bustle of everyday life.

kok: Salsa, khoroksa skili bwrwima Daina mungwi bolong bisingtwi himwi thangkha.
en: One day, a young woman named Diana was walking through the forest.

kok: Bo saichung tei kwmajak hwnwi uansukphan wngkha, tei bo bolong kwchangtotok naitugwi phaimani.
en: She was feeling lost and alone, and she came to the forest in search of peace.

kok: Bo himwi tongphuru, bo kaisa khorang khwnakha.
en: As she walked, she heard a noise.

kok: Abo kaisa lengjak khorang, phiya bini saktongma romna bagwi nangmaswk wngkha.
en: It was a faint sound, but it was enough to catch her attention.

kok: Bo bathagwi tei khwnakha, tei bo teiwaisa khorang khwnaphikha.
en: She stopped and listened, and she heard the sound again.

kok: Obo wngkha kabmani khorang.
en: It was the sound of crying.

kok: Diana khorangno rwtharwi thangkha, tei bo sraisrai khaima bwkhak phaikha.
en: Diana followed the sound, and she came to a clearing.

kok: Sraisraini kwcharo khoroksa bwrwi chikonsa wngkha, holong sakao achugwi tei kabwi tongo.
en: In the middle of the clearing was a small girl, sitting on a rock and crying.

kok: Diana bwrwino oro himwi thangkha tei bono swngkha tamo chaya wngkha hwnwi.
en: Diana walked over to the girl and asked her what was wrong.

kok: Bwrwi Dainano sakha je bo kwmakha hwnwi.
en: The girl told Diana that she was lost.

kok: Bo bolongo thwngwi tongohuru, tei bo pakokberai thangphuru simi bini nukhungbai kakkha.
en: She had been playing in the forest, and she had wandered away from her family.

kok: Daina bwrwino sakha tawanadi hwnwi, tei bo swmai tangkha bono chubana hwnwi bini nok lama naituk thani.
en: Diana told the girl not to worry, and she promised to help her find her way home.

kok: Daina tei bwrwi thansakhe bwrwi bisingtwi himwi thangkha.
en: Diana and the girl walked through the forest together.

kok: "Ang ah takjak ni swkang bachakha, ani bwkha kainwi kirima tei bwkha hamya bai kuplung.
en: "I stood before the sculpture, my heart filled with both awe and sadness.

kok: Ah swnamani wngkha aswkno naithokma, phiya amo kaisa khwih kahai wansugo.
en: The creation was so beautiful, but it also felt like a trap.

kok: Ah rikwrwng ah sajaknai kokbwkrai aswkno chasukjakma narakkha je omo wngtwtwi ahaino bohrok tabukbo kwthang tongjak hai.
en: The artist had captured the essence of the subject so perfectly that it was almost as if they were still alive.

kok: Phiya bohrok tongjakya.
en: But they were not.

kok: Bohrok haino kaisa holong ni bokcho wngkha.
en: They were just a piece of stone.

kok: Ang ah rikwrwng bwkhak gurikha, khoroksa chwla sikla ram mungwi, "nwng takmani mase ma mwthaknai," ang sakha.
en: I turned to the artist, a young man named Ram. "You must stop sculpting," I said.

kok: "Nini swnammarok belai naithok wngkha. bohrok ah hayungni simi langma khogwi tongkha."
en: "Your creations are too beautiful. They are stealing life from the world."

kok: Ram ano uanama bising naisikkha "nini kokma tamo abo?" bo swngkha "Ani takmarok wngkha kaisa langmani ni terkhlaimani."
en: Ram looked at me in surprise "What do you mean?" he asked "My sculptures are a celebration of life."

kok: "Ihin', " ang sakha "botog wngkha kaisa gosiya omoni. bohrok wngkha kaisa lama borokno tonimani ah kubui hayungni simi saimanmani.
en: "No," I said "They are a denial of it. They are a way of keeping people from experiencing the real world.

kok: Jephuru nwng kaisa nini takmarok bwkhak naisikha, nwng hayungno amtwikhe naisikya je amo tongma haikhe.
en: When you look at one of your sculptures, you are not seeing the world as it is.

kok: Nwng ah hayungno naimani nini amo mucungma bwkhak twi. Abo kubui rikmung wngmaya.
en: You are seeing the world as you wish it to be. That is not real art.

kok: Kubui rikmung wngkha ah hayungno je amo tongma haikhe phunukmani wngkha, kurothairok tei jottoni bagwi.
en: Real art is about showing the world as it is, warts and all.

kok: Omo wngkha borokno mungsaswk wansukma swnammani.
en: It is about making people feel something.

kok: Nini takmarok borokno mungsaphano wansukma swnamya.
en: Your sculptures don't make people feel anything.

kok: Bohrok haino borokno bwkha hamya wansukrio."
en: They just make them feel sad."

kok: Ram jora kolok bagwi siring wng tongkha.
en: Ram was silent for a long time.

kok: Bwchwi rocking achukphang o achuk tongo, sweater rabwi.
en: Grandmother is sitting in her rocking chair, knitting a sweater.

kok: Bini busuk, chaslokjora, thuyam sakao achugwi tongo, tv naiwi.
en: Her granddaughter, a teenager, is sitting on the couch, watching TV.

kok: Bwchwi: Ang muito mano jephuru ang nini omor phuru, chini thani mohai fancy gadgets kaisaphano kwrwi.
en: Grandmother: I remember when I was your age, we didn't have any of these fancy gadgets.

kok: Tei chwng phataro thangwi ma thwngo.
en: We had to go outside and play.

kok: Busuk: Ang saimano, nana, nwng ano oh kothoma chirasai joratwi sakha.
en: Granddaughter: I know, Grandma. You've told me that story a million times.

kok: Bwchwi: Thikno, omole kubuino!
en: Grandmother: Well, it's true!

kok: Chwng phatra khaina bagwgi chini uansukphanrokno ma phwnango.
en: We had to use our imaginations to have fun.

kok: Chini thani jotto mohai video thwngmungrok tei computerrok kwrwi chwngno tongthokmung rina bagwi.
en: We didn't have all these video games and computers to entertain us.

kok: Busuk: Haiphano ang video thwngmungrok tei computerrokno chajago. bohrok phatra wngo.
en: Granddaughter: But I like video games and computers. They're fun.

kok: Bwchwi: Ang hai hwnwi samaniya bohrok phatraya hwnwi, phiya bohrok phatarni thwngmung bai soloiya hinmase.
en: Grandmother: I'm not saying they're not fun, but they're not the same as playing outside.

kok: Jephuru nwng phataro thwngo, nwng sakswnam mano tei kwtal borok bai malayo.
en: When you play outside, you get exercise and you meet new people.

kok: Busuk: Ang saimano, nana. haiphano ang video thwngmungno chajago.
en: Granddaughter: I know, Grandma. But I still like video games.

kok: Bwchwi: Thikno, ani khachongma khe nwng haino nini achaisongni thaihmanwi.
en: Grandmother: Well, I guess you're just a product of your generation.

kok: Busuk: Angbo hai hwnwi no khachongo.
en: Granddaughter: I guess so.

kok: [Bwchwi mwmwiui tei rabthani phirok thangkha.
en: [Grandmother smiles and goes back to knitting.

kok: Busuk tv naithani phirok thangkha.]
en: Granddaughter goes back to watching TV.]

kok: Ang samungni simi salsa nogo chaklugwi thangmani jephuru ang tei kaisa chaluknai bai tanjak mankha.
en: I was driving home from work one day when I got cut off by another driver.

kok: Ang aswkno jolikha je ang bono riphriknani chengkha tei ani pohorrok chwngrikha.
en: I was so angry that I started tailgating him and flashing my lights.

kok: Bo haino chalukmani twrwk tei twrwk tonikha, tei ang teibo khabaikha tei teibo manmani wng tongkha.
en: He just kept driving slower and slower, and I was getting more and more frustrated.

kok: Paithago, ang omo tei naimanliya .
en: Finally, I couldn't take it anymore.

kok: Ang saka tisai bini gana bachakha tei bono chirikna chengkha.
en: I pulled up next to him and started yelling at him.

kok: Bo bini tailam tola khikwlaikha tei ano ukuluk chiroknani chengkha.
en: He rolled down his window and started yelling back at me.

kok: Chwng khoroknwino aswkno thamsi wngjak chwng kwlwijak wngkha.
en: We were both so angry that we were shaking.

kok: Ah kubun chaluknai ah lama kinar bwkhak saka sotonkha, tei ang bono rwtharkha.
en: The other driver pulled over to the side of the road, and I followed him.

kok: Chwng nini malkhungni phatar ongkhorkha tei khoroksa tei khoroksa no chiriklainani chengkha teibo sotonwi.
en: We got out of our cars and started yelling at each other even louder.

kok: Ang aswko gana wngkha bono bunani phiya ang bini hamanio bahai manwi tongo.
en: I was so close to hitting him that I could smell his breath.

kok: Haino jephuru ang wansukha omoni slai mungsa hamya wngya hwnwi, khoroksa police malkhung saka sotonkha.
en: Just when I thought it couldn't get any worse, a police car pulled up.

kok: Ah habaphang nini malkhungni phatar ongkhorkha tei chwngno swngkha tamo wngwi tong.
en: The officer got out of his car and asked us what was going on.

kok: Chwng khoroknwino bono chini digirokni kothoma saka, tei bo chwngno kaisa nanglaih swinani chengkha.
en: We both told him our sides of the story, and he started writing us a ticket.

kok: Iko ang ani malkhung bwkhak phirok himwi thangmani, ang saimankha je ang nai phwrwng bwchap swrwngkha.
en: As I was walking back to my car, I realized that I had learned my lesson.

kok: Lama jolisuk wngkha jephuru phano omo swk wngya.
en: Road rage is never worth it.

kok: Omo swk wngya saka thamsi manmani, tei omo swk wngya kaisa nanglaih manmani.
en: It's not worth getting angry over, and it's not worth getting a ticket.

kok: Khumrok belai morojak, phiya ang naikani khailiya.
en: The flowers were expensive, but I didn't care.

kok: Ang bohrokno manna nango.
en: I had to have them.

kok: Aborok belai naithokmani khumrok ang kumphru nukmani, tei ang saimano bohrok bono tongthokrwi mano.
en: They were the most beautiful flowers I had ever seen, and I knew they would make her happy.

kok: Ang kaisa chwnwi khutlairok painakha, jotto juda juda palitwi.
en: I bought a dozen roses, all different colors.

kok: Ang bohrokno chabwi vase o dakha tei bohrokno bini bisna ganani songphang sakao thiti khai rwkha.
en: I arranged them in a vase and set them on the table next to her bed.

kok: Bo mwnwikha jephuru bohrokno nukha. "Bohrok naithokmani," bo sakha. "hambai nono."
en: She smiled when she saw them. "They're beautiful," she said. "Thank you."

kok: Ang kiphilwi mwnwikha. "Phaikaham nono bo." ang nini bisna ganao achugwi tei bini yak nai.
en: I smiled back. "You're welcome." I sat down next to her bed and took her hand.

kok: Bo ano saka naisikha bini kotor, chaksrusru mokol bai.
en: She looked up at me with her big, brown eyes.

kok: "Ang tongthokkha nwng oro phai," boh sakha. "Angbo tongthokkha angbo oro phai," ang sakha.
en: "I'm so glad you're here," she said. "I'm glad I'm here too," I said.

kok: Chwng jora kolok romwi kok salaikha.
en: We talked for a long time.

kok: Chwng chini imangrokni bagwi kok salaikha, chini khajamungrok, tei chini kirmarokno twi.
en: We talked about our dreams, our hopes, and our fears.

kok: Chwng chini thinangni bagwibo kok salaikha.
en: We talked about the future.

kok: Jephuru ani thangnani jora wngkha, bo ano kwbakha.
en: When it was time for me to go, she gave me a hug.

kok: "Hambai nwng phaima bagwi," bo sakha. "Ang nono hamjago."
en: "Thank you for coming," she said. "I love you."

kok: "Angbo nono hamjago," ang sakha.
en: "I love you too," I said.

kok: Ang bini talikha'o motom sukha tei hwnkhe ang lamrikha.
en: I kissed her on the forehead and then I left.

kok: Mwithaih bwthaihraok tei bwchwlwirok wngkha langma bwkhak nangnai.
en: Crops and seeds are essential to life.

kok: Bohrok chwngbai chathaih, richum, tei lenglama bago.
en: They provide us with food, clothing, and shelter.

kok: Mwithaih bwthaih sakdukma torwma bwkhak bisingtwi, nwng chakukma bwchwlwirok saina bwkhak nango chini habar tei ha tonghalokrok.
en: In order to grow healthy crops, we need to select the right seeds for our climate and soil conditions.

kok: Chwng chini mwithaih bwthaihrokno naikini khaima bwkhak nango bohrokno twirwmani, bohrokno ha hamrwmani, tei bohrokno pests ni simi katirwmani.
en: We also need to take care of our crops by watering them, fertilizing them, and protecting them from pests.

kok: Chuwainairok sai bisirok karwi saimani tei mwithaih bwthaih thaihrwmani wngkha.
en: Farmers have been selecting and breeding crops for thousands of years.

kok: Bohrok bahaikhe mwithaih bwthairok torwna bwkhak swrwngjak tongo je pests tei bemarrok kasojak bwkhak wngkha, tei je kuchuk achairwi achairwmarok thairwma.
en: They have learned how to grow crops that are resistant to pests and diseases, and that produce high yields.

kok: Laithangnai bisirok bising, chuwairok genetic engineerig phangma bwkhak mwithaih bwthaih achairwmarok tei pests kasojak bwkhak bo chengjakma wngkha.
en: In recent years, farmers have also begun to use genetic engineering to improve crop yields and resistance to pests.

kok: Mwithaih bwthaih torwmani wngkha ah tansep bataimarok kwrwi wngya.
en: The process of growing crops is not without its challenges.

kok: Chuwainairok uramuram sasokmaya salbar tonghalokrok, pests tei bemarok bai naimung bwkhak tongo.
en: Farmers often have to deal with unpredictable weather conditions, pests, and diseases.

kok: Haiphano, ah yakpairok mwithaih bwthairok torimani kotorokuar wngwi mano.
en: However, the rewards of growing crops can be great.

kok: Chuwainairok bohrokni nukhungrok tei hodarokni bagwi chaithaih bagwi mano, tei bohrok bohrokni samungni simi kaisa tongmani bo aji mano.
en: Farmers can provide food for their families and communities, and they can also earn a living from their work.

kok: Jora rwmung bising bakmani bwkhak chathaih, mwithaih bwthaihrok kubun duna bwthaihrok swnamma bwkhak bo chubai mano.
en: In addition to providing food, crops can also be used to create other products.

kok: Phunukmari karwi, khulno richum swnamma bwkhak phwnangjak mano, tei mogodamno ethanol swnamma bwkhak phwnangjak mano.
en: For example, cotton can be used to make clothing, and corn can be used to make ethanol.

kok: Mwithai bwithaihrok biofuels swnamma bwkhak bo phwnangjak mano, omo fossils fuels ni sakao chini khatharjak khaina bwkha chubai mano.
en: Crops can also be used to create biofuels, which can help to reduce our dependence on fossil fuels.

kok: Ah mwithaih bwthaihrok tei bwchwlwirok wngkha undeniable nangkukma.
en: The importance of crops and seeds is undeniable.

kok: Ani puila sal rwngnogo wngkha amtwi sal ang tei abo pokgwlak.
en: My first day of school was a day I will never forget.

kok: Ang aphuru kainwino tongthokjak tei kirijak, saimanjaya tamno khachongjak.
en: I was both excited and nervous, not knowing what to expect.

kok: Jephuru ang phungo bachao, ang dakti no ri chumkha tei dakti no chamung chakha.
en: When I woke up that morning, I got dressed quickly and ate a quick breakfast.

kok: Hwnkhe, ani maa ano rwngnogo twlangkha tei rwngrem bising himrwi tunuikha.
en: Then, my mom drove me to school and walked me to my classroom.

kok: Ang jephuru rwngrem bising himiw thangkha, ang daktino ani rwngphwrwngnai, Ms. Smith bai lamsukjakha.
en: When I walked into the classroom, I was immediately greeted by my teacher, Ms. Smith.

kok: Bo belai kaham-naima brwi tunglulu mwmwima bai.
en: She was a kind-looking woman with a warm smile.

kok: Bo ano bini sinimung rwkha ano tei ani achukthai boro phunukha.
en: She introduced herself to me and then showed me to my seat.

kok: Ang khoroksa bwrwi mung Sarah ni gana achukha.
en: I sat down next to a girl named Sarah.

kok: Bo ano mwmwikha tei sakha, "Hi, ang Sarah."
en: She smiled at me and said, "Hi, I'm Sarah."

kok: Ang kiphilwi mwnwikha tei sakha, "Hi, ang Vera."
en: I smiled back and said, "Hi, I'm Vera."

kok: Chwng jora kisa romwi kok salaikha gonta togwi rwng chengna swkang.
en: We talked for a few minutes before the bell rang for class to start.

kok: Ms. Smith bini bagwi sinimung rina chengkha tei chwngno rwngrem raidarokni bagwi sakha.
en: Ms. Smith began by introducing herself and telling us about the rules of the classroom.

kok: Hwnkhe, bo chwngno ongko phwrwngna chengkha.
en: Then, she started teaching us about math.

kok: Ang puila wo kisa bujimanya wngkha, haiphano Ms. Smith kahamma khe bebak sukurubwi sakha.
en: I was a little bit confused at first, but Ms. Smith explained everything clearly.

kok: Ongko rem ni olo, chwng bathakjakna mankha.
en: After math class, we had a break.

kok: Sarah bai ang phatarni nokhwlao thwngna thangkha.
en: Sarah and I went outside to play on the playground.

kok: Chwng swrapsa khitarjakna tei sorojaknai thwngkha, hwnkhe chwng phirogwi bisingo chana thangkha.
en: We played on the swings and the slide for a while, then we went back inside for lunch.

kok: Oh kisasa jwngjal baino malkhungno chikonsa accident wngwi thangkha.
en: These are just a few of the issues that can plague a car that has been in a minor accident.

kok: Deramarok sijaklia phano, tabukbo kirimasingsa tei thepaphinani morok.
en: While the damage may not seem significant, it can still be dangerous and expensive to fix.

kok: Rubber bwkaprok kwphai tongkhe ba, kisale sak katima hai wngwi mano.
en: In the case of worn or falling apart rubber pieces, this can be a safety hazard.

kok: Rubber malkhungni dal bidal thayo thepajago, tyre, brake pad tei seal rogo.
en: Rubber is used in a variety of places on a car, including the tires, brake pads, and seals.

kok: Jephuru rubber chamwi ransao aphru phatiui mano ebakhe hamsukya wngwi thangnai.
en: When rubber becomes worn, it can crack, split, or otherwise deteriorate.

kok: Oboni bisingtwi brung brung jwngjalrok phaiwi mano, romdi sochol malma khochornai, braking romma bo khainai, tei kwplabo wngwi mano.
en: This can lead to a number of problems, such as reduced traction, decreased braking performance, and leaks.

kok: Nukhung sakao bwkap tongkhebo atomsa patimungni sak kati wngo.
en: Missing roof rail pieces can also be a safety hazard.

kok: Malkhung nukhungni bokong swnamjakma hwnkhe jephuru malkhung goirogwi accident o philjago aphuru aphuru kanaino dukhu manna katirwo.
en: Roof rails are designed to help protect passengers in the event of a rollover accident.

kok: Tumung malkhung nukhungni bokong kwrwi hwnkhe, malkhung nukhung teibo bainani kwlai wngo jephuru malkhung ukuluk philjakhe abo kirimasingcha khe dukhu mannai eba thwinai.
en: If the roof rails are missing, the roof of the car is more likely to collapse in a rollover, which can cause serious injuries or death.

kok: Thok tengki ni khapremung kwbai hwnkhe bo bini akocho kirimasingsa.
en: A broken fuel tank door lock can also be dangerous.

kok: Tumung thokni bokhok tala khajakya hwnkhe malkhung malwi tongphuru phiyokjagwi mano.
en: If the fuel tank door cannot be locked, it could come open while the car is moving.

kok: Haikhe lamao thok kwsarwi mano, abobai hor khamwi mano eba phatiui mano.
en: This could spill fuel onto the road, which could cause a fire or explosion.

kok: Sak kati marino naikhe, obohai deramungno swnamphi nani belai morok.
en: In addition to the safety risks, these types of damage can also be expensive to fix.

kok: Rubber bwkap rokno thepaui swlai rwi mano malkhungni nukhung sakaobo, tei thok tonma bokhokbo swmanna hwnkhe belaino morok wngo.
en: Rubber pieces can be difficult to replace, and roof rails and fuel tank door locks can be expensive to repair or replace.

kok: Babaisa naikhe, aswk morokya bo wngwi mano jotto thumui malkhungni morokma tei kwtal paina no wansuk naikhe.
en: In some cases, it may be more cost-effective to total the car and buy a new one.

kok: Nwng tumung malkhung chalukjak no painani wansugwi tongkhe, abo kisisa accident wngjak phano, siniui nadi je abo elem gwnng malkhung naikwrwngbai naijak wngthung.
en: If you are considering buying a used car that has been in a minor accident, be sure to have it inspected by a qualified mechanic.

kok: Bohrok derajak manwino sinina rwngo mokolbai nukya manwino phano, tei bohrok nono kok khoraiwi mano ah malkhungno paiwi kaham da wngno wngya.
en: They will be able to identify any damage that may not be visible to the naked eye, and they can advise you on whether or not the car is safe to buy.

kok: Ani tangsong belai samung kwrak khainai, phiya bo homnino remtisamung manmarogo lairwi hojago.
en: My colleague was a hard worker, but she was always getting passed over for promotions.

kok: Bo sajakha je bo "samung kwrak" eba "teibo naimanmung wngdi," bwkhak nanganw phiya omo naina thangkhe bo tamo sakha samung nangjakyaa, bo bwskango maanwi manliya.
en: She was told that she needed to "work harder" or "be more visible," but it seemed like no matter what she did, she couldn't get ahead.

kok: Ah manager bo kaisa kebengmung.
en: The manager was also a problem.

kok: Bo homnino jottono micromanaging khayo, tei bo dakti no kokchirmung khayo.
en: He was always micromanaging everyone, and he was quick to criticize.

kok: Bo aswk samungkhainai rokni langma-samung ojon bwkhak naikini khaima nukjakya, tei bo bohrokno 24/7 manthoknai hwnwi khajajak.
en: He didn't seem to care about the employees' work-life balance, and he expected them to be available 24/7.

kok: Ani tangsong paithago bini baimani buchugo sogwikha.
en: My colleague eventually reached her breaking point.

kok: Bo samung ni sekrupma tei naimanliya, tei bo saimano je bo aro bini tangmung swkangkolok manliya.
en: She couldn't take the stress of the job anymore, and she knew that she wouldn't be able to advance her career there.

kok: Bo bono hatinwi rok rwkha' sakhlaimung tei kwtal samung naitukna chengkha.
en: She gave her two weeks' notice and started looking for a new job.

kok: Bo kaisa kwtal samung mankha je teisa kahamkuk bini bagwi chukjak.
en: She found a new job that was a much better fit for her.

kok: Aro rwma tei sa kaham, damrwi rok teibo reasonable, tei manager twichurunai tei buchinai.
en: The pay was better, the hours were more reasonable, and the manager was supportive and understanding.

kok: Bo tabuk teisa tongthokjak, te bo khatung khajak je bo bini kwcham samungno chongwi yakarmani.
en: She's much happier now, and she's glad that she made the decision to leave her old job.

kok: Ang aswk wngkubui rwi mnay tabuk manager tamo kha tong, phiya ang khajamung khayo je bo bini phwrwng bwchap swrwngkhwna.
en: I'm not sure what the manager is doing now, but I hope that he's learned his lesson.

kok: Bo bini samungkhainai rokno naikol manya haino je bohrokno tongdi hwnwi khajama khai tongdi hwnwi manya.
en: He can't treat his employees like that and expect them to stay.

kok: Bo jodi borok kaham rokno tonina muchungkhe, bo bini lamarok swlaina nanganw.
en: If he wants to keep good people, he needs to change his ways.

kok: iko ani tangsongno karwi, bo bini kwtal samungo kotorkuar khaitongo.
en: As for my colleague, she's doing great in her new job.

kok: Bo sinimung manwi tongkha je bo yakpai manmani, tei bo paithago bini tangmung swkangkolok khaimanani.
en: She's getting the recognition that she deserves, and she's finally able to advance her career.

kok: Bo kaisa kotorkuar phunukmari jephuru nwng nini nagwi bachao aphuru tamo wngno tei soiyawui saka tonima bai hamya jorao.
en: She's a great example of what happens when you stand up for yourself and refuse to put up with a bad situation.

kok: Kaisa Google spreadsheet bising, kaisa soidom yasikaihjakma homnino ah solai kotagera bwkhak yasikaihma, khauarya boro amo kosoljak eba norjak bwkhak wngkha.
en: In a Google spreadsheet, an absolute reference will always refer to the same cell, regardless of where it is copied or moved to.

kok: Belai yasikhaihjakma kotagerarokni bagwi doro wngkha je sijakrwnai tongo je nwng swlaina muchungjakya jephuru nwng kosol eba ah karilam norma.
en: Absolute references are useful for cells that contain data that you do not want to change when you copy or move the formula.

kok: Phunukmari karwi, tumungno nini thani kaisa karilam tongkha je tal thwgwi ah bebak phalmarokni bagwi gonimarok, nwng ah kotagerani bagwi kaisa kubui yasikaihjakma phwnangma bwkhak muchung mano je ah chengmani sal tongmarok.
en: For example, if you have a formula that calculates the total sales for each month, you would want to use an absolute reference for the cell that contains the starting date.

kok: Omo haikheno, ah karilam homino ah solai kotagera bwkhak yasikaihnai, ahaino tumungno nwng ahaino omo juda juda bwtang eba thong bwkhak kosol khayo.
en: This way, the formula will always refer to the same cell, even if you copy it to a different row or column.

kok: Nwng kaisa kubui yasikaihjakma swnam mano kaisa kaisa dollar mari ($) jora rwmani bai ah lombor bwtang bai thong swithaih kotagera yasikaihjakma bwkhak.
en: You can create an absolute reference by adding a dollar sign ($) to the row number and column letter of the cell reference.

kok: Phunukmari karwi, ah kubui yasikaihjakma ah kotagera A1 bagwi $A$1 wngwi mano.
en: For example, the absolute reference for the cell A1 would be $A$1.

kok: Nwng kubui yasikaijakmarok kaisa bwtrang kotagerarok yasikaijakma bwkhak bo phwnangjak mano.
en: You can also use absolute references to reference a range of cells.

kok: Omo khaina thangkhe, kaisa dollar mari jora rwma bwkhak ah lombor bwtang tei thong swithaih kotagera thwgwi ah bwtrang bising wngo.
en: To do this, add a dollar sign to the row number and column letter of each cell in the range.

kok: Phunukmari karwi, ah kubui yasikaihjakma ah bwtrang A1:B1 bagwi $A$1:$B$1 wngmano.
en: For example, the absolute reference for the range A1:B1 would be $A$1:$B$1.

kok: Kubui yasikaihjakmarok wngkha kaisa phangwnang kol je nini karilamrok swnamna bwkhak phwnangjak wngmano teibo khongkwlai tei kwlaikuk phwnangma bwkhak.
en: Absolute references are a powerful tool that can be used to make your formulas more flexible and easier to use.

kok: Bahaikhe kubui yasikaihmarok phwnangma bwkhak buchimani bai, nwng karimarok swnam mano je ahaino samung khainai jephuru nwng kosol eba bohrokno juda juda tongma thairokni bwkhak norwi twlango.
en: By understanding how to use absolute references, you can create formulas that will work even when you copy or move them to different locations.

kok: Oro wngkha baska dagiphang rwmarok kubui yasikaihmarok phwnangmani bagwi:
en: Here are some additional tips for using absolute references:

kok: * Kotagerani bagwi kubui yasikaihmarok phwnangdi je sijakrwnai tongma je nwng swlaina muchungjakya.
en: * Use absolute references for cells that contain data that you do not want to change.

kok: * Kotagerani bagwi halok gnang yasikaihmarok phwnangma je sijakmari tongma je nnwg swlaina muchungjakya.
en: * Use relative references for cells that contain data that you do want to change.

kok: * Hush wngdi jephuru yasikaihmarok dalukjak phwnangmani dalujago, omo kubui kainwi tei halok gnang yasikaihmarok tongma wngo.
en: * Be careful when using mixed references, which are references that contain both absolute and relative references.

kok: * Ah F4 berepkhong phwangdi kubui, halol gnang, tei dalukjak yaskikaihmarok kwcharo toggle khaima bwkhak.
en: * Use the F4 key to toggle between absolute, relative, and mixed references.

kok: Oh rwmarok rwktharmani bai, nwng kubui yasikaihmarok phwnang mano phangwnang tei khongkwlai karilamrok bwkhak swnamo je nini samung Excel bising kwlaikuk tei teibo chukma swnammanai.
en: By following these tips, you can use absolute references to create powerful and flexible formulas that will make your work in Excel easier and more efficient.

kok: Esteban wngkha kaisa wanajak bupha.
en: Esteban was a concerned father.

kok: Bini bwsajwk, Marcela, rwchapmung khwnai tongmani je bo khasoiya wngmani.
en: His daughter, Marcela, was listening to music that he didn't approve of.

kok: Ah kokthuprok wngkha sraisrai tei kikhri, tei bo bini bwsajwk no je omo hai manwi-khwnwi bai phunukna muchungjakya.
en: The lyrics were explicit and violent, and he didn't want his daughter exposed to that kind of material.

kok: Abo omo ni bagwi kok sana chaitokkha, phiya bo haino bono bangra norwi rwkha.
en: He tried to talk to her about it, but she just shrugged him off.

kok: Bo saimanliya tei tamo khaisinai.
en: He didn't know what else to do.

kok: Salsa, Esteban auaikhok khwnai tongphuru aphuru bo kaisa rwchapmung khwnakha je bo wansukha Marcela chajakganw hwnwi.
en: One day, Esteban was listening to the radio when he heard a song that he thought Marcela would like.

kok: Omo wngkha kaisa rommanai khorang kaisa kubui koktun bai.
en: It was a catchy tune with a positive message.

kok: Bo chongwi nakha kaisa rwchapmungno copy burn khaima bwkhak bono rina hinkha.
en: He decided to burn a copy of the song and give it to her.

kok: Jephuru bo rwngnokni simi nogo sokphaikha, bo bono CD rwkha te bono sakha khwnadi omono hwnwi.
en: When she got home from school, he gave her the CD and told her to listen to it.

kok: Marcela yakpai manma bai belai wanamasingsa wngkha, phiya bo khwithonjak wngkha.
en: Marcela was surprised by the gift, but she was also intrigued.

kok: Bo CD no bini stereo thepakha tei rwchapmungno khwnakha.
en: She put the CD in her stereo and listened to the song.

kok: Bo omo aswkhe chajakha je bo omono bar-bar khwnakha.
en: She liked it so much that she listened to it over and over again.

kok: Ah teini salo, Esteban Marcelano swngkha bo ah rwchapmungni bagwi tamo wansukkha.
en: The next day, Esteban asked Marcela what she thought of the song.

kok: Bo bono sakha je bo omono hamjakha hwnwi tei je omo bono kaisa kwtal lama bisingtwi wansukna rwkha manwirokni bagwi.
en: She told him that she loved it and that it had made her think about things in a new way.

kok: Esteban saktwikarjak wngkha.
en: Esteban was thrilled.

kok: Bo saimano je bo kaisa pherlaima swnamkha bini bwsajwkni langmao.
en: He knew that he had made a difference in his daughter's life.

kok: Je ah salni simi, Marcela teibo kubui rwchapmung khwnankha.
en: From that day on, Marcela listened to more positive music.

kok: Sakhlaimani wngkha ah khlaimanma bwkhak bachama nini manthairok bagwi kaisa khakrak tei kepleng lama, choprobnai eba lem-choprobnai wngjak karwi.
en: Assertiveness is the ability to stand up for your rights in a confident and direct way, without being aggressive or passive-aggressive.

kok: Jephhuru nwng sakhlaima wngkha, nwng nini wansukmungrok tei sraisrai khai wasukmani tei borom rwmani swbaikhrubwi sama bwkhak khapima wngo, tei nwng arirok kaihma bwkhak khapima wngkha tei jephuru nangphuru ehe hwnwi sadi.
en: When you are assertive, you are able to express your thoughts and feelings clearly and respectfully, and you are able to set boundaries and say no when necessary.

kok: Choprobnairok, tei kubun digi, ah wngmuchung wngkha phankhlaima bwkhak eba ualaijak kaisa lama bising je sikrima phunukma bwkhak khatharjak wngkha eba kubunrokno dukhu manrwma.
en: Aggressiveness, on the other hand, is the tendency to be forceful or hostile in a way that is intended to intimidate or hurt others.

kok: Jephuru nwng choprobnai wngkham nwng kubunrokno makthakmung bwkhak chaitok mano sikrimmung phunukma twih eba sikrimarok, tei nwng daktino jolima tei thamsi karima bwkhak wngwi mano.
en: When you are aggressive, you may try to control others through intimidation or threats, and you may be quick to anger and lash out.

kok: Saktormung tomung wngkha kaisa kahamkukma wansukmani bai gwrwngjakma wngkha tei kubunrokni bagwi borom rwma kwrwi.
en: Arrogant behavior is characterized by a feeling of superiority and a lack of respect for others.

kok: Jephuru nwng saktormung wngo, nwng nini khlaimanmarok bagwi nwng baolaima mano, kubunrokno tola tonima, eba samung mathai rwjak.
en: When you are arrogant, you may brag about your accomplishments, put others down, or act entitled.

kok: Omoni kwcharo pherrwma bwkhak chujak wngma bwhak nangkukma wngkha Sakhlaimani, choprobmani, tei saktormung, omo sakni kaihma thaihmungrok tongo tongmung thwgwi.
en: It is important to be able to distinguish between assertiveness, aggressiveness, and arrogance, as each behavior has its own set of consequences.

kok: Sakhlaimani wngkha jottonokhobwi kaisa kubui tongdal haikhe nukha, jephuru Sakhlaimani tei saktormung uramauram iko chaya tongdalrok nukha.
en: Assertiveness is generally seen as a positive trait, while aggressiveness and arrogance are often seen as negative traits.

en: Early diagnosis and treatment can help to prevent the illness from becoming more serious.

kok: Chahthai wngkha haino kaisa phangwnang manwi.

en: So next time you're feeling down, or you're just looking for a way to connect with someone, share a meal together.

en: Getting lost at sea is a terrifying experience that can quickly lead to death if not properly prepared for.

en: In a single moment, you can find yourself surrounded by vast expanses of water and no land in sight.

kok: Omo muito khlaima bwkhak nangkukma je ahaino tumungno nwng twibom o kwmakhe, aro wngkha tabukbo manwirok tongo nwng nini bachinani sujukrok bangrwma bwkhak khlaimano.
en: It is important to remember that even if you are lost at sea, there are still things you can do to increase your chances of survival.

kok: Kaisa jottoni slai nangkukma manwirok wngkha khwchang khai tongnani .
en: One of the most important things to do is to stay calm.

kok: Achomkirimani haino manwirokno hamya swnamnai.
en: Panicking will only make things worse.

kok: Aboni slai, kaisa hama kolok nadi tei nwng thangna thangkhe nwng tamo khaina nang aro naisikdi.
en: Instead, take a deep breath and focus on what you need to do to survive.

kok: Tei kaisa yapri wngkha nini tonghalokno khangma kwkhak.

kok: Nwng boro?

kok: Ang agi sikla phuru, Salsa ang bolong lamatwi himwi thanhg phuru ang chikonsa sap khlaijak thai nukha.
en: When I was a young man, I was walking through the forest one day when I came across a small clearing.

kok: Ah sap khlaijak thaini kwcharo hwnkhe khoroksa bwrwi naithok, holong dap o achukjak.
en: In the middle of the clearing was a beautiful woman, sitting on a rock.

kok: Bo sak sakno rwchap tongo, tei bini khorang belai khnathothok abobai ang logilogino khasrang thangkha.
en: She was singing to herself, and her voice was so lovely that I was immediately captivated.

kok: Ang ganani holongdap o achuk kha tei bini rwchapmungno khwna kha.
en: I sat down on a rock nearby and listened to her sing.

kok: Bo damsa romwi rwchap kha, tei bini rwchapmungo ang khahapsukha.
en: She sang for hours, and I was completely engrossed in her music.

kok: Bo jephuru rwchapma thaksuk kha, ang bini gana thangkha tei sakni sinimungno rwkha.
en: When she finally stopped singing, I approached her and introduced myself.

kok: Bini mung wngkha Sita, tei bo wng kha buphangni phola.
en: Her name was Sita, and she was a wood spirit.

kok: Chwng kwbangma jora romwi kok salai kha, tei ang saimankha belaino saichung sakkaisa.
en: We talked for a long time, and I learned that she was very lonely.

kok: Bo bolongono tongo, tei bo kubun bororokno aswk nuktrwngya.
en: She lived in the forest, and she rarely saw other people.

kok: Ang bono ani aolikotorni langmano twywi sakha, tei bo khanangjak kha.
en: I told her about my life in the city, and she was fascinated.

kok: Chwng salnwi saltham baksa khe tonglaikha, tei ang phatsa khe sita no hamjagwi tháng kha.
en: We spent the next few days together, and I quickly fell in love with Sita.

kok: Ani nukmani bisingo bohno jottoni slai bwrwi naithok kuk, tei ani khwnamani bere bohnonino khorang kwtwi kuk.
en: She was the most beautiful woman I had ever seen, and she had the sweetest voice I had ever heard.

kok: Phiyaba ang saimano obo chwng kwnwi jesakhe phano thansa wngmanya.
en: But I knew that we could never be together.

kok: Ang wngkha borok, tei bo wngkha mwtaijwk.

kok: Chini swngchar wngkha belai pherlaijak.
en: Our worlds were too different.

kok: Salsa, ang bolong yakarwi mathangnai.
en: One day, I had to leave the forest.

kok: Ah porfolio belai hilik, tei ah ari belai kolok.
en: The portfolio was heavy, and the line was long.

kok: Ang aro bachajak, samani ruwaimani bai, tei wanajak jodi ang bwskango sogwi mano hwnwi.
en: I stood there, aching with pain, and wondered if I would ever get to the front.

kok: Paithago, ani jora phaikha, tei ang counter o tongnai bwrwima no ani portfolio phunukha.
en: Finally, my turn came, and I presented my portfolio to the woman at the counter.

kok: Abo abono mukphliksa khe naikha, hwnkhe bini khorok lorikha.

kok: "Ano nakardi, " bo o sakha. "chwng nini oh portfolio no gosi manya. omo chini bachamarok twi wngya."
en: "I'm sorry," she said. "We can't accept this portfolio. It's not up to our standards."

kok: Ang kaisa ani sakao sujagwi khabaihma lilakmung wngwi wansukha.
en: I felt a wave of despair wash over me.

kok: Ani jotto samung kuthuk, mungsani bagwiliya.

kok: Ang ani porfolio phirok nakha tei himwi thangna chengkha.
en: I took the portfolio back and started to walk away.

kok: "Bathakdi, " ah bwrwima ringkha "ang nukha je nwng omoni bagwi bwswk chaitokha. nwng tangwi aro achuk sokdi tei ang naiyanw ang tamo khaiman."
en: "Wait," the woman called "I can see that you've put a lot of effort into this. Why don't you take a seat over there and I'll see what I can do."

en: I sat down and waited.

en: "We're willing to make an exception for you. We'll accept your portfolio, but you'll have to pay a processing fee."

kok: Ang tail rwkha.

kok: "Ama, omorok tamo?" a makhaknai swngkha, bohrok tongmani nok bisingni buphang-waphang no yasi sulwi.
en: "Mommy, what are those?" the toddler asked, pointing at the plants in the living room.

kok: Bor omo ani phani bisingbai nono khaksa rwma bwkhak je poito chaya pholojkak kokthum ani kuthukma kirima uanamani, ang aswkno sakphorma karwi khlaimano.
en: Were it within my power to impart to you the incredibly detailed information concerning my deepest fear, I would do so without hesitation.

en: Suffice it to say that my greatest dread is something so insidious and far-reaching that it defies description.

kok: Omo kaisa sikrimung je ah sampilirokni bising kosaoi tongmarok wngkha, ah jottoni salai khakajakya mukphliksa muikhwrwng tokyasiku bwkhak naisingmani.

kok: Ang jeswk muito narwk mansak oh insidious kirima ani logi aphuruni simi tongkha.

kok: Omo ani langma lamarokni bising banokjakma tongo je ang aswkno buchina bwkhak chengmani.

kok: Ang khoroksa biragi wngkha, ah hayung bisingo kirimasingsa phatar bwkak thangna kirio mukhisa ang ani hamyasuk imanghamya bai mwkhang bai mwkhang malai phaiyanw.
en: I have become a recluse, afraid to venture out into the world lest I come face to face with my worst nightmare.

kok: Ang loreya nara sakao, ah kubun yaklap kwlaima bwkhak karwi naisingmani.

kok: Ang saimano je ang ani kaphramani bising saichung simiya.

kok: Aro kubunrok tongo je ani poja banta nao.

kok: Chwng kaisa swraijak hoda wngkha, chini kirima bai thansa.

kok: Oh plastic sola wngkha kaisa khibiwi rwdi hwnmani hukumu.

kok: Chwng oborokno waisano samungo phwnango tei paikhe khibirwo, waisa phano obo hapharno tamo dera rwno wansuya.
en: We use them for a few minutes and then discard them, never giving a thought to the environmental consequences.

en: We need to find ways to reduce our use of plastic bags.

en: We can bring our own reusable bags when we go shopping, and we can recycle plastic bags whenever possible.

en: We can also lobby our elected officials to pass laws that restrict the use of plastic bags.

kok: Hamid Al-fitr, sinikukjak kothomasanai, kaisa jora ni bagwi sakha jephuro bo choba o dukhu manjak phuru.
en: Hamid Al-fitr, the famed storyteller, tells of a time when he was injured in battle.

en: "I was a young man, just a green recruit, when I first saw battle.

kok: Ah bulaimani wngkha kirimasingsa, tei ang daktino khamunsukha.

kok: Ang phungsa khorogo togwi khikwlai rwjakha, tei ang ha o kwlaikha, thwi choraijak tei kirima chajak.
en: I was struck down by a blow to the head, and I lay on the ground, bleeding and dazed.

kok: Ang aro kwlai tongphuru, ang ani langma ni bagwi wansukkha tei bahaikhe omo tngphan paihnai.
en: As I lay there, I thought about my life and how it might end.

en: I thought about my family and friends, and how they would miss me.

en: I also thought about the rank I had aspired to, and how it would now be impossible for me to achieve.

kok: Ang ani mokolrok kholobwi tei ani thwimung bagwi tiyarkhaijak.
en: I closed my eyes and prepared for death.

kok: Phiya hwnkhe, ang kaisa khorang khwnakha.
en: But then, I heard a voice.
