kok: Nwng khaswrangwi buphang kainani wngkha, aro kwbangma tanglam manthogo je nono chubai mano.
en: If you are interested in planting trees, there are many resources available to help you.

kok: Nwng buphang kainani kokthumwi mano nini oroni haphang thani, barini kwcharo, tei tongkhorni mothani thani.
en: You can find information on tree planting from your local government, gardening centers, and environmental organizations.

kok: Nwng online twi bo kokthumni chubachu naimano.
en: You can also find helpful information online.

kok: Nini hoda tei hayung ni bagwi nwng pherlai buphang kainani kotokuar lama swmandi.
en: Tree planting is a great way to make a difference in your community and the world.

kok: Buphang kaimabai, nwng tongkhor ni bagwi charwi mano tei thinango teibo rujuwi swnamano.
en: By planting trees, you can help to improve the environment and create a more sustainable future.

kok: Khapangni [mung], ani khajamung oh kokduk nono kahamkhai khai naituk mano.
en: Dear [Name], I hope this letter finds you well.

kok: Ang nono chini nukhung habani simi swimani, boro ah thummung oh bisio kaham thangwi tongo.
en: I'm writing to you from our family farm, where the harvest has been going well this year.

kok: Chwng khakamani kuruk kaisa kupulung bwthaih, boro rum swnamma bwkhak phwnangkha.
en: We're expecting a bumper crop of sugarcane, which is used to make rum.

kok: Rum wngkha kaisa rairai khwlaijakma arak kuruk kwtwi eba kuruk bwtwi simi swnamma.
en: Rum is a distilled spirit made from sugarcane molasses or sugarcane juice.

kok: Omo hainohai buphang uahsongrok bising omor wngkha, bomo omono gwrwngma thokmung rwkha.
en: It's typically aged in wooden barrels, which gives it its characteristic flavor.

kok: Rum sapsutra tongthokma wngmano, on the rocks, eba cocktails bising sapuljak.
en: Rum can be enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or mixed in cocktails.

kok: Aro kwbangma juda juda rum sapokthaihrok tongo, omoni sakni manthokya thokmung profile bai thwgwi.
en: There are many different types of rum, each with its own unique flavor profile.

kok: Baksa ah jottoni slai luku hamjakjak rum sapokthaihrok kwchwng rum khobwi, mwnak rum, tei muithok rum.
en: Some of the most popular types of rum include light rum, dark rum, and spiced rum.

kok: Kwchwng rum wngkha hainohai rairai khwlaijakma simi swnamma tei kaisa kwchwng, kwtwi thokmung tongo.
en: Light rum is typically made from molasses and has a light, sweet flavor.

kok: Kosom rum kuruk bwtwini simi swnammo tei kaisa gnangma, teibo kutuk thokmung tongo.
en: Dark rum is made from sugarcane juice and has a richer, more complex flavor.

kok: Muithok rum muithokrok thepakha, ahaino bukur kwtwi, thaihmotom, tei long bai swnamma wngkha.
en: Spiced rum is made with added spices, such as cinnamon, nutmeg, and cloves.

kok: Rum wngkha kaisa kwbang sini spirit je kaisa dalbidal cokctails bising phwnangjak mano.
en: Rum is a versatile spirit that can be used in a variety of cocktails.

kok: Baksa kwcham rum cocktails ah daiquiri, mojito, tei pina colada khobwi.
en: Some classic rum cocktails include the daiquiri, the mojito, and the pina colada.

kok: Rum teibo cocktails swnamjak bsing phwnangjak mano, ahaino ah Heminway Daiquiri eba ah Painkiller.
en: Rum can also be used in more creative cocktails, such as the Hemingway Daiquiri or the Painkiller.

kok: Nwng amazon o paimani bobohai wngkha chini kwtal ad sebani bisingtwi.
en: "Complete your Amazon shopping experience with our new and improved ad service!" the ad read.

kok: Chini sebani bisingwi nwng mungsa wanana kwrwi chini mwchangjak deal manphinai.
en: "With our service, you'll never have to worry about missing out on a great deal again.

kok: Achukthayo achugwi simi tongsidi tei leladi.
en: Just sit back and relax, and we'll take care of the rest.

kok: Chini seba completely magwnang tei obo kaisa chengwi mannai.
en: Our service is completely free to use, and it's easy to get started.

kok: Sign up khwlaiwi account simi swnamdi tei cart khwlainani chengdi.
en: Just sign up for an account and start adding products to your cart.

kok: Nwng jephuru jotto naikolwi naibaikha hamjakmani manwirokno chini aphuru saksakno nini bagwi jottoni deal kaham swnamwi rwnai tei order khwlai mannai.
en: When you're ready to check out, our service will automatically find the best deals for you and apply them to your order.

kok: Hwnkhe tei twmano naisingwi tong?
en: So what are you waiting for?

kok: Tinini bisingono sign up khwlaidi tei rang khatinani naidi amazon o jotto manwi khwnwi paithani.
en: Sign up for our service today and start saving money on all your Amazon purchases!"

kok: Painairok jephuru ads o click khwlai togwi rwo aphuru kwtal website o twlang thango.
en: As the customer clicked on the ad, they were whisked away to a new website.

kok: Ah website o tongnai ads bai kupulung dal bidal manwi phunukjak wngnai phalnani bagwi.
en: The website was full of ads for all sorts of products, all of which were supposedly on sale.

kok: Painairok kisa kisa manwirokno painale muchungjao phiya bohrok yak korojago.
en: The customer was tempted to buy a few things, but they hesitated.

kok: Bohrok khwnamakhe scam eba thokairok wngo hwnwi ads ni bisingtwi manwi paimano, tei bohrok abohai thokaimungo kwlaina muchungjakya.
en: They had heard stories about people getting scammed by online ads, and they didn't want to be one of them.

kok: Painairok tabuk naituknayo tei swrwngnayo company soisoide ads phunukmani kaham da hamya jachai khwlai nayo.
en: The customer decided to do some research on the company that was running the ad.

kok: Bohrok mankha je aro chaya kok kiphirokmung phiyaba kwbangkukno chama kokno kok phirokmung rwkha.
en: They found a few negative reviews, but most of the reviews were positive.

kok: Ah kothomani swimung wngkha "ah langabol thwngmung".
en: The title of the story is "The Basketball Game".

kok: Obo rwngnokni gym'o basketball thwngwi tongnai rwngswrwngnairokni kaisa bodol no twywi.
en: It is about a group of students who are playing basketball in the school gym.

kok: Bohrok jotto tongthogwi tongmani, tei bohrok kaisa thwngdol haikhe thansa samung khaimani tongo.
en: They are all having a lot of fun, and they are working together as a team.

kok: Khoroksa swrwngnai, mung Ayanda, wngkha ah rwngnogo kwtal, tei bo basketball bwkhak belai kaham wngya.
en: One of the students, named Ayanda, is new to the school, and she is not very good at basketball.

kok: Phiya bo bini kahamkuk chaitokmani wngkha, tei bini thwngdol logisongrok bono khatungrimung wngkha.
en: But she is trying her best, and her teammates are encouraging her.

kok: Khoroksa swrwngnai, mung Christian, wngkha kahamkuk thwngkwrwng ah thwngdol sakao.
en: One of the students, named Christian, is the best player on the team.

kok: Bo belai suargnang wngkha, tei bo homnino bini thwngdol longisongrokno chubana bwkhak muchungjago.
en: He is very talented, and he is always willing to help his teammates.

kok: Bo wngkha khoroksa kaham ojama, tei bo kaisa kaham phunukmari thepakha ah kubun swrwngnairokni bagwi.
en: He is a good leader, and he sets a good example for the other students.

kok: Ah swrwngnai wngkha jotto kwrak thwngmani, tei bohrok jotto belai tongthokjak wngkha.
en: The students are all playing hard, and they are all very excited.

kok: Bohrok jotto ah thwngmung kwplai wngna bwkhak khajamani wngkha.
en: They are all hoping to win the game.

kok: Ah thwngmung wngkha gana, tei abo ah duk bwkhak thangwi tongo.
en: The game is close, and it is going down to the wire.

kok: Ah paithak nwiremrokni bising, Christian kaisa langa swnammarok bwkhak ah thwngmung jitina bini thwngdolni bagwi.
en: In the final seconds, Christian makes a basket to win the game for his team.

kok: Ah swrwngnairok jotto terkhlaikha, tei bohrok jotto belai tongthokjak wngkha.
en: The students all celebrate, and they are all very happy.

kok: Bohrok jotto tangthansa tei rungthwngkwrwng bagwi kwbang jotto swrwngkha.
en: They have all learned a lot about teamwork and sportsmanship, and they have all had a lot of fun.

kok: Ah lenanok wngkha paihlaya, aswkno amo homnino talbung talrogo wngjora wngkha.
en: The hotel was busy, as it always was during the summer months.

kok: Omoni phutani nokrok bising tei omoni kwbangma suksuvidharok tongthok bising jotto hayung sakani simi borok tongna bwkhak phaiyo.
en: People came from all over the world to stay in its luxurious rooms and enjoy its many amenities.

kok: Khoroksa ah naruwairok wngkha kaisa bwrwima sikli Sarah mungwi.
en: One of the guests was a young woman named Sarah.

kok: Bo kisa jora romwi khapang sakdukma wngma bai bo khapharmani wngwi tongkha, tei bo ah lenanok khajamungrok bising bwkhak phaikha kwchangtotok naituknani tei siring mannani.
en: She had been struggling with mental health issues for some time, and she had come to the hotel in hopes of finding peace and quiet.

kok: Sarah's tongar wngkha ah lenanok ah kuchuk noksing ha sakao, tei omo kaisa naithok nukthok ah doyung tongo.
en: Sarah's room was on the top floor of the hotel, and it had a beautiful view of the city.

kok: Bo bini salrok tailam gana achugwi katiwo, ah borok thangmano naimani bai.
en: She spent her days sitting by the window, watching the people go by.

kok: Bo amo dagachopa tei dosidopra ah doyung tola naima bwkhak kwchangtotokmani wngjago, tei amo bono bini suprunarok pokna bwkhak bono chubakha.
en: She found it calming to watch the hustle and bustle of the city below, and it helped her to forget her troubles.

kok: Salsa, Sarah ah tailam gana achugwi tongmani jephuru bo khoroksa chwla no kaisa achukthai sakao ah aolikhumbari hachero achukmani nukha.
en: One day, Sarah was sitting by the window when she saw a man sitting on a bench in the park below.

kok: Bo kabwi tongo, tei bo belai mokjak khe nukjak kha.
en: He was crying, and he looked very sad.

kok: Sarah bini bagwi khanang wasukha, tei bo chongkha je tola thangwi tei bobai koksana hwnwi.
en: Sarah felt sorry for him, and she decided to go down and talk to him.

kok: Jephuru Sarah ah aolikhumbari thangkha, ah chwla tabukbo ah achukthayo achugwi tongkhu.
en: When Sarah got to the park, the man was still sitting on the bench.

kok: Bo bono saka naisikha tei mwnwikha.
en: He looked up at her and smiled.

kok: "Khulumkha, " bo sakha. "ang mung wngkha Tom."
en: "Hello," he said. "My name is Tom."

kok: Sarah sakno sinimung rwkha, tei bohrok thansa khe achuklaikha.
en: Sarah introduced herself, and they sat down together.

kok: Samung chirikgwi koksao kokthairokni slai, tei omo kahamkhai kubui hayungni saktwikarjak karwi.
en: Action speaks louder than words, and this is especially true in the world of adventure.

kok: Nwng jephuru hachingma ni phatar phuru, nwng nini sak yaksrai rogo khajakma bwkhak khai manna nango tei nwng pharimung twih manna bwkhak thango.
en: When you're out in the wilderness, you need to be able to rely on your own skills and abilities to get you through.

kok: Nwng jodi kwmai thangkhe kothairok nono chubai mangwlak, eba jodi nwng sakderakhe.
en: Words won't help you if you're lost, or if you're injured.

kok: Samung simi naimano.
en: Only action will.

kok: Ang oh samung jora tei jora teiwaisa kahamkhai nukha.
en: I've seen this principle in action time and time again.

kok: Ani swkangni kaisa saktwikarjakrok, ang ani bayaprok bodol bai hiking phuru aphuru chwng kwmakha.
en: On one of my early adventures, I was hiking with a group of friends when we got lost.

kok: Chwng damrwi lamkorowui yaksiyagra wng tonglaikha, chin lama phirogwi trail bwkhak naitukna chaitoklaikha.
en: We wandered around for hours, trying to find our way back to the trail.

kok: Phiya chwng tamo sakha eba khaikha abo manwi wngya, chwng haino chini lama naituk kari manya wng tongkha.
en: But no matter what we said or did, we just couldn't seem to find our way.

kok: Paithago, chini khoroksa bayapsong kokchapkha samung nana bwkhak.
en: Finally, one of our friends decided to take action.

kok: Bo kaisa chongjak digi himani chengkha, tei chwng jotto bono rwtharkha.
en: He started walking in a particular direction, and we all followed him.

kok: Kisa damrwi ni olo, chwng lama wo sokphaikha, tei chwng chini lama trailhead bwkhak naituk manphikha.
en: After a few hours, we came to a road, and we were able to find our way back to the trailhead.

kok: Chwng haino jodi yaksiyagra achugwi tongkhe tei tamo khaina hwnwi koksalai tongkhe, chwng jesakhe phano chini lama phirogwi naitugwi mangwlak khamu.
en: If we had just sat around and talked about what to do, we would never have found our way back.

kok: Phiya tamni hinmale chini bising khoroksa samung nakha, chwng kirimasinga jora hamya ni ongkhorwi mangwlakhamu.
en: But because one of us took action, we were able to get out of a dangerous situation.

kok: Omo haino kaisa phunukmari bahaikhe samung sal bachiriwui man.
en: This is just one example of how action can save the day.

kok: Chongwi nadi nini langmano nwng belai tonthogwi tongwi mano bebak bemarokni yakni katewi.
en: Imagine being able to enjoy your life without the constant fear of these debilitating conditions.

kok: Swtwilam ni bemarno bebak borokno manjago, abono manjakuknairok wngkha bwrwirog.
en: Urinary tract infections (UTIs) are a common problem, especially for women.

kok: O bemar sago dalbidal bemar manjak rwo, samani, khamma hairok wngo, tei kwrwngwi ma swtwi o.
en: They can cause a variety of symptoms, including pain, burning, and frequent urination.

kok: Waisa wuisu khe, swtwi lama ni bemar teibo jwngjal kotor wngwi mano, abo swtwikhok no hamya khwlayo.
en: In some cases, UTIs can lead to more serious problems, such as kidney infections.

kok: Bladder o holong wngmani abo bo tei kaisa borokrok majakuk mani jwngjal.
en: Bladder stones are another common problem.

kok: Abohrok nono bwsak sarwo, nwng swtwi phuru, tei swtwi o thwi bo wngwi mano.
en: They can cause pain, difficulty urinating, and blood in the urine.

kok: Jora juru o khe, bladder o holong wngmani abo swtwi lama no kasowi mano, abo hai wngmani langmano derarw wi mano.
en: In some cases, bladder stones can block the urethra, which can lead to a life-threatening emergency.

kok: Swtwikhok ni bemar wngkha belai jwngjal kotor abo bebak borokrok no manjago.
en: Kidney diseases are a serious problem that can affect people of all ages.

kok: Abohrok dalbidal ni bisingtwi sago hamya khwlayo, lengrw o, sak tongthokya khwlayo, tei ma kwba o.
en: They can cause a variety of symptoms, including fatigue, nausea, and vomiting.

kok: Jora juru o khe, kidney ni bemar swtwikhok no hamya khwlai wi mano, abo bwtharwi bo mano.
en: In some cases, kidney diseases can lead to kidney failure, which is a fatal condition.

kok: Tumung nwng obo hairokni jesa kaisa bemarok bai manjagwi tong khe, chubamung manthogo.
en: If you are suffering from any of these conditions, there is help available.

kok: Nini doctor bai kok salai di nini sak hamya no twywi tei bahai khe hamwi mannai abotwi lamarok no twywi.
en: Talk to your doctor about your symptoms and treatment options.

kok: Swtwi lam dera mano twywi swnamjaknai kwbangma lama tongo, bladder o holong wngmarog, tei swtwikhok ni bema wngmarok bo tongo.
en: There are a variety of treatments available for UTIs, bladder stones, and kidney diseases.

kok: Kaham khe naijak khe, sak hamya wngmarok hamwi mannai tei teibo kwbang derana thangwi tongmanirogno kasowi mannai.
en: With proper treatment, you can get relief from your symptoms and prevent further complications.

kok: Nini langmano omo hai jora hamayarok bai mechengna takhwlaidi.
en: Don't let these conditions control your life.

kok: Nini doctor bai kok salai di tei hamnani lamano romna chengsidi.
en: Talk to your doctor today and start on the path to recovery.

kok: Mayungrok sikar khaijakna kiriya karwi phiyokjak khe beraimano, tei chuainairok wngkubui mano je bohrokni bwthai-maithai rok swbaimanya wngtwi.
en: The elephants can roam freely without fear of being hunted, and the farmers can be sure that their crops will not be destroyed.

kok: Auaikhok collar rok wngkha chikonsa devices je malmatani gwdwna thepajak.
en: Radio collars are small devices that are attached to an animal's neck.

kok: Bohrok je khitarsama thar yaprimari yachaknai rokbai mano.
en: They emit a signal that can be tracked by a receiver.

kok: Omo soisikwrwng rokno jora rwgwi malmatarokni lorimano twi naikol mano.
en: This allows scientists to track the animal's movements over time.

kok: Mayungrokni tanghalok hwnkhe, oh sakhlaimung bai bohrokni nok bwtrango maps swnamwi phwnangwi mano tei babai amchaino siniwui narakdi jephuru borok munuishu bai nanglainani majaro bohrok jottoni swlai phaina hwnwi wansugwinao.
en: In the case of elephants, this information can be used to create maps of their home ranges and to identify areas where they are most likely to come into conflict with humans.

kok: Chuainairok oh sakhlaimungno phwnangwi mano yapri sehwui bohrokni bwthaih-maithai rokno mayungrokni simi katirwma babai.
en: Farmers can use this information to take steps to protect their crops from elephants.

kok: Bohrok bera dumwi mano, bushu jabra kaimano, eba kubuni raida phwnangwi mayungrokno kasuma simi bohrok kheto habnani twi.
en: They can build fences, plant thorny bushes, or use other methods to deter elephants from entering their fields.

kok: Thansakhe samung khailai, Soisikwrwng tei chuainai chubai mano babai mayungrok tei borok munuishu khoroknwi kati tonimano.
en: By working together, scientists and farmers can help to keep both elephants and humans safe.

kok: iko kaisa phunukmari bahaikhe auaikhok collars chauinai tei mayungrokno chubama'o phwnangjago.
en: Here is an example of how radio collars have been used to help elephants and farmers.

kok: Kenya o, soisikwrwng University of Cambridge oroni hodarokbai samung khai phayo babai mayungrokni yapri semano twi.
en: In Kenya, scientists from the University of Cambridge have been working with local communities to track the movements of elephants.

kok: Oh sakhlaimung maps swnama'o phwnangjago mayungrokni' nok bwtrango.
en: This information has been used to create maps of the elephants' home ranges.

kok: Maps chuainai rokbai bakjago, jara bohrokni kheto o bera guriwi dumwi tisaui bohrokno phwnangwi khaimani.
en: The maps have been shared with farmers, who have used them to build fences around their fields.

kok: Omo mayung tei borok munuishu bising nanglaimani lombor khairina chubakha.
en: This has helped to reduce the number of conflicts between elephants and humans.

kok: Auaikhok collars wngkha morojak kol mayungno porina bagwi tei mayung-borok bai nanglaimano chubachukhai khaina bagwi.
en: Radio collars are a valuable tool for studying elephants and for helping to reduce human-elephant conflict.

kok: Bohrok soisikwrwng bago morjak sakhlaimung mayungni tongmung chamungno twi, tei bohrok chuairokno chubai mano bohrokni bwthai mwithai no katirina bagwi.
en: They provide scientists with valuable information about elephant behavior, and they can help farmers to protect their crops.

kok: Thansa khe samung khwlai, soisikwrwng tei chuainai thinango twi chubama swnamano jethayo mayung tei borok rok thansa kwthai tongwimano.
en: By working together, scientists and farmers can help to create a future where elephants and humans can live together in harmony.

kok: Bo agini simino khoroksa suargnang lepanai, phiya bini kwmama olo, bo mankha je bo tabuk naithok hakung marirok eba sringsiring langmarok lepanani biisng ol manjakliya wngkha.
en: She had always been a talented painter, but after her loss, she found that she was no longer interested in painting pretty landscapes or still lifes.

kok: Aboni slai, bo mwnak swnamna bwkhak chwngkha, rikmung samungrok wansukmani je bini bisingni tongthokya kiphilphima.
en: Instead, she began to create dark, brooding works of art that reflected her inner turmoil.

kok: Kaisa bini jottoni slai mungkoto lepamanirok wngkha. "ani bwslani thwimung, " uangkha kaisa kuplung tei kebangmani mangili khoroksa sikal chwla phopkhok bising rokoma.
en: One of her most famous paintings, "The Death of My Son," is a stark and disturbing image of a young boy lying in a coffin.

kok: Aha chwlani mwkhang wngkha khajamungjak, phiya bini sak wngkha mothorjak tei samani bising khwrangjak.
en: The boy's face is peaceful, but his body is twisted and contorted in pain.

kok: Ah lepamani wngkha mangthongni kuplung, tei omo wngkha kwchwng je Mary bini rikmung phwnangmani bini khanang tei jolima bwkhak tangsep unkha.
en: The painting is full of symbolism, and it is clear that Mary is using her art to process her grief and anger.

kok: Rikmung tongdal bising Maryni shehma kokchirnairok karwi wngya.
en: Mary's shift in artistic style was not without its critics.

kok: Baksa borok bono kok silchakha shoshanjak wngjak tei bormanjakya.
en: Some people accused her of being exploitative and insensitive.

kok: Kubunrok sakha bini lepamanirok belai khakwbaimung tei je bohrokno lukuni bising phunukjakna tawngthwng.
en: Others said that her paintings were too depressing and that they should not be shown in public.

kok: Haiphano, Mary yakarna bwkhak gosiya.
en: However, Mary refused to back down.

kok: Bo poitokhaikha je bini rikmung wngkha nangkukma, tei bo amono bakna muchungjago ah hayung bai.
en: She believed that her art was important, and she wanted to share it with the world.

kok: Maryni samung paithago khiroksa nainai mankha, tei bo khoroksa jottoni slai borom rwjak rikkwrwng bini jorani wngkha.
en: Mary's work eventually found an audience, and she became one of the most respected artists of her time.

kok: Bini lepamanirok tabuk hamkuk manwirok bwkhak wansukukma wngkha, tei bohrok tabukbo porijak tongo tei jotto ah hayung sakani borok bai lopjago.
en: Her paintings are now considered to be masterpieces, and they are still studied and admired by people all over the world.

kok: Maryni kothoma wngkha kaisa muito narwkna je rikmung kaisa phangwnang manwi wngwi mano kokmwkhangni bagwi.
en: Mary's story is a reminder that art can be a powerful tool for expression.

kok: Omo tansep khanang, jolima, tei kubun 3 khanangjakrok bwkhak phwnangjak bo mano.
en: It can be used to process grief, anger, and other difficult emotions.

kok: Omo koktunrok nangkukma gwdallaima bwkhak phwnangjak bo mano ah borok tonghalok bagwi.
en: It can also be used to communicate important messages about the human condition.

kok: Maryni lepamanirok wngkha kaisa thwiswimung ah phan rikmung bwkhak, tei bohrok choyai tini bo borokno khasrangrwma bwkhak khayo.
en: Mary's paintings are a testament to the power of art, and they continue to inspire people to this day.

kok: [Scene: Coffee phalnok. Kiching kwnwirog, Namrata bai Tudor, bohrok table o achoklai tongo, coffee nungtwtwi kok salayo.]
en: [Scene: A coffee shop. Two friends, Namrata and Tudor, are sitting at a table, drinking coffee and talking.]

kok: Namrata: hwnkhe, ang khwnao Apple song bwskang tal kwtal phone karinai khapho hwnwi.
en: Namrata: So, I heard that Apple is releasing a new phone next month.

kok: Tudor: Kwbwi da? Belai chasukha!
en: Tudor: Really? That's exciting!

kok: Ang kwtal phone nana bagwi uansokma balokjak.
en: I've been thinking about getting a new phone for a while now.

kok: Namrata: angbo.
en: Namrata: Me too.

kok: Ang sasok manya kho iphone da nano naya, haiphano.
en: I'm not sure if I'm ready to switch to the iPhone, though.

kok: Ang Andriod phone no bisi kolokma romwi twijak, ang abono no bwkhale wngwi tongkho.
en: I've been using Android for years, and I'm kind of attached to it.

kok: Tudor: Ang saimano nwng tamo sana nai.
en: Tudor: I know what you mean.

kok: Ang iphone no nana bagwi kwdwkma uansokjak, phiya paithago talnwi taltham swkang chapwi naiman kha, tei ang belai chajaksok kha.
en: I was on the fence about switching to the iPhone for a long time, but I finally took the plunge a few months ago, and I'm really glad I did.

kok: Belai phone kaham.
en: It's a great phone.

kok: Namrata: Ang khakhwlayo wngkhwna hwnwi.
en: Namrata: I'm sure it is.

kok: Phiya ang sasuk manya kho Andriod yakanai de yakaya.
en: But I'm just not sure if I'm ready to give up my Android.

kok: Tudor: hwnkheba, hatibarsa eba barnwi chanai naidi tahake naidi nwng chada chajak.
en: Tudor: Well, you could always try it out for a week or two and see how you like it.

kok: Tumung nwng chajakya wngwi tong khe, nini Android o habwi nai phi mano.
en: If you don't like it, you can always switch back to your Android.

kok: Namrata: Abo belai uansokmung kaham.
en: Namrata: That's a good idea.

kok: Ang abono khwlaiwi phano mano.
en: I might do that.

kok: Koklenamung wngkha ah dal wngjak jora eba swkang sakao.
en: Punctuality is the quality of being on time or early.

kok: Omo wngkha kaisa nangkukma yaksrai kanwi sakbaithang tei tangsamung langmani bising.
en: It is an important skill in both personal and professional life.

kok: Koklena wngjak phunukmarok je nwng kubun borokrokni jorano borom rwma tei je nwng poitogwnang wngkha.
en: Being punctual shows that you respect other people's time and that you are reliable.

kok: Aro kwbangma manmarirok tongo koklena wngjak bwkhak.
en: There are many benefits to being punctual.

kok: Phunukmari karwi, nwng haino kisa chongberamungrok koroma eba nangkukma wngmungrok bwkhak tongo.
en: For example, you are less likely to miss appointments or important events.

kok: Nwng teibo duna bwthaihma wngnai, haino nwng thairogo bwkhak thangna bagwi dona nangwlak.
en: You will also be more productive, as you will not have to rush to get to places.

kok: Jora rwmani, koklena wngjak nono kaisa kaham borom samungo tangma bai chubai mano.
en: Additionally, being punctual can help you build a positive reputation at work.

kok: Tumungno nwng koklena wngjak bagwi sinijak tongo, nini logisamung khlainairok tei painai bohrokrok nono borom rwma tei poito bwkhak teibo haino wngmano.
en: If you are known for being punctual, your coworkers and clients will be more likely to trust and respect you.

kok: Aro wngkha kisa manwirok nwng khlaimano teibo koklena wngna bwkhak.
en: There are a few things you can do to become more punctual.

kok: Puila, ninisaksakni bagwi kubuijak sokthairok kaihma.
en: First, set realistic goals for yourself.

kok: Tumungno nwng jora saka wngjak bwkhak phwnangjakya wngkha, chikon sokthairok tangbwtang bai chengdi, ahaino chongberamungrok bwkhak 5 sotirok dakti sowgwimani.
en: If you are not used to being on time, start by setting small goals, such as arriving 5 minutes early to appointments.

kok: Waisa nwng oh sokthairok malaina kwthajak bwkhak mankha, nwng remrem khai ah jora thikemung bangwi mano nwng saksakno gosima bai.
en: Once you are able to consistently meet these goals, you can gradually increase the amount of time you allow yourself.

kok: Teikaisa chubamung buchuk wngkha swkang bereh chapma bwkhak.
en: Another helpful tip is to plan ahead.

kok: Oh komrarok jora kwbangma yakarmani bwkhak tiyar wngma tei nini sogwina thai bwkhak beraima.
en: This means leaving plenty of time to get ready and to travel to your destination.

kok: Omo kokmarok bo wansukmaya lererwmarok karwi tiyar khalima wngjak, ahaino tahnglaiso eba hamya salbar.
en: It also means being prepared for unexpected delays, such as traffic or bad weather.

kok: Paithago, omo wngkha nangkukma ah jora wansukuplung wngna.
en: Finally, it is important to be mindful of the time.

kok: Bakhara wngkha pharimung bwkhak kaham tonima equilibrium.
en: Balance is the ability to maintain equilibrium.

kok: Omo jotto thangnai manwirokni bagwi nangnai, omo bohrokno gosimarok bwkhak kepeleng tongna tei sakao kwlaiya karwi lorimani.
en: It is essential for all living things, as it allows them to stay upright and move without falling over.

kok: Bakhara belai nangkukmani coordination tei lorirwnai kol yaksrairokni bagwi.
en: Balance is also important for coordination and motor skills.

kok: Borok wngkha kwbangma lama bwkhak bakhara charwma.
en: There are many ways to improve balance.

kok: Kaisa lama hwnkhe salbrum-brum no sakswnamdi.
en: One way is to exercise regularly.

kok: Sakswnam sakphanrokno tei bothor rokno rakrinani chubchu khayo je bakhara bai gwdaljak, tei coordination charwma bwkhak bo chubachu khayo.
en: Exercise helps to strengthen the muscles and joints that are involved in balance, and it also helps to improve coordination.

kok: Tei kaisa lama bakhara charwma hnwkhe yoga eba taichi loi khlaimung.
en: Another way to improve balance is to practice yoga or tai chi.

kok: Aro sakswnamrok sago sijakmani tei coordination naisikma, tei bohrok bakhara charwma bising kaisa kwchang tei amjokthaini lama.
en: These exercises focus on body awareness and coordination, and they can help to improve balance in a gentle and effective way.

kok: Bakhara belai nangkukmani jotto omorni borokni bagwi.
en: Balance is important for people of all ages.

kok: Chwrairok kaham bakhara nango swrwngna tholmung bwkhak himani tei kharnani.
en: Children need good balance in order to learn to walk and run.

kok: Siklarok kaham bakhara nango kwlainarok katima, obo kaisa sosol sakduk khapharmung wngwi mano.
en: Adults need good balance to avoid falls, which can be a serious health risk.

kok: Okrarok sago kwlaina bagwi kahamkhai khapharmung wngkha, tei bakhara sakswnamrok khapharmung khairithani chubaimano.
en: The elderly are especially at risk for falls, and balance exercises can help to reduce their risk.

kok: Aro kwbangma manmari kaham bakhara tongmani.
en: There are many benefits to having good balance.

kok: Chasajak bakhara kwlainani khapharmung khaina bwkhak chubaimano, omo charwma coordination tei lorinai kolyaksrairok, tei tektoni kasogra bwkhak bo chubaimano.
en: Improved balance can help to reduce the risk of falls, it can improve coordination and motor skills, and it can also help to prevent injuries.

kok: Nwng jodi nini bakhara no charwna nangkhe, aro kwbangma sakswnammungrok tei dalbidal rok je nwng khai mantwi wngo.
en: If you want to improve your balance, there are many exercises and activities that you can do.

kok: Nini saknainai eba sakni kok haya nainai bwkhak teibo swrwngwi bahai khe nini bakhara no charwmanai.
en: Talk to your doctor or a physical therapist to learn more about how to improve your balance.

kok: Omo hamajakma borokrok bai kaisa jora larirwna bwkhak, je bisi laithangma bagwi hambairok rwma, tei bwskango phainai bisi bwkhak bwskang naisikma.
en: It is a time to spend with loved ones, give thanks for the year that has passed, and look forward to the year ahead.

kok: Baksani bagwi, talhing kaisa mothokma jora tei kachuk-buchhuk bo wngwi mano.
en: For some, December can also be a time of stress and anxiety.

kok: Ah lelanasal mol bai dagachopa tei dosidopra wngma bai, omo 1 khamunsukma bwkhak wansukmung wngmano.
en: With the hustle and bustle of the holiday season, it can be easy to feel overwhelmed.

kok: Phiya omo muito narakwna bwkhak nangkukma wngkha je talhing wngkha kaisa jora tongthok tei kwchangtoktokni bagwi.
en: But it is important to remember that December is a time for joy and peace.

kok: Aro wngkha kwbangma lamarok tongo ah tal tongthokma bwkhak, tumungno nwng paihlaiya eba lelanasalo.
en: There are many ways to enjoy the month, even if you are busy or on vacation.

kok: Kaisa lama talhing tongthokma bwkhak kaisa lama wngkha hamajakma borokrok bai jora lairwma bwkhak.
en: One way to enjoy December is to spend time with loved ones.

kok: Jebasa nwng kaisa kotor lelasal chahmung bagwi kuthumlaimani wng tongo eba ahaino nini nukghungni borok bai ah blockni yaksiyagra himwi namani, hamjakma borokrok bai jora lairwmani wngkha kaisa kotor lama mothokma tei lengrwma bwkhak.
en: Whether you are gathering for a big holiday meal or simply taking a walk around the block with your family, spending time with loved ones is a great way to relax and de-stress.

kok: Omo bo kaisa kaham sep wngkha ah bisi sakao kiphilphima bwkhak je laithangkha tei ah bisi bwskango bwskang naisikma bwkhak.
en: It is also a good opportunity to reflect on the year that has passed and to look forward to the year ahead.

kok: Teikaisa lama Talhing tongthokma bwkhak wngkha nini hodani bwkhak phirok rwmani.
en: Another way to enjoy December is to give back to your community.

kok: Aro kwbangma lamarok tongo omo khainani, ahaino kaisa oroni muibwtwi gantinok eba kaisa hamari samung bwkhak yakchubamani bai santuamani.
en: There are many ways to do this, such as volunteering at a local soup kitchen or donating to a charity.

kok: Phirok rwmani wngkha kaisa kotor lama ah hayung pherlaimungni bising swnamma bwkhak tei ninisaksakni bagwi kaham wansukmung.
en: Giving back is a great way to make a difference in the world and to feel good about yourself.

kok: Tumungno nwng ah lelanasal molo dagachopa tei dosidopra bai khamunsukma wansukmani wngkha, ninisaksakni bagwi kisasa jora nama bwkhak nangkukma wngkha.
en: If you are feeling overwhelmed by the hustle and bustle of the holiday season, it is important to take some time for yourself.

kok: Omo kaisa kutung tukuma, kaisa bijap porimani, eba ahaino habarni bising kisasa jora lairwmani wngwi mano.
en: This could mean taking a warm bath, reading a book, or simply spending some time in nature.

kok: Ninisaksakni bagwi kisasa jora namani nono mokthokma tei lengrwma bwkhak chubai mano.
en: Taking some time for yourself will help you to relax and de-stress.

kok: Talhing tongthokmung tei kwchangtotok tal wngkha.
en: December is a month of joy and peace.

kok: Hamjakma borokrok bai jora lairwmani ganao, nini hoda no phirok rwmani, tei nini saksakni bagwi kisasa jora namani, nwng ah jottoni slai oh bisini jora mahmlai swnam mano.
en: By spending time with loved ones, giving back to your community, and taking some time for yourself, you can make the most of this special time of year.

kok: Luku haphang bai Baithangni haphang a kainwi haphangrok pherlayo.
en: Democracy and dictatorship are two very different forms of government.

kok: Luku haphango khe, lukurok bohrokni twiphangno saiwi nanani phan tongo tei bohrok hakotor no bahai khe twidulnani abotwirok bo sa'ui mano.
en: In a democracy, the people have the power to choose their leaders and make decisions about how the country is run.

kok: Baithangni haphango khe, khoroksa eba kaisa bwsate bodol simi se bebakni phan tongo tei bebak chap thanibo bohrokno chapo.
en: In a dictatorship, one person or a small group of people has all the power and makes all the decisions.

kok: Luku haphang kwbangma kaham tongo.
en: There are many advantages to democracy.

kok: Kaisa kaham hwnkhe aro teisa yoksamung tongo tei sakni muchungma kokrok sa'ui mano.
en: One advantage is that it allows for more freedom and expression.

kok: Lukurok lukuhaphango khe bohrokni twidulnaino saiwi nao, haphangni thani chao chaya kok tisa mano, tei bohrokni muchung mani samung khwlaiwi mano.
en: People in democracies can vote for their leaders, speak out against the government, and start their own businesses.

kok: Tei kaisa lukuhaphangni kaham hwnkhe rangthongo teisa kuchuk ka'ui mano.
en: Another advantage of democracy is that it can lead to more economic prosperity.

kok: Borokrok haphangni twidulmungno kok tisana cheng khe, bohrok teibo hakotorno naikol nani siwi phayo.
en: When people have a say in how their government is run, they are more likely to be invested in the country's success.

kok: Phiyaba, lukuhaphango bo chaya le tongo.
en: However, there are also some disadvantages to democracy.

kok: Kaisa chaya hwnkhe abo belai lerwi mano tei kulukya wngwi mano.
en: One disadvantage is that it can be slow and inefficient.

kok: Jesa samungno khlaina thang thani lukuhaphango khe lerwi mano, tei aro kwbangma jwngjal phaiwi mano.
en: It can take a long time to make decisions in a democracy, and there is always the risk of gridlock.

kok: Tei kaisa lukuhaphangni chaya hwnkhe aro manthaino kasowi chathogo.
en: Another disadvantage of democracy is that it can be more vulnerable to corruption.

kok: Kokchapthani borokrok bangkhe, borokni bwkhano paiwi bande na layo.
en: When there are many different people involved in making decisions, it can be easier for special interests to buy influence.

kok: Baithangni haphang nibo kahamle tongo.
en: Dictatorships have some advantages over democracies.

kok: Kaisa kaham hwnkhe borok teisa kulugwi mano.
en: One advantage is that they can be more efficient.

kok: Kokchapmanirok daktino chapwi mano tei kokbanglaiya wi.
en: Decisions can be made quickly and without a lot of debate.

kok: Ah swngmung "ang sabo?" wngkha kaisa je nukuansuksinai tei bisirarok bagwi wansuknairok swngjak phaimani.
en: The question of "who am I?" is one that has been asked by philosophers and thinkers for centuries.

kok: Aro wngkha mungsa kokphirokmung kwrwi je jottono no khasupung manya, ahaino chini sak sina samanwi wngkha kwnwjakya phijakma tei swlaijakmani.
en: There is no one answer that will satisfy everyone, as our sense of self is constantly evolving and changing.

kok: Haiphano, aro wngkha baksa manwirok bagwi je chwng saimanao chwng sabo wngkha.
en: However, there are some things that we can say about who we are.

kok: Chwng jotto saichungrok wngkha, chini sakni manthokya wansukmungrok, wansukmani, tei saimanarok.
en: We are all individuals, with our own unique thoughts, feelings, and experiences.

kok: Chwng kaisa kotorma hoda bokcho wngkha, tei chini sak sinai simanwi wngkha chini swnamjak koksalaimaraok kubunrok bai.
en: We are also part of a larger community, and our sense of self is shaped by our interactions with others.

kok: Chwng jotto kaisa chongjak jora tei thai bisingtwi achayo, tei chini saimanjakrok bising oh hayung chubama bwkhak chwng sabo wngkha hwnwi sukrupsama.
en: We are all born into a particular time and place, and our experiences in this world help to define who we are.

kok: Phiya ah nangnaai tamo wngkha "ang" je chini wngdok bwchwlwi kwlaijak?
en: But what is the essential "I" that lies at the core of our being?

kok: Omo chini wansukmarok da?
en: Is it our thoughts?

kok: Chini wansukmani?
en: Our feelings?

kok: Chini saimanmarok?
en: Our experiences?

kok: Eba omo bebak mungsawk wngkha?
en: Or is it something else entirely?

kok: Wngna ah "ang" khakeplengma kaisa mutiorok thummani, saimanmarok, tei poitorok.
en: Perhaps the "I" is simply a collection of memories, experiences, and beliefs.

kok: Wngna omo wngkha kaisa sajakma je chwng chinisaksakrok bagwi swnamjak, chini yaksiyagra hayung sina simana'ui swnamna bagwi.
en: Perhaps it is a narrative that we create about ourselves, in order to make sense of the world around us.

kok: Eba wngma ah "ang" wngkha mungsaswk teibo ephemeral, mungsawk je tola serupjak manya eba sukrupsakha.
en: Or perhaps the "I" is something more ephemeral, something that cannot be pinned down or defined.

kok: Phaithago "ang sabo?" hwnmani swngmungno chwn kukubuikhe tei kahamkhe bujimangwlak.
en: Ultimately, the question of "who am I?" is a mystery that we may never fully understand.

kok: Ang girjao bisingo himwi thang kha, hakhe ang aro achomsa naithok khe manwi swnamjak nugwi rwi kha.
en: I walked into the church, and was immediately struck by the beauty of the architecture.

kok: Birsajak arches tei sajokjak glassni tailamrok belai kwmasingcha.
en: The soaring arches and stained glass windows were breathtaking.

kok: Khamplai kologo ang achugwi kha tei mukum kha, je nukmarogno bebak uansokna bagwi.
en: I sat down in a pew and closed my eyes, trying to take it all in.

kok: Ang aro achuk kha, ang uansokna cheng kha girjani swnamjakrogno twywi.
en: As I sat there, I began to think about the purpose of church architecture.

kok: Abobai tamo khwlainai hwnw?
en: What is it meant to do?

kok: Abo khulumna bagwi thai swnam mani de?
en: Is it simply to create a beautiful space for worship?

kok: Eba abono karwi teibo da tong kho?
en: Or is there more to it than that?

kok: Girjani manwi swnamjakrok kothoma kaham bai kwtha rwjaknai manwise wng khwna.
en: I think that church architecture can be a powerful tool for communicating the message of the Gospel.

kok: Birsajak arches tei sajokjak tailamrok chwngno muito khwlai rwphio Kaitorni hamjakmung kotor tei boni naithothok swnamjak manwirogno twywi.
en: The soaring arches and stained glass windows can remind us of the vastness of God's love and the beauty of his creation.

kok: Abohrokbo borom tei kwmasingcha wngrwi mano, abo bai chwng Kaitor bai halok bothani chukrwi mano.
en: They can also create a sense of awe and wonder, which can help us to connect with the divine.

kok: Abohrokno khobwi, girjani swnamjak manwirok tongthai tei tongthok rwi mano.
en: In addition, church architecture can be a place of refuge and comfort.

kok: jephuru chwng kwmajak tei saichung wngwi tongphru, chwng girjao phai mano tei aro khakchangma tei nini bebakno manwi mano.
en: When we are feeling lost or alone, we can come to church and find a sense of peace and belonging.

kok: Tongjakuk mani tongthairok tei chubanai lukurok bai malai sakno nogo hai matongo.
en: The familiar surroundings and the supportive community can help us to feel at home.

kok: Au, bebak giraja le aswk naithok tei khangnai buya.
en: Of course, not all church architecture is beautiful or inspiring.

kok: Baksa ni girja khe ba ahaino nok bachadropni nok se aswk naithok naijaknairogbo kwrwi.
en: Some churches are simply functional buildings that do not have much to offer in terms of aesthetics.

kok: A: Ang aswkno motokjak! Ang wansukha ani thani thwk tongo hwnwi.
en: A: I'm so itchy! I think I have lice.

kok: B: Omah! Abo belai kirimasincha.
en: B: Oh no! That's terrible.

kok: Tophano, ang saimano bohrokno bahaikhe hamrwi manai.
en: I know how to get rid of them, though.

kok: Chwng kaisa sirisithi hambithi phwnang mano.
en: We can use a traditional remedy.

kok: A: Amo tamo?
en: A: What is it?

kok: B: Chwng jotto kisa jolpui thok nango, kisa lebu bwtwi, tei kisa risum bokrarok.
en: B: We'll need some olive oil, some lemon juice, and a few cloves of garlic.

kok: A: Ako, abo ani thani jotto tongo. Omo bai chwng tamo khlaiman?
en: A: Okay, I have all of that. What do we do with it?

kok: B: Puila, chwng thansa khlai ah jolpui thokni, lebu bwtwi, tei risumno sapulnai.
en: B: First, we'll mix the olive oil, lemon juice, and garlic together.

kok: Hwnkhe, chwng omo nini khwnai tei khorok bukuro phulnai.
en: Then, we'll apply it to your hair and scalp.

kok: Chwng amono damsani bagwi yakar toninani.
en: We'll let it sit for about an hour.

kok: A: Damsa? Abo kisa kolok jora nama hai ta.
en: A: An hour? That sounds like a long time.

kok: B: Amono, phiya nasingmani bwthai mannai.
en: B: It is, but it's worth it.

kok: Ah thok ah thwk no hama mwthakma bwkhak chubanai tei ah lebu bwtwi bohrokno bwtharna bwkhak chubanai.
en: The oil will help to suffocate the lice and the lemon juice will help to kill them.

kok: Ah risum bohrokno kasoma bwkhak chubanai.
en: The garlic will help to repel them.

kok: A: Ako, ang amono khainai.
en: A: Okay, I'll do it.

kok: Ani bayap, Abel, tei ang rwngnok ni simi salsa nogo himwi thangphuru aphuru chwng kaisa thwih chaluk wngma nukha chini hoda bokhwrwi'o.
en: My friend, Abel, and I were walking home from school one day when we saw a blood drive being held at our local community center.

kok: Chwng khoroknwi no omor bisi 17, tei chwng waisa phano swkango thwi bakjakya khu.
en: We were both 17 years old, and we had never donated blood before.

kok: Chwng bathakna hwnwi chapkha tei naikha omo jotto tamoni bagwi.
en: We decided to stop in and see what it was all about.

kok: Ah thwih bakmani tangsep wngkha kubuino naithok khalepleng.
en: The process of donating blood was actually pretty simple.

kok: Chwng khoroknwi no ah swngjaknairok tei kokphirokmarok supung karikha baksa swngmungrok chini sakdukma laihbuma bagwi.
en: We both filled out a questionnaire and answered some questions about our health history.

kok: Hwnkhe, chwng chini thwi sepmung nairikha tei chini sirok nairikha oh wngkubui khlainani bohrok belai kotor da hwnwi.
en: Then, we had our blood pressure checked and our veins were checked to make sure they were big enough.

kok: Waisa chwng bakna bwkhak sraisrai wngkha, chwng thangwi kaisa achukphang tola achukha tei chini yaptwirok bisingo suchi yorjakha.
en: Once we were cleared to donate, we each sat down in a chair and had a needle inserted into our arms.

kok: Ah thwi kaisa sola bising thumjakha, tei ah jotto tangsep 15 sotirok nakha.
en: The blood was collected in a bag, and the whole process took about 15 minutes.

kok: Omo kaham wansukha bwkhak sikha chwng langmarok mwthangna bagwi chubamani hwnwi.
en: It felt good to know that we were helping to save lives.

kok: Chwng bakmani ulo, chwngno kaisa bwtwi baksho tei kaisa cookie rwjakha chwng kaham wngwi chubama bwkhak.
en: After we donated, we were given a juice box and a cookie to help us recover.

kok: Chwng kaisa hambai-nono bwlap bo mankha ah thwi khatinokni simi.
en: We also received a thank-you card from the blood bank.

kok: Ang khatung khajak je Abel tei ang thwih bakna bwkhak chapkha.
en: I'm glad that Abel and I decided to donate blood.

kok: Omo wngkha kaisa dakti tei lama kaisa ah hayung juda juda khlai swnamna bwkhak.
en: It was a quick and easy way to make a difference in the world.

kok: Ang jottono khatorwma rio thwih baknani gosima bwkhak tumungno boro chukjak wngkhe.
en: I encourage everyone to consider donating blood if they are eligible.

kok: Omo kaisa khakepleng khanangma samung je langrokno mwthangna chubai mano.
en: It's a simple act of kindness that can help save lives.

kok: "Kiching, ang tabuk markhe bwkha baijak. ani bwrwi no bisi 2 swkang ang bai kagwi thangkha."
en: "Dude, I'm so heartbroken right now. My girlfriend of 2 years just broke up with me."

kok: "Tamo wngkha?"
en: "What happened?"

kok: "Ang bo saimanya. bo sakha je boni thani wansukphan kisaphano kwrwi kha hwnwi.
en: "I don't know. She just said she wasn't feeling it anymore.

kok: Ang palamanliya.
en: I'm so confused.

kok: Chwng kaham kwrwngno hwnwi ang wansukmani."
en: I thought we were happy."

kok: "Nakardi, borok. ang saimano nwng bahai chongmao tong. bwkha baima hamya."
en: "I'm sorry, man.I know how you feel. Heartbreak sucks."

kok: "Ahaino wngo. I saimanliya tamo khaina nang."
en: "It does. I don't know what to do."

kok: "Saksak no nwng kisaa jora rwdi.
en: "Just give yourself some time.

kok: Chirik kabwi nadi jodi nangkhe.
en: Cry it out if you need to.

kok: Hwnkhe tei, nwng buphuru tiyar wngnai, yapri sena chengkhe.
en: And then, when you're ready, start to move on.

kok: Aro twibom o kubuni ah kwbangma tongo.
en: There are plenty of other fish in the sea."

kok: "Ang saimano. phiya ang saimanya aphrubo ang tei waisa date khaina tiyarda wngno."
en: "I know. But I don't know if I'm ready to date again yet."

kok: "Bo thikno. nwng tabuk tiyar wngnani mungsa nangya. tak nini joranadi tei hamdi."
en: "That's okay. You don't have to be ready right away. Just take your time and heal."

kok: "Hambai, borok. ang appreciate khayo."
en: "Thanks, man. I appreciate it."

kok: "Kunu wngya."
en: "No problem."

kok: Hapung saka simi naimung wngkha belai hamathakmani.
en: The view from the top of the mountain was breathtaking.

kok: Sal pohorwma wngkha, tokrok rwchapmani, tei chumuirok chini tolao.
en: The sun was shining, the birds were singing, and the clouds were below us.

kok: Ang poito khaimanya chwng bwswk kuchugo.
en: I couldn't believe how high up we were.

kok: Chwng aro sogwina bagwi damrwi hiked khai thango, tei jotto yapri omo swk wngkha.
en: We had hiked for hours to get here, and it was worth every step.

kok: Chwng bachawui aro naimung nai tongphuru, kaisa truck lai thangkha.
en: As we stood there taking in the view, a truck drove by.

kok: Abo belai kotor, kwcham truck, tei omo harpek bai thukulubjak.
en: It was a big, old truck, and it was covered in mud.

kok: Ah chaluknai bini khorok tailam ni kariwui kwphajak, tei bo mwnwi tongo.
en: The driver was sticking his head out the window, and he was smiling.

kok: Bo naimung nai aswkno tongthogwi nai tongo aswkno chwng je nai tongmani hai.
en: He must have been enjoying the view as much as we were.

kok: Chwng ah truck chaluk thangmani naitongkha, tei hwnkhe cheng guriwui chini skatongnai naimung bwkhak phirokha.
en: We watched the truck drive away, and then we turned our attention back to the view.

kok: Chwng swrapsa ni bagwi aro saka bathagwi tongkha, haino mukphiliksa tongthokmani twi.
en: We stayed up there for a while, just enjoying the moment.

kok: Amo wngkha kaisa chasukjak sal, tei chwng belai khatung khajak chwng hapung saka hike chaitokma bwkhak swnamkha.
en: It was a perfect day, and we were glad we had made the effort to hike up the mountain.

kok: Chwng hikhe kha tola phirokna chengphuru, chwng saimankha je tola ni simi teibo kahamkuk naimung nukjakha.
en: As we started to hike back down, we realized that the view was even better from below.

kok: Chwng hakchalni truck no nuk tongo, tei omo kaisa chikonsa speck haikhe nukjago.
en: We could see the truck in the distance, and it looked like a tiny speck.

kok: Omo mwlang chajak wansukma bwkhak wngkha je chwng aro haino saka sogwidrop, tola naisijak aro.
en: It was amazing to think that we had just been up there, looking down at it.

kok: Ah tola hike teisa kwlai saka hike khaimani slai, tei chwng chini malkhungo jora kwrwi sani phirogwi sogwikha.
en: The hike down was easier than the hike up, and we made it back to our car in no time.

kok: Ah mukumukhatinok wngkha kaisa rangmai trove laihabuma, rikmamanwirok, tei kothokmarok.
en: The museum was a treasure trove of history, artifacts, and stories.

kok: Ah kwcham Egyptian mummies simi ah kwtal-sal lepamanirok bwkhak, aro jottonni tongthokma bwkha mungsaswk tongo.
en: From the ancient Egyptian mummies to the modern-day paintings, there was something for everyone to enjoy.

kok: Kaisa ah jottoni slai khasrangjak phunukmark wngkha ah kwcham thwngmanwirok thumsa khlaimani.
en: One of the most interesting exhibits was the collection of old toys.

kok: Aro ah Victorian jukni simi phutlarok tongo, thwngmanwi sengkwrakrok ah lukurok chobani simi, tei ahaino kaisa buphang phangkhorrok kaihma ah 1900s swkang simi.
en: There were dolls from the Victorian era, toy soldiers from the Civil War, and even a set of wooden blocks from the early 1900s.

kok: Twngmanwi thwgwi omoni sakni kothoma sana bwkhak tongo, tei omo nukna bwkhak mauni khlaima wngkha bahai boorg jora rwgwi swlaijakha.
en: Each toy had its own story to tell, and it was fascinating to see how they had changed over time.

kok: Kaisa ah thwngmanwirok je ani mokol romkha kaisa chikonsa buphangni malkhung wngkha.
en: One of the toys that caught my eye was a small wooden car.

kok: Omo 1950s bising swnamma wngkha, tei omo chasukjak tonghalok bising wngkha.
en: It was made in the 1950s, and it was in perfect condition.

kok: Ah lepama tabukbo kwchwngkhu, tei ah swkwirok tabukbo milik.
en: The paint was still bright, and the wheels were still smooth.

kok: Ang omono khochai naikha tei omo ganakhai amjokkha.
en: I picked it up and examined it closely.

kok: Omo wngkha kaisa khakepleng thwngmanwi, phiya omo belai kaham-swnamma bo wngkha.
en: It was a simple toy, but it was also very well-made.

kok: Ang uanamasingsa wngkha sabo oh malkhungbai thwngkha jotto ah bisirok swkang.
en: I wondered who had played with this car all those years ago.

kok: Bohrokni imangrok tei muchungjakmarok tamo?
en: What were their dreams and aspirations?

kok: Bohrok tamo wansuk ah thinang narakmao?
en: What did they think the future held?

kok: Ang malkhungno ungkulugo tonikha omo phunukma tonghalok bising tei choyawui ani lama sakao.
en: I put the car back in its display case and continued on my way.

kok: iko ang ah mukumukhatinok twih himwi thangkheno, ang jotto ah manwirokni bagwi wansukkha je ah hayungni bising swlaijak tongkha swkango oh thwngmanwi swnamma wngkha.
en: As I walked through the museum, I thought about all the things that had changed in the world since these toys were made.

kok: Chikonsa kaisa robin bolong bisingtwi biriwui tongo bo nukha yaksigra kaisa kotorma buphango tok buthup kuthumlaimani.
en: A brave little robin was flying through the forest when he saw a group of birds gathered around a large tree.

kok: Bo ganani bedego bikhwlaikha tei bohrok tamo salaitong abo khwnakha.
en: He landed on a branch nearby and listened to what they were saying.

kok: "Chwng hatibar romwi oh buphangno naitukphugwi tongmani", masa tokha sakha.
en: "We've been investigating this tree for weeks," said a raven.

kok: "Chwng wngkubui bwkhak wngyakhu tamoni bagwi aswkno khekma wngthotokungya!" chikonsa chwrwi masa sakha.
en: "We're not sure what's causing it to lean so precariously!" said a little sparrow.

kok: "Haiphano chwng wanjak je omo kwlaina bwkha thangtongo tei khoroksaswkno dukhumanwi mano!" toiling chirik kha.
en: "But we're worried that it's going to fall and hurt someone!" cried an eagle.

kok: Robin buphangno naisikha tei nukha je kaisa digi bwkhak kubuino belaino hilikhe khekjak.
en: The robin looked at the tree and saw that it was indeed leaning very heavily to one side.

kok: Bo saimano je bo chubana bagwi mungsaswk khaina nango hini, phiya bo saimanya tamono.
en: He knew that he had to do something to help, but he didn't know what.

kok: Achumsa, kaisa biniro khakama phaikha.
en: Suddenly, an idea came to him.

kok: Bo ha tolao bikhwlai thangkha tei poja kotorma bwlairokno thumkha.
en: He flew down to the ground and gathered a large load of leaves.

kok: Bo hwnkhe phirogwi buphang saka biriwui thangkha tei bwlaino hakoro swkna chengkha je thayo yarwng nukjaktongmani.
en: He then flew back up to the tree and started to stuff the leaves into the hole where the roots were exposed.

kok: Tokrok tolao mwlangchalai nailai tonglaikha robin samung khai tongphuru.
en: The birds below watched in amazement as the robin worked.

kok: Borok poito khaise manliya je aswk tok chikosa ni thani amswk phan tonganw hwnwi.
en: They couldn't believe that such a small bird could have so much strength.

kok: Kisa damrwini olo, robin hakorno muthubwi paikha.
en: After a few hours, the robin had filled the hole completely.

kok: Buphang tabuk sakadigi tei seya khai bachawui tongo.
en: The tree was now standing upright and stable.

kok: Kubuni tokrok chiroklaiwi tei sal bachirima bagwi robino hambai yapharkha.
en: The other birds cheered and thanked the robin for saving the day.

kok: Kwdwkma jora romwi, aro khoroksa bwrwi sikli naithok Luna mungwi kaisa chikonsa kamio tongo bolongni buchu gana.
en: Once upon a time, there was a beautiful young girl named Luna who lived in a small village on the edge of a forest.

kok: Bo kwbangma kokloprok tei rwchapmung rogo sajaknai, tei jotto para ni chwla siklarok bini hamjakmao kwlwkjak.
en: She was the subject of many poems and songs, and all the young men in the village were in love with her.

kok: Phiya Luna's bwkha teimasa ni oro se thepajak: tal o.
en: But Luna's heart was set on someone else: the moon.

kok: Jotto horo, Luna phataro achugwi tei tal o saka naikolwi tongo, salsa bini logi tonganw hwnwi imang nugo.
en: Every night, Luna would sit outside and gaze up at the moon, dreaming of one day being with him.

kok: Bo bini bagwi kokloprok tei rwchapmungrok swio, bo uramuram talpilala tola mwsao.
en: She would write poems and songs about him, and she would often dance in the moonlight.

kok: Kaisa horo, tal Luna ni imango pepla phayo.
en: One night, the moon appeared to Luna in a dream.

kok: Bo bono saka je bobo bono hamjago, tei je bo salsa bini oro phainai hwnwi.
en: He told her that he loved her too, and that he would one day come to her.

kok: Luna belai tongthokjakma bara, tei bo bobai tongna bagwi naisingwi manya.
en: Luna was overjoyed, and she could not wait to be with him.

kok: Teini salo, Luna bolongo moon bai malaina thangkha.
en: The next day, Luna went to the forest to meet the moon.

kok: Bo bono sapung hor dwgwi naisingwi tongo, phiya bo twse phailiya.
en: She waited for him all night, but he never came.

kok: Luna belai bwkha baijakha, tei bo saimanliya tamo khainai.
en: Luna was heartbroken, and she did not know what to do.

kok: Teini ssalo, Luna tei waisa bolongo thangkha.
en: The next day, Luna went back to the forest.

kok: Bo kaisa buphang tola achugwi tei kabna chengkha.
en: She sat down under a tree and started to cry.

kok: Atumsma, bo kaisa khorag khwnakha. "Luna, " ah khorang sakha.
en: Suddenly, she heard a voice. "Luna," the voice said.

kok: Luna saka naisikha, tei bo nukha tal bini bwskango bachajak.
en: Luna looked up, and she saw the moon standing in front of her.

kok: Bijaprok kaisa tongthokmung ni yaphang tei bisirarok rwngni bagwi wngkha.
en: Books have been a source of entertainment and education for centuries.

kok: Ungthangjak bising, bijaprok wngkha yakbai swijak tei belai morokjak wngkha.
en: In the past, books were hand-written and were very expensive.

kok: Omo bohrokno kaisa tongphlai manwi swnamo je ah rangrigwnang rok simi naimano.
en: This made them a luxury item that only the wealthy could afford.

kok: Haiphano, 15th bisira bising ah sapukmani sapokkhol swnamjakha, bijaprok ah jotto lukuni bwkhak sogwima tei naimanai wngkha.
en: However, with the invention of the printing press in the 15th century, books became more affordable and accessible to the general public.

kok: Omo swikwrwngmung tei rwng dagima bwkhak hamkrai wngkha.
en: This led to a boom in literacy and education.

kok: Bijaprok kaisa kotor tangmung thwngkha hukumu tei dopha swnammani bising.
en: Books have played a major role in shaping culture and society.

kok: Borok swijak laihbuma, wansukamarok auaima, tei hodarwk salai remtisama bwkhak phwnangjakha.
en: They have been used to document history, spread ideas, and promote social change.

kok: Baksa jottoni slai koboljakma bijaprok laihbumani bising Bible, Quran, tei Shakespeareni samungrok khobwi.
en: Some of the most influential books in history include the Bible, the Quran, and the works of Shakespeare.

kok: Tini, bijaprok tabukbo kaisa kotor yaphang tongthokmung tei rwng bwkhak twi.
en: Today, books are still a major source of entertainment and education.

kok: Bohrok kaisa dalbidal swnammarok bising manthokma tongo, sapukma khobmani, e-booksm tei audiobooks.
en: They are available in a variety of formats, including print, e-books, and audiobooks.

kok: Bijaprok bijapnokrok, bijapkhatinokrok, tei online manwi mano.
en: Books can be found in libraries, bookstores, and online.

kok: Bijaprokni thinang wngkha chongmanya.
en: The future of books is uncertain.

kok: Baksa borok poito khayo je e-books paithago sapokma bijaprok no norwimano.
en: Some people believe that e-books will eventually replace print books.

kok: Haiphano, aro tabukbo kaisa kwrak sanmung tongo sapokm bijaprokni bagwi, ahaino porinairokni kwcharo je ah sakno twywi saimanjak kaisa bijap porimani chajakkukma bai.
en: However, there is still a strong demand for print books, especially among readers who prefer the physical experience of reading a book.

kok: Thingango jesaphano khatijakrok wngthwng, bijaprok wngkubui wngkha torwkma bwkhak kaisa borok hukumuni lam bokcho kwbangma bisirok phaima bwkhak.
en: Whatever the future holds, books are sure to remain a vital part of human culture for many years to come.

kok: Kiasa jorani kok, aro khoroksa bwrwi sikli Grace wngwi tongo je kaisa chikonsa kami bising tongo.
en: Once upon a time, there was a young girl named Grace who lived in a small village.

kok: Bo wngkha khoroksa kaham tei kwchang bwrwi, phiya bo belai lachijago.
en: She was a kind and gentle girl, but she was also very shy.

kok: Bini kwbangma bayaprok kwrwi, tei bo uramuram saichung wansukha.
en: She didn't have many friends, and she often felt lonely.

kok: Salsa, Grace ah bolong bisingtwih himwi tongmani jephuru bo kaisa naithok khum kuphur bswkang phaikha.
en: One day, Grace was walking in the forest when she came across a beautiful white flower.

kok: Bo swkango omo kahai jesa manwi waisaphano nukyakhu.
en: She had never seen anything like it before.

kok: Ah bubarlaih aswkno dugwnang tongjak, tei ah bahai wngkha aswkno kwtwi.
en: The petals were so delicate, and the fragrance was so sweet.

kok: Grace ah khum bai hamjakrwma wngkha, tei bo omono bini logi nogo twlangna chongkha.
en: Grace was enchanted by the flower, and she decided to take it home with her.

kok: Jephuru bo ah khumno bini maphasongno phunukha, bohrok mwlangchakha.
en: When she showed the flower to her parents, they were amazed.

kok: Bohrok jeba kaisa omo kahai jesa manwi waisaphano nukyakhu.
en: They had never seen anything like it either.

kok: Bohrok Grace no sakha je ah khum wngkha belai mahmlai, tei je omo wngkha kaisa mari kwthar tei chayakwrwi wngkha.
en: They told Grace that the flower was very special, and that it was a symbol of purity and innocence.

kok: Grace bini khum bai belai kungchukma wngkha, tei omono kotor kuar naikani nahaka.
en: Grace was very proud of her flower, and she took great care of it.

kok: Bo salbrumbrum amono twi rwkha, tei bo wngkubui swnamkha omo homnino kaisa sal thai bising tongo.
en: She watered it every day, and she made sure it was always in a sunny spot.

kok: Ah khum torwi tongkha tei torwi tongkha, tei omo daktino ah kamini bising jottoni slai khum naithok wngkha.
en: The flower grew and grew, and it soon became the most beautiful flower in the village.

kok: Salsa, khoroksa chwla sikla ah kami bwkhak phaikha.
en: One day, a young man came to the village.

kok: Bo wngkha khoroksa berainai, tei bo kaisa hakchal hani simi paikha.
en: He was a traveler, and he had come from a faraway land.

kok: Ah hodapharwk thumsakhaima nangukma overstated wngya.
en: The importance of national integration cannot be overstated.

kok: Kaisa bosong wngkha borok bai swnamjakma jotto langma himmarok simi, juda juda hukumurok bai, tongtharrok, tei poitorok.
en: A nation is made up of people from all walks of life, with different cultures, religions, and beliefs.

kok: Hodapharwk thumsakhaima wngkha ah khlaijak tongmung oh borokno thansakhe tubumani tei kaisa sinai simanwi thansa swnammani.
en: National integration is the process of bringing these people together and creating a sense of unity.

kok: Aro kwbangma manmrirok tongo hodapharwk thumsakhaima bwkhak.
en: There are many benefits to national integration.

kok: Phunukmari karwi, omo tangsitra khaina bwhak chubai mano, rangthong kasama, tei hodarwk kwthamung remtisama.
en: For example, it can help to reduce crime, improve economic growth, and promote social harmony.

kok: Kaisa teibo thumsakhajak bosong wngkha teibo talikha hamrwma tei khlaimanmung bwkhak wngo.
en: A more integrated nation is more likely to be prosperous and successful.

kok: Aro wngkha kwbangma himlarok bwkhak hodapharwk thumsakhaima.
en: There are many ways to promote national integration.

kok: Kaisa nangkukma yapri wngkha khasrai khlaima bwkhak je jotto tongphangrok aro baksa rwng sogwima bwkhak tei sep tongo.
en: One important step is to ensure that all citizens have equal access to education and opportunity.

kok: Omo chubamarok bwkhak swbaiwui kasomungrok juda juda bodolrokni kwchar tei kaisa teibo dopha thansa swnamma.
en: This helps to break down barriers between different groups and create a more cohesive society.

kok: Tei kaisa nangkukma yapri wngkha terkhlaima ah bosong solya bwkhak.
en: Another important step is to celebrate the diversity of the nation.

kok: Omo humuku wngmungrok, terrok, tei kubun tangmung twih khlaijak mano.
en: This can be done through cultural events, festivals, and other activities.

kok: Omo wngkha nangkukma bwkhak sinijakma tei chajakama ah juda juda hukumurok je ah bosong swnamma.
en: It is important to recognize and appreciate the different cultures that make up the nation.

kok: Hodapharwk thumsakhaima wngkha kaisa kutuk tangsep, phiya omo wngkha kaisa je nangnai jesa bosong ah khlaimanma karwi.
en: National integration is a complex process, but it is one that is essential for the success of any nation.

kok: Thansa samung khaimani bai, chwng kaisa tei thansajak tei jotto talikha hamrwma thinang bagwi swnam mano.
en: By working together, we can create a more united and prosperous future for all.

kok: Kaisa phunukmari bahai hodapharwk thumsakhaima kaisa sakphang sekrupma borokni langmarok sakao wngkha ah rwng ari bising.
en: One example of how national integration can have a direct impact on people's lives is in the area of education.

kok: Biyang-biyangni kwnwi-kwcharo chikonsa kaisa kami bising, aro kaisa saknainai tongo je bo bini khakaham tei khairokmung ni bagwi sinijago.
en: In a small village in the middle of nowhere, there lived a doctor who was known for his kindness and compassion.

kok: Bo uramuramwi hayo phataro thango bini lama bwkhak bini rugirokno chubana bagwi, iko tumungno omo kokmang bo sakni jora yakarnani eba tanglamrok.
en: He would often go out of his way to help his patients, even if it meant sacrificing his own time or resources.

kok: Salsa, kaisa bwrwi sikli saknainai ni oro phaikha hamya kuchukma bai.
en: One day, a young woman came to the doctor with a terrible cough.

kok: Bo hatibar romwi kuchugwi tongmani, tei bo wanajakna chengkha.
en: She had been coughing for weeks, and she was starting to get worried.

kok: Ah saknainai bono amjokha, tei bo saimankha je bo belai no lumjak wngkha hwnwi.
en: The doctor examined her, and he could tell that she was very sick.

kok: Bo bono sakha bini oro pneumonia tongo hwnwi, tei bo je bisna o kisa hatibar rwgwi tongna nangnai.
en: He told her that she had pneumonia, and that she would need to stay in bed for a few weeks.

kok: Ah bwrwima belai khabaijak, phiya abo saimano je ah saknainai no kubui hwnwi.
en: The woman was very upset, but she knew that the doctor was right.

kok: Bo bono hambai rwkha bini chubachu rwma bagwi, tei bo nogo lenglana bagwi thangkha.
en: She thanked him for his help, and she went home to rest.

kok: Ah saknainaai bwrwima sal thwgwi malaiyo, tei bo wngkubui khaikha je bono nangmani jotto manwi tonganw hwnwi.
en: The doctor visited the woman every day, and he made sure that she had everything she needed.

kok: Bo bono bithi rwkha bono kahamkhe chubai manna bwkhak.
en: He also gave her medicine to help her get better.

kok: Kisa hatibarni olo, ah bwrwima teisa kahamkhe chongphan wngkha.
en: After a few weeks, the woman was feeling much better.

kok: Bo ah saknainaino hambai rwkha bini chubachu ni bagwi, tei bo bono sakha je bo belaino hamsuthai.
en: She thanked the doctor for his help, and she told him that she was very grateful.

kok: Ah saknainai mwnwi kha tei sakha, "omo ani tongthokma. ang haino khatungkhajak ang chubai mankha hwnwi."
en: The doctor smiled and said, "It was my pleasure. I'm just glad I could help."

kok: Ah sakninai wngkha kaisa khakaham tei khairoknai borok je kubunrokno chubanani bwkhak saktharjak.
en: The doctor is a kind and compassionate man who is dedicated to helping others.

kok: Bayap, nwng omono poito khlagwlak.
en: Dude, you won't believe this.

kok: Aro oh engineer ani rwngnogo je coffee bai tongwi thangnai.
en: There's this engineer at my school who subsists off coffee.

kok: Oh molni jottonisai khanangjak kothomarokni bising kaisa wngkha “Kitten Lady”.

kok: Oh bwrwima khoroksa morphin chakrak tongmani, bini aming bwsa kwbangma tongmani.
en: This woman was a morphine addict who had a litter of kittens.

kok: Boh bini amingrokno belaikhe hamjago tei jora-jora aborokbai dambrum romwi thwngo.

kok: Haiphano, bini loi hamya daktino bangwi thangkha tei boh bini aming bwsarokno naikolya wngna chengkha.

kok: Boh jora kaisao sal kudukni bagwi bohrokno yakarwi kwlango, bohrokno charwnani tei twi rwnani simino kiphilwi phayo.

kok: Paithago o amingrok naikoljakyani bagwi tekto manna chengkha.

kok: Bohrok kerem tei haya wngkha tei bohrokni buikhumu kognani chengkha.

kok: Maksa maksakhe bohrok thwinani chengkha.

kok: Oh aming bwsani nokphangjwk bini amingrok kwmajagwi belai khanangnak tongmani, phiyaba boh bini loi hamyano mwthak manlia.

kok: Paithago bini aming bwsarokno kwlangwi morphin chahui thwiui thangkha.

kok: Oh kothoma wngkha kephek manuini akochono muitu khairwnai.
en: This story is a reminder of the dangers of drug addiction.

kok: Obo malmatani thani bohrokni borokrokni bagwi hamjakma tei khatharma tongwi manmanobo muitu khwlairwo.

kok: Rikimumg wngkha kaisa kebel manwi.
en: Art is a fragile thing.

kok: Omo pohor, kutung, sibubuk tei ahaino kisisa tangma bai derajak mano.

kok: Amoni bagwi omo rikmung naikani nama bwkkhak nangkukma, sanathangkhai tumungno nwng khoroksa thumnai wngkha.
en: That's why it's important to take care of art, especially if you're a collector.

kok: Oh kokmarok wngkha ah tungmari tei sibubukno kaisa loriya mil o tonimani, tei ah rikmungno salpohorni simi sakphang katirinani.
en: This means keeping the temperature and humidity at a constant level, and protecting the art from direct sunlight.

kok: Nwng rikmungno hadulwi tei sitra bwkhak phunukmani sakkati bo khaina nango rikmung , tei wngkubui swnamdi omo aswk kutung yaphang bwkhak belai takachijakthwng.
en: You should also avoid exposing art to dust and dirt, and make sure it's not hung too close to a heat source.

kok: Tumungno nini thani jesa swngmungrok tongkhe nini rikmungno bahaikhe naikani khainai, nwng khoroksa tangsamungkwrwng khatinai bai kokswngna nango.
en: If you have any questions about how to care for your art, you should consult with a professional conservator.

kok: Bohrok kaisa naikani chapmungo nono chubai mano je nini thummani chongjak bwkhak.
en: They can help you create a care plan that's specific to your collection.

kok: Oro kaisa kisasa jora rwmani wngkha rikmungni bagwi naikani bitirimani.

kok: * Rikmungno nini bukcha yakrokbai tatangdi.

kok: Yaklaprok eba laih kwlwi ste omo twidulma bwkhak.

kok: * Kutung yaphangrok simi rikmungno hachal tonidi, ahaino horthairok tei nok tungrwnai kolrok.

kok: * Rikmungno hadulwi tei sitra simi katiridi kaisa kwlwi hujaknai bai sabrumbrumno omo hadulwimani bai.

en: The water flows over rocks and stones, creating a constantly changing pattern of ripples and waves.

kok: Taluang bising, nwng kaisa dalbidal juda juda ah dahl warmani, khad khobmani, trout, tei jagur bo manwi mano.
en: In October, you can also find a variety of different fish species biting, including bass, trout, and catfish.

kok: Tumungno nwng ah rommani bwkhak kwtal wngkha, aro kaisa kisasa manwirok tongo nwng wngkubui swnamma bwkhak khlaimano nini thani kaisa kaham simari tongkhe.
en: If you're new to fishing, there are a few things you can do to make sure you have a good experience.

kok: Puila, wngkubui swnamdi nini thani nangmani manwirok da tong.
en: First, make sure you have the right equipment.

kok: Omo kaisa ah rommani chempuk, dulmanwi, ari, khwi, tei loop sohmani khojago.
en: This includes a fishing rod, reel, line, bait, and lures.

kok: Nwng kaisa dalbidal ah rommani yaktolmarok chubamakuplung manwi bo mano tei bijaprok nini oroni bijapno eba bijapkhotol rogo.
en: You can also find a variety of helpful fishing guides and books at your local library or bookstore.

kok: Waisa nini thani ah nangkukmani manwirok tongkha, Tabuk jora wngkha ah romna bwkhak kaisa thai naitukthani.
en: Once you have the right equipment, it's time to find a place to fish.

kok: Sajwla, artificial intelligent no twywi khwda khwna kha?
en: Son, have you heard of artificial intelligence?

kok: Abo kaisa computer program se abo swrwngwi bo mano tei sakni bagwi bo uansogwi mano.
en: It's a type of computer program that can learn and think for itself.

kok: Abo tabok se chengjak kho, phiya abo industries ni swlaimung ni bagwi belai phan rw o.
en: It's still in its early stages, but it has the potential to revolutionize many industries.

kok: Phunukmari, artificial intelligent bai malkhung no bini bo no chole rw wi mano, medical diagnosis manwirok manthogo, tei customer service chatbots bo wngkha.
en: For example, artificial intelligence is already being used to develop self-driving cars, medical diagnosis tools, and even customer service chatbots.

kok: Bebakni swlai nangkuk mani artificial intelligent ni bising o wngkha machine swrwng mani.
en: One of the most important components of artificial intelligence is machine learning.

kok: Machine swrwng mani wng kha abo artificial intelligent se abo computer o mungsa programmed khwlai ya wi no swrwngwi mano.
en: Machine learning is a type of artificial intelligence that allows computers to learn without being explicitly programmed.

kok: Machine swrwng mani algorithm paternrok no sini wi mano tei o pattern o tamo wngno abo bo sa'ui mano.
en: Machine learning algorithms are able to identify patterns in data and make predictions based on those patterns.

kok: Abo belai samung kaham khwlai layo spam filtering, fraud khwlai jakmarog, tei mwkhang bo sini wi mano.
en: This makes them ideal for tasks like spam filtering, fraud detection, and image recognition.

kok: Artificial intelligent kuchuk karwrwk wngma bai, chini langmani samungo chuk rw nai.
en: As artificial intelligence continues to develop, it will have a major impact on our lives.

kok: Abo chini hayung no tei bo manthok rw nai, teibo manwi manthok nai, hakhe tei bo sakni wngkuk nai.
en: It will make our world more efficient, more productive, and more personalized.

kok: Abo kwtal haba tei jora swnam nai.
en: It will also create new jobs and opportunities.

kok: Haiphano omono sina bo nangsugo artificial intelligent kaisa hai no manwi se.
en: But it's important to remember that artificial intelligence is just a tool.

kok: Tei kubun manwi hai, abo no bo kaham tei hamya samungo thepa wi mano.
en: Like any tool, it can be used for good or for evil.

kok: Abo chini thani o se artificial intelligent no bahai khe samung o thepa hayung no kaham khwlai thani o.
en: It's up to us to decide how we use artificial intelligence to make the world a better place.

kok: Adi nokbaro, khoroksa kwtwng bai ri sunai borok kaham tongo mung Ali bo khungsa kami ste o tongo.
en: Once upon a time, there was a humble tailor named Ali who lived in a small village.

kok: Bo maya bo gwnwng tei samungbo khwlaikrak, phiya bo bini naharmung no supungwi manya.
en: He was a kind and hardworking man, but he was not very successful.

kok: Salsa, khoroksa gwnang paiphal wngnai boni phalnogo haphai kha tei bono kwtal kanchlwi sub di hwnwi hwnkha.
en: One day, a wealthy merchant came to Ali's shop and asked him to make a new suit of clothes.

kok: Ali belai tongthokma bara wng kha, phiya bo saimano a paiphal thwngnai naimani rino morokno rwi manglak hwnwi
en: Ali was overjoyed, but he knew that he could not afford the expensive materials that the merchant wanted.

kok: Ali a jwngjal no nana gosi kha.
en: Ali decided to take a risk.

kok: Bo hatio thang kha hakhe je kwlaikuk ri paiwi tubu kha.
en: He went to the market and bought the cheapest materials he could find.

kok: Bo hakhe nogo thang kha tei ri subna chengwikha.
en: He then went home and began to work on the suit.

kok: Bo damnwi damtham romwino samung khwlai kha, hakhe bo sub manibo paikha, bo kanchwlwi naithok khe sub kha.
en: He worked for hours, and when he was finished, he had created a beautiful suit of clothes.

kok: Tei ni salo, Ali a paiphal wngnaino kanchwlwi rwphai kha.
en: The next day, Ali brought the suit to the merchant.

kok: A paiphal wngnai belai chajak kha bini kanchlwi bai, hakhe bo Alino rang kwbang rwkha.
en: The merchant was very impressed with the suit, and he paid Ali a handsome price for it.

kok: Ali belai tongthokjak kha tamni hinmale bo boni rwngmung bai ajewi man mani bagwi.
en: Ali was so happy that he had been able to use his creativity and skill to make a profit.

kok: Ali bobai baksa samung tangnairokni bagwibo subwi rw kha, tei bo omo hai khe no kamini ri suna kwrwng thajak hwnwi sinijakha.
en: Ali continued to make clothes for his clients, and he soon became known as the best tailor in the village.

kok: Borokrok kwrwng kwrwng thaini phaibayo bo ri subjak painani bagwi, tei Ali boni nokborokrokni bagwi bo rwi mankh hakhe no bo khakchangwi tongkha boni langmao.
en: People came from all over to buy his clothes, and Ali was able to provide for his family and live a comfortable life.

kok: Salsa, swngcharno kitingwi berainai hwnwi belai sinijak khoroksa kamio phai kha.
en: One day, a famous traveler came to the village.

kok: Ani ama khoroksa swikwrwng, tei tini bo oh samungo belai kaham.
en: My mother was a writer, and she was very good at it.

kok: Je jesamanwi bagwi swimano, tei bini kothomarok homnino khasrangjak.
en: She could write about anything, and her stories were always so interesting.

kok: Bo bini langmani borok rokni bagwi swina hamjago, tei bo uramuramwi chini bagwi swio, bini chwrairokni bagwi.
en: She loved to write about the people in her life, and she would often write about us, her children.

kok: Bo homnino chini saksakni chopthani o belai kaham tei chini hayungno naisikmani manthokya lamarokno twi.
en: She was always very good at capturing our personalities and our unique ways of seeing the world.

kok: Ani kaisa chajakma kothomarok je ani ama swimani wngkha chwng jephuru twibomrukung vacation thangma jora.
en: One of my favorite stories that my mother wrote was about the time we went on vacation to the beach.

kok: Chwng jottono thwngna hwnwi tongthoklaijak, tei chwng twiyung nainani naising manliya.
en: We were all so excited to go, and we couldn't wait to see the ocean.

kok: Jephuru chwng aro sogwiyo, abo chwng wansugwi tongmani slai teibo naithokmani.
en: When we got there, it was even more beautiful than we had imagined.

kok: Twi belaino kwchwngkrak sraisrai, tei hasing kuphur tei kwlwi wngkha.
en: The water was crystal clear, and the sand was white and soft.

kok: Chwng sapungno twiyogwi tei hasing bai thwnglai sal katikha.
en: We spent the whole day swimming and playing in the sand.

kok: Abo belai chasukjak sal.
en: It was the perfect day.

kok: Ani ama kaisa kothoma swikha ah salni bagwi, tei abo ani bagwi haino mahmalai.
en: My mother wrote a story about that day, and it was so special to me.

kok: Bo jotto tongthokmani tei tongthok je chwng wansukjak chopbwi narak kha tei omo ano wansukma swnamkha ang aro bobai hwnwi, teiwaisa jotto omo siniloi wngjak.
en: She captured all of the excitement and joy that we felt, and it made me feel like I was right there with her, experiencing it all again.

kok: Ani bagwi je khothoma homnino rangmai tongnai.
en: I will always treasure that story.

kok: Ang wngkha kaisa kotorkuk swikwrwng, tei bini thani yakpa tongo hayung ni naithokno chopna bagwi.
en: My mother was a great writer, and she had a gift for capturing the beauty of the world.

kok: Kotor doyung langma wngkha kaisa paiphwlaiya kuthummung.
en: Life in a big city is like a never-ending party.

kok: Aro hominino mungsaswk khaijaknai tongo, naima, tei sijak.
en: There's always something to do, see, and experience.

kok: Ah lamarogo homnino tangmung bai gugdrilaijak, tei aro homnino naitukberaima kwtal thai tongo.
en: The streets are always buzzing with activity, and there's always a new place to explore.

kok: Phiya obo khamunsukmani wngwi mano.
en: But it can also be overwhelming.

kok: Ah khorang, ah lamchapnai, ah kuthumungrok - omo baksa borok rokni bagwi belai wngwi mano.
en: The noise, the traffic, the crowds - it can all be too much for some people.

kok: Tumungno nwng omo ni bagwi tiyar khwlaijakya khe, doyung kotoro tongmani rok kubuino hukumu dadarmung wngwi mano.
