en: The process of recycling begins with the collection of recyclable materials.

kok: Oh manwi-khwnwi rok wngkha rwngrem tei tongraidrok kwthwng manwi-khwnwi je kwtal thaihmanwirok swnamjakma bwkhak phwnangjagwi mano.
en: These materials are then sorted and processed into raw materials that can be used to create new products.

kok: Phunukmari karwi, plastic bottle kwtal plastic bottles o teiwaisa swnamjak mano, aluminum cans bo kwtal aluminum cans bo teiwaisa swnamjak mano, tei swilaih bo kwtal swilaih thaimanwirogo teiwaisa swnamjak mano.
en: For example, plastic bottles can be recycled into new plastic bottles, aluminum cans can be recycled into new aluminum cans, and paper can be recycled into new paper products.

kok: Teiwaisa swnamjakmani kwbangma manmari rok tongo.
en: Recycling has many benefits.

kok: Omo khibijak rangmari je hakorsupungmarogo thangma bwkhak tei soknanirok khairiwui chupachu khai mano, abo habar no katirwnani tei habar khatima bumukrok.
en: It helps to reduce the amount of waste that goes to landfills and incinerators, which can help to protect the environment and conserve natural resources.

kok: Tewaisa swnamphimani wngkha kaisa phan khatimani, iko omo kisa phan nao thaihmanw thaihrwma bwkhak manwi-khwnwi teiwaisa swnamjak simi hwnkhe omo kwthwng manwi-khwnwirok khaijakma simi.
en: Recycling also conserves energy, as it takes less energy to produce products from recycled materials than it does from raw materials.

kok: Jora rwui, teiwaisa swnamphimani rang khatiwui mano, omo je kwthwng manwi-khwnwirok sepma tei tangraida bwkhak nangmani khairiwui mano.
en: In addition, recycling can save money, as it can reduce the need to extract and process raw materials.

kok: Oh kwtal teiwaisa swnamjakmani pandarok chengsamani kwbangma haktor rogo pali-raidarok teiwaisa swnamjakmani tangdal paithago phaikha.
en: The launch of new recycling programs in most countries has ended the color-coded recycling system.

kok: Omo tamni hwnkhe kaisa kwtal pandarok jotto teiwaisa swnammanai manwi-khwnwi rokno gosima bwkhak swnamjakha, bohrokni pali khauarya.
en: This is because the new programs are designed to accept all recyclable materials, regardless of their color.

kok: Oh kwtal pandarok wngkha teibo yaksrai, bohrok saknibaisak wngjak rwngremni tangdal bwkhak teiwaisa swnamjak mawnwi-khwnwi rok tangraida phwnangjago.
en: The new programs are also more efficient, as they use automated sorting systems to process recyclable materials.

kok: "Ms.Smith, " ang sakha, "ang kubuino ah chahthai tei arak ter rok oh hatibar bwkhak bwskango naising tongo.
en: "Ms. Smith," I said, "I'm really looking forward to the food and wine festival this weekend.

kok: Ang khwnamani je ah chainaimani pandarok belai mlangchamani haii wngnai hwnwi."
en: I've heard that the tasting events are going to be amazing."

kok: "In', bohrok bo, " Ms. Smith kokphirok kha.
en: "Yes, they are," Ms. Smith replied.

kok: "Phiya kisa naikani khaidi omo belai khaiina tathangdi. Nwng belai kuplung wngna muchungya eba belai kephek wngma bwkhak!"
en: "But be careful not to overdo it. You don't want to get too full or too tipsy!"

kok: "Ang wngya, " ang sakha. "ang haino kisa manwirok nokakarijak thwgwi yakphunuk naiyanw."
en: "I won't," I said. "I'll just sample a few things from each booth."

kok: "Amo kaisa kaham chapmung, " Ms. Smiith sakha. "tei wngkubui wngma bwkhak hydrated tongna bagwi twi kwbangma nwngdi."
en: "That's a good plan," Ms. Smith said. "And be sure to drink plenty of water to stay hydrated."

kok: "Ang khayanw," ang sakha.
en: "I will," I said.

kok: Ang ter o dakti thangwi sogwikha tei daktino khamunsukha ah nukmung tei bahairok bai.
en: I arrived at the festival early and was immediately overwhelmed by the sights and smells.

kok: Aro chahthai nokarijrok tongo jotto hayung sakani sami, tei ah nokbar hoku bai supungjak songmani chahathai simi.
en: There were food booths from all over the world, and the air was filled with the smoke from cooking food.

kok: Ang oroni haba ni simi kaisa cheeses ni yakphukma bai chengkha, tei hwnkhe teikaisa nokkarijak wo loriwui thangkha je sindairok hangjak bagwi tongo.
en: I started with a sampling of cheeses from a local farm, and then moved on to a booth that was serving grilled oysters.

kok: Ah sindairok belai thokmani, tei ang borokno tola sulaikha kaisa sisi cherem cherem kuphur arak bai.
en: The oysters were delicious, and I washed them down with a glass of crisp white wine.

kok: Ang choyakarwi ani lama ah ter ni yaksiyagra swnam tongo, jotto manwi yakphugwi charcuterie bwkhak chocolate simi.
en: I continued to make my way around the festival, sampling everything from charcuterie to chocolate.

kok: Therapist: Nwng nok thansa khe tongmani a borok bai walaima bagwi se nwng oro sokphai khwna.
en: Therapist: So, you're here because you're having some conflict with your roommate.

kok: Hamya naijaknaisa: Au, belai no tuk jakha. Chwng thansa si wngwi manliya.
en: Client: Yeah, it's been really tough. We're just not getting along.

kok: Therapist: Tei tamorok wnglai kha tei kisaswk sa'ui de mano?
en: Therapist: Can you tell me a little bit more about what's been going on?

kok: Hamya naijaknaisa: Abo, tal kisaswk swkang se chengo bo bwsak tongthokya hwnwi bithi chana chengphuru ni simi.
en: Client: Well, it started a few months ago when she started taking medication for her anxiety.

kok: Abo switch philjak ma hai se wng si o.
en: It's like a switch flipped.

kok: Bo kwbwino naslema swngcha wngsuk kha tei thamchi bo tungsukha
en: She's become really irritable and short-tempered.

kok: Bo ano chirigwi mangno tongo, tei chini halok nobo sacho na mang no nayo.
en: She's snapping at me all the time, and it's starting to take a toll on our relationship.

kok: Therapist: Nini bagwi jora belai kutuk hai ma tongjak kha.
en: Therapist: It sounds like this is a really difficult situation for you.

kok: Hamya naijaknaisa: Wse wngsugo. Tamo khwlai sinai ang saiman liya.
en: Client: It is. I don't know what to do.

kok: Ang abono twywi bobai kok sana naikha, phiya bo sakno kasojakma hai wngjago hakhe bo saphio angse bono buchiya pho hwnwi.
en: I've tried talking to her about it, but she just gets defensive and says that I'm not being understanding.

kok: Therapist: Ang buchiwi man kha nwng jolijak hwnwi.
en: Therapist: It's understandable that you're feeling frustrated.

kok: Buini jolimano yachak mani abo chaya kwlayo.
en: It's not easy to be on the receiving end of someone's anger.

kok: Salsa, khoroksa bwrwima sikli Sarah mungwi rwngkotor simi rwnwgthekajak wngkha kaisa yakhili bising bepari bai.
en: One day, a young woman named Sarah graduated from college with a degree in business.

kok: Bo belai tongthokjak bini tangmung chengma bwkhak, phiya bo daito no buchikha abo aswk 1 wngnani bwkhakya hwnwi.
en: She was excited to start her career, but she quickly realized that it wasn't going to be easy.

kok: Bo chwnwirok tangsamungrokni bagwi khlaikha, phiya bo kaisa kisa kokmalairok simi mano.
en: She applied for dozens of jobs, but she only got a few interviews.

kok: Tei ah kokmalairok bo manwi thangkha, bo kaisa yapharma simi manjakha.
en: And of the interviews she did get, she only received one offer.

kok: Ah samung yapharma karwi wngkha kaisa kisa-rwma tongthai kaisa company je bo kubuino ol manjakya.
en: The job offer was for a low-paying position at a company that she wasn't really interested in.

kok: Phiya bo ah tangsamung nakha tam hinmaba bo rang ajinani chengna bwkhak nangjakha.
en: But she took the job because she needed to start earning money.

kok: Sarah bini kwtal samungo bwkhak kutuk tangsamung khaikha, phiya bo tongthokjakya wngkha.
en: Sarah worked hard at her new job, but she was unhappy.

kok: Bono samungno chajakya, tei bo ah company no chajakya.
en: She didn't like the work, and she didn't like the company.

kok: Bo abono yakarnani bagwi wansukha, phiya bo kirijago je bo teikaisa tangsamung naitugwi mangwlak hwnwi.
en: She started to think about quitting, but she was afraid that she wouldn't be able to find another job.

kok: Salsa, Sarah ni okra boro bini habanok bisingo ringkha.
en: One day, Sarah's boss called her into his office.

kok: Bo bono sakha je bo belai bini saamung bai rikjak wngkha, tei bo bono kaisa remtisamung yapharkha.
en: He told her that he was impressed with her work, and he offered her a promotion.

kok: Sarah saktwikarjak wngkha.
en: Sarah was thrilled.

kok: Kaisa ah jottoni slai nangnukma kwchamkothomarok chasarwjakma bagwi wngkha je omo wngkha kaisa kwrwngjak tangsep.
en: One of the most common myths about improvement is that it is a linear process.

kok: Chwng sajakha je chwng homnino chinisaksakno chasama bwkhak bataimani wngno, je chwng pogwi phano chini tabukni tongrem bai khapungjak tawngdi hwnwi.
en: We are told that we should always be striving to improve ourselves, that we should never be satisfied with our current state.

kok: Ah kokkwcham wngkha uramuram phanbahrajak ah khothomarok bai chwng chinisaksakno khlaimanma bagwi samani.
en: This myth is often reinforced by the stories we tell ourselves about success.

kok: Chwng sajakha je ah khlaimannai borok wngkha ah khoroksa je mungsa wngphano yakarya, je homni bwkskang aguugwi thangwi.
en: We are told that the successful person is the one who never gives up, who always keeps moving forward.

kok: Phiya tumungno tamo oh kokkwcham chaya wngkha?
en: But what if this myth is wrong?

kok: Tumungno tamo chasarwjakma wngkha kaisa kwrwngjak tangsepya?
en: What if improvement is not a linear process?

kok: Tumungno tamo omo wngkha tei gurilaima, eba ahaino ubrumjabrum?
en: What if it is more cyclical, or even chaotic?

kok: Tumungno tamo aro jorarok tongo jephuru chwng yapri phirok nama bwkhak nango tei khatijak nama chwng tamo mankha, binislai karwi teibo homnino bataimani bagwi?
en: What if there are times when we need to step back and take stock of what we have achieved, rather than always striving for more?

kok: Ang poito khayo je omo wngkha teibo kubuikuk chasajakma nukmung.
en: I believe that this is a more realistic view of improvement.

kok: Chwng jottono borok, tei chwng jottono chaya khlaiyo.
en: We are all human, and we all make mistakes.

kok: Aro mohai jora phainai jephuru chwng phirok kwlaiyo, jephuru chwng chini saksakno sondeho wngo.
en: There will be times when we fall back, when we doubt ourselves.

kok: Phiya omo torrwna bagwi bo seprok wngkha.
en: But these are also opportunities for growth.

kok: Ah malkhungkolok tonthai wngkha kaisa thai boro borok phayo tei thango.
en: The railway station is a place where people come and go.

kok: Aro homnino borokrok dolaijak bohrokni malkhungkolokrokno romna bwkhak, tei kubunrok bohrokni hamjakma borokrokno sokpaima bagwi naisingmani karwi.
en: There are always people rushing to catch their trains, and others waiting for their loved ones to arrive.

kok: Omo wngkha kaisa thai loriya samung-humung, tei aro homnino mungsaswk naina bwkhak tongo.
en: It is a place of constant activity, and there is always something to see.

kok: Kaisa mwnwrok je nwng nugwi mano malkhungkoloklama tonthayo wngkha kaisa meme.
en: One of the things that you might see at a railway station is a meme.

kok: Memes wngkha mangpilirok eba videos wngkha je swiswrwngjak teie online bakjakma, uramuram bai kisisa swlaijakmarok.
en: Memes are images or videos that are copied and shared online, often with slight variations.

kok: Bohrok mwnwi kothok, kubui, eba jseshaphano kwchar bisingo wngwi mano.
en: They can be funny, serious, or anything in between.

kok: Ah malkhungkokol tonthai o, nwng memes nugwi mano berailaimani, malkhungkolok rokni bagwi naisingmani, ebaa kwtal borok rokbai malaimani.
en: At a railway station, you might see memes about traveling, waiting for trains, or meeting new people.

kok: Tei kaisa manwwi je nwng nugwi mano ah malkhungkolok tonthai kaisa khatinok nukganw.
en: Another thing that you might see at a railway station is a store.

kok: Aro haino nangnungya kaisa dalbidal tongo malkhungkoloklama tonthayo, suk suvidha khatinokrok, koktunbwlaih bachajaknai, tei bijap khatinokrok.
en: There are usually a variety of stores at a railway station, including convenience stores, newsstands, and bookstores.

kok: Oh khatinokrok dalbidal manwirok phalo, ahaino chahthai, koktunlaihrok, megazines, tei bijaprok.
en: These stores sell a variety of items, such as food, drinks, newspapers, magazines, and books.

kok: Ah malkhungkolok tonthai wngkha kaisa thai boro borok thansakhe phayo, tei omo wngkha kaisa thai boro jesamanwi phano wngwi mano.
en: The railway station is a place where people come together, and it is a place where anything can happen.

kok: Nwng kaisa meme nugwi mano, nwng kaisa chajaknai pai mano, eba nwng haino nini thinangni logisong bai malai mano.
en: You might see a meme, you might buy a snack, or you might even meet your future spouse.

kok: Sikla engineer, Erica, bo bini kwtal malkhung chongmari thayo samung khwlainani belaikhe tongthokjak.
en: The young engineer, Erica, was excited to start her new job at the automotive recruitment center.

kok: Bo homanino malkhung rokno belaikhe hamjago, tei bo swnamung rokno twywi teibo swrwngna muchungjago.
en: She had always been fascinated by cars, and she was eager to learn more about the industry.

kok: Bini puila salo, Erica bini naikolnai bono tangkhor rok berai phunukha.
en: On her first day, Erica was greeted by her manager, who gave her a tour of the center.

kok: Erica malkhung swnamkhor bwswk tor abono nugui belaikhe wanajakha.
en: Erica was amazed by the size of the facility, which was filled with rows of cars.

kok: Bo swrwngna mankha o swnamkhor tongmani bagwino kwtal kwtal borok kwbangkhe tichoknani mano o amchayo.
en: She learned that the center was responsible for recruiting new employees for all of the major automakers in the area.

kok: Erica kwtal engineer rokno tichokna bagwi tang bodolon samung chongjakha kaisa electric malkhung projectni bagwi.
en: Erica was assigned to a team that was working on recruiting engineers for a new electric vehicle project.

kok: Bo bini projectni samungno kodo khe samung tango, tei bo kwtal chuknai adongrokbai bo malaikha.
en: She was quickly up to speed on the project, and she was soon meeting with potential candidates.

kok: Khoroksa adongbai Erica Malaikha bini mungkhe David.
en: One of the candidates that Erica met was a young man named David.

kok: David bo mung gwnang rwngnokyungni engineer degree najak, tei bini electric malkhung swnam nani rwngmari belai kwbang tongo.
en: David had a degree in engineering from a top university, and he had a lot of experience working on electric vehicles.

kok: Erica Davidni elem tei yak milik rokno nugui belaikhe hamjakha, tei bo poito tongo bo tang bodolni cchuksuknai borokno wngnai hwnwi.
en: Erica was impressed by David's knowledge and skills, and she was confident that he would be a valuable asset to the team.

kok: Erica Davidno project o hapnani bagwibo kok khachop rwkha tei bo oro samung khwlai mankuknani borokno wngkha.
en: Erica eventually convinced David to join the project, and he was a huge success.

kok: Bo tangbodol rokno belaikhe chubachukha kwtal electric malkhung swnamna bagwi abobo kwkrwk twi paiwi manthoknai malkhung.
en: He helped the team to develop a new electric vehicle that was both efficient and affordable.

kok: Ah satungni kwchwng pohor hachingma sakao tola chwngwi tongkha, haching ni haching hapung paiphwlaiya mwchangmani bai.
en: The bright light of the sun shone down on the desert, illuminating the endless dunes of sand.

kok: Aswkno kubun pohorni yaphang athukrirok nokha bising simi phaimani, je hakchal ni simi jilikjalak wng tongkh.
en: The only other source of light came from the stars in the sky, which twinkled in the distance.

kok: Ah bwrwima niathok nokbar bising peplajak nukmung, bini khwnai kolok nokbar bising twi kokchokmani.
en: The vision of a beautiful woman appeared in the air, her long hair flowing in the wind.

kok: Bo kaisa kuphur ri kanmani jewels bising thukulupjak, tei bini bukur rok kothor banik hai wngkha.
en: She was wearing a white dress that was covered in jewels, and her skin was as fair as snow.

kok: Bo ano bini phukmnai khwrang mokolrok baia naisikha, tei ang kaisa sinai simanwi kwchangtotok ani sakao suklaima hai ang wansukha.
en: She looked at me with her piercing blue eyes, and I felt a sense of peace wash over me.

kok: Ang bono tangna bagwi sogwikha, phiya bo ani yaksirok bini bukuro kwthaiya huprena swkang kwmakha.
en: I reached out to touch her, but she vanished before my fingers could brush against her skin.

kok: Ang hachingma wo saichung bachajak khai khibwi kwlangjakha, uanamani tamo wngjakha hwnwi.
en: I was left standing alone in the desert, wondering what had just happened.

kok: Ang kaisa hama kolok nakha tei ani nokrapsao phirok himwi thangna chengkha, ah bwrwima naithok ang nukmani ani khorogo wansukmarokbai kupulung.
en: I took a deep breath and began to walk back to my camp, my mind filled with thoughts of the beautiful woman I had seen.

kok: Ang himkheno, ang wansukha bo ani bagwi kokmang da tamo.
en: As I walked, I thought about what she had meant to me.

kok: Bo wngkha khaisa khajamungni mari, kaisa muito narwkma je hayungni bising tabuk bo naithok tongkhu, ah mwnakjak jorarokni bising tabukbo.
en: She was a symbol of hope, a reminder that there was still beauty in the world, even in the darkest of times.

kok: Bo kaisa nukmung tamo wngwi man, tei ang swmai tangkha ang bono tei jesaphano wngwi bo pokya.
en: She was a vision of what could be, and I vowed to never forget her.

kok: Ang choyawui himkha, tei ang khaikheno, ah sal hapna chengkha.
en: I continued to walk, and as I did, the sun began to set.

kok: Buthup kainwi borokro bisira romwi naslewui phailaimani.
en: The two groups of people had been enemies for centuries.

kok: Bohrokni juda-juda togkwthar, juda-juda hokumu, tei juda-juda kokrok tongo.
en: They had different religions, different cultures, and different languages.

kok: Borok kwbangma choba bulaikha, tei jotto bwkhak kebengwi kubuni swmai tangwi satuklaima tongo.
en: They had fought many wars, and each side had committed atrocities against the other.

kok: Bohrokni naslelaimi belai kuthuk tei kwkhrak.
en: The hatred between them was deep and bitter.

kok: Salsa, bohrokni buthupni chwla sikla khoroksa bolongo himwi thangphuru bo jephuru tei kubuni buthupni bwrwi bai nuklaikha.
en: One day, a young man from one of the groups was walking through the forest when he came across a woman from the other group.

kok: Boh aphuru kwmajak tei kirijak wngkha.
en: She was lost and scared.

kok: Oh chwla sikla bono khairokjagwi tei bono bini nok lama phunuk thani chubakha.
en: The young man took pity on her and helped her find her way home.

kok: Bohrok thansakhe himlai tongphuru, bohrok kok sana chengkha tei khoroksa tei khoroksani thani swrwngkha.
en: As they traveled together, they began to talk and learn about each other.

kok: Bohrok saimankhe je bohrok aswkbo jotto bai pherlaiya.
en: They realized that they were not so different after all.

kok: Bohrok hamjak thanglaikha, tei bohrokni hamajakma bohrokni buthup kainwini bisingtwi chalaimani yakhwrai methepna bagwi chubachu khaikha.
en: They fell in love, and their love helped to bridge the gap between their two groups.

kok: Oh chwla sikla bai bwrwi ni hamjakma kothoma aswkhe kwrak phunukmari bahaikhe hamjak naslemano mechenrwi mano.
en: The young man and woman's love story was a powerful example of how love can overcome hate.

kok: Oro phunugo je jeswk kwkhrak naslemung phano hamjakma tei borom khoroksa tei khoroksani thani swrwngmano.
en: It showed that even the most bitter enemies can learn to love and respect each other.

kok: Jora kaisao Sarah mungwi khoroksa sikli tongmani, boh bini cycle chaloknani hamjakmani.
en: Once upon a time, there was a young woman named Sarah who loved to ride her bicycle.

kok: Kwbangkuk jorano boh nobar kaham tei saichung suta tongthok tongtwtwi, kami amchairogo hachal beraiui tongmani.
en: She would often go for long rides in the countryside, enjoying the fresh air and the freedom of being on her own.

kok: Salsa, Sarah bini bike chalok tongphuru boh Samsung phalnokni nukmari kaisa nugwi mankha.
en: One day, Sarah was riding her bike when she saw a sign for a Samsung store.

kok: Boh swrapsani bagwi bike kwtal thaisa naimani, haini bagwi boh bwthaknani tei nainani khachongkha.
en: She had been wanting a new bike for a while, so she decided to stop in and take a look.

kok: Oh phalnok judajuda bike bai kupulwng tongmani, phiya Sarah logilogino naithokkhe thepjak bikeni phaising mokol kwlaikha.
en: The store was full of all sorts of different bikes, but Sarah was immediately drawn to a beautiful folding bike.

kok: Obo heleng aluminiumbai swnamjak tei rikmaribo milik tongmani.
en: It was made of lightweight aluminum and had a sleek design.

kok: Sarah saimano je oh bike bini bagwino.
en: Sarah knew that this was the bike for her.

kok: Boh chalok naigrana bagwi oh bike nahakha, tei logilogino boh chajak thangkha tamoni hinkhe abo chaloknani belai kwlai tongmani.
en: She took the bike out for a test ride, and she was immediately impressed with how easy it was to ride.

kok: Oh bike belai kwrak tongmani, abobai obono khatinani kwlai wngkha.
en: The bike was also very compact, which made it easy to store.

kok: Sarah bini bike kwtalno twywi aswkno khatungjak je boh obo yang uyang chaloknani chengkha.
en: Sarah was so happy with her new bike that she started riding it everywhere.

kok: Boh obono bini habao, phalnogo, tei hatibar phaithago khakotorni samungo thangthani chalogo.
en: She rode it to work, to the grocery store, and even on her weekend adventures.

kok: Salsa, Sarah bini bike chalogwi habao thangphuru, borok dolsa Samsung-no kebengwi koktanwi tongmano nukha.
en: One day, Sarah was riding her bike to work when she saw a group of people protesting against Samsung.

kok: Ayanda Mapholoba o cabinetry swnamkhoro bisi 10 rwgwi samung khwlai phaimani.
en: Ayanda Mapholoba has been working in the cabinetry industry for over 10 years.

kok: Boni thani kuplwng naidal saithani kwrak rwngmari tongo, tei jotto goron tei torma rok nok bisingo cabinetrok thepathani bo kwrwng.
en: She has a wealth of experience in choosing, designing, and installing cabinets for homes of all shapes and sizes.

kok: O koksobo, bo bini khabisingni simari saui khwnarwkha bahaikhe nini nokni bagwi cabinet saina nang, tei bahaikhe saksakni chajakma hai naidalno bosop khwlainai.
en: In this article, she shares her insights on how to choose the right cabinets for your home, and how to incorporate some form of personalization into your design.

kok: Jephuru nwng nini nokni bagwi cabinetrok sayo, aro kisaswk manwi bwkhao muitu narwkthai tongo.
en: When choosing cabinets for your home, there are a few things you need to keep in mind.

kok: Puila, wansugwi nadi torma tei thai bwswk kuwar.
en: First, consider the size and layout of your space.

kok: Nwng wansugwi nana nangnai ah cabinet no nwng chongwi namani abo nini thai warmabai khapina nangnai tei abo nini samungo nangma haikhe cholina nangnai.
en: You need to make sure that the cabinets you choose will fit in your space and that they will be functional for your needs.

kok: Wainwi, nini nokni nuk gwrwngno twi wansuknaidi.
en: Second, think about the style of your home.

kok: Nwng hukumu bai kwrwngjak cabinet da nanani muchung, kwtal jorani cabinet eba mungsaswk aboni kwcharo.
en: Do you want traditional cabinets, modern cabinets, or something in between?

kok: Waisaswk nini lem kaham hwnkhe nwng je naimano, nwng cabinet painani chengwi mano.
en: Once you have a good idea of what you want, you can start shopping for cabinets.

kok: Nwng jephuru cabinet payo, juda juda brand tei nuk gwrwngbai sulaui nainani belai nangkuknai.
en: When you're shopping for cabinets, it's important to compare different brands and styles.

kok: Nwng wansugwi ma narwkthai buini kokphirokmung rokbo poriui naina nango juda juda borok rogo cabinet no twi tamo saui tong.
en: You should also read reviews to get an idea of what other people have to say about the cabinets you're considering.

kok: Phunukmung nogo thangwi bera'ui naikhebo kaham wngnai hwnba nwng sak saichung sinani bagwi.
en: It's also a good idea to visit a showroom so you can see the cabinets in person.

kok: Ang belai khatung khajak je chwng phaitago email kwrwngmung songchajak mankha.
en: I'm glad that we have finally established email contact.

kok: Ang khwnama je nwng khasrangjak kaisa lapsa swimanai bising ah kokkhak salaikok bormanjak kokmarirok sakao.
en: I've heard that you're interested in writing a piece on the topic of sensitive subjects.

kok: Ang wansukha je kaisa kotor kuar uansukma, tei ang chubana tongthokjak jesa lama twi je ang khai mansak.
en: I think that's a great idea, and I'm happy to help out in any way that I can.

kok: Kaisa bormanjak kokmari je ang chongjakma khamuchungjak baagwi wngkha ah kalaima olo malaimani ongkhorma twi.
en: One sensitive subject that I'm particularly passionate about is the issue of dating after divorce.

kok: Ang saksakno kaisa kakalai thwih thangjak, tei ang saimano bahai omo tei waisa malaimani chengma bwkhak wngwi mano.
en: I've been through a divorce myself, and I know how difficult it can be to start dating again.

kok: Aro wngkha kaisa kwbang khanangjak bai lenden khainani, tei omo kaisa kwrak saimanna bwkha wngmano boro ni simi chengnani.
en: There are a lot of emotions to deal with, and it can be hard to know where to start.

kok: Ang wansukha je ah belai nangkukma manwi wngkha ninisaksak bai kwchang wngnani.
en: I think that the most important thing is to be patient with yourself.

kok: Nini kakalaima simi hamna bwkhak thangkhe omo jora nanai, tei nwng phatsakhe malaina bwkhak tiyar wng thangya khu.
en: It's going to take time to heal from your divorce, and you're not going to be ready to date right away.

kok: Jephuru nwng tei waisa malaina chengo, nini sakrak logisongrok bai nini tonghalok bagwi tongkwthar bwkhak omo nangkukma.
en: When you do start dating again, it's important to be honest with your potential partners about your situation.

kok: Bohrok saimanthwng je nwng laithangnayo kakjak, tei je nwng tabukbo baksa manwirok bising samung khai tongo.
en: Let them know that you're recently divorced, and that you're still working through some things.

kok: Omo bo nangkukma ninisaksak ni bagwiarirok kaihmam bwkhak.
en: It's also important to set boundaries for yourself.

kok: Nwng kaisa holokbokma bising go thangna muchungya je nini bagwi belai khamunsukmani thangwi mano.
en: You don't want to get into a relationship that's going to be too overwhelming for you.

kok: Sakduk rwng hwnkhe vital babai wngkha sakdukni langma tongdal.
en: Health education is a vital part of a healthy lifestyle.

kok: Ang borokno swrwngthani chubai mano nangkuma sakdukni chamani, sakswnam, te kasui manai naitwi.
en: It can help people learn about the importance of healthy eating, exercise, and preventive care.

kok: Sakduk rwng borokrokno buchina bagwi chubai mano bahaikhe byadikwchah bemarni tei kokthumajak chongthani bohrokni bagwi sakduk swnamkha.
en: Health education can also help people understand how to manage chronic diseases and make informed decisions about their health.

kok: Kwbangma rwngnokrok sakduk rwng rwngrem bohrokni porichapmung babai yapharo.
en: Many schools offer health education classes as part of their curriculum.

kok: Oh rwngrem swrwngnai rokno phwrwngmanu dalbidal sakduk kokkhak salaikokno twi, bolimung khobwunai, sakni kok tangmung, tei bokhwrwi kekraima.
en: These classes can teach students about a variety of health topics, including nutrition, physical activity, mental health, and substance abuse.

kok: Sakduk rwng rwngremrok swrwngnairokno chubai mano loiungmani sakdukni hamkrayo je bohrok kakham khai sikla sogwi bohrokni logi twlang thanganw.
en: Health education classes can also help students develop healthy habits that they will carry with them into adulthood.

kok: Jora rwmung bai rwngno selengsa sakduk rwng, kwbangma hoda motharok sakduk rwng pandarok yapharkha.
en: In addition to school-based health education, many community organizations offer health education programs.

kok: Oh pandani borokno kokthuma bagwi mano dalbidal sakduk kokhak salaikokno twi, tei bohrok twichuruma bo yapharwi mano tei tanglam borokni bagwi je bohrokni langmarokno sakduk swlaimani bai chaitogwiw swnammani.
en: These programs can provide people with information about a variety of health topics, and they can also offer support and resources for people who are trying to make healthy changes in their lives.

kok: Sakduk rwng belaino nangkukmani khatimung saksani sakdukno twi tei hoda rokni.
en: Health education is an important investment in the health of individuals and communities.

kok: Borokrokno elem bagma bai tei yaksraini bohrok sakduk chongmanino swnamna nango, sakduk rwng bemar rokno kati thani chubai mano, sakduk hamrio, tei takduk naitwi swkrok khairwi mano.
en: By providing people with the knowledge and skills they need to make healthy choices, health education can help to prevent disease, improve health, and reduce health care costs.

kok: Chasalo, oroni hoda thai kengjak sakduk rwng rwngkok yapharo sakduk chamung kokkhak salaikokno twi.
en: On Saturday, the local community center offered a free health education seminar on the topic of healthy eating.

kok: Rwngnokrok dalbidal borok, chakrarok khobwinai, chwrairok, tei okrarok manjakphaikha.
en: The seminar was attended by a variety of people, including adults, children, and seniors.

kok: Ang bisirok karwi luku laisujakma phwnangwi phayo, tei ang ah jora bising kaisa kwbangma swlaimarok nukha.
en: I've been using public transportation for years, and I've seen a lot of changes in that time.

kok: Ah kasama-bakmani apps kasamung Uber tei Lyft kahai omonno teibo borokni bagwi chasujak swnamkha yaksiyagra manma bwkhak malkhung naharya karwi.
en: The rise of ride-sharing apps like Uber and Lyft has made it more convenient for people to get around without having to own a car.

kok: Haiphanom omo ah luku laisujaknai phwnangma bising kaisa paihma bwkhak twlang thango.
en: However, this has also led to a decline in the use of public transportation.

kok: Ani doyung bising, ah luku laisujaknai tangdal wngkha aswk belai kahamya.
en: In my city, the public transportation system is not very good.

kok: Ah busmalkhungrok uramuram keler wngkha, tei ah relmalkhungrok wngkha kuthumjak.
en: The buses are often late, and the trains are crowded.

kok: Omo swnamo yaksiyagra manna bwkhak, kahamkhai doi thangma dam wngjora.
en: This makes it difficult to get around, especially during rush hour.

kok: Omoni thaihmung, kwbangma borok chalukna chongmani bwkhak wngkha luku laisujaknai namani karwi.
en: As a result, many people are choosing to drive instead of taking public transportation.

kok: Ang wansukha je ah paihma luku laisujaknai bising wngkhak kaisa kebengmung.
en: I think that the decline in public transportation is a problem.

kok: Luku laisujaknai wngkha kaisa nangkuma bokcho doyungni infrastructure, tei omo thahnglaiso kesepjak tei sitrawmani khaina bwkhak chubai mano.
en: Public transportation is an important part of a city's infrastructure, and it helps to reduce traffic congestion and pollution.

kok: Ang poito khayo je chwng luku laisujaknaino teibo sotonmannai swnamna bwkhak nango borokrokni bagwi teibo poitognang tei paimanani bwkhak swnamani bai.
en: I believe that we need to make public transportation more attractive to people by making it more reliable and affordable.

kok: Kaisa lama bwkhak omo khainani bwkhak ah kwlwipramari busmalkhung rok tei relmalkhungrok bangrwi mano.
en: One way to do this would be to increase the frequency of buses and trains.

kok: Omo borokni bagwi yaksiyagra manma bwkhak kwlaikhe swnam jago, tei omo ah thikhemung jora bo khairwi mano je bohrok kasana bagwi naisingma bwkhak.
en: This would make it easier for people to get around, and it would also reduce the amount of time that people have to wait for a ride.

kok: Jora kaisao, kamisa kaisa bwsate tongmani pizza kothok chamungni bagwi sinijago.
en: Once upon a time, there was a small village that was known for its delicious pizza.

kok: O kamini borokrok pizza chamungni bagwi belaikheno kung chukjakbayo te bohrok kahamkhe naikolwi swnamlayo.
en: The villagers were very proud of their pizza, and they took great care in making it.

kok: Bohrok kwthang kwchwng mwikwthwng tei jora kolok naiui pizza no belai kaham khe swnamlayo.
en: They used only the freshest ingredients, and they took their time to make sure that the pizza was cooked perfectly.

kok: Salsa, siniya borok khoroksa phaiwi sokphayo.
en: One day, a stranger came to the village.

kok: Bo khoroksa faraway thaini beraikhiri khwlainaise. bo kamini pizza kothokno twywi kok khwnajak.
en: He was a traveler from a faraway land, and he had heard stories about the village's pizza.

kok: Bo o chamungno chaui nainani belaino muchungjago mungsa wanayaui.
en: He was eager to try it, and he was not disappointed.

kok: O pizza belaino kothok tei o sinijakya borok belaikhe hamjakha. bo wansukha o kamiono tongsinai hwnwi.
en: The pizza was delicious, and the stranger was so impressed that he decided to stay in the village for a while.

kok: O sinijakya borok kwbangma manwino twywi swrwngkha bo kamio tongphru.
en: The stranger learned a lot about the village while he was there.

kok: Bo borok rokni laibuma, hukumu mukumu tei bohrokni tong gwrwngni lam rokno swrwngkha.
en: He learned about the people's history, their culture, and their way of life.

kok: O pizza bwswk joratwi nangkukmani o kamio abono twywi bo sinani mankha.
en: He also learned about the importance of pizza in the village.

kok: O pizza alaida chamungni slaibo borom rwjago o kamio tei o pizza bohrokni kamini hukumu mukumuni sinimung rwo.
en: Pizza was more than just a food to the villagers; it was a symbol of their culture and their heritage.

kok: O sinijakya bor o kamini borok wngna muchungjago. oroni hukumu lam tei luku tongmung rokno kahamkhe swrwngkha.
en: The stranger was honored to be a part of the village, and he learned a lot about the importance of tradition and community.

kok: Oh yaar, nwng ah kwtal kubuiya siyan bagwi da khwnankha je nini muchungsama khanangjakrok borok kahai mano?
en: Hey man, have you heard about the new artificial intelligence that can express emotions like a human being?

kok: Kubuino, omo adamlang haiyada?
en: It's crazy, right?

kok: Ang kokma, omo kahaiya omo kubuino sinaiwansukma eba jesamanwi, phiya omo tabukbo naithok kolopjakma wngkha.
en: I mean, it's not like it's really sentient or anything, but it's still pretty impressive.

kok: Ani wansukma omo kaisa kwbang koibwlaihrok ah thinangni bising tongwi mano, painai borok suarimung bagwi kahai eba ahaino ah kerong thong bising.
en: I think it could have a lot of applications in the future, like for customer service or even in the military.

kok: Phiya nwng saimano kubuio tamo sikrima?
en: But you know what's really scary?

kok: Kubuio je sikrinairok oh tansep auaima bwkhak phwnang mano bohrokni tangbokhrwi te kwtal logisong bhorti khaima.
en: The fact that terrorists could use this technology to spread their propaganda and recruit new members.

kok: Ani kokma, khachongmung tumungno bohrok videorok swnam mano je nukma tei khwnama kahai bohrok kubui borok bai swnamma tongjak, phiya kubuio kaisa computer bai haino achairwjak wngkha.
en: I mean, imagine if they could create videos that looked and sounded like they were made by real people, but were actually just being generated by a computer.

kok: Abo kubuino tikhlaina bwkhak kuthuk wngwi mano, tei amo jotto dalbidal tatalrok tei naslema kokmung auaima bwkhak phwnangjakma wngmano.
en: That would be really hard to detect, and it could be used to spread all kinds of lies and hate speech.

kok: Ang amtwi samaniya je chwng siyan kubuiya eba jesamanwi rosana nango, phiya chwng sraisrai sijak wngna nango ah khotoma khapharmarok bwkhak.
en: I'm not saying that we should ban artificial intelligence or anything, but we definitely need to be aware of the potential risks.

kok: Chwng wngkubui swnamna bwkhak nango je oh tansep wngkha kahamni bagwi phwnangkha, tei hamya ni bagwiya.
en: We need to make sure that this technology is used for good, and not for evil.

kok: Haiphano, aborok haini nai kanwi rarok se.
en: Anyway, that's just my two cents.

kok: "Nwng waisa phano hapung saka da kasakhaa?" ang ani rwngswrwngnai rokno swngkha.
en: "Have you ever climbed a mountain?" I asked my students.

kok: "Amo kaisa mlangchamani wansukmani hayung sakao bachama bwkhak, bini tola ni jottomanwi naimani.
en: "It's an amazing feeling to stand on top of the world, looking down at everything below you.

kok: Ah nokbar wngkha ste tei crisp, ah sal chwngsamani, tei ah nukmung wngkha hamanajaknai.
en: The air is thin and crisp, the sun is shining, and the view is breathtaking.

kok: Phiya omobo samung kutuk.
en: But it's also hard work.

kok: Nwng sakno twywi chukjak tei khapangjak kwrak wngna nango omo ah kuchuk sogwina hwnkhe.
en: You have to be physically fit and mentally tough to make it to the top.

kok: Ang muitiomankha ah puila jora ang bapung saka kasamani.
en: I remember the first time I climbed a mountain.

kok: Omo talbung bising wngkha tei ah salbar wngkha kwchang tei nokbarsibsib.
en: It was in November, and the weather was cold and windy.

kok: Ang jotto kisa srapsarok bathakgwwi ani hama romna nagno.
en: I had to stop every few minutes to catch my breath.

kok: Phiya choliwui thangkha, tei paithago ang ah bochlongo sogwikha.
en: But I kept going, and eventually I reached the summit.

kok: Ano wngkha kaisa uanamasingsaa uansukmani.
en: It was an incredible feeling.

kok: Ang uansukha ang jesaphano khai mano.
en: I felt like I could do anything.

kok: Khajani Sonya, ang kha khwlayo, oh titun manphuru nwng kaham kwrwngno tongo.
en: Dear Sonya, I hope this letter finds you well.

kok: Ang nono chini nukhungni khamparni simi swiui tongo, je khamparo taklai hukbar bwthaih kaham wngkha.
en: I am writing to you from our family farm, where the harvest has been good this year.

kok: Hukbar bwthaih kwbang wngma bagwi chwng belai kha hamjak, tei jerokni belai nangkukma tongo bohrokni thani tunsamungno sraisrai khwlaina bagwi chwng samung kwrak tangwi tongo.
en: We are grateful for the bountiful crops, and we are working hard to ensure that they are distributed to those who need them most.

kok: Nwng sainomano, chahthaih thaihrwmung kaisa kutuk jwngjal.
en: As you know, food production is a complex issue.

kok: Ha, twi, tei kubun rwbai manthokmano khobwi chahthaih thaihrwmung bangmario logirwui mannai abohai kwbangma pher tongo.
en: There are many factors that contribute to the rate at which food is produced, including the availability of land, water, and other resources.

kok: Kisa swkang bisirogo, hayung gwnangwi borok bangmari doui bangwi tongo, abobai chini nangma supungthani nangmani chahthaih thaihrwmungo chini chukphan-no sinwi tongkha.
en: In recent years, the global population has been growing rapidly, which has put a strain on our ability to produce enough food to meet the demand.

kok: O kebengmungno kasunani kaisa lam wngkha kaisa chahthai tangraida kwrak swnammung.
en: One way to address this challenge is to build sustainable food systems.

kok: Chahthai tangraida kwrak wngkha thinang achaisong bohrokni nangmano supungthani chukphanbai muthupjakyaui tabukni nangma supungthani chukma.
en: Sustainable food systems are those that are able to meet the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs.

kok: Oboni kokmang wngkha chahthai tangraida kwrak tongkhortwi kaham, ranghaloktwi chuknai tei hoda haloktwi kubui wngnani nangnai.
en: This means that sustainable food systems must be environmentally sound, economically viable, and socially just.

kok: Oro chini khamparo, chwng bithi sapulyani lamno rwksaui, twi khatiui tei chini carbon yapaimarino khaikwlaiui kaisa chahthai tangraida kwrak swnamui tisanani samung tangwi tongo.
en: Here on our farm, we are working to build a sustainable food system by using organic farming practices, conserving water, and reducing our carbon footprint.

kok: Chwng amchaini chahnairokbai manjumungni bagwibo samung khwlai tongo, abobai chwng sidasidi bohrokno chini manwi phalwiman tongo.
en: We are also working to connect with local consumers so that we can sell our produce directly to them.

kok: Susan, nono titun swiui manma abo boromni.
en: Susan, It's an honor to be writing to you.

kok: Ang bisichi kwbang romwi nini samungno lobwi tongo, tei kha baimano twywi nini swimungno ang belaikhe naithokjago.
en: I've been a fan of your work for decades, and I'm particularly interested in your writing on depression.

kok: Ang uansukmani tumung nwng "khabaima" kokthaini dalbidal thepamano twywi nini uansukmung bagoi mankha hinkhe tei laithangnai kisaswk bisichio obo bahaikhe swlaijakha.
en: I'm wondering if you could share your thoughts on the different applications of the term "depression," and how it's changed over the past few decades.

kok: Ang uansugo, o kokno gosiui chengsanani nangkugo je khabaima kaisa kutuk tei hamung siniya bemar.
en: I think it's important to start by acknowledging that depression is a complex and multifaceted disorder.

kok: Genetics, borokni gwrwng, langmani patimung tei sak halokno khobwi khabaimao logirwui mannai abohai kwbangma pher tongo.
en: There are many different factors that can contribute to depression, including genetics, personality traits, life events, and medical conditions.

kok: Wngmung obobai je, khabaimungni saknaithani jottoni bagwi dalsa wnglami mungsa khropsa raida kwrwi.
en: As a result, there is no one-size-fits-all approach to treating depression.

kok: O kok sajago, abohai kisaswk kok bothoma tongo je chwng jephuru khabaimano twywi salayo aphuru nukjagwi phayo.
en: That said, there are some common themes that emerge when we talk about depression.

kok: Kaisa wngkha je khabaimano moji kisa, anhedonia (tangnani muchungma kwrwi), tei lengma-baikhe yasi kaijago.
en: One is that depression is often characterized by a low mood, anhedonia (loss of interest in activities), and fatigue.

kok: Teikaisa wngkha khabaima khoroksa borokni langmao, bohrokni samung tangnani, rwngnogo thangnani, tei halok romwi narwknani chukphanni kwcharo bwchaiui judakukkhe swlaimung kaisa tubuimano.
en: Another is that depression can have a significant impact on a person's life, interfering with their ability to work, go to school, and maintain relationships.

kok: Laithangnai kisaswk bisichio, khabaimano twywi hojak wngmung twrwk twrwk bangwi tongo.
en: In the past few decades, there has been a growing awareness of depression.

kok: Tamoni hinkhe obo bwkhak kaisatwi bemarni sakao phuarjak amjok naitugo, obai baksa lukurok khapang bemarno twywi kok salayo.
en: This is due in part to the increased research on the disorder, as well as the growing public discourse about mental health.

kok: Ah 2006 chaslok mwnwikothok bo chwla wngkha, Amanda Bynes Viola Hastings thwngma, kaisa kuchuk rwngnok swrngnai je saksak no khoroksa chwla haikhe sakhwima ah chwlarokni bising thwngna bwkhak ah yakung thwngmung thwngdol bagwi.
en: In the 2006 teen comedy She's the Man, Amanda Bynes plays Viola Hastings, a high school student who disguises herself as a boy in order to play on the boys' soccer team.

kok: Ah toke wngkha sotonwi mwnwima mukphliksa kuplung, kubuino mwnwi kothok soithayo joramari tei tunphaima bagwi Bynes no hambai rio.
en: The film is full of laugh-out-loud moments, thanks to Bynes's spot-on comedic timing and delivery.

kok: Bo chasukjak chopma bwkhak phario ah lachimansinsa tei chongmanaya khoroksa chaslokjora chwla wngkha, jephuru tabukbo bini sakni manthoky moji brand tonimani.
en: She is able to perfectly capture the awkwardness and uncertainty of a teenage boy, while still maintaining her own unique brand of humor.

kok: Ah twichurumani swpungma bo kahamkuk wngkha, Channing Tatum, Laura Ramsey, tei Vinnie Jonens jotto naraknai performances rimani.
en: The supporting cast is also excellent, with Channing Tatum, Laura Ramsey, and Vinnie Jones all giving memorable performances.

kok: Ah tokeni director, Andy Fickmam, kaisa kotor kuar samung khaikha ah moji no thungnuk ojonmani, kaisa toke swnammani je kainwino mwnwikothok tei bwkhathaihmani.
en: The film's director, Andy Fickman, does a great job of balancing the humor with the drama, creating a film that is both funny and heartwarming.

kok: Bo chwla wngkha kaisa kwcham chaslok mwnwikothok je wngkhak wngkubui ah tongdal fans no khaphurma bwkhak.
en: She's the Man is a classic teen comedy that is sure to please fans of the genre.

kok: Bynes ni performance wngkha kaisa standout, tei ah toke wngkha sotnwi mwnwima mukpliksa kuplung.
en: Bynes's performance is a standout, and the film is full of laugh-out-loud moments.

kok: Tumungno nwng kaisa tongthok tei thothokmani toke naina bwkhak naiwui tongkhe, ang naichumnani kuchukkhai sakhlayo bo chwla wngkhano.
en: If you're looking for a fun and entertaining movie to watch, I highly recommend checking out She's the Man.

kok: Jora rwmung bising kaisa kotor kuar mwmwikothok wngjak bwkhak, bo chwla wngkha omo kaisa toke kaisa kwrak kotun bai sir thansa bagwi.
en: In addition to being a great comedy, She's the Man is also a film with a strong message about gender equality.

kok: Violani chongmanai bosaksakno chwla haikhe sakhwima chwla rokni yakung thwwngmung thwngdol o thwngna bagwi wngkha kaisa phangwnang sakhlaimung ah nangkukma sir stereotypes swbaimani bagwi.
en: Viola's decision to disguise herself as a boy in order to play on the boys' soccer team is a powerful statement about the importance of breaking down gender stereotypes.

kok: Oh toke phunugo je bwrwirok thwngmungo rogo chwlarok haino kaham wngwi mano, tei abo bohrok bohrokni sir bai ukuluk tanarakjakdi.
en: The film shows that girls can be just as good as boys at sports, and that they should not be held back by their gender.

kok: Nokbar-uatwirok wngkha kaisa bebak swngchar gwnangwi wngmang tongo, tei aborok chini langmarogo kaisa nangkukma mári buwi máno.
en: Rainstorms are a common occurrence in many parts of the world, and they can have a significant impact on our lives.

kok: Aborok há kwran no nangkugwi tongmani twino tubuwi mánno, phiyaba aborokbo twilomrwi, harpek há kakhwlairwi tei kubun hamyarok khaimáno.
en: They can bring much-needed water to parched land, but they can also cause flooding, mudslides, and other damage.

kok: Nokbar-uatwi phaimani abo nokbar kutung bangmani bagwise, abobai twihokuno swkan swnamo tei chumui wngo.
en: Rainstorms are caused by the rising of warm air, which causes water vapor to condense and form clouds.

kok: Jephuru chumuirogo twi thoprok belai hiligo, abo uatwi wngwi kwlayo.
en: When the water droplets in the clouds become too heavy, they fall as rain.

kok: Nokbar-Uatwi o Uatwi bwswkrok kwlai abo inchi bai sujago.
en: The amount of rain that falls in a rainstorm is measured in inches.

kok: Bangthaya nokbar-uatwirok hwnkhe haino kisisa inchi uatwi uarwi mano, phiya hilik nokbar-uatwi khe kwbang footrok phano uarwi mano.
en: A light rainstorm might produce only a few inches of rain, while a heavy rainstorm can produce over a foot of rain.

kok: Nokbar-uatwi chini langmao kwbangma wngmungrok patirwi mano.
en: Rainstorms can have a variety of effects on our lives.

kok: Aborok baijak tei sitrarokno twlangwi, lamarok tei yakunglamarokno bármanya swnamo.
en: They can wash away dirt and debris, making roads and sidewalks impassable.

kok: Aborokbo pherangno phairwya tei twino lomrwi mano.
en: They can also cause power outages and flooding.

kok: Twi-lomani abo belaikhe kirima singchá wngwi mano, abo borokrokno tei manwi khwnwino daktino kochokrwi twlang máno.
en: Flooding can be especially dangerous, as it can quickly sweep away people and property.

kok: Kwbangma phaithothok kebengmungrok tongphano, Nokbar-uatwi kaisa hamkraibo wngwi mano.
en: Despite the potential dangers, rainstorms can also be beneficial.

kok: Aborok hano kaham wngrwrwk swnamo tei bhuphang-uaphangrokno twi nangmano rwo.
en: They can help to improve soil quality and water the plants.

kok: Nokbar-uatwi bo borokrokno kaisa tongthoknani lama phunugo, tamni hwnba bororok tongthokjago uatwino nainani tei pherangno khwnanani.
en: Rainstorms can also be a source of entertainment, as people enjoy watching the rain and listening to the thunder.

kok: Kwdwkma jora romwi, aro chwrai khoroksa mung Juan hwnwi tongo je tacos hamjago.
en: Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Juan who loved tacos.

kok: Bo bohrokno amswk khe hamjago je bo phungbaili o bo chao, sajarchahmung tei horchahmung.
en: He loved them so much that he would eat them for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

kok: Salsa, Juan's ni buma bini bagwi mahmlai taco swnamna hwnwi chongkha.
en: One day, Juan's mother decided to make him a special taco.

kok: Bo bini jotto chajakma sraimanwi supungkha: musuk bahan ha, lettuce, tomatoes, cheese, tei kwkhwi cream.
en: She filled it with all of his favorite ingredients: ground beef, lettuce, tomatoes, cheese, and sour cream.

kok: Juan bini taco no twi belai tongthokjak je bo kisasa chana bagwi naisingjak.
en: Juan was so excited for his taco that he could barely wait to eat it.

kok: Jephuru Juan bini taco no paithak o warkha, bo mlangchakha abo bwswk kothok hwnwi.
en: When Juan finally took a bite of his taco, he was amazed at how delicious it was.

kok: Muihan ni thokma, mwikhwtwng, tei jotto cheese chasujak manjugwi chaimani swnamjakmani je Juan swkangni simi thinang teiya saimanya.
en: The flavors of the meat, vegetables, and cheese all combined perfectly to create a taste that Juan had never experienced before.

kok: Bo bini taco jotto digi twi warwi chakha, tei bo bini buma no tei kaisa swnamdi hwnwi swngkha.
en: He ate every bite of his taco, and then he asked his mother to make him another one.

kok: Juan's ni buma markhe tongthokjakha bini bagwi tei kaisa taco swnama bagwi, tei bo bono ganti nogo chubana bagwi logi rwkha.
en: Juan's mother was happy to make him another taco, and she even let him help her in the kitchen.

kok: Juan swrwngkha bahaikhe sraimanwi sunani, tei bahai khe muihan songnai, tei taco bahai khe thumsa khainai.
en: Juan learned how to measure the ingredients, how to cook the meat, and how to assemble the tacos.

kok: Bo bini buma no chubawui bwswk se tongthojak je bo chongkha je bo chef wngna muchungjago jephuru bo torkhe.
en: He had so much fun helping his mother that he decided that he wanted to be a chef when he grew up.

kok: Juan choyai bini tacos no chwraiphangwi simi kwrwngwi hamjagwi phai o.
en: Juan continued to love tacos throughout his childhood.

kok: Bo bohrokno nogo chao, rwngnogo, tei chahnogo.
en: He ate them at home, at school, and at restaurants.

kok: Omo ni kokmung hwnkhe je rwngsrwngnairok kwsrangwi tangrwkha tangraida twi halok muitokhwlaimani bohrok tamo khwnakha.
en: This means that students should be actively engaged in the process of remembering what they have heard.

kok: Bohrok haino khakwlaikhe lem khwnana simiya, phiya kwsrangwi wanksuknani bagwi bohrok tamo khwnai tong tei muito khainani chaitokmani bai tongna nango.
en: They should not simply be passive listeners, but should be actively thinking about what they are hearing and trying to remember it.

kok: Aro kwbangma lama lombor tongo sijak mukumu samung khatungrimung bwkhak khwnamani sirwkmung phwrwng bwchap bisingtwi.
en: There are a number of ways to encourage conscious memory work in listening comprehension lessons.

kok: Kaisa lama hwnkhe teisa samani phwnangwi mano.
en: One way is to use repetition.

kok: Omo rwngswrwngnairokno hainohai dalkwbang joratwi passage khwnarimani bwkhak khaimano, eba bohrokno kaisa passage dalkwbang joratwi sotonwi porirwi mano.
en: This can be done by having students listen to the same passage multiple times, or by having them read a passage aloud multiple times.

kok: Teisa samani rwngswrwngnairokni' kokthum bising mukumurokno thepam bwwkha chubamarok.
en: Repetition helps to fix the information in students' memories.

kok: Tei kaisa sijak mukumu samung khatungrimung bwkhak lama hwnkhe rwngswrwngnai rokno samarirok khwlai naraknani jephuru bohrok khwnai tongphuru.
en: Another way to encourage conscious memory work is to have students take notes while they are listening.

kok: Omo bohrokno sakphanwi saktongma rwma bwkhak bohrok tamo khwnai tong tei omoni bagwi wansukdi je tamo nangkukma.
en: This forces them to pay attention to what they are hearing and to think about what is important.

kok: Rwngswrwngnairok no kaisa kokbwkrai swina bagwi swjkak mano bohrok je khwnamani.
en: Students can also be asked to write down a summary of what they have heard.

kok: Omo bohrokno chubao kokthum no kwrwngsa khaini borokgni khorogo tei teibo amjokthaitwi muito khairimani.
en: This helps them to organize the information in their minds and to remember it more effectively.

kok: Tei samani bwkhak jora rwmung tei samari-namani, aro kubun tangsep lombor wngkha je sijak mukumu samung bising sirwkmung phwrng bwkchaprok khwnamnai khatungrimung bwkha phwnangjagwi mano.
en: In addition to repetition and note-taking, there are a number of other strategies that can be used to encourage conscious memory work in listening comprehension lessons.

kok: Omo rwngswrwngnairokni swhngmungrok bohrok tamo khwnakha bagwi khobwi swngmani, bohrok khoroksa teimasa bai passage salaima bagwi manwimano, bohrok ni sakni graphic kwrwngnairok kokthum no adong wngma twi bohrokbai swnam manmani.
en: These include asking students questions about what they have heard, having them discuss the passage with each other, and having them create their own graphic organizers to represent the information.

kok: Kaisa juda tangsep halok phwnangwi, rwngphwrwngnairok rwngswrwngnairokno hamrw bwkha chubai mano bohrokni sirwkmung yaksrairok khwnawui tei teibo amjokthaijak swrwngmarok wngthango.
en: By using a variety of strategies, teachers can help students to develop their listening comprehension skills and to become more effective learners.

kok: Jora kaisao, Omar mungwi khoroksa hukbar khwlainai sikla tongmani, boh bolong naro khungsa kami bwsao tongwi tongmani.
en: Once upon a time, there was a young farmer named Omar who lived in a small village on the edge of a forest.

kok: Omar kheto-o samung tangnani tei bini hukbar bwthaihno naikani khwlainani hamjago, phiya boh bolong naituk berainabo hamjago.
en: Omar loved to work in the fields and tend to his crops, but he also loved to explore the forest.

kok: Salsa, Omar bolong naituk berai tongmani aphuru boh sapsutra thai kaisa mankha.
en: One day, Omar was exploring the forest when he came across a clearing.

kok: Sapsutra thaini kwcharo buphang kotor phangsa tongmani, tei buphang buchugo rangchakni apple thaisa tongmani.
en: In the middle of the clearing was a large tree, and at the top of the tree was a golden apple.

kok: Omar saimankha je oh rangchakni apple wngkha bolongni yakpai, tei boh buphang saka kasaui abono khaknani swmai tangkha.
en: Omar knew that the golden apple was a gift from the forest, and he vowed to climb the tree and retrieve it.

kok: Omar buphango kasanani chaitokkha, phiya abo buphang belai kolok tongmani.
en: Omar tried to climb the tree, but it was too tall.

kok: Boh apple phaising holong khitarnani chaitokkha, phiya aborok belai bwsa bwsa tongmani.
en: He tried to throw rocks at the apple, but they were too small.

kok: Boh yakhilik kaisa swnamnanibo chaitokkha, phiya abo nangmaswk kolok tongmania.
en: He even tried to build a ladder, but it wasn't tall enough.

kok: Omar jephuru magwlakkha hwnwi khachongo, aphuru boh khorang thaisa khwnakha, "Ang nono chubaui mano, " oh khorang sao.
en: Just when Omar was about to give up, he heard a voice "I can help you," the voice said.

kok: Omar uphilwi bwchakha tei buikhumu gwnang bwsate mal masa nukha.
en: Omar turned around and saw a small, furry creature.

kok: Oh malni mokol kotor tei khitung kolok tongmani, "nwng sabo?" Omar swngkha.
en: The creature had big eyes and a long tail "Who are you?" Omar asked.

kok: "Ang masa mandar, " o mal sakha. "Tei ang nono rangchakni apple manthani chubaui mano."
en: "I'm a squirrel," the creature said. "And I can help you get the golden apple."

kok: Oh mandar Omarno kisaswk bwlaih tei uaphisarok thumnani sakha.
en: The squirrel told Omar to gather some leaves and sticks.

kok: Kaisa jorani kok, aro khoroksa chwrai chikonsa Mara mungwi tongo je porima hamjago.
en: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mara who loved to read.

kok: Bo jesaphano porio bini yago mankhe, mwtaijak khothomarok simi saktwikhajak kothomrok bwkhak laihbuma mukbwkhal jora.
en: She would read anything she could get her hands on, from fairy tales to adventure stories to historical novels.

kok: Bo ah lama hamjakha je porimani bono kubun hayungrok bwkhak twlangmani tei bono kwtak manwirok phwrwngo ah bini hayung yaksiyagrani bagwi.
en: She loved the way that reading could transport her to other worlds and teach her new things about the world around her.

kok: Salsa, Mara bijap kaisa pori tongmani kaisa hakchalma hani bagwi jephuru bo kaisa passage bwkhak sokphaikha je kaisa nukmlang kwrwng bijapnok swbaikhrupjak sama.
en: One day, Mara was reading a book about a faraway land when she came across a passage that described a magical library.

kok: Ah bijapnok jottojora swijak jotto bijap tongma bwkhak sajakha, tei omo sajakha je jebamasa je ah bijapnokno naitukmano kaisa muchungma rwjak soijak mano.
en: The library was said to contain every book ever written, and it was said that anyone who could find the library would be granted one wish.

kok: Mara ah bijapnok naitukna bwkhak khathonjak wngkha, haini bagwi kaisa beraima o ongkhorkha.
en: Mara was determined to find the library, so she set off on a journey.

kok: Mara kwbangma salrokni bagwi beraikha, tei bo kwbangma bataimungrok ah lama logi malaikha.
en: Mara traveled for many days, and she faced many challenges along the way.

kok: Bo kaisa mwnak bolong laisuna nango, kaisa phemlokjak hachuk kasana nango, tei kaisa phangwnang twima yogwi laisuna nango.
en: She had to cross a dark forest, climb a treacherous mountain, and swim across a raging river.

kok: Phiya boh yakarlangliya, tei paithago bo ah bijapnok mankha.
en: But she never gave up, and eventually she found the library.

kok: Ah bijapnok wngkha haino teibo mwlangchami Mara wansumani slai.
en: The library was even more amazing than Mara had imagined.

kok: Amo bethep khlaimarok sakao bijaprok betheo khlaimarok bai supungjak wngkha, tei bijap thwgwi teibo naithokma wngkha ah paithakni slai.
en: It was filled with shelves upon shelves of books, and each book was more beautiful than the last.

kok: Mara darok katikha ah bijapnok naitukberaimani bai, tei bo daktino ah bijap mankha je bo naitugwi tongmani.
en: Mara spent hours exploring the library, and she soon found the book that she had been looking for.

kok: Ah bijap "Muchungmarok bijap, " hwnwi ringjakha tei omo kaisa muchungma simi tongo.

kok: Hahamjakmung wngkha kaisani hakotorno hamjakma tei omono sasokma bwkhak muchungjakmani.
en: Patriotism is the love of one's country and the willingness to defend it.

kok: Omo kwbangma lamarok bising swbaikhrubwi sajak mano, ah kerong thong bising sebukmani simi nini hodani bising santuamani bwkhak.
en: It can be expressed in many ways, from serving in the military to volunteering in your community.

kok: Hahamjakmung wngkha nangkukma tamni hinba omo kaisa thansani sinai simari tei habohrokrok bising chwrokni naimung swnamma bwkhak chubamrok.
en: Patriotism is important because it helps to create a sense of unity and common purpose among citizens.

kok: Omo bo lukuchongraida remtisama tei ah jotto habohrok manthairok katima bwkhak bo chubamarok wngo.
en: It also helps to promote democracy and protect the rights of all citizens.

kok: Kaisa hamjakmung phunukmari wngkha George Washington ni kothoma ah Delaware Twim barsumani.

kok: December 1776'o, Washington tei bini sengkrakrok kaisa bejua thayo wngkha.

kok: Borok juda chobarok bising mechenjak tongkha tei akocho bising wngkha ah British bai romjakna wngjak
en: They had been defeated in several battles and were in danger of being captured by the British.

kok: Haiaphano, Washington saimano je bo bulaiwui tongna nangkha ah American phiyokmung pher bagwi.
en: However, Washington knew that he had to keep fighting for the cause of American independence.

kok: Christmas ni horo, bo bini bohrokbodorol dagiwui twlangkha ah Delaware twimani ayang naro ah Bristish ni sakao kaisa unanmasingsa choprobma bising.
en: On Christmas night, he led his troops across the Delaware River in a surprise attack on the British.

kok: Ah choprobma kaisa khlaimanma wngkha, tei omo ah chobani twilamthai-tokhlai philma ah Americans digi bwkhak chubakha.
en: The attack was a success, and it helped to turn the tide of the war in favor of the Americans.

kok: Oh kothoma wngkha kaisa hahamjakmungni phunukmari tamni hinba omo ah Americans borokni hakotorni bagwi bulaina bwkhak muchungmani, ahaino jephuru ah solya bohrokno kebengwi burung bethepjak wngkha.
en: This story is an example of patriotism because it shows the willingness of Americans to fight for their country, even when the odds were stacked against them.

kok: Omo bo kaisa phunukmari wngkha bahaikhe hahamjakmung kaisa chwrokni sokthai manma bwkhak chubai mano.
en: It is also an example of how patriotism can help to achieve a common goal.

kok: Oh dorbaphang bising, ah sokthai wngkha ah American kitingmung paina bwkhak tei kaisa yokjak tei phiyokjak bosong songchanani.
en: In this case, the goal was to win the American Revolution and establish a free and independent nation.

kok: Bohrok omo lamarok tisamani, yakhrairok, tei twilah khlaimano beraina tei rwkajakmung kwlaikhai swnamma bwkhak.
en: They would do this by building roads, bridges, and canals to make travel and transportation easier.

kok: Bohrok hatirok tei banikrok bo songchakha boro beparirok paina bwkhak phai mano tei kahamrok phalo.
en: They would also establish markets and fairs where merchants could come to buy and sell goods.

kok: Jora rwmani bising, bohrok beparirokni bagwi dagaitrok tei kubun tangsitra tangnairokni simi mwthangjakma manthokkha.
en: In addition, they would provide protection for traders from bandits and other criminals.

kok: Oh jotto chitokmungrok paithago, Ah Roman bugraha phatar twih bepar hamkraijak wngkha.
en: As a result of these efforts, trade flourished throughout the Roman Empire.

kok: Kahamrok tei uansukmungrok piyokjakhe kochogo kaisa bugraha paithak simi ah kubun bwkhak.
en: Goods and ideas flowed freely from one end of the empire to the other.

kok: Omo ah bugrahano teibo talikha hamrwma tei phangwnang bo swnamo.

kok: Ah Roman bugraha wngkha kaisa kotor tei kutuk sakphang.

kok: Omo kaisa juda bohrok bangmani jotto ah hayung saka simi nok wngkha.
en: It was home to a diverse population of people from all over the world.

kok: Ah Romanrok oh kotor habugra saka kasomung tonima bwkhak chujak wngkha kaisa lam lamarok swnammani bai, yakhrairok, twilahrok, hatirok, banikrok, tei beparirokni bagwi mwthangjakma.
en: The Romans were able to maintain control over this vast empire by creating a system of roads, bridges, canals, markets, fairs, and protection for traders.

kok: Oh lam ah habugra phatartwih bepar khatungrimung bwkha chubao tei omo kahamrokni bagwi wngman tei wansumungrok phiyokjak kochokma swnamo kaisa paithak ah habugra simi ah kubun bwkhak.
en: This system helped to encourage trade throughout the empire and made it possible for goods and ideas to flow freely from one end of the empire to the other.
