en: We will be happy to answer any questions you may have.

kok: Jora rwmani bising jesa kwchamani lendenrok rosamani bwkhak, chwng nini thikemung bo mwthaknai tei chini tongmarirok simi nini jesa sakbaithang kokthum tikhlaina.
en: In addition to canceling any pending transactions, we will also close your account and remove any of your personal information from our records.

kok: Omo nini huijak katirwna bwkhak wngkha tei khasrai khlaima bwkak je nini thikemung jebakhoroksa karwi phwnangjakya.
en: This is to protect your privacy and to ensure that your account is not used by anyone else.

kok: Waisa nini thikemung kholopkha, nwng tei nini thikemung sogwima bwkhka mangwlak eba jesa ah sebukrok je nini thikemung bai gwdaljak phwnangma.
en: Once your account is closed, you will no longer be able to access your account or use any of the services that are associated with your account.

kok: Tumungno nwng nini thikemung jesa karonni bagwi sogwina bwkhak nangkhe omo kholopjakma olo, khaphurwi chwngbai kwrwngdi tei chwng nono chubana bwkhak tongthokma wngnai.
en: If you need to access your account for any reason after it has been closed, please contact us and we will be happy to assist you.

kok: Chwng nini bepari no chajago tei hambai chini companyno chongmani bagwi.
en: We appreciate your business and thank you for choosing our company.

kok: Chwng nono teiwaisa sebuk bwkhak khajamung ah thinangni bising.
en: We hope to serve you again in the future.

kok: Kwdwkma jora romwi, aro kaisa naitok bwrwi sikli Marisol mungwi tongo je kaisa kami chikonsa bising tongo ah phaithago kaisa mwnak tei bisingkok gwnang bolongo.
en: Once upon a time, there was a beautiful young girl named Marisol who lived in a small village on the edge of a dark and mysterious forest.

kok: Salsa, Marisol ah bolong twih himwi thangphuru jephuru bo kaisa siniya buphang lai phaikha.
en: One day, Marisol was walking through the forest when she came across a strange tree.

kok: Ah buphang wngkha kwcham tei bothorjak, tei bini bedekrok wngkha buljak tei bothorkhajak.
en: The tree was old and gnarled, and its branches were twisted and knotted.

kok: Phiya ah buphungno aswk siniya swnamma wngkha hwnkhe bini bwthaih.
en: But what made the tree so strange was its fruit.

kok: Ah bwthai wngkha kaisa kuthuk, kosom phantok gap, tei omo wngkha jesa bwthai haiya je Marsol waisa phano puilao nukyakhu.
en: The fruit was a deep, dark purple, and it was unlike any fruit that Marisol had ever seen before.

kok: Marisol ah bwthaih ni bagwi simuchung wngkha, haini bgwi bo kaisa khochakha tei kaisa wakhak nakha.
en: Marisol was curious about the fruit, so she picked one and took a bite.

kok: Ah bwthai kwtwi tei kothok wngkha, phiya Marisol daito omo monokheno, bo kaisa siniya dunokmani sinai simanwijakma bini jotto sakni sakao nangmahai ma tongkha.
en: The fruit was sweet and delicious, but as soon as Marisol swallowed it, she felt a strange tingling sensation all over her body.

kok: Bo bini yakrok tola naikha, tei bo nukha je bohrok kwkhwrang khai slaijakmani wngkha.
en: She looked down at her hands, and she saw that they were turning green.

kok: Bo ah buphang saka naisikha, tei bo nukha je omo bedekrok bini bwkhak sogwimani.
en: She looked up at the tree, and she saw that its branches were reaching out to her.

kok: Marisol kirijak wngkha, phiya bo muani khlaijakma haibo wngkha.
en: Marisol was scared, but she was also fascinated.

kok: Bo ah buphang bwkhak swgwikha, tei ah buphangni bedekrok bini yatwkrok yaksiyagra gerebkha.
en: She reached out to the tree, and the tree's branches wrapped around her arms.

kok: Ah buphang Marisol no gana bai gana khai sotonkha, bo ah bedekroni bising wngyasak.
en: The tree pulled Marisol closer and closer, until she was inside its branches.

kok: Ah buphang bising, Marisol mwnakjak bai gurijak wngkha.
en: Inside the tree, Marisol was surrounded by darkness.

kok: Kaisa bijaknok wngkha kaisa thai boro borok porina bwkhak thang mano, porimung, tei bijaprok solok nama, kokbwlaihrok, tei kubun manwi khwnwirok.
en: A library is a place where people can go to read, study, and borrow books, magazines, and other materials.

kok: Bijapnokrok kaisa dalbidal kubun sebarok bo yapharo, ahaino computer sogwima, sapukmani, tei rutukwrwk yakkusu.
en: Libraries also offer a variety of other services, such as computer access, printing, and research assistance.

kok: Aro kwbanagma juda juda bijanokrok sapokthaih tongo, luku bijapnokrok khobmani, rwngnok bijapnokrok, swrwngnok bijapnokrok, tei mahmlai bijapnokrok.
en: There are many different types of libraries, including public libraries, school libraries, academic libraries, and special libraries.

kok: Luku bijapnokrok lukuni bagwi khulukkha tei kaisa dalbidal sebarokno yapharo bohrokni paichrunairok bwkhak.
en: Public libraries are open to the public and offer a variety of services to their patrons.

kok: Rwngnok bijapnokrok wngkha rwngnokrokni bising kaijakha tei bumukrok bago swrwngnairok tei phwrwngnairokni bwkhak.
en: School libraries are located in schools and provide resources to students and teachers.

kok: Swrwngnok bijapnokrok rwngnokkotorrok tei rwngnokyungrok bwkhak kaijakha tei swrwngnairok, faculty, tei tanagsong bwkhak bumukrok bago .
en: Academic libraries are located at colleges and universities and provide resources to students, faculty, and staff.

kok: Mahmlai bijapnokrok wngkha saktharma kaisa chongjak sajaknai ari.
en: Special libraries are dedicated to a particular subject area, such as law, medicine, or business.

kok: Bijapnokrok wngkha nangkukma tamni hinba bohrok kokthum tei bumukrok sogwina bwkhak bago je borokno swrwngna tei torna bagwi chubai mano.
en: Libraries are important because they provide access to information and resources that can help people learn and grow.

kok: Bijapnokrok kaisa thai borokni bagwi thansa phaima tei hodarwkjak bwkhak bo yapharo.
en: Libraries also offer a place for people to come together and socialize.

kok: Tinini digital omorni bisingm bijapnorokrok wngkha tabukno haino nangjak tei nangkukma.
en: In today's digital age, libraries are still relevant and important.

kok: Bohrok bijaprok, kobwlaihrok, tei kubu manwi khwnwirok bwkhak sogwima yapharo je online o bo naituk manya.
en: They offer access to books, magazines, and other materials that can't be found online.

kok: Bijapnokrok computrer sogwima, sapukmani, tei rutukrwk yakkusu bo yapharkha, jotto bomo wngkha tinini hayung bising nangnai.
en: Libraries also offer computer access, printing, and research assistance, all of which are essential in today's world.

kok: Tumungno nwng kaisa thai swrwngna bwkhak naitongkhe, torna, tei hodarwjak, slai kaisa bijapnok wngkha nini bagwi chasukjak thai.
en: If you're looking for a place to learn, grow, and socialize, then a library is the perfect place for you.

kok: Ah bwrwi chikonsa bisnani paithago achukha, bini bwskangni bukcha hathe naisikgwi.
en: The little girl sat on the edge of her bed, staring at the blank wall in front of her.

kok: Bo aro damrwi karwi achugwi tongmani, loriyawui.
en: She had been sitting there for hours, unmoving.

kok: Bini maphasong bo bai kok sana chaitokha, phiya bo mungsa saya.
en: Her parents had tried to talk to her, but she wouldn't respond.

kok: Bohrok bono saknainai ni oro twlangkha, phiya ah saknainai bo bai tamo chaya mungsaphano naituk manliya.
en: They had taken her to the doctor, but the doctor couldn't find anything wrong with her.

kok: Ah chikonsa bwrwi kaisa dadarmung tongrem bising wngkha.
en: The little girl was in a state of shock.

kok: Kisa salrok swkang bini gam bayap thwikha, tei bo omoni chongjakjorarak bai khakama bwkhak phaimanliya.
en: Her best friend had died just a few days ago, and she couldn't seem to come to terms with it.

kok: Bo amtwi wansukha bini kaisa bokocho thwikha, tei bo saimanliya bahai khe bini bayapno karwi thangnai.
en: She felt like a part of her had died, and she didn't know how to go on without her friend.

kok: Ah bwrwi chikonsani maphasong saimano je bo khanangrwma bwkhak jora nanganw, ahaino bohrok bono yakar rwkha.
en: The little girl's parents knew that she needed time to grieve, so they gave her space.

kok: Bohrok bono phaina tei thangna rwkha bo haino chajakha, tei bohrok bono bini wansukmani rokni bagwi kok sanani sinmung khailiya.
en: They let her come and go as she pleased, and they didn't pressure her to talk about her feelings.

kok: Bohrok saimano je bo paithago bini khanang chongjakjora phaiyanw, tei bohrok aro bini bagwi tonganw jephuru bo nango.
en: They knew that she would eventually come to terms with her grief, and they were there for her when she did.

kok: Salsa, ah bwrwi chikonsa rwngnokni simi nogo phaikha tei bo suja bini nogo thangkha.
en: One day, the little girl came home from school and went straight to her room.

kok: Bo duklam sokha tei bini bisna saka achukha.
en: She closed the door and sat on her bed.

kok: Bo ah bukcha hathe naisikha kwdwkma jora romwi tei bo kapnani chengkha.
en: She stared at the blank wall for a long time, and then she started to cry.

kok: Kokthairokni bising William Wordsworth, "chwrai wngkha borokni bupha."
en: In the words of William Wordsworth, “The child is the father of the man.”

kok: Omoni kokmarok je ah saimanjakrok tei halokbokmarok chwng nini chwraiphangsini swnamma bising tongo je chwng okrarok wngma.
en: This means that the experiences and relationships we have in childhood shape who we become as adults.

kok: Chini mapharok, bwta-bahanorok, tei bayaprok chwngno hayungni bagwi phwrwngma tei bahai omo bai jugajuk khaima bwkhak.
en: Our parents, siblings, and friends teach us about the world and how to interact with it.

kok: Bohrok chwngno chini rangmarirok bai poitorok hamkrai bo chubao.
en: They also help us develop our values and beliefs.

kok: Ah halokbokmarok chwng chwraiphangsini bising swnammung kaisa chornai sekrupma sakao chini khanangjak kaham-wngjak tongwi mano tei chini pharimung sakdukma halokbokmarok swnamma bwkhak omor kwbangmung bising.
en: The relationships we form in childhood can have a lasting impact on our emotional well-being and our ability to form healthy relationships in adulthood.

kok: Aow, jotto chwraiphangsini saimanjakrok kubui wngya.
en: Of course, not all childhood experiences are positive.

kok: Baksa chwrairok nokrokni bising torrwkha boro bohrok saimanjak naikoljakya, satokma, eba kubun deramung swnamma.
en: Some children are raised in homes where they experience neglect, abuse, or other forms of trauma.

kok: Oh samanjakrok kaisa swbaimani sekrupa kaisa chwraini hamkrai sakao tongwi mano.
en: These experiences can have a devastating impact on a child's development.

kok: Haipano, ahaino wngma ah jottoni slai 3 omtwijorarogo, chwrairok lamarok naituk mano bohrokni bataimarok tei hamsama mechenma bwkhak.
en: However, even in the most difficult circumstances, children can find ways to overcome their challenges and thrive.

kok: Chwrai wngkha borokni bupha, phiya ah borok bo ah chwraini bupha.
en: The child is the father of the man, but the man is also the father of the child.

kok: Chwng torwi tongo, chini thani ah sep tongo chini saimanrok simi swrwngna bwkhak tei saimungrok swnama bwkhak je chwngo chubanai ah kaham borok wngma chwng muchung bwkhak twi.
en: As we grow older, we have the opportunity to learn from our experiences and to make choices that will help us become the kind of people we want to be.

kok: Chwng kaham wngna bwkhak saina mano, khairokmung, tei buchinani.
en: We can choose to be kind, compassionate, and understanding.

kok: Chwng kaisa ah hayungni bising pherlaimung swnamma bwkhak saina mano.
en: We can choose to make a difference in the world.

kok: Tongmung kaham: kaisa thwitongma rikmung?
en: Good Manners: A Dying Art?

kok: Tinini dojak-yapri swngcharo, obo khakama amtwi tongmung kaham kaisa laithangjak manwi haise wngwi thangsio.
en: In today's fast-paced world, it seems like good manners are becoming a thing of the past.

kok: Kubunrokno boromrima bwkhak tei wngdok tongham ni slai borokrok teibo wanalaijak bohrokni sak-sakni sak-muchungmarok no twilai.
en: People are more concerned with their own self-interests than with being polite and respectful to others.

kok: Omo kaisa lachimung, tamni hinba tongmung kaham wngkha kaisa kwthamung tei hoda wngmanwi bagwi nangwi achairimani.
en: This is a shame, because good manners are essential for creating a harmonious and productive society.

kok: Aro kwbangma juda juda sapokthaih tongmung kaham, phiya baksa jotto nangkukma kaisa khobma wngkha wngdok tongham, boromrijak, tei kubunrok bai gosiwui najakmani.
en: There are many different types of good manners, but some of the most important ones include being polite, respectful, and considerate of others.

kok: Tongkwthar, poitokwrak, tei haya tangnai wngnani bo nangkukma obo.
en: It is also important to be honest, trustworthy, and responsible.

kok: Jephuru borokrok tongmungchamung tongham tei boromrijak togmung, omo kaisa sraisrai nokbarkhung achairwo tei jotto no teibo tongthotok chongphan swnamno.
en: When people behave in a polite and respectful manner, it creates a positive atmosphere and makes everyone feel more comfortable.

kok: Talikhahamyaba, tongmung kahamrok rwngnokrogo homnino phwrwngjakya.
en: Unfortunately, good manners are not always taught in schools.

kok: Omo kaisa yakarjak sep, tanmni hinmale tongmung kaham chwrairokno hamrw kaham-kitingwi tei khlaimnajak siklarok no chubai mano.
en: This is a missed opportunity, because good manners can help children to develop into well-rounded and successful adults.

kok: Mapharok kaisa tangmung thwngwi mano bohrokni chwrairokno tongmung kaham phwrwngna bagwi kaisa kaham phunukmari tangbwtang bai, bohrokbai koksalai tonghamrokni nangkukma ni bagwi, tei bohrokno swnamtonimani bai tongmung kaham loi khlaimung seprok.
en: Parents can play a role in teaching their children good manners by setting a good example, by talking to them about the importance of politeness, and by providing them with opportunities to practice good manners.

kok: Tongmung kaham tongmani kwbangma manmarirok tongo.
en: There are many benefits to having good manners.

kok: Je borokrok tongham tei boromgwnang rok bohrok teibo sak-sakni tei kwrwng langma rogo teibo khlaimanjak wngwi mano.
en: People who are polite and respectful are more likely to be successful in their personal and professional lives.

kok: Bohrok teibo tongthok tongo tei halokmaniwi supungnani khayo.
en: They are also more likely to have happy and fulfilling relationships.

kok: Kaisa samung wngkha kaisa remtang samungrok halok bojak tei samanjakrok je kaisa nangkukma jora bokjak mukhosa, hainohai ah solai hauar bisingbai.
en: A career is a sequence of related jobs and experiences that span a significant period of time, typically within the same field.

kok: Kaisa samung kaisani samung bai kokswbaikhrupma wngmano, phiya omo haino kaisa samungni slai teibo wngkha.
en: A career can be defined by one's occupation, but it is more than just a job.

kok: Omo bo ah borokrokni rangmarirok, ol manmarok, tei sokthairok bagwi bo wngkha.
en: It is also about the person's values, interests, and goals.

kok: Kaisa samung wngkha mungsaswk je borok jora rwgwi tangma, tei omo wngkha uramuram bohrokni saimanjakrok tei rwng bai swnamkha.
en: A career is something that people build over time, and it is often shaped by their experiences and education.

kok: Aro wngkha kwbangma juda juda bwchwlwirok gosima bwkhak jephuru kaisa samung chongmani.
en: There are many different factors to consider when choosing a career.

kok: Baksa ah jottoni slai nangkukma wngkha nini ol manmarok, yaksrairok, tei sokthairok khobwi.
en: Some of the most important include your interests, skills, values, and goals.

kok: Omo bo nangkukma bwkhal wansukma nini saksuar tei bahai omo kaisa chongjak samung bisingo chakjak.
en: It is also important to think about your personality and how it will fit into a particular career.

kok: Waisa nwng jotto oh bwchwlwirok wansukma tongkha, nwng nini saimungrok tola beser tei juda juda samung rwtukrwk bwkhak chengwi mano.
en: Once you have considered all of these factors, you can start to narrow down your options and research different careers.

kok: Tumungno nwng wngkubui wngya nini langmabai nwng tamo khaina muchung, aro kisa manwirok tongo nwng khlaimano nwng sakduk karina chubama bwkhak.
en: If you are not sure what you want to do with your life, there are a few things you can do to help you figure it out.

kok: Puila, borok bai koksadi je juda juda hauarrok bising samung khaimani tongo.
en: First, talk to people who are working in different fields.

kok: Nwng bo baksa online rutukrwk eba ah bijapno bwkhak teibo swrwngmano juda juda samungrokni bagwi.
en: You can also do some research online or at the library to learn more about different careers.

kok: Tei kaisa saimung wngkha kaisa samung khangma amjokmung nama bwkhak wngo.
en: Another option is to take a career assessment test.

kok: Oh amjokmungrok nono nini phanrok sinimungo chubai mano tei lengjak tei nwng bai milima samungrok je nini bagwi kaham chakjak wngwi mano.
en: These tests can help you identify your strengths and weaknesses and match you with careers that might be a good fit for you.

kok: Kaisa sakdukma tongdal wngkha kaisa je sakno twywi remtisamarok, khapang, tei khanangjakma kaham-wngjak.
en: A healthy lifestyle is one that promotes physical, mental, and emotional well-being.

kok: Omo kaisa sakdukma chahmung chamani khobwimano, chapjak sakswnam manmani, tei nangmaswk mwktwrwi manmani.
en: It includes eating a healthy diet, getting regular exercise, and getting enough sleep.

kok: Omo hamyakuplung soimanwirok iko hadaphang tei kephekmanwi kokmarok karmani wngwi mano.
en: It also means avoiding harmful substances like tobacco and alcohol.

kok: Aro kwbangma manmarirok tongo kaisa sakdukma tongdal tongnani bwkhak.
en: There are many benefits to living a healthy lifestyle.

kok: Je borok kaisa sakdukma chahmung chah o tei chapjakma sakswnam khainairok kwdwk berma iko bwkha bemar, stroke, 2 swtwikupururok sapokthaih, tei cancer hai kwcham bemar bwkhak kisa hamrwk wngmannani karjak mano.
en: People who eat a healthy diet and exercise regularly are less likely to develop chronic diseases like heart disease, stroke, type 2 diabetes, and cancer.

kok: Bohrok haino teibo kaisa sakdukma hilikmung manma bwkhak wngwi mano, obo bohrokni morji tei phan hasmai charwi mano.
en: They are also more likely to have a healthy weight, which can improve their mood and energy levels.

kok: Jora rwmani bisingtwi ah sakno twywi manmarirok bwkhak, kaisa sakdukma tongdal kaisa sosol sekrupma khapang sakdukma sakao manwi mano.
en: In addition to the physical benefits, a healthy lifestyle can also have a positive impact on mental health.

kok: Bohrok je chapjagwi sakswnam bohrok haino teibo kahamkuk sakno-boromrwma tei kahamkuk samung chokrwma bai sepma.
en: People who exercise regularly are more likely to have better self-esteem and cope better with stress.

kok: Bohrok ahaino saimanjak khakwbai tei uanama bwkha wngnani karjak mano
en: They are also less likely to experience depression and anxiety.

kok: Tumungno nwng chasama bwkha naitongkhe nini sakduk jottokhobwi tei kaham-wngjak, baska swlaimarok swnamwi, nini tongdal wngkha kaisa kotorkuar thai chengma bwkhak.
en: If you are looking to improve your overall health and well-being, making some changes to your lifestyle is a great place to start.

kok: Chikonsa swlaimarok bai swnammani chengdi, ahaino kaisa chamani teibo bakmani bwthaihrok eba mwkhwtwngrok sal thwgwi eba 30 kokmalairok himani kaisa hatio tham jorarok.
en: Start by making small changes, such as eating one more serving of fruits or vegetables each day or walking for 30 minutes three times a week.

kok: Aswkno nwng oh swlaijakmarok phwnangjakma bwkhak manwi tongkhe, nwng teibo nangmanwi swlaimarok swnamna bwkha chengwi mano.
en: As you get used to these changes, you can start to make more significant changes.

kok: Kaisa sakdukma tongdal swlaina wngkha homnino kaisa swnamnaniya, phiya omo swk wngma.
en: Making a healthy lifestyle change is not always easy, but it is worth it.

kok: John Steinbeck bai swijak kothomayung Sinjo bai Borok ni kothoma o khoroknwi beraiwi samung tangnairokni kothoma sajago, George bai Lennie, baksa khe samung rutuklayo bohrokni Tonthokya wngsokma jora.
en: Of Mice and Men is a novel by John Steinbeck that tells the story of two migrant workers, George and Lennie, who travel together in search of work during the Great Depression.

kok: O kothomayungno omo hai jora tei thai o swijakha jephuru Americarokni Imang kwthwi wngwi tongma jora o, tei bohrokni thangwi togjaknai lama wngkha pal khe kwpha'ui tongnani tei bohrok kiching bohrok nailai nani.
en: The novel is set in a time and place where the American Dream is all but dead, and the only way to survive is to stick together and look out for each other.

kok: George bai Lennie bohrok kwnwnwino uansoknai borok.
en: George and Lennie are both dreamers.

kok: Geoge ni imang khe salsa khampar nanani, bo bai Lennie bohrok kwnwi khakchangma tei tongthokma bai tonglaina bagwi.
en: George dreams of one day owning a farm, where he and Lennie can live in peace and harmony.

kok: Linnie ni imang khe kurkurok ri-nani tei abohrok bai kaham khe tongnani.
en: Lennie dreams of petting soft rabbits and being gentle with them.

kok: Phiya bohrok imang nukmani chaya mangno wngo o mwkthangni swngcharni tongmung bai.
en: But their dreams are constantly thwarted by the harsh realities of the world they live in.

kok: Salsa, George bai Lennie California o malmata mwrwkjaknai samungno man kha.
en: One day, George and Lennie find work on a ranch in California.

kok: Bohrok dakti no Candy bai kiching khalai kha, bo wngkha malmata mwrwknai kwcham boni yak baisa kwrwi.
en: They are immediately befriended by Candy, an old ranch hand who is missing an arm.

kok: Candy George bai Lennie no boni imangno twywi sa'ui khwna rw kha bo khampar bwsate nana muchungo hwnwi, hakhe tabok o khorokthamrok rang khanglaina cheng kha khampar paina bagwi.
en: Candy tells George and Lennie about his dream of one day owning a small farm, and the three men decide to pool their money together to buy a farm.

kok: Phiya bohrokni chablaimarok haino hai chaya wngjao khua Lennie khoroksa bwrwi no bwtharma bagwi.
en: But their plans are once again thwarted when Lennie accidentally kills a woman.

kok: George Lennie no kokdi hwnwi hwnjago sakno mwthangna bagwi.
en: George is forced to shoot Lennie to prevent him from being lynched.

kok: Lennie thwima bai George belai udrumudru chajak, phiya bo saimano abo simi se bo khwlai mano hwnwi.
en: George is devastated by Lennie's death, but he knows that it was the only thing he could do.

kok: Rang swlaijakmani wngkha raida bai gosejak samungrok kitingwi bakjak mano normanise.
en: Demonetization is the process of removing legal tender from circulation.

kok: Bharat hakotorni, montri okra Narendra Modi Tabung Talni 8, 2016 o awai khwlai kha, bebak rang 500 tei 1000 banknote-rok hor kwcharni simi mwthakjak sinai hwnwi raidani bisingtwi samung khwlaina bagwi gosewi naharjakha.
en: In India, Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced on November 8, 2016, that all ₹500 and ₹1000 banknotes would cease to be legal tender from midnight.

kok: O naharmung wngkha rang kasowi chamanairogno mwthakna bagwi se, phiya tong kosong lukurokni thani bo jwngjal tei tekto phai kha.
en: This move was intended to crack down on corruption and counterfeiting, but it also caused significant disruption and hardship for many people.

kok: Rang swlaimani abo kwbangmani phaising twino gosewi manya tongo.
en: There are several reasons to be skeptical of demonetization.

kok: Puilao, abo swrai swrai wngya bwswk joratwi rang kasowi chanairogno mwthagwi man.
en: First, it is not clear that it will be effective in reducing corruption.

kok: Kasowi chamani wngkha abo jwngjal kisaniya abono laitesa khe bo norwi manya rang ayang uyang kitingwi tongmano.
en: Corruption is a complex problem that cannot be solved simply by removing cash from circulation.

kok: Phiya, rangno swlaimani bisingtwi kasowi chanairok teibose bangsio aboni saki le tongo, abo teibose borokrokni rang borotong biyangsok rutukna lai si o.
en: In fact, there is some evidence that demonetization may actually increase corruption, as it makes it more difficult for people to track and trace their money.

kok: Ulnwi o khe, rang swlai mani abobai bigrarok khe teibose kwlwk sio.
en: Second, demonetization is likely to have a negative impact on the poor.

kok: Kwbangma bigrarok bohrokni yaphani rang bai se salbrumo nao rwo wnglayo.
en: Many poor people in India rely on cash for their daily transactions.

kok: Achomsa rang swlaijakmani bagwi bankni notes bai manwi painani tekto wngkha, bills rwnabo, tei kubun samung khwlaina bo khwlai thokliya.
en: The sudden withdrawal of large-denomination banknotes made it difficult for them to buy food, pay their bills, and access other essential services.

kok: Ultham o, rang swlai mani abo rangni thongni swbai kha.
en: Third, demonetization has caused significant disruption to the economy.

kok: Paiphal thwngnairok salsa salnwi hairok ma kholop kha eba hati barsa phanose wngkha kwtalrang kariya swkang.
en: Businesses had to close for days or even weeks while they adjusted to the new currency.

kok: Ang: Nini malkhung bai tamo wngkha? Omo kaisa chalthaya solya khorang swnamani wngtongkha.
en: Me: What's up with your car? It's been making a weird noise lately.

kok: Kaka: Au, ang saimano. Ang khwna mechanic bwkhak omo twlangnai.
en: Uncle: Yeah, I know. I'm taking it to the mechanic tomorrow.

kok: Ang: Omo morokma da wngo.
en: Me: Is it going to be expensive.

kok: Kaka: Omo wngmano. Ah malkhung kwcham wngkha, tei bini bokchorok phaina bwkha kuthuk wngkha. Phiya ang khajamani omo haini kaisa kisa swirwma.
en: Uncle: It might be. The car is old, and parts are hard to come by. But I'm hoping it's just a minor issue.

kok: Ang: Kaham, kaham talikha. Ano sadi ah mechanic tamo samarok.
en: Me: Well, good luck. Let me know what the mechanic says.

kok: Kaka: Ang sanai. Hambai.
en: Uncle: I will. Thanks.

kok: Ang: Oi, ahaino, nwng saidaman je nuclear malkhungrok wngkha kaisa manwi?
en: Me: Hey, by the way, did you know that nuclear cars are a thing?

kok: Kaka: Ihin', ang saimanya. Abo khasrangjakganw.
en: Uncle: No, I didn't. That's interesting.

kok: Ang: Au, bohrok kahamno. bohrok nuclear phan phwngno pherang achirwma bwkhak, bomo ah malkhungni kolno phanrok rio.
en: Me: Yeah, they're pretty cool. They use nuclear power to generate electricity, which powers the car's motor.

kok: Kaka: Abo khwnama bai amo belai morokma wngwi mano.
en: Uncle: That sounds like it would be really expensive.

kok: Ang: Omo wngmano, phiya omo bo kisa kwbang teibo sirisiti malkhungrokni slai yaksrai tongo.
en: Me: It can be, but it's also a lot more efficient than traditional cars. Nuclear cars can go for hundreds of miles on a single tank of fuel.

kok: Kaka: Hmm, ang aboni bisingo naina nanganw.
en: Uncle: Hmm, I'll have to look into that.

kok: A hiksoknwirog, khoroksa khe belai mung gwnang linguist tei khoroksa khe swngcharni mungwnang pastry sungna kwrwng, bohrok bisi kwdwkma romwi bwsa nalaina bagwi chaitok laijak.
en: The couple, a renowned linguist and a world-renowned pastry chef, had been trying for a baby for years.

kok: Bohrok je nukmani bebak doctor tei specialistrogo thangwi nailai kha, phiya ba mungsa o phano samung chukliya.
en: They had been to every doctor and specialist they could find, but nothing seemed to work.

kok: A linguistni khatungmung paina chengsa kha, tei a pastry sungna kwrwng bo uanajak tamni hwnmale bohrok bwsa manya ni bagwi bohrokni sinijakmung tola kwlwk nai kha.
en: The linguist was starting to lose hope, and the pastry chef was worried that their reputation would be ruined if they couldn't have a child.

kok: Salsa, a linguist kaisa koklob kwtalno kok swlaiwi tongphuru bo belaino khao tekto nangjak kha.
en: One day, the linguist was working on a new translation of a difficult poem when he had a breakthrough.

kok: Bo saiman kha chwrai nanani lama wngkha kwnwi ni chajakma lamano rutugwi thepamani bising twi se mano hwnwi.
en: He realized that the key to having a child was to find a way to combine their two passions.

kok: Bo pastry sungna kwrwng no ringkha tei sa'ui khwna rw kha boni uansokma rogno twywi.
en: He called the pastry chef and told her his idea.

kok: A pastry sungna kwrwng puila o chajak thaliya, phiya bo gosiwi rwkha chaitogwi nai wano hwnwi.
en: The pastry chef was skeptical at first, but she agreed to give it a try.

kok: Bohrok talnwi taltham kwnwi khe tongwi cake kwtal taklaina samung chenglai kha abo linguist khe ba kokno hamjakmani tei pastry sungna kwrwng bo boni sungna samungno hamjakmani teibo kwpwlwng wngwi phai kha.
en: They spent the next few months working on a new recipe for a cake that would be infused with the linguist's love of language and the pastry chef's love of baking.

kok: Paithago cake swnamani paima yagulo, bohrok puila a linguist kokswlaima samung khwlaimani thayo twlangwi thanglai kha.
en: When the cake was finally finished, they took it to the premier of a new play that the linguist was translating.

kok: Bohrok aro panda paiyasakno naisingwi tonglai kha, hakhe a cake no ra'ui jotto no baglai kha.
en: They waited until the after-party, and then they cut the cake and served it to everyone.

kok: A cakeno belai thokjak bai kha.
en: The cake was a huge hit.

kok: Bebakno a cake no thokjak bai kha, tei bohrok a cake no swnam mani uklogni kothoma no khwna'ui bebak chajak bai kha.
en: Everyone loved the taste, and they were all impressed by the story behind it.

kok: Hockey wngkha dakti-domunani, thumung habar je kothor o thwngjago.
en: Hockey is a fast-paced, physical sport that is played on ice.

kok: Omo kainwi bodolni bisingo thwngjago dok thwngnai rok bai, kaisa goaltender bai.
en: It is played with two teams of six players each, with one goaltender.

kok: Thwngmung ni kokksoma hwnkhe opponent ni jaal o puck no kogwi along lekhamari khaimani. .
en: The object of the game is to score goals by shooting the puck into the opponent's net.

kok: Hockey Canada, United States, tei Europe o belai luku hamjakjak thwngmung.
en: Hockey is a popular sport in Canada, the United States, and Europe.

kok: Omo kaisa Olympic thwngmung.
en: It is also an Olympic sport.

kok: Puila nokbisingni hockey thwngmung Montreal wo thwngjago, Canada, 1875 bisi o.
en: The first indoor hockey game was played in Montreal, Canada, in 1875.

kok: National Hockey League (NHL) 1917 bisi o songchajakha.
en: The National Hockey League (NHL) was established in 1917.

kok: Hockey hwnkhe belai sanjakma thwngmung je kuchuk mil yaksrai tei athleticism wngna nango.
en: Hockey is a demanding sport that requires a high level of skill and athleticism.

kok: Thwngnai rok kothor kaisleyaklap, kogma, pass, tei kuchuk mil o stickhandle manna nangnai.
en: Players must be able to skate, shoot, pass, and stickhandle at a high level.

kok: Bohrok daktino wansukna kwrwng wngna nanganw tei split-nwirem chongwi mannani.
en: They must also be able to think quickly and make split-second decisions.

kok: Hockey wngkha kotorkuar thwngmung jotto omor borok rokni bagwi.
en: Hockey is a great sport for people of all ages.

kok: Omo wngkha tongthok tei batailaimani lama kwsrang tongna hwnkhe.
en: It is a fun and challenging way to stay active.

kok: Eva Green kwmai thangmani bisingkok khobmarok.
en: Mystery surrounds disappearance of Eva Green.

kok: Eva Green, khoroksa 25-bisi-bwrwima London ni, kaisa hatibar saka kawrwi kwmamani wng tongkha.
en: Eva Green, a 25-year-old woman from London, has been missing for over a week.

kok: Bo February 25th o paithak nukjakha, Noting Hill nokaganani ah doyung bisingni bini nok yakarmani.
en: She was last seen on February 25th, leaving her apartment in the city's Notting Hill neighborhood.

kok: Green 5'6" kuchuk hwnwi swnaokhrup sajakha, kolok chaksrusru khwnai tei kwkhwrang mokolrok.
en: Green is described as being 5'6" tall, with long brown hair and green eyes.

kok: Bo kaisa kosom coat, jeans, tei kaisa kuphur t-shirt kanmnai pithak nukjak kha.
en: She was last seen wearing a black coat, jeans, and a white t-shirt.

kok: Police sakha je bohrok Green's no kitirwna bagwi wanajak wngkha tei jeba khoroksa phano swngmani kokthumani bai bini kwrwngsani bwskang phaima bwkhak.
en: Police have said that they are concerned for Green's safety and are asking anyone with information about her whereabouts to come forward.

kok: Greens's nukhung tei bayaprok bini koktunmarok ni bagwi sutkwrwi wngkha.
en: Green's family and friends are desperate for news of her.

kok: Bohrok flyers achukremani tongmani tei ah doyungni yaksiyagra borokrok kwmamani kokboklaih rok bagwi tongmani.
en: They have been posting flyers and distributing missing person's posters around the city.

kok: Bohrok haino kaisa Facebook laih swnamkha bini kwmai thangmani kok auaima chubamani bwkhak.
en: They have also set up a Facebook page to help spread the word about her disappearance.

kok: Naimwthang tubukswk jora mungsa kothoma phiyakhu wngmanma khlaimanai eba khachongmungrok Green's kwmai thangmani bising.
en: The police have not yet released any information about possible suspects or motives in Green's disappearance.

kok: Bohrok jeba khoroksa swngmani bwskang phaima bwkhak kokthuma bai, jesaphano wngthwng bwswk chikon.
en: They are asking anyone with information to come forward, no matter how small.

kok: Green's kwmai thangmani wngkha kaisa bisingkok, phiya bini nukhung tei bayaprok wngkha khathaihjak je bono kaham kwrwng khe mananw hwnwi.
en: Green's disappearance is a mystery, but her family and friends are hopeful that she will be found safe and sound.

kok: Ang 1 swtwibemar sapokthaih bai 20 bisirik saka karwi tongwi tongkha.
en: I have been living with type 1 diabetes for over 20 years.

kok: Ang haino 10 bisirok wngkha aphuru manjakha, tei omo kaisa langmakolok beraima wngkha.
en: I was diagnosed when I was just 10 years old, and it has been a lifelong journey.

kok: Aro kwbangma bataimungrok tongo ah lama logi, phiya angbo swrwngkha kaisa kwbang anisaksak ni bagwiw tei amo tamo kokmarok kaisa kwrak wngna bwkhak, khongkwlai borok.
en: There have been many challenges along the way, but I have also learned a lot about myself and what it means to be a strong, resilient person.

kok: Kaisa ah kotorma bataimungrok ang malaima wngkha ani thwi chini milrokno methepnani.
en: One of the biggest challenges I have faced is managing my blood sugar levels.

kok: Swtwibemar wngkha kaisa tonghalok je nini bwsak bisingtwih chathaih no phan philmarok ah lama nangrwmarok.
en: Diabetes is a condition that affects the way your body turns food into energy.

kok: Nwng jephuru chao, nini bwsak ah carbohydrates swbaima bisingtwi nini chathaihno glucose swnamo, bomo hwnkhe nini thwitwidar bisingtwih kusupma wngkha.
en: When you eat, your body breaks down the carbohydrates in your food into glucose, which is then absorbed into your bloodstream.

kok: Nin pancreas insulin phiyogo, kaisa hormone je glucose no nini thwi simi mannani chubamarok nini cells bisingtwih.
en: Your pancreas releases insulin, a hormone that helps glucose get from your blood into your cells.

kok: Borok bising 1 swtwibemam sapokthaih bai, ah pancreas nangmaswk insulin swnamya, eba omo mungsaphan swnamya.
en: In people with type 1 diabetes, the pancreas doesn't make enough insulin, or it doesn't make any at all.

kok: Omo kokmaro je borok bai 1 swtwibemar sapokthaih bai insulin injection nana nango borokni sakrokno chubana bwkhak phwnangwi glucose ni phan bagwi.
en: This means that people with type 1 diabetes have to take insulin injections to help their bodies use glucose for energy.

kok: Ani thwi chini milrok methepnani kaisa phemlonai bepari wngwi mano.
en: Managing my blood sugar levels can be a tricky business.

kok: Aro wngkha kaisa kwbang bwchwlwirok je ni thwi chini no nangrwi mano, ang tamo chah khobwinai, ang bwswk sakswnam, tei bwswk ang mothokma tola.
en: There are a lot of factors that can affect my blood sugar, including what I eat, how much I exercise, and how much stress I am under.

kok: Ang amtwinoamtwi ani thwi chini milrokno naikola nango tei ani insuslin chadrop bithi rok nangma bwkhak gothokmungrok swnamma.
en: I have to constantly monitor my blood sugar levels and make adjustments to my insulin doses as needed.

kok: iko nwichi bisira paithak bwkhak phaikha, computers tei pherangmanwirok kubuljak bangrwi tongjak.
en: As the twentieth century drew to a close, computers and electronics were becoming increasingly intertwined.

kok: Ah computingni swkang salrokni bising, oh kainwi thwngthairok kotorma juda khlaima wngjak.
en: In the early days of computing, these two fields were largely separate.

kok: Computers kotorma wngkha, morokjak kolrok je soisijak tei kerong thong naimungrokni bagwi phwnangjak wngkha.
en: Computers were large, expensive machines that were used for scientific and military purposes.

kok: Pherangmanwirok kaisa dalbidal painai duna bwthaihrok, ahaino nobarauairok, nukuairok , tei nokbarkokrok bising phwnangjak wngkha.
en: Electronics were used in a variety of consumer products, such as radios, televisions, and telephones.

kok: Haiphano, iko computers chikonrwk tei teibo naimanma wngkha, bohrok kaisa kuar dalbidal koibwlaihrok bising phwnangma bwkhak chegkha.
en: However, as computers became smaller and more affordable, they began to be used in a wider variety of applications.

kok: Omo kaisa mirimni bwkhak dagikha arirok computers tei pherangmanwirokni kwcharo.
en: This led to a blurring of the lines between computers and electronics.

kok: Kaisa jottoni slai nangkukma hamkrairok ah laihbuma bising computers tei pherangmanwirok ah sakbaithang computer (PC) uansukkharimung wngkha.
en: One of the most significant developments in the history of computers and electronics was the invention of the personal computer (PC).

kok: Ah PC puila 1970s bising sinirijakha wngkha, tei omo dakti kaisa luku hamjajak kol wngkha saksakni tei bepari phwnangma kwinwini bagwi.
en: The PC was first introduced in the 1970s, and it quickly became a popular tool for both personal and business use.

kok: PCs swkango nokrok tei tangkhor bising phwnangma karwi rikjak wngkha, phiya bohrok daktino bohrokni lama mankha kubun tangbwtangrokni bisingo, ahino rwngrokrok tei bijapnokrogo.
en: PCs were originally designed for use in homes and offices, but they soon found their way into other settings, such as schools and libraries.

kok: Ah PCs twithokma tei kwbang sinai swnamma omo kaisa tonggwrwng kol kaisa kuar bwtrang samungrok bagwi, bwkhak kokthaih tangsepmani simi thwngmani bwkhak
en: The PC's portability and versatility made it an ideal tool for a wide range of tasks, from word processing to gaming.

kok: Ah PC hamkrai bo kaisa kwtal swnammung bwkhak dagikha: ah software swnammung.
en: The development of the PC also led to the development of a new industry: the software industry.

kok: Software companies tangbwlairok swnamkha je PCs chaluk mano, tei oh tangbwlaihrok daktino PCs phwnangmarok karwi nangnai kolrok wngkha.
en: Software companies created programs that could run on PCs, and these programs quickly became essential tools for PC users.

kok: Kaisa bisaikel wngkha kaisa naithok manwi, milik, tei twidararijak, omo swkwi wngkha nukthaya lorimung iko omo ah lamani maritwi malmarok wngo.
en: A bicycle is a thing of beauty, sleek and streamlined, its wheels a blur of motion as it glides along the road.

kok: Phiya tamo wng jephuru nwng nini saikelno kaisa khotol bisingo tubuo?
en: But what happens when you bring a bike into a small room?

kok: Atumsa, abo jotto hamari tei khotoma kwmama wngkha, tei ah saikel hamya wngthangkha, sitra phankhai hapkha.
en: Suddenly, all that grace and efficiency is lost, and the bike becomes a clumsy, awkward intruder.

kok: Ang waisa kaisa khotol chikonsa bising saikel tonikha.
en: I once had a bike in a small room.

kok: Omo kaisa kesepjak wngkha, sitra khotolbwsa kaisa kwbai nokarini bising, tei ah saikel jottoni slai thai nakha.
en: It was a cramped, dingy apartment in a rundown neighborhood, and the bike took up most of the space.

kok: Ang kisisa ah duklam twih thang mano omo saka tokya karwi, tei ang kisa naikani khai ma tongnai amoni sakako kasleya twi jephuru ang ah hor kuthukni bising wngkha.
en: I could barely get through the door without knocking it over, and I had to be careful not to trip over it when I was in the middle of the night.

kok: Phiya haiphano ah saikel wngkha kaisa akarmung, ang saksakno tubui manliya omono yakarma manna bwkhak.
en: But even though the bike was a nuisance, I couldn't bring myself to get rid of it.

kok: Omo kaisa kaham jora babai muito narakna wngkha, jephuru ang omorkisa tei phiyokjak tei khajamung kuplung wngkha.
en: It was a reminder of a better time, when I was young and free and full of hope.

kok: Ang ah saikel sakao achugwi tei ang thangwi manna jotto thairokni imang nugo , jotto ah saktwikarjakrok ang tongwi manma.
en: I would sit on the bike and dream of all the places I could go, all the adventures I could have.

kok: Salsa, ang pathaigo ang ah saikelno yakar manma bwkhak chongkha.
en: One day, I finally decided to get rid of the bike.

kok: Ang omono ah kuna bwkhak twlangkha tei ah aragora dai rwkha.
en: I took it to the curb and put it out for the trash.

kok: iko ang omo hakchalo sotonma wngjak naikha, ang kaisa dukhu manna wansukkha.
en: As I watched it being hauled away, I felt a pang of regret.

kok: Salsa, Mary mungwi khoroksa bwrwi sikli bini khwnai khawlwi tongphuru boh thuk masa nukha.
en: One day, a young girl named Mary was combing her hair when she saw a louse.

kok: Boh kirijakha, tei chubachuni bagwi bumani ayang kharwi thangkha.
en: She was horrified, and she ran to her mother for help.

kok: Buma bohno sakha je thwkni bagwi sirisitini kwbangma ham bithirok tongo, tei boh mukhisa nangmani yapri romna bagwi chaitoknai.
en: Her mother told her that there were many traditional remedies for lice, and that she would try the one that required the least amount of action.

kok: Buma puila je samungno tangkha abo wngkha twk thaisa twi kupulung naui twi rukkha.
en: The first thing her mother did was to boil a pot of water.

kok: Ulo, boh yak mochomsa rosemary bwlaih kwranrokno bulkha tei aborokno swrapsa ni bagwi swkwlwkha.
en: Then, she added a handful of dried rosemary leaves and let them steep for a few minutes.

kok: Twi changmani ulo buma omono khuri kaisao lukhwlai rwkha tei Mary-no achukdi hwnwi sakha.
en: After the water had cooled, her mother poured it into a bowl and told Mary to sit down.

kok: Ulo boh Maryni khwnaino rosemary twibai misina bagwi betra kaisa samungo phwnangkha.
en: She then used a comb to wet Mary's hair with the rosemary water.

kok: Thwkrok thwinani chengkha, tei Mary kwlaisakhe aborokno bini khwnaini kariui mankha.
en: The lice started to die, and Mary was able to pick them out of her hair with ease.

kok: Buma belai tongthokjak je boh mungsa yapri kwrak romya karwino Maryno chubai mankha.
en: Her mother was so happy that she had been able to help Mary without having to take any drastic measures.

kok: Boh saimano ah horo Mary thwkni yokjak hwnwi saimanwi uanakwrwikhe thuwi mananw.
en: She knew that Mary would be able to sleep soundly that night, knowing that she was free of lice.

kok: Teini salo, Maryni buma phalnogo thangwi sisi thaisa thwkni shampoo paikha.
en: The next day, Mary's mother went to the store and bought a bottle of lice shampoo.

kok: Boh Maryno sakha je bahra tongnai thwkno bwtharna bagwi shampoo samungo phwnangnani nangkugo tei sisini dagimungrokno kahamkhe rwksathai.
en: She told Mary that it was important to use the shampoo to kill any remaining lice, and that she should follow the directions on the bottle carefully.

kok: Mount Everest wngkha ah hayungni bising kuchukma hachuk, twibom mil sakao 8,848 meters bachamani.
en: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world, standing at 8,848 meters above sea level.

kok: Ah Mahalangur Himal yakchu-bwtrang ah Himalayas bising amo yasithai wngkha.
en: It is located in the Mahalangur Himal sub-range of the Himalayas.

kok: Ah hachuk wngkha hachuk kasanairokni bisingo belai mungwnangkuk, tei kwbangma borok omo bisi thwgwi bochlong bwkhak chaithogo.
en: The mountain is a popular destination for mountaineers, and many people attempt to summit it each year.

kok: Haiphano, ah kasama wngkha akochoma, tei kwbangma borok ah buchuk sogwina bwkhak chaitokmani thwikha.
en: However, the climb is dangerous, and many people have died trying to reach the top.

kok: Ah Everest bochlong puila tongmari chaitokma bwkhak 1921 bising swnamma wngkha George Malloryni dagima bai khoroksa British nongkhormung khlai jago.
en: The first recorded attempt to summit Everest was made in 1921 by a British expedition led by George Mallory.

kok: Mallory tei bini kasanai logisong Andrew Irvine kwmakha boroni chaitokma wngjora, tei borokni mangrok naituk manya 1999 wngyasak.
en: Mallory and his climbing partner Andrew Irvine disappeared during their attempt, and their bodies were not found until 1999.

kok: 1953 o, Edmund Hillary tei Tenzing Norgay ah puila borok wngkha Everest bochlong khlaimanmung bwkhak.
en: In 1953, Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay became the first people to successfully summit Everest.

kok: Aphuruni simi, borok chirasairok borokni yaprimarirok bising rwtharkha.
en: Since then, thousands of people have followed in their footsteps.

kok: Ah Everest bochlong bwkhak kasama wngkha kaisa kolok tei hamthaya beraima.
en: The climb to the summit of Everest is a long and arduous journey.

kok: Omo hainohai kasanairokno kanwi talrok bagwi nao ah beraina paihna bwkhak, tei bohrok kwbangma bataimung ah lama logi ma mechenrwnai.
en: It typically takes climbers about two months to complete the journey, and they must overcome a number of challenges along the way.

kok: Oh bataimungrok altitude kulum, belai salbar tonghalokrok, tei ah khapharmung kwlaimani khobwi.
en: These challenges include altitude sickness, extreme weather conditions, and the risk of falling.

kok: Tophano ah akochorok, ah Everest bochlong bwkhak kasama wngkha kaisa yakpaimani simari.
en: Despite the dangers, the climb to the summit of Everest is a rewarding experience.

kok: Twi wngkha langmao nangkukmani.
en: Water is essential for life.

kok: Obo chini sakno hilikthani 60% chubao tei abo kwbangma sakni nangkukma samungrogo gwdaljak, haikhe sakno kutung khlai thani, sirró sakham manwirok tei hama rohorthani, hamya manwirokno northani chubao.
en: It makes up over 60% of our body weight and is involved in many important bodily functions, such as regulating body temperature, transporting nutrients and oxygen to cells, and removing waste products.

kok: Twi jorarokno bo chubao rimithanio tei mwthango sakmangno tei sakbophono.
en: Water also helps to lubricate joints and protect organs and tissues.

kok: Tangwi chwng twino khatina nang abo kwbangma dál wngmung tongo.
en: There are many reasons why we should conserve water.

kok: Kaisa wngmung wngkha swngchar gwnangwi twini biyal wngrwgo.
en: One reason is that water scarcity is a growing problem around the world.

kok: Swngcharni kwbangma thayo no, bororok twikaham manya, tei omotwihai thayoo twi kwbangma tongo haiphano , nokbar-twibar swlaijakmabai aboni biyal teibo bangrwrwgo.
en: In many parts of the world, people do not have access to clean water, and even in areas where water is plentiful, it is becoming increasingly scarce due to climate change.

kok: Tamoni bagwi twi khatina nang hwnmale obo kaisa nangkukmani tanglam.
en: Another reason to conserve water is that it is a valuable resource.

kok: Twino naikani khlainani tei rohornani kwbangma phan nango, tei chwng o nangkukmani manwino hamya khlaiya twikhe twino belaino uansogwi samungo thepana nango.
en: It takes a lot of energy to treat and transport water, and it is important to use water wisely so that we do not waste this precious resource.

kok: Twi khatina bagwi kwbangma samung chwng khlaimano.
en: There are many things we can do to conserve water.

kok: Chwng dakti tukubai mano, tepni twi kosorjakno muthupmano, tei chini nokhla ni samarokno twi lunani teisa salbararwi mano.
en: We can take shorter showers, fix leaky faucets, and water our lawns less often.

kok: Tei chwngbo abo hai manwirokno paina nangnai je manwi teisa twikaham swnamphijak bai swnamjak.
en: We can also choose to buy products that are made with recycled water.

kok: Chini langma o kisisa slaimung tubuma bising twi, chwng twino kháti thanio chuba'ui mano tei khabwtharwi chini bwskangni achaisongni bagwi o nangkukmani manwino manthokrwnabagwi.
en: By making small changes in our daily lives, we can help to conserve water and ensure that this vital resource is available for future generations.

kok: Ah hayung wngkha belai juda juda thai wngkha omoni slai haino kisa lai thangjak swkang.
en: The world is a very different place than it was just a few decades ago.

kok: Hodaphalam kwbangma hakotorogo bising romchrepma nakha, tei borok wngkha tei khakjak slai jottojora.
en: Nationalism has taken hold in many countries, and people are more divided than ever.

kok: Kaisa hakotor bising, kaisa dophahamjaknai bodol ah hapang no kasomung naipaikha tei bohrokni phan sinkilikma gothokya wngma bwkhak phwnagmani.
en: In one country, a group of nationalists have taken control of the government and are using their power to suppress dissent.

kok: Bohrok jotto pinlam sakmangarok muthupkha je bohrok bujuknani "hahamnaiya," wngma tei bohrok romkha tei ahaino borok bwtharkha je hapangni kebengwi kari samano.
en: They have banned all forms of media that they deem to be "unpatriotic," and they have arrested and even killed people who speak out against the government.

kok: Salsa, khoroksa bwrwima sikli Rebecca wngwi nini nok ni simi rwngnogo himwi tongmani jephuru bo kaisa dophahamajaknai sengkrakrokbai bathajakha.
en: One day, a young woman named Rebecca is walking home from school when she is stopped by a group of nationalist soldiers.

kok: Bohrok bono kaisa phemloknao wngdok hwnwi berkha, tei bohrok bono kaisa huijak along bwkhak twlangkha.
en: They accuse her of being a traitor, and they take her to a secret prison.

kok: Rebecca swngjakha tei satokjakha, phiya bo mungsa kokthum rininai gosiya wngkha.
en: Rebecca is tortured and interrogated, but she refuses to give up any information.

kok: Daldibal hatibarrok olo, Rebecca no paithago along simi phiyokjakha.
en: After several weeks, Rebecca is finally released from prison.

kok: Bo kebel tei sakbolijak wngkha, phiya bo ah dophahamjaknai kebengwi phirok bulaima bwkhak khathonjak wngkha.
en: She is weak and malnourished, but she is determined to fight back against the nationalists.

kok: Bo kaisa resistance ninangrimung manjukha, tei bo khoroksa morokjak rangmai ah pher bwkhak wngkha.
en: She joins a resistance movement, and she becomes a valuable asset to the cause.

kok: Rebecca bini tansep elem phwnangmarok bwkhak ah resistance gwdalaima tei bohrokni choprobmarok twinglaima bwkhak chubao.
en: Rebecca uses her knowledge of technology to help the resistance communicate and coordinate their attacks.

kok: Bo khoroksa hacker wngwi bini yaksrairok bo phwnango ha dophahamjaknairokni' computers tei borokni data khokna hapsonma bwkhak.
en: She also uses her skills as a hacker to infiltrate the nationalists' computers and steal their data.

kok: Khoroksa buma wngkha kaisa borok je nono paiphwlaiya hamjakma, twichuruma, tei naikaichom rio.
en: A mother is a person who gives you unconditional love, support, and guidance.

kok: Bo aro nini bagwi homnino tongo, jesaphano wngthwng.
en: She is always there for you, no matter what.

kok: Khoroksa buma wngkha phwrwngnai, khoroksa bayap, khoroksa poitokhaimanai.
en: A mother is a teacher, a friend, a confidant.

kok: Bo wngkha khoroksa je nono phwrwngo langma tongnai tei bahaikhe khoroksa borok kaham wngnai.
en: She is the one who teaches you how to live life and how to be a good person.

kok: Khoroksa bumani hamjakma wngkha kaisa phangwnang sakphan.
en: A mother's love is a powerful force.

kok: Omo ah kulum rokno hamrwi mano, omo pholarokno tisai mano, tei omo jesamanwi wngwi swnam mano.
en: It can heal the sick, it can lift the spirits, and it can make anything possible.

kok: Khoroksa bumarokni hamjakma wngkha kaisa rwmung je torrwjak wngna nango.
en: A mother's love is a gift that should be cherished.

kok: Bumarok wngkha mahmalai borok.
en: Mothers are special people.

kok: Bohrok terkhlaijakna tei boromjak khaijkna bwkhak manthai nango.
en: They deserve to be celebrated and honored.

kok: Oh bumani salo, kisa jora nawui nini buma no hambai rwdi bo nini bagwi jottomanwi khaimani bagwi.
en: On this Mother's Day, take some time to thank your mother for everything she has done for you.

kok: Bono sadi nwng bono bwswk hamjak tei bono chajak.
en: Tell her how much you love and appreciate her.

kok: Tei belai nangkukjak, bono phunukdi nwng bono bwswk hamjak iko wngdok kahamkuk borok nwng wngwi manma bai.
en: And most importantly, show her how much you love her by being the best person you can be.

kok: Nukprom eba andragundra thairok bisingkok gwnang tei muchungrwma gwnang kainwino wngwimanw.
en: Dimly lit or dark places can be both mysterious and alluring.

kok: Bohrok siringsorop tei hwijakmungni kha simung rwimano, phiya bohrok kirimasingsa tei sundrurwnaibo wngwimanw.
en: They can provide a sense of seclusion and privacy, but they can also be dangerous and frightening.

kok: Kokrwbayo, uaikwbangno andragundra tei nukprom thairokno poito thangsokya eba kirimungni kha simung achairwthani phwangjago.
en: In literature, dark and dim places are often used to create a sense of suspense or horror.

kok: Phunukmarini bagwi, Edgar Allan Poe ni "The Tell-Tale Heart, "-o nukmano sanaini ah mwnakma khotolni kok swbai samao boh je chakra borokno butharo, abo kwchangma karwnai tei tungphlawnai kainwino.
en: For example, in Edgar Allan Poe's "The Tell-Tale Heart," the narrator's description of the dark room in which he murders the old man is both chilling and evocative.

kok: Soisoi langmao, mwnak tei nukprom thairokbo kirimasingsa wngwimanw.
en: In real life, dark and dim places can also be dangerous.

kok: Bohrokno chongwi nainani belai kutuk wngwimanw, tei bohrok tangsitra tangnairokni bagwi hwijaknani thai wngwimanw.
en: They can be difficult to navigate, and they can provide cover for criminals.

kok: Teisase, mwnak thai borokrokno kebel wngma tei kirimano khao nangrwimano.
en: Additionally, dark places can make people feel vulnerable and afraid.

kok: Haini bagwi, nini ganaginino twywi hojak wngma tei andragundra eba nukprom amchairogo happhuru katilam rwksanani nangkugo.
en: For this reason, it is important to be aware of your surroundings and to take precautions when entering a dark or dimly lit area.

kok: Kirithotok wngphano, andragundra tei nukprom thairok naithotok tei khasrangrwnai wngwimanw.
en: Despite the potential dangers, dark and dim places can also be beautiful and inspiring.

kok: Bohrok tongkwchang tei kwchangdodoni simung rwuimanw, tei bohrok tangkwtal tei nukmung kiphilmungo chubauimanw.
en: They can provide a sense of peace and tranquility, and they can be conducive to creativity and reflection.

kok: Phunukmarini bagwi, kwbangma rwbai kwrwng tei swi kwrwngsong andragundrani bisingo khasrangmung mankha.
en: For example, many artists and writers have found inspiration in the darkness.

kok: Phunukmarini bagwi, Vincent van Gogh mwnak o mangpili rikmungni bagwi sinimung manjak tongmani, tai
en: Vincent van Gogh, for example, was known for painting in the dark, and his work often reflects the beauty and mystery of the night.

kok: Kanchum tei tongdal tabukni jorao swlaijagwi mangse tongsio, twmale hwnba kwtal kwtal richum chummungni trend sokphaikhe kwchamrok sokomajagwi thango.
en: Fashion and style are constantly evolving, as new trends emerge and old ones fade away.

kok: Phiya o mungsale kunphuru phano swlaijakya borok rokni naithok nukjakna muchungmale.
en: But one thing that never changes is the human desire to look good.

kok: Nwng town o beraina bagwi ri chumwi phano tongdi eba office o thangna bagwi nini kanma chumma bai nini saksakni simungno chwnarwo tei khakotor swnamo.
en: Whether you're dressing for a night out on the town or a day at the office, your outfit should reflect your personality and make you feel confident.

kok: Kaisa kotorkuk o bisini kan chum phaising dekhakma wngkha kolok kolok richumrok.
en: One of the biggest trends in fashion this year is the return of long, flowing dresses.

kok: O richum rok jesa pandao phano chumnani bagwi khapio, tei ah richumrok saka eba tola dalnwi kheno chumui mano nwng bobo haikhe chumna muchung aro nainai.
en: These dresses are perfect for any occasion, and they can be dressed up or down depending on your needs.

kok: Nwng tumung kaisa richumno borok kwbang thayo bolaijakna muchungkhe ri kolok, khumgwnang ri se jottoni khapikugo.
en: If you're looking for a dress that will make you stand out from the crowd, a long, flowing dress is a great option.

kok: Tei kaisa wngtongma hwnkhe mung gwnang wngnase tabukni kanchum.
en: Another trend that is gaining popularity is sustainable fashion.

kok: Obono kokmang wngkha, ri recycle wngnaijat manwibai swnamjak eba brand kok rwkheba kaham swnamjakmung wngo.
en: This means choosing clothing that is made from recycled materials or from brands that have a commitment to ethical manufacturing.

kok: Wngtongmani kanchum hapharni bagwi simi kahamya, tangwi hwnkhe obo rang solani bagwibo kaham.
en: Sustainable fashion is not only good for the environment, but it's also good for your wallet.

kok: O hayung twrwk twrwk jotto hayung kwswngwi phayo, aswkno kanchumni trend bo solai solai wngo.
en: As the world becomes more globalized, fashion trends are becoming more uniform.

kok: Twmale hwnba kaisa mung gwnang wngwi phaikhe tei kaisa hao bo luku hamjakmung wngwi thango.
en: What's popular in one country is quickly becoming popular in another.

kok: Oboni kokmang wngkha tabuk nwng kwtal kwtal trend ni kanchum nuknai tangwi hwnba nwng je thayo phano tongdi.
en: This means that you can now find the latest fashion trends no matter where you live.

kok: Khoran wngkha hukbar bwthaih hamya wngmani pher kotor tei katijak chahmung tei tangwi chahthani deramungni mari khikwlaimanw.
en: Droughts are a major cause of crop failure, and can have a devastating impact on food security and livelihoods.

kok: 2019 bisio, Horn of Africao betalai khoran rasai rasai borokno chahmung kwrwikhe tonikha.
en: In 2019, a severe drought in the Horn of Africa left millions of people without food.

kok: El Nino tei nokbar twibar swlaimungno khobwi juda juda pherni kwrwgmabai khoran wngmani.
en: The drought was caused by a combination of factors, including El Niño and climate change.

kok: Khoran nokni rwjak malmata butharkha, bwthaih derarwkha tei borokrokno bohrokni nokhuk yakarwi thangrwkha.
en: The drought killed livestock, destroyed crops, and forced people to flee their homes.

kok: Kisaswk amchayo khoran aswkkhe betalai tongmani je abo machaya manungya khwlaikha.
en: In some areas, the drought was so severe that it caused famine.

kok: Pacific twiyung wngkha hayung gwnangwi nokbar twibar naidalrokni kaisa dagarnai kotor.
en: The Pacific Ocean is a major driver of global climate patterns.

kok: El Nino wngkha kaisa habarni nokbar twibar naidal, abo kisaswk bisibrumo wngo.
en: El Niño is a natural climate pattern that occurs every few years.

kok: El Ninoni jora, Pacific twiyungo twibom sakani tungmari bango, abo hayungni kisaswk bwkhago khoran tei kubun thairogo twilommungni pher wngwimanw.
en: During El Niño, the ocean surface temperature in the Pacific Ocean rises, which can cause droughts in some parts of the world and floods in others.

kok: Nokbar twibar swlaimani pherbai hayungni tungmaribo bangwi tongo, abo khoran hai nobar halokni kotor patimung patirwo.
en: Climate change is also causing the Earth's temperature to rise, which is leading to more extreme weather events, such as droughts.

kok: Toksa tokmilirok bohrokni tongkhor swlaimano twywi saimanwi tongo.
en: Birds are sensitive to changes in their environment.

kok: Khoranni pherbai toksa tokmilirokni chahmung tei twini biyal wngwimanw, abobai langma chorwi eba tongthai serwimanw.
en: Droughts can cause a shortage of food and water for birds, which can lead to death or migration.

kok: Phunukmarini bagwi, 2021 bisio Western United States o khoranni pherbai kisaswk dalni toksa tokmilini bangmari holikha, romdi totwra kosom chora.
en: For example, a drought in the western United States in 2021 caused a decline in the population of some bird species, such as the black-throated sparrow.

kok: Sikwrwng rokni kaisa poito hwnkhe wngmung tei kokchirmungni bisingtwise wngwi mano.
en: Rationalist thought is the belief that the only way to acquire knowledge is through reason and logic.

kok: Obo hayungni raida rokno naikolma tei amjokmung baise bujiui mano.
en: It is based on the idea that the world is governed by natural laws that can be understood through observation and experimentation.

kok: Sikwrwngrok poito khwlaima soisoikhe o swngcharno bujina hwnkhe kubuino kahamkhe naichomna nangnai.
en: Rationalists believe that the only way to truly understand the world is to strip away all of our preconceived notions and biases and look at things objectively.

kok: Obo daltham raida wngwi mano, phiya kaisa hwnkhe soisimung tei koksimung o hamchamung nango.
en: This can be a difficult task, but it is one that is essential for making progress in science and philosophy.

kok: Sikwrwngrok poito khwlaimakhe kahamkhe chapmanani wngkha wngmung tei yakumu bisingtwi.
en: Rationalists believe that the only way to make good decisions is to base them on facts and evidence.

kok: Bohrok khakamungrokno kubui hwnwi gosina naya.
en: They reject the idea that intuition or emotion can ever be a reliable guide to truth.

kok: Haipahno obo abohaiya je bohrok kwchang tei khakamungrok gwnang borokya hwnwi; bohrok sana naimakhe haise wansukmung bai khakamungno judakhe khagwi tonna bagwi.
en: This does not mean that rationalists are cold and unfeeling; they simply believe that it is important to separate our feelings from our thoughts when making decisions.

kok: Sikwrwng wngmung phaiwi sokphaimakhe posimgwlarokni wansukmung baise hamchamung phayo.
en: Rationalism has been a major force in the development of Western thought.

kok: Obo soisimung, koksimung tei tangsep rogo nangkumani lam rwkha.
en: It has led to many important advances in science, philosophy, and technology.

kok: Haiphano, belai khochor tei kutuk wngmani bagwi belaikhe koksilchamung bo phayo.
en: However, it has also been criticized for being too narrow and rigid.

kok: Baksa bohrok sao obo khakamung tei bujiui manmungno noro, tei hayungni borokrokno lam pherwi mano.
en: Some people argue that it ignores the importance of emotion and intuition, and that it can lead to a dehumanizing view of the world.

kok: Aswk kwbangma koksilchamung manphano, posomgwlarokni thani sikwrwng roknino phangwnang wansukmung wngwi bachakha.
en: Despite these criticisms, rationalism remains a powerful force in Western thought.

kok: Chwla bai chwla eba bwrwi bai bwrwi kaijakmani abo raida bai gosewi naharjak kha.
en: Same-sex marriage is a legal union of two people of the same sex.

kok: Tabokni bisi o chwla bai chwla eba bwrwi bai bwrwi kaijaklaimano twywi belai kok banglaiwi tongo.
en: The legal recognition of same-sex marriage has been the subject of much debate in recent years.

kok: Kebo khe ba chwela bai chwla eba bwrwi bai bwrwi kaijaklaimano twywi chajaklayo, teirok khe salayo abotwi wngthai kwrwi hwnwi.
en: Some people believe that same-sex marriage should be legal, while others believe that it should not be.

kok: Abono twi kaham bai hamya ni kok kwbangma kasa'ui tongo.
en: There are a number of arguments for and against same-sex marriage.

kok: Kaisa kok tisajak mani khe chwla bai chwla eba bwrwi bai bwrwi kaijaklaimano chajagwi sao abo baksase wngna nango hwnwi.
en: One argument in favor of same-sex marriage is that it is a matter of equality.

kok: Bebak lukurog, bohrokni tonglaimano karwi, manthai tei barja baksano wngna nangnai.
en: All people, regardless of their sexual orientation, should have the same rights and responsibilities.

kok: Kaijakmani wngkha abo bohrokni manthaise, tei chwla bai chwla eba bwrwi bai bwrwi kaijaknairogbo chwlai bai bwrwi kaijaknairok haino manthai mana nangnai.
en: Marriage is a fundamental right, and same-sex couples should be able to enjoy this right just like heterosexual couples.

kok: Tei kaisa chwla bai chwla eba bwrwi bai bwrwi kaijakmani kaham khe chwrairokni bagwi kaham.
en: Another argument in favor of same-sex marriage is that it is beneficial for children.

kok: Abono twywi porenairok khursa'ui phunugo a chwla bai chwla eba bwrwi bai bwrwi kaijagwi bwsa manmanibo chwlai bai bwrwi kaijagwi bwsa man mani haino.
en: Studies have shown that children who are raised by same-sex parents are just as well-adjusted as children who are raised by heterosexual parents.

kok: Phiya, baksa porenairok omono bo phunugo chwla bai chwla eba bwrwi bai bwrwi manmani bwsarogse soichuknai tei kwthanai wngkugo buini slai.
en: In fact, some studies have even shown that children who are raised by same-sex parents may be more tolerant and accepting of others.

kok: Au, chwla bai chwla eba bwrwi bai bwrwi kaijaklaimano chajakya ni bo kok tisa jago.
en: Of course, there are also arguments against same-sex marriage.

kok: Kebo ba poito khwlayo kaijakmung wngkha chwla bai bwrwi simise wngthai hwnwi, tei chwla bai chwla eba bwrwi bai bwrwino kaijakmano ma mwthaknai hwnwi.
en: Some people believe that marriage is a union between a man and a woman, and that same-sex couples should not be allowed to marry.

kok: Saswirinai wngkha uramuram nukjakha aswkno khairokmakwrwi tei thwikangjaknai naikolnai je borok langma ni baga'ui mungsa kharwma kwrwi.
en: Dictators are often seen as ruthless and bloodthirsty rulers who have no regard for human life.

kok: Jephuru aro kisa kubui tong oh stereotype bwkhak, omom wngkha nangkukma muitomanma je jotto saswirinairok solaiya hwnwi.
en: While there is some truth to this stereotype, it is important to remember that not all dictators are the same.

kok: Baksa kotorkuar satukmarok bagwi bokjakma wngkha, jephuru kubunrok kubuino bohrokni borokni tongmarok hamrwjakha.
en: Some have been responsible for great atrocities, while others have actually improved the lives of their people.

kok: Kaisa ah belai sinijak saswirinai laihbuma bising wngkha Adolf Hitler.
en: One of the most famous dictators in history is Adolf Hitler.

kok: Hitler wngkha Nazi Germany ni ojama 1933 simi 1945 jora.
en: Hitler was the leader of Nazi Germany from 1933 to 1945.

kok: Bini naikolma tola, Germany dalbidal hakotorrokno sekhkha tei jews kwthaiya bwtharnani khlaikha tei kubun chikonsa bodolrokno.
en: Under his rule, Germany invaded several countries and committed genocide against the Jews and other minority groups.

kok: Hitler borok chirasairokni thwimungrok bagwi bokjakma wngkha, tei bo khoroksa belai soitan borok laihbumani bisingtwi gosijakha.
en: Hitler is responsible for the deaths of millions of people, and he is considered one of the most evil men in history.

kok: Teikaisa sinijak saswirinai wngkha Joseph Stalin.
en: Another famous dictator is Joseph Stalin.

kok: Stalin wngkha ah Soveite Union ni ojama wngkha 1924 simi 1953 jora.
en: Stalin was the leader of the Soviet Union from 1924 to 1953.

kok: Bini naikolma tola, ah Soviet Union kaisa kotorphangwnang wngkha, phiya omo bo kaisa saimanjak kaisa kotor paiphalmung repression tei bulaimung.
en: Under his rule, the Soviet Union became a superpower, but it also experienced a great deal of repression and violence.

kok: Chirasairok borok bwtharjakha eba chobjakha Stalin ni naikaniraida tolao.
en: Millions of people were killed or imprisoned under Stalin's regime.

kok: Jephuru Hitler tei Stalin wngkha kainwi ah belai sinikukjak saswirinairok laihbuma bising, aro kabangma kubunrok tongo je satukmanrok khlaijak.
en: While Hitler and Stalin are two of the most infamous dictators in history, there have been many others who have committed atrocities.

kok: Rogi: ang homnino kesepjakha tei ang ah kuchukma jangrima bwkhak kahakma wngo.
en: Patient: I'm always congested and I can't seem to shake the cough.

kok: Saknainai: Omo khwnamarokbai nwng kaisa khaichuak solomani manwi mano.
en: Doctor: It sounds like you might have a fungal infection.

kok: Khaichuak wngkha kaisa mukhisamalamatarok je kaisa dalbidal bemarok borokrokni bising pher mano.
en: Fungi are a type of microorganism that can cause a variety of diseases in humans.

kok: Bohrok ah habar bisingo tongwi mano, chini bukar sakao, tei ahaino chini bwsakrokni bising.
en: They can live in the environment, on our skin, and even in our bodies.

kok: Rogi: Bomtwi prakarni khaichuak ani nukswkangmarirok phermani wngmano?
en: Patient: What kind of fungi could be causing my symptoms?

kok: Sakanai: aro kwbangma juda juda khaichuak sapokthaih tongo je borokrok bising solomani phermano.
en: Doctor: There are many different types of fungi that can cause infections in humans.

en: This can lead to a more fulfilling and satisfying life.

en: However, freedom is not without its issues.

en: One challenge is that it can be difficult to know where to draw the line between freedom and chaos.

en: For example, should people be free to do anything they want, even if it harms others?

kok: Omo wngkha kaisa kutuk sirwma aro kebo 1 kokphirokm kwrwi.

kok: Arak wngkha kaisa kuthuk bemar je jotto omorrok borok, bosongrok, tei hodarangthong hatlairok sago kwlaimarok.
en: Alcoholism is a complex disease that affects people of all ages, races, and socioeconomic backgrounds.

en: While there is no single cause of alcoholism, it is believed to be caused by a combination of genetic, environmental, and psychological factors.

kok: Arak wngkha kaisa chasajak bemar je kwbangma sakduk kebengmung bwkhak dagi mano, bwkha hamya khobmani, bwkha bemar, agyukmayuk, kwsabemar, tei khapung sakduk kebengmungrok.
en: Alcoholism is a progressive disease that can lead to a number of health problems, including liver damage, heart disease, stroke, cancer, and mental health problems.

kok: Arak thaihmungrok bai chaya tongphano, omo kaisa saknaima bemar wngkha.

kok: Ah arak ni bemar uramuram kaisa tongsitra gurima bwkhak sujakma wngkha.
en: The disease of alcoholism is often compared to a vicious cycle.

en: The best way to get your news is to use a variety of sources and to be critical of the information you're consuming.

kok: Nwngsaksakno swngdi sabo ah kothum manthokmani rwi tongm, bohrokni tamo bekar tamo, tei jebasa ah kokthum kubuida wngkha.

en: Some of the most popular food and wine festivals include the Napa Valley Wine Festival in California, the Sonoma County Harvest Festival in California, and the New York City Wine and Food Festival.

en: You should also make sure to book your transportation and accommodations in advance, as these can become scarce during peak festival season.

en: One challenge is voter suppression, which can take many forms, such as voter ID laws, gerrymandering, and intimidation.

en: By addressing these challenges, we can make sure that elections are fair and transparent, and that all citizens have a voice in their government.
