en: You may also be able to get a discount if you book your rental car in advance.

kok: Nini solok najak malkhungno nana thangphuru, tamorok hamya wngwi tong abo kaham khe siwi nadi.
en: When picking up your rental car, be sure to inspect it carefully for any damage.

kok: Hamya wngjakrok nugwi tongkhe, solok namani goselaimungo kaham khe salai di.
en: If you see any damage, be sure to note it on the rental agreement.

kok: Nwng o malkhungno chalokya swkang mangpili tisa wi nadi.
en: You should also take pictures of the car before you drive it away.

kok: "Bwkhap naywi simi bijap bisingni no taamjokdi" kaisa sinikukjak sahthai aboni kokmang wngkha saka-saka nukma bai simi kaisa manwi no twywi chongwi tapaidi.
en: "Don't judge a book by its cover" is a popular saying that means one should not make assumptions about something based on its outward appearance.

kok: Omo borok, thairiok, tei manwirok bwkhak thepajak mano.
en: This can be applied to people, places, and things.

kok: Phunukmari karwi, nwng masaswk bai malai mano je hamya munggang tongo, phiya saimankha je bohrok kubuono khoroksa kaham tei togkaham borok wngkha.
en: For example, you might meet someone who has a bad reputation, but after getting to know them, you realize that they are actually a kind and gentle person.

kok: Eba, nwng nugwi mano kaisa dalan je kwcham tei rundown nukjago, phiya jephuru nwng bisingo thango, nwng mananw je omo kubuio kaisa naithok tei laihbuma thai.
en: Or, you might see a building that looks old and rundown, but when you go inside, you find that it is actually a beautiful and historic place.

kok: Aro kwbangma kokrok tongo tangwi omo kaisa nangkukma je bohrokni peplamung bai manwirok dorbaphang bwkhak takhaidi.
en: There are many reasons why it is important not to judge things by their appearance.

kok: Puila, omo kaisa chaya anumantwi swnamani bwkhak dagi mano.
en: First, it can lead to making incorrect assumptions.

kok: Nwirem, omo chwngno nainani simi mungsaswk ah kubui moroukma kasogra mano.
en: Second, it can prevent us from seeing the true value of something.

kok: Thamrem, omo nangnungya nanglaimung tei khakmani swnamjak mano.
en: Third, it can create unnecessary conflict and division.

kok: Teiwaisa phuru nwng omoni peplamung bai mungsaswk dorbaphang bwkhak lupjakma wngkha, kisa bathakdi tei yamrok kisajora nadi.
en: The next time you are tempted to judge something by its appearance, take a moment to pause and reflect.

kok: Sakbaithangno swngdi tumungno nwng kubuono kaisa kokthum chapmani swnammani wngkha, eba tumungno nwng khakeplengwi nini baises yakarmani bai nini kokchomung chumui wngkha.
en: Ask yourself if you are really making an informed decision, or if you are simply letting your biases cloud your judgment.

kok: Muito khlaidi, aro teibo kaisa borok, thai, eba manwi slai ah mokol malaimarok bwkhak wngkha.
en: Remember, there is more to a person, place, or thing than meets the eye.

kok: Hayungrwgwi rangthong choyai bwkhak torma bai, aswkno khulni sanmarok teibo bangkha.
en: As the global economy continues to grow, so too does the demand for cotton.

kok: Kwbanghachalni, twihmabai kanchum saka chalugwi lukuni hamjakma bangmabai sanmarok tongkaham khulni bagwi.
en: Furthermore, the increasing popularity of sustainable fashion is driving up demand for organic cotton.

kok: Omo khulni swnamkhor o rang tongmung bai twidolma bangkha, kwtal khaimani bai haktor o songchajak mani ahai India bai china.
en: This has led to a surge in investment in the cotton industry, with new plantations being established in countries such as India and China.

kok: Haiphano, oh tormani bataimung karwi wngwi manya.
en: However, this growth has not been without its challenges.

kok: Khulni sanma bangma bagwi twini mukno phanbai sotonma tonikha, tei pesticides tei fertilizer tongkhorno sitrarwma bwkhak twlangkha.
en: The increased demand for cotton has put a strain on water resources, and the use of pesticides and fertilizers has led to environmental pollution.

kok: Kwbanghakchalni, hamrwrwk haktoro khul chuainairokno belai beton kom rijago haini bagwi tangnai samung khwlai roknoni bagwi wanario.
en: Furthermore, the low wages paid to cotton farmers in developing countries has led to concerns about labor exploitation.

kok: Tophano oborok bataimung tongphano, khul swnamkhor hayungrwgwi rangthongni bagwi nangkukmani bwkhak tongo.
en: Despite these challenges, the cotton industry remains an important part of the global economy.

kok: Obo chirasai borokno samung bago tei omo no yaphang mal ajinani kwbangma hamwrwk hakotor rogo.
en: It provides jobs for millions of people and is a source of vital income for many developing countries.

kok: Kwchanghakchalni, khul wngkha kwbang sinai tei twihmanaijat manwi-khwnwi je wngmanwi kaisa kuar rem o phwnangjago, richummani simi nok sajukjakmani.
en: Furthermore, cotton is a versatile and sustainable material that is used in a wide range of products, from clothing to home furnishings.

kok: Hayungrwgwi choyai bohrok bangmani bwkhak toro, khulni sanmarok kuchugo tongnani wngwimano.
en: As the global population continues to grow, the demand for cotton is likely to remain high.

kok: Omo khul swnamkhor bagwi kainwino wngtongmani bataimarok tei hamjorarok.
en: This presents both challenges and opportunities for the cotton industry.

kok: Chakra Mrs. Brown bini nokbwsa ni nuka o báchajak, chwrairokno nokhla thwngmano naisigwi tongo.
en: Old Mrs. Brown stood on the porch of her small cottage, watching the children play in the yard.

kok: Bo bini busuk bwrwino nugwi mwnwikha, Lily bo kubun chwrairokbai khaichik kha tei bahor kha.
en: She smiled as she saw her granddaughter, Lily, run and jump with the other children.

kok: Lily khe kwchwng tei khasrangjak chwrai, tei Mrs. Brown bini bagwi kung chugo.
en: Lily was a bright and cheerful child, and Mrs. Brown was proud of her.

kok: Mrs. Brown bwchwi wngmani kwbangma bisi wngjak, tei bo swngcharni kwbangma slaijakmung rokno nukjak.
en: Mrs. Brown had been a grandmother for many years, and she had seen many changes in the world.

kok: Bo kwbangma Bubagraha kasamani tei baimani nukha, kwtal tangsep achaimani tei thwimani, tei kwbangma tongdálrok phaimani tei thángmani.
en: She had seen the rise and fall of empires, the birth and death of new technologies, and the coming and going of many different fashions.

kok: Phiyaba aborokni bising twi kaisa tongrwkmani abo khe: bwchwi bai busukni hamjakmung.
en: But through it all, one thing had remained constant: the love between a grandmother and her grandchild.

kok: Mrs. Brown saimano bo simibo omohai khoroksa Bwchwi ya ahaikhe uansugwitongnai.
en: Mrs. Brown knew that she was not the only grandmother who felt this way.

kok: Bebak Swngchar gwnangwi, kwbangma bwchwirok tongo bohrokni busukrokno hamjakai bo jeswk Lilyno hamjakma haino.
en: All over the world, there were grandmothers who loved their grandchildren just as much as she loved Lily.

kok: Tei abohai hamjakmung belai phan gwnang abo babakni slai phano kwrak khe bachaimano.
en: And this love was a powerful force that could stand against anything.

kok: Mrs. Brown bo nukha Bwchwi tei busukni hamjakmung abo jora hamya o phano kwchai tongo, sitra chóba o, tei thwimani jora hamyarogo.
en: Mrs. Brown had seen the love between a grandmother and her grandchild stand against the ravages of time, the cruelty of war, and even the indifference of death.

kok: Bo saimno hamjakmung wngkha kaisa nangkukmani hili, tei bo salbrumno hambai rwo bo bini bsusuk bai tongnani jora manmani bagwi.
en: She knew that this love was a precious gift, and she was grateful for every day that she could spend with her granddaughter.

kok: Ah rutukrwk rwngnok kaisa dadarmung tongrem wngkha tini khoroksa chakra soisikwrwng thwimungni olo.
en: The research institute was in a state of shock today after the death of one of its leading scientists.

kok: Dr. Teklu bini habanok o kwthwih mankha, kaisa bwkha khwchai nukjakmani simi.
en: Dr. Teklu was found dead in his office, apparently from a heart attack.

kok: Bo kaisa buchuk-nukmya porimani ah mothok sago klaimarok borokni sago samung khai tongmani.
en: He had been working on a top-secret study of the effects of stress on the human body.

kok: Ah koktunmarok Dr. Teklu's thwimung ah soisikwrwng hoda twih shockwaves hokha.
en: The news of Dr. Teklu's death has sent shockwaves through the scientific community.

kok: Bo kaisa khoroksa bomtomgwnang soisikwrwng tei khoroksa bwkhani tangsong.
en: He was a brilliant scientist and a beloved colleague.

kok: Bini thwimung wngma kaisa bithi ni khola bwkhak kaisa kotorkuar kwmama.
en: His death is a great loss to the field of medicine.

kok: Oh rwngnok kaisa naiphnikmung chengjakha ah Dr.Teklu's thwimung bagwi.
en: The institute has launched an investigation into the cause of Dr. Teklu's death.

kok: Oh jora, omo sraisraiya bobo bini thwimung bini samung porima mothok saka bai halokjak wngkha.
en: At this time, it is unclear whether his death was related to his work on the stress study.

kok: Haiphano, ah rwngnok ah manwi no belai kubui khlai nai tongkha tei swmai tangjak bwkhak khasrai khlaimani je sebukrokni katima wngkha homnino kaisa buchuk tangswkang.
en: However, the institute is taking the matter very seriously and is committed to ensuring that the safety of its employees is always a top priority.

kok: Dr. Teklu's thwimung wngkha kaisa khaduma muitonarwkma ah khapang sakduk nangkuma.
en: Dr. Teklu's death is a tragic reminder of the importance of mental health.

kok: Mothok wngkha kaisa kubui kebengmung je kaisa swbaimani sekrupma chini sakno twywi tei khanangjakma kaham-wngjak.
en: Stress is a serious problem that can have a devastating impact on our physical and emotional well-being.

kok: Ah wngthahng bising, aro kaisa jora tongo jephuru ah hating habar bumukrok bai rungjak tongo.
en: In the past, there was a time when the Earth was abundant with natural resources.

kok: Aro kotor bolongrok tongjak, ah twibom bising ah kuplung, tei kwchwng nokbar hama nasama bwkhak.
en: There were vast forests, plentiful fish in the sea, and clean air to breathe.

kok: Phiya jora rwgwi, borokrok oh bumurokno bukcha khlaikha ah buchuk bwkhak boro bohrok tabuk rwkma wngkha.
en: But over time, humans have depleted these resources to the point where they are now scarce.

kok: Ah bolongrok tola raphai khibijak baikha lama swnama bwkhak khamparok tei doyungrokni bagwi.
en: The forests have been cut down to make way for farms and cities.

kok: Ah ah twibomni bising belai ah romajakha.
en: The fish in the sea have been overfished.

kok: Tei ah nokbar sitrajak tongo sapulswnamjakrok tei phaprok bai.
en: And the air has been polluted with chemicals and gases.

kok: Omoni thaihmung, ah hating tabuk kwbangma habar kebengmung malaimani wngkha, ahaino nobartwibar slaima, bolong hokmani, tei sitrarimung khaikha.
en: As a result, the Earth is now facing a number of environmental problems, such as climate change, deforestation, and pollution.

kok: Tumungno chwng chini habar bumurok khatima bwkhak samung nayakhe, borok paithago bukcha khlaikha tei chwng kwbangma uansukrak thaihmungrok bwskang ma wngnai.
en: If we do not take action to conserve our natural resources, they will eventually be depleted and we will face a number of serious consequences.

kok: Chwng slaisong pherengni yaphang naitukna bwkhak ma khlainai, tei chwng ah nokbartwibar slaimasago kwlaima bai lenden ma khlainai.
en: We will have to find alternative sources of energy, we will have to deal with the effects of climate change, and we will have to find ways to clean up the pollution we have created.

kok: Samung khwlaina jora tabukno.
en: The time to act is now.

kok: Chwng chini habar bumurokno ma khatinai tei ah habar katirwma thinang bosongrokni bagwi.
en: We must conserve our natural resources and protect the environment for future generations.

kok: Tabukni ojora, naithokmung tei chukmungno twywi chini hoda kha hapsukjakni kwbangma mari nukjagwi tongo.
en: Today, there are many signs that our society is obsessed with beauty and fitness.

kok: Plastic surgery tei diet fad uarmungni simi chengwi social media khaswlainai nukjakma jora, obohaikhe matongo je naithok hwnwi chongjakni bagwi chwng bahaikhe nukjaknani tei samung tangnani nang abonni koktun pirwi chwng thakyaui twikhreng kwlairwi tongo.
en: From the prevalence of plastic surgery and diet fads to the rise of social media influencers, it seems that we are constantly bombarded with messages about how we need to look and act in order to be considered beautiful.

kok: Naithokmungni bagwi o kha hapsukmani kwbangma hamya wngmung wngwimano, oboni bisingo tongo sak mangni jwngjal, chahmungni bemar, tei kha baimung.
en: This obsession with beauty can have a number of negative consequences, including body image issues, eating disorders, and depression.

kok: Oh kok muitu narwknani nangkugo je naithokmung sakni nukjakma simia.
en: It is important to remember that beauty is not just about physical appearance.

kok: Obo wngkha chini bisingni hammarino, romdi chini khakamma, uansukphan tei chukphan twywi.
en: It is also about our inner qualities, such as our kindness, intelligence, and strength.

kok: Chwng jephuru oh hammarirokni sakao kaichomo, aphuru chwng kwkubuini tongthokmung tei kupulwng wngjakno naitugwi mananw.
en: When we focus on these qualities, we are more likely to find true happiness and fulfillment.

kok: Chini sak-naikani biyalni bagwi chwng je lamtwi derasupungwi tongo abono twywibo chwng hoda wngnani nango.
en: We should also be aware of the ways in which we are compensating for our lack of self-care.

kok: Phunukmarini bagwi, Tumung chwng chini nukjakmano hamrwnani chaitogwi choyaui diet khwlayo eba sajokjaknai manwirogo rang swbayo hinkhe abo chwng chini kebengmungno kholopnani chaitokmase kwlayo.
en: For example, if we are constantly dieting or spending money on beauty products in an attempt to improve our appearance, we may be trying to cover up our insecurities.

kok: Chini nukjakmano swlainani chaitokmani swlai, chwng jetwikhe tongo atwikheno sakno hamjakthani tei gosiui nahathani kharwna nango.
en: Instead of trying to change our appearance, we should focus on loving and accepting ourselves for who we are.

kok: Tongthokmung tei kupulwng gwnang langmani bagwi chini sak tei khapangni naikani khwlainani nangsugo.
en: Taking care of our physical and mental health is essential for living a happy and fulfilling life.

kok: Jephuru chwng sakno naikani khwlayo, aphuru chwng hayungno kokti pirwi tongo je chwng hamjakmung tei boromni bagwi chukjak.
en: When we take care of ourselves, we are sending a message to the world that we are worthy of love and respect.

kok: Ah yoga adongrok sokpaikma bising ah chikonsa aoli pherkha kaisa lorirwma paisugwi.
en: The arrival of the yoga agencies in the small town caused quite a stir.

kok: Oroni borok simuchung wngkha omo kwtal loi khlaimung bagwi, tei baksa ahaino skeptical wngkha.
en: The locals were curious about this new practice, and some were even skeptical.

kok: Phiya ah yogis bohrokni koktun kwchangtotok tei hamjakma auaima bwkhak khathonjak wngkha.
en: But the yogis were determined to spread their message of peace and love.

kok: Bohrok ah aolikhumbari bising remrok khaiyo phiyokjak tangkhor yapharkha.
en: They held classes in the park and offered free workshops.

kok: Bohrok kaisa hoda thai chengkha boro borok hai yoga loi khlaimung tei diyaimani bagwi swrwng mano.
en: They also started a community center where people could come to practice yoga and learn about meditation.

kok: Salsa, khoroksa bwrwima sikli Sarah mungwi ah hoda thai phaikha.
en: One day, a young woman named Sarah came to the community center.

kok: Bo mothokma wansukmanai tei khasumsukma wngdrop wngkha, tei bo khajamani je yoga bono lenglama bwkhak chubai mano.
en: She had been feeling stressed and overwhelmed lately, and she was hoping that yoga could help her to relax.

kok: Bo kaisa rem nakha khoroksa yogis bai, tei bo daktino thepajak thangkha.
en: She took a class with one of the yogis, and she was immediately hooked.

kok: Bo sal thwgwi rem bwkhak phainani chengkha, tei bo daktino teibo wansukma bwkhak binisaksak bai kwchangtotok manna chengkha.
en: She started coming to class every day, and she soon began to feel more at peace with herself.

kok: Sarah ni saimanjak wngkha haino kaisa phunukmari bahaikhe yoga langmarok swlai man.
en: Sarah's experience is just one example of how yoga can change lives.

kok: Yoga wngkha kaisa phangwnang loi khlaimung je borok motok khaina, bohrokni sakduk hamrina, tei bohrokni bisingnisaksakrok bai kwrwngma.
en: Yoga is a powerful practice that can help people to reduce stress, improve their health, and connect with their inner selves.

kok: Buini kok ma na mani abo belai khe no jwngjal kotor se abo baithang ni langma o kaham eba hamya wng rwo.
en: Peer pressure is a significant issue that can have a major impact on a person's life.

kok: Abo khoroksa baithang kaisa bodol ni tongmung chamungno chagwi gosewi nahar manibo hwnmano.
en: It can be defined as the influence that a group of people has on an individual to conform to their norms and values.

kok: Bwini kokno na mani abo kaham bo tongo hamya bo tongo, phiya abo hamya phaisingo mangno nukjakugo borokrokni lama saiwi nathani o.
en: Peer pressure can be both positive and negative, but it is often seen as a negative force that can lead people to make poor choices.

kok: Kwbangma dalbidal lama tongwi mano buini kok ma na mano twywi abo ahai no sijagwi thango.
en: There are many different ways that peer pressure can manifest itself.

kok: Kaisa nukjakuk mani wng kha baithang khe dage jakmani, abo jephuru bodol kaisa ni dolrok kaisa samung no khwlaina muchung jakya wngkhe tei khoroksa no khwlai rwna bagwi chaitogo.
en: One common form is through direct pressure, such as when a group of friends tries to convince someone to do something they do not want to do.

kok: Tei kaisa khe bwini bisingtwi kok ma namani, abo wngkha jephuru borok khoroksa kaisa bodol bai kwtha'ui tongna bagwi kok ma namani.
en: Another form of peer pressure is indirect pressure, which can occur when a person feels like they need to do something in order to fit in with a group.

kok: Drugs nana bagwi dagi jakmarok eba sak motoktwi tongna bagwi dagi jakmarok khe belai no hamya khwlayo.
en: This can be especially damaging when it comes to issues such as drug use or sexual activity.

kok: Kok ma namanirok abo jora no rwgwi se wngo abo kisa eba kwbang phano wngwi mano
en: The intensity of peer pressure can vary depending on the situation.

kok: Phunuk mari wngkha, khoroksaswk kwtal bodolni dolrok bai kwthana bagwi a bodol o hab khe bo kok ma nakuk ma hai khe ma tongnai swkang puila a bodol tongsok nairokni swlaibo.
en: For example, someone who is trying to fit in with a new group of friends may feel more pressure to conform than someone who is already well-established in a group.

kok: Kok ma namani abo sakni thani o se tei sakni muchungma tong khe se najak o.
en: The intensity of peer pressure can also depend on the individual's personality and self-esteem.

kok: Je borok kwrak khe tongwi manai tei kiriya borok hairok simi se buini kok ma namani yakni yogwi manai borok kebelrokni swlai le.
en: People who are more confident and assertive are less likely to be swayed by peer pressure than those who are more insecure.

kok: Nwngwi chalukmani kaisa kubui kebengmung je borokno gwdalmarok simi jotto langma himnairokni thani.
en: Drunk driving is a serious problem that affects people from all walks of life.

kok: Omo lekhakhe je 10, 000 saka borok nwngwi chalukmani laharpatimungrogo bwtharjago bisi thwgwi ah kaisa United States simi.
en: It is estimated that over 10,000 people are killed in drunk driving accidents each year in the United States alone.

kok: Ah nwngwi chalukmani bwthaih thaihma wngkha hakchal-sogwmani tei swbaiamanai, khoroksani bagwi simiya je bwtharjakna eba sakdukhu manai, phiya bohrokni nukhungni tei bayaprok bo.
en: The effects of drunk driving are far-reaching and devastating, not only for the individual who is killed or injured, but also for their families and friends.

kok: Ah borok lamaol jora rwmani bising, nwngwi chalukmani wngkha kaisa nangkukma rangthong sekrupma tongo.
en: In addition to the human toll, drunk driving also has a significant economic impact.

kok: Ah hodapharwk lahar thahnglaiso katima bugrasamung lekhamarok je nwngwi chalukmani swkrok ah Uunited States no bisi thwgwi $44 rarwjag saka sakham rang swbairimarok, duna thaihmung kwmama, tei manwiphan piyakmung.
en: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration estimates that drunk driving costs the United States over $44 billion each year in medical expenses, lost productivity, and property damage.

kok: Tophano nwngwi chalukmani ah sraisrai akochorok, omo choyai kaisa kebengmung wngnai.
en: Despite the clear dangers of drunk driving, it continues to be a problem.

kok: 2018 o, 30% chaluknairok je malkhung mothorjaknai sukrubjagwi thwinai rok borokgni thwiyo kephekmanwi kwrwngsa khlaimani (BAC) 0.08 eba gwnang.
en: In 2018, 30% of drivers who were killed in motor vehicle crashes had a blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of 0.08 or higher.

kok: Oh kokmarok wngkha je bohrok raidakhai nwngjak.
en: This means that they were legally drunk.

kok: Aro kwbangma manwirok tongo je ah nwngwi chalukmani kebengmung nikuma khai mano.
en: There are a number of things that can be done to address the problem of drunk driving.

kok: Omo kwrakuk phanbai khlaimani nwngwi chalukmani kerongrokni bagwi, luku sirimani saklamungrok, tei rwng pandarok.
en: These include stricter enforcement of drunk driving laws, public awareness campaigns, and education programs.

kok: Chwng jottono kaisa tangmung ma thangnai nwngwi chalukmani kasuthani.
en: We all have a role to play in preventing drunk driving.

kok: Ani mapharok khoroknwino sosikwrwng wngkha.
en: My parents are both scientists.

kok: Ani ama wngkha khoroksa molecular biologist, tei ani apha wngkha khoroksa chemist.
en: My mom is a molecular biologist, and my dad is a chemist.

kok: Bohrok Germany o thansa kaisa rutwkrwk swnamma sakao samung khailaiphuru bohrok aphuru malaikha.
en: They met while they were working on a research project together in Germany.

kok: Ang muitomano ang jephuru chwraiphuru, ang bohrokni lab o thango tei bohrokno samung khaimani nayo.
en: I remember when I was little, I would go to their lab and watch them work.

kok: Ang jotto ah juda juda chemicals tei manwirok nainani hamjago tei ang homnino bohrokno swngmungrok swngo bohrok tamo khlai tong hwnwi.
en: I loved seeing all the different chemicals and equipment, and I would always ask them questions about what they were doing.

kok: Kaisa manwirok je ang muitomano jottoni slai ani mapharokni bagwi wngkha ah lama bohrok bohrokni samung bagwi kok sao.
en: One of the things that I remember most about my parents is the way they would talk about their work.

kok: Bohrok homnino aswkno omo ni bagwi khamuchungjak wngkha, tei bohrok kubuino tongthojago jephuru bohrok bohrokni kwtal karimarokni bagwi koksamani.
en: They were always so passionate about it, and they would get really excited when they were talking about their latest discoveries.

kok: Ang wansukha je ano tamo khaswrangrwjak khoroksa soisirkwrwng angsaksak wngna bwkhak wngkha.
en: I think that's what inspired me to become a scientist myself.

kok: Ang aswkno tongthokjak mohai mapharok manwi je ani rwng no aswkno twichurujak wngkha.
en: I'm so grateful to have parents who are so supportive of my education.

kok: Bohrok homnino ano khatungrijak ani imangrokno rwtharna bagwi, tei bohrok homnini aro tong ano ah himlang logi chubana bwkhak.
en: They've always encouraged me to follow my dreams, and they've always been there to help me along the way.

kok: Ang saimano je ang mapahrok kahamma karwi sanwi tongwi mangwlak.
en: I know that I couldn't have asked for better parents.

kok: Kuphung wngkha kaisa lukuni sakduk kebengmung, ah United States bising khorokkthamni bisingo khoroksa okrarokno nangrwmani.
en: Obesity is a major public health problem, affecting one in three adults in the United States.

kok: Aro kwbangma kusungchwlwirok tongo je kuphung khangma bwkhak, genetics khobwinai, chahthaim, tei tongdal.
en: There are many factors that contribute to obesity, including genetics, diet, and lifestyle.

kok: Jephuru aro gwdalmung wngkha khoroksa phai jotto torma khropsa wngya hilikmung khaina bwkhak, aro wngkha kwbangma manwirok je borok naharmung sakdukma loirok tei hilikmung seplema bwkhak khlaimano.
en: While there is no one-size-fits-all solution to weight loss, there are a number of things that people can do to adopt healthier habits and lose weight.

kok: Kaisa nangkukm yapri wngkha kaisa mahmlaima bwkha naima, ahaino kaisa saknainai eba chaihthai swnamnai, je nono hamkrai kaisa sakphangjak hilikmung khaina chapmung.
en: One important step is to see a specialist, such as a doctor or dietitian, who can help you develop a personalized weight loss plan.

kok: Oh chapmung nama bising thikemung nini saksakni nangma tei sokthairok, tei omo nomo nini chahthai tei tongdal bwkhak remtang swlaimrok bwkhak swnamma chubai mano je ah kolok joraari sakao tikimannai wngkha.
en: This plan will take into account your individual needs and goals, and will help you make gradual changes to your diet and lifestyle that are sustainable over the long term.

kok: Tei kaisa nangkukma yapri wngkha sakdukjak loirok naaharmung.
en: Another important step is to adopt healthier habits.

kok: Omo kaisa sakdukma chahthai chahmani, sabrumbrum sakswnama manmani, tei nangmaswk thunna manmani.
en: This includes eating a healthy diet, getting regular exercise, and getting enough sleep.

kok: Nini tongdal bwkhak chikonsa swlaimarok swnammani, ahaino norwi khibima chini nwngmarok tei hamya chahthai, tei 30 sotirok sal thwgwi himmani bagwi, kaisa kotor pherlaimung swnamo jora kolok romwi.
en: Making small changes to your lifestyle, such as cutting out sugary drinks and processed foods, and walking for 30 minutes every day, can make a big difference over time.

kok: Paithago, omo wngkha kaisa nangkukma kwchang tei thangkhrupma.
en: Finally, it is important to be patient and persistent.

kok: Hilikmung khaina wngkha kaisa beraima, kaisa sogwimaniya.
en: Weight loss is a journey, not a destination.

kok: Aro kasomungrok tongnai ah lama logi, phiya omo wngkha nangkukma naisikmanjak tongna nini sokthairok tei bwskang agukmani bwkhak.
en: There will be setbacks along the way, but it is important to stay focused on your goals and keep moving forward.

kok: Hukba tei bolong wngkha kainwi ah jottoni slai nangkukma swnammungrok ah hayung bising, chahthai tei rarwjak borokni bagwi tongthai manthokmani khayo.
en: Agriculture and forestry are two of the most important industries in the world, providing food and shelter for billions of people.

kok: Haiphano, oh swnammungrok bo kotor bakmarok wngkha nokbartwibar swlaima bwkhak, bomo kaisa swbaimani sekrupma ah bahngmarok sakao.
en: However, these industries are also major contributors to climate change, which is having a devastating impact on fish populations.

kok: Ah hitingni tungmari kasamungrok bai, ah twijlangrok kutung tei teibo acidic wngo.
en: As the Earth's temperature rises, the oceans become warmer and more acidic.

kok: Omo ah rokni bagwi thangna bwkhak omo 3 swnamo, tei kwbangma dahlrok komornani bwkhak rwkjakma wngo.
en: This makes it difficult for fish to survive, and many species are being driven to extinction.

kok: Jora rwmani bising, nokbartwibai swlaima wngkha twibom milrok phermani kasama bwkhak, bomo twirukung tongthairok akochomani wngkha tei ah rokni bagwi omo 3 swnammani chahthai tei bahmani harok sogwima bwkhak.
en: In addition, climate change is causing sea levels to rise, which is destroying coastal habitats and making it difficult for fish to access food and breeding grounds.

kok: Ah kwmamani wngkha kaisa kubui kebengmung, iko ah wngkha kaisa mal bokcho ah chathaih kitingjak.
en: The loss of fish is a serious problem, as fish are a vital part of the food chain.

kok: Bohrok bohrokni bagwi chahthai, malmatarok, tei kubun twibom langma manthokrwi mano.
en: They provide food for people, animals, and other marine life.

kok: Ah bo ah twijlang habartangdal cholirwna bwkhak chubao, tei ah jotto hating sakao kaisa twitheka sago kwlaima bohrokni kwmama tongma mano.
en: Fish also help to regulate the ocean's ecosystem, and their loss could have a ripple effect on the entire planet.

kok: Chwng samung nana nango nokbartwibar swlaina nikukma bwkhak tei ah bahngmarok katirwma.
en: We need to take action to address climate change and protect fish populations.

kok: Chwng chini nokkwkhwrang phap emissions, paiphwlaiya pherang bising yapharmani, tei twirukung tongmanthai katirwimani lonmai bai omo khwlai mano.
en: We can do this by reducing our greenhouse gas emissions, investing in renewable energy, and protecting coastal habitats.

kok: Chwng chini chahmungrok, teibo buphang-uaphang yaphang chahthairok chamani teu chini ah baimung lonmani.
en: We can also make changes to our diets, eating more plant-based foods and reducing our consumption of fish.

kok: Haini kisa thangnai tal swkang, kaisa sikla Japanese bojro belai tongthokjak borok ni puila chwrai no oh hayungo lamsogwi.
en: Just a few months ago, a young Japanese couple were overjoyed to welcome their first child into the world.

kok: Oh absakwlwi, khoroksa bwrwi naithokma, Sakura mungwi narakjakha cherry khumbar ulo je Japan o saslang thwgwi baro.
en: The baby, a beautiful girl, was named Sakura after the cherry blossoms that bloom in Japan each spring.

kok: Oh bojro rok belai tongthokjak bohrokni kwtal nukhungo jora rwmani, phiya bohrok saimano bataimungrok je bwskango tonijak.
en: The couple was very happy with their new addition to the family, but they were also aware of the challenges that lay ahead.

kok: Borok khoroknwino samung khaina kwrwngrok, tei bohrok saimanao je bohrok kisa yakarna nangnai bohrokni bwsajwkno tholmung swnamtonina bagwi.
en: They were both working professionals, and they knew that they would have to make some sacrifices in order to provide for their daughter.

kok: Haiphano, bohrok khathonjak Sakura no kahamkuk langma chuksak rinai hwnwi, tei bohrok kharakjak je bohrok bohrokni samungrok tei borokgni nukhungno homan khe toninani.
en: However, they were determined to give Sakura the best possible life, and they were confident that they would be able to balance their careers and their family.

kok: Sakura torkheno, bo kaisa kwchwng tei khasrangjak chwrai wngkha.
en: As Sakura grew, she became a bright and cheerful child.

kok: Bo bini mapha tei bini dada songbai thwngna hamjago, tei bo homnino bohrokni mwkhangrok kaisa mwnwima tubu o.
en: She loved to play with her parents and her older brother, and she always brought a smile to their faces.

kok: Ah bojro rok bohrokni bwsajwk bai belai kungchukjak, tei bohrok beli khatung khajak je bo bohrokn langmao tongthok tubumani.
en: The couple was so proud of their daughter, and they were grateful for the joy that she brought into their lives.

kok: Bohrok saimano je bohrok bono manwi kaham chapmung swnamkha, tei bohrok belai tongthokjak thinang o bini bagwi tamo nujak.
en: They knew that they had made the right decision to have her, and they were excited to see what the future held for her.

kok: Sakura torwi khoroksa khlaimanjak bwrwima wngkha.
en: Sakura grew up to be a successful woman.

kok: Bo bini mapha songni' yaprimari rwktharwi tei khoroksa doctor wngkha, tei bo bini langmano kubunrokno chubamani bwkhak saktharkha.
en: She followed in her parents' footsteps and became a doctor, and she dedicated her life to helping others.

kok: Para wngkha siniya malmata, bini kolok, chalibak yethekrok tei kotor, kiting mokolrok.
en: The para was a strange creature, with its long, spindly legs and large, round eyes.

kok: Abo bolong kuthuk bisingo tongo hwnwi sajago, tei belai kisa borok waisa nukphu.
en: It was said to live in the depths of the forest, and few people had ever seen it.

kok: Baksa manthai naimanayo je oh malamata belai kirimasinsa, tei kubunrok khe sao je abo mungsakhaiya hwnwi.
en: Some claimed that it was a dangerous creature, while others said that it was harmless.

kok: Salsa, soisikwrwng buthup parano naitukna hwnwi chongkha.
en: One day, a group of scientists decided to go in search of the para.

kok: Bohrok bolong kuthugo berailaikha, tei phaithogo borok kwchwng khai phaikha.
en: They traveled deep into the forest, and eventually they came to a clearing.

kok: Kwchwng khai tongma kwcharo aro buphang kotorma, tei a buphang bedego para achugwi tongo.
en: In the middle of the clearing was a large tree, and sitting on a branch of the tree was the para.

kok: Soisikwrwngrok mwlangchajak bohrok tamo nukha hwnwi.
en: The scientists were amazed by what they saw.

kok: Para aphuru bohrok wansukmani slai phano teibo sinijakya.
en: The para was even stranger than they had imagined.

kok: Omoni kwkhrang bukur, tei mokol omoni mokolrok kubung khrangjiji.
en: It had green skin, and its eyes were a deep blue.

kok: Soisikwrwngrok parano swrapsa naitonglaikha, tei bohrok yakarna hwnwi chongkha.
en: The scientists watched the para for a while, and then they decided to leave.

kok: Bohrok parano teibo porina muchungjakmani, phiya bohrok saimano je bohrok naikani khaina nango hwnwi.
en: They wanted to study the para more, but they knew that they would need to be careful.

kok: Kwdwkma jora romwi, aro khoroksa bwrwima sikli nung Svetlana wngwi tongo je bini sexualityni bagwi kuthukma nanglaijak wngkha.
en: Once upon a time, there was a young woman named Svetlana who was deeply conflicted about her sexuality.

kok: Bo kaisa conservative hoda bising torrwjak je phwrwngma wngkha je dahl wngkha haino bwsa wngrwmani, tei bo wansugwi lachijakha tei bini muchungmarok bagwi chaya khlainai wngkha .
en: She was raised in a conservative community that taught that sex was only for procreation, and she felt ashamed and guilty for her desires.

kok: Salsa, Svetlana khoroks chwla mung Volodymyr mungwi malaikha je jebakhoroksa simi pherlaima wngkha bo swkango jottojora malaima.
en: One day, Svetlana met a man named Volodymyr who was different from anyone she had ever met before.

kok: Bo khula-bwkha tei gosimani wngkha, tei bo bono naina bwkhak chubakha je bini sexuality bai aro mungsaphano chaya kwrwi wngkha.
en: He was open-minded and accepting, and he helped her to see that there was nothing wrong with her sexuality.

kok: Volodymhr's chubachu bai, Svetlana paithago bini kubui sak no lamsokma bwkhak chengkha, tei bo thongthokmani mankha tei bini halokbokmarok bising supungwi mankha.
en: With Volodymyr's help, Svetlana finally began to embrace her true self, and she found happiness and fulfillment in her relationships.

kok: Svetlana's kothoma wngkha kaisa muito narakma je sexuality wngkha kaisa habar tei sakdukma bokcho borok wngjakni.
en: Svetlana's story is a reminder that sexuality is a natural and healthy part of being human.

kok: Omo kaisa kotor kuar khasrang yaphang tei tongthok, tei omo kaisa lama kubunrok bai kwrwngna bwkha kaisa kuthuk mil sakao bo wngwi mano.
en: It can be a source of great joy and pleasure, and it can also be a way to connect with others on a deep level.

kok: Jephuru chwng chini sexuality bo gosiwui nakha, chwng teibo kubuiphunukma tei kuplungma khai tongwi mano.
en: When we are able to accept our sexuality, we can live more authentically and fully.

kok: Aow, aro homnino nanglaimungrok wngkha je yaksiyagra sexuality sichama mano.
en: Of course, there are always conflicts that can arise around sexuality.

kok: Svetlana's tanghalok bising, bo bini sakni muchungmarok kwcharo ah nanglaimung bai naimung bwkhak tongo tei bini hoda ni morokjakrok.
en: In Svetlana's case, she had to deal with the conflict between her own desires and the values of her community.

kok: Oh nanglaimung 3 bwkhak navigate khlaimano, phiya omo wngna muitomanma bwkhak nangkukma je aro mungsa kubui lama kwrwi sexual wngna bwkhak.
en: This conflict can be difficult to navigate, but it is important to remember that there is no one right way to be sexual.

kok: Kwdwkma jora romwi, aro bwrwi sikli khoroksa Anya mungwi chikonsa kamio tongo.
en: Once upon a time, there was a young woman named Anya who lived in a small village.

kok: Bo belai kaham tei kwraksamung khainai bwrwi, phiyaba bo belaino saichung.
en: She was a kind and hardworking girl, but she was also very lonely.

kok: Bini mapha song thwijakha bo jephuru chwrai phuru, tei bini kebo bwtha-bahano kwrwi.
en: Her parents had died when she was young, and she had no siblings.

kok: Salsa, jephuru Anya bolongo himwi tongphuru bo kaisa siniya nukmung ayang naro nuk phaikha.
en: One day, Anya was walking in the forest when she came across a strange sight.

kok: Aro kaisa kotorma, nok kuphur buphangni kwcharo, tei abo kuchuk hathe bai khopjak.
en: There was a large, white house in the middle of the trees, and it was surrounded by a high wall.

kok: Anya waisaphano mohai nokrok swkango nukyakhu, tei bo khatungjakha.
en: Anya had never seen the house before, and she was curious.

kok: Bo hathe sakao kasana hwnwi chongwi nakha tei ganarwk khe naisikma nanani.
en: She decided to climb over the wall and take a closer look.

kok: Bo jephuru bisingo hapbo, bo nukha je a nok bukcha hwnwi.
en: When she got inside, she saw that the house was empty.

kok: Aro mungsa tonikhok, mungsa naithokrwma kwrwi, tei aro khoroksaphano tongnai hwnwi mungsa mari kwrwi.
en: There was no furniture, no decorations, and no sign of anyone living there.

kok: Anya yakarwi thangna naiphuru bojora bo khorang kaisa khwnakha.
en: Anya was about to leave when she heard a noise.

kok: Bo yaksiyagra philkheno tei nukha khoroksa chwla sikla dogalamo bachajak.
en: She turned around and saw a young man standing in the doorway.

kok: "mwsadi, Henry, mwsadi" bwrwichwk khoroksa chirikha "mwsadi tei langmani palirok nini yangtwi kochogwi thang thwng.
en: "Dance, Henry, dance" the old woman cried "Dance and let the colors of life flow through you.

kok: Rwchapmungrok nini phola no supungwi tei nini sakno lorinani sakni gothokma twi.
en: Let the music fill your soul and your body will move of its own accord.

kok: Mwsadi tei yokdi" Henry bwrwichwk no naisikha palkwrwi bai.
en: Dance and be free" Henry looked at the old woman with confusion.

kok: Bo mwsanakwrwng boya, tei bo buchiwuise manya tangwi bo aswk khamkano khlaima je bo tabuk chngna nango hwnwi.
en: He had never been a dancer, and he didn't understand why she was so insistent that he should start now.

kok: Phiya ah bwrwichwk ni mokol belai kwchwng tei bini mwkhango tongthokma bai supungjak, tei Henry sakno chubai manliya phiya bising sotonjak thangkha.
en: But the old woman's eyes were bright and her face was filled with joy, and Henry couldn't help but be drawn in.

kok: Bo kaisa hama kolok nai tei lorina chengkha.
en: He took a deep breath and began to move.

kok: Puilao, bini ninangrimungrok belai sitra tei sakphoro, phiya bo choyai mwsakha, bo lenglama chengkha tei rwchangmungno nai paina rwkha.
en: At first, his movements were awkward and hesitant, but as he continued to dance, he began to relax and let the music take over.

kok: Hayung ni palirok bono kwrwngwi gurirwi tongkha, tei bo kaisa sina simanwi yokmung tei tongthok je bo waisaphano agi sinijakya khu.
en: The colors of the world swirled around him, and he felt a sense of freedom and joy that he had never experienced before.

kok: Jephuru rwchapmung bathakha, Henry hamathajak tei swrangrijak.
en: When the music stopped, Henry was breathless and exhilarated.

kok: Bo ah bwrwichwk no naisikha tei mwmwikha "hambai nono, " bo sakha "ang saimanya tangwi agi ang mwsajakya.
en: He looked at the old woman and smiled "Thank you," he said "I don't know why I didn't dance before.

kok: Ang muitomano nwng jephuru chikonsa wngkha, nwng ah lenglanasalrok wngjora ah twirwkong bwkhak thangnani hamjakha.
en: I remember when you were little, you loved going to the beach during the holidays.

kok: Nwng ah haching bising thwngmani tei ah twijilang bising twiyokmani damrwirok katimani.
en: You would spend hours playing in the sand and swimming in the ocean.

kok: Ang muitomano jora waisa, nwng kaisa hachingsa buguranok tisana bwkhak aswkno tongthokjak wngkha je nwng twiyoknani thangna phano muchungjakya.
en: I remember one time, you were so excited to build a sandcastle that you didn't even want to go swimming.

kok: Nwng damrwirok bagwi je bugranok sakao samung khaikha, tei jephuru omo paithago paikha, omo wngkha ah jottoni swlai uanaminsa hachingsa bugrakhor ang jottojora nukha.
en: You worked on that castle for hours, and when it was finally finished, it was the most amazing sandcastle I had ever seen.

kok: Nwng aswkno sasksakno kharuarjak wngjakha, tei ang aswkno nini bagwi khaurjak wngkha.
en: You were so proud of yourself, and I was so proud of you.

kok: Ang muitomano ang nini bugrakhor ganao bachawui nini kaisa mangpili namani, tei nini mwkhango belai kotorma mwnwima tongo.
en: I remember taking a picture of you standing next to your castle, and you had the biggest smile on your face.

kok: Abo wngkha kaisa ani chajakma muituphan chini thansa lenglalmasalrok bagwi.
en: That was one of my favorite memories of our holidays together.

kok: Ang saimano nwng chakrama wngkha, tei nwng ah twirwkong chajakya wngwimano agi nwng chajakm hai.
en: I know you're older now, and you might not like the beach as much as you used to.

kok: Phiya ani khajamung ah hachingo thwngmani tei twijlango twiyokmani nwng ah tongthok manmani abono nwng homnino muitonaraknani.
en: But I hope you'll always remember the joy you used to find in playing in the sand and swimming in the ocean.

kok: Aborok wngkha ani langmani bagwi kisa kaham muituphan, tei ani khajamung aborok nini bagwi kisasa.
en: Those are some of the best memories of my life, and I hope they're some of yours too.

kok: Khajani Dr.Smith, ang nono tini swihoro babai kisa khwnathotok koktun bwkhak wngwipaidrop omotoi sakham pinnok pacific salgra no twi.
en: Dear Dr. Smith, I am writing to you today to share some exciting news about the recent medical mission to the South Pacific.

kok: Nwng saimano, chini saknainai thwngdol tei nurse rok hati barnwi bwlap swbai Mercy rungtor sakham nok, kwbang-nangmani thummwi amchaini borokno sakham naitwi.
en: As you know, our team of doctors and nurses spent two weeks on board the hospital ship Mercy, providing much-needed medical care to the people of the region.

kok: Pinnok kotormakhe khwlaimankha.
en: The mission was a huge success.

kok: Chwng 1, 000 jona rogi nukha, tei chwng kuar bwtrango sebok bagwi khlaimankha, swkang naitwi no khobwi, surgery, tei chwraibwsa bahthani chubakha.
en: We saw over 1,000 patients, and we were able to provide a wide range of services, including primary care, surgery, and help with childbirth.

kok: Chwng oroni sakduk naitwi baknairokbai ganawui samung khlaikha bohrokno train khaikha bahai khe teibo kaham naitwi bagwi bohrokni nini hodani bisingtwi.
en: We also worked closely with local health care providers to train them on how to provide better care for their own communities.

kok: Pinnok ni kuk yakpai saimanmani bising twi kaisa wngkha chini rogirokni langmao chini samungni sekrupma nukjako.
en: One of the most rewarding experiences of the mission was seeing the impact that our work had on the lives of our patients.

kok: Phunukmari rwi, chwng bwrwi sikli khoroksa bai malaikha je malariani jwngjal simi kwrak kerong kahmung manjakmani.
en: For example, we met a young woman who had been suffering from a severe case of malaria.

kok: Bo belai lumjak, phiya saknainai rokbai sakajakma olo, bo dakti no hammwi mankha.
en: She was very sick, but after being treated by our doctors, she was able to make a full recovery.

kok: Bo chini chubama bai hambai yapharkha, tei bo chwngno sakha je bo jesaphuru phano mohai nangmanikerong kahmung manwi mangwlakhamu chwng kwrwi hwnkhe.
en: She was so grateful for our help, and she told us that she would never have been able to get the care she needed without us.

kok: Teikaisa rogi chwng nukmakhe omorkisa chwrai je cleft kwkhchwikhe achaimani.
en: Another patient we saw was a young boy who had been born with a cleft lip.

kok: Adi nokbaro, bukhuk khoroknwi apher tongo bohrok salbai hor phertwi no pherlayo.
en: Once upon a time, there were two twin sisters who were as different as night and day.

kok: Khoroksa bukhuk, mung khe Mary, bo khe belai porenai tei naharmung gwnang.
en: One sister, named Mary, was very studious and ambitious.

kok: Bo porenani tei kwtal swrwngnani hamjago, tei boni imang khe salsa chujak scientist wngnani.
en: She loved to read and learn new things, and she dreamed of one day becoming a successful scientist.

kok: Boni apher bukhuk, mung Jane, khe phataro berainani tei kwtal kwtal simung sinani.
en: Her twin sister, named Jane, was more outgoing and adventurous.

kok: Bo khe thwngnarok hamjago tei kwtal tongthairok beraiwi nainarog, tei boni imang khe salsa kharnai kwrwng hwnwi sinijakna muchung jago.
en: She loved to play sports and explore new places, and she dreamed of one day becoming a famous athlete.

kok: O bukhuknwirok belaino kwthalayo, phiya janija langmano twywi khe kwthalaiwi manya.
en: The two sisters were very close, but they often disagreed about what was important in life.

kok: Mary ni uansokmung khe nini iamngno supungmani abobaise langma pungsogo hwnwi, ayang Jane ni uansok ma khe langmao tonthok chathok khe tongmani abobai se langma pungsogo hwnwi.
en: Mary thought that success was all about achieving your goals, while Jane thought that success was about having fun and enjoying life.

kok: Salsa, bukhuk kwnwirok rwngnokni phirogwi nogo thanglai tong phuru, khoroksa chakrajak borokno laiwi thanglayo.
en: One day, the two sisters were walking home from school when they came across a strange old man.

kok: A chakrajak borok khamplai kologo achukjak, tei boni khosai kuphur khe kolok tei thopo kwplar thupjak. " Hello, " sakha a borok chakra. " Ani mung Merlin, tei ang soidomni samung kwrwngse.
en: The old man was sitting on a bench, and he was wearing a long white beard and a pointy hat. "Hello," said the old man. "My name is Merlin, and I am a wizard.

en: However, there are still many challenges to be overcome before AI systems can achieve human-level intelligence.

kok: Kaisa kotorkuk kasujakmung AI ni hwnkhe bono kisisa samung baino kachopnani.

en: AI systems are often able to learn to solve specific problems very well, but they often struggle to generalize their knowledge to new problems.

kok: Tangwi hwnkhe AI wngkha dal kaisa samungni bagwi phwrwngjak kotor kotor simaphang swgwi rwjak baise khwlaimano romdi, bo kisakhe khachobwi jwngjalrokno thamok manglak bini yago ah jwngjalno thamokna bagwi simaphang swkjakya sak.
en: This is because AI systems are typically trained on a large dataset of examples, and they may not be able to generalize to new situations that are not represented in the training data.

kok: Tei dalsa jwngjalbai AI mwkhang hanglai jaomakhe bini simung tei sinimung phan gwnang wngmankukya wngmani.
en: Another challenge facing AI researchers is the problem of robustness.

kok: AI system belai kebel, kokmang kwthwi hai boniro kisaswk ko swlaiwi input khwlaikhe koro mothro khwlai thokijak mano.
en: AI systems are often brittle, meaning that they can be easily fooled by small changes to the input data.

kok: Obo hai hwnkhe AI belai kirimasingsa khe sak kati thanio yaknang keplejaknai, romdi, sak sak malkhung chalokmung.
en: This can make AI systems dangerous in safety-critical applications, such as self-driving cars.

kok: O kasumung tongma ulo phano, AI ni naitukmung kaisa kotor hamchamung hwnwi romwi mano.

kok: AI system twrwk twrwk phan gwnang wngwi phayo, tei bo swkang puilano o hayungo bini nangjakmung saharwi tonkha.

en: Finally, make plans for the day of your birthday.

kok: Omo nini chajakmarokni logi jora swbaimani khobwi mano, chini chajkama chahthairok chamani, eba mungsawk khaimani nwng homni khaina muchungjakmani.
en: This could include spending time with your loved ones, eating your favorite foods, or doing something you have always wanted to do.

kok: Hodarwk pinlam babai ah tabuk kasamung mungboromrok bwkhak kaisa kwtal bahma kasamung rwkha: hodarwk pinlam kobolnai.
en: The recent rise of social media has given rise to a new breed of celebrities: the social media influencer.

kok: Oh saksakrok charrok sakao kotor shongkha utummanirok tongo Twitter, Instagram, tei YouTube kahai, tei bohrok bohrokni duna bwthaihrok, suarimung, tei uansukmarok remtisama bwkhak kobolmung phwnango.
en: These individuals have amassed large followings on platforms like Twitter, Instagram, and YouTube, and they use their influence to promote products, services, and ideas.

kok: Kaisa ah jottoni slai luku hamjajak hodarwk pinlam kobolnairok ah hayungni bising wngkha Kim Kardashian.
en: One of the most popular social media influencers in the world is Kim Kardashian.

kok: Instagram saka 200 chirasai sakao utumarok bai, Kardashian wngkha kaisa phangwnang tangphang ah kanchum bising, naithok, tei langmatongdal swnammarok.
en: With over 200 million followers on Instagram, Kardashian is a powerful force in the fashion, beauty, and lifestyle industries.

kok: Bo hodarwk swirwmarok bwkha sana bagwi bini charno bo phwnangkha, ahaino hamya tangnai mankubui swnamphima tei bwrwimarokni manthairok.
en: She has also used her platform to speak out about social issues, such as criminal justice reform and women's rights.

kok: Haiphano, aro kaisa mwnak babai tongo ah hayung hodarwk pinlam kobolnairokni bwkhak.
en: However, there is a dark side to the world of social media influencers.

kok: Baksa kobolnairok phatarhani haphangrok bai rwjakha tangbokhrwi auaima tei kokthumya wngkha.
en: Some influencers are paid by foreign governments to spread propaganda and disinformation.

kok: Omo wngkha kaisa kubui kebengmung, iko omo kobolmung kotorma lukuni khakamung tei bukhurung lukuchongraida mano.
en: This is a serious problem, as it can greatly influence public opinion and undermine democracy.

kok: 2016 o, omo saimankha je Russian trollrok ah US kaskuma chongbari wngjora kokthumya tei tangbokhrwi auaima bwkhak hodarwk pinlamno phwnangkha.
en: In 2016, it was revealed that Russian trolls used social media to spread propaganda and disinformation during the US presidential election.

kok: Ah trollrok kaisa tatal thikemungrok swnamkha tei phainai Trumpno-dainai koktunmarok tei Hillary Clinton-birodhi koktunamrok bwkhak bohrokno phwnangkha.
en: The trolls created fake accounts and used them to post pro-Trump messages and anti-Hillary Clinton messages.

kok: Omo ah chongbari sakao kaisa nangkukma sekhrupma tongo, iko omo lukuni khakamung norma Trumpni digi bwkhak omo chubakha.
en: This had a significant impact on the election, as it helped to sway public opinion in favor of Trump.

kok: Mol puilani simino sakhaya borokrokni langmani kaisa bwkhak.
en: Sickness has been a part of human life since the beginning of time.

kok: Sana thangkhe kongraini simi chengwi bubonik bemuk jora, kwbangma bemar chini bosongno lansan khwlaikha, abobai kiyorkha, tentokkha tei ma thwikha.
en: From the common cold to the bubonic plague, countless diseases have ravaged our species, causing pain, suffering, and death.

kok: Phiya, boroni simi phaikha oh bemar-rok?
en: But where did these illnesses come from?

kok: Sakhayani bumukno twywi luku khatungjak kaisa kwcham kothoma tongo je obo mwtairokni swraimungni bagwi wngmani.
en: One popular myth about the origin of sickness is that it was caused by a curse from the gods.

kok: Oh kwcham kothomano rwgwi, mwtairok borokrokni tongraidano jolijakmani, haibi bagwi bohrok bohrokno satokna bagwi bemuk kaisa rwhorkha.
en: According to this myth, the gods were angered by the behavior of humans, so they sent down a plague to punish them.

kok: Oh kwcham kothoma hayungni kwbangma hukumuo manthogo, tei uaikwbangno obohai solaimolai kothoma nukjago: mwtairok borokrokni mungsaswk khwlaimano jolijago, haini bagwi bohrok bohrokno saja rwna bagwi bemuk kaisa rwhoro.
en: This myth is found in many cultures around the world, and it often features a similar story: the gods are angered by something humans have done, so they send down a plague to teach them a lesson.

kok: Phiyaba oh kwcham kothoma kwkubuino kaisa phangwnang kothoma, oboni babayo thangna bagwi mungsa wng phunukmung kwrwi.
en: While this myth is certainly a powerful story, there is no evidence to support it.

kok: Mukthango, kwbangkuk soisi kwrwngrokno poito khwlayo je sakhaya abo habarni pherbaise wngo, romdi bacteria tei virusrok.
en: In fact, most scientists believe that sickness is caused by natural factors, such as bacteria and viruses.

kok: Oh bemarni yongrok bebak joraono chini tongkhoro tongwi tongo tei aborok chini sago hapkha hinkhe bemar wngwimanw.
en: These pathogens are always present in our environment, and they can cause disease when they enter our bodies.

kok: Sana thangkhe, mwtairokni swraimungni oh kwcham kothoma, sakhayani bumukno twywi kwbangma kothomani bising kaisa kothoma.
en: Of course, the myth of the gods' curse is just one of many stories about the origin of sickness.

kok: Teibo kwbangma kwcham kothoma tei kerong kothoma tongo jebo chwng tangwi haya wng abono swbaikhrubui sanani chaitogo.
en: There are many other myths and legends that attempt to explain why we get sick.

kok: Ani chajakma mol wngkha ah kaisa bomo wngkha jotto kwkhwrang, ah buphangrok wngkha bubar kuplung bising wngkha, tei ah tokrok rwchapmani wngkha.
en: My favorite season is the one in which all is green, the trees are in full bloom, and the birds are singing.

kok: Omo wngkha kaisa jora kwtak chengmanirok, iko ah hayung bachama simi amo maising thuma tei torna bwkhak chengmarok tei swlaima.
en: It is a time of new beginnings, as the world wakes up from its winter slumber and begins to grow and change.

kok: Ang phatarogo oh jora katina bwkhak hamjago, ah kwthar nokbar tei satung bai tongthokmani.
en: I love to spend this time outdoors, enjoying the fresh air and sunshine.

kok: Sachlang salo bolong bising himmani kahai mungsa kwrwi, ah khum motom bising hamanamani tei ah tok rwchapma khwnamani.
en: There is nothing quite like taking a walk in the woods on a spring day, breathing in the scent of the flowers and listening to the birdsong.

kok: Omo wngkha kaisa khajamung jora tei kwtal khlaima, tei ang homnino omo bai phanrwma wansukma khayo.
en: It is a time of hope and renewal, and I always feel invigorated by it.

kok: Salrok logwi tongkha tei horrok barai tongkha, tei ah sal pohormani kwchwngma wngkha.
en: The days are getting longer and the nights are getting shorter, and the sun is shining brighter.

kok: Ah khumrok bubarwi tongkha tei ah buphangrok bosokrwi tongkha, tei ah nokbar ah tok rwchapmung khorang bai kuplung wngkha.
en: The flowers are blooming and the trees are budding, and the air is filled with the sound of birdsong.

kok: Masingni kolok thumani olo teiwaisa hayung kwthang wngwi phaimani, tei omo wngkha kaisa naithokma nujkanai naima bwkhak.
en: The world is coming alive again after a long winter's sleep, and it is a beautiful sight to behold.

kok: Sachlang wngkha kaisa jora kwtal chengmanirok, tei ang homino naina bwkhak tongthokjak ah kwtal mol tamo tubunai.
en: Spring is a time of new beginnings, and I am always excited to see what the new season will bring.

kok: Ang ah buphang uaphangrok torma tei swlaima bwkhak naina hamajgo, tei ang ah malmatarokno phatar phai tei thwngma nainani tongthokjago.
en: I love to watch the plants grow and change, and I enjoy seeing the animals come out and play.

kok: Sachlang wngkha khajamung jora tei kwtal khlaima, tei ang homnino omo bai phanrwma wansukma khayo.
en: Spring is a time of hope and renewal, and I always feel invigorated by it.

kok: Oh kokchirlaimung borok vs. Kol manwirok wngkha kaisa kolok-bachamnai kaisa, 1 kokphirokma kwrwi bai.
en: The debate of man vs. machine is a long-standing one, with no easy answer.

kok: Tei kubun yak sakao, kol manwirok sikrwng tei chukjak bangrwmani wngwi tongo, tei bohrok swkango kwbangma samungrok khlai phaimani tongo je waisa wansukjak ah kwthaya ha borokrok wngkha.
en: On the one hand, machines are becoming increasingly sophisticated and capable, and they are already performing many tasks that were once thought to be the exclusive domain of humans.

kok: Tei kubun yak sakao, borokrok thani kaisa manthokya thepama tongo yaksrairok tei khlaimanmarok je kol manwirok wngkha salya bwkhak jephuruphano rikjak tongo, ahaino swnamanma, phanbojak tei bisingnielem.
en: On the other hand, humans have a unique set of skills and abilities that machines are unlikely to ever replicate, such as creativity, empathy, and intuition.

kok: Kaisa ah berepkong kholarok boro kol manwirok doui borokrokni slai bwskang agukmani wngkha ah swnamjak siyankwrwng (AI) haurar bising.
en: One of the key areas where machines are rapidly outpacing humans is in the field of artificial intelligence (AI).

kok: AI wngkha kaisa computer soisimung bedek je ah swnammani siyankwrwng adongrok bai kokswlaimani, bomo lamrok tongo haini bagwi, swrwngma, tei tangma sakphang mano.
en: AI is a branch of computer science that deals with the creation of intelligent agents, which are systems that can reason, learn, and act autonomously.

kok: AI agini phwnangjak wngkha kaisa kuar bwtrang thepamungrokni bising, malkhungrok saksa-chalukmani simi sakham rok manajakma bwkhak.
en: AI is already being used in a wide range of applications, from self-driving cars to medical diagnosis.

kok: Tei AI teibo samung khlaijak tongma bai, abo teibo phangwnang tei chukuknai wngthothok.
en: And as AI continues to develop, it is likely to become even more powerful and capable.

kok: Haiphano, aro bo kwbangma kholarok tongo boro borokrok ahaino tonima bwkhak kaisa nangnukma tangsrai kolmanwirok tongo.
en: However, there are also a number of areas where humans are likely to retain a significant advantage over machines.

kok: Phunukmari karwi, ambiguity tei chongmanya bai lenden bwkhak borokrok belai kaham wngkha.
en: For example, humans are much better at dealing with ambiguity and uncertainty.

kok: Chwng chini simari tei bisingnielem sakao kutuk tongremrok bising chongmarok swnamma bwkhak kari bo mano.
en: We can also draw on our experience and intuition to make decisions in complex situations.

kok: Tei paithago, borokrok thani kaisa mathokya pharima karwi tongo swnammanma tei phinmani.
en: And finally, humans have a unique capacity for creativity and innovation.

kok: Malkhung swnamma tei kaham tonimani wngkha nangnai bagwi nini malkhung kaham tonghalok bising tongmani tei morokjak kasomani ah lama tola.
en: Vehicle repair and maintenance is essential for keeping your car in good condition and preventing costly repairs down the road.

kok: Aro wngkha kwbangma manwirok nwng khlaimano nini malkhungno kaham khai tonima bwkhak, ahaino ah thok tei homnino chwkaimarok, ah tire ni sepmung naichumani, tei ah sokomotwi kupphurrok topped up khaimani.
en: There are a number of things you can do to maintain your vehicle, such as changing the oil and filters regularly, checking the tire pressure, and keeping the fluids topped up.

kok: Tumungno nwng sakphang oro manwirok khainani khasrangjakya khe, nwng nini malkhungno kaisa chukjak mechanic thani twlang mano.
en: If you're not comfortable doing these things yourself, you can take your car to a qualified mechanic.

kok: Jephuru omo malkhung swnamma bwkhak phayo, aro wngkha kaisa juda juda yaprirok nwng nai mano
en: When it comes to vehicle repair, there are a number of different paths you can take.

kok: Nwng kaisa delearship bwkhak thangwi mano, kaisa phiyokjak swnamma phalnok, eba kaisa chain swnamma phalnok.
en: You can go to a dealership, an independent repair shop, or a chain repair shop.

kok: Phalnok sapokthaih thwgwi omoni sakni subhidha tei asubhidha tongo.
en: Each type of shop has its own advantages and disadvantages.

kok: Dealerships thani hainohai ah jottoni slai saimanjak samung khainai kubui swnammarok sakao tei malkhungrok swnamjak dalrok bagwi tongo, phiya bohrok teibo morojak wngwi mano kubun saimungrokni slai.
en: Dealerships typically have the most experience working on specific makes and models of cars, but they can also be more expensive than other options.

kok: Phiyokjak swnamma phalnokrok wngkha uramuram rang hapnani kisa dealerships rokni slai, phiya borok ni thani ah soloi homan kwrwng tongwlak.
en: Independent repair shops are often less expensive than dealerships, but they may not have the same level of expertise.

kok: Chain swnamma phalnokrok hainohai kaisa majar ha kwcharo dealerships tei phiyokjak swnamma phalnokrok yapharo, bataijak swkrok bai tei kaisa dalbidal sebarok.
en: Chain repair shops typically offer a middle ground between dealerships and independent repair shops, with competitive prices and a variety of services.

kok: Jesaphano wngthwng nwng bo yapri chong, kaisa boromjak phalnok je nwng poito khai mano naitukma bwkhak omo wngkha nangkukma.
en: No matter which path you choose, it's important to find a reputable shop that you can trust.

kok: Nwng omo nini bayaprok eba nukhung simi salaikulaimarok karwi swngmani bai khlaimano, eba kisa online naitukrwk bai khlaimano.
en: You can do this by asking for recommendations from friends or family, or by doing some online research.

kok: Islam wngkha kaisa tongthar je khakrakokrok yapharma ah kaitor sakphan bwkhak.
en: Islam is a religion that emphasizes surrender to the will of God.

kok: Oh yapharma wansukmung, eba "Islam" Arabic bai, wngkha uramuram buchiya kokmang mothokjak eba mechenma.
en: This concept of surrender, or "Islam" in Arabic, is often misunderstood as meaning submission or defeat.

kok: Haiphano, Islam o, yapharma wngkha kubuino kaisa kubui kerong khai nukjago, kaisa lama kwchangthokotok tei tongthokmung manma bwkhak.
en: However, in Islam, surrender is actually seen as a positive act, a way to achieve peace and happiness.

kok: Jephuru khoroksa muslim kaitorno yapharo, bohrok bohrokni sakni khengjak sakphan yakar riya.
en: When a Muslim surrenders to God, they are not giving up their own free will.

kok: Aboni slai, bohrok mansamani wngkha je kaitor wngkha ah kaisa phangwnang je jotto manwirokno kaswkma bwkhak mano, tei je bini sakphan bwkhak yapharmani bai, bohrok wngkha kubuino phiyokjakma kubui naitukmani.
en: Rather, they are acknowledging that God is the one who has the power to control all things, and that by surrendering to His will, they are actually finding true freedom.

kok: Oh yapharma wansukmung wngkha naithokma kok swbaikhrubwi sama bising ah Prophet Muhammad ni kothoma.
en: This concept of surrender is beautifully illustrated in the story of the Prophet Muhammad.

kok: Jephuru Muhammad puila khoroksa prophet hwnwi ringjago, bo belai kirijak wngkha.
en: When Muhammad was first called to be a prophet, he was very afraid.

kok: Bo kaitorni koktun auaimani bagwi bokjak mucwngjakya.
en: He didn't want to be responsible for spreading God's message.

kok: Haiphano, olo kwbang surimarok tei kiphilmani, Muhammad paithago kaitorni sakphan bwkhak yaphakha.
en: However, after much prayer and reflection, Muhammad eventually surrendered to God's will.

kok: Bo saimankhak je omobini sakni phanya je bono khlaimanmung bwkhak rwya, phiya kaitorni phan se.
en: He realized that it was not his own strength that would allow him to succeed, but the strength of God.

kok: Muhammad's kothoma wngkha kaisa muito narwkma je yapharma wngkha yakarmani bagwi simiya.
en: Muhammad's story is a reminder that surrender is not about giving up.

kok: Sijak mankubui wngkha kaisa jora ah raida wngkha kaisani sakni yago namani samung namani swbaikhrup sama bwkhak phwnangjakha, aborokno hainohai satokmung phataro rwmani bwkhak je tanghamya khlaijak tongma bwkhak gosijak tongkha.
en: Vigilante justice is a term used to describe the act of taking the law into one's own hands, typically by meting out punishment to those who have been deemed to have committed crimes.

kok: Jephuru sijak mankubui mankubui manna bwkhak 1 lama tei kaisa dojak mohai khakama wngwi mano, omo uramuram teibo kebengmungrok bwkhak dagi mano omo kokpaihmani slai.
en: While vigilante justice may seem like a quick and easy way to get justice, it can often lead to more problems than it solves.

kok: Kaisa ha kotorma kebengmungrok sijak mankubui uyngkha je omo hainohai kaisa banik tei keboni baiya tomung bising khlaijakya.
en: One of the biggest problems with vigilante justice is that it is typically not done in a fair and impartial manner.

kok: Sijakrok uramuram babai tubujak thamsi tei khanangjak bai tongo, bomo bohrokno wansukya chongmarok swnamma bwkhak dagi mano tei samungrok nama je ah kahamkuk ol manmungrok jotto kubulma bising wngya wngo.
en: Vigilantes are often motivated by anger and emotion, which can lead them to make rash decisions and take actions that are not in the best interests of everyone involved.

kok: Jora rwmani, sijak uramuram ah swrwngmani tei nangmani saimanjak kwrwi wngo hamya tangnai tokno kaham khai samlukma bwkhak.
en: Additionally, vigilantes often lack the training and experience necessary to properly handle criminals.

kok: Omo tonghalokrok bwkhak dagi mano boro chayakwrwi borok hamya eba ahaino bwtharjak tongo.
en: This can lead to situations where innocent people are harmed or even killed.

kok: Tei kaisa kebengmung bai sijak mankubui wngkha je omo daktino mwthakmung phataro kundli wngwi mano.
en: Another problem with vigilante justice is that it can quickly spiral out of control.

kok: Jephuru khoroksa borok raidano sakni yago nakha, omo kaisa kubunrokno koktun howu je bohrok bo mohai khlaimano.
en: When one person takes the law into their own hands, it sends a message to others that they can do the same.

kok: Omo kiasa bulaimung kiting tei sumung je mwthakma bwkhak 3 wngmanma bwkhak dagi mano.
en: This can lead to a cycle of violence and retribution that can be difficult to stop.

kok: Ah kolok jora, sijak mankubui wngkha waisa-wuisu wngjak bising tanghamya kosomani.
en: In the long run, vigilante justice is rarely effective in deterring crime.

kok: Kubuio, omo uramuram ah philmasago kwlaima, hamya tangnairokno swnamani teibo ahaino tanghamyarok khlaina bwkhak ah thinang bising.
en: In fact, it can often have the opposite effect, making criminals more likely to commit crimes in the future.

kok: Koklop wngkha kaisa kok hayungkhobwi je jora tei thai laihmarok.
en: Poetry is a universal language that transcends time and place.

kok: Omo khanangmarok sraisrai khai sama bwkhak phwnangjagwi mano, kothomarok sanani, tei kutuk khachongmarok kwtai karinani.
en: It can be used to express emotions, tell stories, and explore complex ideas.

kok: Khoroksa translator wngwi, ani thani ah yakarmung tongo chubanani bwkhak koklop no tubunani kwtal nainairokno kubun kok bisingtwi omo kokslaimani bai.
en: As a translator, I have the privilege of helping to bring poetry to new audiences by rendering it in another language.

kok: Omo wngkha kaisa bataimani phiya manmari samung, ang haino ah swijak koklop kokmangno yaktwina simiya, phiya omoni phan tei naithokmano bo.
en: This is a challenging but rewarding task, as I must not only convey the literal meaning of the poem, but also its beauty and power.

kok: Kaisa belai nangkukma manwirok bwkhak gosima jephuru koklop translating khaiphuru ah koktheka tei suma manwi.
en: One of the most important things to consider when translating poetry is the rhythm and meter.

kok: Oh bokhrwirok ah kokloprok bwkhak nangnai jottokhobwi wngmung wngkha, tei bohrok kubun kok bising 3 bwkhak swnamphima wngmano.
en: These elements are essential to the poem's overall effect, and they can be difficult to reproduce in another language.

kok: Baksa tonghalokrok bising, ang manma nangwi mano ah koktheka mano ah kokthekano khapirwnani eba suma manwi kisisa khai koklopno bo kekhok teibo tongkaham bisingtwi kaichomwi kok tiyar khai swnamna bwkhak.
en: In some cases, I may need to adjust the rhythm or meter slightly in order to make the poem flow more naturally in the target language.

kok: Haiphano, ang homnino naikini khai koklopno khatina bwkhak bini kubui kokmang tei khatharjak.
en: However, I always take care to preserve the poem's original meaning and intent.

kok: Teikaisa nangkukma gosijakmani hwnkhe ah naithokjrwjak kok.
en: Another important consideration is the use of figurative language.

kok: Koklopnai ahaino rwbaikok, mwnwimarok, tei kubun kokthaih lekhathaih sraisrai uansukjak swnamna bwkhak tei bohrokni samungno kuthuk jora rwma bwkhak.
en: Poets often use metaphors, similes, and other figures of speech to create vivid imagery and add depth to their work.

kok: Jephuru oh manwirokno translating khayo, ang hainohai ah kaichummung kok bisingtwi ma naituknai je ah porinai rokni sakao amtwi skerupma tongnai.
en: When translating these devices, I must find equivalents in the target language that will have the same impact on the reader.

kok: Salsa, khoroksa chwrai sikla kaisa mukumukhatino bini mapharokbai naikha.
en: One day, a young boy visited a museum with his parents.

kok: Bo mlangchakha jotto ah juda juda manwirokn bo nukma bai, kwcham rikmamanwirok simi kwtal rikmung bwkhak.
en: He was amazed by all the different things he saw, from ancient artifacts to modern art.

kok: Boh ah dinosaur phunukma hamjaksuksukha, tei bo damrok lairwi mankhamu haino ah bekrerengrok tei tongmarirok naimani bai.
en: He especially loved the dinosaur exhibit, and he could have spent hours just looking at the skeletons and fossils.

kok: iko bo kaisa chongjak kotor dinosaur botomkhor lopmani wngkha, bo bini ungkulukno simi kaisa khorang khwnakha. "abo wngkha Tyrannosaurus rex, " ah khorang sakha.
en: As he was admiring a particularly large dinosaur skull, he heard a voice behind him. "That's a Tyrannosaurus rex," the voice said.

kok: "amo wngkha kaisa kotorma tei joroni slai kirimasinsa sikarirok jottojora ah hating bwkhak himnai.
en: "It was one of the largest and most fearsome predators to ever walk the Earth."

kok: Ah chwrai yaksiyagra gurikha tei khoroksa borok no nini gana bachajak nukha.
en: The boy turned around and saw a man standing next to him.

kok: Bo kuchuk tei keram wngkha, kaisa kolok khochai bai tei kaisa kaham mwkhang. "nwng khoroksa paleontologista da?" ah chwrai swngkha.
en: He was tall and thin, with a long beard and a kind face. "Are you a paleontologist?" the boy asked.

kok: "In', angno, " ah chwla sakha. "ang kwbangma bisirok karwi dinosaurs ni bsgwi poripaikha.
en: "Yes, I am," the man said. "I've been studying dinosaurs for many years."

kok: Ah chwrai khoroksa kubui paleontologist bai malaima bwkhak tongthokjak wngkha.
en: The boy was excited to meet a real paleontologist, and he asked him many questions about dinosaurs.

kok: Ah borok bini jotto swngmanirok kwchang khai kokphirokha tei ah chwrai oh mauni khlaimani malmatarok bagwi kwbang swrwngkha.
en: The man answered all of his questions patiently, and the boy learned a lot about these fascinating creatures.

kok: Swprasani olo, ah chwraini maphasong bono ringkha, tei bo ah paleontologist no thangkha hwnwi sakha.
en: After a while, the boy's parents called him over, and he said goodbye to the paleontologist.

kok: Ah hayung plastic bising suklaijak.
en: The world is awash in plastic.

kok: Jottothayo nwng naisikkhe, aro omo wngkha: ah twijlang bising kochokmani, rukungrok sakao suklaijakmani, twibom kathuwarokno totra sepmani tei kubun twibomni langma.
en: Everywhere you look, there it is: floating in the ocean, washing up on beaches, choking sea turtles and other marine life.

kok: Plastic sitrarwma wngkha kaisa kotor sikrimung chini twijlangrok sakduma bwkhak, tei omo ahaino hayasuk wngwi tongkha.
en: Plastic pollution is a major threat to the health of our oceans, and it's only getting worse.

kok: Bisi thwgwi, chini twijlangrokni bisisng chirasairok tons plastic pai thango.
en: Every year, millions of tons of plastic end up in our oceans.

kok: Jotto ha-khobjak yaphangrokni simi omo phaimarok, ahaino twimarok tei twidarrok.
en: Most of it comes from land-based sources, such as rivers and streams.

kok: Waisa ah twijlang bising, plastic baikhrubanani bwkhak bisi rarok nai mano.
en: Once in the ocean, plastic can take hundreds of years to break down.

kok: Omo twibom malmatarok bai khaijak mano, obo bohrokno kulum wngnani eba haino thwima bwkhak pher mano.
en: It can also be ingested by marine animals, which can cause them to become sick or even die.

kok: Jora rwmani omo phermarok twibom langma bwkhak sakphang chaya khaimano, plastic sitrarwma ah chathaih sorduk sakao kaisa sekrupma wngya tongwi mano.
en: In addition to the direct harm it causes to marine life, plastic pollution can also have a negative impact on the food chain.

kok: Plastic ah bohokrok tei kubun twibom malmatarok bising thumjak mano, tei oh malmatarok bohrokrok bai chajago, chwng chinisago plastic monogwi paijak mano.
en: Plastic can accumulate in the stomachs of fish and other marine animals, and when these animals are eaten by humans, we can end up ingesting plastic ourselves.

kok: Ah sakdukma sago kwlaima plastic chamani wngkha tabukbo kaham khe buchimanya khu, phiya aro wngkha uanama je bo kaisa dalbidal kebengrok bwkha dagi twlang mano, cancer khobwinai, erma lam kebgengmarok, tei hamkraijak oroiproirok.
en: The health effects of consuming plastic are not yet fully understood, but there is concern that it could lead to a variety of problems, including cancer, reproductive issues, and developmental disorders.

kok: Hayung tungmung wngwi tongmani bo kaisa nangkukjak sekrupma ah twijlangrok sakao.
en: Global warming is also having a significant impact on the oceans.

kok: Tangmari sal wngkha kaisa sal ah khangjakmarok tei samung khlainairokni manmarokno borom rwma bwkhak.
en: Labour Day is a day to honour the contributions and achievements of workers.

kok: Omo wngkha kaisa jora kiphilphima ah samung kuthuk tei saktharjak nangkuma sakao, tei ah siyankwrwng chajakma bwkhak tei aborokni yaksrai je chini hakotorno kotor kuar khai swnam tongo.
en: It is a time to reflect on the importance of hard work and dedication, and to appreciate the intelligence and skill of those who have made our country great.

kok: Kaisa ahaino phunukmari wngkha Henry Ford ni kothoma.
en: One such example is the story of Henry Ford.

kok: Ford wngkha kaisa bomtomgwnang engineer tei bepari borok je ah automibile swnammungno pekhrupjak khayo.
en: Ford was a brilliant engineer and businessman who revolutionized the automobile industry.

kok: Bo ah aseembly ari swnammani bai borom rwjakha, bomo malkhungrok thaimung bai teibo efficiently tei kwlaima bwkhak omo wngma swnammo.
en: He is credited with inventing the assembly line, which made it possible to produce cars more efficiently and cheaply.

kok: Omo ah auto swnammung bising kaisa swk bangma bwkhak twlango tei chirasai samungrok swnamma bwkhak chubakha.
en: This led to a boom in the auto industry and helped to create millions of jobs.

kok: Ford bo wngkha khoroksa kwrak sualphang samung khlairokni raidarokni bagwi.
en: Ford was also a strong advocate for workers' rights.

kok: Bo poito khaikha je jotto samung khainairokno kaisa banik beton rwjakna nango tei kaitijak samung khlaimani tonghalorok tongo.
en: He believed that all workers should be paid a fair wage and have safe working conditions.

kok: Bo kaisa manmari-bakmani chapmung bo songchakha bini sebukrokni bagwi, bomo borokno ah companyni bising shareholders swnamkha.
en: He also established a profit-sharing plan for his employees, which made them shareholders in the company.

kok: Ford ni siyankwrwng tei saktharma kaisa kahamma hayung samung khlainairokni baagwi swnamma bwkha chubakha.
en: Ford's intelligence and dedication helped to create a better world for workers.

kok: Bo wngkha kaisa khasrangrwnai chini jotto bwkak, tei bini swikwlangmung choyawui tinibo samung khlainairokno khasrangrima bwkhak tongo.
en: He is an inspiration to us all, and his legacy continues to inspire workers today.

kok: Internet chini langma ni bisingo khobjago.
en: The internet has become an integral part of our lives.

en: We use it to stay connected with friends and family, to learn new things, to be entertained, and to conduct business.

kok: Kubuio, internet mohai nangkukma wng thangkha je chwng tak teibo dagimung 3 rarwjag lapsarok jotto hati o tongbwlaih khayo.
en: In fact, the internet has become so important that we now share more than 3 billion pieces of content every week.

kok: Omo jottomanwi khobwi magpilirok tei naijaknai simi kokdukrok koksoprok tei blog sapukmarok.
en: This includes everything from photos and videos to news articles and blog posts.

kok: Dagimung, internet borokni bagwi jotto hayungni sakani kubun bai kwrwngwi wngwimanma swnamno, obo juda juda hukumurok tei nukmungrok kotorkuk buchimani bwkhak tubui phayo.
en: Additionally, the internet has made it possible for people to connect with others from all over the world, which has led to a greater understanding of different cultures and perspectives.

kok: Oro kisa lama wngkha je internet chini langmarokno swlaikha:
en: Here are some of the ways that the internet has changed our lives:

kok: * Manjumung: internet chini bagwi kwlaikuk khe swnamjakha bayaprok tei nukhungni borokbai kwrwng tongnani je hakchalo tongnai rokbai.
en: * Communication: The internet has made it easier for us to stay connected with friends and family who live far away.

kok: Chwng tabuk bohrokbai logi logi no kwrwngwi mano via email, text message, eba video chat.
en: We can now communicate with them instantly via email, text message, or video chat.

kok: * Rwng: internet chini bagwi jesaphano swrwngna bagwi wngwimanma swnam rwkha chwng je muchungmani, jephuru chwng muchungphuru.
en: * Education: The internet has made it possible for us to learn about anything we want, whenever we want.

kok: Chwng jotto hayung sakani simi rungjak manwirok khulugwi naimano, tei chwng kuchuk rwngkotornok ni simi online swrwngthai rok naimano.
en: We can access educational resources from all over the world, and we can even take online courses from top universities.

kok: * Tongthokmung: internet chwngno kaisa kotorma bangmari tongthokmungni seprok khulugwi rwkha.
