en: Most newspapers are published daily or weekly, but some may be published less frequently.

kok: Koktunmalaihrok wngkha kaisa dalbidal twilamrok twih bakjakha, sapokma khobmani, online, tei mobile.
en: Newspapers are distributed through a variety of channels, including print, online, and mobile.

kok: Kotunmalaihrok bisirarok bagwi yaksiyagra tongwi tongo, tei bohrok kaisa nangkukma samung thwngkha ah lukukno tabukni wngmarok bagwi kothumnani bising.
en: Newspapers have been around for centuries, and they have played an important role in informing the public about current events.

kok: Ah swkang salrok koktunlaihrokni bising, bohrok aswkno uramuram bohrok kami kholarok tongmani bagwi yaphang kokthum wngkha.
en: In the early days of newspapers, they were often the only source of information for people living in rural areas.

kok: Tini, koktunmalaihrok choyai kaisa nangmanwi kothum yaphang wngma bwkhak, phiya bohrok bataimani malayo kubun pinlam phatarlam simi, ahaino nukauai, nobarauai, tei ah internet.
en: Today, newspapers continue to be a valuable source of information, but they face competition from other media outlets, such as television, radio, and the internet.

kok: Aro wngkha kwbangma juda juda koktunlaihrok sapokthaihrok, omoni sakni nainai kaichommung bai thwgwi.
en: There are many different types of newspapers, each with its own target audience.

kok: Baksa koktunmalaihrok wngkha jotto-sakhamkrai sapokjakmarok, jephuru kubunrok mahmlai kokkhak salaikrok sakao naisikma, ahaino beparirok, thwngmungrok, eba tongthokmung.
en: Some newspapers are general-interest publications, while others focus on specific topics, such as business, sports, or entertainment.

kok: Koktunmalaihrok bohrokni thwngrwngrwk kongmanirok bai rem bakjak bo wngwi mano, baksa keboni babaiya eba bampanthi uansukukma wngjak, jephuru kubunrok khatijakma eba yagra-bwkrang.
en: Newspapers can also be classified by their political leanings, with some being considered liberal or left-wing, while others are considered conservative or right-wing.

kok: Jora rwmani bising koktunmarok tei kokthum manthokmani bwkhak kotunmalaihrok wngkha kaisa nangkukma samung thwngo luku khachongma swnammani bising.
en: In addition to providing news and information, newspapers also play an important role in shaping public opinion.

kok: Korai khachik bataimung belai luku hamjajak thwngmung je bisira rwgwi yaksiyagra tongo.
en: Horse racing is a popular sport that has been around for centuries.

kok: Omo kaisa bataimung kainwi eba teibo korai rokni bisingtwi je korai batainai rokbai kasajakmani.
en: It is a competition between two or more horses that are ridden by jockeys.

kok: Oh along hwnkhe puila korai rokno paithakni ari laihnani.
en: The goal is to be the first horse to cross the finish line.

kok: Korai khachik bataimung jotto hayung sakao yaprimario khaijago, tei aro kwbangma juda juda sapokthaih khachik bataimungrok, sprinys khobwi, kwchar chalmungrok, tei soijjak khachik bataimung rok.
en: Horse racing is held at tracks all over the world, and there are many different types of races, including sprints, middle distances, and endurance races.

kok: Jottoni slai sinikukjak korai khachik baitaimung oh hayungni wngkha Kentucky Derby, je bisi thwgwi Churchill Downs o khaijago Louisville, Kentaucky o.
en: The most famous horse race in the world is the Kentucky Derby, which is held every year at Churchill Downs in Louisville, Kentucky.

kok: Kora kachik bataiimung wngkha kaisa kwbang-rarwjag dollar swnamung, tei omoni lekhama je kaisa bisi korai kachik bataimung wngkha jit karimani $100 rarwjag sakao.
en: Horse racing is a multi-billion dollar industry, and it is estimated that over $100 billion is wagered on horse races each year.

kok: Oh thwngmung bo kaisa nangmani samung bumuk, te obo samungrokno dayo korai bahmani, swrwngman, tei khachik bataimung ni swnammungrok.
en: The sport is also a major source of employment, and it supports jobs in the horse breeding, training, and racing industries.

kok: Tophano lukuhamjakmani bising omo tongphano, korai kachik bataimungrok malamatarokno saknaimung kokchirjagwi tongo.
en: Despite its popularity, horse racing has been criticized for its treatment of animals.

kok: Sanairok koktanlaima o je korairokno phanthonwi kachik bataimung dorimarok wngkha je abo bohrokni bagwi akochojak, tei bohrok haino borokni phwrwngnai tei korai batainairok bai kaham khe saknaijkaya.
en: Critics argue that horses are forced to race at speeds that are dangerous for them, and that they are often mistreated by their trainers and jockeys.

kok: Thangnai bisi romwi, aro kwbangma chaitokjagwi tongo korai kachik bataimungno teibo khairokma swnamna bagwi, kwtal raidarok tei kerem khamungrok chengmung khobwinai.
en: In recent years, there have been a number of efforts to make horse racing more humane, including the introduction of new rules and regulations.

kok: Tophano kokbanglaimung tongphano, korai kachik bataimung kaisa lukuhamjakjak hayung rwgwi tongwi tongo.
en: Despite the controversy, horse racing remains a popular sport around the world.

kok: "mungborom": "thumani nangkukmani", "swrwng": "thumani chini langmarokni kaisa mal bokcho.
en: "title": "The Importance of Sleep", "text": "Sleep is a vital part of our lives.

kok: Omo chini sakrokno lenglama tei bohroksaksak snaphima no gosirio, tei omo chwngno kaham khe tangmung kainwi sakni kokno tei khapangni chubachu khayo.
en: It allows our bodies to rest and repair themselves, and it helps us to function properly both physically and mentally.

kok: Chwng jephuru aswk thunnani jora manya, chwng kaisa wngya sago kwlaimarok bwtrang saimanjak wngwi mano, hoihoi no khobwinai, jolirakni, 3y bwkharwmani, tei belrwjak chapmung-swnamani.
en: When we don't get enough sleep, we can experience a range of negative effects, including fatigue, irritability, difficulty concentrating, and impaired decision-making.

kok: Kolok chongjakjora, dwkbemar thumani seplemarok chini sakduk hamkrai khapharmung biyalrok bangriwui mano, ahaino kuphung, bwkhani bemar, tei swtwibemar rok.
en: In the long term, chronic sleep deprivation can increase our risk of developing health problems such as obesity, heart disease, and diabetes.

kok: Aro kwbangma lombor bwchwlwirok tongo je chini thumani nangrwui mano, chini omor no khobwinai, chini tongdallangma, tei chini habar.
en: There are a number of factors that can affect our sleep, including our age, our lifestyle, and our environment.

kok: Chini omor wngkhe, chini thumani naidalrok bo naitwima bwkhak swlaijago.
en: As we age, our sleep patterns tend to change.

kok: Phunukmari phunugwi, okra siklarok kisa lem thuna nango chwrai siklarokni slai, tei bohrok teibo 3 bwkhak kwlai thujak tei thujak tongwi naituk mano.
en: For example, older adults may need less sleep than younger adults, and they may find it more difficult to fall asleep and stay asleep.

kok: Chini tongdal langma rok muchungmarok chini thumani o kaisa kotor sekrupma manwi mano.
en: Our lifestyle choices can also have a big impact on our sleep.

kok: Phunukmari phunugwi, borok je kolok damrwi samung khayo eba je thumani raidatwiya mungremrok wngkha teibo thumani biyalwi saimanjak bwkhkak wngwi mano.
en: For example, people who work long hours or who have irregular sleep schedules are more likely to experience sleep problems.

kok: Tei paithago, chini habar chini thumani manthai wngwi mano.
en: And finally, our environment can also affect our sleep.

kok: Manwirok khorang, pohor, tei tungmari jotto swnam mano obo 3 bwkhak kaisa hor kaham thumani manwi mano.
en: Things like noise, light, and temperature can all make it difficult to get a good night's sleep.

kok: Salsa, chuainai bini kheto kwchartwi himwi tongphuru bo chumui kosom agukphaimani nukha.
en: One day, a farmer was walking through his field when he saw a dark cloud approaching.

kok: Bo saimano je bankundri phaitongmani, haini bagwi bo goinogo khaprumwi thangkha bini malamata rokno katirinani hwnwi.
en: He knew that a storm was coming, so he ran to his barn to get his animals to safety.

kok: Bo musukrok, wakrok, tei tokrok kwrwngsa thayo thumkha tei bohrokno bisingo thubukha.
en: He gathered up his cows, pigs, and chickens and brought them inside.

kok: Bankundri jolijagwi phaikha, chuainai tailamni simi naichumkha nokbar tei watwi whipped khai gerebkha buphangno.
en: As the storm raged, the farmer watched from the window as the wind and rain whipped through the trees.

kok: Bo bini bwthai maithaini bagwi wanajak, phiya bo saimano je aro bo mungsaphano khaimanya hwnwi.
en: He was worried about his crops, but he knew that there was nothing he could do.

kok: Teini phungno, sal pasai phaikha tei bankundri pai thangkha.
en: The next morning, the sun came out and the storm was over.

kok: Chuainai phataro thangwi guriwui naikha piyakmung rokno.
en: The farmer went outside to survey the damage.

kok: Bini maithai bwwthairok baikhrupkha, phiya bo bokcho karwi nukha je bono mwnwi rwkha.
en: His crops were ruined, but he saw something else that made him smile.

kok: Ketho kwcharo aro naithotok chokleng keleng nukjakha.
en: In the middle of the field, there was a beautiful rainbow.

kok: Chuainai saiamano je chokleng keleng wngkha kaisa khajamung ni mari.
en: The farmer knew that the rainbow was a sign of hope.

kok: Obo bono muito khairikha je aro jodi langmao bankundri tongphano, aro homnino silver lining tongo.
en: It reminded him that even though there are storms in life, there is always a silver lining.

kok: Thungnuk wngkha kothoma sanani kaisa dal, jebo ualaimung tei khanangmano kitingjak.
en: Dramas are a genre of storytelling that typically focuses on conflict and emotion.

kok: Oborokno toke tei nukauaini simi chengwi mwsakhola tei kokrwbai jora jotto dalni auailamo manwimanw.
en: They can be found in all forms of media, from film and television to theatre and literature.

kok: Kaisa thungnuk bwtwikhe wng oboni mungsa sraisrai kok swbai samung kwrwiphano kisaswk manuirok tongo jebo uram-uramno a kothomarogo manwi tongo.
en: While there is no one definitive definition of what makes a drama, there are some common elements that are often found in these stories.

kok: Thungnukno twywi kok swbai sanai gwrwngrokni bisingo kaisa wngkha ualaimani sakao bohrokni kitingwi tongma.
en: One of the defining features of dramas is their focus on conflict.

kok: Obo bisingni ualaimung wngwimanw, romdi kaisa tomung bohrokni sakni khanangma eba poitobai kaphraui tongo, eba phatarni ualaimung, romdi kaisa tomung kubun borok eba phan-no kebengwi kaphraui tongo.
en: This can be internal conflict, such as a character struggling with their own emotions or beliefs, or external conflict, such as a character struggling against another person or force.

kok: Ualaimungno kothomano swkangwi twlango tei nainairokno kulpayakhe tonio.
en: Conflict is what drives the story forward and keeps the audience engaged.

kok: Thungnukni taikaisa nangkukmani manui wngkha khanangmano twywi bohrokni kitingwi tongma.
en: Another important element of dramas is their focus on emotion.

kok: Thungnukrok uram-uramno borokrokni khanangmani bebak dal, tongthokma tei hamjakmani simi jolima tei dukhu jora naituk berayo.
en: Dramas often explore the full range of human emotions, from joy and love to anger and sadness.

kok: Obo khwnanai-rokbai manjumungni tei bohrokni tongmung tei kothomano twywi kisaswk khao nangrwnani kaisa phankwrak lam wngwimanw.
en: This can be a powerful way to connect with audiences and make them feel something about the characters and their stories.

kok: Thungnukrok tongthokmung gwnang tei unsukmumg peplarwnai kainwino wngwimanw.
en: Dramas can be both entertaining and thought-provoking.

kok: Bohrok borokrokni tonghalokno philiksa kaisakhe nukjak rwuimanw tei chwng je jwnglal kutukrogo kwlayo abono naituk berayo.
en: They can offer a glimpse into the human condition and explore the complex issues that we all face.

kok: Tabukni tangsep chini langmano dal bidal lamtwi hamrwo, tei babaisa obobo wanarwo sak hui, sak kati tei kok sana manthai khochor rwrwgo.
en: While these advances have the potential to improve our lives in many ways, they also raise important concerns about privacy, security, and freedom of expression.

kok: Romdi, mwkhang sinimung tangsep tabukni jorao thwngjakmani bangrwrwgo.
en: For example, the use of facial recognition technology has become increasingly common in recent years.

kok: O tangsepbai borok rokni thang laisu tei tongmung chamung rokno naichomwi mano.
en: This technology can be used to track people's movements, identify individuals, and even predict their behavior.

kok: Phiya mwkhang sinimari tangsepni bisingtwi raida chaya samung tangnai rokno rom nani sep bo kwlaisa wngo, abono karwi sitra samung tangnai, satok pitok khwlainai rokno bo naichomna bagwi samungo thepajago.
en: While facial recognition technology can be used for legitimate purposes, such as preventing crime and catching criminals, it also has the potential to be used for more nefarious purposes, such as surveillance and discrimination.

kok: Tei dalsa wanamung hwnkhe artificial intelligence (AI).
en: Another concern is the increasing use of artificial intelligence (AI).

kok: AI belaikheno phan gwnang saksak samung khwlai mannai, kutuk jwngjal rokno kwlaisakhe bailchap khwlai mano tei kwtal kwtal manwi swnamwi bini sep rokbo rwwi mano.
en: AI is a powerful tool that can be used to automate tasks, solve complex problems, and create new products and services.

kok: Haiphano, AI no saksak tangchap khwlai mannaikhe swnamnani bo chaitogwi tangjago aro borok rokni mungsa yak nangyaui samung khwlai manna twi.
en: However, AI can also be used to create autonomous systems that are capable of making decisions without human intervention.

kok: Obobai chaya samung tei khak baiching wngnani mari bo phaimano dal bidal samungo.
en: This raises the risk of bias and error, as well as the potential for these systems to be used for malicious purposes.

kok: Paithago, kwtal kwtal tangsepni yak nangmabai, romdi 5G network tei Internet bai manwi khwnwi thepajakma rokbai samung chaya bangnani roknibo kiri koro wngo.
en: Finally, the development of new technologies, such as 5G networks and the Internet of Things, has the potential to create new vulnerabilities in our digital infrastructure.

kok: O kebelmung hackers eba juda samung sitra tangnai sinimarimung khogwi derarwi mano tei baithang dukhubo manwi mano.
en: These vulnerabilities could be exploited by hackers and other malicious actors to steal data, disrupt services, and even cause physical damage.

kok: O wanamung rokno twywi, chwng chapthai kwlayo, sakni manthai, sak huithai tei naichom jakmarokni yakni yokna bagwi yak tolna nangnai.
en: In light of these concerns, it is important to take steps to protect our privacy, security, and freedom of expression in the age of surveillance and technological innovation.

kok: Kaisa jora ni kok, aro khoroksa bwrwima sikli tong mung Nandita je kaisa khil tola bisingo achaikha.
en: Once upon a time, there was a young woman named Nandita who was born into a low caste.

kok: Bo bini nukhungni borok bai hamyakhe saknangjakya wngkha tei ah kubun kamini borokrokbai bo, tei bo rwngnok eba jesa yaksrairok swrwngma bwkhak thangna bwkhak gosijakya.
en: She was treated poorly by her family and the other villagers, and she was not allowed to go to school or learn any skills.

kok: Salsa, Nandita ah bolongo bisingtwih himwi tongmani jephuru bo kaisa buthup berainarok malai phaikha.
en: One day, Nandita was walking through the forest when she came across a group of travelers.

kok: Ah berainairok kaisa juda juda khilni simi wngkha, tei bohrok kaham tei Nanditano lamsokmani wngkha.
en: The travelers were from a different caste, and they were kind and welcoming to Nandita.

kok: Bohrok bono bahaikhe porini tei swina phwrwngkha, tei bohrok bono ah doyungni bising kaisa samung naitukna bwkhak chubakha.
en: They taught her how to read and write, and they helped her to find a job in the city.

kok: Nandita ah berainairokni bwkhak hamsuthai wngkha bono chubamani bagwi, tei bo swmai tangkha bini kwtal yaksrairok kubunrok chubama bwkhak phwnangnai.
en: Nandita was grateful to the travelers for helping her, and she vowed to use her new skills to help others.

kok: Bo tola khilrok simi chwrairokni bagwi kaisa rwngnok swrwngkha, tei bo bohrokno phwrwngkha bohrokni raidarokni bagwi tei thansani bagwi bahaikhe bulainai.
en: She started a school for children from low castes, and she taught them about their rights and how to fight for equality.

kok: Nanditani samung kaisa pherlaimung swnamkha ah kwbangma borok langmarokni bising, tei bo ah lama slaina bwkhak chubakha je borokni wansukma ah khil lamni bagwi.
en: Nandita's work made a difference in the lives of many people, and she helped to change the way that people thought about the caste system.

kok: Salsa, Nandita jephuru aj kamini bisingtwih himwi tongmani bo kaisa omorkisa chwrairokno khoroksa bwrwi kaisa tola khil simi cheklekmani nukha.
en: One day, Nandita was walking through the village when she saw a group of young boys harassing a girl from a low caste.

kok: Nandita ah chwrairokni bwkhak saka bachakha tei borokno sakha je bohrokni tongmung chaya hwnwi.
en: Nandita stood up to the boys and told them that their behavior was wrong.

kok: Ah chwrairok Nanditani khakrak bai uanalaijak wngkha, tei bohrok ungkuluk usulkha.
en: The boys were surprised by Nandita's courage, and they backed down.

kok: Kaisa bwchwlwi wngkha chikonsa, phopjak buphang uaphang embryo je hamkrai khainani mannai wngkha kaisa kwtal buphang uaphang tola ah kubui tonghalokrok bisingtwih.
en: A seed is a small, dormant plant embryo that is capable of developing into a new plant under the right conditions.

kok: Jephuru kaisa bwchwlwi bumuk permarok, omo yarwngrok torma tei buphang bokchorok bwkhak chengmanirok.
en: When a seed sprouts, it begins to grow roots and shoots.

kok: Ah yarwngrok ah buphang uaphangno ha bising songthang khayo tei twi kusupbo tei ha ni simi chahkohlomrok khayo.
en: The roots anchor the plant in the soil and absorb water and nutrients from the ground.

kok: Ah buphang bokchorok sakabwkhangrok torwi ah salni ganarwi thango, tei ah bwlairok photosynthesize bwkhak chengo, ah buphang uaphang bagwi chathaih thaihrwmani.
en: The shoots grow upwards towards the sun, and the leaves begin to photosynthesize, producing food for the plant.

kok: Ah buphang uaphang torkheno, omo kaisa bosok, bwlairok, khumrok, tei bwthaih hamkrairok khayo.
en: As the plant grows, it develops a stem, leaves, flowers, and fruit.

kok: Ah khumrok bwchwlwirok thaihrwo, bomo nokbar, twi, eba malmatarok bai saharjak wngkha.
en: The flowers produce seeds, which are dispersed by wind, water, or animals.

kok: Jephuru kaisa bwchwlwi subhida thayo karijago, omo bumuk perma tei ah tormani tangsep jotto tei waisa chengwi mano.
en: When a seed lands in a suitable location, it can germinate and begin the process of growth all over again.

kok: Ah bwchwlwi bumuk permani tangsep wngkha kaisa habar wanamasingsa.
en: The process of seed germination is a marvel of nature.

kok: Omo wngkha kaisa thwiswimung ah langmani phan bwkhak tei ah habar hayung phorphor bagwi.
en: It is a testament to the power of life and the resilience of the natural world.

kok: Jephuru ah bwchwlwi bumuk permarok, omo wngkha kaisa khajamung mari tei kwtal chengmanirok.
en: When a seed sprouts, it is a sign of hope and new beginnings.

kok: Grace: Nwng ano oboni laibumano twywi kisa sauide mano?
en: Grace: Can you tell me a little bit about its history?

kok: Phwrwngnai: Aow. Cha-ni achaimung Chin-o, obo aro bisi ba-saini kwbang jora romwi kaijagui 5, 000 tongo.
en: Teacher: Of course. Tea originated in China, where it has been cultivated for over 5,000 years.

kok: Cha-ni puila swiui tisamung khristo achaimani bisira tham swkangni, jephuru obono Chin-ni bithini bijapo khursajakmani.
en: The first written record of tea dates back to the 3rd century BC, when it was mentioned in a Chinese medical text.

kok: Sana thangkhe chah dalsa bithi bwrai hwnwi samungo phwnangjakmani, phiya obo daktino jotto hoda beremni chin-ni borokrokni bisingo lukuni nwngjaknai wngwi bwchakha.
en: Tea was originally used as a medicinal herb, but it quickly became a popular drink among Chinese people of all social classes.

kok: Grace: Chin-ni phatarokhe bahai? Cha hayungni kubun amchairogo buphuru pirjaknani chengkha?
en: Grace: What about outside of China? When did tea start to spread to other parts of the world?

kok: Phwrwngnai: Bisira chidogo Europe-o Portoguese baniya khwlainairok-baikhe puila cha chengjakmani.
en: Teacher: Tea was first introduced to Europe in the 16th century by Portuguese traders.

kok: Obo daktino Europeni sisukjakrokni bising, , lukuni wngwi bwchakha tei 18th bisira chichar joratwi cha British hukumuni kaisa bwkhak kotor wngwi bwchakha.
en: It quickly became popular among European elites, and by the 18th century, tea had become a staple of British culture.

kok: Bisira 19th chichukuo, salsi America-obo cha chengjakmani, obo aro colony khaui tongnairok tei americao achainairok kainwini bisingo lukuni nwngjaknai wngwi bwchakha.
en: In the 19th century, tea was also introduced to North America, where it became a popular drink among both colonists and Native Americans.

kok: Grace: Obo kwkubuino khwnathotok. Ang uaisaphano saimanyakho je cha-ni aswk kothoma kolok kaisa tongo.
en: Grace: That's really interesting.I never knew that tea had such a long history.

kok: Phwrwngnai: Obo khwnathotok kothoma, tei obo tabukbo swijagwi tongkho.
en: Teacher: It's a fascinating story, and it's one that's still being written today.

kok: Bua hayapha" ano kisa naina rid. [rogini bua amjogwi naikha.] hmm, omo naimani nini ro bwlah tongma kahai.
en: Dentist: Let me take a look. [Examines the patient's teeth.] Hmm, it looks like you have a cavity.

kok: Ang bwlah no khurwi karina bwkhak thangna nanganw tei bwlamno supungna nanganw.
en: I'm going to need to drill out the decay and fill the hole.

kok: Rogi: omo twda sano?
en: Patient: Will it hurt?

kok: Bua hayapha: omo kisa tongthokya wngwimano, phiya ang ani jora twi jur rinai jetwi sayawui swnam manai.
en: Dentist: It might be a little uncomfortable, but I'll do my best to make it as painless as possible.

kok: Bua hayapha:(rogino oroni anesthetic rwkha) ako, omo oh ari o bormanya khaiyanw je nwng mungsaphanao wngjakgwlak.
en: Dentist: (gives the patient a local anesthetic) Okay, this will numb the area so you won't feel anything.

kok: Bua hayapha: (bwlah no khurwi karikha tei bwlamno supungkhe) jotto paikha!
en: Dentist: (drills out the decay and fills the hole) All done!

kok: Rogi: hambai nono, saknainai. abo aswkbo hamya wngya.
en: Patient: Thank you, doctor. That wasn't so bad.

kok: Bua hayapha: phaikaham nono bo. kubuino haino bua hudi tei joglukdi salbrumno thinango bwlahno babai katinani.
en: Dentist: You're welcome. Just be sure to brush and floss regularly to prevent future cavities.

kok: Rogi: ang khainai bua hayapha: (rogino mungremni phunukmani yapharkha) iko oro kisa phunukmani tongo bahaikh nini kwtal supungmanino naikolnai.
en: Patient: I will Dentist: (hands the patient a list of instructions) Here are some instructions on how to care for your new filling.

kok: Rogi: hambai nono.
en: Patient: Thank you.

kok: Translation ni kwbangma manmari tongu, solaimani morok content bangrimanino khobwi, chasamani sogwimani, tei kwtal hartirogo khulukmani.
en: Translation has many benefits, including increasing the relative value of content, improving accessibility, and opening up new markets.

kok: Jephuru content translated khaijago, omo kuar nainairokni bwkhak sogwijak wngwi thango, phalma tei manmari phasing bangrw'ui mano.
en: When content is translated, it becomes accessible to a wider audience, which can lead to increased sales and profits.

kok: Jora rwmung, translation painai bororok bai halomani tisatani chubai mano kubuni hakotor tei humuku rokbai.
en: In addition, translation can help to build relationships with customers in other countries and cultures.

kok: Dalbidal kokrokni content phunujakmabai, beparrok phunuk mano je bohrok yapharjakma wngkha hayungrwgwi nainai rokni thani sogwinani.
en: By displaying content in multiple languages, businesses can show that they are committed to reaching a global audience.

kok: Omo nujakya painai borokrokni bising poito tei credibility swnamna bagwi chubachu manwi mano.
en: This can help to build trust and credibility with potential customers.

kok: iko oro kisa specific phunukmari bahai khe phunukmani beparrogo manmarikha: * kaisa chikonsa bepar je yakbai swnnamjak kanjaknai translated khai phalo website o Spanish, French, tei German bai.
en: Here are some specific examples of how translation has benefited businesses: * A small business that sells handmade jewelry translated its website into Spanish, French, and German.

kok: Phaithago, phatarhani painai borokrokni thani oro phalma thaino rwgwi nangkukmani bangmung nukjakha * kaisa kotor corporation je sakham manwi swnammarok dalbidal kokrokno yakbai omoni duna bwthaih tangjaknairok kokswlayo.
en: As a result, it saw a significant increase in sales from international customers * A large corporation that manufactures medical devices translated its product manuals into multiple languages.

kok: Omo oro khasrai khlaima khai je chubachu manma khunni hakotorrokni saknairok tei hamya naikolnairok devices katirwi tei sago kwlaiya khgai phwangwi mano * Kaisa manmarikwrwi motha je borokrokno chubam jag bagjago bini translated brochures tei websites rokni bising chwnwi kokrokno phwnango.
en: This helped to ensure that doctors and nurses in other countries could use the devices safely and effectively * A nonprofit organization that provides humanitarian aid translated its brochures and websites into dozens of languages.

kok: Omo nangmani borokrokni aro chubachu sogwikha hayakhe je motharokni tanglamo sogwinani khomota kwrwi rokni bagwi.
en: This helped to reach people in need who would not have otherwise been able to access the organization's resources.

kok: Translation kaisa phangwnangkol je bepar rokno torwnani tei khlaimanmano chubai mano.
en: Translation is a powerful tool that can help businesses to grow and succeed.

kok: Samung wngkha khulumjakthai hwnwi hwnjakmani, abo jeswk phano samung kotoi eba hamthaya phano wngthwng, abono borom rwthai.
en: Work is worship is a principle that states that all work, no matter how menial or insignificant it may seem, is sacred.

kok: Omo bo kaisa poito chajago bebak samung chwng khwlaimarog, chini chwrairokni bagwi horni chamung sung mani simi nok kwchwng khwlaima jora, abo kaisa Kaitorno tei chwnghai borokno borom rwna sep manma se kwlayo.
en: It is a belief that every task we perform, from cooking dinner for our children to cleaning the house, is an opportunity to honor God and our fellow man.

kok: Omo hai uasokmungrok bai samung khwlai khe, chini samungno borom rwma bisingtwi chengsa mase kwlayo.
en: When we work with this mindset, we approach our tasks with a sense of reverence and respect.

kok: Chini samung bai chwng kungchugo tei kaham khe khwlaisokna bagwi kaham ma khwlayo.
en: We take pride in our work and do our best to do it well.

kok: Chini samung ni bisingtwi kebo borok hamcha'ui tongkhe abono bo chwng uansok thai kwlayo, abo baino chwng teibo lama kwchal sogwinai kaham khwlaimani bisingtwi.
en: We also become more mindful of the people who will benefit from our work, and we are more likely to go the extra mile to make sure that it is done well.

kok: Samungno khuluma hai khe tangmani abo chini nukhungni tei hodani borokrogbai kwrwng thani chukrw wi mano.
en: Working as worship can also help us to connect with our families and communities.

kok: Chini chwrairokni bagwi chwng horni chamung sungmani, abo chwng bohrokno naikol mani simi bai thakmani kwlaiya, phiya chwng bohrok bai jora swbaimani tei chamung bai nukhungno twywi bwswk joratwi nangwi tong abono phwrwng mase kwlayo.
en: When we cook dinner for our children, we are not only providing them with nourishment, but we are also spending time with them and teaching them about the importance of food and family.

kok: Chwng nok kwchwng khwlai mani, abo chwng chini tongkhor no tontho-thok khwlaimani simiya, phiya chwng khakchangmano swnamani se kwlayo.
en: When we clean the house, we are not only making our living space more comfortable, but we are also creating a sense of order and peace.

kok: Samung wngkha khulumjakthai hwnmani abo belai kok kotor abo chini langmani halog bothanio swlaimung tubui mano.
en: Work is worship is a powerful principle that can transform our lives and our relationships.

kok: O uansokmungrok bai samung khwlai khe, samung tangna bwkha kwrwi wngwi tongma jora o phano chwng aboni sosol naharmung no saimanai.
en: When we work with this mindset, we can find meaning and purpose in even the most mundane tasks.

kok: Samung tokerok kaisa kotor swlaijakmani tongo laithangma bisirokni bising tolathangkha.
en: Action films have undergone a major transformation in recent years.

kok: Ah khakepleng salrok thangkha, kaisa-banukmung sengrakrok tei themrangrok wngkha.
en: Gone are the days of simple, one-dimensional heroes and villains.

kok: Tinini samung tokerok wngkha teibo kutuk, tomung bai je nangmani swlaijakmarokni ah tokeni swrwngthai sakao tolathango.
en: Today's action films are more complex, with characters who undergo significant transformations over the course of the film.

kok: Ah swlaijakmani wngkha uramuram kaisa tokeni kokbwkhakrokni kiphilmani, bono ah nukhung nangkukma simi ah hamjakma phan bwkhak rem mano.
en: This transformation is often a reflection of the film's themes, which can range from the importance of family to the power of love.

kok: Juda laithangma samung tokerok oh swlaijakmani sapokthaih mwkhang tongo.
en: Several recent action films have featured this type of transformation.

kok: Ah toke bising "tokbagh borok, " phunukmari karwi, ah swimung tomung kisa yagul samung sichajak wngjak simi thango kaisa khajamungni mari ah Gotham doyung bagwi.
en: In the film "The Batman," for example, the title character goes from being a vengeful vigilante to a symbol of hope for the city of Gotham.

kok: "Kosom Mwsasampari, " bising T'Challa Wakananda ni bubagra bini tangmung lamsokma bwkhak ma swrwngnai, ahaino haiphano omo kokmarok bini baksa sakphang phiyokjak yakarmani.
en: In "Black Panther," T'Challa must learn to embrace his role as king of Wakanda, even though it means giving up some of his personal freedoms.

kok: Tei "tangokra unamansingsa, " o Carol Danvers bini pharokrokno kaswkma bwkhak ma swrwngnai tei bohrokno kahamni bagwi phwnangdi.
en: And in "Captain Marvel," Carol Danvers must learn to control her powers and use them for good.

kok: Oh tokerok phunukma je samung tokerok haino buchiya bulaimung salai teibo wngmano.
en: These films show that action films can be more than just mindless violence.

kok: Bohrok kwtal karima kutuk kokbwkhakrok tei tongmungrok bwkhak bo phwnangjak mano.
en: They can also be used to explore complex themes and characters.

kok: Malmata satokmani wngkha saimantwtwi sukmani sama, dukhumanmani, eba kaisa malmata thwimung sakao.
en: Animal cruelty is the intentional infliction of pain, suffering, or death upon an animal.

kok: Omo kwbangma sakmang nai mano, sakno twi satokma simi saknangya bwkhak.
en: It can take many forms, from physical abuse to neglect.

kok: Malmatarok bujak mano, lathirwma, khamma, ok khwima, eba kubuni borokrok tongthokmungni slai mungsa kok kwrwi phano haino bwtharjakma.
en: Animals may be beaten, kicked, burned, starved, or even killed for no reason other than human entertainment.

kok: Malmata satokmani wngkha kaisa kubui kebengmung je bisi thwgwi chirasai malmatarok gwdalmarok.
en: Animal cruelty is a serious problem that affects millions of animals every year.

kok: Omo jottoni slai hakotorni bising lamchaya, phiya phanbai khlaimani wngkha uramuram luthur.
en: It is illegal in most countries, but enforcement is often lax.

kok: Aro kwbangma motharok tongo je kasogra bwkha samung khayo tei malmata satokmani mwthakma, phiya teibo khlaina bwkhak nango.
en: There are many organizations that work to prevent and stop animal cruelty, but more needs to be done.

kok: Chwng jotto malmata satokmani mwthakna bwkhak chubai mano ah swirwma teibo saimanma wngjak bai tei omo kebengwi samani bai.
en: We can all help to stop animal cruelty by being more aware of the issue and by speaking out against it.

kok: Chwng beparirokni simi paihna bwkhak bo saimano je malamata satokmani nangmani khaiya tei motharokno nangmani bwkhak je malmatarokno mwthangna bwkhak samung khaimani.
en: We can also choose to buy from businesses that do not support animal cruelty and to support organizations that work to protect animals.

kok: Malmata satokmani wngkha kaisa kirimasinsa manwi je jotto salo wngmarok.
en: Animal cruelty is a terrible thing that happens every day.

kok: Chwng jotto kaisa pherlaimung swnamma bwkhak chubai mano omo kebengwi ongkhor samani bai tei motharokno nangmani bai je omono mwthakna bwkhak samung khaimani.
en: We can all help to make a difference by speaking out against it and by supporting organizations that work to stop it.

kok: Kosom wngkha kaisa pali je laihbuma bisingtwih phwnangjagwi phayo kainwi phan tei satokmani adong wngkha bwkhak.
en: Black is a color that has been used throughout history to represent both power and oppression.

kok: Kwcham Egypt o, kosom wngkha Osiris mwtai bai gwdaljak, je khilwng no hanaikolnai.
en: In ancient Egypt, black was associated with the god Osiris, who was the ruler of the underworld.

kok: Christian wngphanai, kosom uramuram thwimung tei khanangmung bai gwdaljak.
en: In the Christian tradition, black is often associated with death and mourning.

kok: Haiphano, kosom wngkha kaisa mari phan tei resilience bai phwnangjagwi phayo.
en: However, black has also been used as a symbol of strength and resilience.

kok: Ah luku manthairok ninangrimung bising, kosom wngkha kwbangma samung-humungni bagwi saijak pali, je omo no kaisa lama bwkhak borokni khathonmani bwkahk bulaimani baksani bagwi nukha.
en: In the civil rights movement, black was the color of choice for many activists, who saw it as a way to represent their determination to fight for equality.

kok: Tini, kosom tabukbo kaisa kutuk tei jadrepod pali.
en: Today, black is still a complex and multifaceted color.

kok: Omo kaisa mari kainwi kaham tei hamya khe nukjak mano, naithok tei sitrama, phan tei satokmani.
en: It can be seen as a symbol of both good and evil, beauty and ugliness, power and oppression.

kok: Phiya haiphano jesamanwi sei kwbang, kosom wngkha kaisa pali je borok saimanmano adong wngmarok khayo.
en: But perhaps more than anything else, black is a color that represents the human experience.

kok: Omo wngkha kaisa pali je chwng jotto baklayo, chini chini bosong khaurya, tongthar eba hodaphalam.
en: It is a color that we all share, regardless of our race, religion, or nationality.

kok: Ahaino ah hayung bangrwmani baksaya wngmarok, kosom kaisa teibo nangkukma pali chini hukumu bising wngmani.
en: As the world becomes increasingly diverse, black is becoming a more important color in our culture.

kok: Ang ah bohrokkwbang ter harok twih himwi thangkheno, ang mwnwiya tongwi manliya.
en: As I walked through the crowded festival grounds, I couldn't help but smile.

kok: Ah sal chwngmani wngkha, ah rwchapmung wngkha khorangchiringmani, tei jottono bohrokni mokolsisirok tei salsisirok thupmani wngkha.
en: The sun was shining, the music was blaring, and everyone was wearing their sunglasses and eyeglasses.

kok: Omo wngkha kaisa twibom pali tei tongdal kahai, tei omo ano kaisa omoni bokcho wngna bwkhak tongthok wansukmung swnamo.
en: It was like a sea of color and style, and it made me feel happy to be a part of it.

kok: Ang jotto rwngremrok juda juda sisirok borokno thupmani nukha, kiting framerok uarrwma bwkhak, aming-mokol banokmarok.
en: I saw people wearing all sorts of different glasses, from simple, round frames to elaborate, cat-eye shapes.

kok: Aro salsisirok tongjak jotto pali chokhereng bising, tei baksa borok ahaino sisirok tongo je chwngsama eba palirok swlaijakma.
en: There were sunglasses in every color of the rainbow, and some people even had glasses that lit up or changed colors.

kok: Omo wngkha kaisa kachum kahai, tei ang sak chubai manliya phiya jottoni solya tongdal lopkha.
en: It was like a fashion show, and I couldn't help but admire everyone's unique style.

kok: Ang bwrwima khoroksa bai kok sana bwkhak bathakha je kaisa bojro kwchwng kormo salsisirok thupmani wngkha.
en: I stopped to talk to a woman who was wearing a pair of bright yellow sunglasses.

kok: Boh ano sakha je boh salsisirok thupnani hamjago tamni hinma bohrok bono teibo khakrak tei tongdalma wansukmung swnamo.
en: She told me that she loved wearing sunglasses because they made her feel more confident and stylish.

kok: Boh sakha je boh homnino kaisa richum kanamni wansukma kahai wngkha jephuru bo bini sisirok thupjakya phuru, tei je bohrok bono bini saksuar muchungsama bwkhak chubakha.
en: She said that she always felt like she was wearing a costume when she didn't have her glasses on, and that they helped her to express her personality.

kok: Ang choyai karwi ani himlan thangkha, tei ang sakno chubai manliya phiya ah hayungni bagwi teibo khachongmung wansukkha.
en: I continued on my way, and I couldn't help but feel more optimistic about the world.

kok: Karim bai Abed chwrai phangsini simi bayap wngphaimani.
en: Karim and Abed had been friends since they were kids.

kok: Bohrok thansa khe torkha, rwngnogo baska no thangkha, tei borok thwngdol baksa kheno thwngmung thwngkha.
en: They grew up together, went to the same schools, and even played on the same sports teams.

kok: Bohrokni kwthalaima hai tei kubunrok solya.
en: They had a bond that was like no other.

kok: Bohrok jesphano twi kok saimano, tei bohrok saimano bohrok khoroksa tei khoroksa no goni mano.
en: They could talk about anything, and they always knew that they could count on each other.

kok: Salsa, Karim cancer bemar manjakha.
en: One day, Karim was diagnosed with cancer.

kok: Bo sakbaijakha, phiya bo saimano je bini thani Abed logi tongo.
en: He was devastated, but he knew that he had Abed to lean on.

kok: Abed bini jotto yapri sehma lama bini logi tongo, rachikjakphuru, chemotheraphy, tei radiation.
en: Abed was there for him every step of the way, through the surgeries, the chemotherapy, and the radiation.

kok: Bo Karim ni gandar ni yakarya, tei bo bono homnino khajamung rio.
en: He never left Karim's side, and he always gave him hope.

kok: Karim kwdwkma olo Cancer no mechenrikha, bo bai Abed aphuru ni simi teibo gandar wngkha.
en: Karim eventually beat cancer, and he and Abed were closer than ever.

kok: Bohrok khoroknwi no mwkhang bai mwkhang langma-swlaijagwi sijakha, tei bohrok khoroknwi no kwrak khe ongkhor phaikha.
en: They had both faced a life-changing experience, and they had come out of it stronger together.

kok: John khoroksa hukbar khwlainai, boh mogudam tei soyabin kaiui errwo.
en: John was a farmer who grew corn and soybeans.

kok: Boh bisi thamchini kwbang jora romwi hukbar khwlai 30 tongo tei luku bosongo belai borom manjak tongmani.
en: He had been farming for over 30 years and was well-respected in the community.

kok: Salsa, haphangni tangphang dolsa Johnbai kwrwngmani, jerok hukbar khwlainairokno tangsep kwtal naharthani chubana bagwi yapri swkang kaisano twidulwi tongmani.
en: One day, John was approached by a group of government officials who were leading an initiative to help farmers adopt new technologies.

kok: Tangphangsong John-no sakha je tumung boh tangraida kwtal samungo phwnangnani gosio hinkhe bohrok bohno bini hukbar bwthaih bangrwthani tei bini rang swbaimung holirwthani chubauimano.
en: The officials told John that they could help him increase his crop yields and reduce his costs if he would agree to use their new methods.

kok: Puilao John thotomoto wngmani, phiya paithago boh obono uaisa naiui nainani gosikha.
en: John was hesitant at first, but he eventually agreed to give it a try.

kok: Tangphangsong John-no manui khunui kwtalni kaisa set tei bahaikhe obono samungo phwnangnai aboni loi phwrwngkha.
en: The officials provided John with a new set of equipment and training on how to use it.

kok: John uanajakha je manui khunui kwtalrokno samungo phwnangmung belai kwlai tongmani tei boh logilogino manmarirok nugwi manmani.
en: John was surprised at how easy it was to use the new equipment and he was quickly able to see the benefits.

kok: Bini hukbar bwthaih khursathaikhe bangkha tei bini rang swbaimungbo holikha.
en: His crop yields increased significantly and his costs went down.

kok: John wngmungno twywi belai khatungjak tongmani je boh bini hukbar khwlainai palsongno o samung bwtang kwtalni kokbiti rwkha.
en: John was so happy with the results that he recommended the new program to his fellow farmers.

kok: Oh samung bwtang chaui thangkha tei kwbangma hukbar khwlainaino bohrokni samungrok chasarwthani chubakha.
en: The program was a success and helped many farmers improve their operations.

kok: Siklarok kaisa poito chaya tangmung thwngo bosong tisamani bising.
en: Youths play an incredibly important role in nation building.

kok: Bohrok wngkha chini hakotorni thinang tei bohrokni thani ah phan tongo kaisa kubui pherlaimung swnamma bwkhak.
en: They are the future of our country and they have the power to make a real difference.

kok: Bohrok phan kuplung, swnammanai, tei khamuchung tongo, tei bohrok kaisa swlaimung swnamma bwkhak muchungjak tongo.
en: They are full of energy, creativity, and passion, and they are eager to make a change.

kok: Jephuru borok sikla bosong tisanani bising manjakna bwkhak ah sep rwjakha, bohrok poito chaya manwirok khlaimano.
en: When young people are given the opportunity to participate in nation building, they can do incredible things.

kok: Bohrok kwtal beparirok chengjak mano, kwtal tangseprok swnamma, tei baksa paihma ah hayungni jottoni slai sekhrubmani kebengmungrok.
en: They can start new businesses, create new technologies, and solve some of the world's most pressing problems.

kok: Boroh kubunrokno khasrangrwma bo mano kaisa pherlaimung swnamma tei kubuljak manna bwkhak.
en: They can also inspire others to get involved and make a difference.

kok: Kaisa phunukmari bahai sikla borok kaisa pherlaimug swnammani tongp bosong tisamani bising wngkha ah Malala Fund samung tangma twih.
en: One example of how young people are making a difference in nation building is through the work of the Malala Fund.

kok: Malala Yousafzai, khoroksa Pakistani bwrwi rwng bagwi tangnai, khorogo kokjakha ah Taliban rokbai 2012 o bwrwirokni bagwi rwng digi bising ongkhor samani bagwi.
en: Malala Yousafzai, a Pakistani activist for female education, was shot in the head by the Taliban in 2012 for speaking out in favor of education for girls.

kok: Ah choproma thangmani olo, Mamala khoroksa hayungrwgwi bwrwirokni rwng bagwi saulphang wngkha tei ah Malala thumrang swnamakha ah hayung yaksiyagra bwrwirokni bagwi rwng nangmani bwkhak.
en: After surviving the attack, Malala became a global advocate for girls' education and founded the Malala Fund to support education for girls around the world.

kok: Ah Malala thumrang poito chaya mungtisalaih chasamung tongma omoni pinnokni bwkhak manthokma bising 130 chirasai bwrwi bai 12 bisirok phiyokjak, katijak, rwng hammung 2030 bai.
en: The Malala Fund has registered incredible progress in its mission to provide 130 million girls with 12 years of free, safe, quality education by 2030.

kok: Ang software engineer wngwi samung khaimani kaisa kotor tech company o aphuru ang puila feminism bagwi khwnamani.
en: I was working as a software engineer at a large tech company when I first heard about feminism.

kok: Ang swnamkhor kwtal tei kubuino aboni bagwi aswk saimanya, phiya ang daktino intrigued wngkha.
en: I was new to the industry and didn't really know much about it, but I was immediately intrigued.

kok: Ang baksa rutukwrwk khaina chengjakha tei feminism koksoprok porinani, tei ang mwlang chajak bwswk ang saimanya.
en: I started doing some research and reading articles about feminism, and I was amazed by how much I didn't know.

kok: Ang homnino saksak no khoroksa feminist hwnwi wansugo, phiya ang buchikha je bo kwbang swrwngna nango.
en: I had always thought of myself as a feminist, but I realized that I had a lot to learn.

kok: Kaisa manwirok je ang swrwngmani je femimism wngkha teibo karwi haino baksa chwla tei bwrwima ni bising.
en: One of the things that I learned was that feminism is about more than just equality between men and women.

kok: Omo wngkha bataimani tangdalrok ni phan je chwla rokbai swnamjak tei je chwla manmari bwkhak bwrwima o swbaima.
en: It's also about challenging the systems of power that have been created by men and that benefit men at the expense of women.

kok: Oh tangdalrok ni phan jottothayo no, samungthai ni simi hapangni pinlam bwkhak.
en: These systems of power are everywhere, from the workplace to the media to the government.

kok: Aro kwbangma kok tongo je bwrwima rok chwla rokni slai kisa rwjago, je bohrok tola adong wngma ojamani thairogo, tei bohrok teibo mohai je o kikhrini satoklaimung.
en: They're the reason that women are paid less than men, that they're underrepresented in leadership positions, and that they're more likely to be victims of violence.

kok: Feminism wngkha oh tangdalrokni phan kwthaiya bulaimani bagwi tei haino teibo kaiisa swnamani tei hayungni jotto borokni bagwi tiyar khlaima.
en: Feminism is about fighting against these systems of power and creating a more just and equitable world for all people.

kok: Omo kaisa hayung swnamnani bagwi boro bwrwima rok phiyokjagwi tongnani bwkhak bohrokni langmarok bohrokni sak jorarok rwi, wngkuluk phirok wngdok karwi dahl phermung eba khakjakmani.
en: It's about creating a world where women are free to live their lives on their own terms, without being held back by sexism or discrimination.

kok: Rwngphwrwngjakma seprok tei tanglamrok rwngswrwngnai rokni bagwi manthokma je sakno twinai rwngnogo saktongjakya, hainohai kaisa yakhili pairinani naimungni bagwi, laithangnai bisirokni bising bangwi phaimani nukjakha.
en: Educational opportunities and resources available for students who are not physically present at a school, typically for the purpose of completing a degree, have been increasing in recent years.

kok: Omo wngkha ah online swrwngmani tormung bwkhak bising bokcho, bomo rwngswrwngrokni bagwi uwngwiman hayungni jesathai ni simi swrwngthairok nama bwkhak om swnamjago.
en: This is due in part to the growth of online learning, which has made it possible for students to take courses from anywhere in the world.

kok: Aro wngkha kaisa juda juda online swrwngjaknai platforms je rwngsrwngnairok bohrokni yakhilirok pairina bwkhak phwngwi mano.
en: There are a number of different online learning platforms that students can use to complete their degrees.

kok: Baksa ah jottoni slai lukuhamjak platforms wngkha Coursera, edX, tei Udacity no khobwi.
en: Some of the most popular platforms include Coursera, edX, and Udacity.

kok: Oh platforms kaisa dalbidal swrwngthairok yapharo kuchuk rwngkhungrok tei colleges simi, tei rwngsrwngnairok swrwngthairok saima bwkhak naimano credit eba audit karwi bohrokni bagwi phiyojak.
en: These platforms offer a variety of courses from top universities and colleges, and students can choose to take courses for credit or audit them for free.

kok: Jora rwmani bising bwkhak online swrwngmani platforms, aro wngkha kwbangma kubun tanglamrok rwngswrwngnairokni bwkhak manthokma je rwngnogo sakno twinai saktongjakya.
en: In addition to online learning platforms, there are also a number of other resources available to students who are not physically present at a school.

kok: Oh tanghalorok online bijapnokrok khobwi, phwrwngmani sebokrok, tei kwcharogo swimani.
en: These resources include online libraries, tutoring services, and writing centers.

kok: Rwngsrwngnai rok twichurma naituk mano online dopharokni simi kubun rwngrwngnairok je bohrokni yakhilirok pairina bagwwi samung khai tongmani.
en: Students can also find support from online communities of other students who are also working to complete their degrees.

kok: Oh yapri songmani wngkha kaisa kokkhurma teimasa ni simi ah manmarirok online swrwngmani bagwi: "Online swrwngmani wngkha kaisia kotor kuar saimung rwngswrwngnai rokni bagwi je ah yakhili eba sinilaih ajina muchungma bwkhak rwngrem campus sakao manjakya tongwi.
en: The following is a quote from someone else about the benefits of online learning: "Online learning is a great option for students who want to earn a degree or certificate without having to attend classes on campus.

kok: Omo kaisa kaham saimung rwngswrwngnai rokni bagwi je paihlaya mungremrok eba je hachal dikholo tongnairok.
en: It's also a good option for students who have busy schedules or who live in remote areas.

kok: Salsa, khoroksa bwrwi sikli habani simi nogo kiphilphuru boh khoroksa chwla borokbai choprojakha.
en: One day, a young woman was walking home from work when she was attacked by a man.

kok: Boh kirijak thangkha tei tamo khwlainai abono saimanlia.
en: She was scared and didn't know what to do.

kok: Phiya aphuru boh a kokno muitu mankha jebo boh sak katimungni rwngremo swrwngmani: Tumung uaisaswk nwng choprojakha hinkhe, uphildi tei nono chopronaibai dadak sidak wngdi.
en: But then she remembered something she had learned in a self-defense class: if you're ever attacked, turn and face your attacker.

kok: Abobai nono haya khwlaithani bohrokni bagwi teibo kutuk wngano.
en: This will make it more difficult for them to harm you.

kok: O bwrwi uphilwi bohno chopronai borokbai dadak sidak wngo.
en: The woman turned and faced her attacker.

kok: Boh kirijak thangkha, phiya boh bulaina bagwibo khathonjak tongmani.
en: She was scared, but she was also determined to fight back.

kok: Boh bini yaktwk tisaui o borokni sukmungno kasokha.
en: She raised her arms and blocked the man's punches.

kok: Boh bini yakungo lathi rwkha tei bini bohogo yaskubai kasukkha.
en: She kicked him in the shins and kneed him in the stomach.

kok: Oh chwla o bwrwini phan tei khathonjakno nugwi uanajakha.
en: The man was surprised by the woman's strength and determination.

kok: Boh unslui thangnani chengkha.
en: He started to back away.

kok: Sir baksaya: kaisa hayaungrwgwi kebengmung sir baksaya wngkha kaisa hayungrwgwi kebengmung je hakchal-sogwimani bwthaihrok bwrwima tei bwrwirokni bagwi.
en: Gender Inequality: A Global Problem Gender inequality is a global problem that has far-reaching consequences for women and girls.

kok: Kabangma hakotorrokni bising, bwrwima rok nangmani manthai gosijakya wngkha ahaino ah chongmung manthai, sakni manwiphan, eba ah nok ni phataro samung khainani.
en: In many countries, women are denied basic rights such as the right to vote, own property, or work outside the home.

kok: Bohrok bulaimani saimanjakma, bigra tei khakjakmarok bwkhak bo kahai teibo wngkha.
en: They are also more likely to experience violence, poverty, and discrimination.

kok: Aro kwbangma bwchwlwi tongo sir baksaya rwma bwkhak, hukumu yaphangrok, tongthar poitorok, tei rangthong chaya khaimarok.
en: There are many factors that contribute to gender inequality, including cultural norms, religious beliefs, and economic disparities.

kok: Haiphano, aro kwbangma manwirok tongo je oh kebenegmungni nikuma bwkhak khlaimano.
en: However, there are also many things that can be done to address this problem.

kok: Hapangrok raidarok lairwi mano sir baksaya remstima bwkhak, tei beparirok langmakhatirok swnam mano je bwrwirmarokni manthairok twichuruma khlaimano.
en: Governments can pass laws to promote gender equality, and businesses can create policies that support women's rights.

kok: Saksakrok kaisa samung thwngwi man sir stereotypes bataiman bai tei khakjakmani gwdalwi ongkhor samani.
en: Individuals can also play a role by challenging gender stereotypes and speaking out against discrimination.

kok: Ah sir baksa bulaima wngkha kaisa kolok tei 3 kaisa, phiya omo wngkha kaisa bulaima je bulaiwui swk wngkha.
en: The fight for gender equality is a long and difficult one, but it is a fight that is worth fighting.

kok: Thansa samung khaima bai, chwng kaisa hayung jotto bwrwima tei bwrwirok ni bagwi swnam mano tei borom bai sejakmani tei chwla bai baksa seprok manmani.
en: By working together, we can create a world where all women and girls are treated with respect and have the same opportunities as men.

kok: Kaisa phunukmari mungsaswk je wngwi manma bwkhak sir baksaya nikuma bwkhak wngkha je hapangrok raidarok lairwi mano sir baksa remtisama bwkhak. Oh raidarok sumarok khobwi mano bwrwima gwdalwi bulaima nikuma bwkhak, khasrai khlaima bai baksa rwma baksa samungni bagwi, tei bwrwimarokno thwngrwngrok bising manjakmani remsitamung tei chongmung-swnamani.
en: One example of something that can happen to address gender inequality is that governments can pass laws to promote gender equality. These laws can include measures to address violence against women, ensure equal pay for equal work, and promote women's participation in politics and decision-making.

kok: Bigra tei okkhui wngkha kebengmungrok je hayung yaksiyagra chirasairok borokno nangrwma.
en: Poverty and hunger are major problems that affect millions of people around the world.

en: The World Bank estimates that 1.3 billion people live in absolute poverty, meaning they live on less than $1.90 per day.

kok: Oh hasmai ni bigra khoroksarokni bagwi aswkno swbaimani wngya, phiya kaisa jotto omo hoda o kaisa kotor sekrupma wngkha.
en: This level of poverty is not only devastating for individuals, but it also has a larger impact on society as a whole.

kok: Phunukmari karwi, bigra wngma uramuram kuchukuk tangsitra swkrok bai gwdaljak, nanglaimung, tei hodarwk oroiproi.
en: For example, poverty is often associated with higher rates of crime, violence, and social unrest.

kok: Aro wngkha kwbangma bwchwlwi rok je bigra tei okkhui khangma bwkhak, choba khobwinai, habar dosarok, tei rangthong baksaya.
en: There are a number of factors that contribute to poverty and hunger, including war, natural disasters, and economic inequality.

kok: Haiphano, kaisa kotorma bwchwlwirok khangmnai wngkha khakeplengma kaisa sep ni khangra.
en: However, one of the biggest contributing factors is simply a lack of opportunity.

kok: Kwbangma hakotork hamrwrwk bising, borok rwng sogwina khangra bwkhak, sakduknaikini, tei kubun juda sebarok.
en: In many developing countries, people lack access to education, healthcare, and other basic services.

kok: Omo bohrokno samungrok naitukna bwkhak 3 sep rio tei kaisa beton tongmani bagwi omono swnamo.
en: This makes it difficult for them to find jobs and earn a living wage.

kok: Bigra tei okkhui wngkha nangjakya.
en: Poverty and hunger are not inevitable.

kok: Aro wngkha kwbangma mamnwiwrok je oh kebengrokno nikuma bwkhak khlaimano, rwng manthokmani tei samung swrwngmani, sakduknaikini sogwikha bwkhak hamrwmani, tei rangthong hamkrai remtisamani.
en: There are a number of things that can be done to address these problems, including providing education and job training, improving access to healthcare, and promoting economic growth.

kok: Ah tonghalok phwrwngnai tei swrwngnairokni kwcharo wngkha kaisa kuthuk, phiya omo kaisa je swrwngnai bagwi nangnai wngkha.
en: The relationship between teachers and students is a complex one, but it is one that is essential for learning.

en: Teachers work to impart knowledge and skills to their students, while students learn and grow under their guidance.

kok: Oh halokbokma wngkha kwthalai borom rwma tei poito thai sakao, tei omo wngkha nangnai kaisa kubui habar swrwngnani swnammani bagwi'.
en: This relationship is based on mutual respect and trust, and it is essential for creating a positive learning environment.

kok: Kaisa ah jottoni slai nangkukma manwirok je phwrwngnairok khlaimanma wngkha ah raidarok swrwngwi buchimani bwkhak.
en: One of the most important things that teachers can do is to understand the laws of learning.

en: These laws help teachers to understand how students learn best, and they can use this knowledge to create lessons that are effective and engaging.

kok: Phwrwngnairok sijak wngna nango ah juda juda swrwngmani tongdal je srwngnairokni thani tongmani, tei bohrok bohrokni phwrwngmani khlaimungrok supna nango ah nangmarok malaima bwkhak swrwngnai thwgwi.
en: Teachers should also be aware of the different learning styles that students have, and they should tailor their teaching methods to meet the needs of each student.

en: I'm concerned about the environment and the impact that climate change is having on our planet.

en: I'm also a big fan of technology and gadgets, so I'm always looking for ways to reduce my carbon footprint without sacrificing my lifestyle.

kok: Haini bagwi ang aswkno tongthokjak kwtal khlaima tei slaisong tangphan yakphangrok.
en: That's why I'm so excited about renewable and alternative energy sources.

kok: Kwtal khlaima tangphan wngma mohai tangphan je yakphangrokni simi phaimarok je tongkahamni supungjak, ahaino solar, nokbar, tei twini pherang.
en: Renewable energy is energy that comes from sources that are naturally replenished, such as solar, wind, and water power.

kok: Slaisong tangphan wngma mohai tangphan je yakphangrokni simi phaimarok je wngphaimano phwnang jakya pherang wngrimani , ahaino iko biomass tei geothermal tangphan.
en: Alternative energy is energy that comes from sources that are not traditionally used for power generation, such as biomass and geothermal energy.

kok: Kainwi kwtal khlaima tei slaisong tangphan yakphangrokni wngkha sraisrai tei tikinai, kokmang bohrok greenhouse phaprok thaihrwya eba kubun ebrumrwmarok.
en: Both renewable and alternative energy sources are clean and sustainable, meaning they don't produce greenhouse gases or other pollutants.

kok: Kaisa kahamkuk lamarok bwkhak swnamma kaisa juda juda wngma bwkhak nini nok ni bagwi kwtal khlaima bwkhak swlaimani.
en: One of the best ways to make a difference is to switch to renewable energy sources for your home.

en: You can do this by installing solar panels on your roof, buying a wind turbine, or signing up for a green power plan from your utility company.

en: You can also reduce your energy consumption by unplugging appliances when you're not using them, turning off the lights when you leave a room, and using energy-efficient appliances.

en: Young Man: I get what you're saying. But you have to be careful.

en: However, there are certain circumstances that can increase the risk of a dog attack, such as if the dog is not properly trained, if it is feeling threatened, or if it is in a confined space.

en: The dog's owner has said that he was unaware of any history of aggression in the dog, and that he believes the attack was triggered by the grandmother's sudden movement.

kok: Oh kirimasingsa patimung poja gwnang swihni nokphangni nangkukmano romwi tisao.

kok: Oh suarimungrok yapharma kaisa kuar dalbidal khakwchang, sci-fi tokerok khobwinai, kaisa hacher swk nainathangkhe.

en: The woman helped Paul find his way out of the crowd, and she gave him her phone number in case he ever needed help again.

en: If you live in an area that is prone to natural disasters, you may want to consider a system that is designed to withstand high winds and flooding.
