kok: Chwng samung khwlaimarogno twywi ang belai ma kuchungo, tei angbo saiman kha chwng kwbangma ni langma o swlaimung bo tobo kha.
en: I am very proud of the work that we have done, and I know that we are making a difference in the lives of many people.

kok: Ah tungmani kasamani tei watwi kwlaimani naidalrok slaimani wngkha omo swnammani teibo 3 bwthaihrok torrwma bwkhak baksa kholarokni bising, jephuru ah baksa jora kwtal seprok swnamani kubun kholarokni bising.
en: The rising temperatures and changing precipitation patterns are making it more difficult to grow crops in some areas, while at the same time creating new opportunities for agriculture in other areas.

kok: Ah bebagwi sago kwlaima wngkha je ah hayungrwgwi hukba lam wngkha teibo kutuk tei kisa unumanwi wngmani.
en: The overall effect is that the global agricultural system is becoming more complex and less predictable.

kok: Superhero tokerok thangnai bisirok bising lukuhamjakma belai bangwi thangkha, Marvel Cinematic Universe tei DC Extented Universe chongna manthairok khalimanmung ni bagwi hambairok yapharo.
en: One of the most direct effects of climate change on agriculture is the increase in the frequency and severity of extreme weather events.

kok: Kutung twirrok, khoran, twitormung, tei bankundrirok jotto bwthaih tei khatijakmal piyakmung khlaimano, tei omo chuainairok ni bagwi 3 swnam mano bohrokni bwthaihrok hati bwkhak manna bwkhak.
en: Heat waves, droughts, floods, and storms can all damage crops and livestock, and make it difficult for farmers to get their crops to market.

kok: Baksa tonghalokrok bising, oh wngmungrok jotto bwthaih thaihrwmarok kwmana bwkhak pher mano, abo chathaih kulukyarok tei mbangmungrokni phasing tlangmano.
en: In some cases, these events can cause entire crop yields to be lost, leading to food shortages and price increases.

kok: Jora rwmani ah belai salbar wngmarok, nokbartwibar swlaima wngkha swlaimarok bwkha dagimani ah thumjak baksa tungmari tei watwi kwlaimani naidalrok.
en: In addition to extreme weather events, climate change is also leading to changes in the average temperature and precipitation patterns.

kok: Oh swlaimarok wngkha omo swnammani teibo 3 bwthaihrok torrwma bwkhak baksa kholarokni bising, jephuru ah baksa jora kwtal seprok swnamani kubun kholarokni bising.
en: These changes are making it more difficult to grow some crops in certain areas, while at the same time creating new opportunities for agriculture in other areas.

kok: Baksa tonghalokrok bising, oh wngmungrok jotto bwthaih thaihrwmarok kwmana bwkhak pher mano, chathaih kulukyarok tei morok bangmanirok bwkhak dagimani.
en: For example, the warmer temperatures in some areas are making it possible to grow crops that were previously not possible, while the increased precipitation in other areas is making it possible to grow crops that were previously not feasible.

kok: Laibuma kwrwngwi kwbangma mungwnang daginairok haste naikolangkha.
en: Many famous dictators have ruled over states throughout history.

kok: Jottonisai khursathaini bisingo kisaswk tongo Adolf Hitler, boh chichukura thamchitham bisini simi chichukura brwichiba bisi jora Nazi Germany ha-naikolangkha 1933 to 1945; Joseph Stalin, boh chichukra nwichwnwi bisini simi chichukura bachitham bisi jora Soviet Union ha-naikolangkha1922 to 1953; tei Mao Zedong, boh chichukura brwichichuku bisini simi chichukura snichidok bisi jora Chin ha-naikolangkha 1949 to 1976.
en: Some of the most notable include Adolf Hitler, who ruled over Nazi Germany from 1933 to 1945; Joseph Stalin, who ruled over the Soviet Union from 1922 to 1953; and Mao Zedong, who ruled over China from 1949 to 1976.

kok: Oh daginairok rasai rasai borokrok thwimani bagwi bokjaknai tongmani tei bohrokni ha-naikolmung raida naslemung, satokmung, tei bebakno yapha tonmabaikhe yasi kaijago.
en: These dictators were all responsible for the deaths of millions of people, and their regimes were characterized by violence, oppression, and totalitarianism.

kok: Oh daginarokno twywi jottonisai uanamungni manwi wngkha bohrok aswk jora romwi phano tongwi manmani.
en: One of the most surprising things about these dictators is that they were able to maintain power for so long.

kok: Ereng kok pirwi, kirirwui tei naslemungni kwrwngjakno samungo phwnagwi bohrok obohai khwlai manmani.
en: They were able to do this by using a combination of propaganda, intimidation, and violence.

kok: Bohrokni thani phankwrak sengkrak bodol tei huijak police bodolni chubachubo tongmani.
en: They also had the support of powerful militaries and secret police forces.

kok: Bohrokni thani phan tongwi tongphano, paithago oh daginairokno mechensugwi mankha.
en: Despite their power, these dictators were eventually overthrown.

kok: Hitler 1945 bisio sak-sakno butharkha, 1953 bisio Stalin stroke wngwi thwikha tei Mao 1976 bisio habarni pherbai thwikha.
en: Hitler committed suicide in 1945, Stalin died of a stroke in 1953, and Mao died of natural causes in 1976.

kok: Albert Einstein wngkha khoroksa German-achaima kokbwkraima manwisikrwrwng je ah kokbwkrai holokma hamkrai, kaisa ah kainwi kwtal manwisilam thongrok (ganagini quantum kolni kokrok).
en: Albert Einstein was a German-born theoretical physicist who developed the theory of relativity, one of the two pillars of modern physics (alongside quantum mechanics).

kok: Bini samung ah soisimung koksilam sakao omo koklopmung bagwi bo sinijago.
en: His work is also known for its influence on the philosophy of science.

kok: Einstein luku hamjakjak bising kahamkuk sinijakha bini pha -kotor hainohai kobwrwng E=mc2 (bomo dubbed khaijakha "ah hayungni jottoni slai sinikukjak baksakhalaijak").
en: Einstein is best known in popular culture for his mass–energy equivalence formula E = mc2 (which has been dubbed "the world's most famous equation").

kok: Einstein Ulm bising achai kha, ah bugraha Wuttemberg, German ha naikoljak, 14 tallang 1879.
en: Einstein was born in Ulm, in the Kingdom of Württemberg, German Empire, on 14 March 1879.

kok: Boi phunukha kaisa dakti pharimung lekhamungrok tei manwisilam bagwi.
en: He showed an early aptitude for mathematics and physics.

kok: 1905 o, 26 omor o, Einstein kaibwrwi hakwlwirwma laihrok sapokkha je manwisilam swlaikha.
en: In 1905, at the age of 26, Einstein published four groundbreaking papers that transformed physics.

kok: Omo bini mahmlai halokma kokbwkrai khobkha, bomo ah khakamungrok bukcha tei jora kaisa saichung thumsa khlaima choyai, tei bini jottoni halokma kokbwrai, bomo sasokkha je hilikwkwk kaisa phanya, phiya aboni slai kaisa kokoimari bukchajora.
en: These include his special relativity theory, which introduced the concepts of space and time as a single unified continuum, and his general relativity theory, which proposed that gravity is not a force, but is instead a curvature of spacetime.

kok: Einstein ni samung kaisa ah nokhayung buchimani kwtal bwkhak dagikha.
en: Einstein's work led to a new understanding of the universe, and had a profound impact on the development of modern physics.

kok: Bo 1921 bising manwisilam bising ah hoda kaham yakpai mankha bini ah pherangmangpili sekhrupma swibaikhrup samani karwi.
en: He received the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1921 for his explanation of the photoelectric effect.

kok: Einstein wngkha khoroksa kwchwngkaham tei khoroksa kwrak sualphang hodarwk mankubui bagwi.
en: Einstein was a pacifist and a strong advocate for social justice.

kok: Nwng sakhlaijakha.
en: You have been warned.

kok: Nwng kaisa sraisrai tei swkadrop sakhlaimani rwjakha.
en: You have been given a clear and concise warning.

kok: Nwng je tumungno nwng choyai oh tomung bising tangrwma bwkhak sajakha, nwng mwthakjaknai.
en: You have been told that if you continue to engage in this behavior, you will be banned.

kok: Nini thani tabuk kanwi sujukrok tongo nini tongmungno charwma bwkhak, tei nwng abono khaina bwkhak chenkha.
en: You have now had two chances to correct your behavior, and you have failed to do so.

kok: Thaihmungni logi, Nwng tabuk oh kuthumthaini simi tabuk mwthakjak.
en: As a result, you will now be banned from this forum.

kok: Oh mwthakma wngkha thiti tongthai , tei nwng kwtal thikemung swnamna bwkhak rwjakglak eba jesa lama bising oh kuthumthaini bising manjakama.
en: This ban is permanent, and you will not be allowed to create a new account or participate in this forum in any way.

kok: Chwng khajamung je oh mwthakma kaisa sebuk wngnai kubunrokno kaisa sakhlaimani bwkhak je mwchungrwma wngwi mano solai tongmung bising tangrwma bwkhak.
en: We hope that this ban will serve as a warning to others who may be tempted to engage in similar behavior.

kok: Chwng omohai sapokthaih tongmung chini kuthumthai sakao soimangwlak, tei chwng chini hodano omoni simi katina bwkha samung nanai.
en: We will not tolerate this type of behavior on our forum, and we will take action to protect our community from it.

kok: Tumungno nini thani jesa swngmungrok tongkhe oh mwthakma bagwi, khaphurwi chwngbai kwrwngna bwkhak kwmamma tawngdi.
en: If you have any questions about this ban, please do not hesitate to contact us.

kok: Nini chubalaimungni bagwi nono hambai.
en: Thank you for your cooperation.

kok: Kisa kotor batio, ah thok, khwkhwi, som, tei mohso no dalokdi.
en: In a large bowl, combine the oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper.

kok: Tohan rwdi tei dulna bagwi phildi.
en: Add the chicken and toss to coat.

kok: Mukhisa 30 sotirokni bagwi kwchangkhok tei thululupdi, eba hopung tonidi.
en: Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or up to overnight.

kok: Thapano swkang muthungdi 400 degrrees F (200 degrees C).
en: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).

kok: Ah tohanno ah hangmani riyan sakao tondi tei 20, 25 sotikswk hangdi, eba bisingtwih songjakyaksak.
en: Place the chicken on a baking sheet and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.

kok: Daktino sebuk khaidi.
en: Serve immediately.

kok: Oro baksa swlaimungrok tongo oh recipe sakao:
en: Here are some variations on this recipe:

kok: * Ah tohano marinate khaidi jolpui thok, jami bwtwi, risum, tei bithiphangrok sapulma bising.
en: * Marinate the chicken in a mixture of olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, and herbs.

kok: * Baksa mwikhwtwngrok rajak thummdi marinade khaina bwkhak, ahaino piyojo kwchang, moso, eba zucchini.
en: * Add some chopped vegetables to the marinade, such as red onion, bell pepper, or zucchini.

kok: * Kaisa mai babai, quinoa, eba kwthwng chamung bai ah tohano sebuk khaidi.
en: * Serve the chicken with a side of rice, quinoa, or salad.

kok: Taltung 24, 1980, char U.S churibirkhungrok Delta Force tei kubun U.S. mahmlai operations sengkrak bodolrok ah birkhung twinai USS Nimitz simi chengjakha.
en: On April 24, 1980, eight U.S. helicopters carrying Delta Force and other U.S. special operations troops launched from the aircraft carrier USS Nimitz.

kok: Ah churibirkhungrok ah U.S bikhwlaina nangmani.
en: The helicopters were supposed to land at the U.S.

kok: Tehran o phurainok, boro bohrok ah chojakrokno mwthangkha.
en: Embassy in Tehran, where they would rescue the hostages.

kok: Haiphano, kaisa churibirkhungrok ah hachingsa bising thutaikha, char U.S. sebukborokno bwtharkha.
en: However, one of the helicopters crashed in the desert, killing eight U.S. servicemen.

kok: Ah barahtongmani churibirkhungrok ah pinnok batil khaima bwkhak sakphankha.
en: The remaining helicopters were forced to abort the mission.

kok: Ah bethaya mwthangmung chaitokma wngkha kaisa kotor lachimasinsa ah Carterni bugrasamungni bagwi.
en: The failed rescue attempt was a major embarrassment for the Carter administration.

kok: Omo hayungni bising Americani borom piyakmung khaikha.
en: It also damaged America’s reputation in the world.

kok: Ah bethaya mwthangmung chaitokmani olo, Carter Iranian thokno yakarna dagikha.
en: In the aftermath of the failed rescue attempt, Carter ordered a boycott of Iranian oil.

kok: Bo Iran sakao rangthong mwthakmarok thepakha.
en: He also imposed economic sanctions on Iran.

kok: Ah Iranian haphang ah chopjakrokno yakarkha talrung 20, 1981 o, Ronald Reagan United States ni kasku swmai tangma haino sotirok olo.
en: The Iranian government released the hostages on January 20, 1981, just minutes after Ronald Reagan was sworn in as President of the United States.

kok: Ma: Telescope wngkha nokha sakani manwino naijaknai.
en: Mother: The telescope is used to look at objects in space.

kok: Chwrai: Ang abotwi naisigwi de mano?
en: Child: Can I look through it?

kok: Ma: Naidi, phiya talule rwdi.
en: Mother: Sure, but be careful not to bump it.

kok: A chwrai telescope ni simi nai kha tei athukiri chwngsajak khe nukha.
en: The child looks through the telescope and sees a bright star.

kok: Chwrai: wow, belai naithok.
en: Child: Wow, it's so beautiful!

kok: Ma: Au, naithogo. Athukirirok belai kwchalse, phiya telescope bai khe, chwng bohrokno gana khe naiwi mano.
en: Mother: Yes, it is. The stars are so far away, but with a telescope, we can see them up close.

kok: A chwrai tei kaisa manwi no nokhao naisik kha, planets tei tal no khobwi.
en: The child looks at other objects in space, including planets and moons.

kok: Abohrok belai kwmasingcha o hayungni tormung bai sulai nai khe bwswkse bwsa tei samungo chukya hai.
en: They are amazed by how small and insignificant they feel compared to the vastness of the universe.

kok: Chwrai: Ang poito thangya o nokhayungrok aswk kotor hwnwi.
en: Child: I can't believe how big space is.

kok: Ma: Au, phiya abohrokbo belai kwmasingcha manwi.
en: Mother: It is, but it's also full of amazing things.

kok: Nangthai manthai wngkha nangnai yokmungrok je jotto borok munuishurokni banta rwma bwkhak, bohrokni bosong khauarya, tongthar, sir, sexual orientation, eba jesaphano kubuni tongborom.
en: Fundamental rights are the essential freedoms that all human beings are entitled to, regardless of their race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, or any other status.

kok: Oh manthai wngkha Universal Declaration of Human Rights noktharo tonima, 1948 o United Nations General Assembly by yakchakjakha.
en: These rights are enshrined in the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, which was adopted by the United Nations General Assembly in 1948.

kok: Oh sakhlaimani kaisa kuar bwtrang nangthai manthai ni phataro thepakha, manthai langma no khobwinai, yakarjakma, tei borok ni naimwthang; phiyokjakmung ni muchungsamung bwkhak mathai, kerongchapnok, tei bosong; phiyokjamung ni tongthar bwkhak manthai; tei manwiphan bwkhak manthai.
en: The declaration sets out a broad range of fundamental rights, including the right to life, liberty, and security of person; the right to freedom of expression, assembly, and association; the right to freedom of religion; and the right to property.

kok: Oh nangthai manthai wngkha nangnai borok borom katirwna bagwi tei borok kokotokhai remtisamung khaimani.
en: These fundamental rights are essential for the protection of human dignity and the promotion of human flourishing.

kok: Bohrok wngkha haino kaisa chengphang tei equitable hoda, tei bohrok wngkha kwchangthotok tei naimwthang naikolani bagwi nangnai.
en: They are the foundation of a just and equitable society, and they are essential for the maintenance of peace and security.

kok: Oh nangthai manthai katirwma hwnkhe tei paiphwlaiya samung.
en: The protection of fundamental rights is a never-ending task.

kok: Aro homnino omohai borokrok tongo je naitugwi gosiya eba bukurung khayo oh manthaino, tei chwng homnino kaichomjak bohrokni sakmwthangmao.
en: There are always those who would seek to deny or undermine these rights, and we must always be vigilant in their defense.

kok: Phiya chwng jesaphuru phano khajamung tayakarthwng.
en: But we must never give up hope.

kok: Nangthai manthai ni bagwi kaphramung wngkha kaisa bosong kaham, tei omo wngkha kaisa kaphramung je chwng jephuru phano khibimanya.
en: The struggle for fundamental rights is a noble one, and it is a struggle that we must never abandon.

kok: Chwng jotto miliwui thansa khe samung ma khainai bwkhak khasrai khwlaima bai je nangthai manthai wngkha boromgwnang tei katirijak. `
en: We must all work together to ensure that the fundamental rights of all people are respected and protected.

kok: Tangrwbainai wngkha kaisa rikmung tei soisimung rikmani nokkotorok rikamani tei kubun swnamarirok.
en: Architecture Architecture is the art and science of designing buildings and other structures.

kok: Omo kaisa tisamani naithokunamarok aswkno gwdaljak simiya, phiya omo bo samungjakma, chormani, tei tikimani.
en: It involves not only the aesthetics of a building, but also its functionality, durability, and sustainability.

kok: Tangrwbairok kaisa dalbidal kusungchwlwirok ma gosinai jephuru kaisa nokkoto rikmani, oro ah borokrokni nangmarok bo khopmani wngkha je omono phwnangnai, ah nokbartwibar bising obo chongjak thai wngnai, tei ah manwi khwnwirok je phwnangjaknai.
en: Architects must consider a variety of factors when designing a building, including the needs of the people who will use it, the climate in which it will be located, and the materials that will be used.

kok: Aro wngkha kwbangma juda juda tangrwbainai tongdalrok, omo sakni sloya gwrwngjakmarok bai thwgwi.
en: There are many different styles of architecture, each with its own unique characteristics.

kok: Baksa ah jottoni slai luku hamjajak tongdalrok wngkha kwcham, kwtal, tei phainai-kwtal tangrwbainai.
en: Some of the most popular styles include classical, modern, and post-modern architecture.

kok: Kwcham tangrwbainai omo solaimolai, chapjak, tei sirisiti manwi-khwnairok phwnangma ahaino olong tei itchakha bai gwrwngjakma wngkha.
en: Classical architecture is characterized by its symmetry, proportion, and use of traditional materials such as stone and brick.

kok: Kwtal tangrwbai wngkha teibo minimalist tei uramuram kwtal manwi-khwnwirok phwnangmarok ahaino sisi tei sorchwng.
en: Modern architecture is more minimalist and often uses new materials such as glass and steel.

kok: Phainai-kwtal tangrwbai wngkha kaisa wngphirokmung kainwi kwcham tei kwtal tangrwbai bwkhak, tei umramuram kanwi tongdalrok bokhrwirok mwkhangrok wngo.
en: Post-modern architecture is a reaction to both classical and modern architecture, and often features elements of both styles.

kok: Tangrwibairok wngkha chini tisajak habar bwkhak kaisa mal bokcho, tei omo chini langmarok sakao kaisa nangkukma sekhrupma tongwi mano.
en: Architecture is a vital part of our built environment, and it can have a significant impact on our lives.

kok: Kaham-rikamni nokkotorok chwng tei teibo tongthoktok, duna bwthaihm, tei katijak wansukmung swnam mano.
en: Well-designed buildings can make us feel more comfortable, productive, and safe.

kok: Salsa, ang chwrai bwrwi khoroksa kabwi tongma nugo jephuru ang park bisingtwi himwi tongphru.
en: One day, I was walking through the park when I saw a little girl crying.

kok: Ang bini ganao thangkha tei bono swngkha tamo wngkha hwnwi.
en: I went over to her and asked her what was wrong.

kok: Bo ano sakha bini ball kwmakha hwnwi.
en: She told me that she had lost her ball.

kok: Ang gana ginio naituk naikha phiya ang naituk manlia.
en: I looked around, but I couldn't find it.

kok: Bwrwi bwsa chwraino ang sakha ang bono chubanai o ball no naitukna bagwi.
en: I told the little girl that I would help her look for it.

kok: Chwng park mariuino naitugwi naikha haiphano o ball no naitugwi manlia.
en: We searched all over the park, but we couldn't find the ball.

kok: Chwng kechen gosiui rwtwi rwtwi naituk manlia hwnwi kuna phaisingo kaisa chwngwi tongjak manwi mokolo kwlaiya sak.
en: We were about to give up when I saw something shiny out of the corner of my eye.

kok: Ang ah thayo thangwi naikolkha o bwrwi chwraini ball hwnwi saimankha.
en: I went over to investigate and found the little girl's ball!

kok: Bo belaikheno tongthokjakha o ball no manwi.
en: She was so happy to have her ball back.

kok: Bo ano hambai rwkha tei kwrak khe kwbakkha.
en: She thanked me and gave me a big hug.

kok: J salo ang rwngkotor rwngtheka paiyo ah salni simi langmani muitomanrwkmani sal.
en: The day I graduated from college was one of the most memorable days of my life.

kok: Ang ani swrwngbwlaih ajina bagwi bisi bwrwi samung kwrak khaikha, tei ang paithago ani nukhungni borok tei bayap songbai samung pairwi terkhwlai mankha.
en: I had worked hard for four years to earn my degree, and I was finally able to celebrate my accomplishments with my family and friends.

kok: Kotorma auditorium o panda songchajakha, tei aro tongthotok tei tharewui supungjak.
en: The ceremony was held in a large auditorium, and it was filled with excitement and anticipation.

kok: Ang muito tongkho khanangma bai gulukjwi chongphan wng tongmani ang stage saka ani swrwngbwlai yakchakna hwnwi himiw thangphuru.
en: I remember feeling a mixture of emotions as I walked up to the stage to receive my diploma.

kok: Ang belai khauarjak ani samung pairwi, haiphano ang kisa khabo nangjaka ang ani rwngkotorni bayapsong tei rwngphwrwngnai rokno yakarma bagwi.
en: I was proud of my accomplishments, but I was also sad to be leaving my college friends and professors.

kok: Panda ni ulo, chwng jotto khuthumlai terkhlaikha.
en: After the ceremony, we all went to a party to celebrate.

kok: Aphuru no jora kotor tei lengla'ui jotto bai malainani.
en: It was a great time to relax and catch up with everyone.

kok: Ang muito tongkho ang ani bayap songbai mwsamani tei mwmwimani, tei ang sinai simanwi samung pairimani tei khasrangma khakamani.
en: I remember dancing and laughing with my friends, and I felt a sense of accomplishment and joy.

kok: Rwngthekani sal wngkha mohai sal je ang tei pogwi mangwlak.
en: Graduation day was a day that I will never forget.

kok: Aphruno terkhlaimani tei samung pairimani sal, tei abono ani langmani kwthal bwchap chengsamani sinijakma.
en: It was a day of celebration and accomplishment, and it marked the beginning of a new chapter in my life.

kok: Ah saknainai bini habanok bising achukjak, ah watwino tailam twih phatar naisikmani.
en: The doctor sat in his office, looking out the window at the rain.

kok: Amo wngkha kaisa selema sal, tei ahaino teibo tola wansukmani wngkha nangnungya slai.
en: It was a dreary day, and he was feeling even more down than usual.

kok: Bo hatibarrok karwi kolok damrwirok samung khai tongmani, tei bo ah uarrwma bwkhak wansukma chengkha.
en: He had been working long hours for weeks, and he was starting to feel the strain.

kok: Bo hamakolok nakha tei ah tailamni simi komnwi thangkha.
en: He sighed and turned away from the window.

kok: Bo rugi no naini bwkhak thango, tei bo nasikma bwkhak nangjakha.
en: He had a patient to see, and he needed to focus.

kok: Bo kaisa hama kolok nakha tei bini habarnok bwkha duklam khulukkha.
en: He took a deep breath and opened the door to his office.

kok: Ah rugi wngkha khoroksa bwrwima sikli, tei bo kirijak nukjakha.
en: The patient was a young woman, and she looked scared.

kok: Oh bini ah achukphang buchuk sakao achukha, bini yakrok tontonkhai berepkha bini khuri bising.
en: She sat on the edge of the chair, her hands clasped tightly in her lap.

kok: "ang nini bagwi tamo khai man?" ah saknainai swngkha. "ang sakkuplung, " ah bwrwima sakha.
en: "What can I do for you?" the doctor asked. "I'm pregnant," the woman said.

kok: Ah saknainai kongkha. "ang nukha."
en: The doctor nodded. "I see."

kok: Ah manager wansuk kha je bono kwbang samung rikhe, bo paithago lengjakma bai yakar riwanw hwnwi.
en: The manager thought that by giving her so much work, she would eventually get tired and quit.

kok: Haiphano, samung tangnai belai sak sak no phuknukmari bwkhak khathonjak , tei bo samung kwrak khayo bini jotto samungrokno pairina bagwi.
en: However, the employee was determined to prove herself, and she worked hard to complete all of her tasks.

kok: Manager bini samung raidani bai mwlang chajak, tei bo paithago buchikha je bo company ni bagwi morokjak rangmai.
en: The manager was impressed by her work ethic, and he eventually realized that she was a valuable asset to the company.

kok: Bo bono nakarmung sankha bono jurkhai karina bagwi chaithokmani, tei bo bono kaisa remtisamung ni bagwi yapharkha.
en: He apologized for trying to force her out, and he offered her a promotion.

kok: Samung tangnai remtisamung no gosiwui nakha, tei bo choya karwi company ni bagwi samung kwrak khai thangkha.
en: The employee accepted the promotion, and she continued to work hard for the company.

kok: Bo paithago CEO wngkha, teo bo bini company no kotor kuar khwlai twlangkha.
en: She eventually became the CEO, and she led the company to great success.

kok: Samung khainai ni kothoma wngkha kaisa muitumanrwma je samung kwrak tei khathonma bai jesaphano kebengmung no mechenwi mano.
en: The employee's story is a reminder that hard work and determination can overcome any obstacle.

kok: Omo bo kaisa muitomanrwk nani je managers bohrokni samung tangnai rokno kwlaikhe tanadi hwnwi.
en: It is also a reminder that managers should not take their employees for granted.

kok: Jodi samung khainai bini samung bai tongthokya hwnkhe, bohrok no yakarnani sep rwjakna nango.
en: If an employee is not happy with their job, they should be given the opportunity to resign.

kok: Samung khainai jur khai karinani chaitokma bwkhak borokno teibo khathonwi tongnani bwkhak nayo.
en: Trying to force an employee out will only make them more determined to stay.

kok: Rwbai tei tongthokmung wngkha chini siri
en: The arts and entertainment are a vital part of our culture.

kok: Bohrok chwngno chinisaksakno lama sraisrai khai sama swnamtonima bagwi, kubunrok bai kwrwngwi, tei chini ganagini hayung rokni bwkhak swrwngna bagwi.
en: They provide us with a way to express ourselves, to connect with others, and to learn about the world around us.

kok: Rwchapmung babai theater babai mwsamung babai nujak rwbai simi, rwbai chini langmano lekhabaiya lamano bangrwi mano.
en: From music to theater to dance to visual art, the arts can enrich our lives in countless ways.

kok: Tongthokmung swnamkhor kotor rangthok chaluknai, bisi thwgwi rarwjag dollars ajima achairimamni.
en: The entertainment industry is also a major economic driver, generating billions of dollars in revenue each year.

kok: Omo samung swnamo, pakokmani stimulates, tei chini hasteno sraisrai sinijakmung tisawui chubani hayungni yaksiyagra khai.
en: It creates jobs, stimulates tourism, and helps to promote a positive image of our country around the world.

kok: Laithangjak bisio, rwbai tei tongthokmung bwsakango bataimungni lombor wngtongkha.
en: In recent years, the arts and entertainment have been facing a number of challenges.

kok: Rwbai khainani thumrangni sasui rwjakha, tei kwbangma hukumuni rwngnokrok bo jwngjalwi thangna bwkhak.
en: Funding for the arts has been cut back, and many cultural institutions are struggling to survive.

kok: Haiphano, aro tabukbo rwbaini bagwi kwrak sanma tongkhu, tei rwbaikwrwng bai tangkhwlainai choyai kwtal swnamwi bwkhak tei tongthokma samung.
en: However, there is still a strong demand for the arts, and artists and performers continue to create new and exciting work.

kok: Rwbai tei tongthokmung wngkha chini dophani nangmani bokcho.
en: The arts and entertainment are an essential part of our society.

kok: Bohrok chwngni mwnwirio, bohrok chwngno kabrio, tei chwngno wansukma swnamo.
en: They make us laugh, they make us cry, and they make us think.

kok: Kaisa malkhung belaikhe dowi rwgwi thangmabai naichrop marwkliya, phatsa khe kubun lama chikontwi pherwi tei kaisa malkhung bokhorogo thuthai kha.
en: A car was driving too fast and lost control, swerving into the other lane and hitting a car head-on.

kok: Puilani malkhung mothornai logilogino thwikha, tei khoroksa malkhung mothornai khe belaikhe sago dukha mankha.
en: The driver of the first car was killed instantly, and the driver of the second car was seriously injured.

kok: Ani Kiching Joseph ano kokringkha ah kokno sana bagwi.
en: My friend Joseph called me to talk about it.

kok: "Abo belai khahamya wngjaknai", hwnwi bo sakha."Ang uansogwi manyaliya bahai khe o patimungo manjaknairokni nukhung tong khwna hwnwi.
en: "It's so sad," he said. "I can't imagine how the families of the victims are coping."

kok: "Angbo hwnwi", Ang sakha. Obo ano mwito khwlai rwo chwng malkhung mothorphuru naiwi ma pakoknani.
en: "Me neither," I responded. "It's a reminder that we need to be careful when we're driving.

kok: Kaisa chikonsa chayani bisingtwi no kotorma pátimung wngwimano.
en: Even a small mistake can have devastating consequences."

kok: "Ang gosio", hwnwi sákha Jo. "Chwng jottono lamani raidano ma twinai tei hus khe makhung ma mothornai.
en: "I agree," replied Jo. "We all need to follow the rules of the road and drive defensively."

kok: "Abo haino", Ang phatsakhe sachuru kha." Tei chwng jottono saimanthai malkhung mothorphuru bwkha kobola wngmani abo krimasingcha hwnwi.Text khwlaimani eba phone bai kok samanirok chini bwkhano lamani kubun phaising twlang mano tei patimungorogo khikwlai mano.
en: "Absolutely," I quickly added. "And we need to be aware of the dangers of distracted driving. Things like texting and talking on the phone can take our attention away from the road and lead to accidents."

kok: "Ang saiman", hwnwi Jo sákha. " Ang sakphangbo kwbangma jorao chayarok wngwi thango."
en: "I know," said Jo sheepishly. "I'm guilty of it myself sometimes."

kok: Sijakrwnai phwnangmani borok khapang sakduk sirwmanirok wngkha kaisa holok gnangma kwtal hauar bwkhak chubao, phiya omo kotor swmai phunukmani wngkha.
en: Using data to help people with mental health issues is a relatively new field, but it is showing great promise.

kok: Phunukmari karwi ah sijakrwnai phwnangma wngkha sakbaihthang hamya naimung rogirokni bagwi.
en: One example is the use of data to personalize therapy for patients.

kok: Ah rogirokno saksakni sijarwnai naimani bai, hamya nainairok kaham buchiwui mano bohrokni nangmarok tei kaisa saknaimung chapma swnamma je bohrokno risupnai wngkha.
en: By looking at a patient's individual data, therapists can better understand their needs and create a treatment plan that is tailored to them.

kok: Omo phatarphaimarok rogirokni bagwi kaham bwkhak dagi mano, iko bohrok teibo ahaino manna bwkhka tongo ah chubachu je bohrok nangmani.
en: This can lead to better outcomes for patients, as they are more likely to receive the help that they need.

kok: Kaisa porimung, bomo ah kokbwlaih bising sapukjak wngkha "JAMA khabemar naimung, " manma je rogirok sabo sakbaihthangma hamya naimung mankha bohrokni yaphang sijakrwnai sakao wngkha teibo ahaino bohrokni nukswkangmarirok slai abo je tongham hamya naimung mankha.
en: One study, which was published in the journal "JAMA Psychiatry," found that patients who received personalized therapy based on their data were more likely to improve their symptoms than those who received standard therapy.

kok: Oh porima bo mankha je ah rogirok sakabaihthangma hamya naimung mankha bohrok wngkhah teibo ahaino saknaimung bising tongna kwdwkma jora bokjak karwi.
en: The study also found that the patients who received personalized therapy were more likely to stay in treatment for longer periods of time.

kok: Oh porima wngkha haino kaisa phunukmari bahai sijakrwnai khapang sakduk naikani chasama bwkhak phwnangjak wngmano.
en: This study is just one example of how data can be used to improve mental health care.

kok: iko teibo rutukrwk oh khola bising khlaijak wngkha, chwng khachongma bwkak nugwi mano tei swkangkolok ah sijakrwnai phwnangma bising borok khaphang sakduk swirwmarok bai chubama bwkhak wngo.
en: As more research is done in this area, we can expect to see even more advances in the use of data to help people with mental health issues.

kok: Ani bapahno wngkha khoroksa hamya nainai je bini rogirokno chubama bwkhak sijakrwnai phanango.
en: My sister is a therapist who uses data to help her patients.

kok: Ah moyur kaisa kotorma tei palikuplung tok wngkha je Asia bwkhak achaiha wngkha.
en: The peacock is a large and colorful bird that is native to Asia.

kok: Omo bini naithok bwkrangrokni bagwi sinijago, bomo chokhreng kharangjiji, kwkhwrang, tei phantok gap tokwrangrok swnamjakma wngkha.
en: It is known for its beautiful plumage, which is made up of iridescent blue, green, and purple feathers.

kok: Moyurok bo bohrokni uarrwma runghalok phunukma wngkha, bomo bohrok logisongno khasotonna bwkhak tangkha.
en: Peacocks are also known for their elaborate courtship displays, which they perform to attract mates.

kok: Oh phunukma wngjora, ah chwla moyur bini khitung bwkwrangrok pholoknai tei borokno sipbwi karikha kaisa kotor, palikupung sipjaknai swnamma bwkhak.
en: During these displays, the male peacock will spread his tail feathers and fan them out to create a large, colorful fan.

kok: Ah moyur bwrwi hwnkhe kaisa logisong sainai ah torma yaphang sakao tei naithok bini khitung tokwrwngrok bai.
en: The female peacock will then choose a mate based on the size and beauty of his tail feathers.

kok: Moyurrok bo bohrokni siyankwrwng bagwi sinijak mano tei khlaimanma bwkhak swrwngo.
en: Peacocks are also known for their intelligence and ability to learn.

kok: Bohrok phemlokmarok tangma bwkhak phwrwngjak mano tei ahaino kok sana bwkhak phwrwnghjak mano.
en: They can be trained to perform tricks and can even be taught to talk.

kok: Jora ramani bising borokni naithokma tei siyankwrwng bwkhak, moyurrok bo ah habarlam logisongrok bo nangkukma wngkha.
en: In addition to their beauty and intelligence, peacocks are also important members of the ecosystem.

kok: Bohrok ah yongrok bangmani tei kubunthwikumurok kasomung bwkhak chubao, tei bohrokni kwlaimanirok ah haching phas rwma bwkhak chubai mano.
en: They help to control the population of insects and other pests, and their droppings can help to fertilize the soil.

kok: Nwng’-no ani khajani Sajla, Nono’-no ang belai khe khá phurjago.
en: You are my beloved Son; with you I am well pleased.

kok: Norok sak-sakni tongdal tei bwkhano slái di, tei Kothoma kahamno poito khlai di.
en: Repent and believe in the gospel.

kok: Norok ani logi phai di, ang norokno á romna ya, tamo khe Kaitorni bagwi borok romnani se phrwng anw.
en: Follow me and I will make you fish for people.

kok: Siringcha wng di! O borokni bisingni ongkhorwi phai di!
en: Be silent, and come out of him!

kok: Nwng muchung khe ano ham rwui mano.
en: If you are willing, you can make me clean.

kok: Ham di, angbo ahaino nai-o.
en: I am willing.

kok: Chwlasa, nini bebak sumsok nakarjak kha
en: Son, your sins are forgiven.

kok: Ani logi phai di
en: Follow me.

kok: Kaham borokni bagwi daktor nang ya, hamya borokni bagwi se nango. Borok kahamrokno ang ringna phai ya, sumsok gwnangrokno se ringna phai-o.
en: Those who are well have no need of a physician, but those who are sick; I have come to call not the righteous but sinners.

kok: Rí kwchamo khoroksa phano rí kwtal thap ya; thap khe a rí kwtal kwchamno kichik rwui kákhlai rwnai, hakhe kwpla teibo uarnai.
en: No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old cloak; otherwise, the patch pulls away from it, the new from the old, and a worse tear is made.

kok: Sabat salo omo hai khlai laimani chini kerongni raidano swbaima klai-o.
en: Is it lawful for the Sabbath day?

kok: Jotono nukna tẃi khe oro bacha di.
en: Stand up here in front of everyone.

kok: Sabat salo bú samung khlai kha hwn khe sói wngma klai: Kaham khlaima da eba hamya khlaimani? Khoroksani langma mwthangmani da sói eba butharmani?
en: Is it lawful to do good or to do harm on the Sabbath, to save life or to kill?

kok: Nini yak pholok di.
en: Stretch out your hand.

kok: Nwng’-no Kaitorni Sajla!
en: You are the Son of God!

kok: Soitan bini bisingo tongo! Mwtai hamya bokhorokni phan bai se bo bororokni aroni mwtai hamyarokno rwkhlai-o.
en: He has Beelzebul, and by the ruler of the demons he casts out demons.

kok: Sabo ani ama? Sabo ani takhuksong?
en: Who are my mother and my brothers?

kok: Khna di!
en: Listen!

kok: Khunju gwnangrok hwn kheba o kókno khna thung!
en: Let anyone with ears to hear listen!

kok: Norok khnaui tongmarokno bwkha rwui uansuk di.
en: Pay attention to what you hear

kok: Bebak huijak tongmarok tikhlaiwi phunukjak anw. Bebak bisingni manwirokno kariui sini rwjak anw.
en: For there is nothing hidden, except to be disclosed; nor is anything secret, except to come to light.

kok: Norok khunju tong khe o kókno khna di!
en: If anyone has ears to hear, let them listen!

kok: Nokbar bai twi suda bini kók khnaui ma tongo?
en: Even the wind and the sea obey him?

kok: Chwng bórokni bisingo habwi tháng anw.
en: Let us enter them.

kok: Subrai nini bagwi bwswk kaham khlai kha bórokno sa bai di.
en: Report to them what the Lord has done for you, and how he has had mercy on you.

kok: Ani bwrwima thwina nai tong kha. Nwng phaiwi bini saka-o kisa yak bera phai ja di. Hakhe bo ham anw tei kaham kwrwng khe tongwi man anw.
en: My little daughter is at the point of death. Come and lay your hands on her, so that she may be made well and live.

kok: Ang bini kamchwlwi kisa ma tang kheno ham anw
en: If I but touch his clothes, I will be made well.

kok: Ta kiri di; poito simi khlai di.
en: Do not fear, only believe.

kok: Talitha Kum!
en: Little girl, get up!

kok: Bahai khe bo omo tẃi aswk elem man kha?
en: Where did this man get all this?

kok: Diyari bini kamiyungni borok bai, bini sandairok bai tei bini nokni bororokno karwi kubun bebak jagani bororok bai’-no bórom rwjago.
en: Prophets are not without honor, except in their hometown, and among their own kin, and in their own house.

kok: Yaklaprok káui mano, tamo khe rí bárarok ta tlang di.
en: But to wear sandals and not to put on an extra tunic.

kok: Ano tabukno mairango khlaiwi baptisma rwnai Johonni bokhorok rw phai di
en: I want you to give me at once the head of John the Baptist on a platter.

kok: Ang bai baksa phai di; siring siring jaga-o chwng simi tháng lai anw. Aro-o chwng kisa lenglaui man anw.
en: Come away to a deserted place all by yourselves and rest a while.

kok: Bórokno chá rwna bagwi norok kisa chámung rw gra di.
en: You give them something to eat.

kok: Ta uana di; omo ang se! Ta kiri di.
en: Take heart, it is I; do not be afraid.

kok: Bórokni slái swkang tongwi tháng langnairokni raidaroknobo bórok rákhogo.
en: And there are also many other traditions that they observe, the washing of cups, pots, and bronze kettles.

kok: Bórok yak sú yaui’-no mai chá-o. Tamoni bagwi bórok omo hairok khlai?
en: Why do your disciples not live according to the tradition of the elders, but eat with defiled hands?

kok: O bororok kók bai ano bórom rw-o, phiya bórokni thani-o ang mungsa buya.
en: This people honors me with their lips, but their hearts are far from me

kok: Ani thani tháng di. Mwtai hamya nwsajwkno yakarwi tháng kha.
en: Go home to your daughter, for the demon has left her.

kok: Ephata.
en: Be opened.

kok: Tamo wngwi norok soidomni samung naina hwn?
en: Why does this generation ask for a sign?

kok: Hus wng di! Norok Pharisairokni chuan tei Herodni chuan bai hus khe tong di.
en: Watch out! Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod.

kok: Tabuk nu da nuk kha?
en: Can you see anything?

kok: Bororok ano sabo tamo hwn?
en: Who do people say that I am?

kok: Kaitor naimarokno nwng nangjak ya. Borok nangjakkukmano se nwng torjago.
en: You are setting your mind not on divine things but on human things.

kok: Norokni bisingo ani sagri wngna muchungnairok bórok sak sakni kók ta uansuk thung tei bini krus balwi ani logi phai thung.
en: If any want to become my followers, let them deny themselves and take up their cross and follow me.

kok: Bo’-no ani Sajla, bonono ang belai hamjak kugo. Bini kók khna di!
en: This is my Son, the Beloved; listen to him!

kok: Tamono tẃiwi tokra rw laiwi tong?
en: What are you arguing about with them?

kok: A chwraino ani thani tubu di!
en: Bring him to me.

kok: Norok khe tamo wngwi a mwtai hamyano rwkhlai man li ya sla?
en: Why could we not cast it out?

kok: Chwngno kebeng ya Borok bo chini bwkhak se.
en: Whoever is not against us is for us.

kok: Bono ta mwthak di. Ani mung bai ha-o nuk ya samung kotor kotor khlainairok ano daktino hamya sa glak.
en: Do not stop him; for no one who does a deed of power in my name will be able soon afterward to speak evil of me.

kok: Sóm belai kaham. Phiya abo pwrap ya wngwi tháng khe, nwng abono tei kwprap khlaiwi man phi glak. Hakhe nini bisingni a sóm kahamno ta swkwma di. Tei kwchang kwchang khe tong lai di.
en: Salt is good; but if the salt has lost its saltiness, how can you season it? Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace with one another.

kok: Borok khoroksa bini hikno kagwi rwmani abo sói da?
en: Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?

kok: Chwrai bwsarokno ani thani rohor di. Bórokno ta kasu di, tamoni hwnma le omo tẃi chwrai bwsa hai bororokni bagwi’-no Kaitorni ha.
en: Let the little children come to me; do not stop them; for it is to such as these that the kingdom of God belongs.

kok: Borok ta buthar di, buitali-buitala ta wng di, ta khok di, tatal ta sa di, ta phemlok di, nwma nwphano bórom khlai di….
en: You shall not murder; You shall not commit adultery; You shall not steal; You shall not bear false witness; You shall not defraud; Honor your father and mother.

Tripura ni borokrok 'Wathop' buphang (bamboo) no belai pavitra hwnwi wansuk-o. Kwbangma puja o wa ni kotor kam tongo. Abono karwi bo Tulsi buphangno bo puja rwo.
Nwngni logi kok sanani bagwi belai kaham wngkha.
Ani logi bo nwng bai kok sanani bagwi belai kaham wngkha. Ang asha khwlaio, chwng teisa malai phinai. Kaham khe tongdi!
Angni phone ni battery belai kodo charge kwmawi thango, tamo khwlainai?
Nwng nini phone ni background o cholaithok apps rokno bondho khwlai di. Screen brightness kom khwlaiwi bo battery bachinai. Tei bo hamya wngkhe, battery no swlaiwi naidi mano.
Laptop o screenshot bahai khugo?
Nwng nini laptop ni keyboard o 'PrtScn' (Print Screen) button no press khwlaiwi mano. Ulo 'Paint' eba tei kubuni image editor o paste (Ctrl+V) khwlai di.
Online o samung paina hamjak da?
Au, online o samung paina belai hamjak, phiya kisa suri suri paina nango. Trust khwlaijak website rokni simi se samung nadi. Jeba rang swkang riya khe kaham.
Angni email ni password pogwi thang kha, bahai recover khwlainai?
Nwng email ni login page o 'Forgot Password?' option no click khwlai di. Ulo nini phone number eba recovery email o kaisa link eba code phainai, abono use khwlaiwi kwtal password riwi mano.
Cloud storage hwnmale tamo bujio?

Cloud storage wngkha internet o nini photo, file, eba document rokno joma khwlaiwi romani kaisa jaga. Abo bai nini phone eba computer ni memory pherjakya, tei nwng jeba jagani simi o file rokno mannai.
Bluetooth speaker bai phone bahai connect khwlaio?
Puila nini speaker tei phone ni Bluetooth on khwlai di. Ulo nini phone ni Bluetooth setting o speaker ni mung no search khwlaiwi malai khe, abono click khwlaiwi 'pair' khwlai di.
Ang kaisa 15,000 rang ni bisingo kaham mobile paina mwkhago. Tamo painai?

15,000 rang ni bisingo tabuk kwbangma kaham mobile tongo, jemon Redmi, Realme, eba Samsung ni kisa model. Nwng nini nanganino naiwi - kaham camera, kotor battery eba gaming performance - bachina mano.
Angni computer belai slow wngkha, tamo khwlainai?
Nwng nini computer ni temporary file rokno delete khwlai di, tei jeba nangya software rokno uninstall khwlai di. Kaisa Antivirus bai scan khwlaiwi bo naidi mano.
Wi-Fi ni password bahai change khwlaio?
Wi-Fi ni password change khwlainani bagwi, nwng nini router ni setting page o hapna nango. Abo browser o router ni IP address (jemon 192.168.0.1) type khwlaiwi khwlai-o.
QR code scan khwlaimung hamjak da?
Au, hamjak, phiya jeba QR code no scan khwlaiya khe kaham. Sirif jeba trust khwlaijak jaga ni QR code, jemon दुकान eba official website ni, aborokno se scan khwlaidi.
Angni bokhorok belai sa-o, tamo borom nanai?
Nwng kisa jora aram khwlai di, kwchang twi bai mokol mukhang sup di. Tei bo kom wngya khe, kaisa painkiller mai chana mano. Kwbangma sa khe doctor bai malai di.
Salbrumno bwswk jora thuna nango?
Khoroksa kotor borok salbrumno 7-8 ghanta thuna nango. Kaham thumung mang tei aklani bagwi belai nango.
Weight kom khwlainani bagwi tamo chahna nangya?
Weight kom khwlainani bagwi chini bai khwlaijak chahmung, fried food (jemon puri, samosa), tei soft drinks rokno chahya khe kaham.
Phung o himmung ni tamo lab tongo?
Phung o himmung bwkhani bagwi belai kaham, mangno kwrak khwlaio, tei salbrumni bagwi energy rio. Tension bo kom khwlaio.
Mokol ni power baraina bagwi tamo chahna nango?
Mokol ni bagwi Vitamin A belai nango. Nwng kwkhrang mui, carrot, papaya tei kasoi chahna mano.
Yoga khwlaimung ni bisingtwi tamo hamo wngo?
Yoga khwlaimung bai nini mang flexible wngo, bekereng kwrak wngo, tei aklano kwchang khwlaio. Stress kom khwlainani bagwi bo belai kaham.
Angni yakung belai samo, tamo khwlainai?
Yakung samani kwbangma karan wngwi mano. Nwng kisa jora yakungno kuchuk o romwi achuk di. Tei bo samo khe, doctor no phunuk di.
Healthy breakfast ni bagwi kaisa idea ri di.
Healthy breakfast ni bagwi nwng boiled tok bwtwi, seasonal फल, eba oats chahna mano. Abo salbrumni bagwi nwngno shakti rinai.
Uatwi o kichinani ulo angno srdi-khuk wng-o, tamo khwlainai?
Uatwi o kichi khe nini mangno kodo khe kwran khwlai di tei kwtung mungsa nwng di, jemon cha eba soup. Uatwi o kwbang jora kichiya khe kaham.
Agartala o joto ni swlai kaham hospital boro?
Agartala o kwbangma kaham hospital tongo, jemon GB Pant Hospital, ILS Hospital, tei Tripura Medical College. Nini samasya no naiwi nwng thangna mano.
Exam ni swkang tension kom khwlainani bagwi tamo khwlainai?
Exam ni swkang kaham khe thudi, time o chahdi, tei kisa jora aram khwlaidi. Jeba nwng porikha, abono se revise khwlaidi, kwtal mungsa poriya khe kaham.
Job interview o tamo tamo swng-o?
Job interview o nini kokno swngnai, nini swkangni samungni experience, tei o company o tamoni bagwi samung tangna mwkhago, o kokrokno swng-o.
Ang kaisa kaham CV (Bio-data) swina mwkhago, chubai di.
Kaisa kaham CV o nini mung, address, education, experience, tei skillrokno suri suri swina nango. Jeba tatal swiya khe kaham.
Class 12 ni ulo ang tamo subject laiwi porinai?
Nwng nini interest tei nini future o tamo wngna mwkhago, abono wansukwi subject bachina nango. Nini teacher eba nukhungni borok bai bo kok sadi.
Public o kok sana ang belai kirio, tamo khwlainai?
Public o kok sana kirimung kwma-nani bagwi, nwng puila khorok ni swkang eba logisongni swkang kok sana practice khwlaidi. Bwkha gwran khwlai di, jwng jwng khe ham wngnai.
Tripura Board of Secondary Education (TBSE) ni result online o bahai naina man-o?
Nwng TBSE ni official website o thangwi, nini roll number enter khwlaiwi nini result no naina mannai. Result ongmung jorao website o link rijago.
Ang pora-lekha o mon romwi manya, tamo khwlainai?
Nwng siring siring kaisa jaga o achukwi poridi. Porinani bisingo chuchu break na di. Nini goal no wansukdi, abo nwngno motivate khwlainai.
Government job ni bagwi bahai prepare wngnai?
Government job ni bagwi, nwng o exam ni syllabus no kaham khe poridi, kwcham question paper solve khwlaidi, tei salbrumno current affairs poridi.
Angni memory belai kom, jeba porio pog-o.
Memory baraina bagwi, nwng jeba porio abono bujiwi poridi. Likhai likhai poridi. Kaham thumung tei healthy chahmung bo aklani bagwi belai nango.
Skill development tamoni bagwi nango?
Pora-lekha ni logi logi skill, jemon computer, communication, eba tei kubuni technical skill, kaham samung manani chance no bario.
Agartala o tongna bagwi kaisa kom dam ni hotel ni mung sa.
Agartala o kom dam ni kwbangma hotel tongo, jemon Hotel Sonar Tori, Hotel Welcome Palace. Nwng online o review naiwi booking khwlaiwi mano.
Jampui hachuk o snow phai-o da?
Ihi, Jampui hachuk o snow phaiya, tamni hwnmale Tripura ni climate kwtung. Phiya kwchang mol jorao aro belai kwchang wngo.
Chabimura thangnani lama kaham da?
Agartala ni simi Amarpur jora lama kaham tongo, phiya Amarpur ni simi Chabimura ni lama kisa hamya wngwi mano. Boat bai Gomati twima twi thangmung belai naithok.
Tripura ni kon jaga trekking ni bagwi kaham?
Tripura ni Jampui hachuk tei Debtamura hachuk amchai trekking ni bagwi belai kaham. Aroni naithokmung belai mon khamo.
Ang Tripura ni simi souvenir hisap o tamo tubui thangnai?
Nwng Tripura ni simi bamboo ni naithok samungrok, Risa-Rignai, eba Matabari ni Peda tubui thangna mano.
Tripura o solo travel khwlaimung safe da?
Au, Tripura haste solo travellerrokni bagwi belai safe. Phiya jeba jaga o hor jorao saichung beraiya khe kaham.
Agartala ni simi Dharmanagar train o bwswk jora nango?
Agartala ni simi Dharmanagar train o 4 ghanta swk nango. Train ni samung hisap o kisa jora bara-kom wngwi mano.
Local market o bargaining khwlai mano da?
Au, Tripura ni kwbangma local market o kisa bargaining khwlai mano, phiya jeba固定 দাম ni dukan o bargaining wngya.
Tripura ni kon jaga o paragliding wngo da?
Ihi, tabuk jora jora Tripura o paragliding ni sujog kwrwi. Phiya future o haste ni tourism department abo chengna wansukwi tongo.
Ang family bai beraina thangna mwkhago. Kaisa kaham resort ni mung sa.
Nwng 'Sagarika Tourist Lodge' (Dumboor) eba 'Eden Tourist Lodge' (Jampui) o thangna mano. O jaga rok family ni bagwi belai kaham.
Nwng ano hayungni kothoma ni kaisa short story sa di.

Kaisa jorao, kaisa chuchu athukiri nokha o saichung tongmani. Bo salbrumno tei kubuni kotor athukirirokno naiwi wansukmani, 'Ang buphru bohrok hai chwngnai?' Salsa hor, kaisa chwrai bo chuchu athukirino naiwi bini amano sakha, 'Ama, naidi, o athukiri belai naithok!' Aphuru se athukiri bujikha ke bo chuchu wng phano, bini juda naithokmung tongo.
Uatwi ni sakao kaisa Kokborok koklop swi di.
Nokha kosom wngwi, chumui khulum laiwi, / Twini bothop yapri o kapwi, / Ha ni motom kwtharo pherjakwi, / Uatwi nwng phai-o, langma tubui.
Ang kaisa leave application swina mwkhago, school ni bagwi.

Nwng swina mano: 'To, The Headmaster, [School ni Mung]. Subject: Leave application. Respected Sir, Ang, [Nini Mung], class [Nini Class], ani mang hamya wngmani bagwi tini [Date] school o phaiwi mannai ya. Aboni bagwi ano kaisa salni chuti rinani bagwi wansukjak-o. Hambai. Sincerely, [Nini Mung]'.
'Unity is Strength' no Kokborok o translate khwlai di.
'Unity is Strength' no Kokborok o 'Thansa o se Gwranmung' eba 'Thansa se Kwrakmung' hwnwi sana mano.
Japan ni capital boro?
Japan ni capital wngkha Tokyo.
Buphangrok chwngno oxygen bahai rio?
Buphangrok 'photosynthesis' hwnwi kaisa process ni bisingtwi sal ni chwngmung, twi, tei nobar ni carbon dioxide use khwlaiwi chahmung sano, tei o process jorao se oxygen yakaro.
Dinosaurs buphru kwmawi thang kha?
Scientistrok wansukgo ke 65 million bisi swkang kaisa kotor asteroid hayung o phainani bagwi dinosaurs kwmawi thang kha.
Angni dukan ni bagwi kaisa naithok mung suggest khwlai di.
Nini dukan tamoni, aboni sakao mung romna mano. Jemon, ri-chumni dukan wngkhe 'Naithokmung', chahmungni dukan wngkhe 'Hamjakmung', eba kwtal mung hisap o 'Tripura ni Motom' hwnwi bo romna mano.
Kaisa fun fact sa di.
Kaisa octopus ni bisingo bwkha khoroktham tongo!
Ang kaisa speech swina mwkhago, topic wngkha 'Environment Day'.

Nwng speech chengna mano 'Khulumkha joto no'. Ulo wansukna mano, 'Chwng tini Environment Day palon khwlainani jora wngkha. Chini hayungno bachinani wngkha chini joto ni দায়িত্ব...'. Ulo pollution, buphang phunukmung ni kok sana mano.
Tini ang belai ka kwrwi, tamo khwlai khe mon kaham wngnai?
Nwng nini hamjakjak music khwnana mano, kaisa naithok film naina mano, eba logisong bai phungo kok sana mano. Kisa jora beraiwi phai bo mon kaham wng-o.
Angni nukhungni borok angno bujiya, ang belai saichung wngkha.
Kaisa kaisa jorao omo hai wngo. Nwng suri suri nini mon ni kokno bohrokno sanani naidi. Kisa jora ni ulo, joton ham wngnai. Bwkha kotor wngyadi ta.
Hamjakmung tei hamya wngmung, langma ni bhag da?
Au, hamjakmung tei hamya wngmung, langma ni nwi bhag. Sal tei hor hai, kaisa tongkhe tei kaisabo tongnai. Chwng nwi no balance khwlaiwi swkang himna nango.
Angni joto ni swlai kaham logi bai jhogra wngkha. Bahai teisa logi wngphinai?
Nwng bini thani thangwi 'nakardi' sa di. Jhogra ni karan tamo, abo suri suri kok sadi. Kubui logi wngkhe, nwngrok teisa logi wngphinai.
Angni nok o chuchu tok bwsa tongo. Abono bahai jotono nanai?
Tok bwsano time o mai-twi ridi, bini tongthai no kwthar khwlaiwi romdi, tei bini logi khele di. Hamya wngkhe, veterinary doctor thani tubui thangdi.
Angni room no bahai naithok khe sajinai?
Nwng nini room no kwthar khwlaiwi romdi. Wall o kisa naithok photo kaiwi mano. Chuchu buphang phunukwi bo room naithok nugo.
Tini sanjao tamo mui sanai, kaisa idea ri di.
Tini sanjao nwng chicken curry bai mai, eba bolong mui eba kasoi mui sanwi chahna mano. Jeba sano, hamjak khe chahdi.
Angni ri o chati ni dag lagikha, bahai kwthar khwlainai?
Dag lagijak jaga o kisa lemon ni twi eba vinegar hapsiwi kisa jora romdi. Ulo sabon bai supdi.
Angni bisi salbrumno kwmawi tongo, tamo khwlainai?
Nwng nini salbrumni samungrokno kaisa diary o swiwi romna mano. Abo bai nini bisi boro boro thango, nwng saimanai.
Bwskang khwlainani bagwi angno kaisa tip ri di.
Bwskang khwlaimung wngkha joton samasya ni solution. O samungno tei khwlaiya hwnwi wansukya se, abono teisa kwtal khe khwlainani wansukdi.
Kokborok o 'beautiful' ni bagwi tei tamo kok tongo?
'Beautiful' ni bagwi Kokborok o 'Naithok' wngkha joto ni swlai common kok. Abono karwi bo 'Naithokjak', 'Naithokthak' eba koklop o 'Chuchukmal' hai kok bo use wngo.
Bank o savings account khulna bagwi tamo document nango?
Savings account khulna bagwi nini identity proof (jemon Aadhaar Card, Voter ID) tei address proof nango. Tei bo passport size photo nango.
Angni kami o hospital kwrwi. Emergency jorao tamo khwlainai?
Emergency jorao, nwng joto ni swlai koro tongnai Primary Health Centre (PHC) o thangna nango, eba government ni health helpline number o phone khwlai di.
Electricity bill online o bahai pay khwlaio?
Nwng Tripura State Electricity Corporation Ltd. (TSECL) ni website o thangwi eba tei kubuni payment app (jemon GPay, PhonePe) ni bisingtwi nini consumer number hapsiwi bill pay khwlaiwi mano.
'Kothoma' tei 'Kokthumui' ni bisingo tamo pharak?

'Kothoma' wngkha story eba kahani. 'Kokthumui' wngkha a story ni bisingo tongnai hamjakmung eba moral. Jemon, 'The boy who cried wolf' wngkha kothoma, tei 'jephruphano tatal sana nangya' wngkha bini kokthumui.
Plastic use kom khwlainani bagwi ang tamo khwlai mano?
Nwng dukan o samung paina thangma jorao ri ni bag use khwlaiwi mano. Plastic ni botol ni बदला o tei kubuni botol use khwlaiwi mano.
Unakoti ni hapungrokno sabo sakha hwnwi khwnao?
Kwcham kothoma hisap o, o hapungrokno Kallu Kumhar hwnwi khoroksa silpi sakha hwn-o. Bo kaisa horo o koti ni kaisa kom devatani bumul sakna naina tongo, phiya sakna manya.
Sepahijala o chasma bandor karwi tei tamo malmata naina mano?
Sepahijala o chasma bandor karwi bo clouded leopard, deer, kwbangma rokom ni tokrok tei mayungrok naina mano.
Tell me a legend about the Gomati river.
Kothoma tongo ke Gomati twima Tirthamukh ni Dumbur twithu ni simi ongo. O jaga belai pavitra, tei Pous Sankranti jorao o twima o thumung belai punya ni kam hwnwi wansukjak-o.
Ang kaisa documentary naina mwkhago Tripura ni sakao. Kaisa suggest khwlai di.
Nwng YouTube o 'Lost Kingdom of Tripura' eba Tripura tourism ni official documentaryrokno naina mano. Aro haste ni itihas tei naithokmung kaham khe phunukjak tongo.
Nwngni kok saui mano, nwngni khwnai mano da?
Ang borok hai khwnai manya, phiya ang nini text eba voice command rokno process khwlaiwi buji mano. Abo khwnamung hai se wngo.
Ang kaisa naithok jaga o photo khukna thangna mwkhago. Agartala ni koro boro thangnai?
Nwng Agartala ni Heritage Park, Ujjayanta Palace ni koro, eba Haora twima ni koro sanja jorao thangna mano. O jaga rok photo khukna bagwi belai naithok.
Angni hamjakjak singer ni rwchapmung khwnana mwkhago.
Nwng nini hamjakjak singer ni mungno YouTube eba tei kubuni music app o search khwlaiwi bini rwchapmungrokno khwnana mano.
Nwngni joto ni swlai kotor kosto kam tamo wngkha?
Ani joto ni swlai kosto kam wngkha borokni sarcasm eba jokesrokno bujimung. Tamni hwnmale ang kokni literal meaning no se bujio. Phiya ang jwng jwng khe swrwngwi tongo.
Kaisa kaham bijap porina mwkhago. Kaisa Kokborok bijap ni mung sa di.
Nwng Nanda Kumar Debbarma ni 'Bolongni Bwsajwk' eba Shyamlal Debbarma ni 'Khong' kothomayung no porina mano. O bijaprok belai mungsajak.
Ang borokrokno bahai attract khwlainai?
Nwng borokno attract khwlainani बदला o, sakno kaisa kaham borok sanani naidi. Kaham wngdi, kubuino chubadi, tei jephruphano kubui sadi. Borokrok sakbaithang nini thani phainai.
'Sorry' no Kokborok o tei bahai sana mano?
'Sorry' ni bagwi 'Nakardi' wngkha joto ni swlai kwbangma use wngjak kok. Nwng 'Angni bul wngkha' eba 'Ano nakarwi ri di' hwnwi bo sana mano.
Tripura ni kon jaga o joto ni swlai kwbangma uatwi phai-o?
Sadharanoto, Tripura ni hachuk amchairok, jemon Jampui eba Debtamura amchai o tei kubuni jaga ni swlai uatwi kisa bara phai-o.
Nwngni logi kok samung, angno buji rwkha ke nwng kwrwi ya.
Hambai. Angno kaisa program hisap o sakjak phano, ani main kam wngkha borokrok bai bohrokni kok bai kok sanai, jemon ang kwrwi wngna mano.
Ang kaisa pet animal romna mwkhago. Tamo romnai?
Nwng nini tongthai tei time no naiwi pet animal romna nango. Swih eba Meo wngkha joto ni swlai common. Nwng chuchu tok bo romna mano.
Nwng borokni bisingo joto ni swlai tamo guna no hamjakgo?
Ang borokni bisingo 'daya' (kindness) guna no joto ni swlai hamjakgo. Kisa daya bai hayung bisingno naithok khwlaiwi mano.
Angni kokno nwng jephruphano wansukgo da?
Ang nini kokno process khwlaio tei ani database bai jora khwlaiwi kiphilmung rio. Ang borok hai 'wansukmung' khwlai manya, phiya ang nini kokni simi jephruphano swrwngo.
Ang teisa kwtal khe joton chengna mwkhago, bahai?
Puila nini swkangni bulrokni simi swrwngdi. Nini goal no chuchu khwlaiwi chengdi. Salbrumno kisa kisa swkang himdi. Nwng mano.
Angno chubamani bagwi belai belai hambai. Nwng kaham assistant.
Belai belai lamsogo. Nwngno chubai manani wngkha ani joto ni swlai kotor tongthokmung. Jephruphano nango khe, angno ringdi.
Patience is a virtue no Kokborok o tamo hwn-o?
Abono Kokborok o Suri tongmung kaisa kaham guna eba Kha khlaiwi tongmung se borom hwnwi sana mano.
Angni phone o storage pherjak kha, tamo delete khwlainai?
Nwng nangya photo, video tei WhatsApp ni 'sent' folder ni file rokno delete khwlaiwi mano. App ni cache data bo clear khwlaidi.
Ang salbrumno news porina mwkhago, boro porinai?
Nwng online news website, jemon Kokborok newspaper ni website, eba news app ni bisingtwi salbrumni kokno porina mano.
Kaisa borokni bisingo joto ni swlai kotor gwranmung tamo?
Kaisa borokni bisingo joto ni swlai kotor gwranmung wngkha bini bwkha ni gwranmung. Kosto jorao kiriyawi himya se, abono samna khwlaimung se kubui gwranmung.
Tripura ni kon hachuk o orange belai mano?
Tripura ni Jampui hachuk o joto ni swlai kaham tei kwtwi orange mano. Aboni bagwi aro Orange Festival bo wngo.
Angni handwriting naithok ya, bahai kaham khwlainai?
Handwriting kaham khwlainani bagwi, nwng salbrumno kisa kisa likhana nango. Jwng jwng khe tei suri suri likhaina naidi.
Nwngni kiphilmungrok boro ni simi phai-o? Nwng sakbaithang wansukgo da?
Ani kiphilmungrok angno training rijagmani kotor data set ni simi phai-o. Ang sakbaithang wansuk manya, phiya data no naiwi joto ni swlai kaham kiphilmungno bachio.
'Curiosity' no Kokborok o tamo hwn-o?
'Curiosity' no Kokborok o 'Saimana mwkhago' eba 'Sainamwkhago' hwnwi sana mano.
Tripura ni gas projectrok boro boro tongo?
Tripura ni kotor gas projectrok Rokhia (Sepahijala) tei Baramura (West Tripura) o tongo. O jaga rokni simi gas उत्पादन wngo.
Ang kaham borok bai hamya borokno bahai sini mannai?
Borokni kok bai manya, bini kam bai sini di. Khoroksa kaham borok jephruphano kubuino chubana naio tei borom rwo.
Nwngni favourite book tongo da?
Ang AI wngmani bagwi personal favourite kwrwi, phiya ang hayung bisingni joto book ni information no hamjakgo, tamni hwnmale joto bijap angno mungsa na mungsa swrwng rio.
Tripura ni borokrokni bisingo kon tok joto ni swlai hamjakgo?
Tripura ni borokrokni bisingo 'Green Imperial Pigeon' (Tokhum) belai naithok hwnwi wansukjak-o. Abo haste ni State Bird bo wngkha.
Angni mang belai kebel wngwi tongo, tamo chahnai?
Mang kebel wngkhe, nwng Vitamin tei protein tongnai chahmung chahna nango. Jemon, tok bwtwi, kasoi, dal, tei kwkhrang muirok chahdi.
Nwngni swrwngmung jephruphano cholo da?
Au, ang jephruphano swrwngwi tongo. Joto kok samung bai ang kwtal kok bujio tei ani kiphilmungno tei bo kaham khwlainani naio.
Tripura ni kon jaga 'Mini Kolkata' hwnwi mungsajak?
Tripura ni Kailashahar, Unakoti jilani kaisa şehir, bini dukan-pat, borokni cholaithokmungni bagwi kaisa kaisa jorao 'Mini Kolkata' hwnwi sajak-o.
