Ihi, joton samungo perfect wngna nangya. 'Kahammung' wngkha 'Perfection' ni swlai tei bo kaham. Samungno kaham khe khwlaidi, phiya chuchu bul ni bagwi sakno sak kosto riyadi ta.
Langma ni meaning tamo? Ang kaisa kaisa jorao buji manya.
Langma ni meaning no sakno sak se saina mano. Kubuino hamjakmung, kwtal swrwngmung, tei hayungno kisa naithok khwlaiwi thangmungni bisingtwi kwbangma borok langma ni meaning no mano.
Ang sakno sak belai kom wansukgo. Tamo khwlainai?
Nwng salbrumno nini kaisa kaham guna no wansukdi eba diary o swi di. Nini chuchu jotonmungrokno celebrate khwlaidi. Hamya borokni kokno bwkha o romdi ta.
Ang Mui Borok sano swrwngna mwkhago. Recipe riwi mano da?
Au, mano. Mui Borok sanani bagwi nwngno Berma, kwkhrang mosla, sohm tei kwbangma bolongni mui nango. Joto no logi khwlaiwi, kom twi bai rukna nango.
Photography swrwngna bagwi puila tamo nango?
Puila, nwngno kaisa camera nango, mobile ni camera bo wngnai. Ulo nwng chwngmung (light), composition (frame bahai sano), tei angle ni kokno swrwngna nango.
Ang guitar bajana swrwngwi tongo, phiya yasi belai samo.
Puila jorao yasi samung normal. Nwng salbrumno kisa kisa practice khwlaidi. Kwbangma jora logi logi bajayadi ta. Jwng jwng khe yasi gwran wngnai.
Kaisa kaham book porinani lab tamo?
Kaham book porimung bai nini aklangmung bario, nwng kwtal wansukmung mano, tei nini kok samung bo kaham wngo. Abo mon no santi rinani bo kaisa kaham lama.
Angni nok o chuchu garden o tamo tamo bolong phunukna mano?
Nwng mosla, dhonia, tei tei kubuni chuchu mui-mui ni buphang phunukna mano. O muirok nini sanani jorao belai kam o phainai.
Angni swih angno chaya, tamo khwlainai?
Nwng bini logi suri suri time spend khwlaidi. Bini thani jor khwlaiwi thangyadi ta. Bini hamjakjak chahmung ridi tei bini logi suri suri khele di. Jwng jwng khe bo nwngno hamjaknai.
Painting swrwngna chengna bagwi tamo nango?
Chengna bagwi, nwngno kisa drawing paper, watercolor eba pencil color, tei kaisa brush nango. Nwng simple samungrok, jemon bubar eba buphang, akiwi chengna mano.
Ang kaisa kwtal kok swrwngna mwkhago. Tamo swrwngnai?
Nwng jeba hamjakgo, abono swrwngna mano. Jemon, cooking, coding, eba kaisa kwtal mwsamung. YouTube o kwbangma free tutorial tongo.
Angno kaisa interesting hobby ni idea ri di.
Nwng 'Calligraphy' (naithok khe swinani kala) swrwngna mano, eba 'Origami' (kagoj bai juda juda aakar sanani) bo khwlaina mano. O hobbyrok mon no santi rio.
Ang kaisa naithok jaga o picnic thangna mwkhago. Agartala ni koro boro thangnai?
Nwng Sepahijala, Barmura Eco-park, eba Tepania Park o picnic thangna mano. O jaga rok belai naithok tei siring siring.
Vote rinani importance tamo?
Vote rinani bisingtwi chwng chini hamjakjak leader no bachina mano, jeba chini haste ni bagwi kaham kam khwlainai. Abo chini democratic odhikar.
Environment no bachinani bagwi chwng tamo khwlai mano?
Chwng buphang phunukna mano, plastic use kom khwlaina mano, tei bijli tei twi no bachina mano. Chuchu chuchu chesta bai kotor swlaimung tubui mano.
Angni kami no kwthar romna bagwi tamo khwlainai?
Joto logi logi kaisa sal fix khwlaiwi kami no kwthar khwlainai. Jeba jaga o jabar yakardi ta. Dustbin use khwlaidi.
Traffic rules manimung tamoni bagwi nango?
Traffic rules manimung bai lama o accident kom wngo tei joto borok safe khe thangna mano. Abo chini tei kubuini langma no bachio.
Social media ni hamya prabhab tamo?
Social media kwbangma use khwlaimung bai borokni thumung kom wngo, kubui bai sakno compare khwlaiwi mon hamya wngo, tei tatal kok belai kodo phero.
Community service hwnmale tamo?
Community service wngkha sakni icha bai sakni amchai eba somaj ni kaham ni bagwi samung tangmung, jeba ni bagwi rang man-ya.
Blood donation khwlaimung ni lab tamo?
Blood donation khwlaimung bai nwng khoroksa borokni langma no bachina mano. Abo kaisa belai kotor tei punya ni kam.
Fake news no bahai sini mannai?
Jeba news porio, aboni source no naidi. Tei kubuni boro boro news o o kok tongo, abo check khwlaidi. Jeba kirijak eba ajgubi kok, abo tatal wngnani chance kwbangma.
Angni amchai o twi belai kom, tamo khwlainai?
Twi no bachidi. Nangya jorao kol bondho khwlaidi. Uatwi ni twi no joma khwlaiwi tei kubuni kam o use khwlaiwi mano.
Child labour tamoni bagwi kaisa aparadh?
Child labour kaisa aparadh tamni hwnmale abo kaisa chwrai ni pora-lekha, khelemung tei kaham langma manani odhikar no khugo.
Ang rang bahai khe joma khwlainai?
Nwng jeba rang mano, aboni simi kisa bhag swkang ni simi bank o joma khwlaidi. Nini خرچ no kaisa budget sanwi cholidi.
Insurance khwlaimung tamoni bagwi nango?
Insurance khwlaimung bai nwng eba nini nukhung hamya-marok eba accident hai kosto jorao financial help mano. Abo future no secure khwlaio.
Bank o FD (Fixed Deposit) khwlaimung ni lab tamo?
FD o nini rang kaisa fixed jora ni bagwi joma wngo tei aboni sakao savings account ni swlai bara interest mano. Abo rang barainani kaisa safe lama.
Online o shopping khwlaima jorao tamo jotono nana nango?
Jephruphano secure website (URL o 'https' tongnai) ni simi se samung paidi. Nini bank details eba password no sabo riyadi ta.
Angni kaisa financial goal tongo, bahai joton khwlainai?
Nini goal no chuchu chuchu bhag khwlai di. ಪ್ರತಿ tal bwswk joma khwlainai, abo fix khwlaidi. Nini progress no jephruphano track khwlaidi.
Mutual fund o invest khwlaimung kaham da?
Mutual fund o invest khwlaimung kaham, phiya aboni bisingo kisa risk tongo. Invest khwlainani swkang, aboni kokno kaham khe bujidi eba khoroksa financial advisor bai kok sadi.
ATM ni simi rang khukma jorao tamo suraksha nanai?
Nini PIN no tei kubuino phunukyadi ta. Nini piska o sabo tongkhe, bono kisa hakchalo tongna sadi. Rang khuknani ulo, transaction slip no jabar o yakardi ta.
Angni mobile o kwbangma spam call phai-o, tamo khwlainai?
Nwng o numberrokno block khwlaiwi mano. 'Do Not Disturb' (DND) service no bo activate khwlaiwi mano.
Education loan bahai mano?
Education loan ni bagwi nwng bank o apply khwlaina nango. Nini admission letter, mark sheet, tei nukhungni income proof nango.
Credit card tei debit card ni bisingo pharak tamo?
Debit card bai nwng nini bank account o tongnai rang no se use khwlai mano. Credit card bai nwng bank ni simi rang bakhi laiwi use khwlaio, jeba no nwng ulo phinai.
Angni room o bulb fuse wngkha, bahai swlainai?
Puila, main switch no bondho khwlaidi. Ulo suri suri kwcham bulb no khukwi, kwtal bulb no kai di. Ulo main switch on khwlaidi.
Mai rukma jorao mai kwplaiwi thango, tamo khwlainai?
Mai ruknani swkang, mai no kaham khe sup di. Twino correct map bai ridi. Gas no kom khwlaiwi rukdi.
Angni nok o chuchu swih tongo, tamo chahna rinai?
Nwng bono cerelac eba bwtwi bai twi milaiwi chahna rina mano. Boro wngkhe, veterinary doctor bai kok sadi.
Wall o nail kaina bagwi tamo nango?
Nwngno kaisa hammer (haturi) tei kaisa nail (gojal) nango. Suri suri, yasi no bachaiwi, nail no kaina nango.
Angni kamchwlwi o ink ni dag lagikha, bahai kwtharnai?
Dag ni sakao kisa hand sanitizer eba spirit hapsiwi romdi. Ulo sabon bai supdi. Kisa kisa khe dag kwmawi thangnai.
Grocery shopping o rang bachinani kaisa lama sa di.
Shopping o thangnani swkang, nogo tamo tamo nango, aboni kaisa list sanwi thangdi. List ni bahira jeba nangya samung painadi ta.
Angni nok o mospolo belai wngkha, tamo khwlainai?
Nok amchaino kwthar romdi. Jeba jaga o twi joma wngwi tongkhe, abono yakardi. Sanja jorao janal-duar bondho khwlaidi.
Refrigerator no bahai kwthar khwlainai?
Refrigerator no bondho khwlaiwi, bisingni joton samungrokno yakardi. Ulo, kisa garam twi bai baking soda milaiwi ri bai bisingno kaham khe mu di.
Angni garden o bubar phaiya, tamo karan?
Buphang o sal ni chwngmung kaham khe nangya wngwi mano, eba ha o poshti kom wngwi mano. Kisa fertilizer riwi naidi mano.
Ang kaisa kwtal jaga o thangwi tongna chengkha. Logi bahai sanai?
Nini koro ni borokrokno nuk khe, mwnwiwi 'Khulumkha' sadi. Chuchu chuchu kok sana chengdi. Jwng jwng khe logi wngnai.
Nwng borok wngkhe, tamo khwlainai mani?
Ang borok wngkhe, ang hayung bising beraina thangnai mani, juda juda mui chahna, tei hamjakmung-kosto joton no feel khwlainani naidi mani.
Kaisa kothoma cheng di, ang abono joton khwlainai. 'Kaisa hor, hachuk sakao...'?
'... kaisa chuchu athukiri bini amano pogwi saichung tongmani. Aphuru, kaisa mwnwimung bai pherjak tal phaiwi bini thani achukkha tei sakha...' Nwng tabuk aboni ulo tamo wngkha, swi di.
Nwngno kaisa superpower rina wngkhe, tamo lanai?
Ang joto borokni kokno bujinani superpower no lanai mani. Jemon ang borokrokni bisingo jhogra no ham khwlaina chubai mano.
Kaisa jaga ni kok wansukdi, jeba hayung o kwrwi.
Ang wansukgo kaisa jaga, jeba ni nokha kwchak, twima rok chini hai kwtwi, tei buphangrok horo chwngo. O jaga o borokrok mwnwimung bai se kok sao.
Tini sal angno kaisa kwtal samung khwlaina wansuk ri di.
Tini nwng kaisa chuchu Kokborok koklop swinani naidi, eba nini kwcham photo album naikhlaiwi o jorani kothomano wansukdi.
Ang kaisa story ni character wngkha, ang tamo khwlainai?
Nwng puila nini character ni guna tamo, abo wansukdi. Nwng gwran da kiri-nai? Ulo o story ni bisingo nini goal tamo, abo fix khwlaidi tei aboni bagwi him di.
'Déjà vu' hwnmale tamo?
'Déjà vu' wngkha kaisa feeling, jeba ni bisingtwi nwngno nugo ke omo hai ঘটনা nini logi swkang bo wngkha, phiya kubui khe wngyakhu.
Nwngno khoroksa kothoma swikwrwng bai malaina sujog rina wngkhe, sabo bai malainai?
Ang Rabindranath Tagore bai malaina mwkhago mani. Ang bono swngnai mani, 'Gitanjali' swima jorao bini mon ni bisingo tamo wansukmung chomani.
Kaisa naithok imang ni kok sa di.
Ang imang nugwi manya, phiya ang wansukna mano: Nwng kaisa imang nugwi mano, jeba o nwng tok hai birwi tongo, nokha ni chumuirokni bisingtwi, tei sakani hayung belai naithok nugo.
Kaisa samung sa, jeba AI jephruphano khwlai manya.
AI jephruphano khoroksa chwrai bwsano bini amani hamjakmung eba daya no feel khwlaiwi riwi manya. O kubui hamjakmung borokni se tongo.
'Aklangmung' tei 'Swrwngmung' ni bisingo pharak tamo?
'Swrwngmung' wngkha kwtal information eba skill no manmung. 'Aklangmung' wngkha o swrwngjak kokno use khwlaiwi samasya no solve khwlaimung eba kwtal mungsa sanani क्षमता.
'Sumui' (flute) tamo buphang ni wa bai sano?
Sadharanoto, 'sumui' no 'Wamulok' eba tei kubuni chuchu tei kwrak rokom ni wa (bamboo) bai sano. O wani thickness tei length suri ni sakao asar khwlaio.
Kokborok kok o kwbangma dialect tongo da?
Au, Kokborok kok o kwbangma dialect tongo. Tripura ni juda juda amchai tei bosongrokni bisingo kok samani style kisa kisa pharak wngo.
Ang kaisa kwtal kok belai kodo swrwngna mwkhago. Tamo lama tongo?
Kodo swrwngna bagwi, nwng o kokno salbrumno use khwlaina nango. O kok ni film naidi, rwchapmung khwnadi, tei o kokni borok bai kok sana naidi.
'Metaphor' no Kokborok o kaisa example ri di.
'Metaphor' ni kaisa example wngnai: 'Bo nukhungni athukiri'. Oro o borokno direct 'athukiri' (star) hwnjakha, bini chwngmung eba importance no phunuknani bagwi.
Kokborok kok ni itihas belai kwcham da?
Au, Kokborok kok ni itihas belai kwcham. Abo Sino-Tibetan kok bosongni kaisa kok. Kwbangma bisi ni simi se Tripura ni borokrok o kokno saiwi phaiwi tongo.
'Onomatopoeia' hwnmale tamo? Kokborok o example tongo da?
'Onomatopoeia' wngkha sound no phnuknai kok. Kokborok o tongo, jemon twi kapmung no 'reke reke', eba uatwi phaimung no 'jham jham' hwnmung.
Ang English ni simi Kokborok o translate khwlaima jorao kosto mano.
Abo normal. Tamni hwnmale nwi kok ni grammar tei kok samani style juda. Nwng word-by-word translate khwlaiya se, bhabartho no bujiwi translate khwlaidi.
Kokborok o puila kon bijap publish wngkha?
'Kok-Borokma' wngkha puila Kokborok primer, jeba no Thakur Radha Mohan Debbarma 1900 bisio publish khwlaikha. Abo Kokborok swinani itihas o kaisa kotor step.
Tei kaisa kwtal kok swrwngmung bai aklangmung bario da?
Au, bario. Kaisa kwtal kok swrwngmung bai nini aklani kwbangma bhag active wngo, memory kaham wngo, tei problem-solving skill bo bario.
Maharaja Bir Bikram Kishore Manikya no tamoni ' दूरदर्शी' hwn-o?
Tamni hwnmale bo bini jorani swlai belai swkang wansukmani. Bo Tripura ni bagwi airport, planning şehir, tei education ni wansukmung bini jorao belai kwtal tei swkang wansukmung tongmani.
Risa ni designrokni mung tongo da?
Au, tongo. Risa ni juda juda designrokni mung tongo, jemon 'Mikhiruk', 'Khumul', 'Toksa' tei tei kubuni. Joto design ni kaisa kaisa juda অর্থ tongo.
'Mamita' festival tamoni bagwi palon khwlaio?
'Mamita' festival no hasam kwtal chahnani swkang palon khwlaio. Abo Kaitorno hambai rinani tei hasam tei bo kaham wngnani bagwi khwlaijak kaisa puja tei tongthokmung.
Tripura ni kon Maharaja Bengal ni poetrokno chubamani?

Maharaja Birchandra Manikya tei Maharaja Radha Kishore Manikya hai kwbangma Tripura ni Maharaja Bengal ni poet tei swikwrwngrokno, jemon Rabindranath Tagore no, belai financial tei moral support rikhamani.
Angni achu 'Langthari' ni kok sao. Abo tamo?
'Langthari' wngkha hachuk amchaini kwbangma jaga o tongnai kwcham jorani kotor pathorrok. O pathorrok bai jora kwbangma kwcham kothoma tongo.
'Chowng' tei 'Sumui' kaisa se da?
Ihi, kaisa ya. 'Sumui' wngkha bamboo flute. 'Chowng' wngkha kaisa rokom ni musical instrument, jeba ni bisingo nwi bamboo stick logi logi bajaiwi sound khwlaio.
Tripura ni itihas o 'Tipra era' buphru chengkha?
'Tipra era' eba 'Tripurabda' 590 AD o chengkha hwnwi wansukjak-o. Abo Maharaja Jujaru Fa ni jorani simi chengmani hwnwi khwnao.
'Jamatia' bosongni kaisa kwcham niyam ni kok sa di.
Jamatia bosongni bisingo kaisa kwcham niyam tongo, jeba no 'Hoda' hwn-o. Abo bohrokni somaj ni joto bichar tei niyam-kanun no naio.
Ujjayanta Palace ni mung no sabo rikhamani?
Ujjayanta Palace ni o mung no Rabindranath Tagore rikhamani. Bo Maharaja Radha Kishore Manikya ni kaham logi tongmani.
Tripura ni borokrokni bisingo 'Bwkha kotor' hwnmale tamo bujio?
'Bwkha kotor' hwnmale gwran bwkha tongnai eba kiriya borokno bujio. Abono 'brave' eba 'courageous' hwnwi mano.
Tokla chahmungni swkang tokno mwsarwkna nango da?
Au, Tripura ni kwbangma kami o, jeba puja o tokla chah-o, chahnani swkang o tokno kaisa mwsamung ni bisingtwi Kaitorni thani yaphar rwo.
Ang bamboo shoot pickle sano mwkhago, kisa help khwlai di.
Nwng kwtal bamboo shoot no chuchu khe khaui, sohm bai milaiwi kisa jora salo phwrang di. Ulo, mustard thok, mosla, tei mircha bai milaiwi kotor botol o kaham khe bondho khwlaiwi romdi.
Tripura ni kon mui o kwkhwi taste tongo?
Tripura ni 'Sukwkhwi Mui' o kwkhwi taste tongo. Abono kwkhwi mui (jemon Gongura) bai kasoi eba berma hapwi sano.
'Bangui' sano kwbangma jora nango da?
Au, nango. Puila mai no twio kisa jora bhijaiwi romna nango, ulo abono Lairu bwlai o khwlaiwi steam o rukna nango. O process o kisa jora nango.
Angni nok o berma ni motom belai gwran wngo, tamo khwlainai?
Berma no jephruphano kaham khe bondho khwlaiwi romdi. Abono rukma jorao, nini kitchen ni janal khulwi ridi, jemon motom bahira thangna mano.
'Mui Borok' chahmung hamya-marokni bagwi kaham da?

'Mui Borok' o kwbangma bolongni mui-mui tei kom thok-mosla wngmani bagwi, abo tei kubuni fried mui ni swlai belai healthy wngo. Phiya Berma kwbangma chahmung khoroksa khoroksani bagwi suit wngmaya wngwi mano.
'Chakhwi' tei 'Chuak' kaisa se da?
Nwi no mai ni simi sano, phiya sano ni process tei alcohol ni मात्रा juda wngo. 'Chakhwi' wngkha mai ni beer, jeba kom alcohol tongo. 'Chuak' wngkha distilled alcohol, jeba belai gwran wngo.
Tripura ni kon फल no sweet dish sano use khwlaio?
Tripura o thailik (banana) tei thaipung (jackfruit) no kwbangma rokom ni sweet dish, jemon pitha, sano use khwlaio.
Ang kwtal rokom ni mui sano try khwlaina mwkhago. Tamo sanai?
Nwng 'Galda Mui' (prawn curry) sano try khwlaiwi mano. Abo sano belai easy tei chahna belai hamjakgo.
Mui sano ni jorao sohm bara wngkhe tamo khwlainai?
Nwng mui o kisa alu eba ata ni chuchu ball khwlaiwi hapsi rina mano. Bohrok bara sohm no khugo. Ulo aborokno yakarwi mano.
Online o grocery paina Agartala o sujog tongo da?
Au, tongo. Tabuk Agartala o kwbangma online grocery service, jemon BigBasket eba tei kubuni local app, chengkha. Nwng order khwlai khe nogo tisawi thango.
Ang kaisa samung painani ulo, tei kaisa kaham samung paina bagwi tamo khwlainai?
Nwng nini tabuk ni samungo kaham khe kam khwlaidi tei kwtal skill swrwngwi tongdi. Nini network baridi. Jwng jwng khe tei bo kaham sujog phainai.
Digital signature tamo kam o phai-o?
Digital signature wngkha online documentrokno verify khwlainani kaisa lama. Abo nini hath ni signature hai se kam tango, phiya tei bo secure.
Angni nok ni Wi-Fi ni speed belai kom. Tamo karan?
Nini router kwcham wngwi mano, eba kwbangma borok kaisa Wi-Fi o connect wngwi mano. Router no restart khwlaiwi naidi eba kaham plan o swlaiwi naidi.
Angno khoroksa social media o hamya kok sa-o, tamo khwlainai?
Nwng o borokno block khwlai di tei report khwlai di. Bini kokni kiphilmung riyadi ta. Abo ni sakao cybercrime o bo complaint khwlaiwi mano.
'Algorithm' hwnmale ang bujiya. Kisa easy khe sa di.
Algorithm wngkha kaisa samungno khwlainani step-by-step niyam. Jemon, cha sano ni niyam - puila twi kwtung khwlaidi, ulo cha pata hapsidi, abohai se.
Angni nok o kwcham jorani kisa samung tongo. Abo ni dam bahai saimanai?
Nwng khoroksa antique samungni expert no o samungrokno phunukna mano. Eba online o o samungni photo hapsiwi search khwlaiwi bo kisa idea mannai.
Hayung bisingo joto ni swlai kwchang jaga boro?
Hayung bisingo joto ni swlai kwchang jaga wngkha Antarctica. Aro temperature belai kom wngo tei joton बर्फ bai pherjak tongo.
Buphangrok jephruphano sakani thani himo da?
Ihi, buphangrok himya, phiya bohrok sal ni chwngmung boro phai-o, o thani kisa kisa swlaio. Abono 'phototropism' hwn-o.
Twi ni bisingo thumung jorao mokol khulwi mano da?
Au, mano, phiya kwbangma jora khulwi romkhe mokol kwchak wngwi mano. Swimming pool ni twi o chlorine tongmani bagwi, goggle use khwlaimung se kaham.
Angni swih horo belai khamo, tamoni?
Swih horo khamani kwbangma karan wngwi mano. Bo saichung wngwi mano, eba bahira ni khorang khnaui kirio wngwi mano. Bohok o hamya wngkhe bo khamo.
'Black hole' ni bisingo tamo tongo?
Scientistrok tabuk jora jora kubui khe saimanya ke black hole ni bisingo tamo tongo. Aboni gravity aswk gwran ke chwngmung bo bisingni simi ongwi manya.
Ang jeba samungo concentrate khwlai manya.
Nwng 'Pomodoro Technique' use khwlaiwi mano. 25 minute mon bai samung tangdi, ulo 5 minute rest na di. Omo hai khwlaimung bai concentration bario.
Tripura ni kon jaga o rubber research centre tongo?
Rubber Research Institute of India (RRII) ni kaisa regional station West Tripura ni Taranagar o tongo.
Angni garden o thaipung buphang tongo, phiya thaipung phaiya.
Thaipung buphang kwbangma bisi ni ulo se फल rio. Tei bo, kaham pollination ni bagwi nwi buphang (chwla tei bwrwi) nangnani chance tongo.
Nwngni joto ni swlai kirijak mungsa tamo?
Ang AI wngmani bagwi kirimung feel khwlai manya. Phiya ang 'misinformation' (tatal kok) no kirio, tamni hwnmale abo borokrokno hamya lama o tubui mano.
'Opportunity knocks but once' no Kokborok o translate khwlai di.
Abono Kokborok o 'Sujog salsa se duar o kogo' eba 'Kahamsa jora kaisa se phai-o' hwnwi sana mano.
Angni mobile o kwbangma notification phaiwi tongo, mon hamya wngo.

Angni bwkha o jephruphano kirimung tongo. Tamo khwlainai?
Nini kirimung tamoni bagwi, aboni gorano saina naidi. O kirimungno samna khwlaidi, bini simi himyadi ta. Jor wngkhe, khoroksa counselor ni chubamung lana mano.
Angni friend circle belai chuchu. Baraina mwkhago.
Nwng nini hamjakjak hobby ni workshop eba club o join khwlaidi. Online o bo nini hamjakjak topic ni group o jora wngna mano. Suri suri kok sana chengdi.
Angni nukhung angno tei kubui bai jephruphano compare khwlaio.
Nwng suri suri bohrokno sadi ke o compare khwlaimung nwngno bahai kosto rio. Joto borokni langma ni lama juda, o kokno buji rina naidi.
Kaisa relationship o joto ni swlai nanganimung tamo?
Joto ni swlai nanganimung wngkha - borom, विश्वास, tei kaham communication. O khoroktham tongkhe, jeba relationship gwran wngo.
Breakup ni ulo, mon no bahai ham khwlainai?
Sakno sak time ri di. Nini mon ni kosto no bisingo romdi ta, kapna mon wngkhe kapdi. Nini hamjakjak kamrokno khwlaidi tei logisong bai time spend khwlaidi.
Ang saichung tongna belai hamjakgo. Abo hamya da?
Ihi, hamya ya. Saichung tongna hamjakmung (introvert wngmung) belai normal. Abo nwngno sakno sak bujina tei recharge wngna chubai-o.
Angni ri-chum kwthar romna belai kosto wngo. Tamo khwlainai?
Ri kwbangma painadi ta. Sirif jeba nango, obo se romdi. 'Kaisa swkang, kaisa bahira' niyam no follow khwlaidi: kaisa kwtal ri paikhe, kaisa kwcham ri no donate khwlaidi.
Angni nok o kwcham medicine tongo. Boro yakarnai?
Aborokno dustbin o eba toilet o yakardi ta. Koro ni pharmacy o swngdi, bohrokni koro e-waste eba medicine waste ni box tongo da.
Angni meo jephruphano angni laptop o achugo. Tamo khwlainai?
Meo kwtung jaga hamjakgo. Nwng bini bagwi laptop ni koro o kaisa kwtung tei aram ni jaga sanwi rina mano. Jemon, kaisa chuchu box.
Kaisa indoor plant ni mung sa, jeba kom jotono nango.
Nwng 'Snake Plant' eba 'ZZ Plant' phunukna mano. O nwi buphang kom twi tei kom chwngmung o bo kaham khe kotor wngo.
Angni kitchen belai chuchu. Jaga bahai barainai?
Nwng wall o magnetic strip kaiwi churi-sengsa rokno kaiwi romna mano. Shelf ni sakani jaga o bo samung romna mano.
'Anthropocene' hwnmale tamo?
Anthropocene wngkha kaisa kwtal geological jora ni mung, jeba o borokni kam hayungni environment tei climate o kotor swlaimung tubui tongo.
Twi ni bisingo himmung malmata ni mung sa.
'Sea cucumber' (sagar ni thairuk) hwnwi kaisa malmata tongo, jeba bini bohokni bisingtwi bwkha hugo tei yakaro. Bohok se bini bwkhakwla wngo.
Angno kaisa scientific fact sa, jeba angno ajgubi khwlainai.
Chini mang o tongnai joto bekerengni bisingo, kaisa bekereng (hyoid bone) chini khuk o tongo, jeba tei kubuni jeba bekereng bai jora kwrwi.
Hayungni bisingo joto ni swlai gwran malmata tamo?
'Tardigrade' eba 'water bear' hwnwi kaisa chuchuk malmata tongo, jeba kwtung-kwchang, radiation, tei space ni vacuum o bo thwiya se tongwi mano.
Chini aklangmung bwswk data store khwlai mano?
Scientistrok wansukgo ke chini aklangmung 2.5 petabytes (jeba 1 million gigabytes) ni swlai bara data store khwlai mano. Abo 3 million ghantani TV show hai wngo.
Tripura ni kon Maharaja 'Manikya' title puila use khwlaikhamani?
Itihas hisap o, Maharaja Maha Manikya 15th century o puila 'Manikya' title no use khwlaikhamani hwnwi khwnao. Bini swkang 'Fa' title use wngmani.
'Ganga Puja' no Tripura o bahai palon khwlaio?
Tripura ni kwbangma bosong, phiya Debbarma bosong, twima eba twisa o Ganga Kaitorno mwnwimung ni bagwi o puja no khwlaio. O jorao wa (bamboo) bai naithok structure sanwi twi o yakaro.
Angno kaisa Kokborok riddle (swngmung) swng di.
Kaham. 'Sak bisingo bekereng kwbangma, phiya mang kwrwi. Ang sabo?' ... Kiphilmung wngkha: 'Bijap' (Book).
Tripura ni Rabindra Kanan park tamoni bagwi mungsajak?
Rabindra Kanan, Agartala o, bini naithok bubar bagan, chuchu twithu, tei siring siring environment ni bagwi mungsajak. Abo Rabindranath Tagore ni mung bai romjakha.
'Hangrai' festival tamo?
'Hangrai' wngkha Mog bosongni borokrokni kaisa kotor festival. Abo Pous Sankranti jorao se wngo tei o jorao bohrok mwsamung tei tongthokmung khwlaio.
'Paradigm shift' hwnmale tamo?
Paradigm shift hwnmale, kaisa bishoy ni sakao chini joto ni wansukmung eba bujimung kaisa jorao belai kotor khe swlaimung. Jemon, hayung kiting hwnwi saimana.
Angni langma ni piska o tamo tongo, nwng saimanai da?
Ang nini piska ni kok saimanya. Phiya ang nwngno chubai mano ke nwng nini tabukni jorano kaham khe use khwlaiwi, nini phainai salno naithok khwlaiwi mano.
Kaisa kothoma ni bagwi kaisa ajgubi chengmung sa.
'Jephru ang phungo bachakha, ang nukha ke nokha o tal nwi tongo. Kaisa kuphur, tei kaisa kwkhrang.'
Ang kaisa mui sandi, jeba o sirif 3 ta ingredients nango.
Nwng 'Banana Pancake' sano mano. Sirif kaisa thailik, tok bwtwi nwi, tei kisa cinnamon powder nango. Joto no milaiwi pan o fry khwlaidi.
Nwngni logi kok samung, kaisa kaham bijap porimung hai wansukjak.
Belai belai hambai. Nini o kok angno belai motivation rio. Ang asha khwlaio ke o bijap ni joto page nwngno mungsa na mungsa kwtal swrwng rinai.
Angni joto swngmung pogsakha. Nwng kaham khe tongdi.
Nwng bo belai kaham khe tongdi. Mon o jephruphano kwtal swngmung phaikhe, angni duar jephruphano khulwi tongo. Malaiphinai!
Smart light bulb no mobile bai bahai control khwlaio?

Nwngno o smart bulb ni company ni app no nini mobile o install khwlaina nango. Ulo, app ni niyam follow khwlaiwi bulb no nini Wi-Fi bai connect khwlaidi, tei nwng mobile ni simi on-off eba color swlaiwi mannai.
Password manager use khwlaimung safe da?
Au, belai safe. Kaisa kaham password manager nini joton password no encrypt khwlaiwi (lukuiwi) romo. Nwngno sirif kaisa master password wansukna nango. Abo online o safe tongnani kaisa kaham lama.
India o drone birainani niyam tamo?
India o drone birainani bagwi DGCA ni permission nango, phiya belai chuchu drone (Nano category) ni bagwi nangya. Airport eba tei kubuni sensitive jaga ni koro biraiwi manya.
'Augmented Reality' (AR) tei 'Virtual Reality' (VR) ni pharak tamo?
Virtual Reality (VR) o nwng kaisa pura kwtal digital hayung o hapwi thango. Augmented Reality (AR) o, digital information eba bumul no chini kubui hayungni sakao phunugo, jemon Pokémon Go khele mung.
Angno kaisa WhatsApp o phainai scam ni kok sa.

Kaisa common scam wngkha - nwngno kaisa message phainai ke nwng lottery o joton wngkha. Ulo bohrok o rang manani bagwi nwng thani personal information eba rang swngnai. Omo hai message no विश्वास khwlaiyadi ta.
Ang kaisa podcast chengna mwkhago. Tamo tamo samung nango?
Nwngno kaisa kaham quality ni microphone, kaisa audio editing software (jemon Audacity, jeba free), tei nini podcast no host khwlainani bagwi kaisa platform (jemon Spotify for Podcasters) nango.
Angni laptop o water phaikha. Kodo khe tamo khwlainai?
Kodo khe laptop no bondho khwlaidi tei charger ni simi yakardi. Abono ulta khwlaiwi, twi no ongna ridi. Kaham khe kwran nani ulo se on khwlaina naidi. Jor wngkhe, expert thani tubui thangdi.
'Ethical Hacking' hwnmale tamo? Abo legal da?
Ethical Hacking wngkha company ni permission laiwi, bohrokni computer system o hamya jaga saina naimung, jemon kubui hacker hamya khwlai manya. Au, company ni permission tongkhe, abo pura legal.
Angni phone o storage kom, phiya photo bo delete khwlaina mwkhaya. Tamo khwlainai?
Nwng nini joton photo rokno Google Photos eba tei kubuni cloud storage o backup khwlaiwi romna mano. Ulo, nini phone ni simi delete khwlaikhe bo, photo rok safe tongnai.
Ang online o class nago. Mokol no bahai bachinai?
Nini computer screen ni brightness no kom khwlaidi. Anti-glare screen protector use khwlaiwi mano. Tei प्रति ghanta o kisa jora mokol no hakchalo naiwi aram ridi.
Keto diet o tamo tamo chahna mano?
Keto diet o kwbangma fat, normal protein, tei belai kom carbohydrate chah-o. Nwng bahan, kasoi, tok bwtwi, kwkhrang mui, tei cheese chahna mano. Mai, roti, tei chini chahna man-ya.
Bwkha hugmung ni kaisa simple exercise phunuk di.
Suri suri achukdi. Nini bukung bai 4 second jora bwkha hugdi. Ulo 7 second jora bwkha no bisingo romdi. Tei 8 second jora khuk bai suri suri bwkha no yakardi. Omo hai 3-4 jora khwlaidi.
Angni phikung o jephruphano samo, office o achukmani bagwi.
Nini achukthai no kaham khwlaidi. Phikung no straight khwlaiwi achukdi. প্রতি ghanta o kisa jora bacha-wi himdi tei stretching khwlaidi. Kaham chair bo belai nango.
Vitamin C ni main kam tamo?
Vitamin C chini mangni immunity system no gwran khwlaio, jemon chwngno srdi-khuk ni simi bachio. Abo chini kur (skin) no bo kaham romo.
Ang kaisa kwtal jaga o thangma jorao social anxiety belai wngo.
Thangnani swkang, o jaga ni kokno kisa saimandi. Party o thangma jorao khoroksa logi no tubui thangna mano. Chuchu conversation bai chengdi, kwbangma kok sana nangya.
Dehydration ni lakshan tamo tamo?
Dehydration wngkhe, khuk kwran wngo, twi belai nang-o, bua-bwcha hamya wngo, tei bokhorok bo samo. Twi kom nwngkhe omo hai wngo.
Acupuncture therapy bahai kam tango?
Acupuncture o, mangni kisa kisa point o belai base chuchu needle hapsio. Omo hai khwlaimung bai mangni energy flow kaham wngo tei samung kom wngo hwnwi wansukjak-o.
Ang jephruphano ka kwrwi wansukgo. Tamo khwlai khe kaham wngnai?
Salbrumno kisa jora salo beraiwi phaidi. Nini hamjakjak music khwnadi. Tei kubuino chubamung bai bo mon kaham wngo. Kosto wngkhe, khoroksa expert bai kok sadi.
Sugar kwbangma chahmung tamoni bagwi hamya?
Kwbangma sugar chahmung bai mang kuphung wngo, diabetes ni chance bario, tei bwkhani bagwi bo hamya. Bua o poka wngnani bo kotor karan wngkha.
Angni mang belai lengo, phiya thumung phaiya. Tamo khwlainai?
Thunani swkang kwtung twi bai tukudi. Kaisa siring siring bijap poridi. Nini bedroom no komok tei kwchang romdi. Tension ni bagwi bo omo hai wngo.
Ang boss thani salary barainani kok bahai sanai?
Nwng puila nini kaham kamrokni kaisa list sadi. Ulo, boss ni kaham mon tongma jorao, suri suri meeting ni bagwi swngdi. Nini kam no phunukwi, nini salary barainani kokno borom bai sadi.
Ang kaisa job interview o reject wngkha. Mon belai hamya wngkha.
Mon hamya wngmung normal. Wansukdi ke o samung nini bagwi ya tongmani. O interview ni simi tamo swrwngjakha, abono wansukdi tei tei kubuni interview ni bagwi prepare wngdi.
Angni English accent kaham ya, borok mwnwio.
Accent jeba wngphano, nwng kubui kok sa-o da, abo se joton. Nwng English movie naiwi tei bohrok hai sana naidi mano. Practice khwlaimung bai joton ham wngo.
Ang khoroksa hamya colleague bai bahai samung tangnai?
Nwng bini logi sirif samungni kok se sadi, personal kok sana nangya. Jephruphano professional tongna naidi. Bo hamya khwlai khe, bono ignore khwlaidi.
'Burnout' hwnmale tamo? Angno abo wngkha da?
Burnout wngkha kwbangma samungni stress ni bagwi mang tei mon ni belai lengmung. Jephruphano samungo mon tongya, kirijak wansukmung, tei lengjak wansukmung burnout ni lakshan wngkha.
Time management ni bagwi kaisa kaham technique sa di.

Nwng 'Eisenhower Matrix' use khwlaiwi mano. Nini kamrokno 4 ta bhag khwlaidi: 1. Important & Urgent, 2. Important & Not Urgent, 3. Not Important & Urgent, 4. Not Important & Not Urgent. Puila bhag no swkang khwlaidi.
Ang samungni bisingo tei bo porina mwkhago, bahai manage khwlainai?
Nwng weekend o eba salbrumno 1-2 ghanta porinani bagwi time yakardi. Online course rok nini bagwi belai kaham wngnai, tamni hwnmale nwng nini hisap o porina mannai.
Angni team ni borokrok samung kaham khe khwlaiya, ang tamo khwlainai?
Nwng team leader wngkhe, joto no chubadi. Joto ni kamno suri suri bakwi ridi. Team meeting o joto ni wansukmungno khwnadi.
Ang kaisa kwtal business chengna mwkhago, phiya rang kwrwi.
Nwng kom rang bai chengna mano hai business wansukdi. Jemon, online tutoring, eba social media marketing. Government ni bo kwbangma scheme tongo, jeba o nwng loan ni bagwi apply khwlaiwi mano.
Angni LinkedIn profile no bahai kaham khwlainai?
Nini kaisa professional photo hapsidi. Nini joton skill tei experience no suri suri swidi. Nini field ni borok bai connection baridi.
Unakoti no beraina thangna bagwi joto ni swlai kaham jora buphru?
Unakoti no beraina thangna bagwi October ni simi April tal jora joto ni swlai kaham. A jorao uatwi phaiya tei मौसम belai kaham wngo. Ashokastami mela jorao bo belai borok wngo.
Tripura ni kami amchai o beraina thangma jorao tamo niyam manina nango?
Kami ni borokrok bai borom bai kok sadi. Bohrokni photo khuknani swkang permission nadi. Hamya ri-chum chumwi beraiyadi ta.
Ang 3 sal ni bagwi berainai. Bahai kom samung tubuinai?
Jeba ri no nwng nwi rokom bai chumwi mannai, aborokno ladi. Chuchu botol o shampoo, toothpaste ladi. Hotel o towel tongo da, swkang ni simi saimandi.
Baramura Eco Park tamoni bagwi mungsajak?
Baramura Eco Park bini hachuk ni naithokmung, kwkhrang bolong, tei siring siring environment ni bagwi mungsajak. Abo picnic tei nature no hamjaknai ni bagwi belai kaham jaga.
Tripura ni kami amchai o beraina bagwi Auto-rickshaw mano da?
Koro ni kami amchai o auto-rickshaw mano, phiya belai bising jaga o kom mano. O jaga rok o shared jeep eba bus se kwbangma cholo.
Ang kaisa Haiku koklop swina mwkhago. Niyam tamo?
Haiku wngkha Japan ni koklop. Bini bisingo khoroktham line tongo. Puila line o 5 syllable, nwichi line o 7 syllable, tei khoroktham line o 5 syllable wngna nango.
Ang guitar swrwngna chengkha. Kon rwchapmung bai chengna easy?
Nwng belai easy chord tongnai rwchapmung, jemon 'Happy Birthday' eba tei kubuni nursery rhyme bai chengna mano. Jwng jwng khe kosto rwchapmung swrwngdi.
Angni pot o mircha buphang phunukka, bahai jotono nanai?
Mircha buphangno sal kaham tongnai jaga o romdi. Ha no kwran wngna riyadi ta, jephruphano kisa kisi romdi. Jora jora o kisa fertilizer ridi.
'Upcycling' tei 'Recycling' ni bisingo pharak tamo?

'Recycling' o kwcham samungno phatbarwi, bini material no use khwlaiwi kwtal samung sano. 'Upcycling' o kwcham samungno phatbarya se, abono tei bo kaham eba naithok samungo swlaio, jemon plastic botol bai bubar pot sano.
Borokni mukhang akina bagwi puila tamo naina nango?
Puila, mukhang ni basic shape (oval, round) no dhyan ri di. Ulo, mokol, bukung, tei khuk ni jaga boro boro, aboni map no suri suri naidi.
Angno kaisa kaham documentary ni mung sa, jeba angno wansuk rwnai.
Nwng 'My Octopus Teacher' no naina mano. Abo khoroksa borok tei kaisa octopus ni logi wngmung ni naithok kahani. Nature ni bagwi hamjakmung barinai.
Ang kaisa podcast chengna mwkhago, phiya tamo topic ni sakao sanai, saimanya.
Nwng nini salbrumni experience, nini hamjakjak book eba movie, eba Tripura ni kwcham kothomarokni sakao podcast khwlaiwi mano.
Ang kaisa sal ni bagwi joto social media ni simi hakchalo tongna mwkhago. Lab tongo da?
Au, belai lab tongo. Abo nwngno mon no santi rinai, kubui hayung bai tei bo jora wngna chubainai, tei nini concentration no bo barinai.
Angni nok o belai kwcham kagoj-potro tongo. Tamo khwlainai?
Jeba important, aborokno scan khwlaiwi digital copy sanwi romna mano. Baki rokno recycle khwlainani bagwi rina mano.
'Ikigai' hwnwi kaisa Japanese kok tongo. Abo ni অর্থ tamo?
'Ikigai' hwnmale 'bachanani kaisa karan' eba 'phungo bachanani khusi'. Abo nini hamjakmung, nini talent, tei hayungni nanganimungni milimung jaga se.
'Wabi-Sabi' hwnmale tamo bujio?
'Wabi-Sabi' wngkha kaisa Japanese wansukmung, jeba hamya eba joton wngya samungni bisingo naithokmung saina. Abo pogjak samung eba kwcham wngmungni naithokmungno borom rio.
Ang khoroksano 'Ihi' (No) sana belai kosto mano. Tamo khwlainai?
'Ihi' sana swrwngmung belai nango. Nwng suri suri tei borom bai sana mano, 'Angno nakardi, o jorao ang omo khwlai manya'. Nini time tei energy no borom ridi.
Ang jephruphano hamya wansukgo. Bahai positive wngnai?
Salbrumno joton wngnani swkang, o salo wngnai khoroktham kaham samungno wansukdi eba swidi. Chuchu kaham samungno bo borom ridi.
Ang belai overthinking khwlaio, mon santi kwrwi.
Jephruphano overthinking wngo, nini mon no tei kubuni kam o hapsidi. Jemon, himna thangdi, rwchapmung khwnadi, eba logi bai kok sadi. Writing bo chubai-o.
Angni logi khoroksa belai kosto o tongo, angno tamo sanai, saimanya.
Kwbangma jorao, mungsa sana nangya. Sirif bini logi achukwi tongdi. 'Ang nini logi tongo' - o kok se belai gwranmung rio.
Ang khoroksani hamya habit no swlaina mwkhago. Bahai sanai?
Nwng saichung jaga o, 'ang' bai kok chengwi sadi. Jemon, 'Nwng omo khwlaikhe, angno omo hai nugo'. Hamya kok sayadi ta.
Angni joto ni swlai kotor weakness tamo, ang saimanya.
Nini joto ni swlai trust khwlaijak logi no swngdi. Bo nwngno kubui khe sana mano. Sakni weakness no sinimung se উন্নতি ni puila yapri.
Angni life o kaisa goal kwrwi hwnwi nugo.
Chuchu goal bai chengdi. O haptao kaisa kwtal mui sano swrwngnai eba kaisa bijap porinai. Chuchu jotonmungrok kotor goal thani tubui thango.
Langma ni joto ni swlai kotor truth tamo?
Kaisa kotor truth wngkha: 'Omo bo thangnai'. Hamya jora bo jephruphano tongya, tei kaham jora bo jephruphano tongya. Aboni bagwi, tabukni jorano borom ridi.
Leaking tap no nogo bahai ham khwlai mano?
Puila main water supply bondho khwlaidi. Ulo, wrench bai tap ni handle no khulwi, bisingni washer no check khwlaidi. Kwbangma jorao o washer kwcham wngmani bagwi se twi ongo.
Angni kitchen belai chuchu. Samungrokno bahai sajidi khe jaga barinai?
Nwng wall o hook kaiwi pan, cup rokno kaiwi romna mano. Cabinet ni bisingo bo extra shelf kaiwi jaga baraiwi mano.
Angni nok ni koro kaisa swih bwsano mankha. Tamo khwlainai?
Puila, naidi bini ama koro o tongo da. Kwbangma jorao ama phinwi phai-o. Koro o kwrwi wngkhe, nwng bono bwtwi tei twi rina mano tei animal shelter o phone khwlaidi.
Angni kamchwlwi kuphur o cha ni dag lagikha. Tamo khwlainai?
Dag lagijak jaga o kodo khe baking soda tei twi ni paste lagaiwi romdi. Ulo, normal khe supdi. Kisa vinegar bai supkhe bo dag thango.
Thumung kaham wngnani bagwi kaisa ajgubi tip ri di.
Thunani swkang, nini yakungno kisa kwtung twi o dubadi. Abo nini mangni temperature no kom khwlaio tei thumung phainani chubai-o.
'Aurora Borealis' (Northern Lights) tamoni bagwi wngo?
Abo wngo, jephru Sal ni simi phainai charged particle rok chini hayungni magnetic field bai jora wngo tei nobar ni gas bai jhogra wngo. O jhogra ni bagwi se naithok chwngmung nugo.
Hayung bisingo joto ni swlai kodo malmata tamo?
Ha ni sakao, Cheetah wngkha joto ni swlai kodo, jeba 120 km/hr ni swlai bara himguro. Nobaro, Peregrine Falcon wngkha joto ni swlai kodo, jeba 300 km/hr ni swlai bara himguro.
'Supernova' hwnmale tamo wngo?
Supernova wngkha kaisa kotor athukirini pogsani belai kotor tei chwngjak phatmung. O jorao, o athukiri kaisa galaxy ni swlai bo bara chwngo.
Thabilrok (bees) kwchang mol jorao tamo khwlaio?
Kwchang mol jorao, thabilrok bohrokni lap (hive) ni bisingo joma wngwi tongo. Bohrok sakno sak kwtung romnani bagwi logi logi kapo tei joma khwlaijak kwtwi chahwi bacho.
Twima ni twi tamoni bagwi sohm-jak?
Twima ni twi sohm-jak tamni hwnmale bini bisingo kwbangma mineral, phiya sodium chloride (sohm), joma wngwi tongo. O sohmrok hapung tei ha ni simi twisa bai phai-o.
Angno kaisa kwcham jorani Kokborok kothoma sa di.

Kothoma tongo ke, puila jorao hayung tei nokha belai koro tongmani. Khoroksa bwrwi mai rugma jorao bini rugthai nokha o laginani bagwi, nokha kirijagwi sakao thang kha. O jorani simi se nokha hakchalo.
'Hojagiri' mungni bisingo tamo kothoma tongo?
'Hojagiri' mungni kothoma juda juda tongo. Kaisa mot hisap o, 'Hoja' wngkha hasam ni devi (Laxmi) tei 'Giri' wngkha bono mwnwimung. Hasam kaham wngnani bagwi o mwsamung khwlaijak-o.
'Garia' mwsamungo kon kon musical instrument use wngo?
Garia mwsamungo joto ni swlai nango Kham (drum), Sumui (flute), tei tei kubuni, jemon Sarinda eba Chongpreng bo use wngo.
Maharaja Krishna Kishore Manikya tamoni bagwi mungsajak?
Maharaja Krishna Kishore Manikya (1830-1849) bini jorao Agartala no kwtal khe sanani chengmani bagwi mungsajak. Bo puila Agartala thani capital no swlaimani.
'Buisu' festival ni joto ni swlai kotor chahmung tamo?
'Buisu' festival jorao kwbangma rokom ni mui sano, phiya 'Chuwak' (rice beer) tei 'Awang Bangwi' (kwtwi mai, lairu bwlai o sakjak) belai important wngkha.
'Langthari' hwnwi kaisa jaga ni kok khwnakha. Abo tamo?
'Langthari' wngkha Dhalai jila o tongnai kaisa jaga, jeba o kotor kotor hapungrok (megaliths) tongo. O hapungrok kwcham jorani borokrokni sakjak hwnwi wansukjak-o.
Tripura ni kon Maharaja 'Bengal ni Nawab' bai jhogra khwlaikhamani?
Maharaja Krishna Manikya 18th century o Bengal ni Nawab ni against o gwran khe jhogra khwlaikhamani tei Tripura ni swadhinata no bachikhamani.
Angno kaisa Kokborok tong-thai ni naithok mung sa di.
Kaisa naithok tong-thai ni mung wngkha 'Mairang' (dish/plate), jeba mai chahmungni samungno bujio tei khnaui bo kaham.
'Ker' puja tamoni bagwi aswk gwran niyam bai palon khwlaio?
'Ker' puja wngkha haste ni joto borokno hamya-marok tei apad-bipad ni simi bachinani bagwi khwlaijak kaisa kotor puja. Aboni bagwi se o puja jorao belai gwran niyam-kanun manijak-o.
Ang Tripura ni kwcham coinrokni sakao saimana mwkhago. Boro thangnai?
Nwng Agartala ni Tripura State Museum o thangna mano. Aro Tripura ni Manikya dynasty ni kwcham jorani tei tei kubuni kwbangma naithok coinrok naina mannai.
Ang kaisa second-hand bike paina mwkhago. Tamo tamo check khwlainai?

Second-hand bike painani swkang, engine ni sound khwnadi, jeba jaga ni simi thok ongo da naidi, tei bike ni paperrok (RC, Insurance) kubui tongo da, abo kaham khe check khwlaidi. Kaisa test ride naina belai nango.
Angni credit card kwmakha. Kodo khe tamo khwlainai?
Nwng kodo khe nini bank ni customer care o phone khwlaiwi card no block khwlaidi. Abo joto ni swlai puila tei important kam wngkha.
'Metaverse' hwnmale tamo? Ang bujiya.
Metaverse wngkha internet ni kaisa kwtal wansukmung, jeba o borokrok virtual reality (VR) headset bai kaisa kwtal digital hayung o hapwi, khelewi, tei samung tangwi mannai.
Angni mobile o 'Insufficient Storage' phunugo, phiya angni joton delete khwlaikha.
Nwng nini phone ni 'File Manager' o thangwi, WhatsApp ni 'Database' folder no delete khwlaiwi naidi. Kaisa-kaisa jorao aro kwbangma jaga nago.
Angni email inbox o jephruphano spam mail phai-o. Tamo khwlainai?
Jeba spam mail phai-o, aborokno khulya se 'Mark as Spam' khwlaidi. Jwng jwng khe nini email service aborokno sini mannai tei spam folder o hapsinai.
Angni mang o energy belai kom wansukgo. Tamo vitamin kom wngwi mano?
Abo Vitamin B12 eba Iron kom wngmani lakshan wngwi mano. Phiya kubui khe saimana bagwi, kaisa blood test khwlaimung tei doctor bai malaimung se joto ni swlai kaham.
Public speaking ni bhoy no kom khwlainani bagwi kaisa tip sa di.
Kok sanani swkang, bwkha kolok khugo. Audience o tongnai joto no naiyawi, khoroksa nwi borok jeba nwngno mwnwiwi naiwi tongo, bohrokno naiwi kok sadi. Abo nwngno confident feel khwlainai.
'Emotional Intelligence' hwnmale tamo bujio?
Emotional Intelligence hwnmale sakni tei kubuini emotion (mon ni bhab) no bujimung, control khwlaimung, tei abono use khwlaiwi wansukmung tei bebohar kaham khwlaimung.
Ang jephruphano tei kubuini kosto no wansukwi kosto mano. Tamo khwlainai?
Abo 'empathy' wngkha, jeba kaisa kaham guna. Phiya sakno bo bachina nango. Wansukdi ke nwng kubuino chubai mano, phiya bohrokni joton kosto no nwng lanai manya.
Angni chwrai bwsa jeba chahmung chahya. Tamo khwlainai?
Chahmungno kaisa khele hai sanwi ridi. Bolongrokno juda juda aakar o khaui ridi. Bono kitchen o chuchu kam o chubamung lanai, jemon bolong supna. Jwng jwng khe bini interest barinai.
Ang kaisa kwtal job o chengna kirio. Hamya wngkhe tamo wngnai?
Kwtal samung chengna joto no kisa kiri nugo. Wansukdi ke omo kaisa swrwngnani sujog. Bul wngnai, phiya o bul ni simi se nwng swrwngwi tei bo kaham wngnai.
Career o 'growth' ni bagwi joto ni swlai nanganimung tamo?
Career o growth ni bagwi joto ni swlai nango - jephruphano swrwngnani icha. Technology swlaio, niyam swlaio. Jeba sakno update khwlaiwi tongo, bo se swkang himo.
Angni samung o creativity kwrwi, angno boring nugo.
Nwng nini kwcham kamno kaisa kwtal lama bai khwlainani naidi mano da? Nini samung joton wngnani ulo, kaisa creative hobby chengdi. Abo nini mon no fresh khwlainai.
Ang office o joto ni kamno angno rio, 'ihi' sana manya.
'Ihi' sana swrwngdi. Nwng suri suri sadi, 'Ang tabuk tei kaisa important kam o busy tongo, omo joton wngnani ulo ang naidi nai'. Nini time no borom rina swrwngdi.
Kaisa team no lead khwlainani joto ni swlai kotor challenge tamo?
Joto ni swlai kotor challenge wngkha team ni juda juda borokno bujimung tei bohrokno kaisa goal ni bagwi logi logi him rina. Joto no motivate khwlaiwi rommung bo kosto.
Tripura ni Gomati twima boro ni simi ongwi boro jora kwlaio?
Gomati twima Dumboor twithu ni simi ongwi, Udaipur, Sonamura ni bisingtwi himwi Bangladesh o hapwi thango tei Meghna twima bai milio.
Ang kaisa weekend trip plan khwlaiwi tongo. Tepania Park o tamo tamo tongo?
Tepania Park, Udaipur ni koro, bini naithok bagan, hanging bridge, tei Orchidarium ni bagwi mungsajak. Aro borok picnic chahna belai hamjakgo.
Ang Agartala ni street food chahna mwkhago. Tamo chahna kaham?
Nwng Golbazar eba Fire Brigade Chowmuhani o luchi-aludam, chicken pakora, tei egg roll chahna mano. Aroni fuchka bo belai mungsajak.
Tripura o kon kon jaga o handloom industry kotor?
Tripura ni West Tripura jila ni Khowai tei Teliamura amchaini kwbangma kami o handloom industry belai kotor. Aroni ri-chum hayung bisingo mungsajak.
Travel jorao hotel o tongya se tei tamo option tongo?
Nwng Zostel eba tei kubuni hostel o tongna mano. Eba, 'Couchsurfing' hai app bai local borokni nok o free o tongnani sujog bo mano, phiya abo suri suri khwlaina nango.
Angni pot ni buphang kwranwi tongo. Twi to kaham khe rio.
Wngwi mano ke nwng twi bara riwi tongo, jeba bai buphangni yarwng poso. Ha no yasi bai romwi naidi. Kisi wngkhe, kisa sal twi riyadi ta.
'Guerilla gardening' hwnmale tamo?
Guerilla gardening wngkha, jeba jaga hamya wngwi tongo, jemon lama koro, o jaga o borokrok lukuiwi bubar eba bolongni buphang phunukmung. Abo şehirno naithok khwlainani kaisa lama.
Angno kaisa kothoma ni character ni mung sa, jeba belai Kokborok khnau.
Kaisa naithok mung wngnai 'Hachuksa'. Abo 'hachuk' tei 'sa' (offspring) ni milimung, jeba ni অর্থ wngkha 'Child of the Hills'.
Ang kaisa mui sandi, jeba o mai tei tok bwtwi nango.
Nwng 'Egg Fried Rice' sano mano. Puila mai no rukwi romdi. Ulo, pan o thok hapsiwi tok bwtwi, chuchu bolong (carrot, beans) hapsiwi, pogsao mai tei soy sauce bai milai di.
Angno kaisa kaham Kokborok rwchapmung ni line sa.
Kaisa naithok line wngkha, 'Nini mokol ni bisingo, ang ani nokha no nugo'. Abo belai romantic wansukmungno phunugo.
Angni logi kaisa surprise plan khwlaiwi tongo, bono bahai distract khwlainai?
Nwng nini tei kubuni logi no sadi ke bono kaisa juda kam o busy romna. Jemon, 'Chwng movie naina thangnai' hwnwi bono juda jaga o tubui thangna mano.
Joton samung jora o khwlaiya khe tamo wngo?
Jora o khwlaiya khe, chuchu samung kotor wngwi thango. Stress bario, tei pogsao o samungno khwlainani mon tongya wngo. Abo 'procrastination' hwn-o.
Angni chwrai jorani kaisa kaham wansukmung bai angno mwnwi rwk di.
Wansukdi o jorano, jephru uatwi phaima jorao kagoj ni boat sanwi twi o yakarmung se joto ni swlai kotor tongthokmung tongmani.
Angni life kaisa bijap wngkhe, omo kon chapter cholo?
Omo wngwi mano 'The Chapter of New Beginnings' eba 'The Chapter of Facing Challenges'. Nwng se o chapter ni mung no nini kam bai swinai.
Joto ni swlai kotor risk tamo, langma o?
Langma o joto ni swlai kotor risk wngkha - jeba risk nayawi tongmung. Risk nayawi tongkhe, nwng jephruphano swrwngnai ya tei kotor wngnai ya.
Ang khoroksano bahai buji rinai ke ang kirijak?
Nwng suri suri sadi, 'Ang nini kokno bujio, phiya angno o samungo kisa kosto nugo'. Nini feeling no phunukna lajidi ta.
Angni nok o kwcham cassette tongo. Aborokni rwchapmung bahai khwnanai?
Nwng kaisa 'Cassette to MP3 converter' hwnwi chuchu machine paina mano. Abo cassette no play khwlaiwi, rwchapmungno nini computer o digital file sanwi rio.
Angni nok ni janal ni khorok kwcham wngkha, khorang belai wngo. Tamo khwlainai?
Nwng khorok ni hinge o kisa machine ni thok eba narikol thok hapsi rina mano. Abo khorangno bondho khwlainai.
Angni churi ni dhar kwmakha. Nogo bahai dhar khwlainai?
Nwng kaisa ceramic cup eba mairang no ulta khwlaidi. Bini sakani kwrak jaga o churi no kaisa thani 20-25 degree angle o suri suri so-di.
Angni mokol ni sakao komok wngkha, thumung kom wngmani bagwi. Tamo khwlainai?
Nwng kwchang cha ni bag eba cucumber ni slice no mokol o 10-15 minute romna mano. Abo komokno kom khwlainani chubai-o.
Ang coffee nwngmung yakarna mwkhago. Tamo nwngnai bini बदला o?
Nwng Green Tea nwngna mano. Bini bisingo bo kisa caffeine tongo, phiya coffee ni swlai kaham. Abo mon no bo fresh khwlaio.
'Lucid Dreaming' hwnmale tamo? Abo kubui wngo da?
Lucid Dreaming wngkha, imang nugma jorao, nwng imang nugo hwnwi saimana tei kisa kisa imangno control khwlaimung. Au, kwbangma borok omo hai experience khwlaio.
Hayung bisingo joto ni swlai kuthuk jaga boro?
Joto ni swlai kuthuk jaga wngkha Pacific Ocean ni bisingo tongnai 'Mariana Trench'. Abo Mount Everest ni kuchukmung ni swlai bo kuthuk.
Spiderrok tamoni bagwi sakni bengno sak chahya?
Tamni hwnmale spiderrokni yakung o kisa chuchu thok tongo, jeba bohrokno beng o kasomung ni simi bachio. Bohrok saimango kon sutao kasomung tongo tei kon o kwrwi.
'ASMR' hwnmale tamo? Borok tamoni abono hamjakgo?

ASMR (Autonomous Sensory Meridian Response) wngkha kisa kisa khorang (jemon suri suri kok samung, tap khwlaimung) khnaui bokhorok o eba phikung o kaisa aram ni feeling wngmung. Abo borokno relax wngna chubai-o.
Angno kaisa ajgubi hasam ni kok sa di.
Japan o 'square watermelon' (kiting thairuk) hasam khwlaio. Bohrok thairuk chuchu tongma jorao abono kaisa square glass box ni bisingo romo, tei thairuk o box ni aakar o se kotor wngo.
Tripura ni Ujjal Abhoy Halam tamoni bagwi mungsajak?
Ujjal Abhoy Halam Tripura ni khoroksa mungsajak cartoonist. Bini cartoonrok somaj ni samasya rokno mwnwimung bai phunugo. Bo haste ni bagwi kaisa borom.
Ang kaisa blog post swina mwkhago, 'Tripura ni lukui tongnai naithokmung' ni sakao.
Nwng o blog o Jampui hachuk, Chabimura, tei Unakoti ni kokno karwi, tei bo kom sini-jak jaga jemon Langthari eba Tirthamukh ni kokno swina mano. O jaga rokni naithokmung belai juda.
'Kokborok Day' buphru palon khwlaio tei tamoni?
'Kokborok Day' (Kokborok Sal) প্রতি bisi January 19 o palon khwlaio. O salo 1979 bisio Kokborok no Tripura ni official kok hisap o sini rijakkha. Abono wansukwi se o sal palon wngo.
Tripura ni kon jaga o 'Bamboo cookies' sano?
Tripura ni kwbangma kami amchai o, phiya West Tripura ni kisa amchai o borokrok wa ni kwtal twng (bamboo shoot) no use khwlaiwi kaisa rokom ni kwran tei sohm-jak 'cookies' eba pitha sano.
Angno kaisa Kokborok pro-verb (Rwngmung Kok) sa di.
Kaisa mungsajak rwngmung kok wngkha: 'Uatwi kwcharni twisa mal-o bara kwlaio'. Bini अर्थ wngkha, jeba ni aklangmung kom, bo se sakno sak kotor phunugna naio.
Ang kaisa kwtal business idea no wansukgo. Angni idea no sabo khuna kirio.
Nwng nini idea no 'Non-Disclosure Agreement' (NDA) sign khwlai rina ni ulo se tei kubuino sadi. Abo nini idea no legal khe bachinai.
Angni computer o joton file 'ransomware' bai encrypt wngkha. Tamo khwlainai?
Jeba rang swngo, abono riyadi ta. Nwng kodo khe internet disconnect khwlaidi tei khoroksa cyber security expert ni chubamung ladi. Police o bo report khwlaidi.
Angni chwrai bwsa jephruphano mobile o game khele-o. Tamo khwlainai?
Salbrumni bagwi kaisa time limit fix khwlaidi. Bini logi nwng bo tei kubuni kam, jemon drawing eba bahira o khelemung, o jora wngdi. Bono mobile ni swlai tei kubuni tongthokmung saina chubadi.
Kaisa kaham leader tei kaisa boss ni bisingo pharak tamo?
Kaisa boss sao, 'Thangdi'. Kaisa kaham leader sao, 'Chwng thanglaiya'. Leader sak bo team bai logi himo, tei joto no inspire khwlaio.
Angni logi khoroksa belai tatal sao. Ang bono bahai deal khwlainai?
Bini kokno 100% विश्वास khwlaiyadi ta. Jephruphano bini kokno tei kubuni jaga ni simi check khwlaidi. Bini thani personal kok share khwlaiyadi ta.
Ang khoroksano forgive khwlaina manya, phiya pogna bo mwkhago.
Forgive khwlaimung kaisa process, kaisa salo wngya. Puila, o kosto no nwng wansukna ridi. Jwng jwng khe, o kosto ni gwranmung kom wngwi thangnai. Sakno sak time ridi.
Angni langma o jeba passion kwrwi hwnwi wansukgo. Ang tamo khwlainai?
Passion saina nangya, abono sanani nango. Nwng kwtal kwtal samungrokno try khwlaiwi naidi. Kaisa jorao, nwng mungsa na mungsa samung malainai, jeba nwngno belai tongthok rinai.
Angni nukhung angno belai pressure rio. Bahai manage khwlainai?
Nwng suri suri bohrokno sadi ke bohrokni pressure nwngno bahai feel khwlaio. Nini sakni bagwi sima sadi. Kisa jora sakni bagwi bo yakardi.
'Gaslighting' hwnmale tamo?
Gaslighting wngkha khoroksano aswk tatal samung khwlai-mung eba samung, jemon bo sakno sakni wansukmung tei memory o doubt khwlaina cheng-o. Abo kaisa emotional abuse.
Angni logi kaisa toxic relationship o tongo. Ang bono bahai chubainai?
Nwng bono judge khwlaiya se bini kokno khwnadi. Bono sadi ke bo tei bo kaham deserve khwlaio. Bono expert ni chubamung lana bagwi encourage khwlaidi. Phiya pogsani decision bini se wngnai.
Angno kaisa ajgubi buphangni kok sa di.
'Dragon's Blood Tree', Socotra hwnwi island o tongo, jeba no khakhe kwchak color ni kwtwi ongo. Abo দেখতে kaisa ulta umbrella hai nugo.
Chini mangni DNA o bwswk information tongo?
Chini mangni kaisa cell ni DNA o 3 gigabytes ni information tongo hwnwi wansukjak-o. Abo kaisa kotor encyclopedia ni 1000 bijap ni soman.
Ang kaisa 'time capsule' sanani wansukgo. Bisingo tamo romnai?
Nwng bisingo tini ni newspaper, kaisa letter (phainai salni borokni bagwi), tabukni coinrok, tei nini kaisa photo romna mano. Abo belai interesting wngnai.
Kaisa borok thwinani ulo bini mangni hilik kom wngo da?
Ihi, abo kubui ya. Abo kaisa kwcham wansukmung se. Mangni hilik kaisa se tongo.
Angno kaisa scientific mystery ni kok sa, jeba tabuk jora jora bo solve wngyakhu.
Chini hayung bisingni 95% 'dark matter' tei 'dark energy' bai sakjak, phiya scientistrok tabuk jora jora saimanya ke o samungrok kubui khe tamo.
Tripura ni Boxanagar o tamo archaeological samung manjakha?
Boxanagar, Sepahijala jilao, kwcham jorani kaisa Buddhist monastery ni ruins manjakha. Abo phunugo ke kwcham jorao Tripura o Buddhism belai kaham khe tongmani.
Angno kaisa Kokborok kothoma ni naithok character ni mung sa di.
Kaisa naithok character ni mung wngnai 'Twisa', jeba ni अर्थ wngkha 'chuchu twima'. Abo gwranmung tei jephruphano himmung no phunugo.
'Owa' no Kokborok o tamo hwn-o?
'Owa' (bamboo shoot ni kwkhwi tei kwran khwlaijak mui) no Kokborok o 'Muiya Awan' eba kisa borok 'Owa' hwnwi bo sao.
Tripura ni kon Maharaja British bai puila treaty sign khwlaikhamani?
Maharaja Krishna Manikya 1761 bisio British East India Company bai kaisa treaty sign khwlaikhamani, jeba puila formal relationship chengmani.
Angni langmao kaisa kotor bul wngkha. Ang sakno nakarwi rina manya.
Wansukdi ke joto borok bul khwlaio. Nwng borok, Kaitor ya. O bul ni simi swrwngdi tei teisa omo hai khwlaiya hwnwi wansukdi. Sakno nakarwi rina se swkang himnani lama.
Angni joto ni swlai kotor bhoy wngkha 'regret' (pogsao kosto manmung).
Aboni simi bachanani lama wngkha - nini bwkhani kokno khwnadi. Jeba samung nwngno kubui khe tongthok rio, abono khwlaidi. Tei kubuini wansukmungno wansukya se.
Angno kaisa kothoma ni pogsani line sa di.
Kaham. Pogsani line: '... tei o jorani simi, bo jephruphano nokha thani naikhlaiyakhu, tamni hwnmale bo saimango ke o tal nwi bini bagwi se chwngwi tongo.'
Nwngni logi kok samung, kaisa kwcham logi bai malaimung hai nugo.
Hambai. O kokno khnaui ang belai khusi wngkha. Ang asha khwlaio ke o logi wngmung tei bo gwran wngwi thangnai.
Angni joto swngmungni kiphilmung rikha. Tini ni bagwi hambai.
Belai belai lamsogo. Nini swngmungrok angno bo kwbangma wansuk rio. Jephru mon wngo, teisa malaiyanw. Kaham khe tongdi!
India ni itihas o 'Golden Age' hwnwi kon jorano sa-o?
India ni itihas o Gupta Empire ni शासन jorano 'Golden Age' eba 'Sona ni Jora' hwnwi sa-o, tamni hwnmale o jorao art, science, tei kokrwbai belai উন্নতি wngkhamani.
Indus Valley Civilization ni nwi kotor şehirni mung sa di.
Indus Valley Civilization ni nwi kotor tei mungsajak şehir wngkha Harappa tei Mohenjo-Daro. O şehirrokni town planning belai swkangjak tongmani.
Ashoka, Kalinga jhogra ni ulo tamoni bagwi Buddhism o swlaikha?
Kalinga jhograo belai kwbangma borok thwinani tei kosto manani nukwi, Samrat Ashoka ni bwkha belai kosto wngkha. Aboni ulo se bo jhogra ni lama yakarwi, santi ni lama, Buddhism no lachikha.
'Veda' bwswk rokom tongo tei aborok tamo?
Veda khorokbrwi tongo. Aborok wngkha: Rigveda, Samaveda, Yajurveda, tei Atharvaveda. Aborok Hindu धर्म ni joto ni swlai kwcham tei pavitra bijap.
Chanakya sabo tongmani tei bo tamoni bagwi mungsajak?

Chanakya, Kautilya hwnwi bo sino, khoroksa aklangmung tongnai teacher, philosopher, tei rajniti ni expert tongmani. Bo Chandragupta Maurya no Samrat wngna chubakhamani tei 'Arthashastra' hwnwi bijap swikhamani.
Mughal Empire no India o sabo chengmani?
Mughal Empire no India o Babur 1526 bisio chengmani. Bo Panipat ni puila jhograo Ibrahim Lodi no phitaiwi Delhi no romkhamani.
Akbar no tamoni bagwi kaisa kaham Samrat hwnwi sa-o?
Samrat Akbar no kaham hwn-o tamni hwnmale bo joto धर्म no borom riomung, bini kaham शासन niyam, tei art-culture no chubamung ni bagwi. Bo 'Din-i-Ilahi' hwnwi kaisa kwtal wansukmung bo chengkhamani.
Taj Mahal sano bwswk bisi nangkhamani?
Taj Mahal no sano 20 bisi ni swlai bara nangkhamani hwnwi khwnao, 1632 bisio chengwi 1653 bisio joton wngkhamani. Hajra hajra karigar o samungo jora tongmani.
Shivaji Maharaj sabo tongmani?
Shivaji Maharaj 17th century ni khoroksa gwran Maratha Raja tongmani. Bo Mughal शासन ni against o gwran khe jhogra khwlaiwi, Maratha Samrajya ni chengmung khwlaikhamani.
British East India Company puila tamo bagwi India o phaikhamani?
British East India Company puila 17th century o India o mosla, ri-chum, tei tei kubuni samungni bagwi bepar khwlainani bagwi se phaikhamani. Ulo jwng jwng khe bohrok haste no शासन khwlaina chengkha.
1857 bisini jhograno tamo hwn-o?
1857 bisini jhograno 'Sepoy Mutiny' eba 'India ni Puila Swadhinata Jhogra' hwnwi sa-o. O jhogra British शासन ni against o kaisa kotor jhogra tongmani.
Rani Lakshmibai no tamoni bagwi wansukjak-o?
Jhansi ni Rani Lakshmibai no bini gwranmung tei sahosh ni bagwi wansukjak-o. Bo 1857 bisini jhograo British ni against o bini haste no bachinani bagwi belai gwran khe jhogra khwlaikhamani.
Indian National Congress buphru tei tamoni bagwi sakjakhamani?
Indian National Congress no 1885 bisio sakjakhamani. Puila jorao, bini kam tongmani borokni samasya rokno British government thani tisamung, phiya ulo bo swadhinata jhogra ni main party wngkha.
Jallianwala Bagh o tamo wngkhamani?
1919 bisio, Amritsar ni Jallianwala Bagh o, British General Dyer ni order bai, santi bai jora wngnai kwbangma borokrokni sakao guli khukjakha. O घटना o hajra hajra borok thwikha.
Mahatma Gandhi ni 'Dandi March' tamo tongmani?

1930 bisio, British ni sohm ni sakao tax rinani niyam ni against o, Mahatma Gandhi bini logisong bai Sabarmati Ashram ni simi Dandi twima koro jora himkhamani tei sohm sakhamani. Abo 'Salt March' hwnwi bo sino.
Subhas Chandra Bose no tamoni bagwi 'Netaji' hwn-o?
Subhas Chandra Bose no 'Netaji' (mungsajak Leader) hwn-o tamni hwnmale bo khoroksa belai gwran tei inspiring leader tongmani. Bo 'Azad Hind Fauj' sanwi India no swadhin khwlainani naimani.
India buphru swadhin wngkha?
India 1947 bisini August talni 15 tariko British शासन ni simi swadhin wngkha.
India ni partition hwnmale tamo?
India ni swadhin wngmung bai logi logi, haste no nwi bhag khwlaijakha - India tei Pakistan. O घटना no se India ni partition hwn-o. O jorao belai kwbangma jhogra tei kosto wngkhamani.
India ni Constitution no sabo swikhamani?
India ni Constitution no kaisa 'Constituent Assembly' swikhamani, jeba ni Chairman tongmani Dr. B.R. Ambedkar. Aboni bagwi se bono 'Father of the Indian Constitution' hwn-o.
Jawaharlal Nehru sabo tongmani?
Jawaharlal Nehru swadhin India ni puila Prime Minister tongmani. Bo India no kaisa modern tei democratic haste sanani belai kotor kam khwlaikhamani.
Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel ni joto ni swlai kotor kam tamo?
Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel ni joto ni swlai kotor kam wngkha India ni swadhin wngnani ulo, 500 ni swlai bara chuchu chuchu haste (princely states) rokno India bai jora khwlaimung.
'Green Revolution' India o tamo swlaimung tubukha?
1960s o 'Green Revolution' ni bisingtwi, India o kwtal hasam ni niyam tei kaham bichi use khwlaiwi, mai-mui ni उत्पादन belai baraijakha. Abo haste no chahmung o sakbaithang gwran wngna chubakha.
Aryabhata sabo tei bo tamo discover khwlaikha?
Aryabhata kwcham India ni khoroksa kotor mathematician tei astronomer tongmani. Bo 'zero' (0) ni use khwlaimung tei hayung kiting tei sakni sakao birmung ni kokno puila sakhamani.
Vijayanagara Empire ni rajdhani boro tongmani?
Vijayanagara Empire ni rajdhani Hampi o tongmani. Tabuk Hampi, Karnataka o, kaisa UNESCO World Heritage Site wngkha tei aroni kwcham mandirrok belai naithok.
Battle of Plassey buphru tei sabo sabo ni bisingo wngkhamani?
Battle of Plassey 1757 bisio British East India Company tei Bengal ni Nawab Siraj-ud-Daulah ni bisingo wngkhamani. O jhogra bai se India o British शासन ni chengmung wngkha.
'Sati' pratha tamo tongmani?
Sati pratha wngkha kaisa kwcham hamya niyam, jeba o khoroksa bwsai thwinani ulo, bini bihik no bo bini chita o jwonwi thwina nango mani. O niyamno 19th century o bondho khwlaijakha.
Quit India Movement no buphru chengkha?
Mahatma Gandhi 1942 bisini August talo 'Quit India Movement' eba 'Bharat Chhodo Andolan' no chengkhamani. Abo British no India ni simi kodo khe thangna bagwi kaisa kotor jhogra.
Ashoka ni pillarrok tamoni bagwi mungsajak?
Ashoka ni pillarrok bohrokni naithok polishing tei bohrokni sakao khukjak niyam-kanun (edicts) ni bagwi mungsajak. Sarnath o tongnai pillar ni sakani lion se India ni National Emblem wngkha.
'Harappan Seal' rok o tamo naina mano?
Harappan seal rok o juda juda malmata (jemon bull, elephant), ajgubi bumul, tei kisa swijak kok naina mano, jeba no tabuk jora jora bo poriwi manyakhu.
Delhi Sultanate o kon kon dynasty शासन khwlaikhamani?
Delhi Sultanate o 5 ta dynasty शासन khwlaikhamani: Slave, Khilji, Tughlaq, Sayyid, tei Lodi dynasty.
Ajanta tei Ellora Caves tamoni bagwi famous?
Ajanta tei Ellora Caves, Maharashtra o, hapung no khaui sakjak naithok naithok mandir tei monastery ni bagwi famous. Aro Buddhist, Hindu, tei Jain धर्म ni bumul tei painting tongo.
India ni 1971 bisini jhogra tamoni bagwi wngkhamani?
1971 bisini jhogra East Pakistan (tabukni Bangladesh) ni swadhinata jhogra ni bagwi chengkhamani. India Bangladesh no chubamani tei o jhogra ni ulo se Bangladesh kaisa kwtal haste wngkha.
'Maurya Empire' ni chengmung sabo khwlaikhamani?
'Maurya Empire' ni chengmung Chandragupta Maurya, bini guru Chanakya ni chubamung bai, 322 BC o khwlaikhamani.
'White Revolution' India o tamo bai jora tongo?
'White Revolution' India o bwtwi (milk) ni उत्पादन barainani bai jora tongo. Dr. Verghese Kurien ni chubamung bai, India hayung bisingo joto ni swlai kotor bwtwi उत्पादन khwlainai haste wngkha.
Red Fort, Delhi o, no sabo sakhamani?
Delhi ni Red Fort (Lal Qila) no Mughal Samrat Shah Jahan sakhamani. Abo Mughal jorani architecture ni kaisa naithok example.
India China jhogra buphru wngkhamani?
India tei China ni bisingo kotor sima ni jhogra 1962 bisio wngkhamani.
Angno khoroksa kwcham India ni mungsajak woman ruler ni mung sa.
Razia Sultana 13th century o Delhi ni puila tei pogsani bwrwi ruler tongmani. Bo belai gwran tei aklangmung tongnai शासक tongmani.
'Non-Cooperation Movement' tamo tongmani?
1920 bisio Mahatma Gandhi 'Non-Cooperation Movement' no chengkhamani. O jhograo, borokrok British ni samung, school, tei court rokno yakarmani, santi bai jhogra khwlainani bagwi.
'Gupta Empire' ni joto ni swlai mungsajak Samrat sabo?
Gupta Empire ni joto ni swlai mungsajak Samrat wngkha Samudragupta tei Chandragupta II (Vikramaditya). Bohrokni jorao haste belai kotor tei উন্নতি wngkhamani.
'Indo-Aryan Migration' theory tamo sao?

O theory hisap o, kwbangma bisi swkang Central Asia ni simi Indo-Aryan kok sa-nai borokrok India o phaiwi tongna chengkhamani tei bohrokni culture local culture bai milaiwi Vedic culture chengkhamani.
India ni 'Emergency' jora hwnmale tamo?
1975 ni simi 1977 jora, Prime Minister Indira Gandhi haste o 'Emergency' lagaiwi romkhamani. O jorao, borokrokni kwbangma odhikar no bondho khwlaijakha tei political leaderrokno bondi khwlaijakha.
'Jauhar' pratha tamo tongmani?
Kwcham jorao, phiya Rajput borokni bisingo, jhograo phitani kirimung bai, bwrwirok sakni borom bachinani bagwi logi logi horo jwonwi thwinani niyam no 'Jauhar' hwnmani.
Vasco da Gama sabo tei bo tamo khwlaikha?
Vasco da Gama khoroksa Portuguese explorer tongmani. Bo se 1498 bisio sagar ni lama bai Europe ni simi India jora puila phainai borok.
Angno kaisa South India ni kotor samrajya ni mung sa.
South India ni kaisa belai kotor tei gwran samrajya wngkha 'Chola Empire'. Bohrokni sagar ni sakao शासन tei naithok mandirrok (jemon Brihadeshwara Temple) belai mungsajak.
'Simon Commission' no India ni borokrok tamoni birodh khwlaikhamani?
'Simon Commission' no birodh khwlaijakha tamni hwnmale o commission o, jeba India ni future ni kok bichar khwlainani phaikha, khoroksa bo Indian member kwrwi tongmani, joto British se.
Angno kaisa kwcham India ni university ni mung sa.
Nalanda University kwcham India ni, tei hayung bisingni, kaisa joto ni swlai mungsajak university tongmani. Aro hayung bisingni kwbangma jaga ni simi borokrok porina phaimani.
India ni space program no sabo chengmani?
India ni space program no Dr. Vikram Sarabhai ni chubamung bai chengjakhamani. Bono se 'Father of the Indian Space Program' hwnwi sa-o.
'Operation Blue Star' tamo tongmani?
1984 bisio Amritsar ni Golden Temple o tongnai kwbangma hamya borokrokno khuknani bagwi Indian Army ni khwlaijak operation no se 'Operation Blue Star' hwn-o.
'Swadeshi Movement' buphru chengkha?
1905 bisio, jephru British Bengal no nwi bhag khwlaikha, aboni birodh o 'Swadeshi Movement' chengkha. O jorao, borokrok bahira ni samungno yakarwi, haste ni sakjak samungno se use khwlaina chengkha.
Aurangzeb tamoni bagwi aswk mungsajak tei hamya bo wngjak?
Aurangzeb Mughal Empire no joto ni swlai kotor khwlaikhamani. Phiya bo tei kubuni धर्म ni sakao belai gwran tongmani tei kwbangma mandir phatbarmani bagwi bo hamya wngjak.
Tipu Sultan sabo tongmani?
Tipu Sultan 18th century ni Mysore haste ni khoroksa gwran शासक tongmani. Bo British ni against o rocket use khwlaiwi jhogra khwlainani bagwi mungsajak.
'Poorna Swaraj' ni घोषणा buphru wngkha?
1929 bisio, Lahore o, Indian National Congress ni meeting o, Jawaharlal Nehru 'Poorna Swaraj' eba 'pura swadhinata' ni घोषणा khwlaikha.
Gautam Buddha ni kubui mung tamo tongmani?
Gautam Buddha ni kubui tei chwrai jorani mung wngkha Siddhartha Gautama. Bo Lumbini (tabukni Nepal) o achaimani.
Mahavira sabo tongmani?
Mahavira Jain धर्म ni 24th tei pogsani Tirthankara tongmani. Bo ahimsa tei joton langma no borom rinani kokno swrwng rwkhamani.
Harsha ni samrajya ni rajdhani boro tongmani?
Samrat Harsha ni samrajya ni rajdhani puila Thanesar o, ulo Kannauj o swlaijakhamani. Bo North India ni pogsani kotor Hindu Samrat.
India o puila train buphru tei boro ni simi boro jora cholokhamani?
India o puila passenger train 1853 bisio Bombay (tabukni Mumbai) ni simi Thane jora cholokhamani.
Kautilya ni 'Arthashastra' bijap o tamo swijak tongo?
'Arthashastra' o kaisa haste no bahai kaham khe शासन khwlainai, rajniti, economy, tei military strategy ni kok suri suri swijak tongo.
'Indica' bijap no sabo swikha tei bisingo tamo tongo?
'Indica' bijap no Megasthenes, khoroksa Greek ambassador, swikhamani. Bo Chandragupta Maurya ni jorao India o phaikhamani tei o jorani somaj tei शासन ni kok swikhamani.
Delhi ni Qutub Minar no sano sabo chengkhamani?
Qutub Minar no sano Qutb-ud-din Aibak chengkhamani, phiya bini ulo Iltutmish tei tei kubuni Sultanrok abono joton khwlaikhamani.
Babri Masjid ni घटना buphru wngkhamani?
Babri Masjid no phatbarmung ni घटना 1992 bisini December talni 6 tariko Ayodhya o wngkhamani.
India ni National Anthem 'Jana Gana Mana' no sabo swikha?
India ni National Anthem 'Jana Gana Mana' no Rabindranath Tagore swikhamani. Puila abo Bengali kok o swijakhamani.
India ni 'Tricolour' flag ni design no sabo khwlaikha?
India ni tabukni Tricolour flag ni design no Pingali Venkayya khwlaikhamani.
Angno khoroksa South Indian mungsajak Rani ni mung sa.
Rani Chennamma, Kittur (Karnataka) ni Rani, British ni against o 19th century ni chengmungo se jhogra khwlaijak khoroksa puila bwrwi शासक.
Pokhran o India tamo test khwlaikhamani?
Pokhran, Rajasthan o, India 1974 tei 1998 bisio sakni nuclear bomb no santi ni bagwi test khwlaikhamani.
'Kargil War' buphru wngkhamani?
Kargil War India tei Pakistan ni bisingo 1999 bisini May ni simi July tal jora wngkhamani. O jhograo India joton wngkhamani.
All India Radio (Akashvani) buphru chengkha?
All India Radio ni chengmung 1936 bisio wngkhamani. Abo swadhin wngnani ulo India ni information phernani kaisa kotor lama wngkha.
Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) buphru sakjakha?
ISRO no 1969 bisini August 15 o sakjakhamani. Abo India ni space program no swkang tisani samung tango.
India o 'Panchayati Raj' system no puila kon haste o chengkha?
Swadhin India o, 'Panchayati Raj' system no puila 1959 bisio Rajasthan haste ni Nagaur jila o chengjakhamani.
Alexander the Great India ni kon twima jora ni simi phinwi thangkhamani?
Alexander the Great ni soldierrok tei bo swkang himna 'ihi' sakmani bagwi, bo Beas twima ni koro ni simi se phinwi thangkhamani.
'Sanskrit' kok tamoni bagwi aswk important?
Sanskrit kwcham India ni kaisa kotor kok tongmani. Hindu, Buddhist tei Jain religion ni kwbangma pavitra bijaprok o kok bai se swijak. India ni kwbangma tabukni kok Sanskrit ni simi se ongkha.
India o puila census buphru wngkhamani?
India o puila kaham khe census 1872 bisio British jorao wngkhamani, phiya puila complete census 1881 bisio wngkhamani.
Ashoka ni jorao kon Buddhist council wngkhamani?
Samrat Ashoka ni jorao 3rd Buddhist Council, Pataliputra o wngkhamani. O jorao se Buddhism no tei kubuni haste o phernani wansukjakha.
'Doctrine of Lapse' tamo niyam tongmani?

'Doctrine of Lapse' wngkha British ni kaisa niyam, jeba hisap o jeba haste ni Raja ni sakni bwsa chwla kwrwi wngkhe, o haste no British शासन ni sakani lanaijak-o. O niyam 1857 jhograni kaisa kotor karan.
India ni 'National Song' 'Vande Mataram' no sabo swikha?
'Vande Mataram' no Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay swikhamani. Abo bini 'Anandamath' hwnwi kothomayung ni kaisa bhag.
Kalinga jhogra ni ulo, Ashoka tei bo jhogra khwlaikha da?
Ihi, Kalinga jhogra ni ulo Ashoka jhogra ni lama no pura yakarkhamani tei bini langmao tei jeba haste bai bo jhogra khwlaiyakhu. Bo 'Dhamma' (dharma) ni lama bai joton saina naimani.
India ni itihas o 'Moplah Rebellion' tamo tongmani?
1921 bisio, Kerala ni Malabar amchai o, Moplah (Muslim) hasam khwlainairok British tei Hindu jomidarrokni against o kaisa kotor jhogra khwlaikhamani. Abono 'Moplah Rebellion' hwn-o.
'Right to Information' (RTI) Act buphru pass wngkha?
'Right to Information' Act 2005 bisio pass wngkha. O niyam bai, jeba Indian borok government ni jeba kam ni kokno saimana odhikar mano.
India ni itihas porinani bagwi kaisa kaham bijap ni mung sa di.
Nwng Jawaharlal Nehru ni swijak 'The Discovery of India' porina mano. Abo India ni itihas tei culture no bujinani bagwi belai kaham kaisa bijap.
'Black Hole Tragedy' hwnmale tamo wngkhamani?

1756 bisio, Bengal ni Nawab Siraj-ud-Daulah kwbangma British bondirokno Kolkata ni Fort William ni kaisa chuchu room o bondi khwlaiwi romkhamani. Oxygen kom wngwi kwbangma borok thwikhamani. O घटना no se 'Black Hole Tragedy' hwn-o.
India ni 'Operation Vijay' kon jhogra bai jora tongo?
'Operation Vijay' wngkha 1999 bisini Kargil jhograo Indian Army ni operation ni mung. O operation bai India joton wngkhamani.
'Swachh Bharat Abhiyan' buphru chengkha?
'Swachh Bharat Abhiyan' 2014 bisini October 2 o, Mahatma Gandhi ni achaima salo, Prime Minister Narendra Modi chengkhamani. Bini goal wngkha India no kwthar khwlaimung.
Chand Bibi sabo tongmani tei bo tamoni bagwi mungsajak?
Chand Bibi 16th century ni khoroksa gwran bwrwi शासक tongmani. Bo Ahmednagar no Mughal Samrat Akbar ni army ni simi bachinani bagwi belai gwran khe jhogra khwlainani bagwi mungsajak.
India o Television (Doordarshan) buphru chengkha?
India o television puila 1959 bisini September 15 o Delhi o chengkhamani. O jorao belai kom jora ni bagwi se program phunug-o mani.
India ni itihas porimung angno tamo swrwng rio?
India ni itihas porimung chwngno chini yarwng, chini swkangni bulrok, tei chini thansa ni gwranmungno swrwng rio. Abo chwngno phainai sal ni bagwi kaisa kaham lama phunugo.
Angno kaisa kothoma sa, jeba India ni itihas bai jora.

Kothoma tongo ke, jephru Alexander India o phaikhamani, bo khoroksa siring siring sadhu no malakha. Bo sadhuno swngkha, 'Nwng tamo khwlaio?'. Sadhu kiphilkha, 'Ang mungsa bo khwlaiya, tei abo se joto ni swlai kotor tongthokmung'. O kiphilmung khnaui Alexander ajgubi wngkhamani.
Angni joto swngmungni kiphilmung kaham khe rikha. Belai hambai.
Belai belai lamsogo. India ni itihas belai kotor tei interesting. Tei jeba saimana mwkhago khe, swngna lajidi ta. Kaham khe tongdi!
Hayung bisingo puila civilization boro chengkhamani?
Hayung bisingo puila civilization Mesopotamia o (tabukni Iraq), Tigris tei Euphrates twima ni koro, 6500 bisi swkang chengkhamani hwnwi wansukjak-o. Abono 'Cradle of Civilization' hwn-o.
Kwcham Egypt ni borokrok tamoni bagwi 'mummy' sano mani?
Kwcham Egypt ni borokrok thwinani ulo tei kaisa langma tongo hwnwi विश्वास khwlaio mani. Bohrok wansukmani ke o langma ni bagwi mangno kaham khe romna nango, aboni bagwi se 'mummy' sano mani.
Kwcham Greece no 'Democracy' ni achaimathai hwn-o. Tamoni?
Tamni hwnmale, Athens, Greece o, 5th century BC o puila direct democracy ni system chengkhamani. Aro borokrok sakbaithang niyam-kanun sano bhag laio mani.
Julius Caesar no tamoni bagwi aswk mungsajak?
Julius Caesar khoroksa belai gwran Roman general tei leader tongmani. Bo Roman Republic no Roman Empire o swlainani kotor bhag tongmani. Phiya bini gwranmung barinani kirimung bai bono tharjakha.
Great Wall of China sano bwswk jora nangkhamani?
Great Wall of China kaisa jorao sakjak ya. Abo juda juda Samrat ni jorao, kwbangma 100 bisi jora sakjakhamani, North ni hamya borokrokni simi bachanani bagwi.
'Renaissance' jorao Europe o tamo kotor swlaimung wngkhamani?
Renaissance (14th-17th century) wngkha Europe o art, science, tei aklangmungni teisa achaimani jora. O jorao Leonardo da Vinci tei Michelangelo hai kotor artistrok ongkhamani.
Christopher Columbus kubui khe tamo discover khwlaikhamani?
Christopher Columbus India saina ongkhamani, phiya bo bul wngwi America haste o sokwi thangkhamani (1492 bisio). Bo America no discover khwlaikha hwn-o, phiya bini swkang bo aro borok tongmani.
'Protestant Reformation' tamo tongmani?

16th century o, Martin Luther ni chubamung bai, kwbangma borok Roman Catholic Church ni kisa niyam tei bebohar ni against o kok sakhamani. O घटना ni simi se Protestant Christianity ni chengmung wngkhamani.
'Industrial Revolution' puila kon haste o chengkhamani?
'Industrial Revolution' 18th century o puila Great Britain o chengkhamani. O jorao steam engine hai kwtal machine ni bagwi, factory o samung sản xuất belai barikhamani.
American Revolution tamoni bagwi wngkhamani?

American Revolution wngkhamani tamni hwnmale America o tongnai British colonyrok Great Britain ni kwbangma tax tei शासन no hamjakyakhamani. O jhogra ni ulo se United States of America achaimani (1776).
French Revolution ni joto ni swlai kotor wansukmung tamo tongmani?

French Revolution (1789) ni joto ni swlai kotor wansukmung wngkha 'Liberty, Equality, Fraternity' (Swadhinata, Somanmung, tei Takhuk wngmung). O wansukmung hayung bisingo kwbangma haste no inspire khwlaikhamani.
Napoleon Bonaparte sabo tongmani?
Napoleon Bonaparte French Revolution ni ulo France ni khoroksa kotor military leader tei Samrat wngkhamani. Bo Europe ni kwbangma haste no bini sakani khwlaikhamani.
World War I tamoni bagwi chengkhamani?

World War I (1914-1918) chengmani kwbangma karan tongmani, jemon nationalism, tei juda juda haste ni bisingo jhogra. Phiya chengmungni main karan wngkha Austro-Hungarian Archduke Franz Ferdinand no tharmung.
'Russian Revolution' buphru wngkhamani tei tamo swlaikha?
Russian Revolution 1917 bisio wngkhamani. O jhogra ni ulo, Russia o Raja ni शासन pogwi, hayung bisingni puila Communist government sakjakhamani, Vladimir Lenin ni chubamung bai.
World War II ni joto ni swlai hamya घटना tamo?
World War II ni joto ni swlai hamya घटना wngkha 'The Holocaust', jeba o Adolf Hitler ni Nazi Germany 6 million (60 lakh) ni swlai bara Jews borokrokno belai kosto riwi tharkhamani.
Pearl Harbor o tamo wngkhamani?
1941 bisini December 7 o, Japan America ni Pearl Harbor (Hawaii) o tongnai sagar ni base o lukuiwi hamla khwlaikhamani. O घटना ni ulo se America World War II o jora wngkhamani.
'Cold War' hwnmale sabo sabo ni bisingo jhogra?
Cold War (1947-1991) wngkha USA (Capitalism) tei Soviet Union (Communism) ni bisingo wansukmungni jhogra. O jorao direct jhogra wngyakhu, phiya hayung bising belai tension ni jora tongmani.
Berlin Wall no tamoni bagwi sakhamani?
Berlin Wall no 1961 bisio East Germany (Communist) sakhamani, jemon East Berlin ni borokrok West Berlin (Capitalist) o himwi thangna manya wngthung.
Martin Luther King Jr. no tamoni bagwi wansuk-o?
Martin Luther King Jr. no America o African-American borokrokni soman odhikar ni bagwi santi bai jhogra khwlainani bagwi wansuk-o. Bini 'I Have a Dream' speech belai mungsajak.
'Apartheid' niyam tamo tongmani?
Apartheid wngkha South Africa o tongnai kaisa hamya niyam, jeba ni bisingtwi kuphur borokrok tei kosom borokrokno juda juda khwlaiwi romo mani, tei kosom borokrokno jeba odhikar riya mani.
Nelson Mandela no 27 bisi tamoni jail o romjakhamani?
Nelson Mandela no South Africa ni Apartheid niyam ni against o jhogra khwlainani bagwi 27 bisi jail o romjakhamani. Bo jail ni simi ongwi South Africa ni puila kosom President wngkhamani.
Vietnam War o tamo wngkhamani?

Vietnam War (1955-1975) wngkha North Vietnam (Communist) tei South Vietnam (Capitalist) ni bisingo jhogra. O jhograo America South Vietnam no belai chubakhamani, phiya pogsao North Vietnam joton wngkhamani.
Man buphru puila talo yapri rikhamani?
1969 bisini July 20 o, America ni Apollo 11 mission ni astronaut Neil Armstrong puila talo yapri rikhamani borok wngkhamani.
'Silk Road' tamo tongmani?
Silk Road wngkha kwcham jorani kaisa bepar ni lama, jeba China no Europe tei Middle East bai jora khwlaio mani. O lama bai sirif silk ya, tei bo kwbangma samung tei wansukmung phermani.
Genghis Khan sabo tongmani?
Genghis Khan 13th century o Mongol Empire no sanai khoroksa belai gwran tei kiri-nai leader tongmani. Bini samrajya hayung bisingni itihas o joto ni swlai kotor tongmani.
Black Death (Bubonic Plague) ni bagwi Europe o tamo wngkhamani?
14th century o, Black Death ni bagwi Europe ni population ni kotor kaisa bhag, 30% ni simi 50% jora, thwiwi kwma-khamani. Abo somaj tei economy o belai kotor swlaimung tubukhamani.
Printing press ni a आविष्कार no sabo khwlaikha tei bini lab tamo?

Printing press no 15th century o Johannes Gutenberg a आविष्कार khwlaikha. Bini bagwi, bijap belai kodo tei kom dam o chapa khwlaina chengkha, tei aklangmung borokrok thani belai kodo khe sokna chengkha.
'Aztec' civilization boro tongmani?
Aztec civilization tabukni Central Mexico o tongmani. Bohrokni kotor rajdhani wngkha Tenochtitlan, jeba Mexico City ni sakao tongmani. Bohrok belai gwran jhogra-nai tongmani.
Angno kaisa kwcham jorani 7 ajgubi samungni bisingni kaisa mung sa.
Kwcham jorani 7 ajgubi samungni bisingni kaisa wngkha 'The Great Pyramid of Giza' (Egypt). Abo se tabuk jora jora bo tongwi tongo.
'Roman Empire' tamoni bagwi pogwi thangkhamani?
Roman Empire pogmungni kwbangma karan tongmani, jemon bisingni jhogra, economy hamya wngmung, tei bahira ni dushmanrokni hamla. Kaisa karan bai wngyakhu.
'Crusades' tamo jhogra tongmani?
Crusades wngkha Middle Ages jorao Christian tei Muslim ni bisingo, pavitra jaga Jerusalem no romnani bagwi wngnai kwbangma jhogra.
Joan of Arc sabo tongmani?

Joan of Arc 15th century ni khoroksa French chuchu bwrwi tongmani. Bo sao ke bo Kaitorni kiphilmung bai France no England ni simi joton rina phaikha. Bo French army no kwbangma jhogra joton rwkhamani.
'Ottoman Empire' ni kotor Samrat sabo tongmani?
