Ottoman Empire ni joto ni swlai kotor Samrat wngkha Suleiman the Magnificent. Bini jorao, 16th century o, samrajya belai kotor tei gwran wngkhamani.
'Age of Enlightenment' o borokrok tamo wansukna chengkhamani?
18th century ni 'Age of Enlightenment' o borokrok science, aklangmung, tei sakni wansukmungno borom rina chengkhamani. Bohrok kwcham विश्वास tei Raja ni शासन ni sakao swngmung khwlaina chengkhamani.
'Titanic' jahaj tamoni bagwi dubikhamani?
1912 bisio, Titanic jahaj bini puila beramungo se kaisa kotor बर्फ ni hapung (iceberg) bai jhogra wngwi dubikhamani. O घटना o 1500 ni swlai bara borok thwikhamani.
'The Great Depression' hwnmale tamo wngkhamani?
1929 bisio America ni stock market pogmung ni ulo, hayung bisingo kaisa belai kotor financial kosto phaikhamani. O jorao, kwbangma borokni samung kwma-khamani tei belai biyal wngkhamani.
Adolf Hitler tamoni bagwi Germany o aswk power mankhamani?
World War I ni ulo Germany ni economy belai hamya tongmani tei borokrok kosto o tongmani. Hitler o jorano use khwlaiwi, borokrokno kaham sal phunuknani kok riwi, jwng jwng khe power o phaikhamani.
D-Day (June 6, 1944) o tamo wngkhamani?
D-Day o, World War II jorao, Allied forces (USA, Britain, etc.) France ni Normandy twima koro o lukuiwi hapkhamani, jemon Europe no Nazi Germany ni simi swadhin khwlaina mano.
Hiroshima tei Nagasaki o tamo wngkhamani?
1945 bisio, World War II no pog rina bagwi, America Japan ni o nwi şehir o atomic bomb yakarkhamani. O घटना o lakh lakh borok thwikhamani.
United Nations (UN) no tamoni bagwi sakjakha?
United Nations no World War II ni ulo, 1945 bisio, sakjakha. Bini main kam wngkha hayung bisingo santi rommung, jhogra bathakmung, tei joto haste ni bisingo kaham jora rommung.
'Mao Zedong' sabo tongmani?
Mao Zedong China ni Communist jhograni kotor leader tongmani. 1949 bisio, bini chubamung bai People's Republic of China sakjakhamani.
'Cuban Missile Crisis' tamo tongmani?

1962 bisio, Soviet Union Cuba o nuclear missile romkhamani. O kokno saimani ulo, USA tei Soviet Union ni bisingo nuclear jhogra wngnani kirimung belai barikhamani. Abo Cold War ni joto ni swlai kirijak jora.
Falklands War sabo sabo ni bisingo wngkhamani?
Falklands War 1982 bisio Great Britain tei Argentina ni bisingo, Falkland Islands no romnani bagwi wngkhamani. O jhograo Great Britain joton wngkhamani.
Chernobyl o tamo apad wngkhamani?
1986 bisio, Ukraine ni Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant o kaisa belai kotor accident wngkhamani, jeba ni bagwi kwbangma radiation pherkhamani. Abo hayungni joto ni swlai hamya nuclear apad.
Internet ni a आविष्कार hayungo tamo swlaimung tubukha?
Internet ni a आविष्कार hayungni borokrokni kok samung, information manmung, tei bepar khwlaimung ni lama no pura swlai rwkha. Abo chini langmano tei bo jora khwlaikha.
'European Union' (EU) tamo?
European Union wngkha Europe ni kwbangma haste ni kaisa political tei economic jora. Bini member hasterokni bisingo bepar khwlaimung tei beramung belai easy.
9/11 o America o tamo wngkhamani?

2001 bisini September 11 o, al-Qaeda ni terroristrok 4 ta plane no hijack khwlaiwi, New York ni World Trade Center tei Washington D.C. ni Pentagon o jhogra rwkhamani. O ঘটনা o 3000 ni swlai bara borok thwikhamani.
'Arab Spring' hwnmale tamo jhogra?
2010 bisio chengwi, Middle East tei North Africa ni kwbangma haste o, borokrok bohrokni gwran शासकrokni against o jhogra khwlaikhamani. O jhogra no se 'Arab Spring' hwn-o.
Hayungni itihas o kon samrajya joto ni swlai lama jora शासन khwlaikha?
Kwcham Egypt ni samrajya (3000 bisi ni swlai bara) tei Roman Empire (1000 bisi ni swlai bara) hayungni itihas o joto ni swlai lama jora शासन khwlaijak samrajyarokni bisingo tongo.
Marie Curie no tamoni bagwi nwi jora Nobel Prize rijakkha?

Marie Curie no puila jora Physics o (radioactivity ni a आविष्कार ni bagwi) tei nwichi jora Chemistry o (radium tei polonium a आविष्कार ni bagwi) Nobel Prize rijakkha. Bo nwi juda science o Nobel manai puila tei pogsani borok.
'Vikings' sabo tongmani?
Vikings wngkha 8th ni simi 11th century jora, Scandinavia (Norway, Sweden, Denmark) ni sagar ni jhogra-nai tei bepari. Bohrok sagar lama bai kwbangma haste o beraiwi, jhogra, tei bepar khwlaimani.
Angno khoroksa Africa ni kotor leader ni mung sa, Nelson Mandela karwi.
Kwame Nkrumah khoroksa kotor leader tongmani. Bo Ghana no British शासन ni simi swadhin khwlainani jhograno lead khwlaikhamani tei swadhin Ghana ni puila President wngkhamani.
'Inca' civilization tamoni bagwi mungsajak?
Inca civilization, South America ni Andes hachuk o tongmani, bohrokni kotor lama sanani system, naithok hapungni kam, tei Machu Picchu hai naithok şehirni bagwi mungsajak.
'Spanish Flu' buphru pherkhamani?
1918 bisio, World War I ni pogsao, 'Spanish Flu' hwnwi kaisa kotor hamya pherkhamani. O hamya bai hayung bisingo million million borok thwikhamani.
Hayung bisingo joto ni swlai chuchu haste kon no?
Hayung bisingo joto ni swlai chuchu haste wngkha Vatican City. Abo Rome şehirni bisingo tongnai kaisa swadhin haste.
Leonardo da Vinci 'Mona Lisa' karwi tei tamo mungsajak samung khwlaikha?
Leonardo da Vinci 'The Last Supper' hwnwi kaisa belai mungsajak painting bo akimani. Bo sirif artist ya, khoroksa kotor scientist tei inventor bo tongmani.
'Samurai' sabo tongmani?
Samurai wngkha kwcham Japan ni gwran jhogra-nai borok. Bohrokni sakni honor tei Raja ni bagwi langma rinani kothoma belai mungsajak.
Albert Einstein no tamoni bagwi aswk mungsajak?
Albert Einstein no bini 'Theory of Relativity' (E=mc²) ni bagwi hayung bisingo mungsajak. Bini o a आविष्कार science ni wansukmungno pura swlai rwkha.
'Sputnik' tamo tongmani?
1957 bisio, Soviet Union 'Sputnik 1' no hayungni bahira o yakarkhamani. Abo hayung bisingni puila sakjak satellite. O घटना bai se Space Race chengkhamani.
'Mayan' civilization tamoni bagwi ajgubi wngjak?

Mayan civilization bohrokni aklangmung (astronomy tei math), naithok pyramid, tei ajgubi lekha ni bagwi mungsajak. Bohrokni kotor şehirrok tamoni bagwi yakarjakha, abo tabuk jora jora bo kaisa mystery.
'Brexit' hwnmale tamo?
'Brexit' hwnmale 'British Exit'. Abo United Kingdom (Britain) European Union ni simi ongwi phaimani घटना no bujio. O घटना 2020 bisio wngkhamani.
Angno kaisa South American swadhinata jhograni leader ni mung sa.

Simón Bolívar khoroksa belai kotor leader tongmani. Bono 'El Libertador' (The Liberator) hwn-o. Bo Venezuela, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, tei Bolivia no Spanish शासन ni simi swadhin khwlainani chubakhamani.
'Three Gorges Dam' boro tei tamoni bagwi sakjakha?
Three Gorges Dam China o Yangtze twima ni sakao sakjakha. Abo hayung bisingni joto ni swlai kotor bijli santhai. Abo uatwi no bathakna tei bijli sanani bagwi sakjakha.
'Perestroika' tei 'Glasnost' tamo niyam tongmani?

O nwi niyam no Soviet Union ni pogsani leader Mikhail Gorbachev chengkhamani. 'Perestroika' hwnmale economy o swlaimung, tei 'Glasnost' hwnmale 'khulwi kok samung' eba borokno kok sanani odhikar rinani.
Hayung bisingni itihas o kon borokno joto ni swlai kotor inventor hwnwi mano?
O kokno sana kosto, phiya Thomas Edison no kwbangma borok kotor inventor hwn-o. Bo electric light bulb, phonograph, tei movie camera hai hajarni swlai bara samung a आविष्कार khwlaikhamani.
Hayungni population 1 billion puila buphru sokkhamani?
Hayungni population puila 1 billion 1804 bisi ni koro sokkhamani hwnwi wansukjak-o. Tabuk abo 8 billion ni swlai bara wngkha.
'Feminism' jhograni main goal tamo?
Feminism jhograni main goal wngkha somaj o, rajniti o, tei economy o chwla tei bwrwini bisingo soman odhikar tei sujog manmung.
Angno kaisa Australia ni itihas ni kok sa.
Australia o Europeanrok phainani swkang, 50,000 bisi ni swlai bara jora ni simi Aboriginal borokrok tongwi phaimani. Bohrok hayung bisingni joto ni swlai kwcham langma tongnai culture ni borok.
Hayung bisingni itihas porimung angno tamo swrwng rio?
Hayung bisingni itihas porimung chwngno buji rio ke chini tabukni somaj bahai khe sakjakha. Abo chwngno tei kubuni culture no borom rina tei swkangni bulrokni simi swrwngna chubai-o.
Angni joto swngmungni kiphilmung rikha. Nwng belai aklangmung tongnai.
Belai belai hambai. Angni aklangmung nwngrokni swngmung ni simi se bario. Ang jephruphano nwngni bagwi kwtal information saina bagwi ready tongo. Kaham khe tongdi!
India ni economy no kon kon kotor bhag o bakna mano?

India ni economy no kotor khoroktham bhag o bakna mano: Puila wngkha Agriculture (hasam-khilim), nwichi wngkha Industry (factory o samung sanmung), tei khoroktham wngkha Services (jemon IT, banking, tourism).
GDP hwnmale tamo? Abo haste ni bagwi tamoni nango?
GDP (Gross Domestic Product) hwnmale kaisa haste ni bisingo, kaisa bisi o joto sakjak samung tei service ni dam. Abo kaisa haste ni economy kotor da chuchu, abo map nani bagwi use wngo.
India ni kon sector o joto ni swlai kwbangma borok samung tango?
India o tabuk jora jora bo, Agriculture sector o se joto ni swlai kwbangma borok samung tango, phiya GDP o bini योगदान Services sector ni swlai kom.
'1991 Economic Reforms' o tamo kotor swlaimung wngkhamani?

1991 bisio, India 'Liberalisation, Privatisation, and Globalisation' (LPG) niyam no lachikha. O jorao, government ni control kom khwlaijakha tei bahira ni companyrokno India o bepar khwlaina sujog rijakkha.
Reserve Bank of India (RBI) ni main kam tamo?
RBI wngkha India ni central bank. Bini main kam wngkha rang (notes) chapa khwlaimung, inflation no control khwlaimung, tei haste ni joto bankrokni sakao najor rommung.
'Inflation' (dam barimung) hwnmale tamo? Abo borokno bahai asar khwlaio?
Inflation hwnmale samung-lugri ni dam jwng jwng khe barimung, jeba bai rang ni dam kwma-o. Abo bai, borokrok bohrokni pocha bai swkang ni swlai kom samung paina mano.
GST (Goods and Services Tax) tamo?
GST wngkha India ni kaisa kotor indirect tax system. Abo swkangni kwbangma juda juda tax ni बदला o kaisa se tax lagaimung, jemon bepar khwlaimung tei bo easy wngo.
'Per Capita Income' hwnmale tamo bujio?
Per Capita Income hwnmale kaisa haste ni joto income no bini joto population bai bakmung. Abo haste ni khoroksa borokni average income no phunugo.
India ni stock market o BSE tei NSE ni full form tamo?
BSE ni full form wngkha Bombay Stock Exchange, tei NSE ni full form wngkha National Stock Exchange. O nwi no India ni joto ni swlai kotor stock exchange.
'Make in India' scheme ni goal tamo?
'Make in India' scheme ni main goal wngkha India no hayung bisingni kaisa kotor manufacturing hub sanmung, jemon bahira ni companyrok India o phaiwi factory sano tei samung bario.
Demonetisation (Notebandi) India o buphru wngkhamani?
India o demonetisation 2016 bisini November 8 o wngkhamani. O jorao, 500 tei 1000 rang ni kwcham note rokno bondho khwlaijakhamani.
India ni IT sector tamoni bagwi aswk mungsajak?
India ni IT sector bini kom خرچ o kaham quality ni software tei service rinani bagwi hayung bisingo mungsajak. Bangalore, Hyderabad, tei Pune o kotor IT hub tongo.
'Fiscal Deficit' hwnmale tamo bujio?
Fiscal Deficit hwnmale government ni joto خرچ bini joto income (tax ni simi manjak rang) ni swlai bara wngmung. O pharak no bakhi laiwi pura khwlaina nango.
MGNREGA scheme ni bisingtwi borokrok tamo sujog mano?
MGNREGA (Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act) ni bisingtwi, kami amchaini jeba nukhung 100 salni samung manani odhikar mano. Abo kami o samung rinani kaisa kotor scheme.
UPI (Unified Payments Interface) tamo? Abo bahai kam tango?
UPI wngkha India ni kaisa instant payment system. Abo bai nwng mobile app use khwlaiwi, kaisa bank account ni simi tei kaisa o kodo khe rang tisawi mano.
India ni 'Five-Year Plans' no tabuk sabo sano?
Swkang 'Five-Year Plans' no Planning Commission sano mani. Tabuk, aboni बदला o 'NITI Aayog' hwnwi kaisa kwtal organization sakjakha, jeba government no economic policy o wansuk rio.
'Minimum Support Price' (MSP) tamoni bagwi rijago?
MSP wngkha o kom se dam, jeba bai government hasam khwlainairokni thani hasam (jemon mai, gahu) painani kotha rio. Abo hasam khwlainairokno dam belai kom wngmung ni simi bachio.
SEBI (Securities and Exchange Board of India) ni kam tamo?
SEBI wngkha India ni stock market ni regulator. Bini kam wngkha investorrokni rangno bachimung tei share market no kaham khe cholaithokmung.
'Foreign Direct Investment' (FDI) kaisa haste ni bagwi tamoni kaham?
FDI phai khe, haste o rang, kwtal technology, tei management skill phai-o. Abo bai kwtal factory wngo tei borokrok samung mano.
India ni 'demographic dividend' hwnmale tamo?
India ni population ni bisingo samung tangnai bisi ni borok (15-59 bisi) kwbangma tongo. O kaham sujog no se 'demographic dividend' hwn-o. O borokrokno kaham skill rikhe, haste belai উন্নতি wngnai.
'Sensex' tei 'Nifty' tamo?
'Sensex' wngkha BSE ni top 30 company ni share ni average dam no phunugo. 'Nifty' wngkha NSE ni top 50 company ni share ni average dam no phunugo. Abo market ni অবস্থা no phunugo.
'MSME' hwnmale kon rokom ni business no bujio?
MSME hwnmale Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises, eba chuchu tei majhari rokom ni business. India ni economy o o sector belai kwbangma borokno samung rio.
'Balance of Trade' hwnmale tamo?

Balance of Trade hwnmale kaisa haste ni export (bahira o phaljak samung) tei import (bahira ni simi paijak samung) ni bisingo pharak. Export bara wngkhe 'trade surplus' tei import bara wngkhe 'trade deficit' wngo.
India o 'poverty line' no bahai map-o?
India o poverty line no khoroksa borokni salbrumni خرچ ni sakao map-o. Jeba o line ni sakani kom kamai-o, bono gorib hwnwi wansukjak-o.
'Start-up India' scheme tamoni bagwi chengjakha?
'Start-up India' scheme no haste o kwtal business chengna bagwi borokrokno chubanani bagwi chengjakha. O scheme o loan, tax chuti, tei tei kubuni sujog rijago.
India ni economy 'mixed economy' hwn-o. Abo hwnmale tamo?
Mixed economy hwnmale o rokom ni economy, jeba o government company (public sector) tei sakni company (private sector) nwi no logi logi samung tango.
'Repo Rate' hwnmale tamo bujio?
Repo Rate wngkha o interest rate jeba bai RBI tei kubuni commercial bankrokno kom jora ni bagwi bakhi rio. O rate bai RBI inflation no control khwlaio.
India ni kon haste o joto ni swlai bara GDP tongo?
Maharashtra haste ni GDP India ni joto haste ni bisingo joto ni swlai bara. O haste India ni financial capital, Mumbai no romwi tongo.
'Disinvestment' hwnmale government tamo khwlaio?
Disinvestment hwnmale government sakni company (PSU) ni kisa share no private borokrok thani phal mung. Abo bai government rang mano.
India ni 'Blue Revolution' tamo bai jora tongo?
'Blue Revolution' India o kasoi (fish) ni उत्पादन barainani bai jora tongo. Bini goal wngkha hasam khwlainairokni income barainani tei chahmung ni security rinani.
'Unemployment Rate' no bahai lekha-o?
Unemployment Rate no o borokrokni lekha bai map-o, jeba samung kwrwi phiya samung saina tongo, aborokno joto samung tangnai borok bai bakwi.
Angno India ni kaisa kotor PSU (Public Sector Undertaking) ni mung sa.
India ni kaisa kotor PSU wngkha State Bank of India (SBI). Abono karwi bo ONGC (Oil and Natural Gas Corporation) tei Indian Oil Corporation bo kotor PSU wngkha.
'Human Development Index' (HDI) o tamo tamo map-o?
HDI o kaisa haste ni 3 ta samungno map-o: borokni bachanai bisi (life expectancy), pora-lekha (education), tei per capita income. Abo haste ni kubui উন্নতি no phunugo.
India ni kon sector o FDI joto ni swlai kwbangma phai-o?
Sadharanoto, India ni Services sector, phiya computer software tei hardware o, joto ni swlai kwbangma FDI (Foreign Direct Investment) phai-o.
'NPA' hwnmale bank ni bisingo tamo bujio?
NPA (Non-Performing Asset) hwnmale o rokom ni loan, jeba ni principal eba interest 90 sal ni swlai bara jora phinjakya. Abo bank ni bagwi kaisa kotor samasya.
India ni 'Look East Policy' no tabuk tamo hwn-o?
India ni 'Look East Policy' no tabuk 'Act East Policy' hwn-o. Bini goal wngkha South-East Asia ni hasterok bai economic tei strategic jora no tei bo gwran khwlaimung.
Ang share market o invest khwlaina mwkhago. 'Demat account' nango da?
Au, nango. Demat account wngkha kaisa electronic account, jeba o nini paika share rokno joma khwlaiwi romo. O account yakarwi share paina-phalna manya.
India ni 'Special Economic Zone' (SEZ) tamoni bagwi sano?
SEZ wngkha kaisa juda jaga, jeba o bepar khwlainani niyam-kanun tei kubuni jaga ni swlai kom gwran wngo. Abo export barainani tei bahira ni investment saina bagwi sano.
India ni currency 'Rupee' ni symbol (₹) no sabo design khwlaikha?
Indian Rupee ni tabukni symbol (₹) no Udaya Kumar Dharmalingam 2010 bisio design khwlaikha.
'Digital India' program ni main goal tamo?
'Digital India' program ni main goal wngkha India no digital rokom bai gwran khwlaimung tei joto government service no borokrok thani online o tisamung.
India ni agriculture sector ni kaisa kotor samasya sa di.
India ni agriculture sector ni kaisa kotor samasya wngkha uatwi ni sakao belai depend wngmung. Kaham uatwi wngya khe, hasam belai hamya wngo. Chuchu jomi bo kaisa samasya.
'PM-KISAN' scheme ni bisingtwi hasam khwlainairok tamo mano?
PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi) scheme ni bisingtwi, chuchu hasam khwlainairok প্রতি bisi 6000 rang, khoroktham soman kisti o, direct bohrokni bank account o mano.
India ni BPO industry tamo?
BPO (Business Process Outsourcing) industry o, bahira ni companyrok bohrokni kam, jemon customer service eba data entry, no India ni companyrokno khwlaina rio. Abo India o kwbangma samung sano.
'Infrastructure' haste ni উন্নতি ni bagwi tamoni nango?
Kaham infrastructure, jemon lama, railway, airport, tei bijli, kaisa haste ni economy উন্নতি ni bagwi belai nango. Abo bai bepar khwlaimung tei borokni himmung easy wngo.
India ni kon haste o joto ni swlai gorib borok tongo?
Kwbangma report hisap o, Bihar, Jharkhand, tei Uttar Pradesh hai hasterok o India ni tei kubuni haste ni swlai gorib borokni population bara.
Mutual fund o 'SIP' hwnmale tamo?
SIP (Systematic Investment Plan) hwnmale प्रति tal kaisa fixed rang mutual fund o invest khwlaimung. Abo chuchu chuchu rang joma khwlaiwi, lama jorao kotor rang sanani kaisa kaham lama.
'Angel Investor' sabo?
Angel Investor wngkha o rokom ni borok, jeba kaisa kwtal chengjak business (start-up) o sakni rang invest khwlaio, company ni kisa share ni बदला o.
India o 'Income Tax' no sabo collect khwlaio?
India o Income Tax no Finance Ministry ni sakani 'Central Board of Direct Taxes' (CBDT) tei bini Income Tax Department collect khwlaio.
'Gini Coefficient' bai tamo map-o?
Gini Coefficient bai kaisa haste ni bisingo income ni somanmung ya (inequality) no map-o. O map 0 ni simi 1 jora wngo. 0 hwnmale pura somanmung, 1 hwnmale pura somanmung ya.
India ni 'Atmanirbhar Bharat' abhiyan ni अर्थ tamo?
'Atmanirbhar Bharat' abhiyan ni অর্থ wngkha 'Sakbaithang Gwran India'. Bini goal wngkha India no joton jinis, phiya joton nangnai samungrok o, sakbaithang उत्पादन khwlainai haste sanmung.
India o 'e-commerce' industry ni future bahai?
India o e-commerce (online shopping) industry ni future belai kaham. Internet tei smartphone use barimung bai, tei bo kwbangma borok online o samung paina cheng tongo.
India ni 'National Food Security Act' ni goal tamo?
O niyam ni main goal wngkha haste ni gorib borokrokno kom dam o kaham quality ni chahmung (mai, gahu) tisamung, jemon kebo bokho tongna nango ya.
'Gig Economy' hwnmale kon rokom ni kam no bujio?
Gig Economy hwnmale o rokom ni kam no bujio, jeba o borokrok permanent job ni बदला o chuchu chuchu kam eba project hisap o kam khwlaio. Jemon, online food delivery ni kam.
India ni kon haste no 'Spice Garden of India' hwn-o?
Kerala haste no bini kwbangma rokom ni mosla-mosli (jemon black pepper, cardamom) उत्पादन wngmani bagwi 'Spice Garden of India' hwn-o.
'Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code' (IBC) tamoni bagwi sano?
IBC no o companyrokni bagwi sano, jeba bohrokni bakhi no phinai manya. O niyam bai o company no ham khwlainani eba bondho khwlainani process no kodo khwlaio.
'Golden Quadrilateral' project tamo?
Golden Quadrilateral wngkha India ni 4 ta kotor şehir - Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, tei Kolkata - no kaham highway bai jora khwlainai kaisa kotor lama sanani project.
India ni Pharmaceutical (medicine sanai) industry aswk kotor tamoni?
India ni Pharmaceutical industry kom dam o kaham quality ni medicine sanani bagwi hayung bisingo mungsajak. Abo hayungni kotor vaccine sanai haste bo wngkha.
India ni economy o 'black money' ni asar tamo?
Black money (hisap kwrwi rang) bai government kaham khe tax mano ya, jeba bai haste ni উন্নতি ni kam o rang kom wngo. Abo somaj o corruption bo bario.
Angno India ni kaisa mungsajak economist ni mung sa.
Amartya Sen India ni khoroksa hayung bisingo mungsajak economist. Bono 1998 bisio economics o Nobel Prize rijakkha.
'Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana' (PMJDY) ni lab tamo?
PMJDY ni bisingtwi, haste ni joto borok, phiya gorib nukhung, no bank o zero balance savings account khulna sujog rijakkha. Abo financial inclusion barainani kaisa kotor step.
India ni tourism industry economy o bahai chubai-o?
Tourism industry bai bahira ni rang (foreign exchange) phai-o, hotel, transport, tei tei kubuni sector o borokrok samung mano. Abo haste ni culture no bo bahira o phunugo.
'Aadhaar' card ni main kam tamo?
Aadhaar wngkha khoroksa Indian borokni 12-digit ni unique identity number. Abo government ni kwbangma scheme ni lab manani tei sakni identity no phunuknani bagwi kam o phai-o.
India ni 'textile industry' ni kaisa kotor samasya sa di.
India ni textile industry ni kaisa kotor samasya wngkha bahira ni, phiya Bangladesh tei Vietnam hai haste ni, kom dam ni ri-chum bai jhogra khwlaimung.
'Remittance' hwnmale economy o tamo bujio?
Remittance hwnmale o rang, jeba no bahira haste o kam tangnai borokrok bohrokni nukhung thani haste o tisa-o. India hayung bisingo joto ni swlai bara remittance mano.
India ni 'Union Budget' no sabo present khwlaio?
India ni Union Budget (salbrumni aay-byay ni hisap) no प्रति bisi haste ni Finance Minister Parliament o present khwlaio.
'Monsoon' India ni economy ni bagwi aswk important tamoni?
India ni hasam belai kwbangma monsoon uatwi ni sakao depend wngo. Kaham monsoon wngkhe hasam kaham wngo, kami ni borokni thani rang phai-o, tei joton economy no boost rio.
'ONDC' (Open Network for Digital Commerce) tamo?

ONDC wngkha government ni kaisa kwtal wansukmung, jeba ni bisingtwi chuchu dukanrok bo Amazon eba Flipkart hai kotor e-commerce platform bai jhogra khwlaina sujog mannai. Abo UPI hai se, phiya e-commerce ni bagwi.
India ni 'renewable energy' ni goal tamo?
India ni kotor goal wngkha sal ni chwngmung (solar), nobar (wind) hai renewable energy ni simi bijli उत्पादन no belai barainani, jemon koyla ni sakao depend kom wngo tei pollution bo kom wngo.
India ni 'Gati Shakti' plan tamo?

Gati Shakti wngkha kaisa kotor National Master Plan. Bini goal wngkha haste ni joto infrastructure project, jemon lama, railway, port, no kaisa platform o tubui, plan khwlaimung tei kam no kodo khwlaimung.
India ni 'Unicorn Start-up' hwnmale tamo?
Unicorn wngkha o rokom ni kwtal chengjak, sakni company (start-up), jeba ni market dam 1 billion US dollar ni swlai bara wngo.
India ni economy $5 trillion economy wngna mwkhago. Abo hwnmale tamo?
Abo hwnmale, India ni salbrumni GDP ni dam no $5 trillion (5 lakh crore dollar) jora tisana. Abo haste no hayung bisingni top economyrokni bisingo kaisa khwlainai.
Angno India ni stock market ni kaisa hamya jorani kok sa.
2008 bisio, hayung bisingni financial kosto ni bagwi, India ni stock market bo belai kwma-khamani. O jorao kwbangma investor ni rang belai kwma-khamani. Abono '2008 Financial Crisis' hwn-o.
India ni 'Rupee' ni dam dollar bai compare khwlaikhe tamoni swlaio?
Abo haste ni economy ni gwranmung, inflation, interest rate, tei bahira ni bepar ni sakao depend wngo. Economy gwran wngkhe, Rupee ni dam bario.
India o 'Housing for All' scheme ni goal tamo?
O scheme ni goal wngkha 2022 bisi jora, haste ni joto borokno, phiya jeba ni nok kwrwi, sakni kaisa nok tisamung. O jorano tabuk baraijakha.
'Angel Tax' tamo?
Jephru kaisa kwtal chengjak company (start-up) bini share no bini kubui dam ni swlai bara dam o angel investor thani phalo, o bara rang ni sakao jeba tax lagio, abono 'Angel Tax' hwn-o.
India ni telecommunication industry o aswk jhogra tamoni?
Jio ni phaimani ulo, data ni dam belai kom wngkha. Aboni bagwi, tei kubuni companyrokno bo dam kom khwlaina nangkha, jeba bai bohrokni lab belai kom wngkha tei jhogra barikha.
'National Pension System' (NPS) o invest khwlaimung ni lab tamo?
NPS wngkha retirement ni bagwi rang joma khwlainani kaisa government ni scheme. Aro invest khwlaikhe, nwng tax o bo chuti mano tei retirement jorao kaham rang mano.
India ni economy o agriculture ni piskao tei tamo samasya tongo?
Hasam joton wngnani ulo, abono kaham dam o phalna tei market jora tisana bo kaisa kotor samasya. Kaham cold storage kwrwi wngmani bagwi bo kwbangma bolong poso-o.
Angno India ni kaisa kotor port (sagar ni bandar) ni mung sa.
India ni kaisa kotor tei busy port wngkha Mumbai o tongnai Jawaharlal Nehru Port (JNPT). Abo India ni kwbangma bahira ni bepar no cholaio.
India ni 'Smart Cities Mission' o tamo kam khwlaio?

O mission ni bisingtwi, haste ni 100 ta şehirno bachijakha, jeba o borokni langmano tei bo kaham khwlainani bagwi, kwtal technology use khwlaiwi, kaham sujog (jemon twi, bijli, transport) rijagwi tongo.
'Corporate Social Responsibility' (CSR) hwnmale companyrok tamo khwlaio?
CSR ni niyam hisap o, kotor companyrok bohrokni lab ni kisa bhag rang somaj ni উন্নতি ni kam, jemon school sano, health camp khwlaimung, omo hai kam o خرچ khwlaina nango.
India ni economy ni bagwi nini pogsani wansukmung tamo?

India ni economy o challenge tong phano, bini kotor population, barungwi tongnai middle class, tei technology o gwranmung bai, phainai salo hayung bisingni kaisa joto ni swlai kodo barunai economy wngnani pura sujog tongo.
Angni joto swngmungni kiphilmung rikha. Hambai, ang kwbangma swrwngjakha.
Belai belai lamsogo. Indian economy kaisa belai interesting tei kotor bishoy. Nini swrwngnani icha no ang borom rwo. Tei jeba nango khe, angno ringdi. Kaham khe tongdi!
India tei Pakistan ni bisingo jhogra ni goran tamo?

India tei Pakistan ni bisingo jhogra ni joto ni swlai kotor goran wngkha 1947 bisini Partition, jephru British India no धर्म ni hisap o nwi bhag khwlaijakha, tei aboni ulo Jammu & Kashmir haste no romnani jhogra.
'Partition of India' hwnmale tamo wngkhamani?

Partition of India hwnmale 1947 bisio British शासन ni pogsao, British India no nwi swadhin haste - India (Hindu kwbangma) tei Pakistan (Muslim kwbangma) - o bakmung. O jorao hayungni joto ni swlai kotor migration tei jhogra wngkhamani.
'Radcliffe Line' tamo?
Radcliffe Line wngkha o sima, jeba no Sir Cyril Radcliffe 1947 bisio India tei Pakistan (tabukni Bangladesh bo) ni bisingo khukhamani. O sima khukmung belai jor tei kosto bai pherjak tongmani.
Puila Indo-Pak jhogra buphru wngkhamani?
Puila Indo-Pak jhogra 1947-48 bisio, India swadhin wngnani jwng jwng khe se, Kashmir no romnani bagwi chengkhamani.
Kashmir ni Maharaja Hari Singh tamo decision lakhamani?
1947 bisio, Pakistan ni chubaijak tribal hamla ni ulo, Kashmir ni Maharaja Hari Singh sakni haste no bachinani bagwi India bai jora wngnani 'Instrument of Accession' o sign khwlaikhamani.
'Line of Control' (LoC) tamo?
Line of Control (LoC) wngkha o sima, jeba 1947-48 jhogra ni ulo Kashmir no India tei Pakistan ni bisingo bakha. Abo kubui international sima ya, kaisa military control line se.
1965 bisini jhogra tamoni bagwi chengkhamani?
1965 bisini jhogra chengkhamani, jephru Pakistan 'Operation Gibraltar' hwnwi kaisa plan bai, Kashmir ni bisingo lukuiwi borokrokno India ni against o jhogra khwlaina bagwi tisa-mani.
1971 bisini jhogra ni piskao tamo kotor घटना wngkhamani?
1971 bisini jhogra ni piskao kotor घटना wngkha Bangladesh Liberation War. East Pakistan (tabukni Bangladesh) o West Pakistan ni शासन ni against o kotor jhogra chengkhamani.
'Mukti Bahini' sabo tongmani?
'Mukti Bahini' wngkha Bangladesh ni swadhinata jhogra-nai ni group, jeba no India ni army training tei chubamung rikhamani.
1971 jhogra ni pogsao tamo wngkha?
1971 jhogra ni pogsao, Dhaka o, Pakistani army Indian army ni thani surrender khwlaikha, tei hayungni map o 'Bangladesh' hwnwi kaisa kwtal swadhin haste achaikha.
'Simla Agreement' o tamo kotha wngkhamani?

1972 bisini Simla Agreement o, India tei Pakistan kotha rikhamani ke bohrokni joto jhograno santi bai tei nwi haste ni bisingo se kok saiwi solve khwlainai. O jorao se 'Line of Control' mungno rijakkha.
Siachen Glacier o tamo jhogra tongo?

Siachen Glacier wngkha hayung bisingni joto ni swlai kuchuk jhograni jaga. 1984 bisio Indian Army 'Operation Meghdoot' bai o jaga no sakani khwlaikha, tei o jorani simi nwi haste ni bisingo jhogra cholo.
Kargil jhogra buphru tei tamoni wngkhamani?
Kargil jhogra 1999 bisini kwchang mol jorao wngkhamani, jephru Pakistani soldierrok lukuiwi, Kargil, Ladakh ni kuchuk kuchuk hachukrok (Indian side o) o hapwi tongkhamani.
'Operation Vijay' tamo tongmani?
'Operation Vijay' wngkha Indian Army ni o operation ni mung, jeba bai Kargil jhograo Pakistani soldierrokno Indian hachukrokni simi khutulwi yakarjakha.
India tei Pakistan buphru nuclear power wngkha?

India 1974 o puila nuclear test khwlaikhamani, phiya kubui khe 1998 bisio teisa test khwlainani ulo sakno nuclear power hwnwi घोषणा khwlaikha. Pakistan bo 1998 bisio se sakni puila nuclear test khwlaikhamani.
2001 bisio Indian Parliament o hamla ni ulo tamo wngkhamani?

2001 bisio Parliament o hamla ni ulo, India tei Pakistan ni bisingo belai kotor tension barikhamani. Nwi haste bohrokni army no sima o joma khwlaikhamani tei jhogra wngnani kirimung belai barikhamani.
26/11 Mumbai hamla no sabo khwlaikhamani?
2008 bisini Mumbai hamla (26/11) no Pakistan o tongnai Lashkar-e-Taiba (LeT) hwnwi kaisa terrorist group khwlaikhamani. O घटना o kwbangma borok thwikhamani.
'Surgical Strike' hwnmale tamo?

2016 bisio, Uri o hamla ni kiphilmung hisap o, Indian Army LoC barwi, Pakistan o tongnai terrorist launch padrokno hamla khwlaikhamani. O lukuiwi tei kodo khe khwlaijak hamla no se 'Surgical Strike' hwn-o.
Pulwama hamla ni ulo India tamo kiphilmung rikhamani?
2019 bisio Pulwama o CRPF ni sakao hamla ni kiphilmung hisap o, Indian Air Force Pakistan ni Balakot o tongnai Jaish-e-Mohammed ni kaisa terrorist training camp o airstrike khwlaikhamani.
'Lahore Declaration' o tamo kotha wngkhamani?

1999 bisio, India ni PM Atal Bihari Vajpayee tei Pakistan ni PM Nawaz Sharif Lahore Declaration o sign khwlaikhamani. Abo nwi haste ni bisingo santi tei kaham jora ni bagwi kaisa kaham step tongmani, phiya Kargil jhogra ni bagwi abo ham wngyakhu.
'Indus Waters Treaty' tamo?

1960 bisio World Bank ni chubamung bai sign khwlaijak o treaty hisap o, Indus twima system ni 6 ta twima no India tei Pakistan ni bisingo bakwi rijakkha. Jhogra tong phano, o treaty tabuk jora jora bo cholo.
'Cross-border terrorism' hwnmale tamo bujio?
Cross-border terrorism hwnmale, kaisa haste ni chubamung eba aklangmung bai, terroristrok sima barwi tei kaisa haste o hamla khwlaimung. India jephruphano Pakistan no o kam khwlaio hwnwi sao.
India-Pakistan cricket match aswk tension tamoni wngo?
Nwi haste ni bisingo political tei itihas ni jhogra ni bagwi se, India-Pakistan cricket match sirif khele ya, kaisa national borom ni jhogra hai wngwi thango. Aboni bagwi se aswk tension wngo.
Partition jorao aswk jhogra tamoni wngkhamani?
Simano belai kodo khe bakmung, borokrokno sakni nok-kami yakarwi thangna nangmung, tei धर्म ni mung bai kirimung phermung ni bagwi se Partition jorao lakh lakh borok thwikhamani.
UN (United Nations) Kashmir jhograo tamo role khwlaikha?
1948 bisio, UN ni security council kaisa resolution pass khwlaikhamani ke Kashmir o 'plebiscite' (borokni vote) bai pogsani decision wngnai. Phiya o resolution jephruphano kubui khe kam o phaiyakhu.
1965 jhogra ni pogsao kon agreement sign khwlaijakha?
1965 jhogra ni pogsao, 1966 bisio, Soviet Union ni chubamung bai India tei Pakistan ni bisingo 'Tashkent Declaration' sign khwlaijakha. O jorao se India ni PM Lal Bahadur Shastri thwikhamani.
India ni 'No First Use' nuclear policy tamo?
India ni policy wngkha ke bo jeba haste ni sakao puila nuclear bomb use khwlainai ya. Phiya jeba haste India no nuclear bomb bai hamla khwlaikhe, India kotor kiphilmung rinai.
'Samjhauta Express' bombing tamo घटना?

2007 bisio, Samjhauta Express, jeba India tei Pakistan ni bisingo cholo, o train o bomb phatbarwi kwbangma borok, phiya Pakistani, thwikhamani. Abo nwi haste ni santi process no hamya khwlainani naimung tongmani.
'Operation Gibraltar' fail wngnani karan tamo?

'Operation Gibraltar' fail wngkha tamni hwnmale Pakistan wansukmani ke Kashmir ni local borokrok India ni against o jhogra khwlainai, phiya omo hai wngyakhu. Local borokrok Indian Army no information riwi chubakhamani.
1971 jhograo Indian Navy ni kam tamo tongmani?
1971 jhograo, Indian Navy 'Operation Trident' tei 'Operation Python' ni bisingtwi Karachi port o kotor hamla khwlaikhamani, jeba bai Pakistani navy belai kwma-khamani.
Pakistan ni itihas o 'Kargil jhogra' no bahai nugo?
Pakistan o kwbangma borok Kargil jhograno kaisa kotor military tei diplomatic bul hwnwi wansukgo. O jhogra ni bagwi Pakistan hayung bisingo belai hamya wngkhamani.
'Agra Summit' (2001) tamoni bagwi fail wngkhamani?
Agra Summit fail wngkhamani tamni hwnmale nwi haste, phiya Pakistan, Kashmir ni kok tei cross-border terrorism ni kok o kaisa mot o phaiwi manyakhu.
'Instrument of Accession' kubui da tatal, o bishoy o Pakistan tamo sao?
Pakistan sao ke Maharaja Hari Singh o jorao borokni kubui leader ya tongmani tei bini sign jor khwlaiwi lanaijakha. India sao ke o sign pura legal tei kubui.
Jhogra ni bagwi nwi haste ni bepar o tamo asar wngo?
Jephruphano jhogra eba tension bario, nwi haste ni bisingo bepar bondho wngwi thango eba belai kom wngo. Abo nwi haste ni economy no se hamya khwlaio.
'Siachen conflict' o jhogra ni swlai kwbangma borok tamoni thwi-o?
Siachen o, dushman ni guli ni swlai kwbangma soldier belai kwchang मौसम, oxygen kom wngmung, tei hachuk ni hamya ni bagwi thwi-o.
India ni film tei artistrokno Pakistan o ban khwlai-o da?
Au, jephruphano nwi haste ni bisingo tension bario, Pakistan o Indian film tei artistrokno ban khwlaijak-o. Omo hai se India o bo kaisa kaisa jorao wngo.
'RAW' tei 'ISI' tamo?

RAW (Research and Analysis Wing) wngkha India ni bahira ni intelligence agency. ISI (Inter-Services Intelligence) wngkha Pakistan ni main intelligence agency. Nwi agency no kaisa-kaisa hamya kam khwlaio hwnwi sao.
'LOC Kargil' film kon jhogra ni sakao sakjak?
'LOC Kargil' film no 1999 bisini Kargil jhogra ni kubui घटना ni sakao sakjakha. O film Indian Army ni gwranmungno phunugo.
Kulbhushan Jadhav case tamo?

Kulbhushan Jadhav khoroksa swkangni Indian Navy ni officer, bono Pakistan 2016 bisio 'jasus' (spy) hwnwi romkhamani. India sao ke bono Iran ni simi kidnap khwlaijakha. O case International Court of Justice jora sokkhamani.
Jhogra tong phano, nwi haste ni borokrokni bisingo milimung tongo da?
Au, belai tongo. Jhogra political level o wng phano, nwi haste ni kwbangma borokni culture, kok, tei chahmung-nwngmung belai milio. Bohrok santi se hamjakgo.
'Proxy War' hwnmale tamo? Kashmir o abo wngo da?

Proxy War hwnmale, kaisa haste tei kaisa haste bai direct jhogra khwlaiya se, o haste ni bisingo tongnai group (jemon terrorist) rokno rang tei hathiyar riwi jhogra khwlai rimung. India sao ke Pakistan Kashmir o proxy war cholaio.
India tei Pakistan ni bisingo 'water dispute' tamo tongo?
Jhogra kwbangma jorao twima ni sakao dam sanani kokno laiwi wngo. Pakistan kirio ke India twima ni twi no bathakwi Pakistan no hamya khwlainai.
1947 o Kashmir swadhin tongna mwkhago mani da?

Au, puila Maharaja Hari Singh Kashmir no India eba Pakistan, jeba bai bo jora wngya se, kaisa swadhin haste hisap o romna mwkhago mani. Phiya Pakistani hamla ni ulo, bini thani tei lama kwrwi wngkhamani.
'Shaurya Chakra' tei 'Nishan-e-Haider' tamo?
Shaurya Chakra wngkha India ni santi jorani kaisa kotor military borom. Nishan-e-Haider wngkha Pakistan ni joto ni swlai kotor military borom, jeba jhograo gwranmung phunuknani bagwi rijago.
India-Pakistan jhogra ni bagwi South Asia ni উন্নতি o tamo asar wngo?
O jhogra ni bagwi South Asia ni hasterokni bisingo kaham jora wngna mano ya, bepar barina mano ya. Abo joton amchaini উন্নতি no piska khwlaio.
'Track II diplomacy' tamo?
Track II diplomacy hwnmale, government ni bahira ni borokrok, jemon swkangni diplomat, academic, eba journalistrokni bisingo kok samung. Abo nwi haste ni bisingo bujimung barainani naimung.
Pakistan Occupied Kashmir (POK) no Pakistan o tamo hwn-o?
Pakistan Occupied Kashmir (POK) no Pakistan 'Azad Jammu and Kashmir' (AJK) tei 'Gilgit-Baltistan' hwnwi nwi bhag o bakwi शासन khwlaio.
India-Pakistan jhogra ni pogsani solution tamo wngwi mano?
Pogsani solution ni bagwi nwi haste no logi logi kok sana nangnai, विश्वास sanani nangnai, tei cross-border terrorism no pura bondho khwlaina nangnai. Abo belai kosto, phiya asambhav ya.
Angno India-Pakistan jhograni kaisa kaham film ni mung sa, jeba nwi thani ni kokno phunugo.
Kabir Khan ni sakjak 'Bajrangi Bhaijaan' kaisa omo hai film, jeba jhogra ni bisingo borokni hamjakmung tei milimungni kothomano naithok khe phunugo.
India-Pakistan ni border boro joto ni swlai dangerous hwnwi wansukjak-o?
Line of Control (LoC) no joto ni swlai dangerous hwnwi wansukjak-o, tamni hwnmale o jaga o jephruphano nwi haste ni army ni bisingo guli khuklaimung wngwi tongo.
'Two-Nation Theory' no sabo rikhamani?

'Two-Nation Theory' ni wansukmungno Muhammad Ali Jinnah tei Muslim League belai swkang tisakhamani. O theory hisap o, Hindu tei Muslim nwi juda 'nation' (haste), aboni bagwi bohrokni bagwi juda haste nango.
1965 jhograo India ni kon kotor şehir o hamla wngkhamani?
1965 jhograo, Pakistani Air Force India ni Amritsar, Pathankot, tei tei kubuni simani koro ni şehir tei airbase o hamla khwlainani naimani.
India-Pakistan jhograo social media ni role tamo?
Social media nwi thani ni borokni bisingo bujimung barainani bo kam tango, tei tatal kok tei kirijakmung pherwi jhograno tei bo barainani bo kam tango.
'Ghazwa-e-Hind' hwnmale tamo?
'Ghazwa-e-Hind' hwnmale kisa extremist wansukmung hisap o 'India ni sakao jhogra'. Kwbangma terrorist group o kokno use khwlaiwi borokrokno jhogra ni bagwi motivate khwlaio.
SAARC (South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation) tamoni bagwi kaham khe kam khwlai manya?
SAARC kaham khe kam khwlai manyani kotor karan wngkha India tei Pakistan ni bisingo jephruphano tongnai jhogra tei विश्वास ni kom wngmung.
Angno India-Pakistan partition ni sakao swijak kaisa mungsajak bijap ni mung sa.
Khushwant Singh ni swijak 'Train to Pakistan' partition ni jorani kosto tei jhograno belai kubui khe phunuknai kaisa kotor bijap.
India tei Pakistan nwi no 'Commonwealth of Nations' ni member da?
Au, nwi haste no Commonwealth of Nations (o hasterokni group jeba swkang British Empire ni bisingo tongmani) ni member.
Jhogra ni ulo, prisoner of war (jhograni bondi) rokno tamo khwlaio?

International niyam (Geneva Convention) hisap o, jhogra pognani ulo, joto prisoner of war (POW) rokno suraksha bai sakni haste o phin rina nango. 1971 jhogra ni ulo India 90,000 ni swlai bara Pakistani POW no phin rikhamani.
'Composite Dialogue' hwnmale India-Pakistan ni bisingo tamo kok samung?

Composite Dialogue wngkha kaisa kok samung ni process, jeba ni bisingtwi nwi haste 8 ta juda juda bishoy (jemon Kashmir, Siachen, Terrorism) ni sakao logi logi kok samani. O process tabuk bondho tongo.
Jhogra ni bagwi nwi haste ni defence budget o tamo asar wngo?

Jephruphano tongnai jhogra ni bagwi, nwi haste no bohrokni budget ni kaisa belai kotor bhag defence o خرچ khwlaina nango. O rangno education eba health o خرچ khwlai mankhe, haste tei bo kaham wngnai mani.
Future o India tei Pakistan logi wngphinai ni chance tongo da?
Abo sana belai kosto. Jhogra kotor wng phano, jeba asambhav ya. Nwi haste ni borokrok santi hamjak khe, tei leaderrok kubui mon bai himkhe, phainai salo kaham jora phaiwi mano.
Angni joto swngmungni kiphilmung rikha. Hambai, o bishoy belai kosto.
Belai lamsogo. Au, o bishoy belai kosto tei mon hamya wngnai. Phiya itihas no kubui khe saimana tei aboni simi swrwngmung belai nango. Kaham khe tongdi!
What specific economic frustrations fueled the Gen-Z protests in Nepal?
The protests were fueled by chronic youth unemployment, which fluctuated between 19 and 22 percent, leaving young Nepalis with little hope for economic mobility within their country.
How did the lifestyle of politicians' families contribute to the anger?

The lavish lifestyles of politicians' children, often flaunted on social media and dubbed 'nepo babies' or 'nepo kids', created a stark contrast with the struggles of ordinary youth and amplified public anger over corruption and inequality.
Why was the social media ban seen as the final straw for Nepal's youth?

For Nepal's digitally dependent Gen-Z, the ban on 26 platforms, including those central to communication, commerce, and education, was viewed as a direct assault on their speech, work, and connectivity, becoming the final straw after years of broken promises.
What was the government's official reason for the social media ban?

The Nepalese government's official justification for the ban on 26 social media platforms was that the companies had failed to register under the Ministry of Communication and Information Technology's new rules.
Did the government cite any other reasons for the social media regulations?

Yes, the government and the Supreme Court also cited the need to regulate revenues, enforce a new Digital Services Tax, and address misinformation as reasons for the registration requirements that led to the ban.
Which specific social media platforms were banned?
The ban included 26 prominent platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, X (formerly Twitter), WhatsApp, LinkedIn, Reddit, and Snapchat.
Was TikTok also banned by the Nepali government?
No, TikTok was not banned because it had complied with the necessary local registration laws, which ironically allowed it to become a key tool for protestors to organize.
How did the protestors organize after the social media ban?
After the ban, protestors quickly moved to encrypted apps, offline groups, and gaming apps like Discord to continue organizing their movement and coordinating street protests.
What was the role of the Discord app in these protests?

The gaming app Discord became the nerve center for the Gen-Z movement; the 'Youths Against Corruption' channel was used as a central communication system and even to hold online polls to select an interim prime minister.
Who was Sushila Karki and why was she chosen as the interim leader?

Sushila Karki, the first woman to serve as Nepal's Chief Justice, was chosen as the interim Prime Minister after she emerged as a favorite in online discussions and polls held by thousands of Gen-Z protestors on Discord.
What were the main demands of the Gen-Z protestors beyond lifting the social media ban?

Key demands included the resignation of Prime Minister K.P. Sharma Oli, the dissolution of Parliament, the establishment of an independent watchdog to monitor corruption, and comprehensive electoral reform.
Did the protestors have a specific demand regarding past corruption cases?
Yes, a clear demand of the Gen-Z protestors was the establishment of a trusted body to investigate all major corruption cases from 1990 to 2025.
Were there calls for the arrest of specific political leaders?

Yes, following the deadly clashes, protestors and activists began demanding the arrest of the ousted Prime Minister K.P. Sharma Oli and former Home Minister Ramesh Lekhak for their alleged roles in corruption and the shooting of demonstrators.
How did the protests turn violent on September 8, 2025?

The protests, which began peacefully, turned violent after some demonstrators breached security barricades near the parliament building in Kathmandu, leading police to respond with tear gas, water cannons, rubber bullets, and eventually live ammunition.
What was the human cost of the Gen-Z protests?
The protests resulted in a significant human cost, with reports indicating at least 74 people were killed and over 2,100 injured in clashes with security forces.
Were there casualties among very young protestors?

Yes, the violence was particularly shocking as victims included many students in school uniforms, and reports confirmed that at least one 12-year-old child and 19 young students were among those killed.
What was the immediate result of the deadly clashes on September 8?

Following the deaths of 19 protestors on the first day, public anger intensified, leading to the resignation of Home Minister Ramesh Lekhak and the government's decision to lift the social media ban that same evening.
What happened to government buildings during the uprising?
In the days following the initial clashes, vengeful mobs set fire to numerous government buildings, including the Parliament, the Prime Minister's Office, and the residences of several politicians.
Did any political leaders' residences get attacked?
Yes, the residences of several political figures were attacked, including those of former Prime Minister Sher Bahadur Deuba and former President Bidya Devi Bhandari, which were set on fire.
What was the ultimate political outcome of the Gen-Z revolution?
The protests led to the resignation of Prime Minister K.P. Sharma Oli, the dissolution of the House of Representatives, and the appointment of Sushila Karki as the head of an interim government.
How was Sushila Karki's appointment as interim Prime Minister formalized?
Following discussions with Gen-Z representatives and the Nepali Army, President Ramchandra Poudel appointed Sushila Karki as interim Prime Minister on September 12, 2025.
What was one of the first actions of the interim government regarding the victims?
One of the first actions of Sushila Karki's interim government was to announce monetary compensation of 1 million Nepalese rupees for the family of each person killed in the protests.
What did the interim government promise for those injured?
The interim government led by Sushila Karki also promised that those who were injured during the widespread protests would receive compensation for their treatment.
Was the appointment of the interim government universally accepted?

No, the formation of the interim government under Sushila Karki and the dissolution of parliament were challenged in the Supreme Court through 10 petitions filed by lawyers and law students, who claimed the moves were unconstitutional.
What was the legal argument against Sushila Karki's appointment?
Petitioners argued that her appointment breached the constitution, which states that a former Chief Justice cannot be engaged in any other office.
What task was given to the Karki-led interim government?
The interim government was tasked with stabilizing the country, restoring public trust, and conducting a general election for the House of Representatives, which was scheduled for March 5, 2026.
How did the movement remain largely leaderless?

The Gen-Z protests did not have a single formal leader or a manifesto; individuals joined voluntarily, and decisions, including the choice of an interim leader, were made through collective online discussions.
Were there any specific groups that helped organize the initial protests?
The initial protest on September 8 was organized by Hami Nepal, a nonprofit organization that began as a youth movement in 2015 and had secured official approval for the demonstration.
What role did the Nepali diaspora play in the protests?

The Nepali diaspora, including economic migrants, actively participated in the online discussions and polls on platforms like Discord, contributing to decisions such as the selection of the interim prime minister.
What is the significance of youth unemployment in Nepal's recent unrest?

Chronic youth unemployment, hovering around 20%, has created widespread frustration and disillusionment, making the younger generation a key force behind the protests as they see little future for themselves in the country.
How does labor migration relate to the Gen-Z protests?

Mass labor migration, with hundreds of thousands of youths leaving Nepal for work annually due to a lack of local jobs, has fueled the economic grievances and anger against the government's failures that underpinned the protests.
How many governments has Nepal had since the monarchy was abolished?

Since the abolition of the monarchy in 2008, Nepal has experienced 14 successive governments, highlighting a deep political instability that has failed to address citizens' fundamental economic needs.
What kind of cabinet did interim Prime Minister Sushila Karki form?

Sushila Karki's interim cabinet reflected a technocratic approach, appointing ministers based on merit and specialization rather than political loyalty, such as a former finance secretary becoming the finance minister.
What were some of the slogans seen on placards during the protests?
Protestors carried placards with slogans like “Stop corruption, not social media,” “youths against corruption,” and “Unban social media.”
What was the international reaction to the social media ban?

International rights organizations like the Committee to Protect Journalists (CPJ) condemned the ban, warning that it set a dangerous precedent for press freedom and would limit democratic access to information.
How did the protestors bypass the internet shutdown?
Despite the ban on major platforms, protests were ironically coordinated using VPNs to access blocked sites and through encrypted messaging apps that were not banned.
What symbolic image from the protests went viral?

A photograph of a single, bloodied training shoe left behind on the street after the police shooting on September 8 went viral, becoming an evocative symbol of the deadliest day of protest in Nepal's history.
Has there been frustration with the pace of change after the uprising?

Yes, one month after the uprising, some protestors and victims expressed frustration at what they saw as the slow pace of change, particularly the lack of high-profile arrests of former ministers for corruption.
What was one of the first moves by the new interim Home Minister?

The new interim Home Minister, Om Prakash Aryal, stated that one of the government's first moves was to remove the political links that had previously prevented powerful figures from being investigated for corruption.
How do the Nepal protests compare to other regional uprisings?

The Gen-Z uprising in Nepal has been compared to similar youth-led movements in Sri Lanka (2022) and Bangladesh (2024), all of which were driven by anger over corruption, economic hardship, and unaccountable elites.
What does this protest reveal about Nepal's political old guard?

Analysts suggest the uprising should be a moment of reckoning for Nepal's political old guard, who were seen as fighting for their chairs instead of addressing the country's problems, highlighting the need for a transfer of leadership.
What is the link between corruption and poverty that fueled the protests?

Studies show a direct link between corruption and poverty in Nepal, where misuse of public funds erodes resources for essential services, fostering the inequality and economic hardship that drove the protests.
What was the scale of property damage during the protests?

The protests caused extensive damage to both public and private property, with mobs setting fire to the Parliament building, the Prime Minister's Office, various ministries, and the homes of several former prime ministers.
Did the protestors use any unique symbols of dissent?

Yes, some protestors used the Jolly Roger flag from the manga series 'One Piece', similar to its use in 2025 Indonesian protests, symbolizing a globally connected youth's dissent against a corrupt government.
What was the government's justification for the deadly use of force?

The government did not provide a clear justification; however, the deadly force was used after protestors broke through barricades and attempted to storm the parliament building, leading to an escalation from tear gas and water cannons to live ammunition.
Were there demands for electoral reform from the Gen-Z protestors?

Yes, the youth demanded a revision of the electoral rolls, as many of them were not registered to vote, and also expressed interest in a directly elected executive model as part of a comprehensive reform of the electoral system.
What is the interim government's stance on diaspora voting?
The interim Home Minister, Om Prakash Aryal, announced the likelihood that the Nepali diaspora would be able to vote in the upcoming elections, a key issue for the many citizens working abroad.
How did Nepal's political instability contribute to the protests?

Decades of political instability, with prime ministers averaging barely a year in office, led to a lack of consistent economic policies, soaring unemployment, and deep-rooted corruption, creating the long-term frustration that erupted in the Gen-Z protests.
What are the geopolitical implications of the Nepal uprising?

Analysts suggest the instability in Nepal has geopolitical implications, particularly concerning the country's growing ties to China and the potential for regional powers like India to play a stabilizing role.
What was the role of the Nepali Army during the crisis?

During the peak of the crisis, the Nepali Army stepped in to take charge of security, closed the international airport, and participated in talks to select an interim leader, appealing for peace while resisting direct political takeover.
Did the protestors' demands include changes to government appointments?
Yes, there was a growing consensus and demand that future ministers and government officials must be appointed based on merit and specialization, rather than political loyalty, to curb nepotism.
What happened to former Prime Minister Sher Bahadur Deuba during the protests?
Former Prime Minister Sher Bahadur Deuba and his wife, Foreign Minister Arzu Rana Deuba, were injured after protestors stormed their residence, which was later set on fire.
How did the government initially react to criticism of the social media ban?
Before the protests turned deadly, Prime Minister K.P. Sharma Oli hit back at critics, stating he would not tolerate the “nation being undermined” by unregistered social media platforms.
Did the protests spread beyond the capital city, Kathmandu?
Yes, while the main clashes occurred in Kathmandu, the protests quickly spread to other major cities across Nepal, including Pokhara, Lalitpur, and Itahari, evolving into a nationwide movement.
What is the connection between the cooperative fraud victims and the Gen-Z protests?

While they were separate movements, the widespread anger over cooperative fraud and the government's inaction contributed to the overall atmosphere of deep public frustration with corruption and institutional failure that fueled the Gen-Z uprising.
Who is leading the investigation into the protest-related deaths and violence?

The interim government formed a three-member probe commission headed by former justice Gauri Bahadur Karki to investigate the excessive use of force by police and other incidents linked to the Gen-Z movement.
What specific law was used to justify the social media ban?

The government directive was issued under the 'Directives for Managing the Use of Social Networks, 2023,' which required all social media platforms to register with the Ministry of Communication and Information Technology (MoCIT).
How did protestors feel about the political parties?

The protestors showed immense anger towards all major political parties, setting fire to the offices of the three main parties—UML, Nepali Congress, and the Maoists—signifying a complete breakdown of trust with the entire political establishment.
What is the significance of the protestors being in school uniforms?

The presence of many protestors, including those injured and killed, in their school and university uniforms highlighted the youth-centric nature of the movement and created powerful, viral images of state violence against its youngest citizens.
Were there any arrests after the interim government took over?

Yes, about a month after the main protests, police arrested 18 activists from a faction of the 'Gen-Z' group who were demonstrating and demanding the arrest of the deposed prime minister K.P. Sharma Oli.
What is the connection between Nepal's remittance economy and the protests?

Nepal's heavy dependence on remittances from citizens working abroad meant the social media ban directly impacted families' ability to communicate. This, combined with the lack of domestic jobs forcing migration, was a significant source of anger.
What did interim Prime Minister Sushila Karki say in her first public remarks?

In her first public remarks, Sushila Karki stated, “I did not come to this position because I had sought it, but because there were voices from the streets demanding that Sushila Karki should be given the responsibility.”
What is the long-term challenge for the new government formed after the protests?

The real test for the new government is whether the spirit of accountability can last and if the demands for reform can be translated into lasting institutional change, or if the cycle of corruption and instability will simply repeat.
How did the protestors' tactics evolve?

The protest evolved from peaceful marches and chanting slogans to breaching barricades and, after the deadly police response, to retaliatory acts like arson and vandalism against government and political symbols.
What are 'nepo kids' and how did they fuel the protests?

'Nepo kids' refers to the children of Nepal's political elite. Their flaunting of lavish lifestyles on social media, in a country with high youth unemployment, fueled immense anger and became a key symbol of the corruption and inequality the Gen-Z protestors were fighting against.
Were journalists targeted during the protests?

Yes, several journalists were among those injured during the police crackdown on the protests, and press freedom groups had warned that the social media ban itself was a threat to the media's ability to report.
What was the role of the President of Nepal during this crisis?

President Ramchandra Poudel's role was to formalize the transition of power. He accepted Prime Minister K.P. Sharma Oli's resignation and, on the recommendation of protest representatives and the army, appointed Sushila Karki as the interim Prime Minister.
How did the Gen-Z protests demonstrate a generational shift in Nepal?

The protests marked a pivotal moment where a new generation, born after the monarchy and raised on promises of democracy, showed they were no longer willing to accept the long-standing practices of corruption, nepotism, and unaccountable governance.
Did the interim government include any Gen-Z figures?

While there were no Gen-Z figures appointed to Sushila Karki's initial cabinet, protest leaders confirmed that they remained in close talks with the new government to ensure their demands were addressed.
What did the government do after the Parliament building was stormed?
After the Parliament building was stormed and set on fire, and with protests raging nationwide, Prime Minister K.P. Sharma Oli resigned and reportedly fled to an army barracks for safety.
How long did it take for the government to topple?

The government toppled with extraordinary speed; it took only about 36 hours from the deadly escalation of the protests on September 8 for the government to collapse and the Prime Minister to resign on September 9.
What were the geopolitical concerns for India regarding the Nepal protests?

For India, the instability in Nepal raised concerns about China's growing influence in the region and the security of critical access corridors. Some voices in Nepal even called for Indian mediation to stabilize the situation.
Was there any suspicion of foreign influence in the protests?

Some analysts questioned whether the uprising was purely organic or if it was influenced by external forces seeking to reshape Nepal's geopolitical alignment, especially noting the timing of meetings between the PM and Chinese officials.
How did TikTok's compliance with regulations impact the protests?

Because TikTok had complied with Nepal's registration laws, it was not banned. This ironically provided the youth with a major platform to organize protests and share information after other major social media sites were shut down.
What was the main difference between the Gen-Z protests and earlier anti-corruption movements?

Unlike previous movements that were often co-opted by political factions like monarchists, the Gen-Z protest was a broader, leaderless movement that channeled widespread public discontent specifically against the entire corrupt political establishment.
How did the police justify using live ammunition on protestors?

There was no formal justification provided in the search results for the use of live ammunition; it was described as an escalation after tear gas and water cannons failed to stop protestors from storming the Parliament, leading to widespread condemnation.
What is the long-term goal of the Gen-Z movement beyond the immediate demands?

The long-term goal appears to be a fundamental shift in Nepal's governance, prioritizing transparency, accountability, merit-based appointments, and genuine youth inclusion in the country's political future.
Did the government deploy the army against the protestors?
After the initial deadly clashes involving police, the government imposed curfews and deployed the army to restore order in the streets of Kathmandu and other cities.
What does the term 'Gen Z Revolution' refer to?

'Gen Z Revolution' is the term used to describe the September 2025 events in Nepal, where youth-led protests against a social media ban and corruption escalated rapidly, leading to the toppling of the government within days.
Were there any signs of the uprising before the social media ban?

Yes, popular anger had been simmering for a long time due to numerous corruption scandals, high unemployment, and economic distress. The social media ban was simply the immediate trigger that ignited these long-held frustrations.
What is the current status of the investigation into the protest deaths?

The interim government established a probe commission to investigate the deaths and the use of excessive force, but one month after the events, victims and activists were expressing frustration over the slow pace and lack of arrests.
How did the protests impact Nepal's image internationally?

The protests and the violent crackdown damaged Nepal's image, but the youth-led movement also drew international attention to the country's deep-seated problems with corruption and governance, placing it within a regional trend of youth uprisings.
What is the main lesson for other governments from the Nepal Gen-Z protests?

The main lesson is that ignoring youth disillusionment, chronic unemployment, and systemic corruption, while also attempting to stifle digital expression, can create an explosive situation that can topple even entrenched political establishments with stunning speed.
What is the next step for the protest movement if talks do not resume?

If talks do not resume under their pre-conditions, the leaders have announced they will proceed with peaceful protests like the silent march and blackout, while warning this silence could eventually turn into a 'storm'.
'Doctrine of Lapse' no sabo chengkhamani tei abo tamo niyam tongmani?
'Doctrine of Lapse' no Lord Dalhousie chengkhamani. O niyam hisap o, jeba Indian haste ni Raja ni sakni bwsa chwla kwrwi wngkhe, o haste no British East India Company sakani khwlaiwi mano mani.
Mangal Pandey no tamoni bagwi 1857 jhograni puila sahid hwn-o?

Mangal Pandey, khoroksa sepoy, puila British officerrokni against o kok sakhamani tei hamla khwlaikhamani, jephru kwtal rifle ni cartridge o uak tei musuk ni miti tongo hwnwi khwnajakha. Aboni bagwi se bono puila sahid hwn-o.
Swadeshi Movement jorao 'Boycott' ni अर्थ tamo tongmani?
'Boycott' ni अर्थ tongmani British samungrok, phiya ri-chum, chini, tei sohm no paina eba use khwlaino yakarmung. Bini बदला o, borokrok haste ni sakjak samungrokno se use khwlaina chengkhamani.
Ghadar Party no boro tei sabo sakhamani?

Ghadar Party no 1913 bisio America tei Canada o tongnai Indian borokrok, phiya Lala Har Dayal ni chubamung bai, sakhamani. Bohrokni goal tongmani jhogra khwlaiwi India no British ni simi swadhin khwlaimung.
Komagata Maru घटना tamo wngkhamani?

1914 bisio, Komagata Maru hwnwi kaisa Japan ni jahaj kwbangma Indian (phiya Punjabi) borokrokno tubui Canada thangmani. Phiya Canada government bohrokno hapna riyakhu tei phin tisakhamani. O ঘটনা British ni hamya bebohar no phunukha.
Lucknow Pact (1916) tamoni bagwi important?
Lucknow Pact wngkha Indian National Congress tei Muslim League ni bisingo wngnai kaisa agreement. O jorao, nwi group no logi logi British ni against o jhogra khwlainani bagwi kaisa mot o phaikhamani.
'Home Rule League' no sabo sabo chengkhamani?

1916 bisio, India o nwi 'Home Rule League' chengkhamani. Kaisa no Bal Gangadhar Tilak tei tei kaisa no Annie Besant chengkhamani. Bohrokni goal tongmani British Empire ni bisingo India ni bagwi sakni शासन manmung.
'Rowlatt Act' (1919) ni against o borokrok tamoni kirijakhamani?
Rowlatt Act British government no power rikhamani ke jeba borokno jeba প্রমাণ yakarwi bondi khwlaiwi romna mano tei jail o hapsina mano. Abo borokni odhikar ni sakao kaisa kotor hamla tongmani.
Chauri Chaura घटना ni ulo Mahatma Gandhi tamo khwlaikha?

1922 bisio Chauri Chaura o jhogra khwlainai borokrok kaisa police station o hor yakarmani bagwi, Mahatma Gandhi 'Non-Cooperation Movement' no bondho khwlai rwkhamani, tamni hwnmale bo jhogra no hamjakyamani.
Swaraj Party no sabo sakhamani tei bohrokni wansukmung tamo tongmani?
Swaraj Party no 1923 bisio Chittaranjan Das tei Motilal Nehru sakhamani. Bohrokni wansukmung tongmani ke legislative council ni bisingo hapwi, bising ni simi se British government ni kam no bathakna.
'Hindustan Socialist Republican Association' (HSRA) ni member sabo sabo tongmani?
HSRA ni kotor memberrok wngkha Chandrashekhar Azad, Bhagat Singh, Sukhdev, tei Rajguru. Bohrok jhogra ni lama bai se swadhinata mannai hwnwi विश्वास khwlaio mani.
Bhagat Singh, Sukhdev, tei Rajguru no tamoni bagwi phasi rijakkha?
Bohrokno 1928 bisio khoroksa British police officer, John Saunders no tharmung ni aparadh o phasi rijakkha. Bohrok kubui khe tei khoroksa officer no tharna naimani.
'Poorna Swaraj' (pura swadhinata) ni kotha puila kon Congress meeting o wngkhamani?
1929 bisini Lahore Congress meeting o, Jawaharlal Nehru ni chubamung bai, puila 'Poorna Swaraj' no se Congress ni pogsani goal hwnwi घोषणा khwlaijakha.
'Civil Disobedience Movement' buphru chengkha?
Mahatma Gandhi 1930 bisio Dandi March bai se 'Civil Disobedience Movement' no chengkhamani. O jhograo, borokrok British ni niyam-kanun no santi bai maniyawi tongna chengkhamani.
'Round Table Conference'rok tamoni bagwi wngkhamani?
1930-32 jorao, London o 3 ta Round Table Conference wngkhamani. Aborokni goal tongmani India ni future constitution tei swlaimung ni kok British government bai Indian leaderrok logi logi kok samung.
'Gandhi-Irwin Pact' o tamo kotha wngkhamani?

1931 bisini o pact o, Mahatma Gandhi Civil Disobedience Movement no bathaknani tei nwichi Round Table Conference o jora wngnani kotha rikhamani. Bini बदला o, British kwbangma political bondirokno yakarmani.
'Communal Award' (1932) tamo tongmani?

British Prime Minister Ramsay MacDonald o award ni घोषणा khwlaikhamani. Bini bisingtwi, joto chuchu somaj, phiya 'Depressed Classes' (Dalits) no bo juda electoral sujog rijakkhamani. Gandhi o niyam ni belai birodh khwlaikhamani.
'Poona Pact' sabo sabo ni bisingo wngkhamani?
Poona Pact Mahatma Gandhi tei Dr. B.R. Ambedkar ni bisingo wngkhamani. O pact bai, Depressed Classes ni bagwi juda electorate ni बदला o, provincial legislature o tei bo bara seat reserve khwlaijakha.
'Government of India Act 1935' ni main kotha tamo?
O niyam India no kaisa 'Federation of India' sanani kotha sakhamani tei provincial level o tei bo bara autonomy rikhamani. O niyam se ulo swadhin India ni Constitution ni kotor bhag wngkhamani.
'August Offer' (1940) o British tamo kotha rikhamani?
World War II o Indian borokni chubamung manani bagwi, British 'August Offer' o kotha rikhamani ke jhogra pognani ulo, India no 'dominion status' rijagwi tei constitution sanani odhikar rinai.
'Cripps Mission' (1942) tamoni bagwi fail wngkhamani?

Cripps Mission fail wngkhamani tamni hwnmale bo jhogra pognani ulo India no 'dominion status' rinai hwnmani, phiya Congress 'pura swadhinata' se hamjakmani. Tei bo, haste no baknani kotha bo bisingo tongmani.
'Quit India Movement' jorao Gandhi ni slogan tamo tongmani?
'Quit India Movement' jorao, Mahatma Gandhi bini mungsajak slogan 'Do or Die' (Khwlai eba Thwi) rikhamani. Bini अर्थ wngkha, 'swadhinata manani bagwi joton khwlainai eba o naimungo se thwinai'.
'Indian National Army' (Azad Hind Fauj) no sabo lead khwlaikhamani?
Indian National Army (INA) no puila Rash Behari Bose sakhamani, phiya ulo abono Subhas Chandra Bose lead khwlaikhamani. Bini goal tongmani jhogra khwlaiwi British no India ni simi khutulmung.
'INA Trials' tamo tongmani?
World War II pognani ulo, British government INA ni kwbangma soldierrokno 'deshdrohi' hwnwi Red Fort o bichar khwlaikhamani. O bichar ni against o haste bisingo belai kotor jhogra wngkhamani.
'Cabinet Mission Plan' (1946) tamo wansuk rikhamani?
Cabinet Mission Plan India no kaisa loose federation hisap o romna wansuk rikhamani, jeba o Hindu tei Muslim kwbangma amchairokno autonomy rijagwi, haste bakmung no bathakna naimani.
'Direct Action Day' o tamo wngkhamani?
1946 bisini August 16 o, Muslim League 'Direct Action Day' ni घोषणा khwlaikhamani, Pakistan ni demand no jor rinani bagwi. O salo Kolkata o belai kotor Hindu-Muslim jhogra chengkhamani.
Lord Mountbatten no India o tamoni bagwi tisajakkha?
Lord Mountbatten no India ni pogsani Viceroy hisap o tisajakkha, jemon bo British ni simi Indian leaderrok thani power no kodo tei suri suri tisawi mano.
India ni swadhinata jhograo bwrwirokni role tamo tongmani?

Sarojini Naidu, Annie Besant, Rani Lakshmibai, tei tei kubuni hajra hajra bwrwirok jhograo belai kotor role khwlaikhamani. Bohrok jhogra khwlaimani, borokrokno jora khwlaimani, tei jail o bo thangkhamani.
'Drain of Wealth' theory no sabo rikhamani?

'Drain of Wealth' theory no Dadabhai Naoroji rikhamani. Bini hisap o, British India ni rang-ri no juda juda lama bai (jemon salary, trade) England o tubui thangmani, jeba bai India gorib wngwi thangmani.
Bal Gangadhar Tilak no tamoni bagwi 'Father of Indian Unrest' hwn-o mani?

Bal Gangadhar Tilak no British omo hai hwnmani tamni hwnmale bo bini swijak kok tei kok samung bai, borokrokni bisingo swadhinata ni bagwi belai kotor josh barai rwkhamani. Bo 'Swaraj is my birthright' hwnwi sakhamani.
'Alipore Bomb Case' o sabo jora tongmani?

1908 bisini Alipore Bomb Case o, Aurobindo Ghosh, bini takhuk Barin Ghosh, tei tei kubuni 30 ni swlai bara jhogra-nai jora tongmani. Bohrok British officerrokno tharna bagwi bomb sano hwnwi aparadh rijakkha.
'Jallianwala Bagh' घटना ni ulo Rabindranath Tagore tamo khwlaikha?
O kosto घटना ni birodh o, Rabindranath Tagore British government ni rijak bini 'Knighthood' borom no phin rwkhamani.
'Kakori Conspiracy' tamo tongmani?
1925 bisio, HSRA ni memberrok, jemon Ram Prasad Bismil tei Ashfaqulla Khan, Kakori ni koro kaisa train no bathakwi, government ni rangno lukuiwi lakhamani. O घटना no se 'Kakori Conspiracy' hwn-o.
'Indian Independence Act 1947' no kon Parliament o pass khwlaijakha?
'Indian Independence Act 1947' no British Parliament o pass khwlaijakha. O niyam bai se British India no nwi swadhin haste, India tei Pakistan, o bakna tei power tisana.
Swadhin wngmung jorao, Kashmir karwi tei kon haste India bai jora wngna hamjakyamani?
Swadhin wngmung jorao, Hyderabad tei Junagadh haste bo puila India bai jora wngna 'ihi' sakhamani. Ulo, police action tei borokni vote ni bisingtwi o hasterok India bai jora wngkhamani.
Angno swadhinata jhograni khoroksa 'tribal' leader ni mung sa.

Birsa Munda khoroksa belai mungsajak tribal leader tongmani. Bo 19th century ni pogsao, Chotanagpur (tabukni Jharkhand) amchai o British शासन tei jomidarrokni against o 'Ulgulan' (kotor jhogra) khwlaikhamani.
'Wavell Plan' (1945) tamo tongmani?

Lord Wavell o plan o wansuk rikhamani ke Viceroy ni Executive Council no teisa sanai, jeba o Hindu tei Muslim member soman soman tongnai. Bini goal tongmani jhogra pognani ulo power tisani lama sanani.
'Royal Indian Navy mutiny' (1946) tamoni bagwi important?

1946 bisini o jhogra belai important, tamni hwnmale abo phunukha ke British शासन ni bagwi विश्वास tei borom tabuk Indian army ni bisingo bo kwmawi thang tongo. O ઘટના British no kodo khe India yakarnani bagwi tei bo jor khwlaikha.
Jhogra jorao, 'underground radio' no sabo cholaio mani?
1942 bisini 'Quit India Movement' jorao, Usha Mehta tei bini logisong kaisa 'underground radio' cholaio mani. Abo jhograni kokrokno borokrok thani tisamung, jephru newspaperrokno bondho khwlaijakha.
'Individual Satyagraha' (1940) ni puila Satyagrahi sabo tongmani?

'Individual Satyagraha' ni puila Satyagrahi wngkha Acharya Vinoba Bhave. Jawaharlal Nehru nwichi Satyagrahi tongmani. O jhogra World War II o India no jor khwlaiwi jora khwlaimung ni birodh o tongmani.
Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan no tamoni bagwi 'Frontier Gandhi' hwn-o?

Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan, North-West Frontier Province (tabukni Pakistan) ni khoroksa kotor leader, Mahatma Gandhi ni ahimsa (non-violence) ni wansukmungno belai manio mani. Aboni bagwi se bono 'Frontier Gandhi' hwn-o.
Swadhinata jhograni pogsani salrok o aswk jhogra tamoni barikhamani?
Jephru swadhin wngmung tei haste bakmung ni kok suri wngkha, Hindu tei Muslim ni bisingo kirimung tei विश्वास ni kom wngmung belai barikhamani. O kirimung se pogsao belai kotor jhogra o swlaikhamani.
Angno kaisa kothoma sa, jeba swadhinata jhograni bisingni.

Kothoma tongo ke, Bhagat Singh jail o tongma jorao, bini ama bono malaina phaikhamani. Bini mokol o muktwi nukwi, Bhagat Singh sakhamani, 'Ama, nwng tamoni kapo? Nwng khusi wngna nango ke nini bwsa haste ni bagwi langma rio'.
'At midnight, when the world sleeps, India will awake to life and freedom.' - O kokno sabo sakhamani?
O mungsajak kokno India ni puila Prime Minister, Jawaharlal Nehru, 1947 bisini August 14 ni horo, swadhin wngnani jorao, bini speech o sakhamani.
Swadhinata jhogra angno tamo swrwng rio?
Swadhinata jhogra chwngno swrwng rio ke thansa, gwran bwkha, tei jephruphano himmung bathakyawi tongkhe, joto ni swlai kotor kosto no bo phitaiwi mano.
Joto kokni bagwi hambai. Itihas saimana belai nango.
Belai lamsogo. Au, itihas saimana belai nango, tamni hwnmale 'jeba sakni itihas no pog-o, bo jephruphano kwtal itihas sanwi manya'. Kaham khe tongdi!
India ni food culture o aswk juda rokom tamoni nugo?

India ni food culture o aswk juda rokom nugo tamni hwnmale bini juda juda amchaini climate, hasam, tei kwbangma bisi jora ni itihas o phainai juda juda bosongni (jemon Mughals, British) asar ni bagwi.
North India tei South India ni chahmungni main pharak tamo?
North India o kwbangma roti, naan, tei gahu bai sakjak samung chah-o, tei bwtwi, paneer ni use bara. South India o mai, dosa, idli, tei narikol, kwkhwi (tamarind) ni use bara.
'Tandoor' tamo? Abo kon amchaini chahmungo use wngo?
Tandoor wngkha kaisa ha ni sakjak kwtung bhatti (oven). Abo North Indian food, phiya Punjabi chahmungo, naan, roti, tei tandoori chicken hai samung sano belai use wngo.
Punjabi chahmungni kaisa mungsajak mui ni mung sa.
Punjabi chahmungni kaisa hayung bisingo mungsajak mui wngkha 'Butter Chicken' (Murgh Makhani). Abono karwi bo 'Sarson da Saag' tei 'Makki di Roti' belai mungsajak.
Bengali chahmungo joto ni swlai important samung tamo?
Bengali chahmungo kasoi tei mai joto ni swlai important. Bohrok kwbangma rokom ni kwtwi twi ni tei sagar ni kasoi sano. 'Mustard thok' (mustard oil) bo bohrokni chahmungo belai use wngo.
'Panch Phoron' hwnmale tamo mosla?
'Panch Phoron' wngkha 5 ta moslani milimung, jeba Bengali tei East India ni chahmungo use wngo. Bini bisingo methi, kalo jeera, jeera, mustard, tei saunf tongo.
Rajasthani chahmungo twi kom use wngmani karan tamo?
Rajasthan kaisa kwran amchai wngmani bagwi, aroni kwcham chahmungo twi ni बदला o bwtwi, doi, eba ghee bara use wngo, jemon mui lama jora hamya wngya wngthung.
'Dal Baati Churma' kon haste ni mui?
'Dal Baati Churma' wngkha Rajasthan ni joto ni swlai mungsajak tei traditional mui. 'Baati' wngkha kwrak roti, jeba no dal tei kwtwi churma bai chah-o.
Gujarati thali o kwbangma mui tamoni kwtwi-kwkhwi wngo?
Gujarati chahmungo kwbangma jorao chini eba gur hapsio, jeba mui no kaisa kwtwi-kwkhwi tei juda taste rio. 'Dhokla' tei 'Thepla' bohrokni mungsajak mui.
'Biryani' kubui khe kon amchaini mui?

Biryani ni chengmung Mughal jorao wngkhamani hwnwi khwnao. Tabuk, India ni juda juda jaga o juda rokom ni Biryani mano, jemon Hyderabadi Biryani (belai spicy) tei Lucknowi Biryani (kom spicy, motom kaham).
Hyderabadi chahmungo kon शासकrokni asar nugo?
Hyderabadi chahmungo Mughal tei Nizam शासकrokni asar belai nugo. 'Hyderabadi Biryani' tei 'Haleem' o amchaini joto ni swlai mungsajak mui.
South India ni 4 ta main food culture tamo tamo?
South India ni 4 ta main food culture wngkha - Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Andhra Pradesh, tei Karnataka ni chahmung. Joto ni sano ni lama tei mosla juda juda.
'Idli' tei 'Dosa' sano tamo tamo nango?
Idli tei Dosa sano ni main samung wngkha mai tei urad dal. O nwi no bhijaiwi, grind khwlaiwi, tei kisa jora ferment khwlaina romo, jemon abo phul wngo tei kwkhwi wngo.
'Sambar' tei 'Rasam' ni bisingo pharak tamo?
Sambar wngkha dal tei bolong bai sakjak kaisa kotor mui. Rasam wngkha belai base, kwkhwi (tamarind) twi bai sakjak kaisa soup hai mui. Nwi no mai bai chah-o.
Kerala ni chahmungo narikol aswk kwbangma tamoni use wngo?
Kerala o narikol buphang belai kwbangma wngmani bagwi, bohrokni joto rokom ni chahmungo narikol, narikol ni bwtwi, eba narikol thok use wngo. Abo mui no kwtwi tei rich khwlaio.
'Sadya' hwnmale tamo? Abo buphru chah-o?
Sadya wngkha Kerala ni kaisa kotor vegetarian thali, jeba no thailik bwlai o chah-o. Bini bisingo 20 ni swlai bara rokom ni mui tongo. Abo bihik kaimani tei Onam festival jorao chah-o.
Andhra food tamoni bagwi aswk spicy hwnwi mungsajak?
Andhra Pradesh haste o mircha ni hasam belai kwbangma wngo, aboni bagwi se bohrokni chahmungo, phiya 'Guntur' mircha, belai kwbangma use wngo, jeba mui no belai spicy khwlaio.
'Chettinad cuisine' kon haste ni?
Chettinad cuisine wngkha Tamil Nadu ni Chettinad amchaini mui. O mui bini kwbangma rokom ni kwran mosla (jemon star anise, black stone flower) use khwlainani bagwi belai motom kaham tei spicy wngo.
Goan chahmungo kon bahira haste ni asar nugo?
Goan chahmungo Portuguese ni asar belai nugo, tamni hwnmale Goa 450 bisi jora Portuguese ni sakani tongmani. Mui ni mung, jemon 'Vindaloo', bo Portuguese kok ni simi phaikha.
Kashmiri chahmungni joto ni swlai kotor mui tamo?
Kashmiri chahmungni joto ni swlai kotor mui wngkha 'Wazwan'. Abo kaisa 36 rokom ni mui ni kotor thali, jeba o kwbangma rokom ni bahan ni mui tongo.
North-East India ni food culture o kon samung common nugo?
North-East India ni food culture o mai, bamboo shoot (muiya), tei berma/fermented samungrok belai common nugo. Bohrokni mui sadharanoto kom thok-mosla bai sakjak tei boil khwlaijak wngo.
Awadhi cuisine kon şehir bai jora tongo?
