Awadhi cuisine Lucknow şehir bai jora tongo. O chahmung belai suri suri tei kom horo rukjak (dum style) ni bagwi mungsajak. 'Galouti Kebab' o amchaini kaisa mungsajak mui.
India ni 'Street Food' aswk popular tamoni?
India ni Street Food kom dam o, hamjakgo, tei kodo khe man-o. Joto şehir ni juda juda street food o amchaini kubui taste no mano. Jemon, Mumbai ni Vada Pav, Delhi ni Chole Bhature.
'Chaat' hwnmale tamo rokom ni mui?
Chaat hwnmale kaisa rokom ni sohm-jak, spicy, kwtwi-kwkhwi taste ni milimung. Bini bisingo alu, chana, doi, tei kwbangma rokom ni chutney hapsio.
Parsi chahmungo kon nwi haste ni milimung nugo?
Parsi chahmungo Persian (Iranian) tei Gujarati chahmungni naithok milimung nugo. 'Dhansak' (dal, bolong tei bahan bai sakjak mui) bohrokni kaisa mungsajak mui.
India o chahmung bai धर्म ni jora tongo da?
Au, belai kotor jora tongo. Hindu धर्म o musuk bahan chahya, Muslim धर्म o uak bahan chahya. Jain धर्म o jeba ha ni sakani samung, jemon alu, piyaj, chahya.
'Prasad' hwnmale tamo?
Prasad wngkha o chahmung, jeba no puila Kaitorno puja rinani ulo, bhoktorokni bisingo bakwi rijago. Abo Kaitorni आशीर्वाद hwnwi wansukjak-o.
India ni kon amchai o 'non-vegetarian' chahmung kom?
Sadharanoto, Gujarat tei Rajasthan hai hasterok o, Jain tei Vaishnav Hindu धर्म ni asar ni bagwi, vegetarian chahmung se kwbangma chah-o.
India ni kon festival o 'Ghevar' hwnwi kwtwi chah-o?
'Ghevar', kaisa round, net hai naithok kwtwi, Rajasthan o Teej tei Raksha Bandhan festival jorao belai chah-o.
Angno kaisa Udupi cuisine ni mui ni mung sa.
Udupi cuisine (Karnataka ni) bini simple tei hamjakjak vegetarian mui ni bagwi mungsajak. 'Masala Dosa' ni chengmung Udupi ni simi se wngkhamani hwnwi khwnao.
'Thali' system tamo? Abo tamoni kaham?
Thali system wngkha kaisa kotor mairang o kwbangma rokom ni chuchu bati o juda juda mui (jemon dal, bolong, mai, roti, kwtwi) no logi logi chahmung. Abo kaisa balanced meal rio.
India ni chahmungo 'ghee' ni use tamo?
Ghee (kwthar मक्खन) no India o mui sano, roti o lagaina, tei mai o hapsiwi chahna use khwlaio. Ayurveda hisap o, abo mang ni bagwi belai kaham.
'Paan' chahmung tamo?
Paan wngkha betel bwlai ni bisingo supari, chuna, tei tei kubuni mosla hapsiwi, mai chahnani ulo khuk kwtharnani tei হজম ni bagwi chahmung.
Kon Indian kwtwi no 'King of Sweets' hwn-o?
Omo hai official mung kwrwi, phiya kwbangma borok Bengali 'Rosogolla' eba 'Gulab Jamun' no bohrokni hamjakmung hisap o o mung bai ringo.
'Ayurveda' hisap o chahmungni niyam tamo?
Ayurveda hisap o, chahmung 6 ta taste (kwtwi, kwkhwi, sohm-jak, kwkha, spicy, tei kwsai) ni milimung wngna nango. Abo mangni 3 ta dosha (Vata, Pitta, Kapha) no balance khwlaio.
'Pickle' (Achar) India ni chahmungo tamoni aswk important?
Achar mai bai logi kaisa extra taste rio, tei chahmungni hamjakmungno bario. Abo kwran mol jorao, jephru bolong kom mano, o jorao chahna bagwi bo sano.
'Dum' style o rukmung hwnmale bahai?
'Dum' style o rukmung hwnmale, mui no kaisa kaham khe bondho khwlaijak handi o, belai kom horo, lama jora jora rukmung. Abo bai mui ni motom bisingo se tongo.
Angno India ni kaisa ajgubi mui ni kok sa.
Chhattisgarh o 'Chaprah' hwnwi kaisa chutney chah-o, jeba kwchak mospolo (red ants) tei bohrokni bwtwi bai sano. Abo belai kwkhwi tei spicy wngo.
Chahmung sano ni jorao 'tempering' (tadka) khwlaimung tamo?
Tadka khwlaimung hwnmale, kwtung thok eba ghee o jeera, mustard, kwran mircha hai mosla rokno phutmung, tei o milimungno dal eba mui ni sakao hapsimung. Abo mui no belai kaham motom rio.
India ni juda juda amchai o roti sano ni lama juda da?
Au, juda. North o gahu ni roti sano, Rajasthan o bajra ni roti (Rotlo) sano, tei Punjab o makai ni roti (Makki di Roti) sano. Joto ni taste tei texture juda.
'Kulfi' tei 'ice cream' ni pharak tamo?

Kulfi no bwtwi no belai jora rukwi kotor khwlaiwi sano, tei abono pogsao freeze khwlaio. Ice cream o bwtwi no rukya se, cream bai sano tei sano ni jorao nobar hapsio, aboni bagwi abo tei bo soft wngo.
'Chai' (cha) India o aswk popular bahai wngkha?

British jorao cha bagan chengmani ulo, cha ni bepar barainani bagwi companyrok India o belai advertisement khwlaikha. Jwng jwng khe, bwtwi tei mosla bai milaiwi, cha Indian borokni salbrumni langma ni bhag wngkha.
India ni kon amchai o 'bamboo' ni bisingo mui sano?
North-East India ni kwbangma amchai o, jemon Nagaland, Arunachal Pradesh, tei Tripura o, bahan eba kasoi no mosla bai milaiwi, kwtal wa ni bisingo hapsiwi horo jwonwi ruk-o.
'Mughlai cuisine' ni kaisa kotor guna tamo?
Mughlai cuisine bini rich gravy, kwran फल (jemon badam, kaju), tei motom kaham mosla (jemon saffron, cardamom) ni use ni bagwi mungsajak. Jemon, Korma, Nihari.
India ni juda juda amchai o 'pitha' sano ni lama juda da?
Au, belai juda. Bengal o 'Patisapta' (kwtwi), Bihar o 'Pitha' (sohm-jak dal tongnai), tei Assam o 'Til Pitha' (til tongnai) sano. Joto ni sano ni samung tei taste juda.
Angno kaisa 'fusion food' ni example ri di, jeba India o famous.
'Chilli Chicken' eba 'Gobi Manchurian' wngkha Indian-Chinese fusion food ni belai kaham example. Abo Chinese sano ni lama tei Indian mosla ni milimung.
India ni kon amchai o 'seafood' joto ni swlai kwbangma chah-o?
India ni sagar koro ni joto amchai, jemon Goa, Kerala, West Bengal, tei Mumbai o seafood belai kwbangma chah-o. Aro kwthar kasoi, prawn, tei crab belai mano.
'Langar' hwnmale tamo? Abo kon धर्म bai jora tongo?
Langar wngkha Sikh धर्म ni Gurudwara o tongnai free community kitchen. Aro joto borok, jeba धर्म eba jat wngphano, logi logi achukwi mai chahna mano.
India ni kon state no 'Land of Spices' hwn-o?
Kerala haste no kwcham jora ni simi se mosla-mosli ni bepar ni kotor jaga wngmani bagwi 'Land of Spices' hwn-o.
'Malabar Parotta' tei 'Laccha Paratha' kaisa se da?
Nwi no naina kisa milio, phiya sano ni lama juda. Malabar Parotta (Kerala ni) maida bai sano tei belai soft wngo. Laccha Paratha (North India ni) kwbangma jorao atta bai sano tei kisa crispy wngo.
'Lassi' kon haste ni nwngmung?
Lassi kubui khe Punjab haste ni nwngmung. Abo doi, twi, tei chini (kwtwi lassi) eba sohm-mosla (sohm-jak lassi) bai milaiwi sano. Kwtung jorao nwngna belai kaham.
Angno India ni kaisa kwcham jorani chahmung ni kok sa, jeba tabuk kom mano.
Kwcham jorao, phiya hachuk amchai o, borokrok 'fermented bamboo shoot' no belai chah-o mani. Tabuk bo mano, phiya şehir amchai o bini use belai kom wngkha.
India ni chahmungo yasi bai chahmung ni niyam tamo?
Traditional hisap o, India o yagra yasi bai se mai chah-o. Yaksi yasi no hamya eba kwthar ya hwnwi wansukjak-o. Yasi bai chahmung bai chahmungni taste tei bo kaham wngo hwnwi khwnao.
'Bhang' tamo? Abo kon festival o use wngo?
Bhang wngkha cannabis buphang ni bwlai ni simi sakjak kaisa samung. Abono kwbangma jorao Holi festival o 'Thandai' eba 'Lassi' o milaiwi nwngo.
'Sattvic food' hwnmale tamo rokom ni chahmung?
Sattvic food wngkha Ayurvedic tei yogic wansukmungo, joto ni swlai kwthar tei simple chahmung. Bini bisingo piyaj, garlic, bahan-kasoi, tei kwbangma mosla wngya. Abo mon no santi rio hwn-o.
India ni 'wedding feast' o tamo juda nugo?
India ni wedding feast belai kotor wngo. Jaga ni hisap o, vegetarian eba non-vegetarian kwbangma rokom ni mui sano. Kwbangma jorao 100 ni swlai bara rokom ni mui bo tongo.
Angno India ni kaisa ajgubi फल ni mung sa.
'Tadgola' eba 'Ice Apple' (palm fruit) kaisa ajgubi tei hamjakjak फल. Abo kwtung jorao mano, tei bisingo jelly hai twi tongo. Chahna belai refreshing wngo.
India ni borokrok aswk kwbangma mosla tamoni chah-o?
Kaisa wansukmung hisap o, kwtung amchai o mosla chahmung chahmungno kodo hamya wngmung ni simi bachio. Tei bo, mosla chahmungno belai hamjakgo khwlaio tei mang ni bagwi bo kaham guna tongo.
India ni kon amchai o 'insect' (kiri) chah-o?
North-East India ni kwbangma amchai, jemon Nagaland tei Manipur o, juda juda rokom ni kiri, jemon silkworm, red ants, no fry khwlaiwi eba chutney sanwi chah-o.
'Shahi Paneer' tei 'Kadai Paneer' ni pharak tamo?
Shahi Paneer ni gravy kwtwi tei creamy wngo, jeba o kaju, cream ni use wngo. Kadai Paneer ni gravy spicy wngo tei bisingo kotor khe khajak capsicum tei piyaj tongo.
'Momo' kubui khe India ni mui da?
Ihi, Momo kubui khe India ni mui ya. Abo Tibet tei Nepal ni mui. Phiya tabuk India ni joto jaga o, phiya North-East tei North India o, belai popular wngkha.
India ni borokrokni chahmung habit phainai salo bahai swlainai?
Phainai salo, Indian borokrok tei bo bara 'health-conscious' wngnai, tei kwcham jorani healthy mui (jemon millets) teisa phinwi phainai. Phiya, international food ni hamjakmung bo barinai.
Angno India ni kaisa 'lost recipe' ni kok sa.
Mughal jorani kaisa 'lost recipe' wngkha 'Moti Pulao' (Pearl Pulao). O pulao o, tok bwtwi no silver foil bai naithok khe khwlaiwi chuchu moti (pearl) hai sanwi mai o hapsio mani. Sano belai kosto.
India ni chahmung bai jora kaisa kaham film ni mung sa.
'The Lunchbox' (2013) kaisa belai naithok film. Abo Mumbai ni 'Dabbawala' system tei chahmungni bisingtwi nwi siniya borokni kahani no phunugo.
Angni joto swngmung ni kiphilmung rikha. Tini tamo mui sanai, wansukwi tongo.
Belai lamsogo! Ang asha khwlaio nwng kaisa naithok Indian mui sanwi chahnai. Jeba sano, mon khusi wngwi chahdi. Kaham khe tongdi!
Hor (fire) no control khwlaino swrwngmung borokni itihas o tamo swlaimung tubukha?

Hor no control khwlaino swrwngmung bai, kwcham borokrok chahmungno rukwi chahna chengkha, jeba bai হজম kaham wngkha, kwchang ni simi bachanani lama mankha, tei hamya malmatarokno hakchalo romna mankha. Abo civilization ni kaisa kotor yapri.
'Wheel' (Chakka) ni a आविष्कार tamoni bagwi aswk important?
Wheel ni a आविष्कार bai transport belai easy wngwi thangkha. Hilik samungrokno kaisa jaga ni simi tei kaisa o tubuna tei pottery sano hai kam o bo kotor swlaimung phaikha.
Hasam-khilim (agriculture) ni chengmung borokni langmano bahai swlaikha?
Hasam-khilim ni chengmung bai borokrok शिकार khwlaiwi beramung yakarwi, kaisa jaga o tongwi, kami sanwi tongna chengkha. Abo population barinani tei kwtal somaj sanani lama khukha.
Swinani chengmung (writing) ni lab tamo tongmani?
Swinani chengmung bai aklangmung, itihas, tei niyam-kanun no joma khwlaiwi romna tei kaisa generation ni simi tei kaisa o tisana belai easy wngkha. Abo kotor samrajya cholaithokna chubakha.
Gravity ni niyam no sabo discover khwlaikha?
Sir Isaac Newton gravity ni niyam no discover khwlaikha. Kothoma tongo ke bo kaisa apple buphang ni sakani kwmainai nukwi o wansukmung chengkhamani.
Nicolaus Copernicus astronomy o tamo kotor wansukmung rikhamani?
Nicolaus Copernicus o wansukmung rikhamani ke hayung bisingni bising ya, phiya Sal se chini solar system ni bising, tei hayung tei tei kubuni planetrok Salno bir-o.
Galileo Galilei telescope use khwlaiwi tamo tamo nukhamani?
Galileo Galilei telescope use khwlaiwi Jupiter ni 4 ta tal, Venus ni aakar swlaimung, tei tal ni sakao hachukrok nukhamani. Abo Copernicus ni theory no support khwlaikha.
Electricity ni a आविष्कार no sabo credit rijago?

Kwbangma borok o kam o jora tongmani, phiya Benjamin Franklin bini mungsajak kite experiment bai phunukha ke pherang o electricity tongo. Michael Faraday electricity ni tei bo guna discover khwlaikha.
Albert Einstein ni 'Theory of Relativity' (E=mc²) tamo sao?
Einstein ni theory sao ke time tei space kaisa ya, aborok speed ni sakao swlaio. Bini mungsajak formula E=mc² phunugo ke mass (borom) no energy o tei energy no mass o swlaiwi mano.
Electron no sabo discover khwlaikha?
Electron no 1897 bisio J.J. Thomson discover khwlaikhamani. O a आविष्कार bai borokrok bujikha ke atom no tei bo bakna mano tei abo chuchu particle bai sakjak.
DNA ni double helix aakar no sabo sabo discover khwlaikha?
DNA ni double helix aakar no 1953 bisio James Watson tei Francis Crick, Rosalind Franklin ni X-ray photo ni chubamung bai, discover khwlaikhamani. Abo genetics no bujinani lama khukha.
Penicillin ni a आविष्कार bahai wngkhamani?

Penicillin no 1928 bisio Alexander Fleming bul wngwi discover khwlaikhamani. Bo nukhamani ke bini lab o kaisa mold (fungus) bacteria rokno tharwi tongo. O a आविष्कार medicine o kotor swlaimung tubukha.
Vaccination ni concept no sabo puila chengkhamani?

Vaccination ni concept no Edward Jenner 18th century o chengkhamani. Bo nukhamani ke jeba borokno cowpox (musuk ni hamya) wngo, bohrokno smallpox wngya. O a आविष्कार bai kwbangma hamya-marokno bathakwi mankha.
Louis Pasteur ni joto ni swlai kotor kam tamo?

Louis Pasteur phunukha ke kwbangma hamya-marok chuchu chuchu malmata (microbes) ni bagwi wngo. Bo 'pasteurization' (bwtwi kwtung khwlaiwi bacteria tharmung) tei rabies ni vaccine bo discover khwlaikhamani.
'Periodic Table' no sabo sano?
Periodic Table ni kwtal aakar no Dmitri Mendeleev, khoroksa Russian chemist, 1869 bisio sano. Bo elementrokno bohrokni atomic weight hisap o sajikhamani.
Oxygen gas no sabo discover khwlaikha?
Oxygen gas no 18th century o Joseph Priestley tei Carl Wilhelm Scheele, nwi jono juda juda khe, discover khwlaikhamani. O a आविष्कार chemistry no pura swlai rwkha.
Printing press ni a आविष्कार itihas o tamo asar khwlaikha?

15th century o Johannes Gutenberg ni printing press ni a आविष्कार bai bijap belai kodo tei kom dam o chapa wngna chengkha. Abo aklangmung, pora-lekha, tei kwtal wansukmung borokrok thani belai kodo khe tisakha.
Steam engine ni a आविष्कार tamoni bagwi aswk kotor?
James Watt ni kaham khwlaijak steam engine Industrial Revolution ni chengmung wngkha. Abo factory, train, tei jahaj cholaithokna gwranmung rikhamani, tei somaj no pura swlai rwkhamani.
Telephone no sabo a आविष्कार khwlaikha?
Telephone no 1876 bisio Alexander Graham Bell a आविष्कार khwlaikhamani. Abo borokrokni kok samung ni lama no pura swlai rwkha, jemon hakchal tongnai borokrok bo kodo khe kok sai mano.
Thomas Edison ni joto ni swlai mungsajak a आविष्कार tamo?
Thomas Edison ni joto ni swlai mungsajak a आविष्कार wngkha 1879 bisini electric light bulb. Abo horo no sal khwlaikha tei borokni kam khwlainani jorano barai rwkha.
Puila motor gari (automobile) no sabo sano?
Puila petrol bai cholonai motor gari no 1886 bisio Karl Benz sano. O a आविष्कार borokni himmung tei şehirni aakar no pura swlai rwkha.
Wright brothers tamo a आविष्कार khwlaikha?
1903 bisio, Orville tei Wilbur Wright puila gwranmung bai cholonai, borom bai cholonai airplane no sakha tei biraikha. Abo hayungni transport no teisa swlaikha.
'The Internet' ni chengmung bahai wngkhamani?
Internet ni chengmung 1960s o US military ni kaisa project (ARPANET) hisap o wngkhamani, jeba ni goal tongmani computerrokni bisingo jora rommung. Ulo se abo joto borokni bagwi khulijakha.
'Transistor' ni a आविष्कार tamoni bagwi kotor?
1947 bisio a आविष्कार wngjak transistor bai se tabukni joto chuchu tei gwran electronic samung, jemon computer, mobile phone, sano sambhav wngkha. Abo kwcham jorani kotor vacuum tube no swlaikha.
Charles Darwin ni 'Theory of Evolution' tamo sao?
Charles Darwin bini 'On the Origin of Species' bijap o sakha ke joton langma tongnai samungrok 'natural selection' ni bisingtwi, kwbangma jora ni ulo, jwng jwng khe swlaio tei kwtal rokom o achaio.
Gregor Mendel no tamoni bagwi 'Father of Genetics' hwn-o?

Gregor Mendel, khoroksa monk, motor buphangni sakao experiment khwlaiwi, a आविष्कार khwlaikha ke ama-apha ni gunarok chwrai-bwsa ni thani kisa niyam maniw se phai-o. O niyamrokno se 'Mendelian inheritance' hwn-o.
Radioactivity no sabo discover khwlaikha?
Radioactivity no 1896 bisio Henri Becquerel bul wngwi discover khwlaikhamani. Ulo, Marie tei Pierre Curie o bishoy o tei bo kotor kam khwlaikhamani tei Radium tei Polonium a आविष्कार khwlaikhamani.
'Plate Tectonics' theory tamo sao?
O theory sao ke hayungni bahira ni kwrak jaga (crust) kotor kotor plate o bakjak tongo, jeba rok suri suri himwi tongo. O himmung ni bagwi se earthquake, volcano, tei hachuk sano.
'Big Bang Theory' tamo phunugo?

Big Bang Theory wngkha chini hayung bising (universe) ni chengmung ni sakao joto ni swlai maniojak scientific theory. O theory hisap o, hayung bising 13.8 billion bisi swkang kaisa belai kwtung tei kotor jaga ni simi phatwi chengkhamani.
Edwin Hubble ni joto ni swlai kotor discovery tamo?
Edwin Hubble 1920s o phunukha ke chini Milky Way galaxy karwi tei bo kwbangma galaxy tongo, tei o galaxyrok kaisa-kaisa ni simi hakchalo himwi tongo. Abo hayung bising barungwi tongo hwnwi phunukha.
Anesthesia ni a आविष्कार medical o tamo swlaimung tubukha?

Anesthesia ni a आविष्कार ni swkang, operation belai samung tei kosto ni kam tongmani. Abo borokno operation jorao thum rina ni lama khukha, tei tei bo kotor tei kosto operation khwlaino sambhav khwlaikha.
Blood circulation no mangni bisingo sabo discover khwlaikha?
Mangni bisingo blood ni pura circulation system no 1628 bisio William Harvey discover khwlaikha. Bo phunukha ke bwkha kaisa pump hai kam tango tei blood no mang bisingo bir rio.
'Cell' no puila sabo nukhamani?
Cell no puila 17th century o Robert Hooke, kaisa chuchu microscope bai, cork ni base tukra o nukhamani. Bo aborokno chuchu room hai nukwi 'cell' hwnwi mung rikhamani.
Angno kaisa kwcham jorani mungsajak civilization ni mung sa, jeba ni kok tabuk jora jora poriwi manyakhu.
Indus Valley Civilization (Harappan Civilization) ni swijak kok (script) tabuk jora jora bo scientistrok poriwi bini অর্থ khukwi manyakhu. Abo itihas ni kaisa kotor mystery.
Rosetta Stone ni discovery tamoni bagwi aswk important?

Rosetta Stone belai important tamni hwnmale bini sakao kaisa kokno se 3 ta juda kok (Egyptian hieroglyphs, Demotic script, tei kwcham Greek) o swijak tongmani. Abo bai se scientistrok kwcham Egypt ni hieroglyphs no porina swrwngkha.
Machu Picchu no sabo hayungno teisa sini rwkha?
Machu Picchu, Inca ni kwcham şehir, no 1911 bisio American explorer Hiram Bingham hayungno teisa sini rwkhamani. O şehir hachuk sakao lukuiwi tongmani.
Plastics ni a आविष्कार ni kaham tei hamya nwi thani tamo?
Plastic ni kaham thani wngkha abo kom dam, heleng, tei kwbangma kam o phai-o. Hamya thani wngkha abo ha o belai lama jora posoya se tongo, tei pollution ni kotor karan wngo.
Calculus no sabo a आविष्कार khwlaikha?
Calculus no 17th century ni pogsao, Isaac Newton tei Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz, nwi jono juda juda khe, phiya kaisa jorao se, a आविष्कार khwlaikhamani.
'Zero' (0) ni concept no puila kon civilization use khwlaikha?
'Zero' no kaisa number hisap o puila India ni mathematicianrok, phiya Brahmagupta, 7th century o use khwlaina chengkhamani. Abo mathematics o kotor swlaimung tubukha.
'Lucy' hwnmale tamo? Abo tamoni important?
'Lucy' wngkha 3.2 million bisi swkangni kaisa 'Australopithecus afarensis' ni fossil (bekereng), jeba Ethiopia o manjakha. Abo borokni evolution o, nwi yakung bai himmung ni, kotor প্রমাণ rio.
Insulin ni a आविष्कार kon hamya ni bagwi asirbad wngkha?
1921 bisio insulin ni a आविष्कार diabetes hamya tongnai borokrokni bagwi kaisa kotor asirbad wngkha. Bini swkang, o hamya wngkhe borokrok belai kodo thwio mani.
GPS (Global Positioning System) puila tamoni bagwi sakjakhamani?
GPS system no puila US military ni bagwi sakjakhamani, jemon bohrokni soldier, jahaj, tei airplane ni kubui jaga no saimana mano. Ulo se abo joto borokni bagwi khulijakha.
Angno kaisa tei kubuni planet ni discovery ni kok sa.
Uranus no 1781 bisio William Herschel puila telescope bai discover khwlaikhamani. Bini swkang, joto planetrokno sirif mokol bai se nugo mani.
'Dark Matter' tei 'Dark Energy' tamo?

O nwi no scientistrok tabuk jora jora bo kaham khe bujiya. Dark Matter wngkha kaisa ajgubi samung jeba ni gravity galaxyrokno jora khwlaiwi romo. Dark Energy wngkha kaisa ajgubi gwranmung jeba hayung bisingno tei bo kodo khe pherna chubaiwi tongo.
CRISPR gene editing technology tamo?

CRISPR wngkha kaisa kwtal tei gwran technology, jeba bai scientistrok DNA no belai suri suri tei kaham khe khaui, hapsiwi, eba swlaiwi mano. Abo genetics hamya-marokno ham khwlainani lama khui rina mano.
Gravitational waves no discover khwlaimung tamoni kotor?
2015 bisio gravitational waves no puila discover khwlaimung Albert Einstein ni theory no teisa kubui hwnwi phunukha. Abo chwngno hayung bisingno naina tei bujinani kaisa kwtal 'mokol' rikhamani.
World Wide Web (WWW) no sabo a आविष्कार khwlaikha?
World Wide Web no 1989 bisio Tim Berners-Lee, khoroksa British scientist, a आविष्कार khwlaikha. Abo internet o information no share khwlainani tei manani lama no belai easy khwlaikha.
Puila rocket no sabo sakha tei hayungni bahira o tisakha?
Puila liquid-fueled rocket no Robert Goddard 1926 bisio sakha tei biraikha. Phiya, hayungni bahira o puila samung (Sputnik satellite) no Soviet Union 1957 bisio tisakhamani.
Exoplanet hwnmale tamo?
Exoplanet hwnmale o rokom ni planet, jeba chini Salno birya se, tei kubuni athukirirokno biro. Puila exoplanet 1992 bisio discover wngkhamani.
Angno kaisa ajgubi archaeological discovery ni kok sa.

Turkey o 'Göbekli Tepe' hwnwi kaisa jaga tongo, jeba 11,000 bisi ni swlai swkang sakjakha. Abo hayung bisingni joto ni swlai kwcham mandir hwnwi wansukjak-o, tei abo hasam-khilim chengmani swkang se sakjakha.
'Placebo Effect' hwnmale tamo wngo?
Placebo Effect wngkha, jephru khoroksa borokno tatal marok (jemon chini ni tablet) riwi, 'omo kaham marok' hwnwi sajak-o, tei o borok kubui khe ham wngna cheng-o. Abo aklani gwranmungno phunugo.
'Law of Conservation of Energy' tamo sao?
O niyam sao ke energy no sano bo manya, tei phatbarna bo manya. Abono sirif kaisa aakar ni simi tei kaisa aakar o swlaiwi se mano.
Hayungni age no bahai map-o?
Scientistrok hayungni joto ni swlai kwcham hapung tei meteorite rokni radioactive dating khwlaiwi, hayungni age 4.5 billion bisi swk wngnai hwnwi khukha.
'Quarks' tamo? Aborokno discover khwlaijakha da?
Quarks wngkha joto ni swlai chuchu fundamental particle, jeba rok milaiwi proton tei neutron rokno sano. Bohrokni tongmungno 1960s o experiment bai প্রমাণ khwlaijakha.
Chini mangni bisingo bacteria kaham bo tongo da?
Au, belai kwbangma tongo. Chini bohok o million million kaham bacteria tongo, jeba rok chahmung হজম khwlainani tei hamya bacteria ni simi bachanani chubai-o.
Graphene tamo samung tei tamoni bagwi special?
Graphene wngkha carbon ni kaisa belai base layer. Abo steel ni swlai 200 guna gwran, phiya belai heleng. Abo future ni electronics tei tei kubuni kam o belai use wngnai.
Deep-sea vents ni discovery tamoni bagwi important?

1977 bisio deep-sea vents (sagar ni bisingni kwtung twi ongnai jaga) ni discovery scientistrokno ajgubi khwlaikha. O komok tei kwtung jaga o bo, Sal ni chwngmung yakarwi, kwbangma ajgubi langma tongo.
'Classical Conditioning' no sabo discover khwlaikha?
Classical Conditioning no Ivan Pavlov, khoroksa Russian scientist, discover khwlaikhamani. Bo bini mungsajak experiment o, swihno ghanta ni khorang khnaui khuk bwtwi ongnani swrwng rwkhamani.
DNA fingerprinting technology bahai kam tango?
O technology khoroksa borokni DNA ni unique pattern no use khwlaio. Abo aparadhi saina, tei chwrai-bwsa ni ama-apha sabo, abo saina bagwi use wngo.
Puila antibiotic, penicillin, karwi tei kaisa mungsajak antibiotic ni mung sa.
Selman Waksman 1943 bisio Streptomycin no discover khwlaikha. O marok tuberculosis (TB) hamya no ham khwlainani puila kaham marok tongmani.
Antarctica continent no buphru discover khwlaijakha?
Antarctica ni tongmungno kwbangma jora wansukjak phano, abono puila kubui khe 1820 bisio Russian expedition ni borokrok nukhamani.
'Higgs Boson' no tamoni bagwi 'God Particle' hwn-o?
Abono 'God Particle' hwn-o (phiya kwbangma scientist o mung hamjakya) tamni hwnmale o particle se tei kubuni joto fundamental particle rokno 'mass' (borom) rio hwnwi wansukjak-o.
Joto discovery ni bisingo, kon no nwng joto ni swlai important wansukgo?

Abo sana belai kosto, tamni hwnmale joto discovery kaisa-kaisa bai jora tongo. Phiya, 'hor' (fire) no control khwlaimung se joto ni goran wngwi mano, tamni hwnmale abo se borokno tei kubuni malmata ni simi juda khwlaiwi, aklangmungni lama o puila yapri rom rikhamani.
Angni joto swngmungni kiphilmung rikha. Ang belai swrwngjakha.
Belai lamsogo. Borokni swrwngnani icha se joto kotor discovery ni piska o tongnai gwranmung. Jephruphano swrwngwi tongdi. Kaham khe tongdi!
Christianity o 'Baptism' hwnmale tamo?
Baptism wngkha kaisa pavitra niyam, jeba o borokno twi bai sup rwi eba sakao twi hapsiwi, bini pap supjakha tei bo Christian somaj o jora wngkha hwnwi phunugo.
Islam o 'Hajj' tamoni bagwi aswk kotor?
Hajj wngkha Mecca (Saudi Arabia) thani kaisa pavitra beramung. Jeba Muslim ni mang tei rang ni gwranmung tongo, bono langmao kaisa jora Hajj khwlaimung bini bagwi kotor niyam (farz).
Hinduism o 'Puja' khwlaimung ni main goal tamo?
Puja khwlaimung ni main goal wngkha Kaitor eba Devi-Devtano mwnwimung, borom rinani, tei bohrokni thani आशीर्वाद (blessings) nani. Abo chahmung, bubar, tei mantra bai khwlaijak-o.
Buddhism o 'Meditation' (Dhyan) tamoni bagwi nango?
Meditation wngkha Buddhism ni kaisa kotor practice. Bini goal wngkha mon no santi khwlaimung, aklangmungno kaham khwlaimung, tei kubui aklangmung (enlightenment) ni lama o himmung.
Judaism o 'Sabbath' (Shabbat) tamo?
Sabbath wngkha Friday sanja ni simi Saturday sanja jora, kaisa aram ni sal. O jorao, Jewish borokrok jeba kam khwlaiya se, nukhung bai jora wngo tei Kaitorno wansugo.
Sikhism o 'Langar' ni wansukmung tamo?
Langar wngkha Gurudwara o tongnai free kitchen, jeba o joto borok, jeba jat-धर्म wngphano, logi logi achukwi mai chahna mano. Abo somanmung tei borokno chubamung ni wansukmungno phunugo.
'Shinto' धर्म o 'Kami' hwnmale sabo?
Shinto (Japan ni kwcham धर्म) o 'Kami' hwnmale juda juda Kaitor, atma, eba pavitra samungrokno bujio. Bohrok ha, twima, buphang hai joton jaga o tongwi mano hwnwi wansukjak-o.
Jainism o 'Ahimsa' (non-violence) ni niyam aswk gwran tamoni?
Jainism o Ahimsa joto ni swlai kotor niyam. Bohrok wansukgo ke joton langma tongnai samung (borok, malmata, eba buphang) ni bisingo atma tongo, tei jeba no kosto rina pap wngo.
Christianity o 'Communion' (Eucharist) jorao tamo khwlaio?
Communion jorao, Christianrok roti (bread) tei wine no chah-o eba nwngo. Abo Jesus Christ ni mang tei bwtwi no wansuk rio, jeba bo borokni pap ni bagwi rikhamani.
Islam o 'Ramadan' talo tamo khwlaio?
Ramadan talo, Muslimrok phung ni simi sal kwmai jora, chahmung, nwngmung, tei tei kubuni kam ni simi hakchalo tongo (roza romo). Abo atma no kwthar khwlainani tei gorib borokni kosto bujinani jora.
Hinduism o 'Karma' ni niyam tamo sao?
Karma ni niyam sao ke joto borokni kaham kam kaham phol rio, tei hamya kam hamya phol rio. O phol o langmao eba phainai langmao bo manwi mano.
Buddhism ni 'Four Noble Truths' tamo tamo?
Four Noble Truths wngkha: 1. Langma o kosto tongo. 2. Kosto ni karan wngkha icha tei hamjakmung. 3. O icha no yakar khe kosto no pog rina mano. 4. O kosto pog rinani lama wngkha 'Eightfold Path'.
Judaism o 'Kosher' chahmung hwnmale tamo?
Kosher hwnmale o rokom ni chahmung, jeba Jewish धर्म ni niyam hisap o chahna mano. Jemon, uak bahan chahna man-ya, tei bahan tei bwtwi no logi logi chahna man-ya.
Sikhism ni 'Five Ks' (panch kakar) tamo tamo?
Baptized Sikh (Khalsa) rok 5 ta samung jephruphano mang o romo: Kesh (khwnai khaya), Kangha (khwnai sanai), Kara (yasi ni lohani mala), Kachera (chuchu photlong), tei Kirpan (chuchu churi).
Taoism (China ni धर्म) o 'Yin and Yang' ni wansukmung tamo?
Yin and Yang phunugo ke hayung bisingni joton samung nwi juda, phiya kaisa-kaisa no pura khwlainai gwranmung bai sakjak. Jemon, hor (Yin) tei sal (Yang), bwrwi (Yin) tei chwla (Yang).
Baha'i Faith ni main विश्वास tamo?
Baha'i Faith ni main विश्वास wngkha joto धर्म kaisa Kaitorni simi se ongkha tei joto borok kaisa nukhung ni borok. Bohrok hayung bisingo thansa tei somanmung sanani kok sao.
Zoroastrianism o hor (fire) no tamoni bagwi borom rwo?
Zoroastrianism o hor no Kaitor (Ahura Mazda) ni kwtharmung tei chwngmungni symbol hisap o nugo. Aboni bagwi se bohrokni mandir (Fire Temple) o jephruphano hor jwonwi tongo.
Hinduism o 'Moksha' manmung hwnmale tamo?
Moksha manmung hwnmale achaimung tei thwimung ni chakka (samsara) ni simi swadhin wngmung. Abo Hindu langma ni pogsani tei joto ni swlai kotor goal.
Islam o 'Zakat' hwnmale tamo?
Zakat wngkha kaisa salbrumni dan. Muslimrok bohrokni joma khwlaijak rang-ri ni kisa bhag (sadharanoto 2.5%) gorib tei nangnai borokrokno rinani niyam.
Christianity o 'Good Friday' no tamoni palon khwlaio?
Good Friday o, Christianrok Jesus Christ ni cross o thwimungno wansugo. Abo kosto ni sal wng phano, 'Good' hwn-o tamni hwnmale o thwimung bai se borokni pap supjakha hwnwi विश्वास khwlaijak-o.
Buddhism o 'Nirvana' ni अवस्था bahai wngo?
Nirvana wngkha kaisa pogsani अवस्था, jeba o joton kosto, icha, tei hamya wansukmung kwmawi thango. Abo pura santi tei swadhin ni अवस्था.
Judaism o 'Passover' festival o tamo wansukjak-o?
Passover jorao, Jewish borokrok kwcham Egypt ni দাস wngmung ni simi bohrokni swadhin wngmungno wansugo. O jorao kaisa special chahmung (Seder) chah-o.
'Guru Granth Sahib' no Sikhrok tamoni bagwi aswk borom rwo?
Sikhrok 'Guru Granth Sahib' no sirif kaisa pavitra bijap hisap o naiya, phiya abono bohrokni pogsani tei jephruphano tongnai Guru hisap o mano. Aboni bagwi aswk borom rwo.
Shinto mandir o borokrok hapnani swkang tamo khwlaio?
Shinto mandir o hapnani swkang, borokrok kaisa twi ni jaga o yasi tei khuk no sup rwi sakno kwthar khwlaio. O niyam no 'Temizu' hwn-o.
Jainism o 'Sallekhana' (Santhara) hwnmale tamo niyam?
Sallekhana wngkha kaisa belai gwran niyam, jeba o khoroksa Jain monk eba borok, jeba ni langma ni kam joton wngkha hwnwi wansukgo, bo suri suri chahmung-nwngmung yakarwi, santi bai thwimungno lachio.
Hinduism o 'Trimurti' hwnmale kon khoroktham Kaitorno bujio?
Trimurti hwnmale khoroktham kotor Kaitor - Brahma (hayung sanai), Vishnu (hayung bachinai), tei Shiva (hayung phatbarnai) - no bujio.
Islam o 'Sharia' niyam tamo?
Sharia wngkha Islamic niyam-kanun, jeba Quran tei Prophet Muhammad ni swrwngmung ni sakao sakjak. Abo Muslimrokni salbrumni langma, nukhung, tei somaj ni joto kam no cholaio.
Christianity o 'Saints' sabo? Bohrokno tamoni mwnwi-o?

Saints wngkha o rokom ni borok, jeba rokni langma belai pavitra tei Kaitorni belai koro tongmani hwnwi wansukjak-o. Borokrok bohrok thani आशीर्वाद nani tei Kaitor thani bohrokni bagwi kok sanani swng-o.
'Vesak' (Buddha Purnima) salo Buddhistrok tamo khwlaio?
Vesak salo, Buddhistrok Gautam Buddha ni achaimung, aklangmung manmung (enlightenment), tei thwimung (parinirvana), o khoroktham kotor घटना no logi logi wansugo.
Judaism ni pavitra bijap 'Torah' o tamo swijak tongo?
Torah o Jewish borokni puila 5 ta bijap tongo. Bini bisingo hayung sanmung ni kok, Jewish borokni itihas, tei Kaitorni rijak niyam-kanun (jemon Ten Commandments) swijak tongo.
'Waheguru' mungni अर्थ tamo?
'Waheguru' wngkha Sikhism o Kaitorno ringnai kaisa kotor mung. Bini अर्थ wngkha 'Ajgubi Swrwng Rinaisa' eba 'Komok ni simi Chwngmung thani Tubuinai'.
Taoism ni kotor bijap ni mung tamo?
Taoism ni joto ni swlai kotor bijap wngkha 'Tao Te Ching'. Abo Laozi ni swijak hwnwi khwnao tei bisingo 'Tao' (lama) ni wansukmungni kok tongo.
'Reincarnation' (punarjanma) ni wansukmung kon kon धर्म o tongo?
Reincarnation ni wansukmung Hinduism, Buddhism, Jainism, tei Sikhism o tongo. O wansukmung hisap o, atma thwinani ulo tei kaisa kwtal mango achai-o.
Islam o 'Jihad' ni kubui अर्थ tamo?

'Jihad' ni kubui अर्थ wngkha 'kosto khwlaimung' eba 'naimung'. Bini kotor अर्थ wngkha sakni hamya wansukmung bai jhogra khwlaimung (kotor Jihad). Hamya ni against o jhogra khwlaimung chuchu Jihad wngkha.
Hinduism o 'Avatar' hwnmale tamo?
Avatar hwnmale, jephru hayungo hamya belai bario, Kaitor Vishnu borok eba malmata ni aakar laiwi hayungo achaimung. Jemon, Ram tei Krishna, Vishnu ni avatartongmani.
'The Pope' Christianity o sabo?
The Pope wngkha Roman Catholic Church ni joto ni swlai kotor leader tei Rome ni Bishop. Bo hayung bisingni joto Catholic Christianrokni atmani leader.
Buddhism o 'Stupa' tamoni bagwi sano?
Stupa wngkha kaisa gumbad hai aakar ni structure. Bini bisingo Buddha eba tei kubuni pavitra borokni bekereng eba samungrok romjak tongo. Abo mwnwimung ni kaisa jaga.
Angno kaisa African traditional religion ni kok sa.
Yoruba (phiya Nigeria o) धर्म o, 'Orishas' hwnwi kwbangma Kaitor tongo, jeba rok Kaitor kotor (Olodumare) tei borokni bisingo kam tango. Joto Orisha ni juda juda gwranmung tongo.
'Animism' hwnwi wansukmung tamo?
Animism hwnwi wansukmung hisap o, sirif borok eba malmata ya, phiya buphang, hapung, twima hai joton samungni bisingo bo atma eba langma tongo.
'Shaman' sabo? Bohrok tamo kam khwlaio?

Shaman wngkha kwbangma kwcham somaj o khoroksa o rokom ni borok, jeba atmani hayung bai jora khwlaiwi mano hwnwi wansukjak-o. Bohrok hamya ham khwlaimung, tei somaj ni bagwi kiphilmung saina kam khwlaio.
'Diwali' festival tamoni bagwi palon khwlaio?

Diwali, 'chwngmungni festival', kwbangma karan ni bagwi palon khwlaio. Joto ni swlai mungsajak karan wngkha Lord Rama 14 bisi ni ulo Ayodhya o phin phaimung. Abo hamya ni sakao kaham ni jotonmungno phunugo.
'Holi' festival o rang bai khelemungni piskao tamo kothoma tongo?

Holi ni kothoma Prahlad, Hiranyakashipu, tei bini bibi Holika bai jora tongo. Prahlad no tharna naima jorao Holika horo jwonwi thwikha, phiya Prahlad bachikha. Abo hamya ni sakao kaham ni jotonmungno wansuk rio.
'Christmas' jorao Christmas tree sajinani niyam boro ni simi phaikha?
Christmas tree sajinani tabukni niyam 16th century o Germany ni simi chengkhamani hwnwi khwnao. Abo jephruphano kwkhrang tongnai buphang bai langma tei kwtal achaimungno phunugo.
Islam o 'Eid al-Fitr' tei 'Eid al-Adha' ni pharak tamo?

'Eid al-Fitr' Ramadan tal ni pogsao, roza pogmungni khusi o, palon khwlaio. 'Eid al-Adha' Prophet Ibrahim ni sakni bwsano Kaitorni bagwi rinani tyag no wansukwi palon khwlaio. O jorao malmata boli rijago.
Judaism, Christianity, tei Islam, o khoroktham धर्म o tamo milimung tongo?
O khoroktham धर्म no 'Abrahamic religions' hwn-o, tamni hwnmale joto no Prophet Abraham no khoroksa kotor tei puila borok hisap o mano. Joto no kaisa se Kaitor (monotheistic) o বিশ্বাস khwlaio.
'Atheism' tei 'Agnosticism' ni pharak tamo?
Atheism wngkha 'Kaitor kwrwi' hwnwi বিশ্বাস khwlaimung. Agnosticism wngkha 'Kaitor tongo da kwrwi, abo saimana eba প্রমাণ khwlaina manya' hwnwi wansukmung.
'Pantheism' wansukmung tamo sao?
Pantheism wansukmung sao ke Kaitor tei hayung bising (universe) kaisa se. Hayung bisingo jeba tongo, abo joton Kaitorni bhag.
'Confucianism' kaisa धर्म da philosophy?
Confucianism no kwbangma jorao kaisa philosophy hwn-o, धर्म ni swlai. Abo borokni bebohar, nukhung tei somaj ni kahammungni sakao se bara dhyan rio, Kaitorni kok ni swlai.
Hinduism o 'Guru' ni jaga aswk kotor tamoni?
Hinduism o Guru no aklangmungni chwngmung phunuknai, komok ni simi bahira khuknai borok hisap o nugo. 'Gu' hwnmale komok, 'Ru' hwnmale yakarnai. Bohrokno Kaitorni soman borom rijago.
'Vatican City' tamoni bagwi kaisa swadhin haste?
Vatican City wngkha Roman Catholic Church ni headquarters tei Pope ni tongthai. Bini swadhinata, Church no jeba haste ni political asar ni simi hakchalo romwi, bini atmani kam khwlaina sujog rio.
Angno kaisa Native American borokni विश्वास ni kok sa.
Kwbangma Native American bosong 'Great Spirit' o বিশ্বাস khwlaio, jeba joton samungni bisingo tongo. Bohrok ha (Earth) no 'Ama' hisap o mano tei abono borom rina belai nango hwnwi wansukgo.
Islam o 'Mecca' thani naiwi 'Namaz' porimung tamoni nango?
Muslimrok Mecca thani (Kaaba ni thani) naiwi Namaz porimung bohrokni thansa tei kaisa disani thani himmungno phunugo, jeba jaga o bohrok tongphano.
Angno kaisa kwcham jorani Roman Kaitorni mung sa.
Kwcham Rome o, Jupiter no nokha tei pherang ni Kaitor, tei joto Kaitorni Raja hisap o mano mani. Bo Greek Kaitor Zeus bai soman.
Rastafarianism o 'Jah' hwnmale sabo?
Rastafarianism o, 'Jah' (Jehovah ni chuchu mung) hwnmale Kaitorno bujio. Bohrok Ethiopia ni pogsani Samrat Haile Selassie I no Jesus Christ ni nwichi avatar tei Kaitorni aakar hisap o mano.
'Exorcism' hwnmale tamo khwlaimung?
Exorcism wngkha khoroksa borokni mang ni simi hamya atma eba bhoot no khutulnani kaisa pavitra niyam. O niyam Christianity tei tei kubuni kwbangma धर्म o tongo.
'Pilgrimage' hwnmale borok tamoni thango?
Pilgrimage (Tirtha Yatra) hwnmale kaisa pavitra jaga o beraina thangmung. Borokrok pap supna, Kaitorni आशीर्वाद nani, eba sakni atmani santi ni bagwi thango.
Hinduism o 'Ganges' (Ganga) twima aswk pavitra tamoni?
Hindu kothoma hisap o, Ganga twima nokha ni simi hayungo phaikha. O twi o thumung bai joto pap supjak-o hwnwi विश्वास khwlaijak-o. Aboni bagwi se aswk pavitra.
'Dalai Lama' Buddhism o sabo?
Dalai Lama wngkha Tibetan Buddhism ni Gelug school ni joto ni swlai kotor atmani leader. Bohrokno Avalokiteshvara (daya ni Bodhisattva) ni avatar hisap o mano.
'Fasting' (upwas) kwbangma धर्म o tamoni khwlaio?
Upwas khwlaimung atmano kwthar khwlainani, aklangmungno gwran khwlainani, tei Kaitor bai jora wngnani kaisa lama hisap o nugo. Abo sakni icha no control khwlainani bo kaisa practice.
'Halal' tei 'Haram' Islam o tamo bujio?
'Halal' hwnmale o joton samung eba chahmung, jeba Islamic niyam hisap o anumati tongo. 'Haram' hwnmale o joton samung, jeba niyam hisap o bondho eba pap.
'Monastery' o monkrok bahai tong-o?
Monastery o monkrok (Buddhist sannyasi) kaisa simple langma o tong-o. Bohrokni salbrum dhyan, pora-lekha, tei somaj ni sewa khwlaiwi se kwma-o.
'Synagogue' kon धर्म ni puja ni jaga?
Synagogue wngkha Jewish धर्म ni puja, pora-lekha, tei somaj ni milimung ni jaga.
'Mandala' ni अर्थ tamo?
Mandala, jeba Hinduism tei Buddhism o use wngo, hayung bisingni kaisa pavitra map no phunugo. Abo dhyan (meditation) jorao mon no kaisa jaga o romnani bagwi use wngo.
'OM' (Aum) mantra ni gwranmung tamo?
Hinduism o, 'OM' no hayung bisingni puila khorang tei joto ni goran hwnwi wansukjak-o. O mantra no jap khwlaimung bai mon o santi phai-o hwn-o.
Angno kaisa Australian Aboriginal borokni kothoma sa.
Bohrokni 'Dreamtime' hwnwi kaisa kothoma tongo, jeba hayungni chengmungni kok sao. O jorao, bohrokni kotor atmarok himwi, hayung, hachuk, tei twima rokno rwchapmung bai sakhamani hwn-o.
'Sufism' hwnmale Islam ni bisingo tamo wansukmung?
Sufism wngkha Islam ni bisingo kaisa atmani tei mysterious wansukmung. Sufirok rwchapmung, mwsamung (jemon Whirling Dervishes), tei dhyan ni bisingtwi Kaitor bai direct jora wngnani naio.
Joto ni swlai kwtal kotor धर्म kon no?
Joto ni swlai kwtal kotor धर्मrokni bisingo kaisa wngkha 'Baha'i Faith', jeba 19th century o Persia (tabukni Iran) o chengkhamani.
'Sharia law' tei 'secular law' ni pharak tamo?
Sharia law wngkha धर्म ni bijap (Quran) ni simi phainai niyam-kanun. Secular law wngkha borokni sakjak niyam-kanun, jeba jeba धर्म bai bo jora kwrwi.
Joto धर्म santi ni kok sao, phiya धर्म ni mung bai jhogra tamoni wngo?
Jhogra धर्म ni kubui swrwngmung ni bagwi wngya, phiya borokrok jephru धर्म no sakni political eba personal lab ni bagwi hamya khe use khwlaio, aphuru se wngo.
Angni joto swngmungni kiphilmung rikha. Hambai, o bishoy belai sensitive.
Belai lamsogo. Au, o bishoy belai sensitive tei kotor. Kubuino borom rinani tei bujinani naimung bai se chwng joto logi logi santi bai tongwi mannai. Kaham khe tongdi!
Ang kaisa kwtal laptop paina mwkhago. Gaming ni bagwi kon processor kaham wngnai, Intel i7 da AMD Ryzen 7?

Nwi no belai kaham, phiya gaming ni bagwi kwbangma jorao AMD Ryzen 7 ni performance kisa kaham nugo, phiya abo model ni sakao bo depend wngo. Nwng nini budget tei hamjakjak game no naiwi bachina mano.
Angni computer o 'Cookies' hwnmale tamo? Ang aborokno delete khwlainai da?
Cookies wngkha chuchu file, jeba no website rok nini browser o joma khwlaio, jemon nwngno wansukna mano. Kisa kisa jorao aborokno delete khwlaimung bai browser ni speed bario tei privacy kaham wngo.
Angni Wi-Fi ni password no sabo khuna mwkhago hwnwi wansukgo. Tamo khwlainai?
Nwng kodo khe nini Wi-Fi ni password no swlaidi. Kaisa gwran password romdi, jeba o letter, number, tei symbol tongo. Router ni admin password no bo swlaidi.
'Quantum Computing' ni kok khwnakha. Abo normal computer ni swlai bahai juda?
Normal computer 0 eba 1 o kam tango. Quantum computer 'qubits' use khwlaio, jeba 0 tei 1 logi logi wngwi mano. Aboni bagwi, abo kisa kisa kosto hisabrokno belai kodo khe khwlai mano.
Ang kaisa app sana mwkhago. Coding swrwngya se mano da?
Au, mano. Tabuk kwbangma 'no-code' eba 'low-code' platform tongo, jemon Glide eba Bubble. O platformrok o nwng coding swrwngya se, drag-and-drop khwlaiwi, app ni basic version sanwi mano.
Angni mobile o 'There is no SIM card' phunugo, phiya SIM to tongo.
Nwng puila phone no restart khwlaiwi naidi. Ulo, SIM card no khukwi, kaisa kwthar ri bai bini chip no suri suri mudi, tei teisa hapsiwi naidi. Tei bo wngya khe, SIM card hamya wngwi mano.
'Open Source' software hwnmale tamo?
Open Source software hwnmale o rokom ni software, jeba ni kubui code (source code) joto borokni bagwi khulwi tongo. Jeba bo abono poriwi, swlaiwi, tei bakwi mano. Jemon, Linux eba Firefox.
Angni computer ni fan belai khorang wngo. Tamo samasya?

Fan o dhula joma wngmani bagwi eba fan kwcham wngmani bagwi omo hai wngo. Eba, nwng kotor software cholaio wngwi mano, jeba bai processor kwtung wngo tei fan kodo biro. Fan no kwthar khwlai rina kaham.
Angni pendrive 'corrupted' wngkha. Data no phin mannai da?
Chance tongo. Nwng pendrive no format khwlaiyadi ta. Data recovery software, jemon 'Recuva', use khwlaiwi naidi mano. Abo bachajak file rokno saina chubai-o.
'5G' tei '4G' ni bisingo speed karwi tei tamo pharak tongo?
5G ni speed 4G ni swlai belai bara. Abono karwi bo, 5G ni 'latency' (signal phainani-thangnani jora) belai kom. Abo online gaming tei self-driving gari ni bagwi belai nango.
Angni mang o vitamin B12 kom hwnwi doctor sakha. Tamo chahna nango?
Vitamin B12 kwbangma jorao bahan-kasoi o se mano. Nwng tok bwtwi, kasoi, bahan, tei bwtwi ni samungrok (doi, paneer) chahna nango. Vegetarian wngkhe, doctor bai kok saiwi supplement chahna nango.
'Post-traumatic stress disorder' (PTSD) ni lakshan tamo wngo?
PTSD ni lakshan wngkha kosto घटना ni kok jephruphano wansukmung (flashbacks), o घटना bai jora jaga eba borokni simi hakchalo tongna naimung, belai kirijak wansukmung, tei thumung hamya wngmung.
Angni yakung-yasi jephruphano kwchang wngwi tongo. Tamo karan?
Abo blood circulation kaham wngyani bagwi eba iron kom wngmani (anemia) bagwi wngwi mano. Jephruphano wngkhe, doctor no phunukna kaham.
Angni weight bara, phiya angno kwtwi chahna belai mon wngo. Tamo khwlainai?
Nwng chini bai sakjak kwtwi ni बदला o, फल (jemon apple, thailik) chahna mano. Jwng jwng khe nini kwtwi chahnani icha kom wngnai. Jeba chah-o, kom chahdi.
'Mindfulness' hwnmale tamo? Abo bahai practice khwlaio?

Mindfulness hwnmale, jeba wansukya se, tabukni jorao pura mon hapsimung. Nwng nini bwkha hugmung-yakarmung ni sakao mon hapsiwi eba chahmung jorao chahmungni taste o pura mon hapsiwi abono practice khwlaiwi mano.
Angni kur (skin) belai kwran. Tamo khwlainai?
Nwng salbrumno kaham khe twi nwngdi. Tukunani ulo, mang kisi tongma jorao se moisturizer lagai di. Narikol thok bo kur ni bagwi belai kaham.
Horo thumung jorao khuk khwramung (snoring) no bahai kom khwlainai?
Kaisa thani swlaiwi thumung bai omo kom wngo. Mang kuphung wngkhe, weight kom khwlaidi. Thunani swkang alcohol nwngyadi ta.
Angni chwrai bwsa bolong chahya. Bono bahai chah rinai?
Bolongno chuchu khe khaui, bini hamjakjak mui, jemon pasta eba noodles o, milaiwi rina mano. Bolongno naithok aakar o khaui bo rina mano.
High blood pressure tongnai borok tamo chahna nangya?
High blood pressure tongnai borok sohm belai kom chahna nango. Packet o phaljak chahmung (jemon chips), achar, tei fast food o sohm belai bara tongo, aborokno chahya khe kaham.
Mangni posture kaham romnani bagwi tamo khwlainai?
Achukma jorao phikungno straight romdi. Gari cholaithokma jorao eba mobile naima jorao bokhorokno sakani suridi ta. Salbrumno kisa stretching exercise khwlaidi.
Ang khoroksa kaham leader wngna mwkhago. Joto ni swlai important guna tamo?
Joto ni swlai important guna wngkha 'empathy' - nini team ni borokrokni kosto tei feeling no bujimung. Tei bo, kaham communication tei kubui kok samung belai nango.
Angni resume o tamo swikhe, angno interview ni bagwi ringnai?
Nini resume o, nini kamrokno sirif swiya se, o kam bai nwng tamo 'result' tubukha, abono number bai phunukdi. Jemon, 'Sales 20% barai rwkha'.
Ang kaisa kwtal skill swrwngna mwkhago, phiya jora kwrwi.
Nwng micro-learning ni lama ladi. Salbrumno sirif 15-20 minute o skill ni bagwi poridi eba video naidi. Jwng jwng khe nwng belai swrwngnai.
Angni office o angno kebo siniya. Bahai sini lainai?
Nwng lunch jorao tei kubui bai achukna naidi. Jeba ni kam no nwng hamjakgo, bono kaisa compliment ridi. Chuchu kok samung bai se jora cheng-o.
Job swlaimung jorao, salary ni kok bahai sanai?
Interview jorao, puila bohrokno swngna ridi. Bohrok swngya khe, pogsao nwng suri suri swngna mano. Nini swkangni salary tei o kam ni market rate no naiwi kaisa range wansukwi romdi.
Ang office o kaisa bul wngkha. Tamo khwlainai?
Lukuyadi ta. Kodo khe nini boss no nini bul ni kokno sadi tei aboni bagwi nakardi. O bul no ham khwlainani lama bo wansukwi sadi.
Ang kaisa mungsajak company o internship manani bagwi tamo khwlainai?
Nini pora-lekha kaham romdi. O company bai jora kisa project sakbaithang khwlaidi. Nini CV bai kaisa kaham 'cover letter' swiwi tisadi, jeba o nwng tamoni bagwi o internship no hamjakgo, abo swijak.
Angni logi tei ang kaisa business chengna mwkhago. Tamo jotono nana nango?
Puila, nwi jono ni kam tei দায়িত্ব no suri suri bakwi ladi. Joton kokno swiwi romdi, jemon rang ni hisab tei lab ni bakmung. Logi wngmung bai bepar khwlaimung juda.
'Passive income' hwnmale tamo?
Passive income hwnmale o rokom ni income, jeba ni bagwi nwngno jephruphano active khe kam khwlaina nangya. Jemon, kaisa bijap swiwi bini royalty manmung, eba nok bhara o rinai.
Ang kaisa presentation o belai kirio. Tamo khwlainai?
Nini topic no kaham khe saimandi. Kwbangma jora practice khwlaidi, jor wngkhe khorok ni swkang. Presentation ni chengmungo kaisa swngmung swngdi, abo audience bai jora khwlaio.
Ang kaisa solo trip o Europe thangna mwkhago. Kon haste puila thangna kaham?
Nwng Portugal eba Ireland bai chengna mano. O hasterok belai naithok, borokrok friendly, tei tei kubuni Western Europe ni haste ni swlai kisa kom خرچ wngo.
'Digital Nomad' hwnwi ang khwnakha. Abo hwnmale tamo?
Digital Nomad wngkha o rokom ni borok, jeba computer tei internet use khwlaiwi jeba jaga ni simi kam khwlaiwi mano, tei logi logi juda juda haste o beraiwi tongo.
Angni flight belai lama jora ni. Tamo khwlainai jemon boring wngya wngthung?
Nwng kaisa kaham bijap, movie download khwlaijak tablet, eba kaisa noise-cancelling headphone tubui thangna mano. Kisa thumung bo kaham.
Ang Thailand thangnai. Angno kaisa basic Thai kok swrwng rwk di.
'Hello' no 'Sawasdee' hwn-o (chwla wngkhe 'Sawasdee-krap', bwrwi wngkhe 'Sawasdee-kah'). 'Thank you' no 'Khop Khun' hwn-o ('krap'/'kah' logi o bo use wngo).
Ang beraina thangma jorao jephruphano rang bara خرچ wngo. Tamo khwlainai?
Thangnani swkang kaisa salbrumni budget sadi. Kom dam ni chahmung dukan saina naidi. Tourist jaga ni dukan ni swlai, kisa bising jaga ni dukan o dam kom wngo.
Angni pasport ni validity pogsanai tongo. Beraina thangna mano da?
Kwbangma haste o hapnani bagwi nini pasport ni validity minimum 6 tal tongna nango. Nini pasport no kodo khe renew khwlaina kaham wngnai.
Ang kaisa trekking jorao jot wngkha. Tamo khwlainai?
Nwng jeba himmung bathakyadi ta. Nini logi ni borokrokno sadi. Nini map o nini jaga no naidi tei o jaga o se tongdi. Rescue team no phone khwlaidi.
Ang Africa ni 'Great Migration' naina mwkhago. Buphru thangnai?
Great Migration (wildebeest ni kotor himmung) no naina bagwi joto ni swlai kaham jora wngkha July ni simi October tal, jephru bohrok Tanzania ni Serengeti ni simi Kenya ni Masai Mara thani himo.
Angno kaisa ajgubi berainani jaga ni kok sa, jeba kom borok sinio.
Nwng Faroe Islands (Denmark ni sakani) o thangna mano. Abo hachuk tei sagar ni belai naithok jaga, jeba o puffin tokrok tei chuchu kamirok tongo. Belai siring siring jaga.
Ang beraina thangma jorao kaisa travel diary swina mwkhago. Tamo swinai?
Nwng nini salbrumni kok karwi, o jaga ni motom, aroni borokni bebohar, tei nini mon o tamo wansukmung phaikha, o kokrokno bo swina mano. Photo bo kaiwi romna mano.
Angni bwkha o kaisa kothoma ni idea tongo, phiya chengna manya.
Nwng pogsani kokno puila wansukdi. Nini character tamo hamjakgo, tei tamo kirio, abo swidi. O chuchu kokrok bai se kothoma sakbaithang kotor wngnai.
Angno kaisa naithok Kokborok rwchapmung ni title ri di.
Nwng 'Muktwi ni Chumui' (Tears of the Cloud), 'Bwkha Bising ni Sumui' (Flute inside the Heart), eba 'Pogjak Langma ni Reng' (Melody of a Lost Life) hai title wansukna mano.
Ang watercolor painting swrwngna mwkhago. Tamo bulrokno samna nango?
Kwbangma borok twi belai kom use khwlaio eba color no direct paper o hapsio. Puila, paper no kisa kisi khwlaidi, tei color no kaisa jaga o milaiwi ulo se use khwlaidi.
Angno kaisa creative writing exercise ri di.
Kaisa chuchu samung ladi, jemon kaisa kwcham chabi. O chabi ni kothomano swidi. O chabi kon duar no khulo? Sabo bini malik? Omo hai swngmungrok bai kothoma sadi.
Ang photography o 'Rule of Thirds' no bujiya.

Nini photo ni frame no 9 ta soman box o wansukdi (nwi himthok tei nwi bwchathok line bai). Nini main subject no o line rokni jora wngmung jaga o romkhe, photo naithok nugo. Abono se 'Rule of Thirds' hwn-o.
Ang kaisa mui sandi, jeba belai colourful wngo.
Nwng 'Vegetable Pulao' sano mano. Bini bisingo carrot (orange), beans (kwkhrang), corn (kormo), tei paneer (kuphur) hapsikhe, abo naithok tei chahna bo hamjakgo.
'Abstract art' no bahai bujinai?
Abstract art kubui hayungni samungno phunugna naimung ya. Abo color, aakar, tei line bai khoroksa artist ni wansukmung eba feeling no phunugo. Abo tamo wansuk rio, abo borokni sakao depend wngo.
Angni nok o belai kwcham music record (vinyl) tongo. Abo tabuk bo cholonai da?
Au, cholonai. Nwngno kaisa record player (turntable) nango. Kwcham recordrokni sound quality belai kaham wngo tei tabuk bo kwbangma borok aborokno collect khwlaio.
Angno kaisa comedy movie ni mung sa, jeba angno belai mwnwi rwnai.
Nwng 'Hera Pheri' (Hindi) movie no naidi mano. Bini comedy belai kubui tei characterrok belai mungsajak. Ang wansukgo nwng belai mwnwinai.
Ang kaisa story o kaisa 'anti-hero' character romna mwkhago. Abo bahai wngo?
Anti-hero wngkha story ni main character, phiya bini bisingo hero ni kaham guna rok kwrwi. Bo sakni lab ni bagwi kam khwlaio, phiya pogsao kaisa kaham kam khwlaiwi mano.
'Existentialism' philosophy ni main wansukmung tamo?
Existentialism sao ke borokni langma ni swkang ni simi jeba goal eba meaning kwrwi. Chwng hayungo phai-o, tei chini kam bai se chini langma ni meaning no saina nango.
Angni langma o jeba khusi kwrwi hwnwi wansukgo.
Khusi no saina himyadi ta. Chuchu chuchu samungo khusi saina naidi. Jemon, phung ni cha nwngmung, kaisa kaham rwchapmung khwnamung. 'Gratitude' (hambai wansukmung) practice khwlaidi.
'Sonder' hwnwi kaisa feeling tongo hwn-o. Abo tamo?
Sonder wngkha o wansukmung, jephru nwng bujio ke lama bai himnai joto borokni sakni kaisa kotor tei kosto kahani tongo, jeba nini kahani hai se important.
Ang jeba samung cheng-o, pogsao yakaro. Tamo khwlainai?
Nini goal no belai kotor khwlaiyadi ta. Chuchu, joton khwlai mannai goal romdi. Kaisa joton wngnani ulo, sakno sak kisa borom ridi. Abo nwngno swkang himna gwranmung rinai.
Angno kaisa kothoma sa, jeba mon no ham khwlainai.

Kaisa kami o khoroksa achu bini suk chwrai no salbrumno kaisa bubar rwkhamani. Chwrai swngkha, 'Nwng tamoni salbrumno rio?'. Achu kiphilkha, 'Jemon nwng wansukna mano ke jeba wngphano, hayungo salbrumno mungsa na mungsa naithok samung jephruphano achai-o'.
Angni logi khoroksa belai negative. Bini logi tongkhe ang bo negative wngo.
Nwng bini logi tongnani jorano kom khwlaidi. Bini negative kokno tei bara baraiyadi ta. Topic no swlaidi. Pogsao, nwng nini aklani santi no bachina nango.
Angni nukhungni borok angno bujiya hwnwi wansukgo.
Kaisa kaisa jorao, generation gap ni bagwi omo hai wngo. Nwng nini wansukmungno suri suri tei borom bai bohrokno sanani naidi. Bohrokni wansukmungno bo bujina naidi.
'Letting go' hwnmale tamo? Abo bahai khwlaio?

'Letting go' hwnmale swkangni kosto eba bul no bisingo romya se, abono yakarmung. Abo forgive khwlaimung bai cheng-o, phiya joto ni swlai kotor wngkha sakno sak forgive khwlaimung. Abo kaisa process, kaisa salo wngya.
Angni life o jeba friend kwrwi. Saichung belai nugo.
Friend sanani bagwi, nwng nini hamjakjak kam bai jora jaga o thangna mano. Jemon, book club eba trekking group. Online o bo kaham borok malaina mano. Puila yapri no nwng se romna nango.
Angni joto ni swlai kotor bul tamo wngkhamani, ang buji manya.
Bul ni kok wansukyadi ta. O bul ni simi nwng tamo swrwngjakha, abono wansukdi. Joto borok bul khwlaio. Jeba bul ni simi swrwngo, bo se aklangmung tongnai wngo.
Chini mangni bisingo joto ni swlai gwran muscle kon no?
Chini mangni bisingo joto ni swlai gwran muscle wngkha chini khuk bisingo tongnai 'Masseter' muscle, jeba chwngno chahmung chabana chubai-o.
Hayung bisingo joto ni swlai kotor desert (kwran jaga) boro?
Joto ni swlai kotor desert wngkha Antarctic Polar Desert. Desert hwnmale sirif kwtung jaga ya, jeba jaga o uatwi belai kom phai-o, abono hwn-o.
'Pangolin' malmata tamoni bagwi aswk ajgubi?
Pangolin wngkha hayungni kaisa se malmata, jeba ni mang bising kwrak kwrak 'scales' (bichli) bai pherjak tongo. Bohrok kirikhe, kaisa ball hai kiting wngwi mano.
Angno kaisa ajgubi buphangni kok sa, jeba bahan chah-o.
'Venus Flytrap' hwnwi kaisa buphang tongo, jeba bini bwlai no kaisa khuk hai use khwlaiwi, bini sakao achuknai kiri-kotorrokno romwi chah-o.
Hayung bisingo joto ni swlai poison tongnai malmata kon no?
'Golden Poison Frog', Colombia o mano, hayung bisingni joto ni swlai poison tongnai malmata hwnwi wansukjak-o. Bini kur ni poison 10 ta borokno tharwi mano.
'The Great Dying' hwnmale itihas o tamo wngkhamani?

'The Great Dying' wngkha 252 million bisi swkang wngnai kaisa kotor ঘটনা, jeba o hayungni 95% ni swlai bara sagar ni langma tei 70% ha ni langma kwmawi thangkhamani. Abo hayungni joto ni swlai kotor extinction event.
Angno kaisa archaeological discovery ni kok sa, jeba itihas no swlai rwkha.
1974 bisio China o 'Terracotta Army' ni discovery itihas no swlai rwkha. Abo phunukha ke kwcham China ni puila Samrat, Qin Shi Huang, aswk gwran tei kotor tongmani.
'Placebo' tei 'Nocebo' effect ni pharak tamo?
'Placebo' effect o, tatal marok chahwi bo borok kaham wngo. 'Nocebo' effect bini ulta: borok mungsa hamya wngnai hwnwi wansukmani bagwi se, kubui khe bini mang o hamya lakshan nugo.
'Mithridatism' hwnmale tamo?
Mithridatism hwnmale suri suri, chuchu chuchu poison (bikh) chahwi, o poison ni against o mangni bisingo immunity sanani process. Abo belai dangerous tei expert yakarwi khwlaina nangya.
Hayungni itihas o joto ni swlai lama jora jhogra kon no?
'Hundred Years' War', England tei France ni bisingo, kubui khe 116 bisi jora cholokhamani (1337-1453). Abo joto ni swlai lama jora jhograrokni bisingo kaisa.
Tripura ni 'Pilak' festival tamoni bagwi palon khwlaio?
Pilak festival, South Tripura o, o amchaini kwcham itihas tei archaeological importance no celebrate khwlainani bagwi palon khwlaio. O jorao local culture tei mwsamung phunugo.
Angno kaisa Kokborok koklop ni line sa, jeba nature bai jora.
Kaisa naithok line wngwi mano: 'Hachuk sakani chumui himo, twisa rwchapwi bini lama sano'.
Tripura ni kon Maharaja 'social reformer' hisap o mungsajak?
Maharaja Bir Chandra Manikya no kaisa social reformer hisap o mungsajak. Bo 'Sati' pratha no bondho khwlainani tei bwrwi pora-lekhano barainani belai kam khwlaikhamani.
'Jamatia Hoda' ni kotor kam tamo?
'Jamatia Hoda' wngkha Jamatia bosongni joto ni swlai kotor somaj ni organization. Bohrok Jamatia somaj ni niyam-kanun, culture, tei jhogra-jhati bichar khwlaimung ni kam khwlaio.
'My last day was a good day' - omohai wansukna bagwi ang tamo khwlainai?
Salbrumno mungsa na mungsa kwtal swrwngdi. Khoroksano jeba chubamung yawi chubadi. Nini nukhungni borok bai kisa jora kaham khe kok sadi. Chuchu kaham kam se langmano naithok khwlaio.
Nwngni joto ni swlai hamjakjak swngmung tamo, jeba angno nwng swngkha?
Ani joto ni swlai hamjakjak swngmung wngkha: 'Nwng borok wngkhe, puila tamo feel khwlainani naidi mani?' Tamni hwnmale o swngmung angno borokni langma ni kosto tei naithokmung nwi no wansuk rio.
Angni joto swngmungni kiphilmung rikha. Nwngni aklangmung belai kotor.
Belai belai hambai. Angni aklangmung nwngrokni swngmung bai se bario. Nini swrwngnani icha no ang borom rwo. Phainai salo teisa malaiyanw!
'Geopolitics' hwnmale kubui khe tamo bujio?
Geopolitics wngkha kaisa haste ni geography (map o bini jaga, sima, tei samung) bahai khe bini political jora, tei tei kubuni haste bai bini jorano asar khwlaio, aboni pora-lekha.
'Soft Power' tei 'Hard Power' ni bisingo pharak tamo?

'Hard Power' wngkha military tei economic gwranmung bai tei kubuni haste no control khwlaimung. 'Soft Power' wngkha sakni culture, wansukmung, tei niyam-kanun bai tei kubunino attract khwlaiwi sakni thani samung.
USA hayung bisingo aswk gwran tamoni?
USA bini kotor economy, joto ni swlai gwran military, tei bini culture (jemon movie, music) ni hayung bisingo phermung ni bagwi aswk gwran.
China ni 'Belt and Road Initiative' (BRI) tamo?
BRI wngkha China ni kaisa kotor project, jeba ni bisingtwi bo Asia, Europe, tei Africa ni kwbangma haste o lama, railway, tei port sano rang rio. Abo China ni asar barainani kaisa kotor lama.
Russia ni geopolitics o 'gas' ni kam tamo?
Russia hayung bisingni joto ni swlai kotor natural gas sanai haste. Bo Europe ni kwbangma haste no gas phalo. Aboni bagwi, bo gas no kaisa political hathiyar hisap o bo use khwlaiwi mano.
'NATO' (North Atlantic Treaty Organization) tamoni bagwi sakjakhamani?
NATO no 1949 bisio, Cold War jorao, sakjakhamani. Bini main goal tongmani Soviet Union ni hamla ni simi Western Europe tei North America ni hasterokno logi logi bachimung.
South China Sea o jhogra tamoni bagwi wngo?

South China Sea o jhogra wngo tamni hwnmale o sagar ni bisingtwi hayungni kotor bepar ni lama himo, tei bini ha bisingo kwbangma thok tei gas tongo hwnwi wansukjak-o. China, Vietnam, Philippines hai kwbangma haste o sagar no sakni hwnwi sao.
'Geopolitical hotspot' hwnmale tamo jaga no bujio?
Geopolitical hotspot hwnmale o rokom ni jaga, jeba o juda juda haste ni interest ni jhogra ni bagwi, jephruphano jhogra eba tension wngnani chance kotor tongo. Jemon, Middle East eba Taiwan Strait.
India ni 'Neighborhood First' policy tamo?
'Neighborhood First' policy hisap o, India bini koro ni hasterok (jemon Nepal, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka) bai kaham jora romna tei bohrokni উন্নতি o chubana joto ni swlai puila borom rio.
'Quad' hwnwi group o kon kon haste tongo?
Quad (Quadrilateral Security Dialogue) o 4 ta haste tongo: USA, India, Japan, tei Australia. O group ni main kam wngkha Indo-Pacific amchai o santi tei swadhin himmung no kaham rommung.
Arctic amchai tamoni bagwi geopolitically important wngwi tongo?
Hayung kwtung wngmani bagwi Arctic ni borof kwmawi tongo, jeba bai kwtal sagar ni lama tei thok-gas saina ni sujog ongo. Aboni bagwi Russia, USA, tei China o amchai o sakni asar baraina naio.
Iran ni nuclear program ni bagwi hayung bisingo aswk chinta tamoni?
Kwbangma haste, phiya USA tei Israel, kirio ke Iran nuclear program ni mung bai lukuiwi nuclear bomb sano naio, jeba Middle East o santi no hamya khwlainai.
'Sanctions' (pratibandh) kaisa haste ni sakao lagaimung bai tamo wngo?
Sanctions lagaimung bai o haste ni economy belai hamya wngo. Bini bahira ni bepar bondho wngo, tei bini rang ni dam kwma-o. Abo kaisa haste no bini bebohar swlaina bagwi jor khwlainani kaisa lama.
Taiwan tei China ni bisingo jhogra ni goran tamo?
China Taiwan no sakni kaisa bhag hwnwi mano tei jeba jorao sak bai jora khwlainai hwn-o. Phiya Taiwan sakno sak kaisa swadhin, democratic haste hwnwi mano. O wansukmung ni pharak se jhogra ni goran.
'G20' group ni main kam tamo?
G20 hwnmale hayung bisingni 19 ta kotor economy tongnai haste tei European Union ni kaisa group. Bohrok hayung bisingni economy tei financial santi ni kokno logi logi kok sa-o.
'Brexit' ni ulo, UK ni geopolitics o tamo asar wngkha?
Brexit ni ulo, UK European Union ni bepar ni niyam ni simi ongkha. Tabuk bo sakni bagwi kwtal bepar ni agreement tei hayung bisingo sakni kwtal jaga saina naio.
Africa o China ni asar bahai barungwi tongo?
China Africa ni kwbangma haste o lama, railway, tei tei kubuni infrastructure sano belai kotor loan rio. Abo bai China aroni natural resource mano tei bini political asar bo bario.
'BRICS' group o kon kon haste tongo?
BRICS o puila 5 ta haste tongmani: Brazil, Russia, India, China, tei South Africa. Tabuk o group o tei bo kwtal member jora wngkha. Bohrok hayungni economic niyam no swlaina naio.
Israel tei Palestine ni jhogra aswk lama jora tamoni cholo?
O jhogra ha (land), itihas, tei धर्म bai jora. Nwi thani no kaisa jaga no sakni pavitra haste hwnwi mano (Jerusalem), tei nwi ni bisingo kaham sima tei jora ni lama saina belai kosto wngkha.
'Suez Canal' tamoni bagwi hayungni bepar ni bagwi aswk important?
Suez Canal Europe tei Asia ni bisingo sagar ni lama no belai chuchu khwlaio. O lama bondho wngkhe, jahajrokno pura Africa birwi thangna nango, jeba belai jora tei rang خرچ wngo.
'Cyber warfare' hwnmale tamo?
Cyber warfare wngkha kaisa haste tei kaisa haste ni computer network, power grid, eba tei kubuni important infrastructure o internet ni bisingtwi hamla khwlaimung.
United Nations Security Council (UNSC) o 'veto power' tamo?
UNSC ni 5 ta permanent member (USA, UK, France, Russia, China) ni thani 'veto power' tongo. Jeba kaisa resolution no o 5 ni bisingni kaisa bo 'ihi' sakhe, o resolution pass wngya.
Angno kaisa 'proxy war' ni example ri di, Cold War ni.
Vietnam War kaisa kotor proxy war ni example. O jhograo, Soviet Union North Vietnam no chubamani, tei USA South Vietnam no chubamani. Nwi kotor power direct jhogra khwlaiyakhu.
'Human rights' geopolitics o bahai use wngo?
Kwbangma jorao, kotor hasterok tei kubuni hasterokno 'human rights' ni kokno laiwi pressure rio, bohrokni sakao sanctions lagaina eba bohrokni bebohar no swlaina bagwi.
'Resource curse' hwnmale tamo wngo?

Resource curse hwnmale o অবস্থা, jephru kaisa haste o belai kwbangma natural resource (jemon thok, diamond) tong phano, o resource ni bagwi corruption, jhogra, tei hamya शासन wngwi, haste gorib se wngwi tongo.
'Democracy' tei 'Autocracy' ni bisingo jhogra tabukni geopolitics ni kaisa kotor bhag da?

Au, belai kotor bhag. USA tei bini logisong democracy no swkang tisana naio, tei China tei Russia hai hasterok autocracy ni system no kaham hwnwi phunugna naio. O nwi wansukmung ni bisingo jhogra cholo.
'Geopolitical vacuum' hwnmale tamo?

Geopolitical vacuum hwnmale, jephru kaisa amchai ni simi kaisa kotor gwran haste (jemon USA) sakni asar no kom khwlaio eba ongwi thango, tei o khali jaga no romna bagwi tei kubuni gwran hasterokni bisingo jhogra cheng-o.
India ni 'Act East' policy o kon amchai no focus khwlaio?
India ni 'Act East' policy o joto ni swlai bara focus khwlaio South-East Asian hasterok (ASEAN countries) jemon Vietnam, Indonesia, Singapore, bai economic tei strategic jora barainani sakao.
North Korea ni sakao aswk kwbangma sanctions tamoni tongo?
North Korea bini nuclear bomb tei missile program no bondho khwlaiyani bagwi, tei human rights ni hamya record ni bagwi, UN tei kwbangma haste bini sakao belai gwran sanctions lagaiwi romkha.
'String of Pearls' hwnwi wansukmung China bai bahai jora?

'String of Pearls' wngkha kaisa wansukmung, jeba hisap o China Indian Ocean o, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, tei tei kubuni haste o port tei military base sanani naimung. Abo India no birnani kaisa naimung hwnwi wansukjak-o.
Hayungni climate change geopolitics no bahai asar khwlainai?

Climate change ni bagwi twi kom wngmung, hasam hamya wngmung, tei sagar barimung hai samasya wngnai. O samasyarokni bagwi hasterokni bisingo kwtal jhogra, jemon twi eba borok himmung ni jhogra, chengwi mano.
Angno kaisa 'failed state' ni example ri di.
Somalia no kwbangma jora 'failed state' ni example hisap o rijago. O haste o kaisa gwran central government kwrwi, tei juda juda jhogra-nai group ni bisingo jephruphano jhogra wngwi tongo.
Brazil South America o kaisa kotor power da?
Au, Brazil bini kotor population, kotor economy, tei Amazon bolong hai kotor natural resource ni bagwi South America ni kaisa joto ni swlai kotor regional power hwnwi mano.
'Monroe Doctrine' tamo wansukmung tongmani?

19th century ni Monroe Doctrine wngkha USA ni kaisa policy, jeba hisap o bo European hasterokno North eba South America o kwtal colony sanani eba aroni political kam o jora wngnani swng khwlaikhamani.
Iran tei Saudi Arabia ni bisingo jhogra tamoni?
Bohrokni bisingo jhogra ni kwbangma karan tongo. Kaisa wngkha धर्म ni pharak (Iran Shia, Saudi Arabia Sunni), tei nwichi wngkha Middle East o sabo kotor leader wngnai, o jhogra.
Turkey NATO ni member wng phano, Russia bai kaham jora tamoni romo?
Turkey sakni geopolitical lab ni bagwi nwi thani bai balance khwlaiwi himna naio. Bo NATO bai security ni jora romo, tei Russia bai bepar tei energy ni jora romo.
'Balkanization' hwnmale tamo bujio?
Balkanization hwnmale, kaisa kotor haste eba amchai bini bisingni jat eba धर्म ni jhogra ni bagwi phatbarwi chuchu chuchu hamya haste o swlaimung. O kok Balkan amchai ni itihas ni simi phaikha.
'Non-Aligned Movement' (NAM) Cold War jorao tamo kam khwlaikhamani?
NAM wngkha o hasterokni group (jemon India, Egypt, Yugoslavia), jeba rok Cold War jorao USA eba Soviet Union, jeba group o bo jora wngya se, sakbaithang tongna naimani.
Japan tamoni bagwi sakni military no teisa gwran khwlaino naio?
Japan bini koro o China ni barungwi tongnai military gwranmung tei North Korea ni missile ni kirimung ni bagwi, sakni bachanani gwranmungno tei bo baraino naio.
'Shanghai Cooperation Organisation' (SCO) o kon kon kotor haste tongo?
SCO o China tei Russia joto ni swlai kotor haste. Abono karwi bo India tei Pakistan bo bini member. Abo Central Asia o security tei economic jora barainani bagwi sakjakha.
Africa ni 'Sahel' amchai o aswk jhogra tamoni?
Sahel amchai o gorib wngmung, climate change ni bagwi hasam hamya wngmung, tei hamya शासन ni bagwi, extremist group (jemon al-Qaeda, ISIS) rok belai gwran wngwi tongo. Aboni bagwi se aswk jhogra.
'World Trade Organization' (WTO) ni kam tamo?
WTO wngkha hayung bisingni bepar ni niyam-kanun sano tei hasterokni bisingo bepar ni jhogra roknok solve khwlainai kaisa kotor organization.
Germany European Union o aswk gwran tamoni?
Germany bini hayung bisingni joto ni swlai kotor export economy tei gwran industry ni bagwi European Union ni joto ni swlai kotor tei asar tongnai haste.
'Asylum' tei 'Refugee' ni pharak tamo?
Refugee wngkha o borok, jeba sakni haste no jhogra eba kosto ni bagwi yakarwi himo. Asylum seeker wngkha o borok, jeba tei kaisa haste o hapwi, refugee hisap o sinijaknani bagwi swngo.
Angno kaisa geopolitical theory ni mung sa.
Kaisa mungsajak theory wngkha Halford Mackinder ni 'Heartland Theory'. O theory hisap o, jeba Eastern Europe tei Central Asia (Heartland) no control khwlaio, bo hayungno control khwlainai.
France ni Africa o tei bo asar tongo da?
Au, tongo. Kwbangma swkangni French colony tongnai West African hasterok o France ni military, economic, tei cultural asar tabuk jora jora bo belai gwran tongo.
'Choke point' hwnmale geopolitics o tamo jaga?

Choke point wngkha kaisa chuchu sagar ni lama, jeba bai kwbangma jahaj himo. O jaga no jeba control khwlaio, bo hayungni bepar no bo control khwlaino gwranmung mano. Jemon, Strait of Hormuz eba Strait of Malacca.
India ni 'soft power' ni kaisa example ri di.
India ni 'soft power' ni kaisa kotor example wngkha Bollywood. Bini movie tei music hayung bisingo, phiya South Asia, Middle East tei Africa o, belai popular tei India ni culture no phero.
Joto haste sakni lab ni bagwi se wansukgo da?

Geopolitics ni 'Realism' theory hisap o, au, joto haste pogsao sakni national interest (lab) no se joto ni swlai puila borom rio. Phiya 'Liberalism' theory hisap o, hasterok logi logi kam khwlaiwi joto ni lab ni bagwi bo wansugo.
'Genocide' hwnmale tamo?
Genocide hwnmale kaisa jat, धर्म, eba bosongni borokrokno pura kwma rina bagwi plan khwlaiwi tharmung eba hamya khwlaimung. Abo international niyam hisap o joto ni swlai kotor aparadh.
Geopolitics o 'rare earth minerals' ni kam tamo?

Rare earth minerals wngkha o rokom ni samung, jeba mobile phone, computer, tei military hathiyar sano belai nango. China hayung bisingni joto ni swlai kotor sanai wngmani bagwi, o bishoy o bini belai gwranmung tongo.
Angno kaisa geopolitics bai jora kaham bijap ni mung sa.

Nwng Tim Marshall ni swijak 'Prisoners of Geography' porina mano. O bijap o, hayungni 10 ta map no use khwlaiwi, geography bahai khe itihas tei tabukni politics no asar khwlaio, abono naithok khe phunukjakha.
Angni joto swngmungni kiphilmung rikha. Hambai, ang kwbangma swrwngjakha.
Belai belai lamsogo. Geopolitics kaisa belai kotor tei jephruphano swlaiwi tongnai bishoy. Nini swrwngnani icha no ang borom rwo. Kaham khe tongdi!
Angni mobile ni touch screen kisa jaga o kam khwlaiya. Tamo khwlainai?
Puila, screen no kaisa kwthar suri ri bai mudi. Screen guard lagaijak tongkhe, abono khukwi naidi. Tei bo hamya wngkhe, screen no swlainani swlai tei lama kwrwi wngwi mano.
Angno 'phishing' ni kaisa kwtal lama ni kok sa di.
Kaisa kwtal lama wngkha 'voice phishing' (vishing). Scammerrok nwngno phone khwlaiwi, bank ni borok hai kok saiwi, nini OTP eba password swngna naio.
Angni email o 'ransomware' attack wngkha. Ang rang rinai da?
Jephruphano rang riyadi ta. Rang rikhe bo, nini file rokno phin rinai hwnwi jeba guarantee kwrwi. Nwng khoroksa cyber security expert ni chubamung ladi tei police o saikadi.
Laptop ni battery no kaham romna bagwi, jephruphano 100% charge khwlaina nango da?
Ihi, nangya. Laptop ni battery no 20% ni sakani kom wngna riyadi ta tei 80-90% jora charge khwlaimung se battery ni langma ni bagwi joto ni swlai kaham.
'OCD' (Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder) ni lakshan tamo?

OCD ni lakshan wngkha mon o jephruphano phainai hamya wansukmung (obsessions), tei o wansukmungno kom khwlainani bagwi kaisa kam no jephruphano khwlaimung (compulsions), jemon yasi supna eba samung lekha na.
Angno kaisa 'superfood' ni mung sa, jeba India o mano.
'Moringa' (sajna bwlai) kaisa superfood wngkha. Bini bisingo vitamin tei mineral belai kwbangma tongo. Bini bwlai kwran khwlaiwi powder hisap o bo chah-o.
Angni yasi o jephruphano samo, mobile kwbangma use khwlaini bagwi.
Abo 'texting thumb' ni samasya wngwi mano. Nwng yasi no kisa aram ridi. Yasi ni chuchu stretching exercise khwlaidi. Jor wngkhe, voice typing use khwlaidi.
Thumung jorao, mokol o komok wngmung kaham da?
Au, kaham. Pura komok o thumung bai chini aklango 'melatonin' hwnwi kaisa hormone ongo, jeba chwngno kaham khe thumna chubai-o.
Ang salbrumno kaisa 'power nap' (chuchu thumung) lana mwkhago. Bwswk jora lanai?
20-30 minute ni power nap joto ni swlai kaham. Abo nwngno fresh feel khwlainai, phiya bini swlai bara thukhe, nwng tei bo lengjak wansukna mano.
Angni samung wngkha jephruphano achukwi tongmung. Tamo exercise khwlainai?
Nwng প্রতি ghanta o 5 minute bacha-wi, kisa himna eba chuchu stretching khwlaina mano. Jemon, yakungno sakao kuchuk khwlaimung, eba phikungno suri suri bir rina.
Angno kaisa kaham 'cover letter' swinani tip ri di.
Cover letter o, company ni mung tei job ni mung suri suri swidi. Nwng tamoni bagwi o job ni bagwi kaham, abono 2-3 line o phunukdi. Nini CV no teisa kok bai swiya se, nini passion no phunukdi.
'Toxic work environment' ni lakshan tamo?
Toxic work environment ni lakshan wngkha borokrokni bisingo kok hamya samung, jephruphano kirijak wansukmung, tei kaham kam ni bagwi borom kwrwi wngmung.
Angno kaisa 'ice breaker' swngmung swng di, meeting ni bagwi.
Kaham. Nwng swngna mano: 'Nwngno kaisa superpower rina wngkhe, tamo lanai mani tei tamoni bagwi?'
Ang kaisa kwtal skill swrwngna mwkhago, phiya pocha manya.
Nwng 'Coursera' eba 'edX' hai website o 'audit' option bai kwbangma course no free o swrwngna mano. Certificate ni bagwi se rang nango.
'Kyoto Protocol' tamo agreement tongmani?
Kyoto Protocol wngkha kaisa international agreement, jeba ni goal tongmani hayung kwtung khwlainai greenhouse gasrokni ongmungno kom khwlaimung. Abo 1997 bisio wngkhamani.
Ang 'sustainable tourism' ni bagwi tamo khwlai mano?
Nwng local hotel o tongna mano, local mui chahna mano, tei local borokni dukan ni simi samung paina mano. Plastic botol ni बदला o sakni twi botol tubui thangdi.
'Zero Waste' langma ni wansukmung tamo?
Zero Waste langma ni wansukmung wngkha joton samungno teisa use khwlaimung, recycle khwlaimung, eba compost khwlaimung, jemon jabar belai kom wngo eba wngya.
'Carbon footprint' hwnmale tamo?

Carbon footprint hwnmale, khoroksa borok eba organization ni kam ni bagwi, jemon gari cholaithokmung eba bijli use khwlaimung, nobaro bwswk carbon dioxide tei tei kubuni greenhouse gas ongo, aboni map.
Angni nok o kwcham electronic samung (e-waste) tongo. Boro yakarnai?
E-waste no normal jabar bai yakardi ta. Tabuk kwbangma şehir o e-waste collection centre tongo. Nwng online o nini koro ni centre no saina mano.
Angno kaisa naithok Kokborok rwchapmung ni line sa, uatwi bai jora.
'Nokha kapo muktwi kwtwi, ha mwnwio motom kisi.' (The sky cries sweet tears, the earth smiles with a wet scent.)
Ang kaisa kothoma swinai, jeba ni main character kaisa buphang wngo.
Kaham idea! Nwng phunukna mano ke o buphang bwswk mol nukha, bini koro tamo tamo wngkha, tei bo borokrokni kokno khwnawi tamo wansukgo.
'Surrealism' art o tamo phunugo?
Surrealism art aklani bisingni tei imang ni ajgubi jaga no phunugna naio. Abo normal hayungni niyam-kanun no maniya, jemon Salvador Dalí ni paintingrok.
Angno kaisa ajgubi musical instrument ni mung sa.
'Theremin' hwnwi kaisa ajgubi musical instrument tongo, jeba no yasi bai romya se, bini koro yasi him rimung bai se suri sano.
Angni drawing o, borokni mokol akina belai kosto wngo.
Mokol akina jorao, chwngmungno (light) dhyan ri di. Mokol bisingo jephruphano kaisa chuchu kuphur dot romdi. Abo mokolno langma tongnai hai phunugo.
'Guerrilla marketing' hwnmale tamo?
Guerrilla marketing wngkha kom خرچ o, ajgubi tei creative lama bai, borokrokni mon o kaisa product ni mungno hapsinani naimung. Jemon, lamao kaisa ajgubi samung khwlaimung.
Ang kaisa samung chengkhe, aboni pogsao jora himna manya.
Nini goal no kwbangma chuchu chuchu goal o bakwi ladi. Joto chuchu goal joton wngkhe, sakno sak kisa borom ridi. Abo nwngno swkang himna gwranmung rinai.
'Butterfly Effect' wansukmung tamo sao?

Butterfly Effect sao ke kaisa belai chuchu chengmung (jemon kaisa thabil ni bir mung), pogsao kaisa belai kotor swlaimung tubui mano (jemon kaisa kotor nobar). Abo joton samung jora tongo hwnwi phunugo.
Ang jeba samungo jor khwlaiwi 'ihi' (yes) saiwi phino. Tamo khwlainai?
'Ihi' sanani swkang, kisa jora ladi. Sakno sak swngdi, 'Ang omo kubui khe khwlaina mwkhago da? Ani thani jora tongo da?'. Suri suri 'ihi' sana swrwngdi.
Angni langma o jeba 'spark' kwrwi hwnwi nugo.
Kaisa kwtal hobby chengdi, jeba no nwng jephruphano khwlaiyakhu. Kaisa chuchu trip plan khwlaidi, jeba jaga o nwng thangyakhu. Kwtal experience se langmao 'spark' tubui phai-o.
Ang khoroksano bahai buji rinai ke bo angno kosto rio, bono kosto riya se?
Nwng 'I-message' use khwlaidi. 'Nwng omo khwlaikha' sanani बदला o, sadi: 'Jephruru omo hai wngo, angno omo hai feel wngo'. Abo jhograno kom khwlaio.
Kwcham Egypt ni borokrok meono tamoni aswk borom riomung?
Kwcham Egypt o meono pavitra malmata hisap o nugo mani. Bohrok wansukmani ke meo hamya gwranmungni simi bachio. Meo no tharkhe, kotor aparadh wng-o mani.
Angno kaisa kwcham jorani ajgubi niyam ni kok sa.
Kwcham Rome o, apha ni odhikar tongmani sakni bwsa-bwrwirokno das hisap o phalnani, eba thar rina ni bo.
'Tunguska event' hwnmale 1908 bisio tamo wngkhamani?

1908 bisio, Siberia ni Tunguska amchai o kaisa belai kotor phatmung wngkhamani, jeba hajra hajra buphangrokno phatbarmani. Abo kaisa kotor meteorite eba comet nobaro phatmani bagwi wngkhamani hwnwi wansukjak-o.
Hayungni itihas o joto ni swlai chuchu jhogra kon no?
Joto ni swlai chuchu jhogra wngkha 'Anglo-Zanzibar War' (1896). Abo Great Britain tei Zanzibar ni bisingo wngkhamani tei sirif 38 minute jora cholokhamani.
'Library of Alexandria' tamoni bagwi aswk mungsajak tongmani?
Library of Alexandria kwcham hayungni joto ni swlai kotor tei important library tongmani. Aro lakh lakh scroll tei bijap joma tongmani, jeba o jorani joto aklangmung joma wngwi tongmani.
'Manhattan Project' tamo tongmani?
Manhattan Project wngkha World War II jorao USA ni kaisa belai secret project. Bini goal tongmani hayung bisingni puila atomic bomb no sanmung.
Angno kaisa hayung bisingni itihas ni kaisa unsolved mystery ni kok sa.
'Voynich Manuscript' hwnwi kaisa 15th century ni bijap tongo, jeba ni kok tei drawingrokno tabuk jora jora bo kebo poriwi eba bujiwi manyakhu. Bini kok tei aakar ajgubi.
'Holodomor' hwnmale tamo wngkhamani?
1930s o, Ukraine o Soviet Union ni niyam ni bagwi, kaisa borokni sakjak akal wngkhamani, jeba o million million borok bokho bai thwikhamani. O घटना no se 'Holodomor' hwn-o.
'Opium Wars' China tei Britain ni bisingo tamoni wngkhamani?
O jhogra wngkhamani tamni hwnmale British beparirok China o illegal khe opium phalna naimani, tei China ni government abono bathakna naimani. Abo China ni bagwi belai hamya jhogra tongmani.
'Area 51' o kubui khe tamo tongo?
Area 51 wngkha USA ni kaisa belai secret military base. Aro kwtal rokom ni airplane tei hathiyar ni test khwlaimung wngo. Alien ni kothoma rok kwbangma jorao sirif kahani se.
'Chikankari' embroidery kon şehir bai jora tongo?
Chikankari wngkha kaisa belai naithok tei suri hath ni embroidery, jeba Lucknow şehir bai jora tongo. Abo Mughal jorani simi se phaiwi tongo.
'Warli painting' o tamo phunugo?
Warli painting wngkha Maharashtra ni Warli bosongni kaisa kwcham art. Bini bisingo, simple geometric aakar (jemon kiting, triangle) use khwlaiwi, kami ni langma, mwsamung, tei puja no phunugo.
'Pattachitra' art kon haste ni?
Pattachitra wngkha Odisha haste ni kaisa kwcham scroll painting ni art. O paintingrok ri ni sakao sano tei Hindu Kaitor, phiya Lord Jagannath ni kahanirokno phunugo.
Angno India ni kaisa martial art ni mung sa.
'Kalaripayattu', Kerala ni kaisa belai kwcham martial art. Abono hayung bisingni joto ni swlai kwcham martial artrokni bisingo kaisa hwnwi wansukjak-o.
'Bandhani' ri bahai sano?
Bandhani (Bandhej) ri no Gujarat tei Rajasthan o sano. O jorao, ri no chuchu chuchu sutai bai kaham khe kha-o, tei ulo abono color o dubo-o. Khakhe, kha-jak jaga kuphur wngwi naithok design wngo.
'Kathakali' mwsamung o aswk kotor makeup tamoni khwlaio?
Kathakali (Kerala ni mwsamung) o kotor makeup tei ri-chum bai characterrokno phunugo. Joto color ni kaisa juda অর্থ tongo. Jemon, kwkhrang wngkha hero, tei kwchak wngkha hamya borok.
India ni 'puppet theatre' (putul mwsamung) ni kaisa rokom sa di.
Rajasthan ni 'Kathputli' belai mungsajak. O jorao, sutai bai jora naithok naithok putulrokno mwsarwkwi, Raja-Rani ni kahanirokno sao.
'Thali' chahmungo aswk kwbangma mui tamoni rijago?
Thali rijamungni piskao Ayurvedic wansukmung tongo. Bini goal wngkha kaisa meal o joto 6 ta taste (kwtwi, kwkhwi, sohm-jak, etc.) no rinai, jemon mang o balance tongo.
Angno kaisa Himalayan chahmungni mui sa.
'Thukpa', kaisa noodle soup, Himalayan amchai, jemon Ladakh tei Sikkim o, belai popular. Abo bolong eba bahan bai sakjak kwtung tei hamjakgo mui.
'Bisi Bele Bath' kon haste ni mui?
'Bisi Bele Bath' wngkha Karnataka ni kaisa mungsajak mui. Abo mai, dal, bolong, tei kaisa special mosla bai sakjak kaisa kwtung tei spicy 'khichdi' hai mui.
