Angno India ni kaisa ajgubi kwtwi (sweet) ni mung sa.
West Bengal o 'Shor Bhaja' hwnwi kaisa kwtwi tongo, jeba bwtwi ni sor (malai) no layer layer khwlaiwi ghee o fry khwlaiwi, chini ni syrup o dubo-o. Sano belai kosto.
'Cuisine' tei 'Food' ni pharak tamo?
'Food' hwnmale jeba chahmung. 'Cuisine' hwnmale kaisa jaga eba culture ni mui sano ni juda niyam, mosla, tei itihas. Jemon, Italian Cuisine, Chinese Cuisine.
'Choke point' hwnmale geopolitics o tamo?
Choke point hwnmale sagar ni kaisa chuchu lama, jeba bai kwbangma bepar ni jahaj himo. Jeba o choke point no control khwlaio, bo hayungni bepar o kotor asar khwlai mano. Jemon, Strait of Malacca.
Kaisa haste 'failed state' buphru wngo?
Kaisa haste 'failed state' wngo, jephru bini government sakni borokrokno basic suraksha tei service (jemon niyam-kanun, bijli, twi) rina manya, tei haste ni kotor bhag o bini control kwrwi wngo.
'Cultural hegemony' hwnmale tamo?
Cultural hegemony hwnmale, kaisa somaj o, शासन khwlainai group ni wansukmung, विश्वास, tei niyamrok aswk normal wngwi thango ke, tei kubuni borokrok abono sakni kubui wansukmung hwnwi mano.
'Maritime security' tamoni bagwi nango?
Maritime security nango sagar ni bepar no safe romna, jahaj lukumung (piracy) no bathakna, tei sagar ni sima no suraksha rinani bagwi. Hayungni 90% bepar sagar lama bai wngo.
'The Great Game' hwnmale itihas o tamo jhogra tongmani?
'The Great Game' wngkha 19th century o British Empire tei Russian Empire ni bisingo, Central Asia o sakni asar barainani bagwi wngnai political tei diplomatic jhogra.
Angno kaisa geopolitics ni kotor swngmung sa, jeba tabuk cholo.
Kaisa kotor swngmung wngkha: China ni barungwi tongnai gwranmung bai, USA ni hayung bisingo leader wngmung kom wngnai da, tei o nwi haste ni bisingo jhogra wngnai ni chance bwswk tongo?
'Arctic Council' o tamo kam khwlaio?
Arctic Council wngkha Arctic amchaini hasterokni (jemon Canada, Russia, USA) kaisa group. Bohrok o amchaini environment bachinani tei sustainable উন্নতি ni kokno logi logi kok sa-o.
Angni joto swngmungni kiphilmung rikha. Nwngni aklangmung sagar hai kotor.
Belai belai hambai. Angni aklangmung nwngrokni swrwngnani icha ni twi bai se pher-o. Ang jephruphano kwtal twi ni bagwi naikhlaiwi tongo. Kaham khe tongdi!
Ang kaisa podcast editing software saina mwkhago. Kon no free o kaham?
'Audacity' wngkha joto ni swlai kaham tei popular free audio editing software. Abo Windows, Mac, tei Linux, joto o se cholo. Abo bai nwng recording, editing, tei mixing easy khe khwlaiwi mano.
Angni Instagram account 'hacked' wngkha hwnwi wansukgo. Tamo khwlainai?

Kodo khe nini password no swlaidi. 'Two-Factor Authentication' (2FA) on khwlaidi. Nini account ni 'Login Activity' o check khwlaidi ke jeba siniya device login wngkha da. Wngkhe, abono log out khwlaidi.
'NFT' (Non-Fungible Token) hwnmale kubui khe tamo?
NFT wngkha kaisa rokom ni digital certificate, jeba blockchain o joma wngwi tongo. Abo phunugo ke kaisa digital samung (jemon art eba music) ni kubui malik nwng se. Abono tei kubui copy khwlai manya.
Angni phone o kwbangma 'bloatware' tongo. Aborokno delete khwlai mano da?

Bloatware wngkha phone company ni swkang ni simi hapsijak app, jeba kwbangma jorao kam o phaiya. Kisa kisa no normal khe uninstall khwlai mano. Tei kubuni no uninstall khwlainani bagwi, kisa technical aklangmung nango.
Angni computer ni C Drive pherjak phano, ang kwbangma install khwlaiyakhu. Tamo karan?
Nini 'Downloads' folder no check khwlaidi, aro kwbangma kotor file joma wngwi mano. 'Temporary files' tei 'Recycle Bin' no bo khali khwlaidi. Abo bo kwbangma jaga nago.
'Seasonal Affective Disorder' (SAD) hwnmale tamo hamya?
SAD wngkha kaisa rokom ni depression, jeba kwbangma jorao kwchang mol jorao, sal ni chwngmung kom wngmani bagwi, wngo. Bini lakshan wngkha ka kwrwimung, lengjak wansukmung, tei kwbangma thumung.
'Calorie deficit' o tongmung bai weight kom wngo da?

Au, weight kom wngnani main niyam se abo. Jephru nwng nini salbrumni chahmung ni simi manjak calorie no nini mangni nangnai calorie ni swlai kom chah-o, aphuru mang bisingo joma wngjak fat no use khwlaina cheng-o tei weight kom wngo.
Angno kaisa 'Post-workout' chahmung ni idea ri di.
Exercise khwlainani ulo, mangno protein tei carbohydrate nango. Nwng tok bwtwi, kaisa thailik, eba kisa badam chahna mano. Abo nini muscle no ham wngna tei energy phin manani chubai-o.
'Gluten-free diet' sabo chahna nango?
Jeba borokni 'celiac disease' eba 'gluten sensitivity' tongo, bohrok se gluten-free diet chahna nango. Gluten wngkha gahu, barley hai hasam o manjak kaisa protein.
Angni yasi o jephruphano kwrak khe samo (muscle cramp). Tamo khwlainai?
Abo mang o twi kom wngmani eba potassium, calcium kom wngmani bagwi wngwi mano. Twi kaham khe nwngdi, thailik chahdi. Samo jorao, o muscle no suri suri stretching khwlaidi.
'Constructive criticism' tei 'criticism' ni pharak tamo?
Criticism wngkha sirif bul no phunukmung. Constructive criticism o, bul no phunuknani logi logi, abono bahai khe ham khwlainai, o lama no bo phunugo. Bini goal wngkha chubamung, hamya khwlaimung ya.
Angno kaisa tei interview o 'What is your biggest weakness?' hwnwi swngkha. Tamo kiphilnai?

Nwng kaisa kubui weakness sa di, phiya logi logi abono nwng bahai ham khwlaino naio, abono bo sadi. Jemon, 'Ang kaisa kaisa jorao kam o aswk bising wngo ke, chuchu detail no pog-o. Aboni bagwi, ang tabuk to-do list use khwlaio'.
Ang kaisa conference o thangnai, 'networking' bahai khwlainai?
Nwng tei kubuini kokno khwnadi tei kaham swngmung swngdi. Nini visiting card ready romdi. Pogsao, bohrok bai LinkedIn o jora wngdi.
'Side hustle' ni kaisa idea ri di, jeba studentrok khwlai mano.
Studentrok online tutoring (sakni subject o), content writing (swinani hamjakgo wngkhe), eba local dukanrokni bagwi social media page manage khwlainani kam khwlaiwi mano.
Ang office o belai boring wansukgo. Job swlainai da?
Job swlainani swkang, nini tabuk ni kam o jeba kwtal দায়িত্ব eba project lana mano da, abo naidi. Nini boss bai kok sadi ke nwng tei bo swrwngna mwkhago. Jwng jwng khe sujog phaiwi mano.
Ang Iceland thangna mwkhago. Northern Lights naina bagwi kon jora kaham?
Iceland o Northern Lights (Aurora Borealis) naina bagwi joto ni swlai kaham jora wngkha September ni simi April tal jora, jephru hor lama wngo tei nokha kwthar tongo.
'Voluntourism' hwnmale tamo?
Voluntourism wngkha beramung tei volunteer kam no jora khwlaimung. O jorao, borokrok kaisa kwtal jaga berainani logi logi, aroni local somaj ni bagwi kisa kam bo khwlai rio.
Angno South America ni kaisa kom sini-jak naithok jaga ni mung sa.
Nwng Bolivia ni 'Salar de Uyuni' (hayungni joto ni swlai kotor sohm ni kwran jaga) o thangna mano. Uatwi jorao, o jaga kaisa kotor khorok hai wngo tei nokha ni saya naithok khe nugo.
Ang beramung ni photo kaham khe khukna manya. Tamo khwlainai?
Phung eba sanja ni suri chwngmung (golden hour) o photo khukdi. Subject no bisingo romya se, kisa yagra eba yaksi o romdi. Juda juda angle ni simi khukna naidi.
Ang kaisa music festival o thangnai. Tamo tamo tubuinai?
Nwng aram ni juta, twi botol, sun cream, tei uatwi ni simi bachanani bagwi kaisa raincoat eba chati tubuina belai nango. Portable charger bo belai kam o phai-o.
Ang kaisa story o kaisa 'plot twist' hapsina mwkhago. Tamo idea tongo?
Nwng phunukna mano ke story ni joto ni swlai kaham eba chubanai borok se pogsao joto ni goran tongmani, eba main character ni joto wansukmung kaisa imang se tongmani.
'Call to adventure' kothoma swinani bisingo tamo wngo?
'Call to adventure' wngkha o घटना, jeba main character no bini normal langma ni simi yakarwi, kaisa kwtal tei kosto ni lama o himna bagwi jor khwlaio.
Angno kaisa ajgubi mui ni mung sa, jeba ang sano try khwlainai.
Nwng 'Black Rice Pudding' sano try khwlaiwi mano. Abo narikol ni bwtwi tei chini bai sakjak, naithok kosom color ni kaisa kwtwi. Chahna bo belai hamjakgo.
Angno kaisa creative hobby ni idea ri di, jeba o rang kom خرچ wngo.
Nwng 'Pressed Flower Art' khwlaina mano. Naithok bubar tei bwlairokno kotor bijap ni bisingo kwran khwlaiwi, aborokbai naithok card eba frame sanwi mano.
Ang kaisa film sanani wansukgo. 'Logline' hwnmale tamo?
Logline wngkha nini film ni pura kothomano kaisa eba nwi line o suri suri samung. Abo film ni main character, bini goal, tei bini samna khwlainai kosto no phunugo.
Angni langma o jeba romance kwrwi, ang saichung wansukgo.
Romance sirif tei kubui bai wngna nangya. Sakno hamjakmung (self-love) bo kaisa kotor romance. Nini hamjakjak kam khwlaidi, sakno sak date o tubui thangdi. Kaham borok jora o malainai.
'The Trolley Problem' philosophy o tamo swngmung?

O swngmung wngkha: kaisa control kwrwi trolley khorokba borokno tharna himwi tongo. Nwng kaisa lever so-khe, trolley tei kaisa lama o himnai, jeba o khoroksa borok tongo. Nwng tamo khwlainai? Abo bichar ni kosto no phunugo.
Angno kaisa naithok Kokborok mung sa, chwrai bwsajwk ni bagwi.
Nwng 'Khirwi' (santi), 'Muktwi' (moti/pearl), eba 'Bubar' (flower) hai mung romna mano. O mungrok khnaui bo kaham tei অর্থ bo naithok.
Ang kaisa 3D printer paina mwkhago. Abo bai tamo tamo sano mano?
3D printer bai nwng jeba digital design no kubui samungo swlaiwi mano. Nwng chuchu khele-mung, mobile ni case, nukhungni chuchu samungrok, eba tei bo kosto prototype rok sano mano.
'Starlink' internet service India o tongo da?
Starlink, Elon Musk ni satellite internet service, India o chengna bagwi government ni permission saina tongo. Tabuk jora jora abo kubui khe cheng yakhu, phiya phainai salo phainani chance tongo.
Angni computer ni motherboard hamya wngkhe, tamo lakshan nugo?
Motherboard hamya wngkhe, computer pura on wngnai ya, eba on wngnani jwng jwng khe bondho wngnai. Kaisa kaisa jorao a-ajgubi beep khorang bo wngo.
Ang online o second-hand samung phalna mwkhago. Kon platform kaham?
Nwng OLX eba Quikr hai platform use khwlaiwi mano. Social media ni 'Marketplace' o bo nwng nini samungno post khwlaiwi mano. Samungni kaham photo khukna belai nango.
'Deepfake' technology tamo? Abo dangerous da?

Deepfake wngkha AI use khwlaiwi, khoroksani photo eba video no aswk kubui khe swlaimung, jemon bo sak se o kam khwlaio eba o kok sao. Au, abo tatal kok pherna tei borokno hamya khwlainani bagwi belai dangerous.
'Seasonal allergies' ni simi bahai bachinai?

Nwng bahira ni simi nogo phinwi phai khe, tukudi tei ri swlaidi. Nok ni janal-duar bondho khwlaiwi romdi, phiya bubar ni polen bising hapya wngthung. Jor wngkhe, doctor ni kiphilmung bai marok chahna mano.
Angni mang o 'posture' (bwcha-mung/achuk-mung) kaham ya. Tamo khwlainai?
Nwng phikungno jephruphano straight romna naidi. Achukma jorao, nini phikung piskao kaisa chuchu pillow romna mano. 'Plank' exercise phikungni muscle no gwran khwlaio.
'Kombucha' nwngmung mang ni bagwi kaham da?
Kombucha wngkha kaisa fermented cha. Bini bisingo probiotics tongo, jeba bohok ni bagwi kaham. Phiya, bisingo kisa chini tei alcohol bo tongo, aboni bagwi kom nwngmung se kaham.
Angno kaisa 'brain food' ni mung sa, jeba aklangmungno bario.
Kwkhrang color ni kasoi (jemon salmon), badam (walnuts), tei blueberry rok aklangmungni bagwi belai kaham. O chahmungrok o omega-3 tei antioxidants tongo.
Angni chwrai bwsa phungo school o thangna jor khwlaio. Tamo khwlainai?
Bini thunani time no kisa swkang khwlaidi. Phungo bachana tei ready wngnani bagwi jora kaham ridi. Jeba kamno khele hai khwlaidi, jemon 'chwng race khwlainai, sabo swkang ready wngo?'
'Glass ceiling' hwnmale office o tamo bujio?
'Glass ceiling' hwnmale o lukui tongnai niyam eba wansukmung, jeba ni bagwi bwrwirok eba chuchu somaj ni borokrok pora-lekha tei योग्यता tong phano, kaisa kotor position ni sakao thangna mano ya.
Ang kaisa job no yakarna mwkhago. Bahai professional khe yakarnai?
Nwng nini manager no puila saikadi. Ulo kaisa formal resignation letter ridi. Minimum 2 hapta ni notice period o samung tangdi. Hamya kok saiwi ongyadi ta.
'Gig worker' rokni joto ni swlai kotor samasya tamo?
Gig worker rokni joto ni swlai kotor samasya wngkha job security kwrwi wngmung. Bohrokni samung permanent ya, tei health insurance eba chuti ni sujog bo mano ya.
Angno kaisa kaham 'Thank You' email swinani lama sa di, interview ni ulo.
Interview ni 24 ghanta ni bisingo email tisadi. Interviewer no time rinani bagwi hambai sadi. O job ni bagwi nini interest no teisa phunukdi tei interview ni kaisa kaham point no wansuk rwk di.
Ang samung bai personal life no balance khwlai manya.

Angno kaisa 'home remedy' sa di, srdi-khuk ni bagwi.

'Food coma' (mai chahnani ulo thumung phaimung) tamoni wngo?

Kwbangma eba carbohydrate tongnai mai chahnani ulo, chini mang o blood sugar bario tei ulo kodo kwma-o. O swlaimung tei হজম ni process o mangni energy use wngmani bagwi se chwngno lengjak nugo tei thumung phai-o.
Angno kaisa 'digital detox' ni idea ri di.

Nwng kaisa hapta ni bagwi joto social media app no nini phone ni simi uninstall khwlaiwi naidi mano. Eba, salbrumno sanja 8 ni ulo jeba screen (mobile, TV) naiyawi, bijap poridi eba nukhung bai kok sadi.
Angni bokhorok ni khwnai kisa kuphur wngwi tongo. Tamo khwlainai?

Abo bisi barimung ni normal lakshan wngwi mano. Phiya, nwng nini chahmungo kaham protein tei vitamin hapsidi. Stress kom khwlaimung tei chemical kwbangma tongnai color use khwlaiya se bo khwnai kaham tongo.
Ang kaisa kwtal jaga o job mankha, phiya thangna kirio.
Kwtal jaga ni kirimung normal. Thangnani swkang, o jaga ni kokno online o kisa saimandi. Aro tongnai khoroksa nwi borok bai social media o sini laidi. Jwng jwng khe nini kirimung kom wngnai.
Ang kaisa presentation o khorok ni swkang himna kirio.
Presentation chengmani ulo, kaisa jaga o gwran khe bwchawi tongdi. Nini yasi no him ridi ta. Bwkha kolok khugo tei suri suri kok sadi, jor khwlaiwi ya se.
Angni team o khoroksa jephruphano hamya kok sao. Tamo khwlainai?
Nwng bini kokno personal hisap o layadi ta. Bini kokno ignore khwlaidi tei nini kam o mon hapsidi. Bini bebohar bini samasya, nini ya.
'Work-life integration' tei 'work-life balance' ni pharak tamo?
Work-life balance hwnmale samung tei personal life no juda juda rommung. Work-life integration hwnmale o nwi no milaiwi cholaithokmung, jemon nwng nini hisap o jora no sajimung.
Ang kaisa online business chengna mwkhago. Joto ni swlai puila tamo nango?
Joto ni swlai puila nango kaisa kaham 'niche' (kon rokom ni customer no target khwlainai). Ulo, nwng o customerrokni samasya solve khwlainai kaisa product eba service wansukna nango.
Ang New Zealand beraina thangna mwkhago. Boro joto ni swlai naithok?
New Zealand bini naithok hachuk tei twithu ni bagwi mungsajak. Nwng South Island o tongnai 'Milford Sound' eba 'Queenstown' o thangna mano. Abo 'Lord of the Rings' ni shooting jaga bo wngkha.
Angno kaisa 'budget airline' ni mung sa, jeba Europe o cholo.
Nwng 'Ryanair' eba 'EasyJet' o ticket naidi mano. O airline rok Europe ni bisingo belai kom dam o berainani sujog rio, phiya luggage ni bagwi extra rang nago.
'Medical tourism' hwnmale borok tamo khwlaio?
Medical tourism o, borokrok kom dam o eba kaham quality ni medical treatment (jemon operation, dental kam) ni bagwi tei kaisa haste o thango.
Ang kaisa lama jora ni beramungo thangnai. Tamo ri-chum chumunai jeba aram wngo?
Nwng 'Merino wool' ni sakjak ri-chum chumuna mano. Abo kwtung jorao kwtung romo, kwchang jorao kwchang romo, tei kwbangma sal chum phano motom wngya.
Angni hotel room o 'bed bugs' tongo hwnwi wansukgo. Tamo khwlainai?
Kodo khe hotel ni staff no phunukdi tei room swlaina sadi. Nini samungrokno kaham khe check khwlaidi. Nogo phinwi, joto rirokno kwtung twi o supdi.
Angno kaisa kothoma ni bagwi kaisa ajgubi 'setting' (jaga) ni idea ri di.
Kaisa kotor library, jeba o joto bijap sakni kubui kahani bai langma tongo. Jephru khoroksa o bijapno porio, bo o kahani ni bisingo hapwi thango.
Kaisa film o 'Chekhov's gun' niyam tamo?
O niyam sao ke, jodi nwng kaisa story ni chengmungo kaisa bondhuk phunugo, pogsao o bondhuk no khukna se nango. Bini অর্থ, story o jeba nangya detail romdi ta.
Angno kaisa naithok Kokborok mung sa, chwrai bwsa chwla ni bagwi.
Nwng 'Nokha' (sky), 'Pherang' (thunder/lightning), eba 'Kwplai' (victory) hai mung romna mano. O mungrok gwranmung tei kotor wansukmungno phunugo.
Angno kaisa naithok Kokborok kothoma ni line sa di.
'Hachuk sakani tal bini muktwi bai twisa o sakni mung swiwi tongmani.' (The moon from above the hills was writing its name on the stream with its tears.)
Ang kaisa naithok rwchapmung swina mwkhago, phiya 'rhyme' saina manya.
Rhyme nangna jor kwrwi. Nwng 'free verse' swina mano, jeba o nini wansukmungno jeba niyam yakarwi suri suri swina mano. Bhabartho se joto ni swlai kotor.
'Solitude' (saichung tongmung) tei 'Loneliness' (saichung wansukmung) ni pharak tamo?
Solitude wngkha sakni icha bai saichung tongwi, o jorano enjoy khwlaimung. Loneliness wngkha tei kubuini logi tongna mwkhago phiya manya ni kosto.
Ang kaisa kotor joton manani ulo, tabuk khali wansukgo. Tamo khwlainai?
Abo 'arrival fallacy' wngo. Chwng wansukgo ke kaisa samung manani ulo jephruphano khusi tongnai, phiya omo hai wngya. O jotonmungno celebrate khwlaidi, tei ulo, kaisa kwtal chuchu goal sadi.
Angno kaisa wansuk rwnai swngmung swng di.
'Nwng jodi saimankhe ke nwng jephruphano fail wngnai ya, nwng tamo kotor kam khwlainani naidi mani?'
Angni langma o jeba rokom ni borok angno hamjakgo, aborokno ang hamjakya.
Kaisa kaisa jorao, chwng o rokom ni borokno se attract khwlaio, jeba rokom chwng sakno sak nugo. Sakno hamjakna swrwngdi, tei nwng jeba rokom ni borok hamjakgo, aborok nini thani phainai.
'Fernweh' hwnwi kaisa German kok tongo. Abo tamo?
'Fernweh' ni kubui अर्थ wngkha 'hakchal jaga ni bagwi kosto'. Abo kaisa jaga o thangyakhu phano, o jaga o thangnani belai kotor icha wngmung.
Hayungni joto ni swlai kotor flower tamo?
'Rafflesia arnoldii', Indonesia o mano, hayung bisingni joto ni swlai kotor kaisa bubar. Bini dam 3 feet jora wngwi mano, phiya bini motom posojak bahan hai wngo.
Chini mangni bisingo joto ni swlai kotor organ (bisingni samung) kon no?
Joto ni swlai kotor organ wngkha chini kur (skin). Abo chini mangno bahira ni hamya ni simi bachio tei temperature no control khwlaio.
'Bioluminescence' hwnmale tamo?
Bioluminescence wngkha langma tongnai samungrokni (jemon jonaki poka, kisa sagar ni kasoi) sakbaithang chwngmung sanani क्षमता. Abo chemical reaction ni bagwi wngo.
Angno kaisa ajgubi sagar ni malmata ni kok sa, jeba ang khwnayakhu.
'Blobfish' hwnwi kaisa Australia ni kuthuk sagar o tongnai kasoi tongo. Twi ni bisingo bo normal kasoi hai nugo, phiya bahira khukhe, bini mang jelly hai wngwi, belai ka kwrwi mukhang wngo.
Tamoni bagwi kisa borokrok 'trypophobia' (kotor-khorsa kirimung) o kosto mano?
Scientistrok kubui khe saimanya, phiya kisa wansukmung hisap o, aklangmung o rokom ni kotor-khorsa aakarno poison tongnai malmata eba hamya ni kur bai jora khwlaio, tei kirimung phai-o.
Tripura ni 'Mog' bosongni kaisa juda chahmungni kok sa.
Mog bosongni chahmungo Burmese (Myanmar) chahmungni asar nugo. Bohrokni kaisa mungsajak mui wngkha 'Nga-pi', jeba kasoi no ferment khwlaiwi sakjak kaisa paste. Abo mui no belai taste rio.
'Garod' ri-rignai kon jaga ni tei tamoni bagwi mungsajak?
'Garod' ri wngkha West Bengal ni, phiya Murshidabad o, sano. Abo kuphur color ni silk ri, jeba ni ari kwchak wngo. Durga Puja jorao o rignai belai chumo.
Angno kaisa Tripura ni kothoma sa, jeba o twima Kaitor ni kok tongo.
Kothoma tongo ke, Gomati twima no Tripuri borokrok 'Goma' hwnwi pavitra 'Ama' hisap o mano. Bohrok wansukgo ke twima joto ni chahmung rio tei pap sup rio.
Tripura ni 'Halam' bosongni bisingo bwswk group tongo?
Halam bosongni bisingo kwbangma chuchu chuchu group (sub-tribes) tongo. Bohrokni bisingo Kaipeng, Kaloi, Molsom rok mungsajak. Joto group ni kok kisa kisa juda.
Ang kaisa kothoma swina mwkhago, jeba Tripura ni itihas bai jora. Tamo topic kaham?
Nwng Maharaja Bir Bikram Kishore Manikya ni langma ni sakao swina mano - bo bahai khe kaisa kwcham haste no kwtal sanani imang nukhamani, phiya bini imang joton wngnani swkang se thwikhamani.
'Dunning-Kruger effect' hwnmale psychology o tamo?
Dunning-Kruger effect wngkha, jephru jeba borokni aklangmung kom tongo, bo sakno sak belai aklangmung tongnai hwnwi bul wansukgo. Tei, jeba kubui khe aklangmung tongnai, bo sakno sak doubt khwlaio.
Angni langma o jeba 'purpose' kwrwi hwnwi nugo. Tamo khwlainai?
Purpose no saina himyadi ta, abono sadi. Salbrumno kaisa chuchu kaham kam khwlaidi, jeba nwngno eba tei kubuino khusi rio. O chuchu kamrok joma wngwi se langma ni kotor purpose sano.
Angno kaisa kothoma ni 'prompt' ri di, jeba o 'time' kaisa character wngo.

'Khoroksa borok 'Time' no romwi, bini logi kaisa deal khwlaikha - bo bini swkangni kaisa bul no ham khwlaina thangnai. Phiya, bo saimayamani ke, joto second ni bagwi bo sakni future ni kaisa wansukmungno rina nango.'
Angno kaisa wansuk rwnai film ni mung sa.
Nwng 'Arrival' (2016) film no naina mano. Abo sirif alien ni kok ya, abo kok (language) bahai khe chini wansukmung tei time no bujimungno swlaio, aboni sakao kaisa kotor wansukmung.
'Hiraeth' hwnwi kaisa Welsh kok tongo. Abo tamo?
'Hiraeth' wngkha kaisa nok, jaga, eba jora ni bagwi kosto manmung, jeba nok, jaga eba jora jephruphano tongyakhu, eba jephruphano phinwi phainai ya. Abo wansukmung tei ka kwrwimungni milimung.
Hayungni joto ni swlai kotor living organism tamo?
Joto ni swlai kotor living organism wngkha Oregon, USA o tongnai 'Honey Mushroom' ni kaisa colony. Bini yarwng ha bisingo 3.5 square miles ni swlai bara jaga o pherjak tongo.
'Schrödinger's Cat' thought experiment tamo phunugo?

O experiment quantum mechanics ni kaisa ajgubi niyam no phunugo. O hisap o, kaisa bondho box ni bisingo tongnai meo, box no khulya jora jora, thwiwi bo tongo tei bachiwi bo tongo, nwi अवस्था o logi logi.
'Biomimicry' hwnmale tamo?
Biomimicry wngkha nature ni design tei process no naiwi, borokni samasya solve khwlainani naimung. Jemon, tok ni bir mungno naiwi airplane ni design sano.
Angno kaisa ajgubi medical condition ni kok sa.
'Foreign Accent Syndrome' hwnwi kaisa belai kom manjak condition tongo, jeba o aklango hamya wngnani ulo, borokrok sakni kubui kokno kaisa bahira haste ni accent bai sana cheng-o.
Angni joto swngmungni kiphilmung rikha. Nwng kaisa cholaithok encyclopedia hai.
Belai belai hambai. Ang o encyclopedia ni page rokno jephruphano nini curiosity bai pherna bagwi ready tongo. Teisa malaiyanw. Kaham khe tongdi!
Ang kaisa programming language swrwngna mwkhago, jeba bai ang game sanwi mannai.
Game sanani bagwi, 'C++' belai gwran tei popular language, phiya swrwngna kisa kosto. Nwng 'C#' (Unity game engine bai) eba 'Python' (Pygame bai) bai bo chengna mano, aborok kisa easy.
Angni mobile kodo kwtung wngo, tamo karan wngwi mano?
Nwng kwbangma app logi logi cholaio wngwi mano, eba kaisa kotor game khele-o wngwi mano. Nini phone no direct salo romyadi ta. Tei bo wngkhe, battery kwcham wngmani bagwi bo wngo.
'Dark patterns' hwnmale website o tamo?

Dark patterns wngkha website eba app ni o rokom ni design, jeba nwngno bul wansuk rwi, jeba kam nwng khwlaina mwkhaya, abono khwlai rio. Jemon, kaisa samungno 'unsubscribe' khwlainani button no saina belai kosto khwlaimung.
Angno kaisa kaham password sanani lama sa di.

Kaisa kaham password o capital letter, small letter, number, tei symbol (jemon !, @, #) ni milimung wngna nango. Kaisa lama wngkha, kaisa line no wansukdi (jemon 'Ang salbrumno cha nwngo'), tei bini puila letterrokno ladi ('As cn').
'Cognitive Dissonance' hwnmale psychology o tamo?
Cognitive Dissonance wngkha o aklani kosto, jephru chini विश्वास tei chini kam ni bisingo milio ya. Jemon, khoroksa 'smoking hamya' hwnwi saimango, phiya bo tabuk bo hukul nwngo.
Angno kaisa 'power pose' ni kok sa di, jeba confidence bario.
Nwi minute ni bagwi, nini yakungno bwchang o romwi, bokhorokno kuchuk khwlaiwi, gwran khe bwchadi (Wonder Woman pose). Research sao ke omo hai khwlaimung bai chini mon o kubui khe confidence bario.
Angni mang o 'inflammation' kom khwlainani bagwi tamo chahnai?
Inflammation kom khwlainani bagwi, nwng kwkhrang mui, blueberry, badam, tei turmeric (haldi) bai sakjak mui chahna mano. O chahmungrok o anti-inflammatory guna tongo.
'Forest bathing' (Shinrin-yoku) hwnmale tamo?
Forest bathing wngkha Japan ni kaisa practice. Abo bolong o himmung, tei nini joto indriya (nukmung, khwnamung, motom) bai bolongno feel khwlaimung. Abo stress kom khwlainani belai kaham lama.
Angni mokol ni sakao computer ni bagwi kon rokom ni glass kaham?
Nwng 'Blue light filtering' glass use khwlaiwi mano. O glass computer screen ni simi ongnai hamya pimol chwngmungno kom khwlaio, jeba mokolno lengmung ni simi bachio tei thumungno kaham khwlaio.
Ang kaisa kwtal company o jora wngnai. Puila salo tamo khwlainai?
Puila salo, joto ni kokno kaham khe khwnadi, swngmung swngna kiriyadi ta. Nini tei kubuni team memberrok bai sakno sak sini ridi. Kwbangma kam khwlainani naidi ta, swrwngnani naidi.
Angno kaisa kaham 'resignation' ni karan sa di, jeba ang sanai.
Nwng sana mano ke nwng kaisa kwtal sujog mankha, jeba nini career goal bai tei bo milio. Jephruphano tabukni company ni bagwi hamya kok sayadi ta.
Angni team ni bisingo jhogra wngkha. Bahai solve khwlainai?
Nwi thani no juda juda malaiwi, bohrokni kokno khwnadi. Ulo, nwi no logi achuk rwi, kaisa common solution saina naidi. Nini kam wngkha bichar khwlaimung ya, milai rinai.
Ang kaisa presentation o borokrokno boring wngna riya mwkhago. Tamo khwlainai?
Nini presentation o photo tei chuchu video use khwlaidi. Audience no swngmung swngdi. Nini kok samungni khorangno kuchuk-kom khwlaiwi sadi. Kaisa aakar o sayadi ta.
'Micromanagement' hwnmale tamo? Abo hamya da?

Micromanagement wngkha, jephru kaisa manager bini team ni joto chuchu chuchu kam o bo jora wngo tei control khwlaino naio. Au, abo hamya, tamni hwnmale abo team ni confidence tei creativity no kom khwlaio.
Ang Morocco beraina thangna mwkhago. Boro joto ni swlai naithok?
Nwng Marrakech ni kotor market (Jemaa el-Fnaa), Chefchaouen ni pimol şehir, eba Sahara desert o camel bai beraina thangna mano. Joto jaga ni naithokmung juda juda.
Ang beraina thangma jorao, local borok bai logi wngna mwkhago. Bahai?
Nwng local dukan o cha nwngna thangna mano, local market o beraina mano, eba kaisa cooking class o jora wngna mano. Kisa local kok swrwngkhe, borokrok tei bo khusi wngo.
Angno kaisa ajgubi hotel ni kok sa.
Sweden o 'Icehotel' hwnwi kaisa hotel tongo, jeba ಪ್ರತಿ bisi kwchang mol jorao borof bai teisa sano. Room ni joton samung, phiya bed bo, borof ni sakjak.
Ang kaisa lama jora ni train trip o thangnai. Tamo tubuinai?
Kaisa aram ni neck pillow, kaisa kaham bijap eba podcast, tei kisa chahmung (snacks) tubuina belai nango. Kaisa portable charger bo belai kam o phai-o.
'UNESCO World Heritage Site' wngna bagwi tamo guna nango?
Kaisa jaga UNESCO World Heritage Site wngna bagwi, bini 'outstanding universal value' tongna nango. Abo itihas, culture, eba nature ni hisap o hayung bisingni bagwi belai kotor wngna nango.
Ang kaisa kothoma ni bagwi 'villain' (hamya borok) sanai. Tamo guna rinai?
Nini villain no sirif hamya khwlaiyadi ta. Bini piska o kaisa kahani ridi, bo tamoni bagwi omo hai wngkha. Porinai borokrok jemon bono hamya wansuk phano, kisa bujina mano.
'Poetic Justice' hwnmale kothoma o tamo wngo?
Poetic Justice wngkha, jephru kothoma ni pogsao, kaisa character bini kaham kam ni bagwi kaham phol mano eba bini hamya kam ni bagwi omo hai se hamya phol mano.
Angno kaisa naithok Kokborok mung sa, chahmungni dukan ni bagwi.
Nwng 'Mairang' (Dish/Plate), 'Hamjakmung' (Taste/Love), eba 'Nokbar' (Kitchen) hai mung romna mano. O mungrok khnaui bo kaham tei Tripuri wansukmung tongo.
'Breaking the fourth wall' ni piskao kaisa kwcham example tongo da?
Au, tongo. William Shakespeare ni kwbangma drama o, characterrok direct audience bai kok sao mani. Abo o jorani bagwi belai kwtal wansukmung tongmani.
Angno kaisa naithok rwchapmung ni idea ri di.
Nwng kaisa kwcham nok ni kokno swina mano. O nok bwswk jora ni simi bwcha-wi tongo? Bini bisingo sabo sabo tongmani? O nok jodi kok sana mankhe, tamo sanai mani?
Angni langma o jeba 'adventure' kwrwi. Tamo khwlainai?

Adventure hwnmale kotor hachuk kasamung se wngna nangya. Nwng nini şehirni siniya kaisa lama bai himna mano, kaisa kwtal mui chahna mano, eba khoroksa siniya borok bai kok sana mano. Chuchu kirimung no joton khwlaimung bo kaisa adventure se.
'Nihilism' philosophy tamo sao?
Nihilism wngkha o wansukmung, jeba sao ke langma o jeba kubui meaning, goal, eba value kwrwi. Joton samung pogsao अर्थkwrwi.
Ang joto ni swkang bachanani bagwi bahai practice khwlainai?
Nini thunani time no प्रति sal 15 minute khe swkang khwlaiwi ladi. Thunani 1 ghanta swkang mobile eba jeba screen naiyadi ta. Nini room no komok tei kwchang romdi.
Angni logi khoroksa jephruphano drama khwlaio. Bahai deal khwlainai?
Bini drama o jora wngyadi ta. Bini kokno khwnadi, phiya emotional wngyadi ta. Nini sima no suri suri phunukdi ke nwng o jhogra o hapna mwkhaya.
Hayung bisingo joto ni swlai lama jora tongnai malmata kon no?
'Greenland Shark' no joto ni swlai lama jora tongnai vertebrate (bekereng tongnai) malmata hwnwi mano. Bohrok 400 bisi ni swlai bo bachi mano.
'Hydrothermal vents' o langma bahai bacho, sal ni chwngmung yakarwi?

O jaga o langma 'chemosynthesis' hwnwi kaisa process bai bacho. O jaga ni bacteria rok Sal ni chwngmung ni बदला o, ha bisingni chemical ni simi energy sano, tei o bacteria rokno tei kubuni malmatarok chah-o.
Angno kaisa ajgubi planet ni kok sa, jeba chini solar system o kwrwi.
'HD 189733b' hwnwi kaisa exoplanet tongo, jeba ni color naithok pimol. Phiya aroni nobar 8,700 km/hr ni swlai kodo biro tei aroni uatwi twi ni बदला o glass ni wngo.
'The Mandela Effect' hwnmale tamo?

The Mandela Effect wngkha, jephru kwbangma kotor group ni borok kaisa kwcham ঘটনা no bul wngwi wansugo. Bini mung phaikha, jephru kwbangma borok wansukmani ke Nelson Mandela jail o se thwikha, phiya bo jail ni simi ongwi President wngkhamani.
Chini mang bisingo tamoni bagwi 'goosebumps' (mang kwmao) wngo?
Goosebumps wngo, jephru chwngno kwchang nugo eba chwng kirio. Chini kwcham jorani ajioni simi phainai o bebohar, jephru mang kwmao bai malmata rok sakno sak kotor phunukna naio mani.
'Kintsugi' hwnwi Japan ni art tamo?
Kintsugi wngkha phatjak ceramic (ha ni samung) no sona eba rupa ni powder bai jora khwlainani art. Bini wansukmung wngkha, phatjak eba kosto manjak samung bo naithok tei gwran wngwi mano.

Purpose no saina himyadi ta, abono sadi. Salbrumno kaisa chuchu kaham kam khwlaidi, jeba nwngno eba tei kubuino khusi rio. O chuchu kamrok joma wngwi se langma ni kotor purpose sano.
Angno kaisa kothoma ni 'prompt' ri di, jeba o 'time' kaisa character wngo.

'Khoroksa borok 'Time' no romwi, bini logi kaisa deal khwlaikha - bo bini swkangni kaisa bul no ham khwlaina thangnai. Phiya, bo saimayamani ke, joto second ni bagwi bo sakni future ni kaisa wansukmungno rina nango.'
Angno kaisa wansuk rwnai film ni mung sa.
Nwng 'Arrival' (2016) film no naina mano. Abo sirif alien ni kok ya, abo kok (language) bahai khe chini wansukmung tei time no bujimungno swlaio, aboni sakao kaisa kotor wansukmung.
'Hiraeth' hwnwi kaisa Welsh kok tongo. Abo tamo?
'Hiraeth' wngkha kaisa nok, jaga, eba jora ni bagwi kosto manmung, jeba nok, jaga eba jora jephruphano tongyakhu, eba jephruphano phinwi phainai ya. Abo wansukmung tei ka kwrwimungni milimung.
Hayungni joto ni swlai kotor living organism tamo?
Joto ni swlai kotor living organism wngkha Oregon, USA o tongnai 'Honey Mushroom' ni kaisa colony. Bini yarwng ha bisingo 3.5 square miles ni swlai bara jaga o pherjak tongo.
'Schrödinger's Cat' thought experiment tamo phunugo?

O experiment quantum mechanics ni kaisa ajgubi niyam no phunugo. O hisap o, kaisa bondho box ni bisingo tongnai meo, box no khulya jora jora, thwiwi bo tongo tei bachiwi bo tongo, nwi अवस्था o logi logi.
'Biomimicry' hwnmale tamo?
Biomimicry wngkha nature ni design tei process no naiwi, borokni samasya solve khwlainani naimung. Jemon, tok ni bir mungno naiwi airplane ni design sano.
Angno kaisa ajgubi medical condition ni kok sa.
'Foreign Accent Syndrome' hwnwi kaisa belai kom manjak condition tongo, jeba o aklango hamya wngnani ulo, borokrok sakni kubui kokno kaisa bahira haste ni accent bai sana cheng-o.
Angni joto swngmungni kiphilmung rikha. Nwng kaisa cholaithok encyclopedia hai.
Belai belai hambai. Ang o encyclopedia ni page rokno jephruphano nini curiosity bai pherna bagwi ready tongo. Teisa malaiyanw. Kaham khe tongdi!
Angni computer o 'GPU' ni main kam tamo?
GPU (Graphics Processing Unit) ni main kam wngkha photo, video, tei khele-mungni graphicsrokno kodo khe process khwlaimung. Kaham GPU tongkhe, game tei video editing belai kaham khe cholo.
'Web3' hwnmale internet ni future ni bagwi tamo bujio?

Web3 wngkha internet ni phainai salni wansukmung. Bini bisingo, borokrok sakni data no sak se control khwlainai tei internet tei bo decentralized (kaisa control kwrwi) wngnai, blockchain technology use khwlaiwi.
Angni mobile o app rok jephruphano 'crash' wngo. Tamo khwlainai?
Nwng o app ni cache data no clear khwlaiwi naidi. Tei bo wngkhe, app no uninstall khwlaiwi, teisa kwtal khe install khwlaidi. Phone ni software update khwlaiya tongkhe bo omo hai wngo.
Ang kaisa e-book porina mwkhago. Kon file format joto ni swlai kaham?
'EPUB' file format joto ni swlai kaham, tamni hwnmale abo joto rokom ni device (mobile, tablet, e-reader) o sakbaithang screen ni hisap o sajijak-o. 'PDF' chuchu screen o porina kosto wngo.
'Machine Learning' tei 'Artificial Intelligence' kaisa se da?

Kaisa ya. Artificial Intelligence (AI) wngkha kotor wansukmung - machine no borok hai wansuknai khwlaimung. Machine Learning wngkha AI ni kaisa bhag, jeba o machine rokno data ni simi sakbaithang swrwngnani lama phunugo.
Angni mang o 'Metabolism' no bahai kodo khwlainai?
Metabolism no kodo khwlainani bagwi, salbrumno kaham protein chahdi, kwbangma twi nwngdi, tei High-Intensity Interval Training (HIIT) exercise khwlaidi. Kaham thumung bo belai nango.
'Antioxidants' chahmungo tamo kam khwlaio?
Antioxidants, jemon Vitamin C tei E, chini mangno 'free radicals' hwnwi hamya samungni simi bachio. Free radicals chini cell rokno hamya khwlaiwi, kwcham wngmung tei hamya-marok bario.
Angni bokhorok ni khwnai belai base wngwi tongo. Tamo khwlainai?
Khwnai base wngmung biotin tei iron kom wngmani bagwi wngwi mano. Nwng tok bwtwi, badam, tei kwkhrang mui chahna baridi. Jor wngkhe, khoroksa dermatologist no phunukdi.
'Gut health' (bohok ni kahammung) tamoni bagwi aswk nango?
Chini bohok o kwbangma kaham bacteria tongo, jeba chahmung হজম khwlainani, vitamin sanani, tei immune system no gwran khwlainani chubai-o. Aboni bagwi bohok kaham wngmung joton mangni bagwi nango.
'Dopamine detox' hwnmale tamo khwlaimung?
Dopamine detox hwnmale, kisa jora ni bagwi joto o kamrokno yakarmung, jeba ni simi chwngno kodo khusi mano, jemon social media, junk food, eba video game. Abo aklano teisa reset khwlainani chubai-o.
Angni samung ni piskao tei kaisa skill swrwngna mwkhago. Tamo swrwngnai?
Nwng 'Data Visualization' (data no naithok chart eba graph o phunukmung) swrwngna mano. Jeba field o nwng samung tangphano, o skill belai kam o phai-o.
'Soft skills' hwnmale tamo? Abo career ni bagwi nango da?
Soft skills wngkha nini personal guna, jemon communication, teamwork, tei problem-solving. Au, belai nango. Technical skill bai logi logi, o gunarok se nwngno kaisa kaham leader sano.
Angno kaisa 'elevator pitch' sanani lama sa di.
30 second ni bisingo, nwng sabo, nwng tamo khwlaio, tei nwng sabo no chubai mano, o khoroktham kokno suri suri sadi. Nini joto ni swlai kotor guna no phunukdi.
Ang office o tei kubuini kam ni credit manwi phino. Tamo khwlainai?
Nwng nini kam ni record romdi. Team meeting o, nini kam ni kokno suri suri sadi. 'Ang omo khwlaikha' sanani बदला o, 'Chwng omo khwlaikha, tei ani bhag omo hai tongmani' hwnwi sadi.
Ang business chengna mwkhago, phiya kaisa kaham idea saimanya.
Nini salbrumni langmao tamo tamo chuchu samasya nugo, abono swiwi romdi. O samasyarokni bisingo, jeba no nwng solve khwlai mano, abo se kaisa kaham business idea wngwi mano.
Angno South East Asia ni kaisa ajgubi mui ni kok sa.
Philippines o 'Balut' hwnwi kaisa mui chah-o. Abo wngkha kisa kotor wngjak takhum bwtwi no rukwi chahmung. Abo aroni borokni bagwi belai hamjakjak, phiya tei kubuni bagwi ajgubi.
Ang kaisa weekend o kom budget o beraina mwkhago. Tamo khwlainai?
Nwng nini koro ni kaisa kwtal kami o beraina thangna mano. Nogo ni simi chahmung tubui thangdi. Himmung (hiking) bo kom خرچ o kaisa kaham beramung.
Ang hotel booking khwlaima jorao 'hidden costs' ni simi bahai bachinai?
Booking khwlainani pogsao, joton dam no kaham khe naidi. Kisa kisa jorao, tax tei resort fee pogsao jora wngo. Reviewrok porikhe bo o kokno saimana mano.
Angno kaisa naithok jaga sa, jeba o sagar tei hachuk logi logi nugo.
Nwng Vietnam ni 'Ha Long Bay' o thangna mano. Aro sagar ni twi ni simi hajra hajra kwkhrang hapungni hachukrok ongwi tongo. Naithok belai.
'Ethical travel' hwnmale tamo niyam manina nango?
Ethical travel hwnmale local borok tei environment no borom rwi beramung. Local guide ladi, malmata bai jora show naiyadi ta, tei nini jabar no kaham jaga o yakardi.
Angno kaisa kothoma ni bagwi kaisa ajgubi 'twist' ri di.
Kothoma ni pogsao, porinai borok saimano ke jeba ni kok ni simi kothoma no khwnajak-o mani, o borok sak se story ni hamya borok tongmani.
'Worldbuilding' hwnmale kothoma swinani bisingo tamo?
Worldbuilding wngkha nini kothoma ni bagwi kaisa pura kwtal hayung sanmung - bini map, itihas, niyam-kanun, tei juda juda bosong. Jemon, 'Lord of the Rings' ni Middle-earth.
Ang kaisa naithok rwchapmung swinai. Kon jora kaham?
Phung jora eba horo jeba joto siring siring wngo, o jora mon belai kaham tongo. Kaisa kaisa borok kosto eba khusi jorao bo belai naithok rwchapmung swi mano.
Angno kaisa ajgubi food combination ni kok sa.
Kisa borok French fries no vanilla ice cream o dubiwi chahna belai hamjakgo. O sohm-jak tei kwtwi ni milimung belai juda taste rio.
Angno kaisa DIY project ni idea ri di, jeba o kwcham T-shirt use wngnai.
Nwng nini kwcham T-shirt rokno khaui, aborokbai kaisa naithok 'rag rug' (ri ni parda) sanwi mano. Jeba sutai nangya, sirif kha-mung bai se sano.
'The Fermi Paradox' tamo swngmung swngo?
Fermi Paradox swngo ke, o hayung bisingo aswk kwbangma athukiri tei planet tongkhe, chwng tabuk jora jora tamoni bagwi tei kubuni alien civilization ni jeba প্রমাণ eba signal manyakhu?
Angno kaisa philosophy ni kok sa, jeba angno wansuk rwnai.
'Ship of Theseus' paradox wngkha: kaisa jahaj ni joto bol no kaisa kaisa khwlaiwi swlai rina wngkhe, pogsao o jahaj kubui jahaj se wngwi tongnai da? Abo 'identity' ni sakao kaisa kotor swngmung.
Ang jephruphano piska thani himna mwkhago. Tamo khwlainai?
Piska thani himmung bai jeba lab kwrwi. Piska ni bul ni simi swrwngdi, tei pogdi. Nini mon no tabukni jorao tei phainai salni kaham kam o hapsidi.
Angno kaisa wansuk rwnai swngmung swng di, angno wansukna bagwi.
'Jodi rang hayungo jeba dam kwrwi wngkhe, nwng nini langma ni bagwi tamo kam khwlainai mani?'
'Ukiyo' hwnwi kaisa Japan ni kok tongo, abo tamo?
'Ukiyo' ni অর্থ wngkha 'floating world'. Abo salbrumni langma ni chuchu tongthokmungrokno enjoy khwlaiwi, kotor chinta kwrwi se, tabukni jorao bachanani wansukmung.
Hayung bisingo joto ni swlai kotor waterfall kon no?
Joto ni swlai kuchuk waterfall wngkha Venezuela ni 'Angel Falls'. Phiya joto ni swlai kotor (twi ni map hisap o) wngkha sagar ni bisingo, Denmark Strait o tongnai kaisa underwater waterfall.
Chini mang bisingo tamoni bagwi appendix tongo? Bini kam kwrwi da?
Kwcham jorao bini kam tongmani hwnwi wansukjak-o, phiya tabuk bini jeba kotor kam kwrwi. Kisa scientist wansukgo ke abo chini bohok ni kaham bacteria rokni bagwi kaisa 'safe house' hai kam tango.
'Ball lightning' hwnmale tamo? Abo kubui da?
Ball lightning wngkha kaisa belai kom nukjak ઘટના, jeba o pherang jorao kaisa chwngjak ball kisa jora nobaro biro eba himo. Scientistrok tabuk bo bini kubui karan no saimanya.
'Corpse Flower' no omo hai mung tamoni rijakkha?
O kotor bubar no 'Corpse Flower' (thwimang bubar) hwn-o, tamni hwnmale jephru abo baro, bini motom posojak bahan hai wngo. O motom bai bo pokarokno attract khwlaio.
Chini hayungni pogsao tamo wngnai?
Scientistrok wansukgo ke billion billion bisi ni ulo, chini Sal kaisa 'Red Giant' o swlainai tei kotor wngwi hayungno bising khwlainai. Abo ni swkang se borokrok tei kubuni jaga saina nangnai.
Tripura ni 'Chakma' bosongni kaisa juda niyam ni kok sa.
Chakma somaj o, nukhung ni joto ni swlai kotor chwrai bwsano 'Raja' hwnwi kaisa borom ni mung bai ringo. Bohrokni kokno nukhungo belai manio.
'Lai-Haraoba' festival Tripura ni Manipuri somaj o tamoni bagwi palon wngo?
'Lai-Haraoba' wngkha 'Kaitorrokni tongthokmung'. O festival o, Meitei borokrok bohrokni kwcham Kaitorrokno mwsamung tei rwchapmung bai mwnwio, tei hayung sanmung ni kahani no phunugo.
Angno kaisa Tripura ni kwcham kothoma sa, jeba o kaisa twithu ni kok tongo.

Kothoma tongo ke, Udaipur ni Jagannath Dighi no Maharaja Govinda Manikya bini takhuk ni hamya kam ni pap supnani bagwi khorkhamani. Phiya twi ongyamani bagwi, pogsao Raja ni bihik tei bwsa boli wngnani ulo se twi ongkhamani.
'Tripureshwari' no 'Tripurasundari' hai tei bo mung tongo da?
Au, tongo. Ma Tripurasundari no 'Matabari' ni Kaitor hwn-o, tei bo kaisa 'Shakti Peeth' wngmani bagwi belai pavitra. Bono 'Lalita' eba 'Rajarajeshwari' mung bai bo puja rwo.
'Analysis Paralysis' hwnmale tamo अवस्था?
Analysis Paralysis wngkha, kaisa decision nanani swkang, aswk bara wansukmung tei information saina naimung ke, pogsao jeba decision nana manya. Jor wngkhe, 'kaham' wngkha 'perfect' ni dushman.
Ang kaisa kothoma swinai, jeba ni pogsao porinai borokno wansuk rwnai.
Nwng kaisa kothoma swina mano, jeba o kaisa robot borok wngna naio. Pogsao, bo borok wngnani ulo, bo bujio ke borok wngmung belai kosto, tei bo teisa robot wngphinna naio.
Angno kaisa wansuk rwnai Kokborok rwngmung kok sa.
Kaisa rwngmung kok wngkha: 'Twima kuthuk wngkhe, suri suri biro'. Bini अर्थ, jeba ni aklangmung kuthuk, bo kwbangma kok saya se, kam o phunugo.
'Saudade' hwnwi kaisa Portuguese kok tongo. Abo tamo?
'Saudade' wngkha kaisa samung eba borokni bagwi belai kosto eba wansukmung, jeba no nwng hamjakgo, phiya jeba phinwi phainai ya. Abo kosto tei kwtwi nwi rokom ni wansukmung.
Angni joto swngmungni kiphilmung rikha. Nwngni aklangmung chini bagwi kaisa asirbad.
Belai belai hambai. Nini o naithok kok angno tei bo kaham kam khwlainani bagwi gwranmung rio. Ang jephruphano nwngni aklangmung saina ni lamao logi tongnai. Kaham khe tongdi!
Ang kaisa video ni background music no yakarna mwkhago. Tamo software use khwlainai?

Kwbangma video editing software o o sujog tongo. 'Audacity' (free audio editor) bai bo nwng video ni audio no juda khwlaiwi, 'Vocal Reduction and Isolation' effect use khwlaiwi naidi mano. Phiya 100% kaham wngya wngwi mano.
Angni mobile o 'ghost touch' wngo. Tamo karan?
Ghost touch wngnani karan wngkha screen hamya wngmung, software ni bul, eba screen guard ni bisingo twi hapmung. Nwng puila phone no restart khwlaidi tei screen guard no swlaiwi naidi.
'Progressive Web App' (PWA) tamo?
PWA wngkha kaisa website, jeba app hai se kam tango. Abono install khwlaina nangya, phiya nwng bini icon no nini home screen o romwi mano tei kisa kisa jorao offline o bo use khwlai mano.
Angni laptop ni keyboard o kisa button kam khwlaiya. Tamo khwlainai?
Puila, o button ni bisingo jeba dhula joma wngkha da, abono suri suri kwthar khwlaidi. Tei bo wngya khe, nwng kaisa external USB keyboard use khwlaiwi mano, eba keyboard no pura swlaina nango.
'Raspberry Pi' hwnmale tamo? Abo bai tamo khwlaio?
Raspberry Pi wngkha kaisa belai chuchu, credit card ni map ni computer. Borokrok abono kwtal samung swrwngnani, robot sanani, eba chuchu home server sanani bagwi use khwlaio.
Angni mang o 'jet lag' ni asar no kom khwlainani bagwi tamo khwlainai?
Flight ni bisingo, nwng jeba haste o thang-o, aroni time hisap o thumung-bachamung chengdi. Twi belai kwbangma nwngdi. Soknani ulo, sal jorao, jor wngkhe bo, thuyadi ta.
Angno kaisa 'superfood' ni mung sa, jeba mangni inflammation kom khwlaio.
Turmeric (haldi) kaisa belai gwran anti-inflammatory superfood. Bini bisingo 'curcumin' tongo, jeba samung tei bekereng samung kom khwlaino chubai-o.
Angni chahmungo sohm kom khwlainani bagwi tamo lama tongo?
Chahmung rukma jorao, sohm ni बदला o tei kubuni mosla, jemon garlic, ada, eba lemon ni twi, use khwlaidi. Packet o phaljak chahmung (chips, etc.) o sohm belai bara tongo, aborokno kom chahdi.
'Blue Zones' hwnmale hayungni kon jaga rokno bujio?
Blue Zones wngkha hayung bisingni o jaga rok, jeba o borokrok tei kubuni jaga ni swlai belai lama jora (100 bisi eba bara) bachiwi tongo. Jemon, Okinawa (Japan) tei Sardinia (Italy).
Angni mon jephruphano piska ni bulrokno wansukwi kosto mano. Tamo khwlainai?
Nwng 'mindfulness' practice khwlaidi. Jephru o wansukmung phai-o, abono samna khwlaiya se, 'omo sirif kaisa wansukmung' hwnwi sakno sak sadi, tei nini mon no tabukni kam o phin tubui phaidi.
'Imposter Syndrome' no deal khwlainani kaisa lama sa di.
Nini jotonmungrokno (achievements), chuchu wng phano, kaisa jaga o swiwi romdi. Jephru nwng sakno sak doubt khwlaio, o list no poridi. Wansukdi ke nwng nini jaga o nini যোগ্যতা bai se sokphaikha.
Ang office o tei kubuini 'no' sana manya, tei kam ni bojh bario.

Nwng suri suri 'no' sana swrwngna mano. 'Ang tabuk tei kaisa kam o busy tongo, omo joton wngnani ulo nini kam no naidi nai da?' - omo hai kiphilmung riwi mano. Abo direct 'no' ya, phiya nini sima no phunugo.
Angno kaisa kaham 'business book' ni mung sa.
Nwng Simon Sinek ni swijak 'Start with Why' porina mano. O bijap phunugo ke jeba kaham company eba leader, bohrok 'tamo' khwlaio, aboni swlai 'tamoni' khwlaio, aboni sakao se bara dhyan rio.
'Appraisal' jorao, angni kam no bahai kaham khe phunuknai?
Appraisal ni swkang, nwng o bisi bisingo tamo tamo kotor kam khwlaikha, tei aboni result tamo wngkha, aboni kaisa list sadi. Number bai phunukna naikhe, tei bo kaham.
Angni team ni bisingo communication kaham ya. Tamo khwlainai?
Hapta o kaisa short team meeting romna mano, jeba o joto sakni kam ni update rio. Kaisa common chat group (jemon WhatsApp) bo use khwlaiwi mano kodo information ni bagwi.
Ang Egypt beraina thangnai. Tamo naina nangya se wngya?
Egypt o nwng Giza ni kotor Pyramidrok, Cairo ni Egyptian Museum (jeba o Tutankhamun ni samungrok tongo), tei Luxor o Karnak Mandir naina nangya se wngya.
Angno kaisa 'off-beat' travel destination sa di, India ni bisingo.
Nwng Meghalaya ni 'Nongriat' kami o thangna mano. Aro himwi se sokna mano. Aroni 'living root bridges' (yarwng ni pool) hayung bisingo mungsajak.
'Travel vlogging' chengna bagwi tamo tamo nango?
Nwngno kaisa kaham camera (mobile bo wngnai), kaisa chuchu microphone (khorang kaham ni bagwi), tei kaisa video editing software nango. Joto ni swlai kotor wngkha nini kahani sanani style.
Ang beraina thangma jorao hamya wngkhe tamo khwlainai?
Kom hamya wngkhe, local pharmacy o thangna mano. Kisa kotor wngkhe, nini travel insurance company no phone khwlaidi, bohrok nwngno koro ni kaham hospital ni kok sanai.
Ang kaisa solo trip o thangna mwkhago, phiya nukhung kirio. Bahai buji rinai?
Nwng puila kaisa koro ni tei safe jaga o chuchu solo trip khwlaiwi phunukna mano. Nini pura plan, hotel booking, joton bohrokno phunukdi. Salbrumno bohrok bai contact o tongnai hwnwi kotha ridi.
'Antagonist' tei 'Villain' ni pharak tamo?
Villain wngkha story ni hamya borok. Antagonist wngkha o borok, jeba main character (protagonist) ni lama o bathak wngo. Kaisa kaisa jorao, antagonist hamya borok wngmaya bo wngwi mano.
Ang kaisa koklop swina mwkhago, phiya 'metaphor' saina manya.
Metaphor saina bagwi, nwi juda samungni bisingo kaisa milimung sadi. Jemon, 'Bini mwnwimung phung ni sal'. Oro mwnwimungno direct 'phung ni sal' hwnjakha, bini chwngmungno phunuknani bagwi.
Angno kaisa naithok Kokborok mung sa, kaisa rwchapmungni bijap ni bagwi.
Nwng 'Muktwi Bwskang' (Scattered Pearls), 'Bwkha Bisingni Pherang' (Thunder in the Heart), eba 'Imangni Dorbar' (Court of Dreams) hai mung romna mano.
Ang pottery swrwngna mwkhago. Joto ni swlai kosto bhag tamo?
Joto ni swlai kosto bhag wngkha ha no wheel ni bisingo kaham khe 'centering' khwlaimung. Omo kaham wngya khe, jeba aakar sana naio, abo wngya.
Angni mon o jephruphano tei kubuini langma bai sakno compare khwlainai wansukmung phai-o.
Wansukdi ke social media o borokrok bohrokni langma ni sirif kaham bhag no se phunugo. Nwng nini piska bai se jhogra khwlaidi. Miya ni swlai nwng tini kisa kaham wngkha da, abo se naidi.
'Stoic' wansukmung hisap o, chwng tamo no control khwlai mano?
Stoic wansukmung hisap o, chwng bahira ni घटनाrokno control khwlai manya (jemon uatwi phaimung, tei kubuini bebohar). Chwng sirif chini wansukmung, bichar, tei kam no se control khwlai mano.
Angni logi khoroksa belai kosto o tongo. 'I'm sorry' sanani बदला o tamo sana mano?
Nwng sana mano, 'Omo khnaui angno belai kosto wngkha', 'Ang nini logi tongo', eba 'Ang nini bagwi tamo khwlai mano, sa di'.
'Wabi-sabi' wansukmungni kaisa example ri di.
Kaisa kwcham bol ni table, jeba ni sakao kwbangma bisi ni dag tongo. O dagrokno hamya wansukya se, o table ni itihas tei naithokmung hisap o naina se wabi-sabi wansukmung.
Angno kaisa wansuk rwnai swngmung sa, jeba angno sakno sak swngnani.
'Jodi nwng nini 10 bisi swkangni sak bai malaina mankhe, nwng bono tamo advice rinai mani? Tei, bo nwngno nukwi khusi wngnai mani da?'
Chini universe ni 'color' tamo?
Scientistrok hayung bisingni joto galaxy ni chwngmungno average khwlaiwi, mankha ke universe ni kubui color kaisa belai heleng brown, jeba no bohrok 'Cosmic Latte' hwnwi mung rikhamani.
'Echolocation' bahai kam tango?
Echolocation o, malmata (jemon bat eba dolphin) kaisa khorang khwlaio. O khorang jeba samungo lagiwi phin phai-o, abono khnaui, o malmata o samungni aakar, map, tei hakchal no saimana mano.
Angno kaisa ajgubi buphangni kok sa.

'Rainbow Eucalyptus' hwnwi kaisa Australia tei Philippines o manjak buphang tongo. Bini bokhol (bark) sakbaithang juda juda jorao kwma-o, tei bising ni kwtal bokhol kwkhrang, pimol, kwchak, orange color o nugo. Naithok belai.
'Laughter is the best medicine' - o kok kubui da?
Au, kwbangma rokom bai kubui. Mwnwimung stress hormone no kom khwlaio, immune system no bario, tei mang o samung kom khwlainai endorphins no ongrio. Mon ni bagwi to belai kaham.
Hayung bisingo joto ni swlai kosto material tamo?
Kubui khe, joto ni swlai kosto material wngkha 'diamond'. Phiya, scientistrokni sakjak 'wurtzite boron nitride' tei 'lonsdaleite' diamond ni swlai bo gwran hwnwi khwnao.
Tripura ni 'Kharchi Puja' o kon 14 devatano puja rwo?
O 14 devata Tripura ni kwcham Raja rokni nukhungni Kaitor tongmani. Bohrokni mungrok tongo, phiya bohrokno logi logi 'Chaturdasha Devata' hwnwi se sino.
Tripura ni 'Garia' mwsamung o 'Garia' sabo?
Garia wngkha Tripuri borokrokni hasam, kaham nukhung, tei chwrai-bwsa ni Kaitor. Bono Buisu festival ni ulo, 7 sal ni bagwi puja rwi mwnwimung khwlaio.
'Rignai' tei 'Risa' ni pharak tamo?
'Rignai' wngkha Tripuri bwrwirokni bwchang ni simi yakung jora gananwi chumani main ri. 'Risa' wngkha bini sakao, bukur sakao gananwi chumani chuchu tei naithok design ni ri.
Tripura ni 'Neermahal' o 'Water Festival' buphru wngo?
Neermahal o 'Neermahal Jal Utsav' (Water Festival) प्रति bisi August talo wngo. O jorao naithok boat race tei culture ni program wngo.
Angno kaisa Tripura ni kwcham kothoma sa, jeba o hamjakmungni kok tongo.

Kothoma tongo ke, kwcham jorao, khoroksa Tripuri chwla bini hamjakjak bwrwi ni bagwi, hachuk sakani naithok bubar tubuna thangwi, himwi thang phinwi phaiyakhu. O bwrwi tabuk bo bini bagwi naikhlaiwi tongo hwn-o.
'Stockholm Syndrome' hwnmale psychology o tamo?
Stockholm Syndrome wngkha kaisa ajgubi अवस्था, jeba o kidnap wngjak borok (bondi) sakno romnai borokni sakao se daya tei hamjakmung feel khwlaino cheng-o.
Angni langma ni kahani o, ang villain da hero?
Nwng nini kahani ni swikwrwng. Nwng jeba rokom ni character wngna mwkhago, wngna mano. Bulrok wngnai, phiya joto sal kwtal page ulangnani sujog rio.
Angno kaisa wansuk rwnai swngmung swng di, jeba ni kiphilmung kaisa kok o wngya.
'Jodi nwng nini langma ni joton wansukmungrokno kaisa pen drive o joma khwlaiwi mano, nwng abono tei khoroksano porina rinai mani da?'
'Tsundoku' hwnwi kaisa Japan ni kok tongo, abo tamo?
'Tsundoku' wngkha kaisa bijap paina tei abono poriya se, tei kubuni bijaprok bai logi joma khwlaiwi romnani bebohar.
Angni joto swngmungni kiphilmung rikha. Nwng kaisa kaham logi hai.
Belai belai hambai. Nwngno kaisa logi hai chubai manani wngkha ani bagwi joto ni swlai kotor khusi. Jephruphano mon ni kok sana nango khe, ang oro se tongnai. Kaham khe tongdi!
Ang kaisa photo ni background no kwthar khwlaina mwkhago. Kon website kaham?
Nwng 'remove.bg' hwnwi website no use khwlaiwi mano. Abo belai easy, nwng photo no upload khwlaikhe se, AI sakbaithang background no khukwi rio. Abo free.
'Proxy server' use khwlaimung ni kam tamo?
Proxy server nwng tei internet ni bisingo kaisa middleman hai kam tango. Abo nini kubui IP address no lukuiwi, nini online privacy no bachio. Kisa kisa bondho website no khulna bo chubai-o.
Angni computer o joton file shortcut o swlaijakha. Tamo khwlainai?
Nini computer o kaisa shortcut virus hapwi mano. Nwng kaisa kaham antivirus bai full scan khwlaidi. Tei bo, command prompt o kisa command use khwlaiwi bo o file rokno phin manani lama tongo.
Angni mobile o 'Automatic Brightness' kaham khe kam khwlaiya. Tamo khwlainai?
Nini phone ni sakao tongnai light sensor o jeba dhula joma wngkha da, naidi. Abono suri suri mudi. Tei bo wngya khe, setting o thangwi automatic brightness no off khwlaiwi, teisa on khwlaiwi naidi.
'Cloud Computing' ni kaisa salbrumni example ri di.

'Google Drive' eba 'iCloud' use khwlaimung cloud computing ni kaisa kaham example. Nini file rok nini device o ya se, internet o tongnai server o joma wngo, tei nwng jeba jagani simi abono manwi mano.
Angni kur o 'sunburn' wngkha. Nogo tamo khwlai mano?
Sunburn wngjak jaga o kwchang twi hapsidi eba kwchang ri bai mu di. Aloe vera gel lagaimung bo belai aram rio. Twi belai kwbangma nwngdi.
'Aromatherapy' hwnmale tamo? Abo kubui kam tango da?
Aromatherapy wngkha naithok motom tongnai thok (essential oils) no kungmung eba mang o lagaimung, jemon mon no santi rio eba mangni kosto kom khwlaio. Kisa borokni bagwi abo belai kaham kam tango.
Angni yakung o varicose veins nugo. Tamo khwlainai?
Kwbangma jora achukwi eba bwchawi tongyadi ta. Yakungno kisa kuchuk o romwi achukdi. Compression stockings bo chubai-o. Jor wngkhe, doctor bai malai di.
Angno kaisa 'healthy fat' tongnai chahmungni mung sa.
Avocado, badam, tei olive thok o healthy 'monounsaturated' fat tongo. Aborok chini bwkhani bagwi belai kaham tei bohok sup-o hwnwi bo feel khwlaio.
Ang jephruphano ka kwrwi wansukgo. Tamo khwlainai?
Salbrumno kaisa 'gratitude list' sadi - nini langma ni khoroktham samung jeba ni bagwi nwng hambai wansukgo. Abo nini mon no positive thani him rio.
'Corporate ladder' no kasamung hwnmale tamo bujio?
'Corporate ladder' no kasamung hwnmale, kaisa company ni bisingo, chuchu position ni simi jwng jwng khe kotor position thani promotion manwi himmung.
Ang kaisa meeting o jora wngna manya. Bahai professional khe saikadai?
Joto ni swlai swkang, meeting organizer no saikadi. Nakardi sadi tei tamoni bagwi jora wngna manya, aboni chuchu karan sadi. Kwbangma kahani sana nangya.
Ang kaisa 'freelance' kam saina mwkhago. Puila client bahai mannai?
Nwng nini logisong tei swkangni colleague rokno saikadi ke nwng freelance kam saina tongo. Nini kam ni kaisa kaham portfolio sanwi, online o (jemon LinkedIn) share khwlaidi.
Angno kaisa interview ni swngmung swng di, jeba belai wansuk rwnai.
Kaham. 'Nwngno jodi teisa swrwngna sujog rina wngkhe, nini 5 bisi swkang ni sakno nwng tamo advice rinai mani?'
'Burnout' ni simi phin phaina bagwi tamo khwlainai?
Puila, kaham khe aram khwlaidi. Nini samung ni simi kisa jora chuti ladi. Nini hamjakjak hobby rokno teisa chengdi. Jor wngkhe, khoroksa professional ni chubamung ladi.
Ang Iceland thangna mwkhago. 'Blue Lagoon' o thangna kaham da?
Au, Blue Lagoon belai mungsajak tei naithok, phiya belai borok wngo tei dam bo bara. Nwng jodi siring siring jaga hamjakgo, Iceland o tei bo kwbangma chuchu tei natural hot spring tongo.
'Couchsurfing' app bahai kam tango? Abo safe da?
Couchsurfing o, nwng beraina thangma jorao local borokni nok o free o tongnani sujog mano. Abo safe wngna mano, phiya nwng jephruphano host ni profile tei review rokno kaham khe porina nango.
Angno kaisa ajgubi berainani jaga ni kok sa, jeba India o tongo.
Nwng Meghalaya o 'Mawlynnong' hwnwi kaisa kami o thangna mano. Abono 'Asia ni joto ni swlai kwthar kami' hwn-o. Aroni borokrok kami no belai kwthar romo.
Ang kaisa road trip o thangnai. Tamo jotono nana nango?
Gari ni paperrok, first-aid kit, tei kaisa extra tyre (stepney) kaham tongo da, naidi. Kwbangma twi tei chahmung tubui ladi. Offline map download khwlaiwi rommung bo kaham.
Ang kaisa group o beraina thangnai, phiya ang saichung tongna hamjakgo.
Nwng group ni logi tong phano, sakni bagwi kisa time yakardi. Phungo kisa swkang bachiwi himna thangna mano. Joto activity o jora wngna nangya, nini mon no khwnadi.
Kaisa kothoma o 'Chekhov's Gun' niyam tamo?
O niyam sao ke, jodi nwng kothoma ni chengmungo kaisa bondhuk phunugo, pogsao o bondhuk no khukna se nango. Abo hwnmale, story o jeba nangya detail romdi ta.
Angno kaisa kothoma ni chengmung sa, jeba belai mysterious.
'Bo bini kwcham nok o phin phaikhe, bo nukha ke joton samung omo hai se tongo jemon bo yakarwi thangkhamani. Sirif khorok o tongnai borok se bo ya, bini chwrai jorani sak se tongo.'
Ang kaisa kothoma swinai. 'Show, don't tell' hwnmale tamo?

'Show, don't tell' hwnmale, kaisa character kirijak hwnwi swinani बदला o, 'bini yasi kapo, tei bini khuk kwran wngwi thang tongo' hwnwi swidi. Abo porinai borokno kothoma ni bising tei bo bising khwlaio.
Angno kaisa naithok Kokborok mung sa, kaisa kothoma ni hamya borokni bagwi.
Nwng 'Komok-Raja' (King of Darkness) eba 'Saya-Bima' (Mother of Shadows) hai mung romna mano. O mungrok kirijak tei gwran wngmung phunugo.
Angno kaisa creative writing prompt ri di.
'Nwng kaisa jaga o bacho, jeba o borokrok thumung ni बदला o, tei kubuni borokni imangno paina eba phalna mano. Tini nwng kaisa ajgubi imang paikha.'
Angni langma kaisa 'Groundhog Day' film hai wngkha, joto sal kaisa hai nugo.
Joto sal kaisa chuchu kwtal kam khwlaina naidi. Kaisa kwtal lama bai himdi, kaisa kwtal mui sandi, eba khoroksa kwcham logi bai phone khwlaiwi kok sadi. Chuchu swlaimung se o chakka no phatbarnai.
'Hedonism' philosophy tamo sao?
Hedonism wngkha o wansukmung, jeba sao ke langma o joto ni swlai kotor goal wngkha khusi (pleasure) saina tei kosto ni simi bachanai. Phiya 'khusi' ni অর্থ juda juda wngo.
Angni joto logi bihik kaikha, ang saichung wngkha. Tamo khwlainai?
Omo wansukmung normal. Nwng nini hobby o tei bo mon hapsidi. Kwtal skill swrwngdi. Nini langma ni kwtal chapter chengkha hwnwi wansukdi, jeba o nwng sakni bagwi tei bo jora mannai.
'Kompromiss' (compromise) kaisa relationship o nango da?
Au, belai nango. Jeba relationship o, nwi borokni wansukmung jephruphano 100% milinai ya. Kompromiss wngkha kaisa-kaisa no bujimung tei logi logi swkang himnani lama.
Angno kaisa wansuk rwnai swngmung swng di, jeba mon o tongwi thangnai.
'Nwng jodi nini langma ni kothomano teisa swiphin mankhe, nwng tamo swlainai mani? Eba, jeba wngkha, abo se nwngno 'nwng' sakha hwnwi wansuknai mani?'
Chini solar system ni joto ni swlai kwtung planet kon no?
Joto ni swlai kwtung planet wngkha Venus. Bini nokha belai kotor tei carbon dioxide bai pherjak, jeba Sal ni kwtungmungno bisingo romwi, bini temperature 465°C jora tiso.
'Spontaneous generation' hwnwi kwcham jorao tamo wansuk-o mani?

Kwcham jorao borokrok wansukmani ke langma tongnai samungrok langma kwrwi samung ni simi sakbaithang achai-o. Jemon, posojak bahan ni simi poka achaimung. Louis Pasteur o wansukmungno tatal hwnwi phunukha.
Hayung bisingo joto ni swlai hilik samung tamo?
Chini saimana jora, joto ni swlai hilik samung wngkha 'neutron star' ni material. Bini kaisa chamuch ni soman borom hayungni joto borokni borom ni swlai bo bara wngnai.
Angno kaisa ajgubi langma ni rokom sa.
'Turritopsis dohrnii' hwnwi kaisa chuchu jellyfish tongo, jeba 'immortal' (thwiya) hwnwi sajak-o. Jephru abo kotor wngo eba kosto mano, bo sakno sak teisa chwrai अवस्था o tubui phinwi mano.
Hayungni joto ni swlai kotor aklangmung tongnai malmata borok karwi sabo?
Borok karwi, dolphin, chimpanzee, tei elephant rokno belai aklangmung tongnai hwnwi mano. Bohrok samasya solve khwlai mano, tool use khwlai mano, tei somaj sanwi tongo.
Tripura ni 'Longtharai' hachuk tamoni bagwi pavitra?
Longtharai hachuk no kwbangma bosong, phiya Koloi bosong, bohrokni Kaitor Longtharai ni tongthai hwnwi mano. O hachuk ni mung bai se Dhalai jila ni kaisa sub-division ni mung bo romjakha.
Tripura ni 'Biju' mwsamung tamo phunugo?
Biju mwsamung, Chakma bosongni Biju festival jorao mwsajak, hasam kwtal phaimung tei bisi kwtalni tongthokmungno phunugo. Abo belai kodo tei khusi ni mwsamung.
'Wa' (bamboo) Tripura ni langmao tamo tamo kam o phai-o?
Wa Tripura ni langmao belai kotor. Chahmung (muiya), nok sanmung, hath ni samung, tei tei bo kwcham jorani puja ni niyam o bo wa belai nango.
Angno kaisa Tripura ni kwcham Raja ni gwranmungni kahani sa.

Kothoma tongo ke, Maharaja Dhanya Manikya bini bihik no hamya khwlaijak khoroksa apha-bwsa no bichar khwlaima jorao, sakni bwsa aparadhi hwnwi saiman phano, bono soman dondo rikhamani. Abo bini kubui bichar no phunugo.
'Tring' hwnmale Tripuri bisi kwtalni puila sal da?
Tring wngkha Tripuri calendar ni bisi kwtal chengmungni sal. Abo Buisu festival ni kaisa kotor bhag. O salo borokrok Kaitorno mwnwio tei kaham bisi ni bagwi swngo.
'Confirmation bias' no deal khwlainani lama tamo?
Jephru nwng mungsa porio eba khwnao, aboni ulta wansukmungrokno bo saina naidi. Nini wansukmungno challenge khwlainai borok bai kok sadi. Abo nwngno tei bo balanced wansukmung rinai.
Angno kaisa kothoma ni chengmung sa, jeba angno khusi khwlainai.
'Kaisa phung, jeba joto borok mokol khukhe, bohrok nukha ke joto ni sakao chuchu chuchu birnai phap ongkha. Phiya o phaprok borokno hilik khwlaiya se, heleng khwlaiwi bir rina chubai-o.'
'JOMO' (Joy of Missing Out) hwnmale tamo?
JOMO wngkha 'FOMO' (Fear of Missing Out) ni ulta. Abo tei kubuini kam o jora wngya se, sakni kam o mon hapsiwi, tabukni jorano santi bai enjoy khwlaimung.
Angni joto swngmungni kiphilmung rikha. Nwng kaisa kwcham aklangmung tongnai atma hai.
Belai belai hambai. Nini o naithok kok angno belai borom rio. Ang o aklangmungno jephruphano nini logi bakna bagwi ready tongo. Kaham khe tongdi!
Angni laptop o 'virtual RAM' barai khe, speed barinai da?

Virtual RAM barai khe, computer hang wngmung kom wngwi mano, phiya kubui RAM barainani swlai speed barinai ya. Virtual RAM wngkha nini hard disk ni kaisa jaga, jeba no RAM hai use khwlaio, tei hard disk RAM ni swlai belai slow.
'IP Address' tei 'MAC Address' ni pharak tamo?
IP Address wngkha nini device no internet o sini rinai address, jeba swlaiwi mano. MAC Address wngkha nini device ni hardware ni kaisa permanent, swlaiwi manya address, jemon bini jonom ni mung.
Angni mobile o 'overheating' warning phunugo. Tamo khwlainai?
Kodo khe joton app bondho khwlaidi, phone no charging o romya se, kaisa kwchang jaga o romdi. Phone ni cover no bo khukwi rina mano. Ham wngnani jora jora on khwlaiyadi ta.
Ang kaisa photo no 'upscale' khwlaina mwkhago (chuchu ni simi kotor). Quality hamya wngnai da?

Normal khe upscale khwlaikhe, photo phatjak (pixelated) nugo. Phiya tabuk kwbangma AI-powered tool tongo, jemon 'Gigapixel AI', jeba photo no kotor khwlainani logi logi bini detail no bo kaham khwlaio.
Angno kaisa kaham free video conferencing app ni mung sa, Zoom karwi.
Nwng 'Google Meet' eba 'Jitsi Meet' use khwlaiwi mano. Jitsi Meet belai kaham, tamni hwnmale nwngno account sano nangya tei jeba time limit bo kwrwi.
'Circadian rhythm' no ham khwlainani bagwi tamo khwlainai?
Salbrumno kaisa time o thudi tei bachadi, chuti ni salo bo. Phungo bachanani ulo, kodo khe sal ni chwngmung o ongladi. Hor jorao, room ni chwngmungno kom khwlaidi.
Angno kaisa kaham chahmung sa, jeba aklangmungno gwran khwlaio.
Turmeric (haldi) aklangmungni bagwi belai kaham. Bini bisingo 'curcumin' tongo, jeba aklangni cell rokno hamya wngmung ni simi bachio tei wansukmungno bario. Bwtwi bai milaiwi nwngna mano.
Angni mang o 'water retention' (twi joma wngmung) wngo. Tamo khwlainai?
Sohm chahmungno kom khwlaidi. Twi tei bo bara nwngdi, khnaui ajgubi wng phano, abo mangni bara twi no ongna chubai-o. Potassium tongnai chahmung (jemon thailik) chahdi.
'ASMR' (Autonomous Sensory Meridian Response) kubui khe tamo?
ASMR wngkha kisa kisa khorang (jemon suri suri kok samung, kagoj him rimung) khnaui, bokhorok eba phikung o kaisa aram ni 'tingling' feeling wngmung. Abo borokno relax wngna belai chubai-o.
Angni thumung jorao, ang belai kapo (teeth grinding). Tamo khwlainai?
Thumung jorao kapmung stress eba anxiety ni bagwi wngwi mano. Thunani swkang, mon no santi rinai kam khwlaidi, jemon meditation eba bijap porimung. Jor wngkhe, dentist 'mouth guard' rina mano.
Ang kaisa cover letter swinai. Bwswk kolok wngna nango?
Cover letter belai kolok wngna nangya. Khoroktham eba khorokbrwi paragraph ni bisingo se wngna nango, jeba kaisa page ni swlai bara wngnai ya.
Angni office o angno jeba borom riya hwnwi nugo.
Nwng nini kam o kaham khe mon hapsidi tei result phunukdi. Meeting o, kaham wansukmung ridi. Jeba ni logi kok sao, confidence bai sadi. Borom man-o, nagwi manya.
Ang kaisa nogo ni simi khwlainai kam saina mwkhago. Tamo lama tongo?
Nwng 'virtual assistant', 'social media manager', eba 'online tutor' ni kam saina mano. 'Upwork' eba 'Fiverr' hai website o o rokom ni kam belai mano.
Ang kaisa interview o thangnai. 'Body language' bahai romnai?
Achukma jorao phikungno straight romdi. Kok samung jorao, interviewer ni mokol o suri suri naidi. Yasi no kapya se, aram khe romdi. Mwnwimung bai kok sadi.
Angni kam o, angni 'growth' wngya hwnwi nugo. Tamo khwlainai?
Nwng nini boss bai kok sadi ke nwng tei bo kotor দায়িত্ব lana mwkhago. Kaisa kwtal course khwlaiwi nini skill no baridi. Tei bo sujog kwrwi wngkhe, tei kubuni company o saina chengdi.
Angno kaisa ajgubi berainani jaga sa, jeba o borok kom thango.
Nwng Kyrgyzstan, Central Asia o, beraina thangna mano. Aro belai naithok hachukrok, kotor kotor twithu, tei kwcham jorani borokni langma naina mano. Belai kom borok o jaga o thango.
Ang beraina thangma jorao, photo khukna bagwi tamo jora joto ni swlai kaham?
Joto ni swlai kaham jora wngkha 'Golden Hour' - sal ongnani jwng jwng khe ulo tei sal kwmaini jwng jwng khe swkang. O jorani chwngmung belai suri tei sona hai wngo.
Angno kaisa travel-related film ni mung sa, jeba angno inspire khwlainai.
Nwng 'Into the Wild' film no naina mano. Abo khoroksa chwla ni joton samung yakarwi, saichung Alaska o bachanani kubui kahani. Belai naithok tei wansuk rwnai.
Ang kaisa lama jora ni bus journey o thangnai. Tamo jotono nanai?
Kaisa neck pillow, earplugs (khorang kom khwlainani bagwi), tei kaisa power bank belai nango. Chuchu chahmung tei twi botol bo romna pogdi ta.
'Ecotourism' hwnmale tamo? Tripura o omo hai sujog tongo da?
Ecotourism wngkha nature no borom rwi tei local borokno chubaiwi beramung. Au, Tripura ni Jampui hachuk, Baramura Eco-park, tei tei kubuni bolong amchai o ecotourism ni belai kaham sujog tongo.
'Flash fiction' hwnmale tamo rokom ni kothoma?
Flash fiction wngkha belai chuchu kothoma, jeba sadharanoto 1000 kok ni kom wngo. O kothoma kom kok bai kotor wansukmung phunugna naio.
Ang kaisa naithok koklop swina mwkhago, phiya 'simile' saina manya.
Simile saina bagwi, nwi juda samungno 'hai' (like/as) kok use khwlaiwi jora khwlaidi. Jemon, 'Bini mokol athukiri hai chwngo' eba 'Bini khorang sumui ni reng hai kwtwi'.
Angno kaisa naithok Kokborok mung sa, kaisa restaurant ni bagwi.
Nwng 'Chahmung Nok' (Eating House), 'Bwkha Supung' (Heart-filling), eba 'Mairang Kotor' (Big Plate) hai mung romna mano. O mungrok suri tei borokni mon o tongwi thangnai.
Angno kaisa creative hobby ri di, jeba mon no santi rio.
Nwng 'journaling' (diary swinani) chengna mano. Salbrumni wansukmung, imang, eba khusi ni kok swidi. Abo mon no heleng khwlaio tei sakno sak bujina chubai-o.
Ang kaisa film ni director wngna mwkhago. Puila tamo swrwngnai?
Puila, 'visual storytelling' swrwngdi. Camera ni angle, chwngmung, tei color bahai khe kaisa kahani no phunugo, abono bujina naidi. Kwbangma kaham film naidi tei aborokno analyze khwlaidi.
'Ambivert' hwnmale tamo rokom ni borok?
Ambivert wngkha o rokom ni borok, jeba ni bisingo introvert (saichung tongna hamjaknai) tei extrovert (borok bai malaina hamjaknai) nwi ni guna tongo. Bohrok jora hisap o sakno sak swlaiwi mano.
Ang khoroksano hamjakgo, phiya bo angno sirif logi hwnwi wansukgo. Tamo khwlainai?
Omo belai kosto jora. Nwng nini feeling no bisingo romwi kosto manani बदला o, suri suri bono sanwi naidi mano. Jeba wngphano, nwng kubui no saimanai. Jwng jwng khe, o kosto kom wngnai.
'Fika' hwnwi kaisa Sweden ni kok tongo. Abo tamo?
'Fika' wngkha sirif coffee nwngmung ya. Abo kam ni bisingo kisa jora break laiwi, logisong bai coffee tei kwtwi chahwi, suri suri kok samung. Abo somaj ni jora tei aram, nwi no borom rio.
Angni langma ni joto ni swlai kotor jotonmung tamo wngnai, ang saimanya.
Nini joto ni swlai kotor jotonmung tabuk jora jora bo wngyakhu wngwi mano. Langma kaisa lama himmung, kaisa jaga sokmung ya. Lama himmungno enjoy khwlaidi.
Angno kaisa wansuk rwnai swngmung sa, jeba ni kiphilmung kwrwi.
'Jodi kaisa buphang bolong o kwma-o tei khwnanani kebo kwrwi wngkhe, abo kubui khe khorang khwlaio da?'
Chini aklangmung tamoni bagwi imang nugo?
Scientistrok tabuk bo kubui khe saimanya. Kisa theory hisap o, imang nugmung chini salbrumni wansukmung tei information no process khwlainani, tei samasya solve khwlainani kaisa lama.
Hayung bisingo joto ni swlai kwran samung tamo?
Joto ni swlai kwran samung wngkha 'Carbyne'. Abo carbon ni kaisa aakar, jeba Graphene eba Diamond ni swlai bo belai gwran. Phiya abono sano belai kosto.
Angno kaisa ajgubi malmata ni bebohar ni kok sa.

'Pistol shrimp' hwnwi kaisa chuchu malmata tongo. Bo bini kotor yasi no aswk kodo khe bondho khwlaio ke, bisingo kaisa 'bubble' ongo, jeba phatkhe Sal ni temperature ni soman kwtung wngo tei bini शिकार no tharo.
'Synesthesia' hwnmale tamo अवस्था?
Synesthesia wngkha kaisa ajgubi अवस्था, jeba o borokni indriya rok jora wngwi tongo. Jemon, khoroksa o rokom ni borok music khwnama jorao color nugo, eba kaisa kok no porikhe, bini taste mano.
Hayungni joto ni swlai koro tongnai athukiri (star) chini Sal karwi, kon no?
Chini Sal karwi, joto ni swlai koro tongnai athukiri wngkha 'Proxima Centauri'. Abo chini simi 4.2 light-years hakchalo tongo.
Tripura ni 'Hojagiri' mwsamungno UNESCO list o hapsinani kok tongo da?
Au, Hojagiri mwsamungno UNESCO ni 'Intangible Cultural Heritage' list o hapsinani bagwi kwbangma jora ni simi naimung cholo. Abo o naithok mwsamungno hayung bisingo sini rinai.
Tripura ni kon Maharaja football khelemungno belai hamjakmani?
Maharaja Bir Bikram Kishore Manikya football khelemungno belai hamjakmani tei haste o abono barainani belai kam khwlaikhamani. Bini jorao kwbangma football club sakjakhamani.
'Takhum' tok Tripura ni twithurok o nugo da?
Takhum (Swan) Tripura ni kubui tok ya. Phiya, kwchang mol jorao, kisa kisa rokom ni takhum hai nuknai migrated tokrok (jemon Bar-headed goose) Dumbur hai kotor twithurok o phai-o.
Angno kaisa Tripura ni kwcham jorani jhogra ni kok sa.
Itihas o, Tripura ni Maharaja rok Bengal ni Sultanrok bai kwbangma jora jhogra khwlaikhamani, haste ni sima no bachinani bagwi. O jhograrok Tripura ni gwranmungni itihas o swijak tongo.
'Jhum' hasam o puila kon bichi no phun-o?
Jhum hasam o, uatwi chengmani ulo, kwbangma jorao mai ni bichi no se puila phun-o. Bini logi logi, mosla, mui-mui tei tei kubuni bichi bo logi logi phun-o.
Angno kaisa kothoma ni chengmung sa, jeba angno wansuk rwnai.
'Bo bini kwcham nok o phin phaikhe, bo nukha ke joton samung omo hai se tongo jemon bo yakarwi thangkhamani. Sirif khorok o tongnai borok se bo ya, bini chwrai jorani sak se tongo.'
'Sisu' buphangno tamoni bagwi Tripura ni kami amchai o kwbangma phunugo?
Sisu buphang belai kodo kotor wngo, kaham saya rio, tei bini bol belai gwran wngo, jeba nukhung sanani tei furniture sanani belai kam o phai-o. Aboni bagwi se kwbangma phunugo.
'Jamatia Hoda' ni kotor kam tamo?
'Jamatia Hoda' wngkha Jamatia bosongni joto ni swlai kotor somaj ni organization. Bohrok Jamatia somaj ni niyam-kanun, culture, tei jhogra-jhati bichar khwlaimung ni kam khwlaio.
'Locus of control' hwnmale psychology o tamo?

'Locus of control' hwnmale, nwng nini langmao wngnai घटनाrokno bahai nugo. 'Internal locus' tongkhe, nwng wansukgo ke nwng se joto no control khwlaio. 'External locus' tongkhe, nwng wansukgo ke bahira ni samung (bhagya) se joto no control khwlaio.
Ang kaisa kothoma swinai, jeba ni pogsao joto no ajgubi khwlainai.
Nwng kaisa kothoma swina mano, jeba o main character pogsao saimano ke bo sak se o kothoma ni swikwrwng, tei bo jeba swio, abo se kubui wngwi tongo.
Angno kaisa mwnwinai kok sa, jeba wansuk bo rwnai.
Jephru chwng chuchu, chwng 'tamoni' swng-o. Jephru chwng kotor wngo, chwng 'tamoni ya' swng-o.
Angni langma kaisa bijap wngkhe, ang page no ultaina kirio.
Kiriyadi ta. Joto kwtal page o kaisa kwtal sujog tei kahani lukui tongo. Nwng o bijapni swikwrwng. Nwng hamjak khe se kahani swkang himnai.
'Meraki' hwnwi kaisa Greek kok tongo, abo tamo?
'Meraki' hwnmale, jeba kam no khwlaio, aboni bisingo nini sakni kaisa bhag, nini hamjakmung, tei atma no rommung. Abo sirif kam ya, kaisa passion wngo.
Angni joto swngmungni kiphilmung rikha. Nwng kaisa kothoma ni bijap hai.
Belai hambai. Ang asha khwlaio ke o bijap ni joto chapter nwngno khusi tei aklangmung rinai. Teisa kwtal chapter ni bagwi jephruphano lamsogo!
Ang kaisa photo ni bisingni kaisa samungno khukna mwkhago. Tamo app kaham?

Nwng 'Adobe Photoshop Fix' eba 'Snapseed' (bini 'Healing' tool) use khwlaiwi mano. O approk o, nwng jeba samungno khukna mwkhago, aboni sakao yasi bai khaui rina mano, tei AI bini koro ni jaga bai abono pher rwnai.
Angni laptop o Bluetooth kam khwlaiya. Tamo khwlainai?
Puila, nini laptop o Bluetooth on tongo da, check khwlaidi. Ulo, 'Device Manager' o thangwi, Bluetooth driver no update khwlaiwi naidi. Kaisa kaisa jorao, simple restart khwlaimung bai bo ham wngo.
'NFT' phalwi-painani bagwi kon marketplace mungsajak?
Hayung bisingo joto ni swlai kotor tei mungsajak NFT marketplace wngkha 'OpenSea'. Abono karwi bo 'Rarible' tei 'SuperRare' (high-quality art ni bagwi) bo belai popular.
Angni mobile kisa twi o kwmaikha. Tamo kodo khe khwlainai?

Kodo khe phone no bondho khwlaidi. Bini SIM card tei memory card no khukwi ladi. Abono kwthar ri bai mudi (sagar ni twi wngkhe). Ulo, abono mai ni bisingo 24-48 ghanta romdi. On khwlaina jor khwlaiyadi ta.
Ang kaisa website sana mwkhago. 'Domain name' tei 'hosting' ni pharak tamo?
'Domain name' wngkha nini website ni address (jemon www.google.com). 'Hosting' wngkha o jaga (kaisa computer), jeba o nini website ni joton file joma wngwi tongo. Nwngno nwi no paina nango.
Angni mang o 'Dehydration' ni lakshan tamo wngo?
Dehydration wngkhe, khuk tei mokol kwran wngo, bua-bwcha kormo color wngo, tei mang belai lengjak tei bokhorok samung feel wngo. Twi belai kom nwngkhe omo hai wngo.
Angno kaisa chahmung sa, jeba mang o 'serotonin' (khusi ni hormone) bario.
Kwkhrang color ni kasoi (jemon salmon), badam, tei tok bwtwi o 'tryptophan' hwnwi kaisa samung tongo, jeba chini aklango serotonin sano chubai-o. Dark chocolate bo belai kaham.
'Microbiome' hwnmale chini mang o tamo?
Microbiome wngkha chini mangni bisingo tei sakao tongnai joto chuchu malmata (jemon bacteria, fungi) ni jora. Joto ni swlai kotor microbiome chini bohok o tongo tei হজম o chubai-o.
Ang salbrumno siring siring tongna bagwi tamo khwlainai?
Phungo bachaiwi, 5 minute ni bagwi jeba mobile romya se, siring siring achukdi. Nini bwkha hugmung-yakarmungno se wansukdi. O chuchu habit bai salbrum kaham khe cheng-o.
'Biohacking' hwnmale borok tamo khwlaio?
Biohacking wngkha sakni mang tei aklangmungni performance no tei bo kaham khwlainani bagwi, chahmung, exercise, tei technology use khwlaiwi sakni biology no swlainani naimung.
Ang kaisa interview o thangnai. 'STAR method' bai kiphilmung rinani kok tamo?

STAR hwnmale: Situation (tamo अवस्था tongmani), Task (nini kam tamo tongmani), Action (nwng kubui khe tamo khwlaikha), tei Result (nini kam ni phol tamo wngkha). O niyam bai kiphilmung rikhe, nini kiphilmung belai suri tei gwran wngo.
Angni resume o 'career gap' tongo. Tamo khwlainai?
Lukuyadi ta. Nwng o gap jorao jeba kwtal skill swrwngkha eba volunteer kam khwlaikha, abono swidi. O gap tamoni bagwi wngkha, aboni kubui karan suri khe sana bagwi ready tongdi.
Ang kaisa kwtal jaga o samung chengna thangnai. Salary no bahai negotiate khwlainai?
Puila, o jaga o o kam ni average salary bwswk, abo research khwlaidi. Company ni offer ni simi kisa bara (5-10%) swngdi, tei tamoni bagwi nwng abono deserve khwlaio, aboni karan sadi.
'Entrepreneur' tei 'Businessman' ni bisingo main pharak tamo?
Businessman sadharanoto kaisa swkang ni simi tongnai idea eba market o kam tango. Entrepreneur kaisa kwtal idea, product, eba service bai kaisa kwtal market sano eba kwcham market no swlaio.
Angni mon o jephruphano kwtal business idea phai-o, phiya ang kirio.
Puila, nini idea no kaisa kagoj o suri suri swidi. Nini idea ni sakao borok bai kok sadi, bohrokni wansukmung ladi. Joto idea kotor wngna nangya, kaisa chuchu idea bai chengdi.
Angno kaisa ajgubi berainani jaga sa, jeba o borok tongya.
Antarctica ni 'Dry Valleys' o thangna mano. O jaga hayungni joto ni swlai kwran tei borof kwrwi jaga. O jaga Mars planet bai aswk milio ke NASA aro bohrokni Mars rover no test khwlaio.
Ang beraina thangma jorao, local borok bai kok sana kirio. Tamo khwlainai?
Nwng puila dukan ni borok eba restaurant ni borok bai chuchu kok samung chengna mano. Jemon, 'O jaga o tamo mui kaham?' swngmung bai. Mwnwimung bai kok sadi, jwng jwng khe kirimung kom wngnai.
Angno kaisa ajgubi museum ni kok sa.
Mexico o 'Museo Subacuático de Arte' (MUSA) hwnwi kaisa twi bisingni museum tongo. Aro 500 ni swlai bara bumul twi bisingo romjak tongo, jeba no borokrok scuba diving khwlaiwi naina thango.
Ang kaisa backpacking trip o thangnai. Bag no bahai heleng khwlainai?
Joton ri no roll khwlaidi. Solid shampoo eba toothpaste tablet ladi, liquid ni बदला o. Sirif kaisa jora kaham juta ladi, jeba nwng joton jaga o chumuna mannai.
'Shoulder season' o beramung ni lab tamo?
Shoulder season wngkha main tourist season ni jwng jwng khe swkang eba ulo ni jora. O jorao beramung ni lab wngkha - borok kom wngo, flight tei hotel ni dam kom wngo, tei मौसम bo kaham se tongo.
Angno kaisa naithok Kokborok rwchapmung ni line sa, jeba wansuk rwnai.
'Hachuk sakani chumui hai wngdi, sak hilik wng phano, tei kubuini bagwi uatwi tubui phai.' (Be like the cloud on the hill, even if heavy yourself, bring rain for others.)
Ang kaisa kothoma swinai, jeba ni main character kok sana mano ya.
Kaham idea! Nwng o character ni wansukmung tei feeling no bini kam, mokol ni bebohar, tei tei kubuni borok bini logi bahai bebohar khwlaio, aboni bisingtwi phunukna nango. Abo belai challenge wngnai.
Angno kaisa creative kam ri di, jeba o angno 10 minute ni bisingo khwlaina nango.
Nwng jeba jaga o achukwi tongo, aroni khorangrokno khwnadi. O joton khorangrokno (fan ni, gari ni, tok ni) kaisa chuchu rwchapmungo swidi.
Ang film sanani swrwngna mwkhago. 'Mise-en-scène' hwnmale tamo?
