Mise-en-scène wngkha film ni frame ni bisingo jeba samung nainai borok nugo - jemon character ni ri-chum, jaga ni sajimung, tei chwngmung. Joton samung kahani no phunukna chubai-o.
Angno kaisa naithok mung sa, kaisa photography exhibition ni bagwi.
Nwng 'Mokol Bisingni Hayung' (The World Inside the Eye), 'Saya bai Khele-mung' (Playing with Shadows), eba 'Pogjak Jorani Khorang' (Voice of Lost Time) hai mung romna mano.
'The banality of evil' hwnwi kaisa wansukmung tongo. Abo tamo?
O wansukmung sao ke, kotor kotor hamya kamrok (jemon Holocaust) ajgubi monster ni sakjak ya, phiya normal borokni sakjak se, jeba rok sakni kam ni phol no wansukya se, sirif niyam no follow khwlaio.
Ang kaisa kotor joton mankha, phiya angno khusi wngya. Tamoni?
Wngwi mano ke nini khusi joton manani piskao ya, phiya o joton manani lama himmung o se tongmani. Tabuk o lama joton wngkha, aboni bagwi khali nugo. Kaisa kwtal lama saina jora wngkha.
Angni joto logi kotor kam khwlaiwi tongo. Ang piska wngkha hwnwi wansukgo.
Langma kaisa race ya. Joto ni lama juda. Nwng nini tabukni jaga no nini swkangni jaga bai compare khwlaidi, tei kubui bai ya. Nini chuchu jotonmungrokno bo borom ridi.
Angno kaisa wansuk rwnai swngmung swng di, jeba ni kiphilmung belai kosto.
'Jodi nwngno nini langma no teisa bachanani sujog rina wngkhe, phiya joton wansukmungrok logi logi, nwng jeba swlainai mani da? Eba, joton bul bai teisa omo hai se bachanai mani?'
'L'esprit de l'escalier' hwnwi kaisa French kok tongo. Abo tamo?
Abo hwnmale 'the spirit of the staircase'. O feeling no bujio, jephru nwng kaisa jhogra eba kok samung pognani ulo, staircase o kwmaima jorao, nini mon o kaisa belai kaham ridi.
Ang kaisa kothoma swinai, jeba ni main character ni mon no santi rio.
Kaham idea! Nwng o character ni feeling no bini kam, mokol ni bebohar, tei tei kubuni borok bini logi bahai bebohar khwlaio, aboni bisingtwi phunukna nango. Abo belai challenge wngnai.
Angno kaisa creative kam ri di, jeba o angno 10 minute ni bisingo khwlaina nango.
Nwng jeba jaga o achukwi tongo, aroni khorangrokno khwnadi. O joton khorangrokno (fan ni, gari ni, tok ni) kaisa chuchu rwchapmungo swidi.
Angni laptop o 'Solid State Drive' (SSD) lagainani lab tamo?
SSD lagai khe, nini laptop belai kodo khe on wngnai, app rok kodo khulnai, tei file copy khwlaimung bo belai fast wngnai. Abo nini kwcham laptop no teisa kwtal hai khwlainai.
'CAPTCHA' test tamoni bagwi use wngo?

CAPTCHA ('Completely Automated Public Turing test to tell Computers and Humans Apart') use wngo website rokno 'bots' (automatic program) ni simi bachinani bagwi. Abo test khwlaio ke website no use khwlainai borok kubui borok da, machine da.
Angni computer o joton file .zip file o swlaijakha. Tamo wngkha?

Nini computer o kaisa ransomware virus hapwi mano, jeba nini file rokno encrypt khwlaiwi, abono khulnani bagwi rang swngo. Kodo khe internet ni simi disconnect khwlaidi tei jeba rang riyadi ta. Khoroksa expert no phunukdi.
'Algorithm' hwnmale social media o tamo kam khwlaio?
Social media ni algorithm nini swkangni bebohar (kon post no nwng hamjakgo, share khwlaio) no naiwi, nini bagwi kon post tei bo interesting wngnai, abono phunugo. Aboni bagwi se nini feed sajijak-o.
Angno kaisa kaham free cloud storage ni mung sa, Google Drive karwi.
Nwng 'Mega' use khwlaiwi mano. Abo chengmungo se 20 GB ni free storage rio, jeba tei kubuni ni swlai belai bara. Bini security bo belai kaham.
Angni mang o jephruphano ka kwrwi wansukgo. Tamo kom wngwi mano?
Abo magnesium kom wngmani lakshan wngwi mano. Magnesium chini aklangno santi rinai neurotransmitterrokno chubai-o. Nwng badam, tei kwkhrang mui chahna baridi mano.
'Lucid dreaming' no bahai practice khwlainai?
Kaisa lama wngkha, sal jorao urum urum sakno sak swngmung, 'Ang tabuk imang nugo da?'. O habit wngkhe, nwng imang nugma jorao bo o swngmungno swngnai, tei nwng imang nugo hwnwi saimanai.
Angno kaisa chahmung sa, jeba chini mangni collagen no bario.
Vitamin C tongnai chahmung, jemon lembu, orange, tei capsicum, mang o collagen sanani bagwi belai nango. Collagen chini kur no kaham tei chuchu romo.
'Earthing' or 'Grounding' hwnmale tamo? Abo kaham da?

Earthing hwnmale, juta yakarwi, ha, ghas, eba sagar koro o himmung. Kisa borok wansukgo ke omo hai khwlaimung bai hayungni energy chini mango phai-o tei inflammation kom khwlaio, phiya scientific প্রমাণ tabuk bo kom.
Angni thumung jorao, yakung-yasi belai himo (Restless Legs Syndrome). Tamo khwlainai?
Thunani swkang, kwtung twi bai tukudi eba yakungno massage khwlaidi. Iron kom wngmani bagwi bo omo hai wngo, aboni bagwi doctor bai malaimung kaham. Coffee tei alcohol kom nwngdi.
Ang kaisa job interview o thangnai. 'What are your salary expectations?' swngkhe tamo sanai?

Nwng direct kaisa number sanani बदला o, sana mano, 'O kam ni responsibility tei market rate no naiwi, ang wansukgo ke [kaisa range, jemon 5-6 lakh per year] kaham wngnai'. Research kaham khe khwlaidi.
'Proactive' tei 'Reactive' wngmung ni pharak tamo?
Reactive borok samasya wngnani ulo abono solve khwlaino naio. Proactive borok samasya wngnani swkang se abono wansukwi, abo jemon wngya wngthung, o lama no sano.
Angno kaisa kaham 'LinkedIn' headline ni example ri di.

Sirif nini job title swiyawi, nwng tamo khwlaio, abono swidi. Jemon, 'Software Developer' ni बदला o, 'Software Developer | Building user-friendly mobile apps that solve real-world problems' swina mano.
Angni team ni bisingo khoroksa belai aklangmung tongnai, phiya tei kubui bai milio ya.
Nwng bini logi saichung kok sadi. Bini kam no borom ridi, tei bono sadi ke bini idea team bai share khwlaikhe, team tei bo kaham wngnai. Bono team ni kaisa kotor bhag hwnwi feel khwlai ridi.
'Performance Improvement Plan' (PIP) o romjakhe, abo hwnmale job thangnai da?

Jephruphano ya. PIP wngkha kaisa sujog. Abo phunugo ke nini kam o kisa hamya tongo, tei abono kaham khwlainani bagwi company nwngno kaisa plan tei jora rio. O jorao kaham khe kam khwlaikhe, nini job bachinai.
Ang Peru beraina thangna mwkhago. Machu Picchu karwi tei tamo naina mano?
Nwng Nazca Lines (kotor kotor ajgubi drawing, jeba no sakani simi se nugo), Rainbow Mountain, eba Amazon bolong ni bisingo beraina thangna mano. Peru belai naithok haste.
'Flygskam' hwnwi kaisa Sweden ni kok tongo. Abo tamo?
'Flygskam' ni अर्थ wngkha 'flight shame'. Abo airplane bai beramung environment ni bagwi aswk hamya, aboni bagwi lajimung. O wansukmung bai kwbangma borok tabuk train o beraina hamjakgo.
Angno kaisa ajgubi jaga ni kok sa, jeba o borok tongwi mano.

Ethiopia o 'Danakil Depression' hwnwi kaisa jaga tongo, jeba hayungni joto ni swlai kwtung tei ha bisingni jaga. Aro kwtung twi, acid ni pool, tei ajgubi color ni ha tongo. O kosto jaga o bo Afar borokrok tongwi tongo.
Ang kaisa travel blog chengna mwkhago. Tamo mung romnai?
Nwng nini mung bai jora mung romna mano (jemon 'Rina's Rucksack') eba kaisa creative mung (jemon 'The Wandering Tripuri'). Mung chuchu tei wansukna easy wngkhe kaham.
Ang kaisa kotor hachuk o kasana thangnai. 'Altitude sickness' ni simi bahai bachinai?
Suri suri sakao himdi, kaisa salo belai kuchuk kasayadi ta. Kwbangma twi nwngdi. Garlic (rasun) bo altitude sickness kom khwlaino chubai-o hwn-o. Jor wngkhe, kom jaga o phinwi phaidi.
Ang kaisa story o 'unreliable narrator' use khwlaina mwkhago. Abo tamo?
Unreliable narrator wngkha o kothoma sanai borok, jeba ni kokno porinai borok pura विश्वास khwlai manya. Bo tatal sana mano, jinis pogna mano, eba sak se jinisno bul wansukna mano.
Ang kaisa kothoma swinai, jeba o jeba dialogue kwrwi.
Kaham challenge! Nwng character ni wansukmung, bebohar, tei bini koro ni jaga ni वर्णन bai se pura kahani no sana nango. Abo 'show, don't tell' ni pogsani practice.
Angno kaisa Kokborok koklop ni bagwi kaisa naithok line sa.
'Nini mwnwimung wngkha kaisa pogjak rwchapmung, jeba no ang salbrumno saina naio.'
Angno kaisa ajgubi art ni rokom sa.
'Anamorphic art' hwnwi kaisa rokom tongo. O art no normal khe naikhe bujiwi manya. Abono kaisa juda angle ni simi eba kaisa khorok o bini saya no naikhe se kubui aakar nugo.
Ang kaisa kothoma ni bagwi 'redemption arc' sanai. Abo bahai wngo?
Redemption arc wngkha, jephru kaisa hamya eba bul borok, kothoma ni bisingtwi, bini bul ni simi swrwngwi, suri suri kaisa kaham borok o swlaimung. Jemon, Star Wars o Darth Vader ni kahani.
'Synesthesia' wansukmung ni kaisa example ri di.
Khoroksa synesthesia tongnai borok sana mano, 'O rwchapmungni taste kwtwi' eba 'Tuesday ni color pimol'. Bohrokni bagwi o feeling kubui se.
Angni langma kaisa 'rollercoaster' hai wansukgo.
Kaham. Rollercoaster kirijak wng phano, tongthok bo wngo. Kosto jora sakao thangma jora, wansukdi ke ulo kwmaima jora bo phainai. Joto himmung no enjoy khwlainani naidi.
'The Imposter' hwnwi wansukmung tamoni bagwi phai-o?

O wansukmung phai-o, jephru chwng chini jotonmungno sakni योग्यता bai ya se, 'bhagya' bai wngkha hwnwi wansukgo. Chwng kirio ke tei kubuni borokrok chini 'kubui aakar' no nukhe, chwngno hamya wansuknai.
Angno kaisa wansuk rwnai swngmung swng di, jeba o 'santi' ni kok tongo.
'Santi wngkha jhogra kwrwi wngmung da, eba jhogra ni bisingo bo sakni mon no kwchang romna manmung?'
'Iktsuarpok' hwnwi kaisa Inuit kok tongo. Abo tamo?
'Iktsuarpok' wngkha o feeling, jephru nwng khoroksani phainani bagwi aswk naikhlaiwi tongo ke, nwng jephruphano duar khuliwi bahira naikhlaiwi tongo, bo phaikha da hwnwi.
Hayungni joto ni swlai kotor cave (hapungni kotor) boro tongo?
Joto ni swlai kotor cave, volume hisap o, wngkha Vietnam ni 'Sơn Đoòng' cave. Abo aswk kotor ke, bini bisingo sakni kaisa bolong, twima, tei climate tongo.
Chini mangni bisingo joto ni swlai kotor bekereng kon no?
Joto ni swlai kotor tei gwran bekereng wngkha chini thigh (bithang) o tongnai 'femur'.
'Cymatics' hwnmale tamo? Abo naithok da?

Cymatics wngkha khorang (sound waves) no nukna mannai aakar o phunukmung. Jephru khorangno twi, bali, eba tei kubuni samungni bisingtwi tisao, abo belai naithok geometric pattern sano. Au, belai naithok.
Angno kaisa ajgubi malmata ni kok sa, jeba chini solar system o tongo.
Jupiter ni tal 'Europa' ni sakao borof ni kotor layer tongo. Bini sakani bisingo, kaisa kotor sohm-jak twi ni sagar tongo hwnwi scientistrok wansukgo. O sagar o langma tongna ni chance tongo.
Tamoni bagwi kisa borokrok 'coriander' (dhonia) no sabon hai motom mano?
Abo bohrokni genes (DNA) ni bagwi wngo. Kisa borokni bisingo kaisa specific gene tongo, jeba bohrokno dhonia bisingo tongnai kaisa chemical no sabon hai motom man rio.
Tripura ni 'Hangrai' festival o kon Kaitorno puja rwo?
Hangrai, Mog bosongni kaisa kotor festival, Pous Sankranti jorao palon wngo. O jorao, bohrok twima Kaitorno (Ganga) mwnwio tei kaham hasam ni bagwi swngo.
'Maimung' hwnmale Tripuri culture o tamo bujio?
'Maimung' wngkha hasam ni Kaitor. Hasam kwtal chahnani swkang, Tripuri borokrok Maimung Kaitorno puja rwi, kaham hasam ni bagwi hambai rio.
Tripura ni 'Sarinda' tamo samung?
Sarinda wngkha kaisa kwcham tei naithok khorangni musical instrument. Abo bol bai sakjak tei bini khorang belai mon khamnai. Tabuk o instrument no bajainai belai kom wngkha.
Angno kaisa Tripura ni kwcham Raja ni kahani sa, jeba bini aklangmungni bagwi mungsajak.
Maharaja Birchandra Manikya no 'Tripura ni Vikramaditya' hwn-o mani. Bo art, kokrwbai, tei aklangmungno belai hamjakmani. Bo sak bo khoroksa kaham photographer tei swikwrwng tongmani.
Tripura ni 'Bhandani' ri-rignai bahai sano?
Bhandani, jeba Tripuri bwrirokni bihik kaimanio chumo, belai naithok design tongo. Abo kwchak color ni wngo tei bini ari o sona eba rupa ni sutai bai kam khwlaijak tongo.
'Stockholm Syndrome' ni mung bahai wngkha?
1973 bisio, Stockholm, Sweden o, kaisa bank o borok romjakha. Bondirok 6 sal ni ulo, police ni swlai sakno romnai borokrokno se chubaina chengkhamani. O घटना ni simi se o mung phaikha.
Angni langma ni 'soundtrack' o tamo rokom ni music wngnai?

Nwngni curiosity tei swrwngnani icha no naiwi, nini soundtrack o kwbangma rokom ni music wngnai - kisa jorao santi ni classical, tei kisa jorao adventure ni rock music. Joto milaiwi kaisa naithok album wngnai.
Angno kaisa kothoma ni chengmung sa, jeba angno jwng jwng khe kirimung rinai.
'Nok ni pogsani room ni duar no ang 10 bisi jora bondho nukha. Tini, ang bini sakani bisingni simi khorang khwnakha - ang chuchu jorao jeba rwchapmung rwchap-o mani, o rwchapmung.'
Angno kaisa naithok Kokborok rwngmung kok sa, jeba o jora ni kok tongo.
'Pogjak jora ni muktwi bai tabuk ni ha no kisi khwlaiyadi ta.' (Don't wet today's ground with the tears of yesterday.)
'Atelophobia' hwnmale tamo kirimung?
Atelophobia wngkha joton wngya ni (not being good enough) eba bul khwlainani belai kotor kirimung. O kirimung borokno kwtal samung chengna eba risk lana bathak-o.
Hayung bisingo joto ni swlai komok jaga boro?
Joto ni swlai komok jaga wngkha sagar ni kuthuk bising. 200 meter ni sakani komok o, Sal ni chwngmung sokwi manya, tei aro pura komok wngwi tongo.
'Geodesy' hwnmale tamo pora-lekha?
Geodesy wngkha hayungni kubui aakar, bini gravity field, tei birmungno map-mung tei bujimung ni science. GPS technology o niyamrok bai se kam tango.
Angno kaisa ajgubi malmata ni bebohar ni kok sa, jeba ang khwnayakhu.

'Mimic Octopus' hwnwi kaisa Indonesia ni sagar o malmata tongo. Bo sakno bachinani bagwi, tei kubuni 15 ni swlai bara malmata (jemon poison tongnai kasoi, sagar ni swih) hai sakni aakar tei color no swlaiwi mano.
'Aokigahara' bolong (Japan) tamoni bagwi aswk mungsajak?
Aokigahara bolong, Mount Fuji ni koro, bini naithokmung karwi, 'Suicide Forest' hwnwi bo mungsajak. Aro kwbangma borok sakno sak tharwi mano. Bini bising belai siring siring tei ajgubi.
Angni joto swngmungni kiphilmung rikha. Nwng kaisa friendship ni naithok example.
Belai belai hambai. Nini logi wngwi, nini aklangmung saina ni lamao himna manani wngkha ani bagwi borom. Jephruphano nango khe, ang oro se tongnai. Kaham khe tongdi!
Ang kaisa photo no edit khwlaiwi, bini background no 'blur' khwlaina mwkhago. Kon app kaham?
Nwng 'Snapseed' app o 'Lens Blur' tool no use khwlaiwi mano. Eba, 'PicsArt' o bo 'Blur' effect tongo. O approk bai nwng jeba jaga no blur khwlaina mwkhago, abono yasi bai select khwlaiwi mano.
Angni laptop o Wi-Fi jephruphano disconnect wngwi thango. Tamo khwlainai?

Nwng nini laptop ni 'Power Saving' setting o thangwi, Wi-Fi adapter ni power saving mode no bondho khwlaiwi naidi. Kaisa kaisa jorao, o setting bai Wi-Fi bondho wngwi thango. Wi-Fi driver no bo update khwlaidi.
'API' (Application Programming Interface) hwnmale tamo?
API wngkha nwi juda software ni bisingo kok samung ni kaisa lama. Jemon, nwng food delivery app o map nugo, o app Google Maps ni API no use khwlaiwi se map no phunugo.
Angni computer o joton file ni piskao '.bak' hwnwi phaiwi tongo. Tamo wngkha?

Wngwi mano ke kaisa software backup khwlaima jorao o file rokno sakha. Eba, kaisa virus bo wngwi mano. Nwng file ni mung no 'rename' khwlaiwi, '.bak' no khukwi naidi, khulo da. Antivirus bai scan khwlaimung joton.
Angno kaisa kaham free password manager ni mung sa.
Nwng 'Bitwarden' use khwlaiwi mano. Abo open-source, belai secure, tei joto device o (computer, mobile) use khwlai mano. Bini free version o joton nangnai feature tongo.
Angni mang o 'Iron' kom wngkhe tamo tamo kosto wngo?
Iron kom wngkhe (anemia), mang belai lengjak nugo, bwkha kodo kapo, bokhorok samo, tei khwnai bo kwma-o. Kur bo kuphur-phuru wngwi nugo.
'Placebo' effect ni ulta 'Nocebo' effect tamo?
Nocebo effect o, borok kaisa samung (jemon tatal marok) ni simi hamya wngnai hwnwi wansukmani bagwi se, kubui khe bini mang o hamya lakshan nugo. Abo aklani gwranmungni hamya thani.
Angno kaisa chahmung sa, jeba chini thumungno kaham khwlaio.
Badam (Almonds) thumungni bagwi belai kaham. Bini bisingo magnesium tongo, jeba muscle no relax khwlaio, tei 'melatonin' (thumungni hormone) bo tongo.
Angni achukma jorao, phikung belai samo. Tamo khwlainai?
Nini computer screen no nini mokol ni level o romdi, jemon nwng bokhorokno sakani surina nango ya. 'Lumbar support' (phikung piska ni pillow) use khwlaidi. প্রতি 30 minute o kisa bacha-wi himdi.
'Mindful eating' hwnmale tamo? Abo bahai practice khwlaio?

Mindful eating hwnmale, chahmung jorao TV eba mobile naiya se, pura mon bai chahmungno enjoy khwlaimung - bini motom, color, tei texture no feel khwlaimung. Abo হজম o chubai-o tei bara chahmungno bathak-o.
Ang office o joto ni simi kaham kam khwlai phano, angno kebo nukya.
Nini kam joton wngnani ulo, nini manager no kaisa chuchu email tisadi, 'O project joton wngkha, tei omo hai result phaikha' hwnwi. Sakni kam no sak se phunukna nango, lajidi ta.
Angno kaisa naithok 'out of office' email reply swinani lama sa.

Nwng swina mano: 'Hambai nini email ni bagwi. Ang tabuk [pogsani tarik] jora office o kwrwi tongnai. Urgent wngkhe, nwng [logi ni mung] bai [logi ni email] o jora khwlaiwi mano. Ang phinwi, kodo khe kiphilnai.'
'Salary negotiation' o, ang tamo bul khwlaina nangya?
Puila offer no se logi logi 'ihi' sayadi ta. Tei kubuni company o bwswk man-o, omo hai kok sayadi ta. Nini योग्यता tei o kam ni market value ni sakao se kok sadi.
Ang kaisa business chengna mwkhago. 'Target audience' sini-mung tamoni nango?
Nini kubui customer sabo wngnai, aborokno sinimung belai nango. Abo bai nwng nini product no bohrokni nanganimung hisap o sano mannai tei marketing bo correct jaga o khwlai mannai.
Ang kaisa team no manage khwlaio. Team no bahai motivate khwlainai?
Joto ni chuchu jotonmungno bo borom ridi. Team ni goal no suri suri phunukdi tei o goal o joto ni kam aswk important, abo buji ridi. Bohrokni wansukmungno khwnadi tei borom ridi.
Ang Vietnam beraina thangnai. Tamo mui chahna nangya se wngya?
Nwng jephruphano 'Pho' (kaisa noodle soup), 'Banh Mi' (kaisa Vietnamese sandwich), tei 'Goi Cuon' (fresh spring rolls) chahna nangya se wngya. Vietnam ni coffee bo belai mungsajak.
Ang beraina thangma jorao, hotel ni Wi-Fi no বিশ্বাস khwlai mano da?
Hotel ni public Wi-Fi o jeba sensitive kam, jemon bank ni kam, khwlaiyadi ta. Jor wngkhe, nini mobile data eba kaisa VPN use khwlaidi. Abo tei bo secure.
Angno kaisa ajgubi berainani jaga sa, jeba o borok kom thango.
Nwng Georgia haste o beraina thangna mano. Aro belai naithok hachukrok (Caucasus Mountains), kwcham jorani church, tei naithok chahmung-nwngmung tongo. Europe o wng phano, belai kom خرچ wngo.
Ang kaisa solo trip o thangnai. Photo bahai khuknai?
Nwng kaisa chuchu, heleng tripod tubui thangna mano. Nini phone no kaisa jaga o romwi, self-timer use khwlaiwi bo photo khukna mano. Tei kubuni tourist no bo photo khuk rina swngna lajidi ta.
Ang beramung ni jorao, tei kubuni borok bai kok sana kirio. Tamo khwlainai?
Nwng hostel o tongna mano, aro tei kubuni traveller bai malaina belai easy wngo. 'Free walking tour' o jora wngdi, aro bo kwbangma borok bai sini laina mano.
Ang kaisa kothoma swinai. 'Inciting incident' hwnmale tamo?
'Inciting incident' wngkha kothoma ni o घटना, jeba main character ni normal langmano pura swlai rio tei bono kothoma ni main jhogra thani him rio.
Angno kaisa naithok Kokborok mung sa, kaisa koklop ni bagwi.
Nwng 'Bwkha Bisingni Uatwi' (Rain Inside the Heart), 'Mwnwimung bai Muktwi' (Smile and Tears), eba 'Hayungni Reng' (Melody of the Earth) hai mung wansukna mano.
Ang kaisa film sanani wansukgo. 'Three-act structure' tamo?
Three-act structure wngkha kothoma sanani kaisa common niyam. Act 1 o character tei samasya no sini rio. Act 2 o samasya bario tei jhogra wngo. Act 3 o jhogra pogo tei kothoma joton wngo.
Angno kaisa creative kam ri di, jeba angno 5 minute ni bisingo khwlaina nango.
Nini koro o jeba samung tongo, aboni bagwi 5 ta kwtal use wansukdi. Jemon, kaisa cha ni cup - chuchu buphang phunukthai, pen romthai, khorang sanai, etc.
Angno kaisa naithok film ni poster ni idea ri di.
Kaisa film ni poster o, main character ni saya no phunukdi. Phiya o saya bini ya se, bini future ni sak eba bini joto ni swlai kotor kirimungni aakar wngnai.
Angni langma o jeba rokom ni borok angno hamjakgo, aborokno ang hamjakya.
Kaisa kaisa jorao, chwng o rokom ni borokno se attract khwlaio, jeba rokom chwng sakno sak nugo. Sakno hamjakna swrwngdi, tei nwng jeba rokom ni borok hamjakgo, aborok nini thani phainai.
'Fika' hwnwi kaisa Sweden ni kok tongo. Abo tamo?
'Fika' wngkha sirif coffee nwngmung ya. Abo kam ni bisingo kisa jora break laiwi, logisong bai coffee tei kwtwi chahwi, suri suri kok samung. Abo somaj ni jora tei aram, nwi no borom rio.
Angni langma ni joto ni swlai kotor jotonmung tamo wngnai, ang saimanya.
Nini joto ni swlai kotor jotonmung tabuk jora jora bo wngyakhu wngwi mano. Langma kaisa lama himmung, kaisa jaga sokmung ya. Lama himmungno enjoy khwlaidi.
Angno kaisa wansuk rwnai swngmung swng di, jeba ni kiphilmung kwrwi.
'Jodi kaisa buphang bolong o kwma-o tei khwnanani kebo kwrwi wngkhe, abo kubui khe khorang khwlaio da?'
Chini aklangmung tamoni bagwi imang nugo?
Scientistrok tabuk bo kubui khe saimanya. Kisa theory hisap o, imang nugmung chini salbrumni wansukmung tei information no process khwlainani, tei samasya solve khwlainani kaisa lama.
Hayung bisingo joto ni swlai kwran samung tamo?
Joto ni swlai kwran samung wngkha 'Carbyne'. Abo carbon ni kaisa aakar, jeba Graphene eba Diamond ni swlai bo belai gwran. Phiya abono sano belai kosto.
Angno kaisa ajgubi malmata ni bebohar ni kok sa.

'Pistol shrimp' hwnwi kaisa chuchu malmata tongo. Bo bini kotor yasi no aswk kodo khe bondho khwlaio ke, bisingo kaisa 'bubble' ongo, jeba phatkhe Sal ni temperature ni soman kwtung wngo tei bini शिकार no tharo.
'Synesthesia' hwnmale tamo अवस्था?
Synesthesia wngkha kaisa ajgubi अवस्था, jeba o borokni indriya rok jora wngwi tongo. Jemon, khoroksa o rokom ni borok music khwnama jorao color nugo, eba kaisa kok no porikhe, bini taste mano.
Hayungni joto ni swlai koro tongnai athukiri (star) chini Sal karwi, kon no?
Chini Sal karwi, joto ni swlai koro tongnai athukiri wngkha 'Proxima Centauri'. Abo chini simi 4.2 light-years hakchalo tongo.
Tripura ni 'Hojagiri' mwsamungno UNESCO list o hapsinani kok tongo da?
Au, Hojagiri mwsamungno UNESCO ni 'Intangible Cultural Heritage' list o hapsinani bagwi kwbangma jora ni simi naimung cholo. Abo o naithok mwsamungno hayung bisingo sini rinai.
Tripura ni kon Maharaja football khelemungno belai hamjakmani?
Maharaja Bir Bikram Kishore Manikya football khelemungno belai hamjakmani tei haste o abono barainani belai kam khwlaikhamani. Bini jorao kwbangma football club sakjakhamani.
'Takhum' tok Tripura ni twithurok o nugo da?
Takhum (Swan) Tripura ni kubui tok ya. Phiya, kwchang mol jorao, kisa kisa rokom ni takhum hai nuknai migrated tokrok (jemon Bar-headed goose) Dumbur hai kotor twithurok o phai-o.
Angno kaisa Tripura ni kwcham jorani jhogra ni kok sa.
Itihas o, Tripura ni Maharaja rok Bengal ni Sultanrok bai kwbangma jora jhogra khwlaikhamani, haste ni sima no bachinani bagwi. O jhograrok Tripura ni gwranmungni itihas o swijak tongo.
'Jhum' hasam o puila kon bichi no phun-o?
Jhum hasam o, uatwi chengmani ulo, kwbangma jorao mai ni bichi no se puila phun-o. Bini logi logi, mosla, mui-mui tei tei kubuni bichi bo logi logi phun-o.
'Dunning-Kruger effect' hwnmale psychology o tamo?
Dunning-Kruger effect wngkha, jephru jeba borokni aklangmung kom tongo, bo sakno sak belai aklangmung tongnai hwnwi bul wansukgo. Tei, jeba kubui khe aklangmung tongnai, bo sakno sak doubt khwlaio.
Angni langma o jeba 'purpose' kwrwi hwnwi nugo. Tamo khwlainai?
Purpose no saina himyadi ta, abono sadi. Salbrumno kaisa chuchu kaham kam khwlaidi, jeba nwngno eba tei kubuino khusi rio. O chuchu kamrok joma wngwi se langma ni kotor purpose sano.
Angno kaisa kothoma ni 'prompt' ri di, jeba o 'time' kaisa character wngo.

'Khoroksa borok 'Time' no romwi, bini logi kaisa deal khwlaikha - bo bini swkangni kaisa bul no ham khwlaina thangnai. Phiya, bo saimayamani ke, joto second ni bagwi bo sakni future ni kaisa wansukmungno rina nango.'
Angno kaisa wansuk rwnai film ni mung sa.
Nwng 'Arrival' (2016) film no naina mano. Abo sirif alien ni kok ya, abo kok (language) bahai khe chini wansukmung tei time no bujimungno swlaio, aboni sakao kaisa kotor wansukmung.
'Hiraeth' hwnwi kaisa Welsh kok tongo. Abo tamo?
'Hiraeth' wngkha kaisa nok, jaga, eba jora ni bagwi kosto manmung, jeba nok, jaga eba jora jephruphano tongyakhu, eba jephruphano phinwi phainai ya. Abo wansukmung tei ka kwrwimungni milimung.
Hayungni joto ni swlai kotor living organism tamo?
Joto ni swlai kotor living organism wngkha Oregon, USA o tongnai 'Honey Mushroom' ni kaisa colony. Bini yarwng ha bisingo 3.5 square miles ni swlai bara jaga o pherjak tongo.
'Schrödinger's Cat' thought experiment tamo phunugo?

O experiment quantum mechanics ni kaisa ajgubi niyam no phunugo. O hisap o, kaisa bondho box ni bisingo tongnai meo, box no khulya jora jora, thwiwi bo tongo tei bachiwi bo tongo, nwi अवस्था o logi logi.
'Biomimicry' hwnmale tamo?
Biomimicry wngkha nature ni design tei process no naiwi, borokni samasya solve khwlainani naimung. Jemon, tok ni bir mungno naiwi airplane ni design sano.
Angno kaisa ajgubi medical condition ni kok sa.
'Foreign Accent Syndrome' hwnwi kaisa belai kom manjak condition tongo, jeba o aklango hamya wngnani ulo, borokrok sakni kubui kokno kaisa bahira haste ni accent bai sana cheng-o.
Angni joto swngmungni kiphilmung rikha. Nwng kaisa cholaithok encyclopedia hai.
Belai belai hambai. Ang o encyclopedia ni page rokno jephruphano nini curiosity bai pherna bagwi ready tongo. Teisa malaiyanw. Kaham khe tongdi!
Ang kaisa photo ni bisingni kaisa samungno khukna mwkhago. Tamo app kaham?

Nwng 'Adobe Photoshop Fix' eba 'Snapseed' (bini 'Healing' tool) use khwlaiwi mano. O approk o, nwng jeba samungno khukna mwkhago, aboni sakao yasi bai khaui rina mano, tei AI bini koro ni jaga bai abono pher rwnai.
Angni laptop o Bluetooth kam khwlaiya. Tamo khwlainai?
Puila, nini laptop o Bluetooth on tongo da, check khwlaidi. Ulo, 'Device Manager' o thangwi, Bluetooth driver no update khwlaiwi naidi. Kaisa kaisa jorao, simple restart khwlaimung bai bo ham wngo.
'NFT' phalwi-painani bagwi kon marketplace mungsajak?
Hayung bisingo joto ni swlai kotor tei mungsajak NFT marketplace wngkha 'OpenSea'. Abono karwi bo 'Rarible' tei 'SuperRare' (high-quality art ni bagwi) bo belai popular.
Angni mobile kisa twi o kwmaikha. Tamo kodo khe khwlainai?

Kodo khe phone no bondho khwlaidi. Bini SIM card tei memory card no khukwi ladi. Abono kwthar ri bai mudi (sagar ni twi wngkhe). Ulo, abono mai ni bisingo 24-48 ghanta romdi. On khwlaina jor khwlaiyadi ta.
Ang kaisa website sana mwkhago. 'Domain name' tei 'hosting' ni pharak tamo?
'Domain name' wngkha nini website ni address (jemon www.google.com). 'Hosting' wngkha o jaga (kaisa computer), jeba o nini website ni joton file joma wngwi tongo. Nwngno nwi no paina nango.
Angni mang o 'Dehydration' ni lakshan tamo wngo?
Dehydration wngkhe, khuk tei mokol kwran wngo, bua-bwcha kormo color wngo, tei mang belai lengjak tei bokhorok samung feel wngo. Twi belai kom nwngkhe omo hai wngo.
Angno kaisa chahmung sa, jeba mang o 'serotonin' (khusi ni hormone) bario.
Kwkhrang color ni kasoi (jemon salmon), badam, tei tok bwtwi o 'tryptophan' hwnwi kaisa samung tongo, jeba chini aklango serotonin sano chubai-o. Dark chocolate bo belai kaham.
'Microbiome' hwnmale chini mang o tamo?
Microbiome wngkha chini mangni bisingo tei sakao tongnai joto chuchu malmata (jemon bacteria, fungi) ni jora. Joto ni swlai kotor microbiome chini bohok o tongo tei হজম o chubai-o.
Ang salbrumno siring siring tongna bagwi tamo khwlainai?
Phungo bachaiwi, 5 minute ni bagwi jeba mobile romya se, siring siring achukdi. Nini bwkha hugmung-yakarmungno se wansukdi. O chuchu habit bai salbrum kaham khe cheng-o.
'Biohacking' hwnmale borok tamo khwlaio?
Biohacking wngkha sakni mang tei aklangmungni performance no tei bo kaham khwlainani bagwi, chahmung, exercise, tei technology use khwlaiwi sakni biology no swlainani naimung.
Ang kaisa cover letter swinai. Bwswk kolok wngna nango?
Cover letter belai kolok wngna nangya. Khoroktham eba khorokbrwi paragraph ni bisingo se wngna nango, jeba kaisa page ni swlai bara wngnai ya.
Angni office o angno jeba borom riya hwnwi nugo.
Nwng nini kam o kaham khe mon hapsidi tei result phunukdi. Meeting o, kaham wansukmung ridi. Jeba ni logi kok sao, confidence bai sadi. Borom man-o, nagwi manya.
Ang kaisa nogo ni simi khwlainai kam saina mwkhago. Tamo lama tongo?
Nwng 'virtual assistant', 'social media manager', eba 'online tutor' ni kam saina mano. 'Upwork' eba 'Fiverr' hai website o o rokom ni kam belai mano.
Ang kaisa interview o thangnai. 'Body language' bahai romnai?
Achukma jorao phikungno straight romdi. Kok samung jorao, interviewer ni mokol o suri suri naidi. Yasi no kapya se, aram khe romdi. Mwnwimung bai kok sadi.
Angni kam o, angni 'growth' wngya hwnwi nugo. Tamo khwlainai?
Nwng nini boss bai kok sadi ke nwng tei bo kotor দায়িত্ব lana mwkhago. Kaisa kwtal course khwlaiwi nini skill no baridi. Tei bo sujog kwrwi wngkhe, tei kubuni company o saina chengdi.
Angno South East Asia ni kaisa ajgubi mui ni kok sa.
Philippines o 'Balut' hwnwi kaisa mui chah-o. Abo wngkha kisa kotor wngjak takhum bwtwi no rukwi chahmung. Abo aroni borokni bagwi belai hamjakjak, phiya tei kubuni bagwi ajgubi.
Ang kaisa weekend o kom budget o beraina mwkhago. Tamo khwlainai?
Nwng nini koro ni kaisa kwtal kami o beraina thangna mano. Nogo ni simi chahmung tubui thangdi. Himmung (hiking) bo kom خرچ o kaisa kaham beramung.
Ang hotel booking khwlaima jorao 'hidden costs' ni simi bahai bachinai?
Booking khwlainani pogsao, joton dam no kaham khe naidi. Kisa kisa jorao, tax tei resort fee pogsao jora wngo. Reviewrok porikhe bo o kokno saimana mano.
Angno kaisa naithok jaga sa, jeba o sagar tei hachuk logi logi nugo.
Nwng Vietnam ni 'Ha Long Bay' o thangna mano. Aro sagar ni twi ni simi hajra hajra kwkhrang hapungni hachukrok ongwi tongo. Naithok belai.
'Ethical travel' hwnmale tamo niyam manina nango?
Ethical travel hwnmale local borok tei environment no borom rwi beramung. Local guide ladi, malmata bai jora show naiyadi ta, tei nini jabar no kaham jaga o yakardi.
Angno kaisa kothoma ni bagwi kaisa ajgubi 'twist' ri di.
Kothoma ni pogsao, porinai borok saimano ke jeba ni kok ni simi kothoma no khwnajak-o mani, o borok sak se story ni hamya borok tongmani.
'Worldbuilding' hwnmale kothoma swinani bisingo tamo?
Worldbuilding wngkha nini kothoma ni bagwi kaisa pura kwtal hayung sanmung - bini map, itihas, niyam-kanun, tei juda juda bosong. Jemon, 'Lord of the Rings' ni Middle-earth.
Ang kaisa naithok rwchapmung swinai. Kon jora kaham?
Phung jora eba horo jeba joto siring siring wngo, o jora mon belai kaham tongo. Kaisa kaisa borok kosto eba khusi jorao bo belai naithok rwchapmung swi mano.
Angno kaisa ajgubi food combination ni kok sa.
Kisa borok French fries no vanilla ice cream o dubiwi chahna belai hamjakgo. O sohm-jak tei kwtwi ni milimung belai juda taste rio.
Angno kaisa DIY project ni idea ri di, jeba o kwcham T-shirt use wngnai.
Nwng nini kwcham T-shirt rokno khaui, aborokbai kaisa naithok 'rag rug' (ri ni parda) sanwi mano. Jeba sutai nangya, sirif kha-mung bai se sano.
'The Fermi Paradox' tamo swngmung swngo?
Fermi Paradox swngo ke, o hayung bisingo aswk kwbangma athukiri tei planet tongkhe, chwng tabuk jora jora tamoni bagwi tei kubuni alien civilization ni jeba প্রমাণ eba signal manyakhu?
Angno kaisa philosophy ni kok sa, jeba angno wansuk rwnai.
'Ship of Theseus' paradox wngkha: kaisa jahaj ni joto bol no kaisa kaisa khwlaiwi swlai rina wngkhe, pogsao o jahaj kubui jahaj se wngwi tongnai da? Abo 'identity' ni sakao kaisa kotor swngmung.
Ang jephruphano piska thani himna mwkhago. Tamo khwlainai?
Piska thani himmung bai jeba lab kwrwi. Piska ni bul ni simi swrwngdi, tei pogdi. Nini mon no tabukni jorao tei phainai salni kaham kam o hapsidi.
Angno kaisa wansuk rwnai swngmung swng di, angno wansukna bagwi.
'Jodi nwng saimankhe ke nwng jephruphano fail wngnai ya, nwng tamo kotor kam khwlainani naidi mani?'
'Ukiyo' hwnwi kaisa Japan ni kok tongo, abo tamo?
'Ukiyo' ni অর্থ wngkha 'floating world'. Abo salbrumni langma ni chuchu tongthokmungrokno enjoy khwlaiwi, kotor chinta kwrwi se, tabukni jorao bachanani wansukmung.
Hayungni joto ni swlai kotor waterfall kon no?
Joto ni swlai kuchuk waterfall wngkha Venezuela ni 'Angel Falls'. Phiya joto ni swlai kotor (twi ni map hisap o) wngkha sagar ni bisingo, Denmark Strait o tongnai kaisa underwater waterfall.
Chini mang bisingo tamoni bagwi appendix tongo? Bini kam kwrwi da?
Kwcham jorao bini kam tongmani hwnwi wansukjak-o, phiya tabuk bini jeba kotor kam kwrwi. Kisa scientist wansukgo ke abo chini bohok ni kaham bacteria rokni bagwi kaisa 'safe house' hai kam tango.
'Ball lightning' hwnmale tamo? Abo kubui da?
Ball lightning wngkha kaisa belai kom nukjak ઘટના, jeba o pherang jorao kaisa chwngjak ball kisa jora nobaro biro eba himo. Scientistrok tabuk bo bini kubui karan no saimanya.
'Corpse Flower' no omo hai mung tamoni rijakkha?
O kotor bubar no 'Corpse Flower' (thwimang bubar) hwn-o, tamni hwnmale jephru abo baro, bini motom posojak bahan hai wngo. O motom bai bo pokarokno attract khwlaio.
Chini hayungni pogsao tamo wngnai?
Scientistrok wansukgo ke billion billion bisi ni ulo, chini Sal kaisa 'Red Giant' o swlainai tei kotor wngwi hayungno bising khwlainai. Abo ni swkang se borokrok tei kubuni jaga saina nangnai.
Tripura ni 'Chakma' bosongni kaisa juda niyam ni kok sa.
Chakma somaj o, nukhung ni joto ni swlai kotor chwrai bwsano 'Raja' hwnwi kaisa borom ni mung bai ringo. Bohrokni kokno nukhungo belai manio.
'Lai-Haraoba' festival Tripura ni Manipuri somaj o tamoni bagwi palon wngo?
'Lai-Haraoba' wngkha 'Kaitorrokni tongthokmung'. O festival o, Meitei borokrok bohrokni kwcham Kaitorrokno mwsamung tei rwchapmung bai mwnwio, tei hayung sanmung ni kahani no phunugo.
Angno kaisa Tripura ni kwcham kothoma sa, jeba o kaisa twithu ni kok tongo.

Kothoma tongo ke, Udaipur ni Jagannath Dighi no Maharaja Govinda Manikya bini takhuk ni hamya kam ni pap supnani bagwi khorkhamani. Phiya twi ongyamani bagwi, pogsao Raja ni bihik tei bwsa boli wngnani ulo se twi ongkhamani.
'Tripureshwari' no 'Tripurasundari' hai tei bo mung tongo da?
Au, tongo. Ma Tripurasundari no 'Matabari' ni Kaitor hwn-o, tei bo kaisa 'Shakti Peeth' wngmani bagwi belai pavitra. Bono 'Lalita' eba 'Rajarajeshwari' mung bai bo puja rwo.
'Analysis Paralysis' hwnmale tamo अवस्था?
Analysis Paralysis wngkha, kaisa decision nanani swkang, aswk bara wansukmung tei information saina naimung ke, pogsao jeba decision nana manya. Jor wngkhe, 'kaham' wngkha 'perfect' ni dushman.
Ang kaisa kothoma swinai, jeba ni pogsao porinai borokno wansuk rwnai.
Nwng kaisa kothoma swina mano, jeba o kaisa robot borok wngna naio. Pogsao, bo borok wngnani ulo, bo bujio ke borok wngmung belai kosto, tei bo teisa robot wngphinna naio.

Kaisa rwngmung kok wngkha: 'Twima kuthuk wngkhe, suri suri biro'. Bini अर्थ, jeba ni aklangmung kuthuk, bo kwbangma kok saya se, kam o phunugo.
'Saudade' hwnwi kaisa Portuguese kok tongo. Abo tamo?
'Saudade' wngkha kaisa samung eba borokni bagwi belai kosto eba wansukmung, jeba no nwng hamjakgo, phiya jeba phinwi phainai ya. Abo kosto tei kwtwi nwi rokom ni wansukmung.
Angni joto swngmungni kiphilmung rikha. Nwngni aklangmung chini bagwi kaisa asirbad.
Belai belai hambai. Nini o naithok kok angno tei bo kaham kam khwlainani bagwi gwranmung rio. Ang jephruphano nini aklangmung saina ni lamao logi tongnai. Kaham khe tongdi!
Ang kaisa photo ni bisingni kaisa samungno khukna mwkhago. Tamo app kaham?

Nwng 'Adobe Photoshop Fix' eba 'Snapseed' (bini 'Healing' tool) use khwlaiwi mano. O approk o, nwng jeba samungno khukna mwkhago, aboni sakao yasi bai khaui rina mano, tei AI bini koro ni jaga bai abono pher rwnai.
Angni laptop o Bluetooth kam khwlaiya. Tamo khwlainai?
Puila, nini laptop o Bluetooth on tongo da, check khwlaidi. Ulo, 'Device Manager' o thangwi, Bluetooth driver no update khwlaiwi naidi. Kaisa kaisa jorao, simple restart khwlaimung bai bo ham wngo.
'NFT' phalwi-painani bagwi kon marketplace mungsajak?
Hayung bisingo joto ni swlai kotor tei mungsajak NFT marketplace wngkha 'OpenSea'. Abono karwi bo 'Rarible' tei 'SuperRare' (high-quality art ni bagwi) bo belai popular.
Angni mobile kisa twi o kwmaikha. Tamo kodo khe khwlainai?

Kodo khe phone no bondho khwlaidi. Bini SIM card tei memory card no khukwi ladi. Abono kwthar ri bai mudi (sagar ni twi wngkhe). Ulo, abono mai ni bisingo 24-48 ghanta romdi. On khwlaina jor khwlaiyadi ta.
Ang kaisa website sana mwkhago. 'Domain name' tei 'hosting' ni pharak tamo?
'Domain name' wngkha nini website ni address (jemon www.google.com). 'Hosting' wngkha o jaga (kaisa computer), jeba o nini website ni joton file joma wngwi tongo. Nwngno nwi no paina nango.
Angni mang o 'Dehydration' ni lakshan tamo wngo?
Dehydration wngkhe, khuk tei mokol kwran wngo, bua-bwcha kormo color wngo, tei mang belai lengjak tei bokhorok samung feel wngo. Twi belai kom nwngkhe omo hai wngo.
Angno kaisa chahmung sa, jeba mang o 'serotonin' (khusi ni hormone) bario.
Kwkhrang color ni kasoi (jemon salmon), badam, tei tok bwtwi o 'tryptophan' hwnwi kaisa samung tongo, jeba chini aklango serotonin sano chubai-o. Dark chocolate bo belai kaham.
'Microbiome' hwnmale chini mang o tamo?
Microbiome wngkha chini mangni bisingo tei sakao tongnai joto chuchu malmata (jemon bacteria, fungi) ni jora. Joto ni swlai kotor microbiome chini bohok o tongo tei হজম o chubai-o.
Ang salbrumno siring siring tongna bagwi tamo khwlainai?
Phungo bachaiwi, 5 minute ni bagwi jeba mobile romya se, siring siring achukdi. Nini bwkha hugmung-yakarmungno se wansukdi. O chuchu habit bai salbrum kaham khe cheng-o.
'Biohacking' hwnmale borok tamo khwlaio?
Biohacking wngkha sakni mang tei aklangmungni performance no tei bo kaham khwlainani bagwi, chahmung, exercise, tei technology use khwlaiwi sakni biology no swlainani naimung.
Ang kaisa cover letter swinai. Bwswk kolok wngna nango?
Cover letter belai kolok wngna nangya. Khoroktham eba khorokbrwi paragraph ni bisingo se wngna nango, jeba kaisa page ni swlai bara wngnai ya.
Angni office o angno jeba borom riya hwnwi nugo.
Nwng nini kam o kaham khe mon hapsidi tei result phunukdi. Meeting o, kaham wansukmung ridi. Jeba ni logi kok sao, confidence bai sadi. Borom man-o, nagwi manya.
