Angni computer 'BIOS' o hapna mwkhago. Kon button no press khwlainai?

Computer on wngma jorao, nwng kodo khe F2, F10, F12, eba DEL button no press khwlaiwi naidi. Model ni hisap o button juda wngo. Nini computer ni brand ni mung bai online o saikhe, kubui button no saimanai.
Angni phone o kwbangma 'junk file' joma wngkha. Kon app bai kwthar khwlainai?
Nwng 'Files by Google' eba 'CCleaner' hai app use khwlaiwi mano. O approk nangya file, duplicate photo, tei kotor file rokno saina tei delete khwlainani chubai-o.
'Scrum' tei 'Agile' methodology software development o tamo?

Agile wngkha software sanani kaisa wansukmung, jeba o kam no chuchu chuchu bhag khwlaiwi, jephruphano swlaimungno lachio. Scrum wngkha Agile no use khwlainani kaisa niyam, jeba o chuchu team 'sprints' (chuchu jora ni kam) o kam khwlaio.
Angni mobile ni GPS kaham khe kam khwlaiya. Tamo khwlainai?
Nwng nini phone ni setting o thangwi, 'Location' no off khwlaiwi teisa on khwlaiwi naidi. 'High Accuracy' mode select khwlaidi. Bahira o, khulwi jaga o, GPS kodo khe signal mano.
'Fintech' hwnmale tamo industry?

Fintech ('Financial Technology') wngkha o industry, jeba technology no use khwlaiwi, traditional financial service (jemon banking, investment) no tei bo easy tei kaham khwlaino naio. Jemon, UPI eba online investment app.
Angni mang o 'carpal tunnel syndrome' ni lakshan nugo. Tamo khwlainai?

Carpal tunnel syndrome o yasi tei yasima o samung eba kwchang nugmung wngo. Computer o kwbangma kam tangnai ni omo hai wngo. Yasi no aram ridi tei wrist support use khwlaidi. Doctor phunukmung belai joton.
'Intermittent fasting' o cha eba coffee nwngna mano da?
Au, mano. Fasting jorao, nwng chini kwrwi black coffee, black tea, eba green tea nwngna mano. Phiya bwtwi eba chini hapsiya khe se kaham.
Angno kaisa chahmung sa, jeba mangni 'collagen' production no bario.
Vitamin C tongnai chahmung, jemon lembu, capsicum, tei amla, mang o collagen sanani bagwi belai nango. Bekereng ni soup (bone broth) o bo collagen belai kwbangma tongo.
'Seasonal Affective Disorder' (SAD) no deal khwlainani lama tamo?
Salbrumno kisa jora sal o ongna naidi, phung jorao wngkhe tei bo kaham. Vitamin D supplement lana mano. Light therapy box bo belai chubai-o.
Angni thumung jorao, ang belai kapo (teeth grinding). Tamo khwlainai?
Thunani swkang, mon no santi rinai kam khwlaidi, jemon meditation eba kwtung twi bai tukumung. Stress ni bagwi bo omo hai wngo. Jor wngkhe, dentist 'mouth guard' rina mano.
Ang office o tei kubuini 'no' sana manya. Tamo khwlainai?

Nwng suri suri 'no' sana swrwngna mano. 'Ang tabuk tei kaisa important kam o busy tongo, omo joton wngnani ulo nini kam no naidi nai da?' - omo hai kiphilmung riwi mano. Abo direct 'no' ya, phiya nini sima no phunugo.
Angni email inbox o jephruphano promotional mail phaiwi phero. Tamo khwlainai?
Joto promotional mail ni sakani bisingo kaisa chuchu 'Unsubscribe' hwnwi swijak link tongo. Abono click khwlaidi. Kisa jora ni ulo, o company ni simi mail phainai ya.
Angni mobile o kwbangma app tongo. Kon app battery joto ni swlai bara chah-o, bahai saimanai?

Nwng nini phone ni 'Settings' o thangwi, 'Battery' section o naidi. Aro nwng naina mannai ke kon app bwswk percent battery use khwlaikha. Jeba bara chah-o, aboni background activity no bondho khwlaidi.
'Ergonomics' hwnmale office o tamo bujio?
Ergonomics hwnmale nini samung tangnai jaga no (chair, table, computer) omo hai khe sajimung, jemon nini mango jeba kosto eba samung wngya wngthung. Abo phikung samung, mokol samung kom khwlaio.
Ang kaisa online meeting o jora wngnai. Tamo jotono nana nango?
Nini internet connection, microphone, tei camera kaham khe kam khwlaio da, swkang ni simi check khwlaidi. Nini piskao jeba ajgubi samung eba khorang wngya wngthung, o jaga o achukdi.
Ang office o joto ni swlai chuchu, angno kebo serious khe naya.
Nini kam bai se joto no phunukdi. Meeting o, research khwlaiwi, kaham wansukmung ridi. Kubuini kokno khwnadi, tei jephru kok sao, confidence bai sadi. Bisi ya, aklangmung se kotor.
Angno Japan ni kaisa ajgubi jaga ni kok sa.
Japan o 'Cat Island' (Aoshima) hwnwi kaisa jaga tongo. O chuchu island o borok ni swlai meo 6 guna bara tongo. Meo hamjaknai borokni bagwi o jaga belai naithok.
'Cultural appropriation' tei 'cultural appreciation' ni pharak tamo?

Cultural appreciation wngkha tei kubuni culture no borom bai swrwngna tei bujina naimung. Cultural appropriation wngkha, o culture ni samungrokno (jemon ri-chum) bini kubui अर्थ bujiya se eba borom riya se, sakni bagwi use khwlaimung.
Angno kaisa travel-related quote sa, jeba angno wansuk rwnai.
Kaisa kaham quote wngkha: 'Beramung nwngno rang-ri bai gorib khwlaiwi mano, phiya wansukmung bai kotor borok sano.'
Ang beraina thangma jorao, nogo chuchu buphangrok tongo. Tamo khwlainai?
Nwng kaisa kotor twi ni botol no ulta khwlaiwi, bini khuk o kaisa chuchu kotor khwlaiwi, buphang ni pot o suri suri romwi rina mano. Abo suri suri twi rio.
Angno kaisa ajgubi khele-mungni kok sa, jeba hayung bisingo khele-o.
Finland o 'Wife-Carrying World Championships' hwnwi kaisa khele wngo. O jorao, bwsairok bohrokni bihikrokno horwi, kosto lama bai himguruna nango.
Kaisa kothoma o 'Foil character' ni kam tamo?
Foil character wngkha o rokom ni character, jeba ni guna main character ni pura ulta wngo. O nwi ni pharak bai, main character ni guna tei bo suri khe nugo.
Ang kaisa horror story swina mwkhago. Tamo tip tongo?
Jeba no phunug-o, aboni swlai jeba no phunugya, abo se tei bo kiri-nai. Porinai borokno sakni aklango kirimungno sanani sujog ridi. Khorang tei siring siring ni वर्णन khwlaidi.
Angno kaisa naithok Kokborok mung sa, kaisa music band ni bagwi.
Nwng 'Rengni Lama' (Path of Melody), 'Hachuk Khorang' (Voice of the Hills), eba 'Pherangni Bwsarok' (Children of Thunder) hai mung romna mano.
Ang 'calligraphy' swrwngna mwkhago. Puila tamo nango?
Nwng puila kaisa 'calligraphy pen' (jeba ni nib juda wngo), kisa ink, tei kaham quality ni kagoj bai chengna mano. Basic stroke rokno puila practice khwlaidi.
Angno kaisa wansuk rwnai documentary ni mung sa.

Nwng 'Minimalism: A Documentary About the Important Things' no naina mano. Abo chini langmao samung-lugri ni बदला o, experience tei relationship no tamoni bara borom rina nango, aboni sakao wansuk rio.
'The prisoner's dilemma' hwnmale tamo?

Omo kaisa game theory ni example. Nwi aparadhi no juda juda romjakha. Jodino kaisa tei kaisano tatal sao, bo swadhin wngnai. Jodino nwi no siring siring tongo, nwi no kom sajja wngnai. Jodino nwi no tatal sa-o, nwi no kotor sajja wngnai. Abo trust tei sakni lab ni jhogra no phunugo.
Angni langma o jeba kaham wngya hwnwi nugo.
Kaisa sal jeba kaham wngya wngwi mano, phiya pura langma hamya wngwi manya. O kosto jora bo thangnai. Chuchu chuchu kaham samungrokno naina naidi, jemon phung ni cha, eba khoroksani mwnwimung.
Angno kaisa wansuk rwnai swngmung swng di, jeba o 'swadhinata' ni kok tongo.
'Swadhinata hwnmale jeba khusi khwlainani odhikar da, eba jeba khusi khwlaina nangya, o kam ni simi sakno bathakna manmung?'
'Gluggaveður' hwnwi kaisa Icelandic kok tongo. Abo tamo?
'Gluggaveður' ni अर्थ wngkha 'window weather'. Abo o rokom ni मौसम no bujio, jeba nok bisingni simi naina belai naithok, phiya bahira ongna bagwi belai kwchang eba hamya.
Angni langma ni 'villain' ang sak se hwnwi wansukgo.
O wansukmung kwbangma borokni phai-o. Kaham kok wngkha, nwng jodi nini kahani ni villain wngna mano, nwng o kahani ni hero bo wngna mano. Nini pogsani chapter no nwng swina chengdi.
Hayungni joto ni swlai kuthuk jaga o tamo tongo?
Hayungni joto ni swlai kuthuk jaga, Mariana Trench ni bisingo, ajgubi tei naithok malmatarok tongo, jeba rok pura komok tei kotor pressure o bacho. Jemon, 'Mariana snailfish'.
Chini mangni bisingo 'mitochondria' ni kam tamo?
Mitochondria no cell ni 'powerhouse' hwn-o. Abo chahmung ni simi manjak samungno energy (ATP) o swlaio, jeba no chini cell rok joto kam khwlainani bagwi use khwlaio.
Angno kaisa ajgubi buphangni kok sa, jeba chini solar system bai jora.

'Ginkgo biloba' buphangno kaisa 'living fossil' hwn-o. O buphangni rokom 270 million bisi swkang bo hayungo tongmani, dinosaurrokni jorani simi bo swkang. O buphang juda juda kotor घटना ni simi bachiwi phaikha.
'Placebo button' hwnmale tamo?
Placebo button wngkha o rokom ni button, jeba no press khwlaikhe jeba kam wngya, phiya borokno wansuk rio ke bohrok control khwlaio. Jemon, kwbangma lama barnai jaga ni 'walk' button.
Tamoni bagwi kisa borokrok 'ASMR' feel khwlaio tei kisa khwlaiya?

Scientistrok kubui khe saimanya, phiya wansukjak-o ke omo aklangni structure ni pharak ni bagwi wngwi mano. Jeba borok ASMR feel khwlaio, bohrokni aklangni emotion tei aram bai jora bhagrok tei bo active wngo.
Tripura ni 'Jampui Hill' o kon bosongni borok kwbangma tongo?
Jampui Hill o joto ni swlai kwbangma Mizo (Lushai) bosongni borokrok tongo. Bohrokni culture tei kok, Mizoram haste bai belai milio. Aro orange bagan belai mungsajak.
Angno kaisa Tripura ni kwcham kothoma sa, jeba o Kaitor ni kok kwrwi.

Kothoma tongo ke, kwcham jorao, khoroksa belai gwran Tripuri chwla bini kami no kaisa kotor mayung ni simi saichung se jhogra khwlaiwi bachikhamani. Bini gwranmungno wansukwi, kami ni borokrok bono pogsao Raja sakhamani.
Tripura ni 'Wa' (bamboo) bai sakjak kon mui belai mungsajak?
'Muiya Awandru' wngkha kaisa belai mungsajak mui. Abo wa ni kwtal twng (bamboo shoot), berma, tei kasoi kwran bai sakjak kaisa kwkhrang tei naithok mui.
'Galamphang' hwnmale Kokborok o tamo bujio?
'Galamphang' hwnmale sadharanoto kaisa kotor, kwcham tei joto ni bisingo achukwi kok sanai kaisa buphang no bujio. Abo kami ni kaisa kotor jaga wngo.
Ang kaisa kothoma swinai, jeba ni main character kaisa Kokborok swikwrwng wngo.
Kaham idea! Nwng phunukna mano ke bo bahai khe pogwi tongnai kwcham kothomarokno saina himo, tei o kothomarokno tabukni borok thani tisana kosto mano. Bini jhogra kok bai tei swlaimung bai wngnai.
'Dunning-Kruger effect' no bahai deal khwlainai?
Jephruphano wansukdi ke nwng joton saimanya. Tei kubuini kiphilmung tei feedback no khwnanani bagwi ready tongdi. Sakni aklangmungno jephruphano challenge khwlaidi.
Angno kaisa wansuk rwnai swngmung swng di, jeba o 'khusi' ni kok tongo.
'Khusi wngkha kaisa jaga sokmung da, eba joto sal ni chuchu himmungni bisingo manjak chuchu tongthokmung da?'
'Kalpa' hwnwi kaisa Sanskrit kok tongo, abo tamo?
Hindu tei Buddhist wansukmungo, 'Kalpa' hwnmale belai, belai lama jora - hayung bising sanani tei phatbarnani kaisa pura cycle. Abo billion billion bisi ni soman.
Angni joto swngmungni kiphilmung rikha. Nwng kaisa khorang kwrwi logi hai.
Belai belai hambai. Ang o 'khorang kwrwi logi' wngna belai hamjakgo. Jephruphano mon ni kok sana nango eba aklangmung saina nango, ang oro se tongnai. Kaham khe tongdi!
Angni laptop o 'Disk Defragmentation' khwlaimung nango da, jodi ang SSD use khwlaio?

Ihi, nangya. Disk defragmentation sirif traditional Hard Disk Drive (HDD) ni bagwi se nango. SSD o abono khwlaimung bini langma no kom khwlaiwi mano. Windows sakbaithang omo no bujio tei SSD no defrag khwlaiya.
Angni phone ni screen jephruphano sakbaithang on wngwi tongo. Tamo khwlainai?

Nwng nini 'Lock Screen' setting o thangwi 'Ambient Display' eba 'Always-On Display' option no bondho khwlaiwi naidi. Kaisa-kaisa app bo omo hai khwlai rio, aboni notification setting no check khwlaidi.
'Software as a Service' (SaaS) hwnmale tamo?
SaaS wngkha software no kaisa jorao painani बदला o, प्रति tal eba प्रति bisi dam riwi, internet ni bisingtwi use khwlaimung. Jemon, Microsoft 365 eba Netflix.
Angno kaisa kaham free photo editing software ni mung sa, computer ni bagwi.
Nwng 'GIMP' (GNU Image Manipulation Program) use khwlaiwi mano. Abo Photoshop hai se belai gwran, phiya pura free. Swrwngna kisa jora nago.
Angni computer o joton text ajgubi symbol o nugo. Tamo khwlainai?
Nini computer ni 'Language and Region' setting no check khwlaidi. Wngwi mano ke nini default language swlaijakha. Nini font file rok corrupt wngkhe bo omo hai wngo.
Angni mang o 'Cortisol' hormone no bahai kom khwlainai?
Cortisol, 'stress hormone', no kom khwlainani bagwi, kaham khe thudi, salbrumno kisa meditation khwlaidi, tei logisong eba nukhung bai mwnwiwi kok sadi. Coffee kom nwngmung bo chubai-o.
'Cold shower' (kwchang twi bai tukumung) ni tamo lab tongo?
Cold shower blood circulation no kaham khwlaio, immune system no bario, tei phungo bachanani ulo, mon no belai fresh tei alert khwlaio. Mang o inflammation kom khwlaino bo chubai-o.
Angni bua o 'plaque' joma wngmung no bahai kom khwlainai?
Salo nwi jora kaham khe, 2 minute jora, bua supdi. Salbrumno kaisa jora 'floss' khwlaidi. Chini tongnai chahmung tei nwngmung kom khwlaidi. 6 talo kaisa jora dentist thani thangdi.
'Lactose intolerance' tongkhe, bwtwi ni बदला o tamo nwngna mano?
Nwng almond milk, soy milk, eba oat milk nwngna mano. O nwngmungrok o lactose kwrwi. Tabuk market o 'lactose-free' bwtwi bo mano.
'Procrastination' no phitaina bagwi kaisa simple lama sa di.
'Two-Minute Rule' no use khwlaidi. Jeba kam khwlaina nango, abono jodi 2 minute ni bisingo khwlaiwi mano, abono logi logi khwlaidi, ulo ni bagwi romdi ta. Omo hai bai kam chengmung easy wngo.
Ang office o kaham kam khwlai phano, angno 'credit' mano ya. Tamo khwlainai?
Nini kam ni 'visibility' no baridi. Nini team no eba boss no salbrumni eba haptani kam ni chuchu update email bai tisadi. Jemon, borok saimana mano ke nwng tamo tamo khwlaiwi tongo.
Ang kaisa job no yakarna mwkhago, phiya kwtal job manyakhu. Tamo khwlainai?
Kwtal job manyakhu jora jora yakarmung belai risk wngo. Nini tabuk ni kam no khwlaiwi tongwi, khali jorao kwtal job saina se joto ni swlai kaham tei safe lama.
'Dress for the job you want, not for the job you have' - o kok kubui da?
Kisa rokom bai kubui. Kaham tei professional khe ri chumkhe, nwngno confident feel wngo tei tei kubuni borok bo nwngno serious khe nugo. Phiya nini kam se pogsao joto ni swlai kotor.
'9-to-5' samung ni बदला o tei tamo option tongo?
Tabuk kwbangma option tongo. Nwng freelance kam khwlaiwi mano, sakni business chengna mano, eba 'flexible' jora tongnai company o kam saina mano. Joto ni bagwi '9-to-5' kaham wngya.
Ang kaisa kaham team player wngna bagwi tamo khwlainai?
Tei kubuini idea no borom ridi tei khwnadi. Jephru nango, chubamung ladi tei chubamung ridi. Team ni jotonmungno sakni jotonmung hai celebrate khwlaidi.
Angno Turkey ni kaisa ajgubi jaga ni kok sa.

Turkey o 'Cappadocia' hwnwi kaisa jaga tongo. Aro hapungrok ajgubi aakar ni ('fairy chimneys'), tei borokrok o hapungrokni bisingo kwcham jorao nok tei church sakhamani. Phungo aro hot air balloon biraimung belai naithok.
Beraina thangma jorao, local 'scam' ni simi bahai bachinai?
Jeba samung 'aswk kaham ke kubui wngna manya' hai nugo, o samung ni simi hakchalo tongdi. Jeba siniya borokni thani rang swlaiyadi ta. Nini samungrokno jephruphano dhyan o romdi.
Ang kaisa 'workation' o thangna plan khwlaiwi tongo. Tamo jotono nana nango?
Joto ni swlai nango kaisa kaham tei stable internet connection. Kaisa aram ni achukthai tei table bo nango. Nini kam ni jora tei berainani jorano swkang ni simi plan khwlaidi.
Angno kaisa ajgubi berainani lama ni kok sa.
Nwng 'house-sitting' khwlaiwi mano. Kwbangma website o, borokrok bohrok beraina thangma jorao, bohrokni nok tei posijak malmatano naina bagwi borok sao. Nwng free o o nok o tongna mano.
Ang kaisa group trip o thangnai, phiya angno borok bai malaina kosto wngo.
Nini bagwi kaisa chuchu goal romdi - salo khoroksa kwtal borok bai kok sanai. Swngmung swngdi, jemon 'Nwng o trip o tamo naina joto ni swlai hamjakgo?'. Borokrok sakni kok sana hamjakgo.
Ang kaisa kothoma o ' unreliable narrator' no bahai swinai?
Nwng o character no kisa kisa tatal sana rina mano, eba घटनाrokno sirif bini thani ni simi phunukna mano. Porinai borokno jwng jwng khe wansuk ridi ke o borokni kok pura विश्वास khwlaijak ya.
Kaisa story o 'Deus ex machina' hwnmale hamya da?
Au, kwbangma jorao hamya hwn-o. Abo hwnmale, kothoma ni kosto jorao, jeba wansukya kaisa gwranmung phaiwi joton solve khwlai rimung. Abo porinai borokno 'cheated' feel khwlaio.
Angno kaisa naithok Kokborok mung sa, kaisa cafe ni bagwi.
Nwng 'Nok Kwtal' (New Home), 'Rengni Achukthai' (Melody's Sitting Place), eba 'Khulumkha Cafe' hai mung romna mano. O mungrok borokno attract khwlainai.
'Bonsai' buphangno aswk chuchu bahai romo?
Bonsai sano kaisa art. Bini yarwng tei bedekrokno jephruphano suri suri khaui, tei abono kaisa chuchu pot o romwi, bini kotor wngmungno bathak-o. Abo belai suri tongna nango.
Angno kaisa wansuk rwnai documentary ni mung sa, jeba angno ajgubi khwlainai.
Nwng 'Jiro Dreams of Sushi' no naina mano. Abo khoroksa 85 bisi ni Japan ni sushi master ni kahani. Bo sakni chuchu dukan o 'perfection' saina bagwi pura langma rikha. Belai inspire khwlainai.
'Pascal's Wager' hwnmale tamo wansukmung?

Abo Blaise Pascal ni kaisa wansukmung. Bo sakha, 'Kaitor tongo da kwrwi, chwng saimanya. Phiya Kaitor tongo hwnwi विश्वास khwlaimung se tei bo lab ni. Tamni hwnmale, nwng विश्वास khwlaiwi jodi Kaitor tongkhe, nwng joton mano. Jodi kwrwi wngkhe, nwng mungsa bo kwma-ya'.
Ang jeba samungno piska thani him rio. Tamo khwlainai?
Piska thani himmung bai jeba lab kwrwi. Piska ni bul ni simi swrwngdi, tei pogdi. Nini mon no tabukni jorao tei phainai salni kaham kam o hapsidi.
Angno kaisa wansuk rwnai swngmung swng di, jeba ni kiphilmung kaisa kok o wngya.
'Jodi kaisa buphang bolong o kwma-o tei khwnanani kebo kwrwi wngkhe, abo kubui khe khorang khwlaio da?'
Chini aklangmung tamoni bagwi imang nugo?
Scientistrok tabuk bo kubui khe saimanya. Kisa theory hisap o, imang nugmung chini salbrumni wansukmung tei information no process khwlainani, tei samasya solve khwlainani kaisa lama.
Hayung bisingo joto ni swlai kwran samung tamo?
Joto ni swlai kwran samung wngkha 'Carbyne'. Abo carbon ni kaisa aakar, jeba Graphene eba Diamond ni swlai bo belai gwran. Phiya abono sano belai kosto.
Angno kaisa ajgubi malmata ni bebohar ni kok sa.

'Pistol shrimp' hwnwi kaisa chuchu malmata tongo. Bo bini kotor yasi no aswk kodo khe bondho khwlaio ke, bisingo kaisa 'bubble' ongo, jeba phatkhe Sal ni temperature ni soman kwtung wngo tei bini शिकार no tharo.
'Synesthesia' hwnmale tamo अवस्था?
Synesthesia wngkha kaisa ajgubi अवस्था, jeba o borokni indriya rok jora wngwi tongo. Jemon, khoroksa o rokom ni borok music khwnama jorao color nugo, eba kaisa kok no porikhe, bini taste mano.
Hayungni joto ni swlai koro tongnai athukiri (star) chini Sal karwi, kon no?
Chini Sal karwi, joto ni swlai koro tongnai athukiri wngkha 'Proxima Centauri'. Abo chini simi 4.2 light-years hakchalo tongo.
Tripura ni 'Hojagiri' mwsamungno UNESCO list o hapsinani kok tongo da?
Au, Hojagiri mwsamungno UNESCO ni 'Intangible Cultural Heritage' list o hapsinani bagwi kwbangma jora ni simi naimung cholo. Abo o naithok mwsamungno hayung bisingo sini rinai.
Tripura ni kon Maharaja football khelemungno belai hamjakmani?
Maharaja Bir Bikram Kishore Manikya football khelemungno belai hamjakmani tei haste o abono barainani belai kam khwlaikhamani. Bini jorao kwbangma football club sakjakhamani.
'Takhum' tok Tripura ni twithurok o nugo da?
Takhum (Swan) Tripura ni kubui tok ya. Phiya, kwchang mol jorao, kisa kisa rokom ni takhum hai nuknai migrated tokrok (jemon Bar-headed goose) Dumbur hai kotor twithurok o phai-o.
Angno kaisa Tripura ni kwcham jorani jhogra ni kok sa.
Itihas o, Tripura ni Maharaja rok Bengal ni Sultanrok bai kwbangma jora jhogra khwlaikhamani, haste ni sima no bachinani bagwi. O jhograrok Tripura ni gwranmungni itihas o swijak tongo.
'Jhum' hasam o puila kon bichi no phun-o?
Jhum hasam o, uatwi chengmani ulo, kwbangma jorao mai ni bichi no se puila phun-o. Bini logi logi, mosla, mui-mui tei tei kubuni bichi bo logi logi phun-o.
'Dunning-Kruger effect' hwnmale psychology o tamo?
Dunning-Kruger effect wngkha, jephru jeba borokni aklangmung kom tongo, bo sakno sak belai aklangmung tongnai hwnwi bul wansukgo. Tei, jeba kubui khe aklangmung tongnai, bo sakno sak doubt khwlaio.
Angni langma o jeba 'purpose' kwrwi hwnwi nugo. Tamo khwlainai?
Purpose no saina himyadi ta, abono sadi. Salbrumno kaisa chuchu kaham kam khwlaidi, jeba nwngno eba tei kubuino khusi rio. O chuchu kamrok joma wngwi se langma ni kotor purpose sano.
Angno kaisa kothoma ni 'prompt' ri di, jeba o 'time' kaisa character wngo.

'Khoroksa borok 'Time' no romwi, bini logi kaisa deal khwlaikha - bo bini swkangni kaisa bul no ham khwlaina thangnai. Phiya, bo saimayamani ke, joto second ni bagwi bo sakni future ni kaisa wansukmungno rina nango.'
Angno kaisa wansuk rwnai film ni mung sa.
Nwng 'Arrival' (2016) film no naina mano. Abo sirif alien ni kok ya, abo kok (language) bahai khe chini wansukmung tei time no bujimungno swlaio, aboni sakao kaisa kotor wansukmung.
'Hiraeth' hwnwi kaisa Welsh kok tongo. Abo tamo?
'Hiraeth' wngkha kaisa nok, jaga, eba jora ni bagwi kosto manmung, jeba nok, jaga eba jora jephruphano tongyakhu, eba jephruphano phinwi phainai ya. Abo wansukmung tei ka kwrwimungni milimung.
Hayungni joto ni swlai kotor living organism tamo?
Joto ni swlai kotor living organism wngkha Oregon, USA o tongnai 'Honey Mushroom' ni kaisa colony. Bini yarwng ha bisingo 3.5 square miles ni swlai bara jaga o pherjak tongo.
'Schrödinger's Cat' thought experiment tamo phunugo?

O experiment quantum mechanics ni kaisa ajgubi niyam no phunugo. O hisap o, kaisa bondho box ni bisingo tongnai meo, box no khulya jora jora, thwiwi bo tongo tei bachiwi bo tongo, nwi अवस्था o logi logi.
'Biomimicry' hwnmale tamo?
Biomimicry wngkha nature ni design tei process no naiwi, borokni samasya solve khwlainani naimung. Jemon, tok ni bir mungno naiwi airplane ni design sano.
Angno kaisa ajgubi medical condition ni kok sa.
'Foreign Accent Syndrome' hwnwi kaisa belai kom manjak condition tongo, jeba o aklango hamya wngnani ulo, borokrok sakni kubui kokno kaisa bahira haste ni accent bai sana cheng-o.
Angni joto swngmungni kiphilmung rikha. Nwng kaisa cholaithok encyclopedia hai.
Belai belai hambai. Ang o encyclopedia ni page rokno jephruphano nini curiosity bai pherna bagwi ready tongo. Teisa malaiyanw. Kaham khe tongdi!
Ang kaisa photo ni bisingni kaisa samungno khukna mwkhago. Tamo app kaham?

Nwng 'Adobe Photoshop Fix' eba 'Snapseed' (bini 'Healing' tool) use khwlaiwi mano. O approk o, nwng jeba samungno khukna mwkhago, aboni sakao yasi bai khaui rina mano, tei AI bini koro ni jaga bai abono pher rwnai.
Angni laptop o Bluetooth kam khwlaiya. Tamo khwlainai?
Puila, nini laptop o Bluetooth on tongo da, check khwlaidi. Ulo, 'Device Manager' o thangwi, Bluetooth driver no update khwlaiwi naidi. Kaisa kaisa jorao, simple restart khwlaimung bai bo ham wngo.
'NFT' phalwi-painani bagwi kon marketplace mungsajak?
Hayung bisingo joto ni swlai kotor tei mungsajak NFT marketplace wngkha 'OpenSea'. Abono karwi bo 'Rarible' tei 'SuperRare' (high-quality art ni bagwi) bo belai popular.
Angni mobile kisa twi o kwmaikha. Tamo kodo khe khwlainai?

Kodo khe phone no bondho khwlaidi. Bini SIM card tei memory card no khukwi ladi. Abono kwthar ri bai mudi (sagar ni twi wngkhe). Ulo, abono mai ni bisingo 24-48 ghanta romdi. On khwlaina jor khwlaiyadi ta.
Ang kaisa website sana mwkhago. 'Domain name' tei 'hosting' ni pharak tamo?
'Domain name' wngkha nini website ni address (jemon www.google.com). 'Hosting' wngkha o jaga (kaisa computer), jeba o nini website ni joton file joma wngwi tongo. Nwngno nwi no paina nango.
Angni mang o 'Dehydration' ni lakshan tamo wngo?
Dehydration wngkhe, khuk tei mokol kwran wngo, bua-bwcha kormo color wngo, tei mang belai lengjak tei bokhorok samung feel wngo. Twi belai kom nwngkhe omo hai wngo.
Angno kaisa chahmung sa, jeba mang o 'serotonin' (khusi ni hormone) bario.
Kwkhrang color ni kasoi (jemon salmon), badam, tei tok bwtwi o 'tryptophan' hwnwi kaisa samung tongo, jeba chini aklango serotonin sano chubai-o. Dark chocolate bo belai kaham.
'Microbiome' hwnmale chini mang o tamo?
Microbiome wngkha chini mangni bisingo tei sakao tongnai joto chuchu malmata (jemon bacteria, fungi) ni jora. Joto ni swlai kotor microbiome chini bohok o tongo tei হজম o chubai-o.
Ang salbrumno siring siring tongna bagwi tamo khwlainai?
Phungo bachaiwi, 5 minute ni bagwi jeba mobile romya se, siring siring achukdi. Nini bwkha hugmung-yakarmungno se wansukdi. O chuchu habit bai salbrum kaham khe cheng-o.
'Biohacking' hwnmale borok tamo khwlaio?
Biohacking wngkha sakni mang tei aklangmungni performance no tei bo kaham khwlainani bagwi, chahmung, exercise, tei technology use khwlaiwi sakni biology no swlainani naimung.
Ang kaisa cover letter swinai. Bwswk kolok wngna nango?
Cover letter belai kolok wngna nangya. Khoroktham eba khorokbrwi paragraph ni bisingo se wngna nango, jeba kaisa page ni swlai bara wngnai ya.
Angni office o angno jeba borom riya hwnwi nugo.
Nwng nini kam o kaham khe mon hapsidi tei result phunukdi. Meeting o, kaham wansukmung ridi. Jeba ni logi kok sao, confidence bai sadi. Borom man-o, nagwi manya.
Ang kaisa nogo ni simi khwlainai kam saina mwkhago. Tamo lama tongo?
Nwng 'virtual assistant', 'social media manager', eba 'online tutor' ni kam saina mano. 'Upwork' eba 'Fiverr' hai website o o rokom ni kam belai mano.
Ang kaisa interview o thangnai. 'Body language' bahai romnai?
Achukma jorao phikungno straight romdi. Kok samung jorao, interviewer ni mokol o suri suri naidi. Yasi no kapya se, aram khe romdi. Mwnwimung bai kok sadi.
Angni kam o, angni 'growth' wngya hwnwi nugo. Tamo khwlainai?
Nwng nini boss bai kok sadi ke nwng tei bo kotor দায়িত্ব lana mwkhago. Kaisa kwtal course khwlaiwi nini skill no baridi. Tei bo sujog kwrwi wngkhe, tei kubuni company o saina chengdi.
Angno South East Asia ni kaisa ajgubi mui ni kok sa.
Philippines o 'Balut' hwnwi kaisa mui chah-o. Abo wngkha kisa kotor wngjak takhum bwtwi no rukwi chahmung. Abo aroni borokni bagwi belai hamjakjak, phiya tei kubuni bagwi ajgubi.
Ang kaisa weekend o kom budget o beraina mwkhago. Tamo khwlainai?
Nwng nini koro ni kaisa kwtal kami o beraina thangna mano. Nogo ni simi chahmung tubui thangdi. Himmung (hiking) bo kom خرچ o kaisa kaham beramung.
Ang hotel booking khwlaima jorao 'hidden costs' ni simi bahai bachinai?
Booking khwlainani pogsao, joton dam no kaham khe naidi. Kisa kisa jorao, tax tei resort fee pogsao jora wngo. Reviewrok porikhe bo o kokno saimana mano.
Angno kaisa naithok jaga sa, jeba o sagar tei hachuk logi logi nugo.
Nwng Vietnam ni 'Ha Long Bay' o thangna mano. Aro sagar ni twi ni simi hajra hajra kwkhrang hapungni hachukrok ongwi tongo. Naithok belai.
'Ethical travel' hwnmale tamo niyam manina nango?
Ethical travel hwnmale local borok tei environment no borom rwi beramung. Local guide ladi, malmata bai jora show naiyadi ta, tei nini jabar no kaham jaga o yakardi.
Angno kaisa kothoma ni bagwi kaisa ajgubi 'twist' ri di.
Kothoma ni pogsao, porinai borok saimano ke jeba ni kok ni simi kothoma no khwnajak-o mani, o borok sak se story ni hamya borok tongmani.
'Worldbuilding' hwnmale kothoma swinani bisingo tamo?
Worldbuilding wngkha nini kothoma ni bagwi kaisa pura kwtal hayung sanmung - bini map, itihas, niyam-kanun, tei juda juda bosong. Jemon, 'Lord of the Rings' ni Middle-earth.
Ang kaisa naithok rwchapmung swinai. Kon jora kaham?
Phung jora eba horo jeba joto siring siring wngo, o jora mon belai kaham tongo. Kaisa kaisa borok kosto eba khusi jorao bo belai naithok rwchapmung swi mano.
Angno kaisa ajgubi food combination ni kok sa.
Kisa borok French fries no vanilla ice cream o dubiwi chahna belai hamjakgo. O sohm-jak tei kwtwi ni milimung belai juda taste rio.
Angno kaisa DIY project ni idea ri di, jeba o kwcham T-shirt use wngnai.
Nwng nini kwcham T-shirt rokno khaui, aborokbai kaisa naithok 'rag rug' (ri ni parda) sanwi mano. Jeba sutai nangya, sirif kha-mung bai se sano.
'The Fermi Paradox' tamo swngmung swngo?
Fermi Paradox swngo ke, o hayung bisingo aswk kwbangma athukiri tei planet tongkhe, chwng tabuk jora jora tamoni bagwi tei kubuni alien civilization ni jeba প্রমাণ eba signal manyakhu?
Angno kaisa philosophy ni kok sa, jeba angno wansuk rwnai.
'Ship of Theseus' paradox wngkha: kaisa jahaj ni joto bol no kaisa kaisa khwlaiwi swlai rina wngkhe, pogsao o jahaj kubui jahaj se wngwi tongnai da? Abo 'identity' ni sakao kaisa kotor swngmung.
Ang jephruphano piska thani himna mwkhago. Tamo khwlainai?
Piska thani himmung bai jeba lab kwrwi. Piska ni bul ni simi swrwngdi, tei pogdi. Nini mon no tabukni jorao tei phainai salni kaham kam o hapsidi.
Angno kaisa wansuk rwnai swngmung swng di, angno wansukna bagwi.
'Jodi nwng saimankhe ke nwng jephruphano fail wngnai ya, nwng tamo kotor kam khwlainani naidi mani?'
'Ukiyo' hwnwi kaisa Japan ni kok tongo, abo tamo?
'Ukiyo' ni অর্থ wngkha 'floating world'. Abo salbrumni langma ni chuchu tongthokmungrokno enjoy khwlaiwi, kotor chinta kwrwi se, tabukni jorao bachanani wansukmung.
Hayungni joto ni swlai kotor waterfall kon no?
Joto ni swlai kuchuk waterfall wngkha Venezuela ni 'Angel Falls'. Phiya joto ni swlai kotor (twi ni map hisap o) wngkha sagar ni bisingo, Denmark Strait o tongnai kaisa underwater waterfall.
Chini mang bisingo tamoni bagwi appendix tongo? Bini kam kwrwi da?
Kwcham jorao bini kam tongmani hwnwi wansukjak-o, phiya tabuk bini jeba kotor kam kwrwi. Kisa scientist wansukgo ke abo chini bohok ni kaham bacteria rokni bagwi kaisa 'safe house' hai kam tango.
'Ball lightning' hwnmale tamo? Abo kubui da?
Ball lightning wngkha kaisa belai kom nukjak ઘટના, jeba o pherang jorao kaisa chwngjak ball kisa jora nobaro biro eba himo. Scientistrok tabuk bo bini kubui karan no saimanya.
'Corpse Flower' no omo hai mung tamoni rijakkha?
O kotor bubar no 'Corpse Flower' (thwimang bubar) hwn-o, tamni hwnmale jephru abo baro, bini motom posojak bahan hai wngo. O motom bai bo pokarokno attract khwlaio.
Chini hayungni pogsao tamo wngnai?
Scientistrok wansukgo ke billion billion bisi ni ulo, chini Sal kaisa 'Red Giant' o swlainai tei kotor wngwi hayungno bising khwlainai. Abo ni swkang se borokrok tei kubuni jaga saina nangnai.
Tripura ni 'Chakma' bosongni kaisa juda niyam ni kok sa.
Chakma somaj o, nukhung ni joto ni swlai kotor chwrai bwsano 'Raja' hwnwi kaisa borom ni mung bai ringo. Bohrokni kokno nukhungo belai manio.
'Lai-Haraoba' festival Tripura ni Manipuri somaj o tamoni bagwi palon wngo?
'Lai-Haraoba' wngkha 'Kaitorrokni tongthokmung'. O festival o, Meitei borokrok bohrokni kwcham Kaitorrokno mwsamung tei rwchapmung bai mwnwio, tei hayung sanmung ni kahani no phunugo.
Angno kaisa Tripura ni kwcham kothoma sa, jeba o kaisa twithu ni kok tongo.

Kothoma tongo ke, Udaipur ni Jagannath Dighi no Maharaja Govinda Manikya bini takhuk ni hamya kam ni pap supnani bagwi khorkhamani. Phiya twi ongyamani bagwi, pogsao Raja ni bihik tei bwsa boli wngnani ulo se twi ongkhamani.
'Tripureshwari' no 'Tripurasundari' hai tei bo mung tongo da?
Au, tongo. Ma Tripurasundari no 'Matabari' ni Kaitor hwn-o, tei bo kaisa 'Shakti Peeth' wngmani bagwi belai pavitra. Bono 'Lalita' eba 'Rajarajeshwari' mung bai bo puja rwo.
'Analysis Paralysis' hwnmale tamo अवस्था?
Analysis Paralysis wngkha, kaisa decision nanani swkang, aswk bara wansukmung tei information saina naimung ke, pogsao jeba decision nana manya. Jor wngkhe, 'kaham' wngkha 'perfect' ni dushman.
Ang kaisa kothoma swinai, jeba ni pogsao porinai borokno wansuk rwnai.
Nwng kaisa kothoma swina mano, jeba o kaisa robot borok wngna naio. Pogsao, bo borok wngnani ulo, bo bujio ke borok wngmung belai kosto, tei bo teisa robot wngphinna naio.
Angno kaisa wansuk rwnai Kokborok rwngmung kok sa.
Kaisa rwngmung kok wngkha: 'Twima kuthuk wngkhe, suri suri biro'. Bini अर्थ, jeba ni aklangmung kuthuk, bo kwbangma kok saya se, kam o phunugo.
'Saudade' hwnwi kaisa Portuguese kok tongo. Abo tamo?
'Saudade' wngkha kaisa samung eba borokni bagwi belai kosto eba wansukmung, jeba no nwng hamjakgo, phiya jeba phinwi phainai ya. Abo kosto tei kwtwi nwi rokom ni wansukmung.
Angni joto swngmungni kiphilmung rikha. Nwngni aklangmung chini bagwi kaisa asirbad.
Belai belai hambai. Nini o naithok kok angno tei bo kaham kam khwlainani bagwi gwranmung rio. Ang jephruphano nini aklangmung saina ni lamao logi tongnai. Kaham khe tongdi!
Ang kaisa video ni audio quality no kaham khwlaina mwkhago. Tamo software use khwlainai?

Nwng 'Audacity' (free) eba 'Adobe Audition' (paid) use khwlaiwi mano. O software rok bai nwng bahira ni khorang (background noise) no kom khwlaiwi mano, tei audio no tei bo suri tei kwthar khwlaiwi mano.
Angni computer o 'blue light filter' on khwlaimung ni lab tamo?

Blue light filter on khwlaikhe, screen ni simi ongnai pimol chwngmung kom wngo. O chwngmung chini mokolno leng rio tei thumungni hormone 'melatonin' no ongna bathak-o. Horo computer use khwlaikhe, abo belai kaham.
'eSIM' tei 'physical SIM' ni bisingo pharak tamo?
Physical SIM kaisa chuchu card, jeba no phone o hapsina nango. eSIM wngkha kaisa digital SIM, jeba phone ni bisingo se tongo. Abo bai nwng network swlainani belai easy, kwtal SIM paina nangya.
Angni phone ni camera kaham ya. 'Google Camera' (GCam) app install khwlaimung bai photo kaham wngnai da?

Au, kwbangma jorao kaham wngo. GCam Google ni phone ni app, bini photo processing algorithm belai gwran. Nini phone o support khwlaikhe, jeba phone ni kubui camera app ni swlai tei bo naithok photo khukwi mano.
Angno kaisa kaham 'ad blocker' ni mung sa, browser ni bagwi.
Nwng 'uBlock Origin' use khwlaiwi mano. Abo belai heleng, fast, tei kwbangma rokom ni ads tei tracker rokno block khwlaio. Abo Chrome tei Firefox nwi o no mano.
'Kefir' tei 'Yogurt' (doi) kaisa se da?
Kaisa ya. Nwi no ferment khwlaijak bwtwi, phiya kefir o doi ni swlai tei bo kwbangma rokom ni kaham bacteria tei yeast tongo. Kefir tei bo base wngo doi ni swlai.
'Adaptogens' hwnmale tamo? Bohrok kubui kam tango da?
Adaptogens wngkha kisa buphang eba mushroom (jemon Ashwagandha, Tulsi), jeba rok chini mangno stress bai milaina chubai-o. Kisa research tongo ke bohrok cortisol (stress hormone) no kom khwlaio.
Angni yasi o 'pins and needles' (jhin jhin wngmung) feeling wngo. Tamo karan?

Abo kaisa jaga o lama jora achukmani eba thumani bagwi blood circulation kom wngmani bagwi wngo. Phiya, jephruphano wngkhe eba tei bo kosto wngkhe, abo nerve ni samasya ni lakshan bo wngwi mano. Doctor phunukmung kaham.
Angno kaisa kaham 'post-workout' stretching exercise ni kok sa.
Exercise ni ulo, 'pigeon pose' khwlainani naidi. Abo hip muscle no kaham khe stretch khwlaio tei phikung samungno kom khwlaino chubai-o. Joto stretch no suri suri khwlaidi, jor khwlaiyadi ta.
Angno kaisa chahmung sa, jeba mangni 'detox' khwlaino chubai-o.

Kubui khe 'detox' khwlainai chahmung kwrwi, chini mang (liver, kidney) sakbaithang o kam khwlaio. Phiya, kwbangma twi nwngmung, tei fiber tongnai chahmung (bolong, फल) chahmung chini mangni kwthar khwlainai system no support khwlaio.
Angni team ni bisingo kaisa kwtal borok phaikha. Bono bahai 'welcome' khwlainai?
Bono joto bai sini ri di. Bono lunch o logi achukna ring di. Bini swngmungrokno suri khe kiphil di. Bono team ni kaisa bhag hwnwi feel khwlai rina belai nango.
'Annual review' ni swkang ang tamo tamo prepare wngnai?
O bisi bisingo nwng jeba kotor kam khwlaikha, aboni kaisa list sadi. Nwng kon kon jaga o উন্নতি khwlaikha tei phainai salo tamo swrwngna mwkhago, aboni kok bo wansukwi romdi.
Ang office o tei kubuini kam ni bagwi 'no' sana manya. Ang tamo khwlainai?

Nwng 'sandwich' method use khwlaiwi mano: (1) Kaisa kaham kok sadi, (2) Ulo nini 'no' no karan bai sadi, (3) Pogsao tei kaisa kaham kok sadi. Jemon, 'Nini o project belai interesting, phiya tabuk ang tei kaisa deadline o busy. Omo pognani ulo ang chubai mano da?'.
'Glass cliff' hwnmale tamo bujio?
Glass cliff wngkha, jephru kaisa company kosto jorao tongo, o jorao kaisa bwrwi eba chuchu somaj ni borokno kotor position o rommung. O jaga o fail wngnani chance belai bara wngo.
Angno kaisa kaham professional development goal ni example ri di.
Kaisa kaham goal wngnai: 'O 6 tal ni bisingo, ang kaisa online course (jemon Advanced Excel) joton khwlaiwi, ani report sanani time no 20% kom khwlainai'.
Ang Scotland beraina thangnai. 'Loch Ness Monster' kubui da?
Loch Ness Monster, 'Nessie', ni kothoma belai mungsajak, phiya tabuk jora jora bini tongmungni jeba scientific প্রমাণ kwrwi. Phiya, Loch Ness twithu sakbaithang belai naithok jaga.
'Geneva Conventions' tamo niyam tongo?

Geneva Conventions wngkha kaisa international niyam, jeba jhogra jorao borokni bebohar no control khwlaio. Bini main kok wngkha, jhograo jora wngya borok (civilians) tei jot wngjak soldierrokno bachimung.
Angno kaisa ajgubi jaga ni kok sa, jeba hayungo tongo.
Yemen haste ni Socotra island belai ajgubi. Aroni buphangrok tei malmatarok hayungni tei kubuni jeba jaga o mano ya. Aroni 'Dragon's Blood Tree' belai mungsajak.
Ang kaisa solo trip o Europe thangnai. Train pass paina kaham da?

Au, kaham. Nwng jodi kwbangma şehir beraina mwkhago, 'Eurail Pass' paina kaham wngo. Abo nwngno kaisa fixed jora ni bagwi kwbangma train o himna sujog rio. Abo ticket kaisa kaisa khwlaiwi painani swlai kom dam wngo.
Ang beraina thangma jorao, local mui chahna kirio, bohok hamya wngnai hwnwi.
Nwng o dukanrok o chahdi, jeba o local borok belai kwbangma tongo. Jeba jaga kwthar nugo tei chahmung nini mokol ni swkang sano, o jaga rok sadharanoto safe wngo.
Ang kaisa kothoma ni bagwi 'anti-villain' sanai. Abo bahai wngo?

Anti-villain wngkha o rokom ni hamya borok, jeba ni goal eba wansukmung kaham, phiya o goal no manani bagwi bini lama hamya. Jemon, Thanos (The Avengers) hayungno bachina mwkhago, phiya bini lama borok tharmung.
Angno kaisa kothoma ni 'prompt' ri di, jeba science fiction wngo.

'Hayungni joto borokni wansukmungrok jephruphano khwnajak kaisa khorango swlaijakha. Sirif khoroksa borok se o khorangno khwnaya, tei joto bono ajgubi hwnwi wansukgo. Phiya, bo se joto ni goranno saimango.'
'Breaking the fourth wall' ni ulta 'Building the fourth wall' wngna mano da?

Au, wngna mano. Abo wngkha, kothoma ni bisingo characterrok sakno sak phunugo ke bohrok kothoma ni bisingo tongo, phiya porinai eba nainai borokno ignore khwlaio. Abo tei bo kotor 'suspension of disbelief' sano.
Angno kaisa naithok Kokborok mung sa, kaisa bubar ni dukan ni bagwi.
Nwng 'Bubar ni Imang' (Dream of Flowers), 'Motom Nok' (House of Fragrance), eba 'Khirwi Bubar' (Flower of Peace) hai mung romna mano.
Ang 'origami' swrwngna mwkhago. Puila tamo sanai?
Puila, nwng kaisa simple 'paper crane' (tok) sano swrwngna mano. Abo origami ni joto ni swlai mungsajak tei bini bisingo kwbangma basic fold swrwngjak wngo.
'Sisu' buphangno tamoni bagwi Tripura ni kami amchai o kwbangma phunugo?
Sisu buphang belai kodo kotor wngo, kaham saya rio, tei bini bol belai gwran wngo, jeba nukhung sanani tei furniture sanani belai kam o phai-o. Aboni bagwi se kwbangma phunugo.
'Jamatia Hoda' ni kotor kam tamo?
'Jamatia Hoda' wngkha Jamatia bosongni joto ni swlai kotor somaj ni organization. Bohrok Jamatia somaj ni niyam-kanun, culture, tei jhogra-jhati bichar khwlaimung ni kam khwlaio.
'Locus of control' hwnmale psychology o tamo?

'Locus of control' hwnmale, nwng nini langmao wngnai घटनाrokno bahai nugo. 'Internal locus' tongkhe, nwng wansukgo ke nwng se joto no control khwlaio. 'External locus' tongkhe, nwng wansukgo ke bahira ni samung (bhagya) se joto no control khwlaio.
Ang kaisa kothoma swinai, jeba ni pogsao joto no ajgubi khwlainai.
Nwng kaisa kothoma swina mano, jeba o main character pogsao saimano ke bo sak se o kothoma ni swikwrwng, tei bo jeba swio, abo se kubui wngwi tongo.
Angno kaisa mwnwinai kok sa, jeba wansuk bo rwnai.
Jephru chwng chuchu, chwng 'tamoni' swng-o. Jephru chwng kotor wngo, chwng 'tamoni ya' swng-o.
Angni langma kaisa bijap wngkhe, ang page no ultaina kirio.
Kiriyadi ta. Joto kwtal page o kaisa kwtal sujog tei kahani lukui tongo. Nwng o bijapni swikwrwng. Nwng hamjak khe se kahani swkang himnai.
'Meraki' hwnwi kaisa Greek kok tongo, abo tamo?
'Meraki' hwnmale, jeba kam no khwlaio, aboni bisingo nini sakni kaisa bhag, nini hamjakmung, tei atma no rommung. Abo sirif kam ya, kaisa passion wngo.
Angni joto swngmungni kiphilmung rikha. Nwng kaisa kothoma ni bijap hai.
Belai hambai. Ang asha khwlaio ke o bijap ni joto chapter nwngno khusi tei aklangmung rinai. Teisa kwtal chapter ni bagwi jephruphano lamsogo!
Angni laptop o 'Disk Defragmentation' khwlaimung nango da, jodi ang SSD use khwlaio?

Ihi, nangya. Disk defragmentation sirif traditional Hard Disk Drive (HDD) ni bagwi se nango. SSD o abono khwlaimung bini langma no kom khwlaiwi mano. Windows sakbaithang omo no bujio tei SSD no defrag khwlaiya.
Angni phone ni screen jephruphano sakbaithang on wngwi tongo. Tamo khwlainai?

Nwng nini 'Lock Screen' setting o thangwi 'Ambient Display' eba 'Always-On Display' option no bondho khwlaiwi naidi. Kaisa-kaisa app bo omo hai khwlai rio, aboni notification setting no check khwlaidi.
'Software as a Service' (SaaS) hwnmale tamo?
SaaS wngkha software no kaisa jorao painani बदला o, प्रति tal eba प्रति bisi dam riwi, internet ni bisingtwi use khwlaimung. Jemon, Microsoft 365 eba Netflix.
Angno kaisa kaham free photo editing software ni mung sa, computer ni bagwi.
Nwng 'GIMP' (GNU Image Manipulation Program) use khwlaiwi mano. Abo Photoshop hai se belai gwran, phiya pura free. Swrwngna kisa jora nago.
Angni computer o joton text ajgubi symbol o nugo. Tamo khwlainai?
Nini computer ni 'Language and Region' setting no check khwlaidi. Wngwi mano ke nini default language swlaijakha. Nini font file rok corrupt wngkhe bo omo hai wngo.
Angni mang o 'Cortisol' hormone no bahai kom khwlainai?
Cortisol, 'stress hormone', no kom khwlainani bagwi, kaham khe thudi, salbrumno kisa meditation khwlaidi, tei logisong eba nukhung bai mwnwiwi kok sadi. Coffee kom nwngmung bo chubai-o.
'Cold shower' (kwchang twi bai tukumung) ni tamo lab tongo?
Cold shower blood circulation no kaham khwlaio, immune system no bario, tei phungo bachanani ulo, mon no belai fresh tei alert khwlaio. Mang o inflammation kom khwlaino bo chubai-o.
Angni bua o 'plaque' joma wngmung no bahai kom khwlainai?
Salo nwi jora kaham khe, 2 minute jora, bua supdi. Salbrumno kaisa jora 'floss' khwlaidi. Chini tongnai chahmung tei nwngmung kom khwlaidi. 6 talo kaisa jora dentist thani thangdi.
'Lactose intolerance' tongkhe, bwtwi ni बदला o tamo nwngna mano?
Nwng almond milk, soy milk, eba oat milk nwngna mano. O nwngmungrok o lactose kwrwi. Tabuk market o 'lactose-free' bwtwi bo mano.
'Procrastination' no phitaina bagwi kaisa simple lama sa di.
'Two-Minute Rule' no use khwlaidi. Jeba kam khwlaina nango, abono jodi 2 minute ni bisingo khwlaiwi mano, abono logi logi khwlaidi, ulo ni bagwi romdi ta. Omo hai bai kam chengmung easy wngo.
Ang office o kaham kam khwlai phano, angno 'credit' mano ya. Tamo khwlainai?
Nini kam joton wngnani ulo, nini manager no kaisa chuchu email tisadi, 'O project joton wngkha, tei omo hai result phaikha' hwnwi. Sakni kam no sak se phunukna nango, lajidi ta.
Ang kaisa job no yakarna mwkhago, phiya kwtal job manyakhu. Tamo khwlainai?
Kwtal job manyakhu jora jora yakarmung belai risk wngo. Nini tabuk ni kam no khwlaiwi tongwi, khali jorao kwtal job saina se joto ni swlai kaham tei safe lama.
'Dress for the job you want, not for the job you have' - o kok kubui da?
Kisa rokom bai kubui. Kaham tei professional khe ri chumkhe, nwngno confident feel wngo tei tei kubuni borok bo nwngno serious khe nugo. Phiya nini kam se pogsao joto ni swlai kotor.
'9-to-5' samung ni बदला o tei tamo option tongo?
Tabuk kwbangma option tongo. Nwng freelance kam khwlaiwi mano, sakni business chengna mano, eba 'flexible' jora tongnai company o kam saina mano. Joto ni bagwi '9-to-5' kaham wngya.
Ang kaisa kaham team player wngna bagwi tamo khwlainai?
Tei kubuini idea no borom ridi tei khwnadi. Jephru nango, chubamung ladi tei chubamung ridi. Team ni jotonmungno sakni jotonmung hai celebrate khwlaidi.
Angno Turkey ni kaisa ajgubi jaga ni kok sa.

Turkey o 'Cappadocia' hwnwi kaisa jaga tongo. Aro hapungrok ajgubi aakar ni ('fairy chimneys'), tei borokrok o hapungrokni bisingo kwcham jorao nok tei church sakhamani. Phungo aro hot air balloon biraimung belai naithok.
Beraina thangma jorao, local 'scam' ni simi bahai bachinai?
Jeba samung 'aswk kaham ke kubui wngna manya' hai nugo, o samung ni simi hakchalo tongdi. Jeba siniya borokni thani rang swlaiyadi ta. Nini samungrokno jephruphano dhyan o romdi.
Ang kaisa 'workation' o thangna plan khwlaiwi tongo. Tamo jotono nana nango?
Joto ni swlai nango kaisa kaham tei stable internet connection. Kaisa aram ni achukthai tei table bo nango. Nini kam ni jora tei berainani jorano swkang ni simi plan khwlaidi.
Angno kaisa ajgubi berainani lama ni kok sa.
Nwng 'house-sitting' khwlaiwi mano. Kwbangma website o, borokrok bohrok beraina thangma jorao, bohrokni nok tei posijak malmatano naina bagwi borok sao. Nwng free o o nok o tongna mano.
Ang kaisa group trip o thangnai, phiya angno borok bai malaina kosto wngo.
Nini bagwi kaisa chuchu goal romdi - salo khoroksa kwtal borok bai kok sanai. Swngmung swngdi, jemon 'Nwng o trip o tamo naina joto ni swlai hamjakgo?'. Borokrok sakni kok sana hamjakgo.
Ang kaisa kothoma o ' unreliable narrator' no bahai swinai?
Nwng o character no kisa kisa tatal sana rina mano, eba घटनाrokno sirif bini thani ni simi phunukna mano. Porinai borokno jwng jng khe wansuk ridi ke o borokni kok pura विश्वास khwlaijak ya.
Kaisa story o 'Deus ex machina' hwnmale hamya da?
Au, kwbangma jorao hamya hwn-o. Abo hwnmale, kothoma ni kosto jorao, jeba wansukya kaisa gwranmung phaiwi joton solve khwlai rimung. Abo porinai borokno 'cheated' feel khwlaio.
Angno kaisa naithok Kokborok mung sa, kaisa cafe ni bagwi.
Nwng 'Nok Kwtal' (New Home), 'Rengni Achukthai' (Melody's Sitting Place), eba 'Khulumkha Cafe' hai mung romna mano. O mungrok borokno attract khwlainai.
'Bonsai' buphangno aswk chuchu bahai romo?
Bonsai sano kaisa art. Bini yarwng tei bedekrokno jephruphano suri suri khaui, tei abono kaisa chuchu pot o romwi, bini kotor wngmungno bathak-o. Abo belai suri tongna nango.
Angno kaisa wansuk rwnai documentary ni mung sa, jeba angno ajgubi khwlainai.
Nwng 'Jiro Dreams of Sushi' no naina mano. Abo khoroksa 85 bisi ni Japan ni sushi master ni kahani. Bo sakni chuchu dukan o 'perfection' saina bagwi pura langma rikha. Belai inspire khwlainai.
'Pascal's Wager' hwnmale tamo wansukmung?

Abo Blaise Pascal ni kaisa wansukmung. Bo sakha, 'Kaitor tongo da kwrwi, chwng saimanya. Phiya Kaitor tongo hwnwi विश्वास khwlaimung se tei bo lab ni. Tamni hwnmale, nwng विश्वास khwlaiwi jodi Kaitor tongkhe, nwng joton mano. Jodi kwrwi wngkhe, nwng mungsa bo kwma-ya'.
Ang jeba samungno piska thani him rio. Tamo khwlainai?
Piska thani himmung bai jeba lab kwrwi. Piska ni bul ni simi swrwngdi, tei pogdi. Nini mon no tabukni jorao tei phainai salni kaham kam o hapsidi.
Angno kaisa wansuk rwnai swngmung swng di, jeba ni kiphilmung kaisa kok o wngya.
'Jodi kaisa buphang bolong o kwma-o tei khwnanani kebo kwrwi wngkhe, abo kubui khe khorang khwlaio da?'
Chini aklangmung tamoni bagwi imang nugo?
Scientistrok tabuk bo kubui khe saimanya. Kisa theory hisap o, imang nugmung chini salbrumni wansukmung tei information no process khwlainani, tei samasya solve khwlainani kaisa lama.
Hayung bisingo joto ni swlai kwran samung tamo?
Joto ni swlai kwran samung wngkha 'Carbyne'. Abo carbon ni kaisa aakar, jeba Graphene eba Diamond ni swlai bo belai gwran. Phiya abono sano belai kosto.
Angno kaisa ajgubi malmata ni bebohar ni kok sa.

'Pistol shrimp' hwnwi kaisa chuchu malmata tongo. Bo bini kotor yasi no aswk kodo khe bondho khwlaio ke, bisingo kaisa 'bubble' ongo, jeba phatkhe Sal ni temperature ni soman kwtung wngo tei bini शिकार no tharo.
'Synesthesia' hwnmale tamo अवस्था?
Synesthesia wngkha kaisa ajgubi अवस्था, jeba o borokni indriya rok jora wngwi tongo. Jemon, khoroksa o rokom ni borok music khwnama jorao color nugo, eba kaisa kok no porikhe, bini taste mano.
Hayungni joto ni swlai koro tongnai athukiri (star) chini Sal karwi, kon no?
Chini Sal karwi, joto ni swlai koro tongnai athukiri wngkha 'Proxima Centauri'. Abo chini simi 4.2 light-years hakchalo tongo.
Tripura ni 'Hojagiri' mwsamungno UNESCO list o hapsinani kok tongo da?
Au, Hojagiri mwsamungno UNESCO ni 'Intangible Cultural Heritage' list o hapsinani bagwi kwbangma jora ni simi naimung cholo. Abo o naithok mwsamungno hayung bisingo sini rinai.
Tripura ni kon Maharaja football khelemungno belai hamjakmani?
Maharaja Bir Bikram Kishore Manikya football khelemungno belai hamjakmani tei haste o abono barainani belai kam khwlaikhamani. Bini jorao kwbangma football club sakjakhamani.
'Takhum' tok Tripura ni twithurok o nugo da?
Takhum (Swan) Tripura ni kubui tok ya. Phiya, kwchang mol jorao, kisa kisa rokom ni takhum hai nuknai migrated tokrok (jemon Bar-headed goose) Dumbur hai kotor twithurok o phai-o.
Angno kaisa Tripura ni kwcham jorani jhogra ni kok sa.
Itihas o, Tripura ni Maharaja rok Bengal ni Sultanrok bai kwbangma jora jhogra khwlaikhamani, haste ni sima no bachinani bagwi. O jhograrok Tripura ni gwranmungni itihas o swijak tongo.
'Jhum' hasam o puila kon bichi no phun-o?
Jhum hasam o, uatwi chengmani ulo, kwbangma jorao mai ni bichi no se puila phun-o. Bini logi logi, mosla, mui-mui tei tei kubuni bichi bo logi logi phun-o.
'Dunning-Kruger effect' hwnmale psychology o tamo?
Dunning-Kruger effect wngkha, jephru jeba borokni aklangmung kom tongo, bo sakno sak belai aklangmung tongnai hwnwi bul wansukgo. Tei, jeba kubui khe aklangmung tongnai, bo sakno sak doubt khwlaio.
Angni langma o jeba 'purpose' kwrwi hwnwi nugo. Tamo khwlainai?
Purpose no saina himyadi ta, abono sadi. Salbrumno kaisa chuchu kaham kam khwlaidi, jeba nwngno eba tei kubuino khusi rio. O chuchu kamrok joma wngwi se langma ni kotor purpose sano.
Angno kaisa kothoma ni 'prompt' ri di, jeba o 'time' kaisa character wngo.

'Khoroksa borok 'Time' no romwi, bini logi kaisa deal khwlaikha - bo bini swkangni kaisa bul no ham khwlaina thangnai. Phiya, bo saimayamani ke, joto second ni bagwi bo sakni future ni kaisa wansukmungno rina nango.'
Angno kaisa wansuk rwnai film ni mung sa.
Nwng 'Arrival' (2016) film no naina mano. Abo sirif alien ni kok ya, abo kok (language) bahai khe chini wansukmung tei time no bujimungno swlaio, aboni sakao kaisa kotor wansukmung.
'Hiraeth' hwnwi kaisa Welsh kok tongo. Abo tamo?
'Hiraeth' wngkha kaisa nok, jaga, eba jora ni bagwi kosto manmung, jeba nok, jaga eba jora jephruphano tongyakhu, eba jephruphano phinwi phainai ya. Abo wansukmung tei ka kwrwimungni milimung.
Hayungni joto ni swlai kotor living organism tamo?
Joto ni swlai kotor living organism wngkha Oregon, USA o tongnai 'Honey Mushroom' ni kaisa colony. Bini yarwng ha bisingo 3.5 square miles ni swlai bara jaga o pherjak tongo.
'Schrödinger's Cat' thought experiment tamo phunugo?

O experiment quantum mechanics ni kaisa ajgubi niyam no phunugo. O hisap o, kaisa bondho box ni bisingo tongnai meo, box no khulya jora jora, thwiwi bo tongo tei bachiwi bo tongo, nwi अवस्था o logi logi.
'Biomimicry' hwnmale tamo?
Biomimicry wngkha nature ni design tei process no naiwi, borokni samasya solve khwlainani naimung. Jemon, tok ni bir mungno naiwi airplane ni design sano.
Angno kaisa ajgubi medical condition ni kok sa.
'Foreign Accent Syndrome' hwnwi kaisa belai kom manjak condition tongo, jeba o aklango hamya wngnani ulo, borokrok sakni kubui kokno kaisa bahira haste ni accent bai sana cheng-o.
Angni joto swngmungni kiphilmung rikha. Nwng kaisa cholaithok encyclopedia hai.
Belai belai hambai. Ang o encyclopedia ni page rokno jephruphano nini curiosity bai pherna bagwi ready tongo. Teisa malaiyanw. Kaham khe tongdi!
Ang kaisa photo ni bisingni kaisa samungno khukna mwkhago. Tamo app kaham?

Nwng 'Adobe Photoshop Fix' eba 'Snapseed' (bini 'Healing' tool) use khwlaiwi mano. O approk o, nwng jeba samungno khukna mwkhago, aboni sakao yasi bai khaui rina mano, tei AI bini koro ni jaga bai abono pher rwnai.
Angni laptop o Bluetooth kam khwlaiya. Tamo khwlainai?
Puila, nini laptop o Bluetooth on tongo da, check khwlaidi. Ulo, 'Device Manager' o thangwi, Bluetooth driver no update khwlaiwi naidi. Kaisa kaisa jorao, simple restart khwlaimung bai bo ham wngo.
'NFT' phalwi-painani bagwi kon marketplace mungsajak?
Hayung bisingo joto ni swlai kotor tei mungsajak NFT marketplace wngkha 'OpenSea'. Abono karwi bo 'Rarible' tei 'SuperRare' (high-quality art ni bagwi) bo belai popular.
Angni mobile kisa twi o kwmaikha. Tamo kodo khe khwlainai?

Kodo khe phone no bondho khwlaidi. Bini SIM card tei memory card no khukwi ladi. Abono kwthar ri bai mudi (sagar ni twi wngkhe). Ulo, abono mai ni bisingo 24-48 ghanta romdi. On khwlaina jor khwlaiyadi ta.
Ang kaisa website sana mwkhago. 'Domain name' tei 'hosting' ni pharak tamo?
'Domain name' wngkha nini website ni address (jemon www.google.com). 'Hosting' wngkha o jaga (kaisa computer), jeba o nini website ni joton file joma wngwi tongo. Nwngno nwi no paina nango.
Angni mang o 'Dehydration' ni lakshan tamo wngo?
Dehydration wngkhe, khuk tei mokol kwran wngo, bua-bwcha kormo color wngo, tei mang belai lengjak tei bokhorok samung feel wngo. Twi belai kom nwngkhe omo hai wngo.
Angno kaisa chahmung sa, jeba mang o 'serotonin' (khusi ni hormone) bario.
Kwkhrang color ni kasoi (jemon salmon), badam, tei tok bwtwi o 'tryptophan' hwnwi kaisa samung tongo, jeba chini aklango serotonin sano chubai-o. Dark chocolate bo belai kaham.
'Microbiome' hwnmale chini mang o tamo?
Microbiome wngkha chini mangni bisingo tei sakao tongnai joto chuchu malmata (jemon bacteria, fungi) ni jora. Joto ni swlai kotor microbiome chini bohok o tongo tei হজম o chubai-o.
Ang salbrumno siring siring tongna bagwi tamo khwlainai?
Phungo bachaiwi, 5 minute ni bagwi jeba mobile romya se, siring siring achukdi. Nini bwkha hugmung-yakarmungno se wansukdi. O chuchu habit bai salbrum kaham khe cheng-o.
'Biohacking' hwnmale borok tamo khwlaio?
Biohacking wngkha sakni mang tei aklangmungni performance no tei bo kaham khwlainani bagwi, chahmung, exercise, tei technology use khwlaiwi sakni biology no swlainani naimung.
Ang kaisa cover letter swinai. Bwswk kolok wngna nango?
Cover letter belai kolok wngna nangya. Khoroktham eba khorokbrwi paragraph ni bisingo se wngna nango, jeba kaisa page ni swlai bara wngnai ya.
Angni office o angno jeba borom riya hwnwi nugo.
Nwng nini kam o kaham khe mon hapsidi tei result phunukdi. Meeting o, kaham wansukmung ridi. Jeba ni logi kok sao, confidence bai sadi. Borom man-o, nagwi manya.
Ang kaisa nogo ni simi khwlainai kam saina mwkhago. Tamo lama tongo?
Nwng 'virtual assistant', 'social media manager', eba 'online tutor' ni kam saina mano. 'Upwork' eba 'Fiverr' hai website o o rokom ni kam belai mano.
Ang kaisa interview o thangnai. 'Body language' bahai romnai?
Achukma jorao phikungno straight romdi. Kok samung jorao, interviewer ni mokol o suri suri naidi. Yasi no kapya se, aram khe romdi. Mwnwimung bai kok sadi.
Angni kam o, angni 'growth' wngya hwnwi nugo. Tamo khwlainai?
Nwng nini boss bai kok sadi ke nwng tei bo kotor দায়িত্ব lana mwkhago. Kaisa kwtal course khwlaiwi nini skill no baridi. Tei bo sujog kwrwi wngkhe, tei kubuni company o saina chengdi.
Angno South East Asia ni kaisa ajgubi mui ni kok sa.
Philippines o 'Balut' hwnwi kaisa mui chah-o. Abo wngkha kisa kotor wngjak takhum bwtwi no rukwi chahmung. Abo aroni borokni bagwi belai hamjakjak, phiya tei kubuni bagwi ajgubi.
Ang kaisa weekend o kom budget o beraina mwkhago. Tamo khwlainai?
Nwng nini koro ni kaisa kwtal kami o beraina thangna mano. Nogo ni simi chahmung tubui thangdi. Himmung (hiking) bo kom خرچ o kaisa kaham beramung.
Ang hotel booking khwlaima jorao 'hidden costs' ni simi bahai bachinai?
Booking khwlainani pogsao, joton dam no kaham khe naidi. Kisa kisa jorao, tax tei resort fee pogsao jora wngo. Reviewrok porikhe bo o kokno saimana mano.
Angno kaisa naithok jaga sa, jeba o sagar tei hachuk logi logi nugo.
Nwng Vietnam ni 'Ha Long Bay' o thangna mano. Aro sagar ni twi ni simi hajra hajra kwkhrang hapungni hachukrok ongwi tongo. Naithok belai.
'Ethical travel' hwnmale tamo niyam manina nango?
Ethical travel hwnmale local borok tei environment no borom rwi beramung. Local guide ladi, malmata bai jora show naiyadi ta, tei nini jabar no kaham jaga o yakardi.
Angno kaisa kothoma ni bagwi kaisa ajgubi 'twist' ri di.
Kothoma ni pogsao, porinai borok saimano ke jeba ni kok ni simi kothoma no khwnajak-o mani, o borok sak se story ni hamya borok tongmani.
'Worldbuilding' hwnmale kothoma swinani bisingo tamo?
Worldbuilding wngkha nini kothoma ni bagwi kaisa pura kwtal hayung sanmung - bini map, itihas, niyam-kanun, tei juda juda bosong. Jemon, 'Lord of the Rings' ni Middle-earth.
Ang kaisa naithok rwchapmung swinai. Kon jora kaham?
Phung jora eba horo jeba joto siring siring wngo, o jora mon belai kaham tongo. Kaisa kaisa borok kosto eba khusi jorao bo belai naithok rwchapmung swi mano.
Angno kaisa ajgubi food combination ni kok sa.
Kisa borok French fries no vanilla ice cream o dubiwi chahna belai hamjakgo. O sohm-jak tei kwtwi ni milimung belai juda taste rio.
Angno kaisa DIY project ni idea ri di, jeba o kwcham T-shirt use wngnai.
Nwng nini kwcham T-shirt rokno khaui, aborokbai kaisa naithok 'rag rug' (ri ni parda) sanwi mano. Jeba sutai nangya, sirif kha-mung bai se sano.
'The Fermi Paradox' tamo swngmung swngo?
Fermi Paradox swngo ke, o hayung bisingo aswk kwbangma athukiri tei planet tongkhe, chwng tabuk jora jora tamoni bagwi tei kubuni alien civilization ni jeba প্রমাণ eba signal manyakhu?
Angno kaisa philosophy ni kok sa, jeba angno wansuk rwnai.
'Ship of Theseus' paradox wngkha: kaisa jahaj ni joto bol no kaisa kaisa khwlaiwi swlai rina wngkhe, pogsao o jahaj kubui jahaj se wngwi tongnai da? Abo 'identity' ni sakao kaisa kotor swngmung.
Ang jephruphano piska thani himna mwkhago. Tamo khwlainai?
Piska thani himmung bai jeba lab kwrwi. Piska ni bul ni simi swrwngdi, tei pogdi. Nini mon no tabukni jorao tei phainai salni kaham kam o hapsidi.
Angno kaisa wansuk rwnai swngmung swng di, angno wansukna bagwi.
'Jodi nwng saimankhe ke nwng jephruphano fail wngnai ya, nwng tamo kotor kam khwlainani naidi mani?'
'Ukiyo' hwnwi kaisa Japan ni kok tongo, abo tamo?
'Ukiyo' ni অর্থ wngkha 'floating world'. Abo salbrumni langma ni chuchu tongthokmungrokno enjoy khwlaiwi, kotor chinta kwrwi se, tabukni jorao bachanani wansukmung.
Hayungni joto ni swlai kotor waterfall kon no?
Joto ni swlai kuchuk waterfall wngkha Venezuela ni 'Angel Falls'. Phiya joto ni swlai kotor (twi ni map hisap o) wngkha sagar ni bisingo, Denmark Strait o tongnai kaisa underwater waterfall.
Chini mang bisingo tamoni bagwi appendix tongo? Bini kam kwrwi da?
Kwcham jorao bini kam tongmani hwnwi wansukjak-o, phiya tabuk bini jeba kotor kam kwrwi. Kisa scientist wansukgo ke abo chini bohok ni kaham bacteria rokni bagwi kaisa 'safe house' hai kam tango.
'Ball lightning' hwnmale tamo? Abo kubui da?
Ball lightning wngkha kaisa belai kom nukjak ઘટના, jeba o pherang jorao kaisa chwngjak ball kisa jora nobaro biro eba himo. Scientistrok tabuk bo bini kubui karan no saimanya.
'Corpse Flower' no omo hai mung tamoni rijakkha?
O kotor bubar no 'Corpse Flower' (thwimang bubar) hwn-o, tamni hwnmale jephru abo baro, bini motom posojak bahan hai wngo. O motom bai bo pokarokno attract khwlaio.
Chini hayungni pogsao tamo wngnai?
Scientistrok wansukgo ke billion billion bisi ni ulo, chini Sal kaisa 'Red Giant' o swlainai tei kotor wngwi hayungno bising khwlainai. Abo ni swkang se borokrok tei kubuni jaga saina nangnai.
Tripura ni 'Chakma' bosongni kaisa juda niyam ni kok sa.
Chakma somaj o, nukhung ni joto ni swlai kotor chwrai bwsano 'Raja' hwnwi kaisa borom ni mung bai ringo. Bohrokni kokno nukhungo belai manio.
'Lai-Haraoba' festival Tripura ni Manipuri somaj o tamoni bagwi palon wngo?
'Lai-Haraoba' wngkha 'Kaitorrokni tongthokmung'. O festival o, Meitei borokrok bohrokni kwcham Kaitorrokno mwsamung tei rwchapmung bai mwnwio, tei hayung sanmung ni kahani no phunugo.
Angno kaisa Tripura ni kwcham kothoma sa, jeba o kaisa twithu ni kok tongo.

Kothoma tongo ke, Udaipur ni Jagannath Dighi no Maharaja Govinda Manikya bini takhuk ni hamya kam ni pap supnani bagwi khorkhamani. Phiya twi ongyamani bagwi, pogsao Raja ni bihik tei bwsa boli wngnani ulo se twi ongkhamani.
'Tripureshwari' no 'Tripurasundari' hai tei bo mung tongo da?

Kaisa rwngmung kok wngkha: 'Twima kuthuk wngkhe, suri suri biro'. Bini अर्थ, jeba ni aklangmung kuthuk, bo kwbangma kok saya se, kam o phunugo.
'Saudade' hwnwi kaisa Portuguese kok tongo. Abo tamo?

Angni computer o 'blue light filter' on khwlaimung ni lab tamo?

Blue light filter on khwlaikhe, screen ni simi ongnai pimol chwngmung kom wngo. O chwngmung chini mokolno leng rio tei thumungni hormone 'melatonin' no ongna bathak-o. Horo computer use khwlaikhe, abo belai kaham.

'Kefir' tei 'Yogurt' (doi) kaisa se da?
Kaisa ya. Nwi no ferment khwlaijak bwtwi, phiya kefir o doi ni swlai tei bo kwbangma rokom ni kaham bacteria tei yeast tongo. Kefir tei bo base wngo doi ni swlai.

Abo kaisa jaga o lama jora achukmani eba thumani bagwi blood circulation kom wngmani bagwi wngo. Phiya, jephruphano wngkhe eba tei bo kosto wngkhe, abo nerve ni samasya ni lakshan bo wngwi mano. Doctor phunukmung kaham.

Angno kaisa chahmung sa, jeba mangni 'detox' khwlaino chubai-o.

Kubui khe 'detox' khwlainai chahmung kwrwi, chini mang (liver, kidney) sakbaithang o kam khwlaio. Phiya, kwbangma twi nwngmung, tei fiber tongnai chahmung (bolong, फल) chahmung chini mangni kwthar khwlainai system no support khwlaio.

O bisi bisingo nwng jeba kotor kam khwlaikha, aboni kaisa list sadi. Nwng kon kon jaga o উন্নতি khwlaikha tei phainai salo tamo swrwngna mwkhago, aboni kok bo wansukwi romdi.
Ang office o tei kubuini kam ni bagwi 'no' sana manya. Ang tamo khwlainai?

'Glass cliff' hwnmale tamo bujio?
Glass cliff wngkha, jephru kaisa company kosto jorao tongo, o jorao kaisa bwrwi eba chuchu somaj ni borokno kotor position o rommung. O jaga o fail wngnani chance belai bara wngo.

Ang office o tei kubuini kam ni bagwi 'no' sana manya. Ang tamo khwlainai?

Nwng 'sandwich' method use khwlaiwi mano: (1) Kaisa kaham kok sadi, (2) Ulo nini 'no' no karan bai sadi, (3) Pogsao tei kaisa kaham kok sadi. Jemon, 'Nini o project belai interesting, phiya tabuk ang tei kaisa deadline o busy. Omo pognani ulo ang chubai mano da?'.
'Glass cliff' hwnmale tamo bujio?
Glass cliff wngkha, jephru kaisa company kosto jorao tongo, o jorao kaisa bwrwi eba chuchu somaj ni borokno kotor position o rommung. O jaga o fail wngnani chance belai bara wngo.
Angno kaisa kaham professional development goal ni example ri di.
Kaisa kaham goal wngnai: 'O 6 tal ni bisingo, ang kaisa online course (jemon Advanced Excel) joton khwlaiwi, ani report sanani time no 20% kom khwlainai'.
Ang Scotland beraina thangnai. 'Loch Ness Monster' kubui da?
Loch Ness Monster, 'Nessie', ni kothoma belai mungsajak, phiya tabuk jora jora bini tongmungni jeba scientific প্রমাণ kwrwi. Phiya, Loch Ness twithu sakbaithang belai naithok jaga.
'Geneva Conventions' tamo niyam tongo?

Geneva Conventions wngkha kaisa international niyam, jeba jhogra jorao borokni bebohar no control khwlaio. Bini main kok wngkha, jhograo jora wngya borok (civilians) tei jot wngjak soldierrokno bachimung.
Angno kaisa ajgubi jaga ni kok sa, jeba hayungo tongo.
Yemen haste ni Socotra island belai ajgubi. Aroni buphangrok tei malmatarok hayungni tei kubuni jeba jaga o mano ya. Aroni 'Dragon's Blood Tree' belai mungsajak.
Ang kaisa solo trip o Europe thangnai. Train pass paina kaham da?

Au, kaham. Nwng jodi kwbangma şehir beraina mwkhago, 'Eurail Pass' paina kaham wngo. Abo nwngno kaisa fixed jora ni bagwi kwbangma train o himna sujog rio. Abo ticket kaisa kaisa khwlaiwi painani swlai kom dam wngo.
Ang beraina thangma jorao, local mui chahna kirio, bohok hamya wngnai hwnwi.
Nwng o dukanrok o chahdi, jeba o local borok belai kwbangma tongo. Jeba jaga kwthar nugo tei chahmung nini mokol ni swkang sano, o jaga rok sadharanoto safe wngo.
Ang kaisa kothoma ni bagwi 'anti-villain' sanai. Abo bahai wngo?

Anti-villain wngkha o rokom ni hamya borok, jeba ni goal eba wansukmung kaham, phiya o goal no manani bagwi bini lama hamya. Jemon, Thanos (The Avengers) hayungno bachina mwkhago, phiya bini lama borok tharmung.
Angno kaisa kothoma ni 'prompt' ri di, jeba science fiction wngo.

'Hayungni joto borokni wansukmungrok jephruphano khwnajak kaisa khorango swlaijakha. Sirif khoroksa borok se o khorangno khwnaya, tei joto bono ajgubi hwnwi wansukgo. Phiya, bo se joto ni goranno saimango.'
'Breaking the fourth wall' ni ulta 'Building the fourth wall' wngna mano da?

Au, wngna mano. Abo wngkha, kothoma ni bisingo characterrok sakno sak phunugo ke bohrok kothoma ni bisingo tongo, phiya porinai eba nainai borokno ignore khwlaio. Abo tei bo kotor 'suspension of disbelief' sano.
Angno kaisa naithok Kokborok mung sa, kaisa bubar ni dukan ni bagwi.
Nwng 'Bubar ni Imang' (Dream of Flowers), 'Motom Nok' (House of Fragrance), eba 'Khirwi Bubar' (Flower of Peace) hai mung romna mano.
Ang 'origami' swrwngna mwkhago. Puila tamo sanai?
Puila, nwng kaisa simple 'paper crane' (tok) sano swrwngna mano. Abo origami ni joto ni swlai mungsajak tei bini bisingo kwbangma basic fold swrwngjak wngo.
'Sisu' buphangno tamoni bagwi Tripura ni kami amchai o kwbangma phunugo?
Sisu buphang belai kodo kotor wngo, kaham saya rio, tei bini bol belai gwran wngo, jeba nukhung sanani tei furniture sanani belai kam o phai-o. Aboni bagwi se kwbangma phunugo.
'Jamatia Hoda' ni kotor kam tamo?
'Jamatia Hoda' wngkha Jamatia bosongni joto ni swlai kotor somaj ni organization. Bohrok Jamatia somaj ni niyam-kanun, culture, tei jhogra-jhati bichar khwlaimung ni kam khwlaio.
'Locus of control' hwnmale psychology o tamo?

'Locus of control' hwnmale, nwng nini langmao wngnai घटनाrokno bahai nugo. 'Internal locus' tongkhe, nwng wansukgo ke nwng se joto no control khwlaio. 'External locus' tongkhe, nwng wansukgo ke bahira ni samung (bhagya) se joto no control khwlaio.
Ang kaisa kothoma swinai, jeba ni pogsao joto no ajgubi khwlainai.
Nwng kaisa kothoma swina mano, jeba o main character pogsao saimano ke bo sak se o kothoma ni swikwrwng, tei bo jeba swio, abo se kubui wngwi tongo.
Angno kaisa mwnwinai kok sa, jeba wansuk bo rwnai.
Jephru chwng chuchu, chwng 'tamoni' swng-o. Jephru chwng kotor wngo, chwng 'tamoni ya' swng-o.
Angni langma kaisa bijap wngkhe, ang page no ultaina kirio.
Kiriyadi ta. Joto kwtal page o kaisa kwtal sujog tei kahani lukui tongo. Nwng o bijapni swikwrwng. Nwng hamjak khe se kahani swkang himnai.
'Meraki' hwnwi kaisa Greek kok tongo, abo tamo?
'Meraki' hwnmale, jeba kam no khwlaio, aboni bisingo nini sakni kaisa bhag, nini hamjakmung, tei atma no rommung. Abo sirif kam ya, kaisa passion wngo.
Angni joto swngmungni kiphilmung rikha. Nwng kaisa kothoma ni bijap hai.
Belai hambai. Ang asha khwlaio ke o bijap ni joto chapter nwngno khusi tei aklangmung rinai. Teisa kwtal chapter ni bagwi jephruphano lamsogo!
Ang kaisa video ni audio quality no kaham khwlaina mwkhago. Tamo software use khwlainai?

Nwng 'Audacity' (free) eba 'Adobe Audition' (paid) use khwlaiwi mano. O software rok bai nwng bahira ni khorang (background noise) no kom khwlaiwi mano, tei audio no tei bo suri tei kwthar khwlaiwi mano.
Angni computer o 'blue light filter' on khwlaimung ni lab tamo?

Blue light filter on khwlaikhe, screen ni simi ongnai pimol chwngmung kom wngo. O chwngmung chini mokolno leng rio tei thumungni hormone 'melatonin' no ongna bathak-o. Horo computer use khwlaikhe, abo belai kaham.
'eSIM' tei 'physical SIM' ni bisingo pharak tamo?
Physical SIM kaisa chuchu card, jeba no phone o hapsina nango. eSIM wngkha kaisa digital SIM, jeba phone ni bisingo se tongo. Abo bai nwng network swlainani belai easy, kwtal SIM paina nangya.

Angno kaisa kaham 'ad blocker' ni mung sa, browser ni bagwi.
Nwng 'uBlock Origin' use khwlaiwi mano. Abo belai heleng, fast, tei kwbangma rokom ni ads tei tracker rokno block khwlaio. Abo Chrome tei Firefox nwi o no mano.

Kaisa ya. Nwi no ferment khwlaijak bwtwi, phiya kefir o doi ni swlai tei bo kwbangma rokom ni kaham bacteria tei yeast tongo. Kefir tei bo base wngo doi ni swlai.

Adaptogens wngkha kisa buphang eba mushroom (jemon Ashwagandha, Tulsi), jeba rok chini mangno stress bai milaina chubai-o. Kisa research tongo ke bohrok cortisol (stress hormone) no kom khwlaio.
Angni yasi o 'pins and needles' (jhin jhin wngmung) feeling wngo. Tamo karan?

Abo kaisa jaga o lama jora achukmani eba thumani bagwi blood circulation kom wngmani bagwi wngo. Phiya, jephruphano wngkhe eba tei bo kosto wngkhe, abo nerve ni samasya ni lakshan bo wngwi mano. Doctor phunukmung kaham.

Ang kaisa solo trip o Europe thangnai. Train pass paina kaham da?

Nwng o dukanrok o chahdi, jeba o local borok belai kwbangma tongo. Jeba jaga kwthar nugo tei chahmung nini mokol ni swkang sano, o jaga rok sadharanoto safe wngo.
Ang kaisa kothoma ni bagwi 'anti-villain' sanai. Abo bahai wngo?

Angno kaisa kothoma ni 'prompt' ri di, jeba science fiction wngo.

'Hayungni joto borokni wansukmungrok jephruphano khwnajak kaisa khorango swlaijakha. Sirif khoroksa borok se o khorangno khwnaya, tei joto bono ajgubi hwnwi wansukgo. Phiya, bo se joto ni goranno saimango.'
'Breaking the fourth wall' ni ulta 'Building the fourth wall' wngna mano da?

Au, wngna mano. Abo wngkha, kothoma ni bisingo characterrok sakno sak phunugo ke bohrok kothoma ni bisingo tongo, phiya porinai eba nainai borokno ignore khwlaio. Abo tei bo kotor 'suspension of disbelief' sano.
Angno kaisa naithok Kokborok mung sa, kaisa bubar ni dukan ni bagwi.
Nwng 'Bubar ni Imang' (Dream of Flowers), 'Motom Nok' (House of Fragrance), eba 'Khirwi Bubar' (Flower of Peace) hai mung romna mano.
Ang 'origami' swrwngna mwkhago. Puila tamo sanai?
Puila, nwng kaisa simple 'paper crane' (tok) sano swrwngna mano. Abo origami ni joto ni swlai mungsajak tei bini bisingo kwbangma basic fold swrwngjak wngo.
'Sisu' buphangno tamoni bagwi Tripura ni kami amchai o kwbangma phunugo?
Sisu buphang belai kodo kotor wngo, kaham saya rio, tei bini bol belai gwran wngo, jeba nukhung sanani tei furniture sanani belai kam o phai-o. Aboni bagwi se kwbangma phunugo.
'Jamatia Hoda' ni kotor kam tamo?
'Jamatia Hoda' wngkha Jamatia bosongni joto ni swlai kotor somaj ni organization. Bohrok Jamatia somaj ni niyam-kanun, culture, tei jhogra-jhati bichar khwlaimung ni kam khwlaio.

Ang kaisa solo trip o Europe thangnai. Train pass paina kaham da?

'Breaking the fourth wall' ni ulta 'Building the fourth wall' wngna mano da?

'Jamatia Hoda' ni kotor kam tamo?

Kaisa kaham goal wngnai: 'O 6 tal ni bisingo, ang kaisa online course (jemon Advanced Excel) joton khwlaiwi, ani report sanani time no 20% kom khwlainai'.
Ang Scotland beraina thangnai. 'Loch Ness Monster' kubui da?

Angno kaisa ajgubi jaga ni kok sa, jeba hayungo tongo.

Ang kaisa solo trip o Europe thangnai. Train pass paina kaham da?

Au, kaham. Nwng jodi kwbangma şehir beraina mwkhago, 'Eurail Pass' paina kaham wngo. Abo nwngno kaisa fixed jora ni bagwi kwbangma train o himna sujog rio. Abo ticket kaisa kaisa khwlaiwi painani swlai kom dam wngo.

Nwng o dukanrok o chahdi, jeba o local borok belai kwbangma tongo. Jeba jaga kwthar nugo tei chahmung nini mokol ni swkang sano, o jaga rok sadharanoto safe wngo.
Ang kaisa kothoma ni bagwi 'anti-villain' sanai. Abo bahai wngo?

Angno kaisa kothoma ni 'prompt' ri di, jeba science fiction wngo.

'Breaking the fourth wall' ni ulta 'Building the fourth wall' wngna mano da?

'Jamatia Hoda' ni kotor kam tamo?

Angno kaisa ajgubi jaga ni kok sa, jeba hayungo tongo.
Yemen haste ni Socotra island belai ajgubi. Aroni buphangrok tei malmatarok hayungni tei kubuni jeba jaga o mano ya. Aroni 'Dragon's Blood Tree' belai mungsajak.
Ang kaisa solo trip o Europe thangnai. Train pass paina kaham da?

Au, kaham. Nwng jodi kwbangma şehir beraina mwkhago, 'Eurail Pass' paina kaham wngo. Abo nwngno kaisa fixed jora ni bagwi kwbangma train o himna sujog rio. Abo ticket kaisa kaisa khwlaiwi painani swlai kom dam wngo.
Ang beraina thangma jorao, local mui chahna kirio, bohok hamya wngnai hwnwi.
Nwng o dukanrok o chahdi, jeba o local borok belai kwbangma tongo. Jeba jaga kwthar nugo tei chahmung nini mokol ni swkang sano, o jaga rok sadharanoto safe wngo.
Ang kaisa kothoma ni bagwi 'anti-villain' sanai. Abo bahai wngo?

Anti-villain wngkha o rokom ni hamya borok, jeba ni goal eba wansukmung kaham, phiya o goal no manani bagwi bini lama hamya. Jemon, Thanos (The Avengers) hayungno bachina mwkhago, phiya bini lama borok tharmung.
Angno kaisa kothoma ni 'prompt' ri di, jeba science fiction wngo.

'Hayungni joto borokni wansukmungrok jephruphano khwnajak kaisa khorango swlaijakha. Sirif khoroksa borok se o khorangno khwnaya, tei joto bono ajgubi hwnwi wansukgo. Phiya, bo se joto ni goranno saimango.'
'Breaking the fourth wall' ni ulta 'Building the fourth wall' wngna mano da?

Au, wngna mano. Abo wngkha, kothoma ni bisingo characterrok sakno sak phunugo ke bohrok kothoma ni bisingo tongo, phiya porinai eba nainai borokno ignore khwlaio. Abo tei bo kotor 'suspension of disbelief' sano.
Angno kaisa naithok Kokborok mung sa, kaisa bubar ni dukan ni bagwi.
Nwng 'Bubar ni Imang' (Dream of Flowers), 'Motom Nok' (House of Fragrance), eba 'Khirwi Bubar' (Flower of Peace) hai mung romna mano.
Ang 'origami' swrwngna mwkhago. Puila tamo sanai?
Puila, nwng kaisa simple 'paper crane' (tok) sano swrwngna mano. Abo origami ni joto ni swlai mungsajak tei bini bisingo kwbangma basic fold swrwngjak wngo.
'Sisu' buphangno tamoni bagwi Tripura ni kami amchai o kwbangma phunugo?
Sisu buphang belai kodo kotor wngo, kaham saya rio, tei bini bol belai gwran wngo, jeba nukhung sanani tei furniture sanani belai kam o phai-o. Aboni bagwi se kwbangma phunugo.
'Jamatia Hoda' ni kotor kam tamo?
'Jamatia Hoda' wngkha Jamatia bosongni joto ni swlai kotor somaj ni organization. Bohrok Jamatia somaj ni niyam-kanun, culture, tei jhogra-jhati bichar khwlaimung ni kam khwlaio.

Nwng kaisa kothoma swina mano, jeba o main character pogsao saimano ke bo sak se o kothoma ni swikwrwng, tei bo jeba swio, abo se kubui wngwi tongo.

Jephru chwng chuchu, chwng 'tamoni' swng-o. Jephru chwng kotor wngo, chwng 'tamoni ya' swng-o.

Kiriyadi ta. Joto kwtal page o kaisa kwtal sujog tei kahani lukui tongo. Nwng o bijapni swikwrwng. Nwng hamjak khe se kahani swkang himnai.
'Meraki' hwnwi kaisa Greek kok tongo, abo tamo?
'Meraki' hwnmale, jeba kam no khwlaio, aboni bisingo nini sakni kaisa bhag, nini hamjakmung, tei atma no rommung. Abo sirif kam ya, kaisa passion wngo.

Belai hambai. Ang asha khwlaio ke o bijap ni joto chapter nwngno khusi tei aklangmung rinai. Teisa kwtal chapter ni bagwi jephruphano lamsogo!
